card.flavor: "This time, the Earth will rise to form our battlefield, and no Akodo or Isawa will be present to hide the Shiba from our ise zumi." - Tamori Shaitung

card.name: Isawa Osugi
card.text:
Phoenix Clan Prodigy • Shugenja • Unique
Any effect that would give Isawa Osugi the Shadowlands trait is canceled and has all effects negated. Isawa Osugi cannot have more than one Spell attached at any time. Spells have their Gold cost reduced to 0 when being attached to Isawa Osugi.

card.name: Isawa Tsuke - exp
card.text:
Phoenix Clan Shugenja • Master of Fire • Shadowlands • Experienced • Unique • Tsuke takes a -1C corruption token whenever he straightens. Tsuke gains a 3C bonus when dueling a Shadowlands Personality.
Limited: Bow Tsuke and issue a challenge that may not be refused to any Personality in play. Tsuke is dishonored if the target isn't Shadowlands. During this duel, Tsuke has an additional 3C bonus.

card.name: Kaiu Pass
card.text:
Industrial Region
Any Personality coming into play from this Province may immediately have a weapon or armor attached. All costs must be paid normally, but gold cost of the item is reduced by 4.

card.name: Kaiu Utsu
card.text:
Crab Clan Siege Master • May only attach Followers that can destroy a Fortification.
Battle: Bow for a Ranged 2 Attack.
Battle: Bow to reduce this Province's strength by three until the end of this turn.

card.name: Kakita Shijin
card.text:
Crane Clan Poet
Reaction: Bow immediately after one of your Personalities has been destroyed. You gain honor equal to the Personality's current Personal Honor.

card.name: Kasuga Kyoji
card.text:
Unaligned Ancient Librarian • Cannot be targeted with Feign Death.
Limited: Bow and pay 5 gold to draw a Fate card.
Limited: Bow and destroy the Librarian to draw five Fate cards.
card.flavor: I will trade your bloody battlefield for the solitude of this place on any day.

card.name: Kisada's Blockade
card.text: Trade Routes and Ports produce zero gold until the next Trade Route or Port is put into play.
card.flavor: He sailed legions of men up the coast of Rokugan, and marched into the Imperial Palace. He expected to find an empty throne; what he found was his doom. - The Doom of Hantei, Part One

card.name: Kolat Instigator
card.text: Limited: Lose 2 Honor. Target a Personality who must issue a challenge to a Personality of his controller's choice. This challenge can be refused without penalty.

card.name: Kolat Interference
card.text: Open: This action is only playable during a player's Action Phase. The current player cannot draw any Fate cards this turn. Lose 3 Honor.
card.flavor: "The thief went that way!" - Ichiin

card.name: Kusatte Iru
card.text:
Unaligned Shadowlands Oni • Unique • Lose 5 Honor • No Items or Followers.
Reaction: Immediately after a Battle Resolution Phase in which Iru and the Province it was defending was destroyed, you may destroy any one Province of the Attacker. Lose 15 Honor. You may perform this action even if this was your last Province.

card.name: Kyojin
card.text:
Unaligned Shadowlands Enforcer • Double Chi • Nonhuman • Lose 4 honor • Kyojin is dishonored if he is bowed when Junzo is challenged, and is destroyed if Junzo is ever destroyed.
Reaction: Bow to replace Junzo with Kyojin in a duel when it is accepted.

card.name: Lies, Lies, Lies...
card.text: Political Limited: If you have no cards in play or in your discard piles that cause their player an Honor loss or have the Shadowlands, Ninja, or Kolat keywords: Gain 8 Honor; this gain can not raise your Family Honor above it's starting value.

card.name: Mantle of Fire
card.text:
Reaction: When this Personality wins a duel, play the Ring of Fire from your Hand.
Elemental Reaction: When this Personality would focus, instead destroy the Mantle of Fire to end the duel without resolution and send this Personality home bowed.

card.name: Matsu Seijuro
card.text:
Lion Clan Samurai
Limited: Bow Matsu Seijuro. Challenge any one Personality in play that you do not control.
Reaction: When Matsu Seijuro issues a challenge that is refused, any Fear effect he produces in the future will be at +1 strength (cumulative).
Battle: Fear 0.

card.name: Mikaru
card.text:
Unaligned Hunter of Nagas
Will not join Naga players or attach Naga Followers. The Hunter is +2F while there is a Naga in the opposing army, and has a 3C bonus in a duel against a Naga.
card.flavor: "Like the sash?"

card.name: Mikio
card.text:
Unaligned Bodyguard • Toturi's Army • Samurai • Double Chi
Mikio is dishonored if he is bowed when Toturi is challenged, and is destroyed (commits seppuku) if Toturi is ever destroyed.
Reaction: Bow to replace Toturi with Mikio in a duel as it is accepted.

card.name: Minor Shugenja
card.text:
Minor Shugenja have +1C while participating in a Ritual that this Personality also participates in. (Followers cannot cast Kihos.)
Battle: Bow Minor Shugenja for a Ranged 1 Attack.

card.name: Monsoon
card.text: While this event is in play, any action that has given or will give a Personality a force bonus has its effects negated. All temporary bonuses are negated, but permanent bonuses and tokens that provide bonuses are not. This event stays in play until your End Phase two turns after this one.

card.name: Mountain of the Seven Thunders
card.text:
Unique
Ignore Honor requirements of Personalities in this Province.
card.flavor: Those who have seen the Cave of Thunder have already been judged worthy by their ancestors.

card.name: Naga Guard
card.text:
Naga
Battle: Bow the Naga Guard. No cards in this battle can receive any further Force bonuses (including Terrain bonuses) until after the Resolution Phase of this battle.
card.flavor: "Like a wall of scale and steel they rose from the sodden ground, and their silent eyes knew our every move." - Ikoma Ryozo

card.name: Night Battle
card.text:
Immediate Terrain.
Battle: No player without a Shugenja or a Shadowlands Personality in this battle can take actions for this battle except an action that destroys this Terrain.

card.name: Oni no Tadaka
card.text:
Phoenix Clan Captive Oni • Shadowlands • Nonhuman
All Phoenix Shugenja in play have a +1C while the Captive Oni is in play. If the Captive Oni is destroyed, all Phoenix Shugenja lose an additional 1C until the end of the current turn.
card.flavor: "I give you my name..."

card.name: Otaku Baiken
card.text:
Unicorn Clan Sergeant • Samurai
Limited: Bow Otaku Baiken. Attach a 1F Cavalry Follower token to any one of your Samurai.
card.flavor: "He follows in Kamoko's wake, cleaning up the messes she leaves behind." - Matsu Agetoki

card.name: Peasant Defense
card.text:
Battle: Terrain
The Attacker may choose to return any or all of his units (including bowed ones) in this battle to his fief, bowed. If this Province is destroyed, all Personalities that are still attacking are dishonored.
card.flavor: "I came to fight soldiers, not boys." - Hida Yakamo

card.name: Pitch and Fire
card.text:
Fortification.
Battle: If your opponent does not have Higher Ground in play, destroy Pitch and Fire for two consecutive Ranged 3 Attacks that target one unit. You can combine the ranged attacks, but other cards cannot raise the ranged attacks' strength. If you have a Fort on a Hill at this Province, the ranged attacks each have 6 strength.

card.name: Plague Skulls
card.text:
When attached, also give this Personality a -1C Plague token. Lose 6 Honor. While this card is in play, all Personalities in play with a Plague Token(s) get an additional -1C Plague token during each of your events phases.
Battle: Bow the Plague Skulls to give a -1C Plague token to an opposing Personality.

card.name: Plague-Infested Region
card.text:
Corrupted Region
Personalities entering play from this Province are immune to the effects of Plague tokens.
All Personalities in this Province at the end of the Battle Action Segment of a battle must attach a -1C Plague token.
card.flavor: We may have lost our homeland, but our loss has made us stronger. - Doji Kuwanan

card.name: Political Dissent
card.text: Political Limited: Bow one of your Personalities to prevent two players from inviting each other to ally for the rest of the game. The players may negate this effect if and when each destroys one of his or her Personalities as a Limited action, "as a sign of good will." If they do this, for the rest of the game each Samurai they send as defending allies for each other gains +2F/+2C until the battle ends.

card.name: Possession
card.text: Limited: Bow this Shugenja, and destroy this spell. Lose 5 honor. Combine one Oni and one non-Oni Personality you control into one Personality. All abilities and attached cards remain. All traits are replaced with Unaligned Shadowlands Nonhuman. Force and Chi are equal to the Personalities' combined numbers and Personal Honor is zero. If this creature is destroyed, the Oni Personality is returned to play immediately without any cards or tokens attached, but still affected by permanent effects.

card.name: Prophecy of the Hero
card.text:
Unique.
Limited: Bow this Shugenja and one of your Personalities. Give this Personality a permanent +3F/+3C bonus, but if this Personality refuses a duel or becomes dishonored, he is immediately destroyed. This spell is destroyed and may not be copied (e.g. by a scribe).

card.name: Qakar
card.text:
Naga Shugenja • Nonhuman • Qakar has a Chi bonus equal to twice the number of other Naga Shugenja you have in play.
Battle: Bow Qakar for a Ranged Attack equal to half his Chi (round down).
Battle: Bow and destroy Qakar and destroy a Pearl Bed for a Ranged Attack equal to twice his Chi.

card.name: Radakast
card.text:
Naga Constrictor • Nonhuman
Battle: Once per battle, issue a challenge to an opposing Personality that may not be refused. Neither Personality will die as a result of this duel. If Radakast wins, his opponent is bowed.

card.name: Ratling Conjuror
card.text:
Ratling Shugenja • Creature
Cannot attach Spells with a Gold cost greater than 3.
Open: Bow Ratling Conjuror and discard a card: Give all Ratlings +1F.

card.name: Refugees
card.text: Battle: If you are the Defender, you may take this action even if you control no units at the current battlefield: Move home a target Personality without Followers. Bow him if he moved. His controller may pay 1 Gold as a cost to create a 1F Ashigaru Follower card and attach it to him.

card.name: Retirement
card.text: The Human Personality (or Personalities) with the highest Chi "retires to a monastic life." The Personality permanently has -4F/+2C, permanently loses the Samurai and Shugenja traits (if any), permanently gains the Monk trait, and bows.

card.name: Rise, Brother
card.text: Battle/Open: Bow your target Personality with your Clan alignment: Straighten another target Personality with your Clan alignment.
card.flavor: "The Tao says 'One must bow to aid a fallen man.' And you believed I was impolite, cousin!"

card.name: River Region
card.text: Reaction: When you discard a card in this Province, place it at the bottom of your Dynasty deck instead of in your discard pile. Ignore anything that has happened to the card from the start of the game until now.

card.name: Scorched Earth
card.text:
Ravaged Region
Do not replace this card when it comes into play. This Province has its strength raised by five, but does not contain any Dynasty cards while this region is in play.

card.name: Shallow Victory
card.text: Battle: This must be the first action played by the Defender for a battle. If the attacking army currently has a higher Force than the defending army, then the Attacker cannot gain any Honor during this battle. The Attacker may gain honor normally after the resolution phase of this battle.

card.name: Shashakar - exp
card.text:
Experienced Naga Shugenja • Unique
Reaction: Bow Shashakar when an action is performed that lowers the Chi of any Naga card in play. The action is canceled and its effects are negated. This does not prevent Chi loss due to tokens.

card.name: Shinjo Morito - exp
card.text:
Unicorn Clan Samurai • Experienced Morito • Unique • . Cavalry
Shinjo Morito gains a 1F bonus when defending.
card.flavor: "Lead the magistrates to the south, my friend, and seek what aid the Crab can give you." - Shinjo Yokatsu

card.name: Shinjo Yasoma
card.text:
Unicorn Clan Strategist • Tactician • Samurai • Cavalry
Battle: Bow Yasoma. The terrain card currently in play for this battle is treated as if you had put it into play instead of whomever actually put it into play.

card.name: Shiryo no Akodo
card.text:
Lion Ancestor • Unique • May attach to Toturi
Reaction: This Personality may bow to gain a 1C bonus when entering a duel.
Reaction: This Personality may bow to gain a 3C bonus when entering a duel opposing a Personality with a Personal Honor lower than his.

card.name: Shiryo no Bayushi
card.text:
Scorpion Ancestor • Unique
Limited: Bow this Personality to destroy any Black Scroll in play.
Limited: Bow this Personality to destroy any corruption token in play.
card.flavor: You have turned from duty to walk the path of revenge. Only a few realize the cost they must pay when destiny comes to call.

card.name: Shiryo no Hiruma
card.text:
Crab Ancestor • Unique
This Personality gains a 1F bonus for every opposing Shadowlands card in a battle, and a 3C bonus against a Shadowlands Personality in a duel.
card.flavor: You have lost your way, young one, and that is why you cannot see the evil that festers on the Throne.

card.name: Shiryo no Isawa
card.text:
Phoenix Ancestor • Unique • Shugenja only.
This Personality may hold any number of spells, ignoring Chi limitations.
Elemental Reaction: Bow this Shugenja to cancel and negate the effects of any one elemental action as it is being activated.

card.name: Shiryo no Kakita
card.text:
Crane Ancestor • Unique
Once per duel, this Personality may focus with two Focus cards instead of one when focusing.
card.flavor: Do not think of the blade, do not think of the draw. Only he who acts with no thought will draw the purest, most perfect strike.

card.name: Shiryo no Shinjo
card.text:
Unicorn Ancestor • Unique
Cards in this unit cannot be targeted with actions by other players during the battle action segment.
card.flavor: Do not let your mind be clouded with what is proper. Let your mind be cleared with what is right.

card.name: Shiryo no Togashi
card.text:
Dragon Ancestor • Unique
This Personality may attach and use one spell as if he or she were a Shugenja while this card is in play.
Challenges issued by this Personality may not be refused.

card.name: Slander
card.text: Political Reaction: Play this card after a Personality enters play. Negate all Honor gains for the Personality entering play.

card.name: Spiritual Presence
card.text:
Open: Bow this shugenja to add his printed Chi to the Force of any Personality in play until the end of the turn.
Open: Bow this shugenja and destroy this spell to add his current Chi to the Force of any Personality in play until the end of the turn.

card.name: Stall Until Sunrise
card.text:
Battle: Terrain
All Shadowlands cards in this battle have their forces halved (round down).
card.flavor: Again and again they retreated from the Shadowlands army until they saw the fear dawning in the Oni's eyes.

card.name: Stealing the Soul
card.text: Ritual Limited: Bow this Shugenja and any number of other Shugenja you control. Target a Personality who loses -X Force and -X Chi until the beginning of your next turn (minimum zero), where X is the number of Shugenja in the ritual. Add Force and Chi to any Personality in play until the end of the turn equal to the amount lost by the first target. If either target Personality is destroyed this turn, destroy this spell.

card.name: Stifling Wind
card.text:
Elemental Battle: Bow this Shugenja to bow an opposing Follower.
Elemental Battle: Bow this Shugenja to bow a Personality with no unbowed Followers.

card.name: Strategic Victory
card.text:
Battle: Terrain.
This card must be put into play as the first action played by the Attacker. If your army is victorious and will destroy the Province, instead of destroying the Province, you may declare a "strategic victory": all of the Defender's holdings that are bowed must remain bowed until the beginning of your next turn.

card.name: Summon Nightstalker
card.text: Limited: Bow this Shugenja and destroy this spell. Target Personality loses 1C permanently during each of his or her controller's Events Phases while this Shugenja remains in play.

card.name: Suzume Mukashino
card.text:
Unaligned Samurai • Venerable Storyteller • May remain bowed.
Limited: Bow to bow any one Human Personality who has a Personal honor of at least 3. The target's controller gains 1 honor. The target Personality may remain bowed, but if the Personality chooses to straighten while Mukashino is and has remained bowed, the Personality is dishonored.

card.name: Takuan
card.text:
Toturi's Army Lieutenant • Samurai
All other Toturi's Army Personalities in Takuan's army gain a 1F/1C bonus.
card.flavor:
Takuan turned to the Imperial Advisor behind the Jade Throne. "Help me, Yoshi. I was not trained to rule an Empire."
The Crane smiled and raised his fan in contemplation. "Then I shall rule it for you, my friend."

card.name: Tapestry of Air
card.text:
Reaction: When this Personality performs or participates in a Ritual with two or more other Shugenja, play the Ring of Air from your hand.
Elemental Reaction: When a Kiho, Spell, or innate ability targets this Personality, destroy the Tapestry of Air to cancel that action.

card.name: Tessen
card.text: Reaction: When an Assassin action targets this Personality, bow the Tessen to cancel it.

card.name: The Blood Feud
card.text: Limited: Target a Personality who is marked for death until the end of the game. Lose 4 Honor. Any Personality may challenge this Personality by bowing as a limited action. This challenge may be refused at a loss of 3 honor and dishonoring the Personality. Any player may remove the mark of death by discarding the Imperial Favor as a Limited action.

card.name: The Bronze Gong of the Hantei
card.text:
Unique Fortification
Battle: Bow one opposing Follower or Personality without unbowed Followers. This can be done three times during any battle at this Province.

card.name: The Celestial Pattern
card.text: Negate the effects of the next Event that resolves.

card.name: The Darkest Day
card.text: All Personalities in play with a Personal Honor above two are bowed.
card.flavor: Now all began to realize the meaning of the prophecy: "When the last Akodo falls, so falls the last Hantei." - The Doom of Hantei, Part III

card.name: The Face of Fear
card.text: Reaction: Play when one of your cards creates Fear. The Fear affects Personalities as if they were Followers.

card.name: The Perfect Gift
card.text: Reaction: Bow one of your Personalities with Personal Honor above 1 when another player has bowed a Personality to lobby for the Imperial Favor. If the Favor is uncontrolled, the lobbying attempt is cancelled, and you gain control of the Imperial Favor. This still counts as a lobbying attempt.

card.name: The Return of Fu Leng
card.text: All players have their rightmost Province destroyed. Each player may elect to renounce their ability to win through an Honor Victory to prevent their Province from being destroyed, unless they are already unable to win through an Honor Victory (such as Scorpion, Naga, and Junzo's Army).

card.name: The Tao of the Naga
card.text: Until the end of the game, units led by a Naga Personality cannot be targeted with an effect from the Imperial Favor. Naga Players cannot lobby to gain the Imperial Favor this game.

card.name: The Way of Air
card.text: Limited: Bow one of your Shugenja who becomes an Adept of Air. This Shugenja gets a 2F/2C bonus while you have the Ring of Air in play. This Shugenja permanently gains the ability: Reaction elemental: Bow this Shugenja to negate the effects of any action that originates from a card that contains the word "water" in the title, in the trait text, or in the text of the action.

card.name: The Way of Earth
card.text: Limited: Bow one of your Shugenja who becomes an Adept of Earth. This Shugenja gets a 2F/2C bonus while you have the Ring of Earth in play. This Shugenja permanently gains the ability: Reaction elemental: Bow this Shugenja to negate the effects of any action that originates from a card that contains the words "wind" or "air" in the title, in the trait text, or in the text of the action.

card.name: The Way of Fire
card.text: Limited: Bow one of your Shugenja who becomes an Adept of Fire. This Shugenja gets a 2F/2C bonus while you have the Ring of Fire in play. This Shugenja permanently gains the ability: Reaction elemental: Bow this Shugenja to negate the effects of any action that originates from a card that contains the word "earth" in the title, in the trait text, or in the text of the action.

card.name: The Way of Water
card.text: Limited: Bow one of your Shugenja who becomes an Adept of Water. This Shugenja gets a 2F/2C bonus while you have the Ring of Water in play. This Shugenja permanently gains the ability: Reaction elemental: Bow this Shugenja to negate the effects of any action that originates from a card that contains the words "fire" in the title, in the trait text, or in the text of the action.

card.name: There is No Hope
card.text: Until the end of the game, any Festival event that appears is discarded without effect.

card.name: To Avenge Our Ancestors
card.text: Reaction: Play at the end of the assignment phase. Choose a battle, in which all honor gains and losses will be doubled for all players during the resolution phase. This is not cumulative with any other honor-doubling effect.
card.flavor: "Today, we avenge our ancestors or we join them." - Doji Hoturi

card.name: To Do What We Must
card.text: Battle: Target and destroy a unit you control led by an unbowed Personality: Target a unit opposing it with total Force less than or equal to your unit's total Force, plus your Personality's Personal Honor, plus 2 if your Personality is Crane Clan. Destroy the opposing unit.

card.name: To the Last Man
card.text: Reaction: Play this card after a Resolution Segment during which the opposing player destroyed an army containing one or more of your units. The opposing player must destroy a number of cards and tokens in his or her army whose total Force is greater than or equal to half of your army's Force, rounded up. The player's bowed cards contribute their Force for this effect as if they were unbowed.

card.name: Togashi Yama
card.text:
Dragon Clan Shugenja
Limited: Bow to put a Mountain token on one of your Provinces. As a battle action, you may send home all units attacking one of your Provinces by destroying a number of Mountain tokens at that Province equal to the number of attacking units. You may not send home fewer than all of the attackers in this fashion.

card.name: Togashi Yokuni - exp
card.text:
Dragon Clan Champion • Experienced • Unique • Samurai • Shugenja • Double Chi • Will only join Dragon Clan player.
Battle: Discard a Fate card from your hand to produce a Ranged Attack equal to the focus value of the discard. This does not bow Yokuni. This Ranged Attack may not be increased in strength or combined with others.

card.name: Tomb of Iuchiban
card.text:
Unique.
Reaction: Bow to give a permanent 1F/1C bonus to any non-oni Shadowlands Personality as you are bringing it into play.
card.flavor: Behind those doors lie unknown treasures. Behind those doors lie horrors beyond imagining.

card.name: Tortuous Terrain
card.text:
Battle: Terrain
All Personalities and Followers with a current Force greater than eight have their Force reduced to eight.
card.flavor: "Those on a straight way thrive. Those on a tortuous course die." - Sun Tzu

card.name: Toturi - exp
card.text:
Unaligned Toturi's Army Samurai • Unique • Experienced • Tactician • Double Chi • Toturi is always -2F/-3C while dishonored.
Reaction: Bow Toturi immediately after an open or battle action is initiated but before it is resolved during a battle at which Toturi is assigned. The action is cancelled and its effects are negated.

card.name: Training Grounds
card.text: Each Follower gains +1F while defending this Province.

card.name: Traveling Poet
card.text: The Personal Honor of this Personality is increased by one while the Traveling Poet is in play.
card.flavor: "How can I forget my duty while he sings song of the courage of my ancestors?" - Daidoji Uji

card.name: Treacherous Terrain
card.text:
Delayed Terrain.
If you are the Defender, you may play this card during a battle in which you have no units.
Battle: Lower to 0 all Force bonuses each Personality and Follower in this battle has received from cards outside the unit.

card.name: Tsukuro
card.text:
Unaligned Shadowlands Undead General • Nonhuman • Lose 5 honor.
All Shadowlands Followers in Tsukuro's army have a 1F bonus.

card.name: Valley of Shadow
card.text:
Unique Shadow Region • Lose 3 honor.
Any Shadowlands Personality or Follower cards that are destroyed during a battle at this Province are shuffled back into their controllers' appropriate decks instead of going to the discard pile.

card.name: Watchtower
card.text:
Fortification.
No player may play Sneak Attack during a battle at this Province.
Reaction: Once per battle, after the first time the Attacker or an attacking ally plays a Terrain during battle at this Province, destroy the Terrain. You may take this action during a battle in which you have no units.

card.name: Wetlands
card.text: Raise the strength of each ranged attack by 1 during battle at this Province.

card.name: Yodin
card.text:
Unaligned Monk • Unique
Reaction: Bow as you are putting an Elemental Ring into play. Go through your fate deck and remove any one Elemental Ring. Show the Ring to your opponents, then put it in your Fate hand. Reshuffle your Fate deck.
card.flavor: Do not laugh at my garden, samurai. If you look, you can find secrets of the universe within its pattern.

card.name: Yogo Ichiba
card.text:
Scorpion Clan Merchant
Open: Bow and target any face up Dynasty card that is not in play. The gold cost of that card is permanently raised or lowered by two.
card.flavor: "I am sorry to hear of your loss, my friend. I guess you will have to purchase your silk from me after all, eh?"

card.name: Yoritomo Kamoto
card.text:
Mantis Samurai • Toturi's Army • Tactician
Yoritomo Kamoto cannot have more than one Follower attached. Yoritomo Kamoto's Follower gains a 2F bonus while attached to him.
card.flavor: The path of betrayal shimmers with plundered gold.

card.name: A Glimpse of the Soul's Shadow
card.text: Kiho Battle: Bow one of your Shugenja in this battle for Fear equal to his or her Chi.
card.flavor: "Samurai, you anger me. I warn you not to do so again, lest the kami alter your place in the Celestial Pattern." - Toturi Sezaru

card.name: A Samurai's Fury
card.text: Reaction: After resolving Delayed Terrains (if any), target a Samurai you control at the current battlefield with more than 2 Chi: Take an Open or Battle action.

card.name: Agasha Heizo
card.text:
Dragon Clan Shugenja
Open: Bow Heizo. Assign a force penalty to Heizo up to his current force total. Give an equal force bonus to any Personality you control. The penalty and bonus last until end of the turn.
card.flavor: "Perhaps the summer he spent with Tsuke did not go to waste." - Mirumoto Hitomi

card.name: Along the Coast at Midnight
card.text:
This card's printed Gold cost equals the number of unbowed Personalities you control.
Open: Give the Cavalry trait to all Personalities and Followers you control.

card.name: An Oni's Fury
card.text: Battle: Target an opposing Oni. The Oni's controller must immediately destroy one of his Personalities in this battle, or else the Oni is destroyed.
card.flavor: "Don't tell me you cannot trust an Oni. You can always count on it losing control." - Toku

card.name: Ancestral Guidance
card.text: Kiho Open: Bow one of your Shugenja or Monks. Give one of your Samurai the Tactician trait until the end of the turn.
card.flavor: "I will never forget him. His face is burned upon my memory. Can you say his hand does not still guide my heart?" - Shiba Tsukune

card.name: Ancestral Weapons of the Mantis
card.text:
Unique Weapon • This Item can only be attached to a Mantis Clan Personality.
When this item is being brought into play, you may spend additional gold to add one or more of the following bonuses and traits permanently: 3 gold - +2F/+2C, 5 gold - Tactician, 5 gold - Double Chi. Each bonus can only be taken once. Traits are conferred to the Personality while the weapon is attached.

card.name: Antidote
card.text:
Limited: Destroy the antidote to destroy all tokens on this Personality that create a Chi penalty.
Reaction: Destroy the antidote to cancel any poison action targeting this Personality.
card.flavor: "My Lady sends you her regards," Akiyoshi said as he presented the gift. "And she hopes it will keep you out of trouble, Toturi-sama."

card.name: Architects of the Wall
card.text:
You can search your Dynasty deck and attach any one Fortification to this Province. The Gold cost of the Fortification is reduced by half (round down).
You can either discard this Event or reshuffle it into the deck. Reshuffle the deck.
This Event resolves every time it arises for every player.

card.name: Are You With Me?
card.text: All Followers in the game cost 6 less Gold, to a minimum of 1, until the start of your next turn.

card.name: Armor of the Shadow Warrior
card.text:
Unique
Cards in this unit may not be the target of spells or Innate Abilities.
card.flavor: No longer able to lead his armies, Kisada has passed his armor to another...

card.name: Armory
card.text:
Bow the Armory to produce 3 Gold when paying for non-Unique Armor or a non-Unique Weapon.
Open: Bow the Armory to give a +2F bonus to a Follower.
card.flavor: "Yes, I am aware that Seung has many finely crafted weapons on display in his shop. I am more interested in the items he does not display." - Yoritomo Ekiken

card.name: Asahina Tomo - exp
card.text: Crane Clan Shugenja • Experienced • Unique • Tomo gains a 2F bonus when defending. Tomo gains a 1F/2C bonus when facing Shadowlands cards in a battle or duel.
card.flavor: When the war began, he was a simple old man, but when the blood of his brethren fell, it awakened a fire in his soul that will never rest.

card.name: Ashamana
card.text:
Naga Youth
Limited: Bow Ashamana and discard him from play. Take any one of your Honorable Dead Naga Personalities and return it to play bowed. You cannot bring back a Personality that swore fealty to the Naga.

card.name: Barbarian Horde
card.text: Battle: A 4F/1C Cavalry Personality joins your army for this battle. This Personality is discarded from play immediately after the resolution phase of this battle. You may only use this action if you have a unit in this battle, and if all of your units in this battle are Cavalry units. Lose 3 Honor.

card.name: Battle at Isawa Palace
card.text: All players may get any one spell from their Fate Deck to add to their hand and then reshuffle.

card.name: Bayushi Tasu
card.text:
Scorpion Clan Killer
Limited: Bow Tasu to challenge a bowed Shadowlands Personality to a duel that cannot be refused.
card.flavor: Against her command, he followed Kachiko to her secret meeting with her husband, and it was his courage that saved her from Shoju's vile caresses.

card.name: Borderland
card.text: When the Borderland enters play, target a Holding in play. If this Province is destroyed, then destroy the Holding.
card.flavor: Do not swear on the border stones between the Great Clans, for you will outlive the stones.

card.name: Breaking Blow
card.text: Reaction: Play this card face up as a focus in a duel. Target one item attached to the opposing Personality. The target item is immediately destroyed.
card.flavor: "Hirariko caught the blade in the folds of her kimono. I heard the steel snap as her own blade came for my throat."

card.name: Bridged Pass
card.text:
Fortification
Battle: Destroy the Bridged Pass to end this battle without resolution. All units go home without bowing.
card.flavor: Sometimes wisdom consists of burning bridges before you cross them.

card.name: Brothers of Thunder
card.text: Can only be attached to Monk Personalities. This Follower has a 1F bonus for each Ring you have in play.
card.flavor: They fought as if they knew each other's every thought, as if they had fought together for a thousand years.

card.name: Carrier Pigeon
card.text: Battle: If you are the Defender: Target a unit you control that has not been at the current battlefield at any time during this attack and was not prevented from assigning to it this attack by card or Stronghold effects. Straighten the unit. Move it to the current battlefield.

card.name: Catching the Wind's Favor
card.text: Kiho Reaction: Bow one of your Shugenja or Monks when a ranged attack is targeting a card in his or her army. If the strength of the ranged attack is lower than the caster's Chi, redirect the ranged attack to any other card in this battle that can be the target of a ranged attack (including cards in the opposing army). If the strength of the ranged attack is less than the Force of the new target, the ranged attack has no effect.

card.name: Chime of Harmony
card.text: The Chime of Harmony gains +3C while this Personality attaches Spells, creates Spell effects, and uses innate abilities.
card.flavor: "One to calm the mind. Two to gather the kami. Three to send the kami forth once more, our souls braided into one." - Tamori Katsu

card.name: Chinoko
card.text:
Unaligned Kolat Madam • Lose 3 honor.
Reaction: Bow to cancel and negate the effects of any Kolat action as it is being performed.
Reaction: Bow to reduce the cost of any Kolat card or action by 4 as it is being played.

card.name: Clan Banner
card.text:
This item has a force bonus equal to the number of honorably dead members of your clan in your discard pile.
The banner gains an additional 3F bonus while your clan champion is honorably dead in your discard pile.

card.name: Clan Heartland
card.text:
Hidden Region • Unique
Units cannot be assigned to a battle at this Province or moved into a battle at this Province unless this is your only Province.
card.flavor: "You say the Crane are gathering an army, but where could they hide so many men?" - Shinjo Yasamura

card.name: Corrupted Copper Mine
card.text:
Shadowlands
Lose 1 Honor when brought into play.
Bow and lose 1 Honor to produce 1 gold. If Corrupt Copper Mine is controlled by a Lion Clan Player, it produces 2 gold.
card.flavor: Not even Akodo Kage could foresee the tragedy that would befall Rokugan's most honorable samurai.

card.name: Counterfeit
card.text:
Kolat Reaction: Play as an item is being attached to a Personality. The item is revealed as a fake and shuffled back into that player's deck.
Kolat Reaction: Play as an item is being attached to a Personality. Pay additional gold equal to the cost of the item. The item is revealed as a fake and is destroyed.

card.name: Courier
card.text: Limited: If this Personality is unbowed, bow Courier to move Courier and any number of unbowed Items and/or Spells from this Personality to another of your unbowed Personalities. (All new attachments must be legal.)

card.name: Cowardice
card.text: Political Reaction: Play immediately after a Personality is moved out of the current battle by an action taken by the Personality's controller. The target Personality is dishonored and the controller loses 5 Honor.
card.flavor: "Toturi calls it tactics. I say it is cowardice!" - Bayushi Goshiu

card.name: Dance of the Elements
card.text: Kiho Open: Bow one of your Shugenja or monks to move a token in play from any one Personality to any other Personality that could legally take the token.
card.flavor: There are no secrets. There is no understanding. Void is all and nothing. It is the dance of the elements. - The Tao of Shinsei

card.name: Deploy Reserves
card.text: Battle: Move any one of your unbowed units into this battle that has not been assigned to a battle this turn. You may only perform this action if you already have a unit in this battle, and this action cannot target units that could not be assigned to this battle.

card.name: Disrupt the Aura
card.text: Reaction: Bow this Shugenja and target a Personality as it is copying an ability or statistic, or when a Personality's stats are being switched. The copying or switching attempt fails and the copying Personality remains unchanged.
card.flavor: "No," Tsuke snarled as fire flew from his fingers into the ninja's frightened eyes. "Not this time."

card.name: Divine the Future
card.text: Limited: Bow this Shugenja. Take any card in one of your Provinces and shuffle it back into your Dynasty Deck. Refill the empty Province normally.
card.flavor: "Knowing the patterns of the past is the key to knowing the patterns of the future." - Isawa Uona

card.name: Doji Reju
card.text:
Crane Clan Samurai
If Doji Reju is tied in a duel, he wins the duel instead.
card.flavor: "Now is the time for action, not prophecy. If you wish to know the future, you can taste it upon my blade!"

card.name: Double Chi
card.text: Kiho Reaction: When one of your target Personalities enters a duel, bow one of your Shugenja or Monks to give that Personality the Double Chi trait until the duel ends.

card.name: Dragon's Teeth
card.text:
Fortification
Each Follower gains +1F while defending this Province. Each Cavalry card has -1F while attacking this Province.
card.flavor: "I would trade twenty Hida berserkers for one good Kaiu engineer." - Ichiro Masaharu

card.name: Engineering Crew
card.text:
Retainer
Bow to produce six gold when bringing a fortification into play.
card.flavor: "They know much about defense," Kisada's broken face smiled. "But whom do you think taught them what they know?"

card.name: Extortion
card.text: Kolat Limited: Target a Dishonored Personality. Until he becomes Honorable, he may not assign or move to attack your Provinces, and actions he performs may not target cards you control.

card.name: Fiery Wrath
card.text: Limited Elemental Ritual: Bow this Shugenja and two other Shugenja you control. Destroy this spell and any one Region card in play.
card.flavor: "The Elemental Masters have fear in their eyes when they speak of Tsuke. His darkness is deeper than any I have ever seen." - Isawa Natsune

card.name: Fight for My Favor
card.text: Political Reaction: Play when another player's Personality has just bowed to lobby for the Imperial Favor. One of your unbowed Personalities challenges the lobbying Personality. If the challenge is refused, the lobbying attempt automatically fails. The winner of the duel gets the Favor, and the loser dies.

card.name: Forced Alliance
card.text: Political Reaction: Play during the resolution phase of a battle as the Attacker. Instead of destroying the Province, you force an alliance upon the Defender. The alliance ends after your end phase, three turns after this one. Either player may break the alliance at the loss of 10 honor by sending one or more units to attack the other. This honor loss cannot be altered or redirected in any way.

card.name: Forest of Thorns
card.text:
Fortification. Any Personality or Follower in a battle at this Province with a force greater than three may, as a Battle action, bow to burn down (destroy) this fortification.
Battle: Send one attacking unit, led by a Personality with a Chi less than four, home from this battle. This can be done once per battle.

card.name: Fresh Horses
card.text: Open: Until the end of this turn, any player may, as an Open action, bow one of his Stables and pay 3 gold to straighten any Cavalry card.
card.flavor: "Strength is not the only advantage of the Unicorn steeds. Their numbers are almost overwhelming." - Doji Kuwanan

card.name: Genzo
card.text:
Falcon Clan Hunter • Yoritomo's Alliance • Samurai • Will join Crab for 2 less gold.
Battle: If opposed by one or more Shadowlands cards, Genzo may take a Chi penalty (to a minimum of one) to gain an equivalent Force bonus.
Reaction: Bow Norio when he is entering a duel against a Shadowlands Personality. He may take a Force penalty (to a minimum of zero) to gain an equivalent Chi bonus.

card.name: Gift of the Wind
card.text: Kiho Elemental Open: Bow one of your Monks or Shugenja to give the Cavalry trait to a number of cards in a unit up to the caster's Chi.
card.flavor: "The sun travels the world in a day, but the wind is already there."

card.name: Ginawa - exp
card.text:
Unaligned Samurai • Toturi's Army • Unique • Experienced • Ginawa gains a 4C bonus when dueling a ninja.
Limited: Bow Ginawa. Challenge any Ninja or Kolat Personality to a duel. The target can only refuse if his or her controller pays 6 Gold.
card.flavor: "I am learning the ways of the ninja who killed my lord, and I see his eyes in every face..."

card.name: Hida Yakamo - exp
card.text:
Crab Clan Hero • Experienced • Unique • Samurai • Will only join Crab Clan • Yakamo will not enter play if you have any Shadowlands cards in play and vice versa • May attach the Jade Hand and Ancestral Sword of Hantei without gold cost.
Battle: Bow Yakamo to destroy any one opposing Shadowlands card. Yakamo gains a permanent 1 point bonus to his Personal Honor (max 5).

card.name: Hiruma Yoshi
card.text:
Crab Clan Samurai
Hiruma Yoshi cannot be targeted with Frenzy.
card.flavor: Still mourning the loss of his son, the retired daimyo of the Hiruma has been forced to return and lead his fallen house once more.

card.name: Historian
card.text:
Retainer
Reaction: When one of your Personalities wins a duel, bow the Historian to gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: The Ikoma family of the Lion Clan are the Empire's official historians. But every clan has its own viewpoint on events.

card.name: Hitoshi
card.text:
Unaligned Monk • Acolyte of Earth.
Elemental Battle: Bow Hitoshi to add 3 to a Province's strength.
Elemental Battle: Hitoshi gains a 2F/2C bonus until the end of the turn if you have the Ring of Earth in play. This can be done once per battle.

card.name: Hyobe
card.text:
Tortoise Clan Sailor • Yoritomo's Alliance
Hyobe does not bow when returning home from battles as an attacker in the resolution phase.
Reaction: Bow one or more of your ports when your army is returning home from a battle as an attacker or ally. You may keep straightened a number of returning units equal to the number of ports you bow.

card.name: Ikoma Ryozo
card.text:
Lion Clan Samurai • Shadowlands
If an effect of the Imperial Favor targets a card in the same battle as Ikoma Ryozo, Ikoma Ryozo returns to your fief bowed.
card.flavor: "You scorn me because I embraced the darkness. You do not understand my destiny, so do not presume to condemn its price."

card.name: Incense of Concentration
card.text:
May only be attached to a shugenja. No more than one per Personality.
When this Personality is involved in a Ritual and is not the Primary Shugenja, he counts as two shugenja for the purposes of casting the ritual, and his Chi is considered to be doubled (after all other bonuses).

card.name: Inner Fire
card.text: Battle: Straighten one of your target bowed Personalities. You can not bow him as a cost or target him (until this turn ends).

card.name: Isawa Norikazu
card.text:
Phoenix Clan Seer • Unique • Shugenja
Reaction: Bow Isawa Norikazu as an Action card that targets you, your cards, or your tokens (or if Norikazu is in a battle, that targets or affects that battle, such as a Terrain) is being played from a player's hand. That action is canceled and its effects negated. The Action card is returned to its player's hand at the end of the Dynasty Phase this turn.

card.name: Isawa Tomo - exp
card.text:
Phoenix Clan Shugenja • Master of Water • Experienced • Unique • Shadowlands
Battle: Bow Tomo to send home, without bowing, all units in this battle containing Shadowlands cards. Tomo must be in the battle to perform this action.
card.flavor: "Only you are left, Kaede, my sister. Only you can preserve us. Only you..."

card.name: Island Wharf
card.text:
The Island Wharf is considered a Port.
Bow the Island Wharf to produce 1 gold.
If a Yoritomo's Alliance player controls the Island Wharf, it produces 2 Gold when bowed.
card.flavor: The lands of Rokugan may have been in flames from the Clan Wars, but her seas still flourish with wealth and beauty.

card.name: Iuchi Daiyu - exp
card.text:
Unicorn Shugenja • Experienced • Unique • Cavalry
Cards in this army cannot be the target of Ranged Attacks if they are in a Cavalry unit.
card.flavor: "The fire in his eyes is a little dimmer, his face is a little sadder. That is the price of wisdom." - Isawa Tadaka

card.name: Kado
card.text:
Unaligned Samurai • Kolat
When Kado is brought into play, you may give control of him to any player.
All Personalities being brought into play by this Personality's controller have their gold cost increased by 2.
card.flavor: "I would accuse him if it didn't mean losing his brilliant sense of command." - Kitsu Motso

card.name: Kakita Ichiro
card.text:
Crane Clan Courtier
Limited: Bow to lobby for the Imperial Favor. This may be done even if you have already lobbied for the Favor once this turn.
card.flavor: "I am sorry you are so disappointed with your son, Toshimoko-sama. I certainly hope my training has nothing to do with that." - Kakita Yoshi

card.name: Kenku
card.text:
Creature
Reaction: If the attached Personality is destroyed or if this unit is destroyed during the resolution phase of the battle, you may move the Kenku to any of your unbowed Personalities that is not currently assigned to a battle.

card.name: Kenku Teacher
card.text:
Creature
Open: Bow the Kenku Teacher. Give this Personality a 1F bonus.
Open: Bow the Kenku Teacher. Give this Personality a 1C bonus.
Open: Bow the Kenku Teacher. Raise the Personal Honor of this Personality by one.

card.name: Kenshin's Helm
card.text: Battle: Bow this Personality to bow any opposing Personality with a lower Chi.
card.flavor: Once worn by a legendary samurai, the helm was said to bring even the boldest samurai to his knees with tears in his eyes and blood in his ears.

card.name: Kitsu Motso - exp
card.text:
Lion Clan Master Tactician • Samurai • Experienced • Unique • Tactician
Limited: Bow Kitsu Motso. Put a Master token on him.
Battle: Destroy a Master token on Kitsu Motso. Put any one Terrain from your Fate deck into play for this battle. This does not bow Kitsu Motso. Reshuffle the deck. This is considered Kitsu Motso's use of his Tactician ability for this battle.

card.name: Know Your Enemy
card.text: Reaction: Target a Personality being assigned to a battle that has the trait: Tactician. Until the end of this battle, this Personality gets a 1F bonus after each Open or Battle action performed by a player with units in the opposing army.

card.name: Koichi
card.text:
Unaligned Monk • Acolyte of the Void
Elemental Limited: Bow to discard a card.
Elemental Limited: Bow to draw a Fate card if you have the Ring of the Void in play.
card.flavor:
"Two weeks have passed and all he does is sit there. What's going through his head?"
Hitoshi smiled. "Nothing, my friend. Nothing."

card.name: Kolat Bodyguard
card.text:
You may attach this Follower to a Personality controlled by another player.
Any player may bow one of their Personalities as a Limited action to challenge this Personality to a duel that cannot be refused. A player may only perform this action once per turn.

card.name: Kolat's Favor
card.text: This Personality may not be targeted by Kolat actions.
card.flavor: "All of this sabotage, and yet the Phoenix is free from such misfortune. What does that suggest to you, Lord Hida?" - Akodo Kage

card.name: Light of the Sun Goddess
card.text: Until the beginning of your next turn, players with one or more Shadowlands cards in play at the end of their action phase do not get an attack phase.
card.flavor: The clouds broke, and for an instant, a look of fear crossed Junzo's face. - The Fall of the Hantei, Volume I

card.name: Lost Valley
card.text:
Valley Region
This Province, and cards attached to or in a battle at this Province, cannot be targeted by actions from cards in play that are not currently assigned to attack or defend this Province. Action cards may be played normally.

card.name: Mantis Shugenja
card.text:
May only be attached to Shugenja. This Personality has a 2C bonus when casting or attaching spells. Spells being attached to this Personality have their gold costs reduced by two.
Reaction: The Mantis Shugenja may bow to act as a 1C Shugenja participating in a ritual when the Shugenja it is attached to is participating in the ritual.

card.name: Master of the Rolling River
card.text: Kiho Water Battle: Bow one of your target Shugenja or Monks at any location: Move one of your target units at a battlefield to a different battlefield.

card.name: Matsu Goemon
card.text: Lion Clan Samurai • Toturi's Army You can immediately attach a Follower from your hand to Matsu Goemon as you bring him into play for the first time. Costs of the Follower must be paid normally. Matsu Goemon cannot bow as part of a lobby attempt.

card.name: Mine Riots
card.text: No mines may straighten until after your next events phase.
card.flavor: The overseer raised his whip again and again, but the scuttling horde decided that they had enough...

card.name: Mitsu - exp
card.text:
Unaligned Monk • Tattooed Man • Unique • Experienced Togashi Mitsu • Toturi's Army
Open: Gain up to five Fire tokens on Mitsu. Mitsu cannot have more than five Fire tokens.
Battle: Bow Mitsu and destroy one or more Fire tokens on Mitsu. Produce a ranged attack equal to the number of Fire tokens destroyed. Mitsu cannot add more Fire tokens this turn.

card.name: Moto Tsume - exp
card.text:
Unaligned Nonhuman Samurai • Shadowlands • Experienced • Unique • Lose 6 Honor • Will not enter play if you have a family honor above zero. Cannot be assigned to the same army as units that have no Shadowlands cards and vice versa.
Battle: Fear 3.

card.name: Mounts
card.text:
Creature • Cavalry
All Followers attached to or being attached to this Personality have the Cavalry trait while this card is in the unit.
card.flavor: "You want to ride with me? You will need these..." - Otaku Kamoko

card.name: Mukami
card.text:
Wasp Clan Skirmisher • Yoritomo's Alliance
Battle: Bow Mukami for a Ranged 3 Attack, then remove this unit from the battle and return it to your fief.
card.flavor: His arrows cut through the advancing Unicorn ranks, swift death to those who rode within his woodlands. Then all was silent, and he was gone.

card.name: Naming the True Evil
card.text:
This Event cannot resolve if you control a Shadowlands card.
Until the game ends, you may not play Shadowlands cards, Followers you control have +2F while opposing a Shadowlands card, and Personalities you control have +2F/+2C while opposing a Shadowlands card or while in a duel against a Shadowlands Personality.

card.name: New Taxes
card.text: Until the beginning of your next turn, each player (including you) on their turn, as a Limited action, should produce 6 gold which is immediately taxed and lost. For each point of gold less than six that is produced, that player loses one point of honor at the end of their action phase. A player may choose to accept the honor loss rather than pay their full share.

card.name: Night of a Thousand Fires
card.text: Ninja Limited: Bow a Ninja Personality you control to destroy any holding in play. You must pay gold equal to twice the gold cost of the holding to put this card into play. This is a variable-cost card.
card.flavor: "I know of only one way to stop them, Toturi-sama - user their own tactics against them." - Ginawa

card.name: Nobuo
card.text:
Mantis Clan Shugenja
Whenever Nobuo bows to produce a spell, the spell is destroyed.

card.name: Norio
card.text:
Unaligned Monk • Kharmic Healer • Norio's Chi may not be reduced below one.
Limited: Bow to move all tokens that produce a force or Chi penalty from a Personality you control to Norio.
Limited: Bow to destroy all tokens on Norio that produce a force or Chi penalty.

card.name: Ogre Outlaw
card.text:
Unaligned Bandit • Nonhuman • Shadowlands
If the Ogre Outlaw is killed in a duel or battle, the player responsible receives 10 gold to spend to help bring any one card into play until the end of his next turn. If the gold is unused it is lost.
card.flavor: "You think you can collect today, samurai? Come then!"

card.name: Oni no Chi
card.text:
Unaligned Shadowlands • Nonhuman
This Oni is brought into play as a Limited Ritual action. Bow and destroy any number of your shugenja to bring this Oni into play. The Oni has a Force equal to half of the total Chi of the participating shugenja and a Chi equal to the number of participating shugenja. This Personality may not be brought into play during your dynasty phase. Lose Honor equal to the Oni's Chi.

card.name: Oni no Genso
card.text:
Unaligned Oni • Shadowlands • Lose 4 Honor.
Open Elemental: Bow to negate the effects of any one Ring of Earth or Ring of Fire until the end of the turn.
Open Elemental: Bow as a Ring of Air, Void or Water is being activated to negate the effects of that ring until the end of the turn.

card.name: Oni Warding
card.text: Ritual Limited: Bow this Shugenja and a number of Shugenja you control equal to twice the number of Oni in play. Target any Province. For the rest of the game, Oni brought into play from this Province are immediately shuffled back into their controller's Dynasty Deck. Destroy this spell.

card.name: Orochi
card.text:
Unaligned • Nonhuman • Cavalry • No Followers or Items.
Battle: Destroy any one Port or Pearl Bed that is controlled by the defender. This does not bow the Orochi, and can be done once per battle that the Orochi is in.

card.name: Osano-Wo's Breath
card.text: Battle Elemental: Bow this Shugenja. No Ranged Attacks can be made until the end of this battle.
card.flavor: "There is strength in wind, as certain as there is subtelty in Earth, Tadaka-san." - Isawa Uona

card.name: Pearl-Encrusted Staff
card.text:
May only be attached to Qamar, Shahadet or a Naga shugenja.
Battle: Bow the Staff. Move all of your unbowed Naga Personalities into this battle if there are one or more Shadowlands cards in the opposing army.

card.name: Peasant Levies
card.text: When you put this card into play, you can draw an additional Fate card during your next End Phase.
card.flavor: "Winds blow, nations change, fortunes rise and fall; but the simple folk will always be asked to shoulder the weight." - from The Tao of Shinsei

card.name: Prayer Shrines
card.text:
Bow the Prayer Shrines produce 2 gold.
If a Monk player controls the Prayer Shrines, they produce 1 additional Gold for each Elemental Ring you have in play.
card.flavor: "Though persecuted and hunted, you are our brothers, and we will shleter you within the house of the Tao." - Yodin

card.name: Robes of Shinsei
card.text: May only be attached to a monk. Gain 2 Honor. No more than one per Personality. The Robes have a +1F/+1C for each Ring you have in play.
card.flavor: The presence of our ancestors is passed along through the ages. Surround yourself with their wisdom and you cannot help but feel them guiding your every action.

card.name: Ryosei
card.text: Fox Clan Shugenja • Yoritomo's Alliance
card.flavor: "I will fight by your side, and I will watch my men die at your command, my Lord. But I will never take your name!"

card.name: Secluded Ravine
card.text:
Singular
The Attacker and attacking allies cannot play Terrains during battles at this Province.

card.name: Shabura - exp
card.text:
Naga • Experienced • Unique • Nonhuman • Shabura gains +2F in battle when opposed by Shadowlands cards if she has no change tokens.
Open: Add or remove a change token from Shabura. This may be done once per turn.
Limited: If Shabura has a change token she may bow to challenge a Shadowlands Personality to a duel that can't be refused.

card.name: Shalasha
card.text:
Naga Scout
If you are a Naga player and have no Personalities in play, Shalasha's Gold cost is reduced by 3.
card.flavor: "Where there is evil, we will hunt it down and see it die beneath our spears. It is not our ancestors that compel us to act, but our very souls."

card.name: Shiba Shingo
card.text: Phoenix Clan Samurai
card.flavor: He watches as each Elemental Master falls to the seductive power of the Black Scrolls and wonders if a phoenix drowned in poisoned waters can be born again...

card.name: Shinjo Rojin
card.text:
Unicorn Clan Explorer • Samurai • Cavalry
Rojin gains a 2F bonus when attacking or defending a Province that has a Region card attached. Rojin gains a 2F bonus while there is a terrain card in play for the battle he is in.

card.name: Shinjo Tashima
card.text:
Unicorn Clan Magistrate • Samurai • Cavalry • Tashima has a 2F/2C bonus while facing, in a battle or duel, one or more human Personalities with a Personal Honor of zero.
Limited: Bow to challenge a Bandit or unaligned samurai to a duel that cannot be refused.

card.name: Shinsei's Shrine
card.text:
Singular
This Province does not hold Dynasty Cards. (Do not refill it.) Gain 2 Honor during each of your End Phases while Shinsei's Shrine is in play.

card.name: Shiryo no Agasha
card.text:
Dragon Clan Ancestor • Unique
While this card is attached to your Personality, your maximum hand size is increased by two.
Reaction: Bow this Personality when you are bringing a Dragon into play to waive its honor requirement. This does not refer to Dragon Clan Personalities unless they are considered to be a Dragon.

card.name: Shiryo no Doji
card.text:
Crane Clan Ancestor • Unique
This Personality may play The Second Shout without having played The First Shout. This Personality may play The Third Shout if he has played either The First Shout or The Second Shout this turn.

card.name: Shiryo no Hida
card.text:
Crab Clan Ancestor • Unique
This unit cannot be targeted with the Imperial Favor.
Battle: If the attached Personality is defending, he gains a 2F/2C bonus until the end of the turn. This can be done once per turn.

card.name: Shiryo no Matsu
card.text:
Lion Clan Ancestor • Unique
