card.text: Kiho Open: Target one of your Personalities. Bow one of your Monks or Shugenja to negate non-Event effects affecting the Personality. This does not affect effects from cards in the Personality's unit.

card.name: Sword of the Sun
card.text:
Weapon. Unique.
Battle: If this Personality is a Dragon Clan Personality, bow the Sword of the Sun to give each Personality in this army +1F/+1C.

card.name: Taka Sensei
card.text:
Crab. Crane. Mantis. Monk. Scorpion. Sensei.
This Stronghold produces only 2 Gold when paying for a Personality.

card.name: Takao - exp2
card.text:
Unaligned Master of Five. Monk. Experienced 2. Unique.
Open: Once per turn, Takao gains +1F/+1C for each of your other Monk Personalities until the turn ends.
Battle: Bow Takao to destroy an opposing Ninja card.

card.name: Tattoo of the Night Sky
card.text: Limited: Target one of your Personalities with the Tattooed trait and without a Tattoo of the Night Sky. For the rest of the game, the Personality has a Tattoo of the Night Sky and gains the ability "Reaction: When an action targets this Personality, bow the Personality to negate the action's effects."

card.name: Tax Collector
card.text:
Retainer.
Reaction: When a Human Personality is committed or moves into battle at one of your Provinces, bow the Tax Collector to force the Personality's controller to either pay 5 Gold, discard a card from his or her hand, or send the Personality's unit home bowed.

card.name: Temple of Divine Influence
card.text:
Unique.
Limited: Bow the Temple of Divine Influence and one of your Personalities to lay a more- or less-experienced version of the Personality from your Dynasty deck over or under the original. Do this as if you had laid the more-experienced version over the less-experienced one. Reshuffle the deck.

card.name: The Dark Moto Sensei
card.text:
Monk. Lion. Naga. Ninja. Phoenix. Unicorn. Sensei.
Your starting Family Honor is 0. Shadowlands cards cost 1 less Gold (minimum 0) for you. Non-Shadowlands Holdings, non-Shadowlands Personalities, and non-Shadowlands Followers cost 1 more Gold for you.

card.name: Third Mask of Iuchiban
card.text:
Unique. Shadowlands. Lose 4 Honor. A Bloodspeaker can attach the Third Mask of Iuchiban for 4 less Gold.
Reaction: Immediately before you attach a Spell to a Shugenja with the Shadowlands trait, bow the Third Mask of Iuchiban to lower the Spell's cost by the Shugenja's Chi.

card.name: Togashi Jodome - exp
card.text:
Dragon Clan Acolyte of Air. Monk. Shugenja. Tattooed. Experienced. Unique. Jodome can remain bowed.
Reaction: Immediately after a Personality creates a Spell effect, bow Jodome to prevent the Personality from straightening while he remains bowed and in play.

card.name: Toritaka Kitao
card.text:
Crab Clan Samurai. Falcon Clan Chui.
Actions that would dishonor Kitao are canceled.

card.name: Tricked
card.text: Limited: Target a Personality. Until your next turn, the Personality cannot be committed or move to attack your Provinces.

card.name: Triumphant Victory
card.text: Target another player. That player cannot ally with other players or invite other players to ally until after your next Straighten Phase.

card.name: Tsuruchi - exp2
card.text:
Wasp Clan Master Bowman. Yoritomo's Alliance. Samurai. Experienced 2. Unique. Tsuruchi's Followers with ranged attacks have their Ranged Attacks strengths raised by 2.
Battle: Once per battle, destroy an opposing Ninja card as a ranged attack, ignoring targeting restrictions.

card.name: Ujina Tomo
card.text:
Hare Clan Samurai.
Ranged Attacks cannot target Tomo. Tomo will not attach Followers.
Battle: Bow Tomo for a Ranged 1 Attack.

card.name: Venerable Stature
card.text: Reaction: When you bow a Personality to begin lobbying for the Imperial Favor, prevent Personalities with Personal Honor less than your Personality's from bowing to lobby against you.

card.name: Yabanjin Sorcerer
card.text: Shugenja.

card.name: Yoritomo Okan
card.text:
Mantis Clan Samurai.
Ranged attacks cannot target Okan's Followers.

card.name: Yoritomo Refuses the Throne
card.text: Permanently raise your hand size by three. All other players permanently raise their hand size by one.

card.name: Yotsu Sabieru
card.text:
Unaligned Samurai.
Battle: Target an opposing Personality's Weapon. Attach the Weapon to Sabieru. Immediately after this battle's Resolution Segment, place the Weapon in its owner's discard pile. Lose 3 Honor.

card.name: A Black Scroll is Opened
card.text: Until the end of the turn, all Shugenja lose Chi equal to the number of spells that they have attached.
card.flavor: Deep in the heart of the Shadowlands, Junzo opens another scroll, and the souls of all of Rokugan's shugenja shudder.

card.name: A Terrible Oath
card.text:
Black Scroll • Unique
After this Shugenja straightens: Give him a -1C Corruption token.
Limited: Bow and destroy this Shugenja and one of your Samurai: Your Personalities in play gain a +2F/-1C Oath token and permanently gain Shadowlands. You can not win an Honor Victory this game.

card.name: Akiyoshi
card.text:
Unaligned Samurai
Open: Bow to straighten Bayushi Kachiko.
card.flavor: "He spoke of Kachiko as if she were his lord, but I think he is hiding more than his loyalty under than mask." - Toturi

card.name: Akodo Godaigo
card.text:
Unaligned Shadowlands Samurai • Unique • Toturi's Army • No Followers • Lose 2 Honor.
Battle: Bow any one Shadowlands Personality or Follower in the opposing army. This can be done once per battle.
Battle: Fear 3.
card.flavor: An ancient spirit came to Toturi, willing to atone.

card.name: An Untold Cost
card.text: Any Personality in play with a Corruption token gets 2 additional -1C Corruption tokens. Then, give any Personality in play with the Shadowlands trait a -1C Corruption token.
card.flavor: It's as if the scrolls were giving that lifeforce to another. But who could it be?

card.name: The Ancestral Sword of Hantei
card.text:
Unique. You must discard the Imperial Favor to bring this card into play.
While this Personality has the Hantei Sword, his Force and Chi are switched. All effects that alter his Force instead affect his Chi and vice-versa.

card.name: Armor of Earth
card.text:
Unique
While you have a Ring of earth in play, Armor of Earth gains a +2F/+1C bonus and has a printed Gold cost of 0.
Elemental Reaction: Cancel an action moving this unit out of a battle it assigned to during this attack.

card.name: Artificer
card.text:
Retainer
Bow to produce 5 gold when bringing an item into play.
card.flavor: her husband passed away long ago, and now she has taken up his trade to keep his memory alive.

card.name: Asako Oyo
card.text:
Phoenix Clan Spell Seeker • Shugenja
Limited: Bow Oyo and draw the top card from your Fate Deck. If it is a spell, attach it to Oyo without gold cost. Otherwise, return it to the top of your Fate Deck.

card.name: Bandit Hideout
card.text:
Each Marketplace, Port, and Trade Route produces 1 less Gold when bowed.
Bow the Bandit Hideout to produce an amount of Gold equal to the number of Marketplaces, Ports, and Trade Routes other players have in play. Lose 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "The bandits have grown fat and rich while the guardians of the roads count their own gold. No more!" - Toturi Tsudao

card.name: Bayushi Baku
card.text:
Scorpion Clan Spirit • Nonhuman • Shadowlands
May not defend. May only be assigned to attack if there is already a Scorpion Personality assigned or being assigned to attack the Province.

card.name: Bayushi Shoju
card.text:
Scorpion Clan Champion • Unique • Samurai • Tactician • Shadowlands
Will only join Scorpion Clan. When this card appears in your Province, place it in your discard pile as dishonorable dead.
card.flavor: Kachiko forbid him to use the spell on her husband's remains, but Buntaro's master has other plans.

card.name: Beiden Pass
card.text:
Mountain • Unique
Units can not move to or from this province's battlefield.

card.name: Black Market
card.text:
Lose 3 Honor. All Trade Routes in play produce 2 less Gold. All Ports in play produce 1 less Gold.
Bow the Black Market and lose 1 Honor to produce 2 gold. If a Crane player controls the Black Market, it produces 3 Gold when bowed.

card.name: Black Wind From the Soul
card.text:
Black Scroll • Unique • Give this Shugenja a -1C Corruption token each time it straightens.
Ritual Limited: Bow and destroy this Shugenja and as many other Shugenja you control that you wish such that the combined Chi of the Shugenja are greater than 20. Destroy any one Province in play. Lose 5 Honor.

card.name: Bog Hag
card.text: Unaligned Nonhuman • Shadowlands • Lose 4 Honor. If the Bog Hag defeats a Personality in a duel, she permanently gains any one ability printed on the defeated Personality's card. There is no limit to the number of abilities the Bog Hag can steal.
card.flavor: Once she was a beautiful woman, but now she must steal another's skin to hide her twisted flesh.

card.name: Brash Hero
card.text: Open: If it is not your turn: Target one of the active player's Samurai Personalities with a Chi of 2 or less. The target's controller must assign him during any Attack Phases this turn if he can legally do so.

card.name: Bribery
card.text: Battle: Bow one opposing Personality with a Personal Honor less than two. Lose 2 Honor.
card.flavor: Generals begrudge bestowing ranks emoluments of 100 pieces of gold, and therefore do not know the enemy's situation.

card.name: Calling the Elements
card.text: Ritual Elemental Reaction: Bow this Shugenja before any player's Infantry Assignment Phase. Bow any number of additional Shugenja you control to remove the trait: Cavalry from a number of any cards in play equal to the number of Shugenja in the ritual. These cards regain the Cavalry trait at the end of the turn.

card.name: Chasing the Wind
card.text: Reaction: Play this card when an infantry unit is being moved into a battle where you have one or more units, all of which are Cavalry. The action that would have moved the infantry unit into this battle is cancelled and all effects of the action are negated.

card.name: Courage of the Seven Thunders
card.text: Ritual Limited: Bow this and any number of other Shugenja you control. The strength of your Provinces are increased by the combined Chi of the bowing Shugenja, divided by two (round up). This bonus lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

card.name: Crossroads
card.text: Lower the Gold cost of Holdings in this Province by 3.
card.flavor: Even two wars, the Emperor's death, and Kaede's refusal of the throne cannot change the fact that life in the Emerald Empire is happier and easier than ever for most of its citizens.

card.name: Crushing Attack
card.text: Battle: You can only play this card if your army has more than twice as much total Force as the opposing army. This Battle Action Segment ends (resolve any Terrains, if applicable), and this battle is now resolved.

card.name: Dairya - exp
card.text:
Unaligned Samurai • Unique • Experienced • Double Chi • Cavalry • Toturi's Army
Battle: Bow for a Ranged 3 Attack.
Reaction: Bow Dairya when he is challenged to refuse the duel (even one which cannot normally be refused). Honor Loss is negated and Dairya is not dishonored by this action.
card.flavor: "Out of my way, samurai. You don't need to die today."

card.name: Dark Daughter of Fu Leng
card.text:
Unaligned Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Lose 4 Honor.
For each opposing Personality and Follower destroyed during or at the resolution of a battle, add one +1F/+1C Blood token to the Dark Daughter. Remove one Blood token during each of your End phases.
Battle: Fear 3.

card.name: Dealing with Shadows
card.text: Each player loses 2 Honor for each Shadowlands card he or she has in play.
card.flavor:
"You ask if I control the Tsuno. No, it is not I. Was it your command that killed Toturi?"
"No, child."
Shahai caressed the ancient skull. "Then together we must make plans."

card.name: Delicate Calculations
card.text: Limited: You may attack two players at once this turn. Each player may ally with only one other player. Each Maneuvers Segment occurs only once. During each battle, only the Province's controller is the Defender. Effects that move cards into or out of battles may move them into or out of any battles in the attack.
card.flavor: Such steps are not taken lightly.

card.name: Disharmony
card.text: Reaction: Play as a ritual is being performed. The ritual is cancelled and its effects are negated. All costs of the ritual (including bowing or destroying all of the Shugenja involved) are still paid.
card.flavor: You cannot balance the elements while you are without balance. - The Tao of Shinsei

card.name: Diversionary Tactics
card.text: Battle: Destroy a Terrain.

card.name: Doji Kuwanan
card.text: Crane Clan Samurai
card.flavor: In his youth, he travelled far to secure trading routes for the Crane. He has returned from his journeys to find his family's house in flames. Now the flames of revenge burn in his heart and he will not rest until they are quenched.

card.name: Dragon Sword is Broken
card.text: Destroy any one Ancestral item in play. That item's controller loses 8 Honor.
card.flavor: The rain was all about them when she felt his claw grip her brother's sword. Thunder pounded in her ears as she heard the steel snap. Lightning flashed behind him as his tetsubo rose above his head, ready to fall.

card.name: Dripping Poison
card.text:
May only be attached to a Ninja • When brought into play, put four vial tokens on this card.
Limited: Bow this Personality and destroy a vial token on this card to put a -1C poison token on a target Personality with Chi less than the attached Personality. If the target is ever destroyed by reaching 0 Chi, you lose honor equal to the target's printed Chi.

card.name: Enlightenment
card.text: Limited: Bow any Monk Personality you control. Retrieve one Elemental Ring from your discard pile and return it to your hand.

card.name: Family Loyalty
card.text: Limited: Target a Personality affiliated with your clan that is controlled by a player from a different clan. That player must give you control of the target Personality until the end of the turn, or the Personality is dishonored and the player loses 7 Honor. This Personality may not attack its original controller this turn.

card.name: Farmlands
card.text:
Farm • Singular
Limited: Pay 2 Gold: Create a 1F Follower and attach it to your target Personality.
card.flavor: No samurai can stand without the support of those who work the fields. Bushido can give life to a man for only so long before hunger claims his body.

card.name: Fearful Populace
card.text: Battle: Until the end of this battle, all Shugenja have the ability Battle: Fear 4.
card.flavor: The peasants turned their fearful eyes up to the castles of the Phoenix, wondering if the rumors of corruption and monstrosities are true.

card.name: Flatlands
card.text: As a Battle action once per unit per turn, any player may move a unit out of or into this Province to or from one of your Provinces immediately to the left or right of this one.
card.flavor: "The plains of the Unicorn are ours again. We must be ever vigilant, or they will not remain so." - Shinjo Maku

card.name: Fu Leng's Steeds
card.text: Limited: Target card loses the Cavalry trait permanently.
card.flavor: Kojiro's dreams are filled with the sight of their frothing lips and the sound of their horrid screams.

card.name: Fusaki
card.text:
Unaligned Shugenja
When Fusaki enters play, you may attach any one spell in your hand to him immediately, without gold cost.
card.flavor: Do not worry for an old man; I have a satchel full of wisdom to guard me against the darkness.

card.name: Garrote
card.text:
May only be attached to a Ninja.
Reaction: Bow the Garrote when this Ninja is in a duel and you declare a strike. You may focus once more before the focuses are revealed and the strike is resolved. You may not gain honor from this duel.

card.name: Goblin Berserkers
card.text:
Nonhuman • Shadowlands • Lose 2 Honor.
Battle: Destroy the Goblin Berserkers. Return this unit to your fief. This action may be performed if the attached Personality is bowed.
card.flavor: "We ain't afraid of samurai. We ain't afraid of Shugenja. We ain't afraid of... ghak!"

card.name: Gunsen of Water
card.text:
Weapon • Unique
While you have a Ring of Water in play, Gunsen of Water gains a +2F/+1C bonus and has a printed Gold cost of 0.
Elemental Battle: Bow Gunsen of Water to move this unit to one of the Defender's Provinces or from the current battle to your home.

card.name: Hazardous Ground
card.text:
You may only play this card if you have a Samurai in this battle with a Chi of 4 or more.
Battle Terrain: This terrain takes effect as soon as it is played. Beginning with your next opportunity to perform an action, whenever it is your turn to perform an action in this battle, you may perform two actions instead of one.

card.name: Ide Daikoku
card.text:
Unicorn Clan Caravan Master • Unique
While the Caravan Master is in play, you may attach unique items to your Unicorn Clan Personalities for 3 less gold.
card.flavor: "All the riches of the Empire have been carried by my wagons. For the right price, you can take one of them home."

card.name: Ikoma Tsanuri
card.text:
Lion Clan Samurai • Tactician
Other players may not play terrain cards during a battle at which Tsanuri is assigned.
card.flavor: "For years, Toturi was her tutor and counsel. If anyone can stop him, it is she." - Matsu Tsuke

card.name: Ikoma Ujiaki - exp
card.text:
Lion Clan Samurai • Experienced • Unique.
Battle: All Lion Clan Personalities in this army gain a +2F bonus when attacking. This ability may be used once per battle.
card.flavor: "The Emperor's revenge is never kind."

card.name: Imperial Funeral
card.text: Starting with you and going clockwise, each player may bow any number of his or her Personalities and gain 1 Honor for each Personality he or she bows. Each player loses 3 Honor for each of his or her Personalities who does not or cannot bow, and those Personalities become Dishonored.
card.flavor: Kaede watches as he is carried to his pyre. She will take the throne, as he wished.

card.name: Isawa Natsune
card.text:
Phoenix Clan Librarian • Shugenja
Natsune may hold any number of Spells. Natsune may not bow to produce spell effects.
All Spells being attached to Natsune have their gold cost reduced by four.

card.name: Isawa Uona - exp
card.text:
Phoenix Clan Shugenja • Master of Air • Experienced • Unique • Shadowlands
Open: Bow Uona to bow any Shadowlands card.
card.flavor: The darkness she carries within her soul has shown her how to tame the dark souls of the Shadowlands.

card.name: Jade Strike
card.text: Battle: Bow this Shugenja and destroy an item you control. Destroy any one Shadowlands Follower or Shadowlands Personality that doesn't have a Follower. The target must be in the same battle as the item that was destroyed. This action is considered a Ranged Attack originating from the item.

card.name: Kaiu Kenru
card.text:
Crab Clan Armorer
Limited: Bow the Armorer to give any Follower a permanent 1F bonus. No Follower may receive this bonus more than once during the game.
card.flavor: So fine is his craft that it seems fused to the skin of the samurai who wear it.

card.name: Kaiu Suman
card.text:
Crab Clan Engineer
Reaction: Bow Kaiu Suman when you bring a Fortification into play. You can either attach the Fortification to a different one of your Provinces or reduce the Fortification's Gold cost by 6.
Battle: Bow Kaiu Suman. Destroy a Fortification at this battle.

card.name: Kakita Foruku
card.text:
Crane Clan Provincial Governor • While Foruku is unbowed, all of your Provinces are +1 Strength.
Open: Bow Foruku to raise the gold production of your Stronghold by 2 until the Governor straightens.

card.name: Kakita Toshimoko - exp
card.text:
Crane Clan Iaijutsu Master • Unique • Experienced • Samurai • Double Chi • Emerald Champion • May not refuse a duel. Lose 5 Honor if Toshimoko loses a duel. He may attach the Emerald Armor without cost.
Limited: Bow to challenge any dishonored Personality to a duel that cannot be refused.

card.name: Katana of Fire
card.text:
Unique Weapon. The gold cost of this card is zero if you have the Ring of Fire in play. Katana gains +2F/+1C while you have the Ring of Fire in play.
Elemental Reaction: If this Personality is killed in a duel, destroy the Katana of Fire instead of the Personality. The Personality is returned to your fief, bowed.

card.name: Kemmei
card.text:
Unaligned Advisor
While the Advisor is in play, your maximum hand size increases by three.
card.flavor: Only a fool does not listen when wisdom is presented to him.

card.name: Kolat Saboteur
card.text: Limited: Target a Stronghold in play. Bow the target Stronghold is it is unbowed. Target Stronghold cannot straighten until after the beginning of your next turn. Any stronghold effects which do not require the Stronghold to bow function normally.

card.name: Kolat Whisperer
card.text:
Unaligned Kolat • Unique
Limited: Bow the Whisperer and discard a card from your hand to target a dishonored human Personality. The target's controller must draw and discard the top card of his fate deck. If that card's focus value is less than the target's printed Personal Honor, the Personality commits seppuku; the target is restored to honor and then destroyed.

card.name: Kotaro
card.text:
Apprentice
Reaction: When the attached Shugenja straightens while holding a Black Scroll, you may draw and discard the top card of your Fate Deck. If the Focus value is odd, this Shugenja does not take a corruption token.

card.name: Kuni Wastelands
card.text:
Shadowlands Border Region • Unique
Any Shadowlands card you are putting into play has its gold cost reduced by one. Any Shadowlands card being put into play from this Province has its gold cost reduced by four.

card.name: Kuni Yori - exp
card.text:
Unaligned Shugenja • Experienced • Unique • Shadowlands
Limited: Bow Kuni Yori and discard a card in one of your Provinces. Select any one other Province in play. Discard any Dynasty card in that Province that is not in play (it is replaced normally).
card.flavor: Of all the lessons Fu Leng has taught us, remember this: death is not eternal.

card.name: Lesser Oni
card.text:
Nonhuman • Shadowlands • You may have any number of Lesser Oni in your deck.
If another player destroys Lesser Oni with an action or in battle, the player gains 1 Honor. (If the player destroys Lesser Oni during the Resolution Segment, the player must be the Attacker or Defender to gain the Honor.)

card.name: Mantis Budoka
card.text: Battle: Once per battle, draw and discard your top Fate card. The Force of the Mantis Budoka is raised by the Focus value of the discarded card until the end of the turn.
card.flavor: "Fill a man's pockets with koku, and his head will swim in the clouds. Where will the Mantis be, I wonder, when their new-found gold is spent?" - Yasuki Taka

card.name: Mantis Samurai
card.text: If the Mantis Samurai are attached to a Samurai Personality, this Personality may straighten during each player's Straighten Phase, if bowed.

card.name: Matsu Toshiro
card.text:
Lion Clan Samurai
Battle: Bow Toshiro for Fear 4.
card.flavor: I may not be the deadliest with the blade or the most skillful on a steed, but I have seen the face of death, and I wear it always.

card.name: Mempo of the Void
card.text:
Unique
While you have a Ring of the Void in play, Mempo of the Void gains a +2F/+1C bonus and has a printed Gold cost of 0.
Elemental Open: Bow Mempo of the Void and discard any number of cards from your hand to draw an equal number of cards from your Fate deck.

card.name: Merchant Caravan
card.text: Bow and discard a Fate card from your hand. Merchant Caravan produces gold equal to the focus value of the card discarded. You must discard for each usage of the Caravan. You may bow the Caravan without discarding to produce zero gold.

card.name: Mirumoto Daini - exp
card.text:
Dragon Clan Samurai • Experienced • Unique • Toturi's Army
Mirumoto Daini will join a Naga player for 2 less Gold.
card.flavor: He stands beside the Naga warriors on the Crab wall, unaware of the horrors that have cursed his homeland.

card.name: Mountain Pass
card.text: This Province gains +4 Strength. Provinces adjacent to this one have -1 Strength. (If a Province is destroyed, the one next to it becomes adjacent.)

card.name: Moving the Shadow
card.text:
You may play this card face up as a Focus card. If you do so, you may look at all Focus cards played for this duel so far.
Battle: One other player who has units in this battle must show you all Open and Battle Action cards that he has in his hand.

card.name: Nemesis
card.text: Limited: Target one of your Personalities without a "nemesis" and another player's Personality. The other Personality is your Personality's nemesis until the other Personality leaves play. While your Personality opposes the nemesis in a battle or duel, your Personality gains +2F/+3C.

card.name: Ningyo
card.text:
Retainer
Open: Bow the Ningyo to straighten any one Port, Pearl Divers, or Pearl Bed in play.
card.flavor: She flitted through the deepest coves and sunken wrecks, bringing treasures undreamed to assit our cause.

card.name: Ninja Kidnapper
card.text: Limited: Bow a Personality with less than 5 Force. Leave this card in play in your home. The target Personality cannot straighten while this card is in play. This card remains in play until any player pays 10 Gold as an Open action. When this card leaves play, straighten the target Personality and lose 5 Honor.

card.name: No-Dachi
card.text: Weapon.

card.name: Not this Day!
card.text: Until the end of the game, all Shugenja have the ability Reaction: Bow and destroy this Shugenja to destroy an Oni as the Oni is being brought into play.
card.flavor: Tokei threw himself, screaming, at the gibbering thing, his very essence destroying the summoned Oni.

card.name: Ogre Warriors
card.text:
Nonhuman • Shadowlands • Ogre
Can attach to Ogre Personalities ignoring restrictions on the Ogre.
Ranged attacks can not target this card.

card.name: Oni no Akeru
card.text:
Unaligned Elemental Terror • Shadowlands • Nonhuman • No Items or Followers • Lose 4 Honor.
Elemental Reaction: Bow the Oni after a Shugenja bows to produce a spell effect or Innate Ability. Give that Shugenja a -2C void token. You may not respond in this way to a Shugenja controlled by a player who has the Ring of Void in play.

card.name: Oni no Jimen
card.text:
Unaligned Elemental Terror • Shadowlands • Nonhuman • No items or Followers • Lose 4 Honor.
Elemental Open: Bow the Oni to destroy any Region card in play. You may not target a Region controlled by a player who has the Ring of Earth in play.

card.name: Oni no Kaze
card.text:
Unaligned Elemental Terror • Shadowlands • Nonhuman • No items or Followers • Lose 6 Honor.
Elemental Limited: Bow the Oni to destroy any spell in play. You may not target a spell controlled by a player who has the Ring of Air in play.

card.name: Oni no Mizu
card.text:
Unaligned Elemental Terror • Shadowlands • Nonhuman • No items or Followers • Lose 4 Honor.
Elemental Battle: Bow the Oni. Select a battle that has not been resolved. Move all units in the current battle to the target unresolved battle and vice-versa. The current battle continues to resolve normally with the new units. You cannot use this action when any units in the opposing army are controlled by a player who has the Ring of Water in play.

card.name: Oni no Seiryoku
card.text:
Unaligned Shadowlands • Nonhuman • No Items or Followers • Lose 5 Honor.
Reaction: Give this Oni a 1F/1C Energy token whenever a spell or innate ability is used by a Shugenja controlled by another player that targets you or your cards during an Action Phase, or is used by an opposing Shugenja in a battle.

card.name: Oni no Taki-Bi
card.text:
Unaligned Elemental Terror • Shadowlands • Nonhuman • No Items or Followers • Lose 4 Honor.
Elemental Battle: Bow the Oni to destroy any combination of Followers in an opposing unit which have a combined force less than the Oni's Chi. You may not target Followers controlled by a player who has the Ring of Fire in play.

card.name: Passing on the Soul
card.text: Reaction: Play as one of your Personalities is being destroyed. Give any one item card attached to that Personality to another of your unbowed Personalities.
card.flavor: "I took the blade with trembling hands, praying that I could live up to its legacy..."

card.name: Pearl of Wisdom
card.text: Any and all Shugenja in play may choose to quest for the Pearl. All such Shugenja bow (if necessary) and destroy any Black Scrolls they may have attached. A questing Shugenja may remain bowed and destroy a corruption token on him or her each time he or she does so.

card.name: Personal Standard
card.text:
Only a Samurai can attach the Personal Standard.
Each Follower in this unit gains +1F while the Personal Standard is in this unit. Lower Fear that targets this unit by 2. Ranged attacks can target this Personality even if this Personality has Followers.

card.name: Pikemen
card.text: This Follower gains a 3F bonus while there is one or more cavalry units in the opposing army.

Naga Naval Warrior • Nonhuman

card.name: Reversal of Fortunes

Unique.

Unaligned Monk • No Followers or items.

card.name: Seize the Day

card.text:
Naga Samurai • Experienced Naga Warlord • Unique • All Naga Followers in this unit have a 1F bonus.

Unicorn Clan Samurai

Unicorn Clan Samurai • Cavalry.

Mantis Clan Veteran. Samurai.
Reaction: Bow Yukue when paying the gold cost affiliated with gaining an additional Province. The gold cost is reduced to zero.

card.name: Zokujin
card.text: Limited: Bow the Zokujin to destroy a Copper Mine. No cards in this unit can straighten during your next turn.
card.flavor: "These creatures grow bolder. The volcanoes that drive our peasants from the fields draw the zokujin like beacons in the earth." - Tamori Shaitung

card.name: 700 Soldier Plain
card.text:
Singular
Battle: Twice per battle, bow one of your defending units to force the Attacker to bow two attacking Personalities and/or Followers.

card.name: Battle Maidens
card.text:
Cavalry
Only a Cavalry Personality can attach Battle Maidens.
While this unit is Cavalry and attacking, Battle Maidens gain +1F and you cannot target this unit with actions that would send it home.
card.flavor: Their banners now bear a kanji: "Forever."

card.name: Big Stink
card.text:
Unique
Non-Goblin Personalities and non-Goblin Followers have -1F while at this battlefield.
After each time a Goblin enters play from this Province, attach two 1F Shadowlands Goblin Nonhuman Follower tokens to him.

card.name: Blackened Claws
card.text:
Shadowlands
Cannot be moved. May only attach to a Shadowlands Personality without Blackened Claws. May attach to a Personality regardless of restrictions on the Personality.
Reaction: When this Personality enters a duel, bow Blackened Claws to give two -1C Corruption tokens to the opposing Personality.

card.name: Chi Projection
card.text: Kiho Open: Bow a shugenja or a monk you control to straighten any Personality in play with a lower Chi.

card.name: Cleansing Bell
card.text: Limited: Bow and destroy the Cleansing Bell to make all players play with their hands face up (and with all cards in their hands completely visible) until the turn ends.
card.flavor: No secrets. No lies. Just the pure tones of the bell... and the certainty that your enemies will reveal themselves for what they are.

card.name: Coordinated Strike
card.text: Battle: Give a +1F bonus to the Personality and all attached Followers in a target unit.

card.name: Cultists
card.text:
Shugenja.
Any Kiho that the Cultists bow to produce is considered maho.

card.name: Daidoji Karasu
card.text:
Crane Clan Bounty Hunter. Samurai.
Battle: Bow for a Ranged 2 Attack.
Reaction: Discard a card from your hand immediately before Karasu performs a Ranged Attack to increase the strength of the Ranged Attack by the focus value of the discard. Karasu can do this once per turn.

card.name: Daidoji Osen
card.text:
Crane Clan Spy. Samurai.
Reaction: When Osen is assigned to or moves into a battle, any player may show you one or more terrains from their Fate Hand. During that battle, players may not play terrain cards from their hand that they did not show you.

card.name: Death of the Ki-Rin
card.text: Until the end of the game, players may not destroy any opponents' last province in battle, and their Events that would destroy that province are canceled without effect. This won't prevent a player from losing due to his own card effects. This event does not affect players while they have 10 or more Family Honor or with at least one Elemental Ring in play, or those clans normally unable to win a honor victory.

card.name: Dharma Technique
card.text: Kiho Reaction: After an Event is revealed but before it resolves, bow one of your Monks to discard the Event without resolution.

card.name: Doji Kuwanan - exp2
card.text:
Crane Clan Champion. Samurai. Unique. Tactician. Experienced 2. Will only join Crane Clan. Kuwanan's unit cannot be targeted with an action that will send him home from battle if he has not received a Force bonus this turn.
Reaction: Cancel any use of Tactician by a card in the opposing army.

card.name: Doom of the Alliance
card.text: Until the end of the game, Yoritomo's Alliance players must pay full cost for Personalities with the Yoritomo's Alliance trait, and only Personalities with "Mantis Clan" as a printed trait are considered part of their clan.

card.name: Eshru - exp
card.text:
Naga Slayer. Experienced. Unique. May attach crystal items for free.
Battle: Bow for a Ranged 4 Attack against any Tattooed card.
Battle: Bow to challenge an opposing Tattooed Personality to a duel that cannot be refused.

card.name: Haunted
card.text: This Follower may be attached to any player's Personality. When this Personality performs an action or is assigned (or moved) to attack, his or her controller must draw and discard their top Fate card. If the focus value is equal to or greater than the Personality's Chi, the action (or assignment) is canceled and cannot be performed again this turn.

card.name: Hida O-Ushi - exp2
card.text:
Crab Clan Bully. Samurai. Experienced 2. Unique. O-Ushi is considered the Crab Clan Champion while Hida Yakamo is not in play. May not assign or move into a battle against a Crab or Unicorn Defender. Will join Unicorn for 2 less gold.
Battle: Produce a Fear effect equal to her Force, affecting both Personalities and Followers.

card.name: Hitomi Reju - exp
card.text:
Dragon Clan Samurai. Tattooed. Unique. Experienced Doji Reju. If Reju is tied in a duel, he wins the duel instead.
Reaction: Once per turn, when Reju enters a duel, draw and discard your top Fate card. Reju gains a Chi bonus until the end of the duel equal to the focus value of the discard.

card.name: Hoshi Wayan
card.text:
Unaligned Monk. Tattooed.
Limited: Once per turn, you may place a tattoo token on Wayan.
Reaction: Destroy a tattoo token on Wayan immediately after an opposing Personality in this battle gains a bonus to Force and/or Chi. Wayan gains an identical bonus to that just gained by the opposing Personality. Wayan may only react this way once to each bonus.

card.name: Ikoma Technique
card.text: Battle: All of your Followers at this battle gain 1F. If you are a Lion player, this technique's gold cost is reduced to zero.

card.name: Isawa Norikazu - exp
card.text: Phoenix Clan Seer. Unique. Experienced. Shugenja. Reaction: Immediately after an event is revealed and before it is resolved, destroy Norikazu to destroy the event, which is discarded without effect. (J)

card.name: Kachiko's Fan
card.text: Unique. When the Fan enters play, name a clan. While the Fan is in play and you have no Shadowlands cards in play, you may brings Personalities from that clan into play as if your Family Honor were a 10.

card.name: Kakita Ariteko
card.text:
Crane Clan Artisan.
Open: Bow Ariteko to restore a Personality to honorable status.

card.name: Kakita Technique
card.text:
This card costs 1 less Gold for a Crane Clan player.
Reaction: Play this card when one of your Personalities enters a duel against a Personality with lower Personal Honor. Your Personality has the first option to focus or strike.
card.flavor: An iaijutsu duel with a Kakita master is as sure a death as seppuku.

card.name: Kansen
card.text:
Shadowlands. Nonhuman.
Battle: Bow the Kansen to destroy any one of the Defender's holdings that has a gold cost less than the Kansen's Force.

card.name: Legacy of the Dark One
card.text: Maho Kiho Limited: Bow a shugenja or monk you control and target any Personality in play. Until the end of this turn, any focus values played for the target are reduced by the Chi of your shugenja or monk. Your shugenja or monk gains the Shadowlands trait permanently and you lose 5 Honor. This honor loss cannot be altered or redirected in any way.

card.name: Makashi
card.text:
Mantis Clan Samurai. Toturi's Army.
Actions targeting Makashi affect him as though he were aligned to every Clan.

card.name: Makoto
card.text: Limited: Every player may bow one Personality, beginning with the player on your left. The player who bows the Personality with the highest Personal Honor gains honor equal to the difference between his Personality and the Personality with the second highest Personal Honor.

card.name: Oni no Akuma - exp
card.text:
Unaligned Oni Overlord. Shadowlands. Nonhuman. Experienced. Unique.
When Akuma enters play it destroys the province from which it enters play. Lose 5 Honor. You must destroy a Follower you control in order to assign or move Akuma into a battle.

card.name: Otaku Steed
card.text: The Personality gains the Cavalry trait while the Otaku Steed is attached. If the Personality already has the Cavalry trait, he or she gains +1F instead.

card.name: Prophet's Tower
card.text:
Unique Fortification. May only be brought into play by a member of The Brotherhood of Shinsei.
Armies attacking this Province may not have more units than the number of Elemental Rings the Attacker has in play plus one. Armies defending this Province may not have more units than the number of Elemental Rings the Defender has in play plus one. Additional units trying to assign or move into the attacking army are returned home, bowed.

card.name: Ratling Nest
card.text:
This card costs 3 gold for Crab Clan player.
Bow to pay the entire gold cost of any one Ratling card when you are bringing it into play. Variable cost cards may not be paid in this manner.

card.name: Ratling Spy
card.text: Limited: Look at the top card of either of one of your opponents' decks. You may return the card to the top of the deck or discard it.

card.name: Shiryo no Tetsuya
card.text:
Brotherhood Ancestor. This card count as Tetsuya for uniqueness purposes.
All numerals on this Personality are increased by one.

card.name: Shosuro Chian
card.text:
Scorpion Clan Ninja. May remain bowed. You must discard 3 Fate cards to put Chian into play.
Limited: Bow Chian and target one player. While Chian remains bowed, that player must discard a Fate Card each time he or she attempts to put a Personality into play. Otherwise, the Personality is discarded.

card.name: Silk Farm
card.text: Bow the Silk Farm to produce an amount of Gold equal to the number of Forests plus the number of Silk Works in play.

card.name: Speak with the Voices of the Dead
card.text: Maho Kiho Open: Bow a shugenja or monk you control. Target a Personality and select any one dead Personality. The live Personality gains any one ability from the dead Personality until the end of the turn.

card.name: Storms of War
card.text: Battle: Until the end of this battle, any player who wishes to perform an action must bow a Personality or Follower in this battle immediately before the action is begun, or else the action is canceled without effect. If the action will move a unit into the battle, cards in that unit may be bowed to allow the action.

card.name: Teach the Mountain
card.text: Reaction: Play when a Personality is entering play from a Province with a fortification attached. Until the end of the game, this Personality gains a +2F/+2C bonus while he or she is in an army at a Province with a fortification.

card.name: The Iron Cranes
card.text: Limited: Target any Poet, Courtier, or Personality with a Political ability. This Personality gains a +1F/+1C permanently and loses all abilities, permanently.

card.name: The Silk Road
card.text: The next holding that appears in this Province after this region enters play has its gold cost reduced to zero.

card.name: Togashi's Daisho
card.text:
Unique. May only attach to a Dragon Personality May attach to a Personality that is not allowed to attach items. Will attach to the Dragon Clan Champion without gold cost.
Open: This Personality gains -2F and Double Chi until the end of turn.

card.name: Tohaku
card.text:
Unaligned Samurai. Toturi's Army. Will not join a Lion player.
Battle: Once per turn, Tohaku gains a 2F/2C bonus if there are one or more Lion Personalities in the opposing army.

card.name: Trapping Tactics
card.text:
You must have a Tactician in this battle to play Trapping Tactics.
Battle Terrain: This terrain takes effect immediately upon being played. No units may move into or out of this battle. All Ranged Attacks performed while this terrain are in play have a +2 strength.

card.name: Tutor
card.text:
Retainer.
Reaction: Bow at the beginning of your end phase. Instead of drawing one card, draw three. Choose one card to put into your hand, returning the other two to the top of your deck (in any order) or discarding them.

card.name: Unrelenting Terror
card.text:
Reaction: Play when performing a Fear effect to combine the strengths of two or more Fear effects within the same unit to produce a larger Fear effect.
Reaction: Play immediately after performing a Fear effect. You may produce as many Fear effects as you wish before the next player may perform their Battle or Open action.

card.name: Valley of the Two Generals
card.text:
Singular.
While in a battle at this Province, Samurai gain the ability: "Battle: Bow to destroy an opposing Follower or an opposing Personality without Followers."

card.name: War in the Shadowlands
card.text: Any Player with fewer Shadowlands cards in play than another player has all of his or her Shadowlands cards destroyed.

card.name: Way of Shadow
card.text: Reaction: Play immediately after an action targets a Ninja card, but before its effects are resolved. The action is canceled and has all of its effects negated.

card.name: Agasha Tamori
card.text:
Dragon Clan Shugenja
Agasha Tamori has a 3C bonus when bringing Spells into play and when bowing to use Spells.
card.flavor: For years Tamori's skills have been praised by the Phoenix. Now Hitomi watches him with a covetous eye.

card.name: Air Dragon
card.text:
Unaligned Creature • Shugenja • Cavalry • Unique
Cannot attach Followers or Items.
Air Dragon cannot be targeted by Ranged Attacks or by the effects of Spells or Kihos.

card.name: Akodo Kage
card.text:
Lion Clan Samurai • Revered Sensei
Limited: Bow this card and place a 1F/1C Sensei token on a Personality. No Personality may have more than 2 Sensei tokens.
card.flavor: With Toturi's banishment, he is the last of the Akodo line. And then the last Akodo falls, so falls the last Hantei.

card.name: Alhundro Cornejo
card.text:
Unaligned Explosives Master
Limited: Bow to destroy any Fortification.
Limited: Bow to permanently reduce the strength of a Province by one (minimum zero).
Reaction: Bow when bringing an Explosives card into play to reduce the gold cost to zero.

card.name: Ancestral Sword of Crane Clan
card.text:
Weapon • Unique • Gain 4 Honor.
When controlled by a Crane Clan Personality, Sword gains a 1F/1C bonus for every Crane Clan personality you control. Any other Crane Clan players lose 6 Honor when this item is brought into play.

card.name: Ancestral Sword of Dragon Clan
card.text:
Weapon • Unique • Gain 4 Honor.
When controlled by a Dragon Clan Personality, Sword gains a 1F/1C bonus for every Dragon Clan personality you control. Any other Dragon Clan players lose 6 Honor when this item is brought

card.name: Ancestral Sword of Lion Clan
card.text:
Weapon • Unique • Gain 4 Honor.
When controlled by a Lion Clan Personality, Sword gains a 1F/1C bonus for every Lion Clan personality you control. Any other Lion Clan players lose 6 Honor when this item is brought into play.

card.name: Ancestral Sword of Phoenix Clan
card.text:
Weapon • Unique • Gain 4 Honor.
When controlled by a Phoenix Clan Personality, Sword gains a 1F/1C bonus for every Phoenix Clan personality you control. Any other Phoenix Clan players lose 6 Honor when this item is brought into play.

card.name: Ancestral Sword of Unicorn Clan
card.text:
Weapon • Unique • Gain 4 Honor.
When controlled by a Unicorn Clan Personality, Sword gains a 1F/1C bonus for every Unicorn Clan personality you control. Any other Unicorn Clan players lose 6 Honor when this item is brought into play.

card.name: Animate the Dead
card.text: Limited: Bow this Shugenja and bring a Follower back into play from any discard pile and attach it to any of your Personalities. Lose 2 Honor. This Follower permanently gains Shadowlands, and the ability Battle: Fear 3.
card.flavor: "The scouts tell of a shugenja who makes the dead walk again, my lord. We must learn more of this dark magic... for research, of course." - Kuni Yori

card.name: Apprentice
card.text: Apprentice adds an additional two to the Chi of this Shugenja for the purposes of bringing spells into play or when bowing to use a spell or innate ability.
card.flavor: There is nothing to match the exuberance of youth... except, of course, wisdom and treachery. - Bayushi Kachiko

card.name: Archers
card.text: Battle: Bow Archers for a Ranged 3 Attack.
card.flavor: Their arrows have burrowed in paper and straw for eight years. Now they find targets of flesh and bone.

card.name: The Armor of Sun Tao
card.text:
Limited: Place any number of Terrains from your hand face down under The Armor of Sun Tao. If The Armor of Sun Tao is moved or destroyed, the Terrains move or are destroyed with it.
Battle: Play a Terrain from under The Armor of Sun Tao. The Terrain destroys any Terrain in play and cannot be destroyed.

card.name: The Armor of the Golden Samurai
card.text: Opponents dueling this Personality cannot play Focus cards with a value less than the Personal Honor of this Personality.
card.flavor: He raised a golden gauntlet to the sky, and the sun's light reached to touch his sword. Surely he was descended from Amaterasu herself, to have such purity at his command.

card.name: Asahina Tamako
card.text:
Crane Clan Shugenja
Reaction: Bow Asahina Tamako and discard a Fate Card at any time in which Gold is needed. Produce an amount of Gold equal to the Focus Value of the discarded card.
card.flavor: He gazes into the stars, searching for the future in the ways of the past.

card.name: Asahina Tomo
card.text: Crane Clan Shugenja
card.flavor: When the war began he knew nothing of strategy and tactics, but that would soon change.

card.name: Asako Yasu
card.text:
Phoenix Clan Interrogator • Shugenja
Limited: Bow the Interrogator to "question" any Shugenja, beginning a duel between these Personalities. The Interrogator may not focus, but also cannot be destroyed by the outcome of this duel.

card.name: Avoid Fate
card.text: Reaction: Play before an Event resolves. The Event does not resolve. When the Events Phase ends, the Event's player shuffles it into his deck and refills the Province.

card.name: Barbican
card.text:
Fortification
Each Personality gains +1F while defending this Province.
Double the strength of each defending card's ranged attacks at this Province, after applying all other Ranged Attack strength bonuses.
card.flavor: "Let them attack. Their ancestors will no longer be lonely."

card.name: Battering Ram Crew
card.text: Battle: If the Battering Ram Crew is attacking, bow it to destroy a Fortification attached to this Province.
card.flavor: "Even the Crab's shells can be pried open." - Yasuki Hachi

card.name: Bayushi Kachiko
card.text:
Scorpion Clan Seductress • Unique
Limited: Bow to put a -1C seduction token on any Personality. Add a seduction token each turn she chooses not to straighten. If Seductress straightens or is destroyed, all seduction tokens are removed. May remain bowed.
card.flavor: "There are subtler strategies and deadlier battlefields than even I know." - The Tao of Shinsei

card.name: Bayushi Togai
card.text:
Scorpion Clan Samurai
Poison cards, including Dripping Poison, can be attached to Togai without paying their gold cost. Poison cards or tokens targeting Togai have no effect.
card.flavor: "One strike is all it takes. Then, you are mine."

card.name: Be Prepared to Dig Two Graves
card.text: Reaction: After a Personality from your Faction is destroyed while in a battle: Target a Personality opposing him. For the rest of the game, Personalities from your Faction gain +2F/+2C while facing the target in a battle or duel. This does not target the destroyed Personality.

card.name: Biting Steel
card.text: Open: Bow this Shugenja to give +3F/+3C to a Dragon Clan Personality or +2F/+2C to a non-Dragon Clan Personality.
card.flavor: "What can stand against a quick hand, sharp eye, and biting steel?"

card.name: Blackmail
card.text: Limited: Choose a Province and a Holding of another player. Take control of that holding while Blackmail is in play. As an Open Action, the affected player may reveal the Blackmail, destroying it and the target Province. Also, the holding is returned, and you lose 10 Honor. If the Province is destroyed, Blackmail cannot be revealed.

card.name: Blacksmiths
card.text:
Bow Blacksmiths to produce 2 Gold, plus 1 Gold for every Iron Mine in play.
Bow Blacksmiths to produce 4 Gold when paying for a Weapon or Armor.

card.name: Blazing Arrows
card.text: Battle: Blazing Arrows adds two to the strength of each of your cards producing a Ranged Attack for this battle. The gold cost of Blazing Arrows is 1G per card in your army that is capable of producing a Ranged Attack.

card.name: Bloodsword
card.text:
Weapon
The Bloodsword gains a +2F/+2C token each time this Personality wins a duel.
card.flavor: "Passion, Ambition, Judgement, Revenge... four of the brightest souls will I take to fuel my darkest ambition." - attributed to the sorcerer Iuchiban

card.name: Bloom of the White Orchid
card.text: Gold cost to attach spells to Shugenja is reduced to zero until the beginning of this player's next turn.
card.flavor: Only once a year does the White Orchid bloom, and upon that day, knowledge is passed freely between all Schools of the Shugenja.

card.name: Bon Festival
card.text: Each player receives 3 Honor for each of his Honorable Dead.
card.flavor: We honor those who have lived before. We will remember their great deeds, and learn from their follies.

card.name: Bountiful Harvest
card.text: Limited: All Gold-producing Holdings produce 1 additional Gold until the end of this turn.
card.flavor: The first two years of Toturi's reign were filled with peace and plenty.

card.name: Breach of Etiquette
card.text: Limited: The player (or players) with the highest Family Honor commits a public breach of etiquette and loses 5 Honor.
card.flavor: "A rash word can damage a man more swiftly than the sharpest sword." - Kakita Yoshi

card.name: Break Morale
card.text: Open: Target any Dishonored Personality. All of this Personality's Followers are destroyed.
card.flavor: You cannot expect to lead by example when your own actions cause the army's faith to falter.

card.name: Call Upon The Wind
card.text: Limited Elemental: Bow this Shugenja to turn over any one card which is not in play.
card.flavor: "The first step to mastering the wind is learning that you can never be its master." - Isawa Uona

card.name: Careful Planning
card.text: Open: Give a Personality +1F/+1C.
card.flavor: "We have halted the Mirumoto's retreat east and south. They can move only west... where our forces are already waiting." - Akodo Tenero

card.name: Castle of Water
card.text:
Water
Battle: Even if this unit is not at the current battlefield and even if you control no units there, bow this card: Give the current battlefield's province +3 strength.
card.flavor: "If you believe that water lacks strength, simply stand in the path of a tidal wave and find yourself proven wrong." - Isawa Mizuhiko

card.name: Celestial Alignment
card.text: Until your next turn begins, Shugenja Personalities need not bow as a cost of Kiho or Spell actions they perform.
card.flavor: "The forces of Jigoku could not withstand the strength and honor of the Empress's armies. The Army of Dark Fire was broken and driven out of the Empire." -- The Chronicles of Empress Iweko, Part IV

card.name: Chrysanthemum Festival
card.text: Each player gains a Province to the left of his leftmost Province.

card.name: Climbing Gear
card.text: The Climbing Gear can only be attached to a Ninja Personality. All effects of Fortifications at the defender's Province are negated while the Climbing Gear is in an attacking army.
card.flavor: "The high walls of the Dragon hold no challenge for me anymore. Even stone has a soul, and souls are easy to conquer..." - Matsu Hiroru

card.name: Cloak of Night
card.text: Limited: Bow this Shugenja and destroy this card: Target a Personality you control. Put a Spell, Follower, or Item in your hand under him, face-down and out of play. Permanently gain the ability "Open: Once per game: Turn that card face-up. If it is a legal attachment, attach it to that Personality, ignoring costs; otherwise, discard it."

card.name: Counterattack
card.text: Reaction: Play this card after the last Resolution Segment of another player's Attack Phase in which you were the Defender. Create an Attack Phase in which you are the Attacker and that player is the Defender.
card.flavor: "We must strike the Phoenix as they have struck us. They must burn and not be allowed to rise again." - Mirumoto Daisuke

card.name: Counterspell
card.text: Reaction: Bow this Shugenja to cancel the effects of one Shugenja's innate ability as it's being used.
card.flavor: A strong man will try to be stronger than a blow. A wise man will learn to sidestep it. - Isawa Tomo

card.name: Crystal Katana
card.text:
Weapon
While this Personality faces a Shadowlands Personality in a battle or duel, the Crystal Katana gains +2C.
card.flavor: When members of the Brotherhood say that they are "going to seek the missing half of the Tao," they usually mean to seek it in the blood of the creatures responsible for its destruction.

card.name: Daidoji Uji
card.text: Crane Clan Samurai
card.flavor: "Shiro Yojin belongs to the Crane. If the Lion will not give it up, then we will take it from them."

card.name: Dance Troupe
card.text:
Bow to produce 2 Gold.
Limited: Bow to gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: Their presence in the Court brought many Lords to our home and much gold to our coffers.

card.name: Dead Walk The Earth
card.text: Until your next Events Phase, all Shadowlands Personalities and Followers have a 4F bonus. At the beginning of your next Event Phase, all Shadowlands cards in play are destroyed.

card.name: Deadly Ground
card.text:
Immediate Terrain
Battle: Players can take no actions for this battle except ones that destroy this Terrain.
card.flavor: "We took back Hiruma Castle thirty years ago. We pay the price daily, but we make the Shadowlands pay more." - Hiruma Todori

card.name: Debt of Honor
card.text: Reaction: Put this card into play immediately after a battle in which you have sent allying units to aid the target player. Later, destroy this card before the Assignments Phase of a battle to request that this player aid you in return. That player must assign the unit you request to the specified battle, or lose 8 Honor. You may not request an illegal assignment of a unit.

card.name: Dispersive Terrain
card.text:
Delayed Terrain
Battle: Each defending Personality in this battle gains +2F until the battle ends.
card.flavor: "Force your foes to attack over broken ground, and you will see their composure shatter along with their formation." - Matsu Nimuro

card.name: Doji Hoturi
card.text:
Crane Clan Champion • Samurai • Unique • Will only join a Crane Clan Player.
Reaction: Change a duel Hoturi is entering to a Duel of Personal Honor. Winner merely survives, loser loses 3 Honor and must either commit seppuku (even if not a samurai) or be dishonored. These results replace the duel's original results.

card.name: Doji Yosai
card.text:
Crane Clan Samurai
If Yosai bows to lobby for the Imperial favor, no player may give gifts to oppose this action.
card.flavor: He has been left alone to guard the ancient fortress of his Clansmen with only an army of Phoenix shugenja and samurai to aid him.

card.name: Dragon Helm
card.text: Open: Bow the Helm to force any target Dragon to bow. (This does not refer to Dragon Clan Personalities, unless they are considered to be a Dragon.)
card.flavor: An item that was thought to have been destroyed by Togashi Yokuni many years ago...

card.name: Earth Dragon
card.text:
Unaligned Creature • Shugenja • Cavalry • Unique
Cannot attach Followers or Items.
Elemental Battle: Until the turn ends, Earth Dragon has +5F while defending.

card.name: Earthquake
card.text: Elemental Earth Battle: Bow this Shugenja to bow an opposing Personality.

card.name: Elemental Ward
card.text: Reaction: Bow this Shugenja to negate the effects of one Elemental action (spell or other card) which is targeting you or any of your cards in play.
card.flavor: Does the falling rain cause itself pain? Does the fire burn its own fingers? Be one with the Elements and you will be one with all Creation.

card.name: Emergence of the Tortoise
card.text: There are no Dynasty Phases until after the beginning of your next turn.
card.flavor: With tranquility, the small departs and the great arrives with auspicious success. - I Ching

card.name: Emperor's Peace
card.text: No attacks can be made by any player until after the beginning of your next turn.
card.flavor: Toturi held up his hand. "Let my reign herald a time of new peace."

card.name: Energy Transference
card.text: Open: Bow this Shugenja to switch a Personality's Force and Chi. If the Personality is not yours, destroy this Spell.

card.name: Entrapping Terrain
card.text:
Delayed Terrain
Battle: This battle ends without resolution. All units go home without bowing.
card.flavor: "Maneuver them towards the marshes, and let them pit their strength against the mud."

card.name: Evil Feeds Upon Itself
card.text: The player (or players) with the lowest Family Honor loses his or her rightmost Province (it is destroyed).
card.flavor: "Even now, the darkness fights against itself, seeking a leader to renew the attack. Our battle is not finished." - Hida Tsuru

card.name: Evil Portents
card.text: Open: All Shadowlands Personalities and Followers currently in play gain a 1F/1C bonus until the end of the turn. All other Personalities suffer a -1F/-1C penalty.
card.flavor: Every night it seems midnight lasts one heartbeat longer.

card.name: Explosives
card.text: Limited: Target a Holding. Destroy it.

card.name: Famous Poet
card.text:
Retainer
Reaction: When you destroy an army or Province as the Attacker or Defender, bow the Famous Poet to gain 3 Honor.
card.flavor: "The sword, the soul, honor, and the glory of the clan - artfully arranged, these words give the mother who has lost her son in battle some comfort." - Shosuro Taberu

card.name: Fan of Command
card.text: This Personality has the Tactician keyword.

card.name: Fantastic Gardens
card.text:
Fantastic Gardens cost 2 less Gold for Crane Clan players.
Limited: Bow Fantastic Gardens to gain 2 Honor.

card.name: Feint
card.text: Play Feint as a Focus card in a duel. After Focus cards are revealed, you may choose any other card in your hand to add as a Focus.
card.flavor: When he hesitates, learn to move his shadow. - Miyamoto Musashi

card.name: Fire Breather
card.text:
Battle: Bow for a Ranged 4 Attack.
Battle: Bow to destroy a Fortification attached to the Province that Fire Breather is attacking.
card.flavor: The fire fell from over the wall, swallowing dozens of men in less than a heartbeat.

card.name: Fires of Purity
card.text: Elemental Open: Bow this Shugenja to give +3F/+3C to a Personality with over 2 Personal Honor.
card.flavor: "If only death can end the Isawa's hatred, we will give it to them." - Tamori Taiu

card.name: Flight of Dragons
card.text: Battle: All Dragons in this battle fly away (are destroyed). No Honor is lost or gained. This does not refer to Dragon Clan Personalities unless they are considered to be a Dragon.

card.name: Forest
card.text:
Bow the Forest to produce 1 Gold.
Bow the Forest to produce 2 Gold when paying for a Personality with the Creature or Nonhuman trait or a Follower with the Creature or Nonhuman trait.
card.flavor: "Still your mind and listen. You will see that the forest is not empty." - Lady Kitsune

card.name: Forgotten Tomb
card.text:
Shadowlands
During your Dynasty Phase, you may place any number of Shadowlands Personalities and Shadowlands Followers face up under the Forgotten Tomb from your hand or Provinces. You may bring cards under the Forgotten Tomb into play without Gold cost during one of your Dynasty Phases after a number of turns equal to each card's Force, paying all non-Gold costs. If the Forgotten Tomb is moved or destroyed, the cards move or are destroyed with it.

card.name: Fort on a Hill
card.text:
Fortification
Provides a 1F bonus to each defending Personality in this Battle and a 1F penalty to each attacking Personality in this Battle.
card.flavor: When all else has failed, the last action of a desperate commander is the siege of a walled city.

card.name: Foxwife
card.text:
Nonhuman • Creature
Raises the Personal Honor of the attached Personality to five (and restores to honor if dishonored). Foxwife is destroyed if the Personality performs any dishonorable act (either causing a loss of family honor, or if the Personality becomes dishonored).

card.name: Frenzy
card.text: Battle: Target one of your Personalities: Dishonor him. Lose 2 Honor. Give him +2F, or +3F if he is Crab Clan. Before the turn ends, destroy all his attached Followers.

card.name: The Fury of Osano-Wo
card.text:
When you bring this Spell into play, place three tokens on it. When this Spell has no tokens, destroy it.
Battle: Bow this Shugenja and destroy a token on this Spell for a ranged attack with strength equal to this Shugenja's Chi plus 2.

card.name: Gaijin Mercenaries
card.text:
Lose 2 Honor.
When the Mercenaries are committed to an attack, you must pay them 3 Gold, or they are destroyed.
Battle: Pay the Mercenaries 4 Gold, and the Mercenaries gain a 1F bonus until the end of the turn. This may be done more than once per battle.

card.name: Geisha Assassin
card.text: Limited: Target a Personality controlled by another player. Create a Geisha Personality with a Chi equal to half the Gold spent on this card, rounded down. She issues an unrefusable challenge to the target. She cannot add cards to her focus pool or focus. Remove her from the game after the duel ends.

card.name: Ginawa
card.text: Unaligned Samurai • Toturi's Army
card.flavor: "Seek a new master, find a new sword... enslaving the Moon would be easier."

card.name: Go Master
card.text:
Retainer
Battle: Bow the Go Master to play a Terrain, which destroys any Terrain in play.
card.flavor: "Where you do not place a stone is as vital to us both as the board itself." - Master Suana

card.name: Goblin Mob
card.text:
Nonhuman • Shadowlands • Lose 2 Honor.
Reaction: When a ranged attack targets a card in this unit, the ranged attack targets the Goblin Mob instead.
card.flavor: They come in waves of teeth and muscle, driven by needs of which none can speak in the light of Lord Sun.

card.name: Goblin Warmonger
card.text:
Unaligned Nonhuman • Shadowlands
When the Goblin Warmonger would be destroyed, if he has any Goblin Followers, instead destroy all cards in this unit except the Goblin Warmonger, bow the Goblin Warmonger, and send him home.
card.flavor: The goblins from the deep Shadowlands do not waste their teeth on words.

card.name: Greater Mujina
card.text:
Creature • Cavalry • Lose 2 Honor
Each Greater Mujina gives a 1F bonus to all Lesser Mujina in play while the Greater Mujina is in play.
card.flavor: The masters of the Mujina direct their servants in the ways of mischief.

card.name: Hawk Riders
card.text:
Cavalry
Lose 2 Honor.
card.flavor: These barbarians are without honor, binding their beasts in that way. - Shinjo Yokatsu

card.name: Hawks and Falcons
card.text: Limited: Bow Hawks and Falcons to gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "Hawks are more than talons. Life is more than war. And there is more to war than killing." - Ide Tadaji

card.name: Heart of the Inferno
card.text: Battle Elemental: Bow this Shugenja and destroy this spell to cast a fiery bolt at the opposing army that targets then destroys all Personalities and Followers that have a Force of 2 or less.

card.name: Heichi Chokei
card.text: Unaligned Monk • Shugenja
card.flavor: Of all the men in the Empire, only one still bears the name of the daimyo of the Boar. Now he has retired to the monastery, and his clan will soon be forgotten.

card.name: Hida Amoro
card.text:
Crab Clan Berserker • No Armor
Berserker is destroyed after any battle in which he is involved unless his army has a force more than twice as great as the opposing army.
card.flavor: We were hundreds against thousands. I looked at him and watched his face twist into an insane grin.

card.name: Hida Kisada
card.text:
Crab Clan Champion • Samurai • Unique • Double Chi • Will only join Crab Clan Player.
Cards in Kisada's Unit cannot be the target of Shugenja Spells and Innate Abilities.
card.flavor: "Your knowledge cannot save you. Your magic cannot save you. Nothing can save you."

card.name: Hida Sukune
card.text: Crab Clan Samurai
card.flavor: "Poor Sukune. He suspected it from the beginning, and his failures at Beiden Pass confirmed his fate." - Kuni Yori

card.name: Hida Tampako
card.text:
Crab Clan Samurai
Gains a 2F bonus when defending.
card.flavor: He spent most of his life defending Rokugan from the horrors of the Shadowlands. When it came time to decide between the Emperor and his uncle Kisada, Tampako knew he made the right decision.

card.name: Hida Tsuru
card.text:
Crab Clan Samurai • Cavalry
All Followers being attached to this card have their gold costs reduced by 2.
card.flavor: "That Shinjo Hanari with his barbarian tricks! He thinks he understands what it means to be a samurai. I have a lesson or two to teach him about courage."

card.name: Hida Yakamo
card.text:
Crab Clan Hero • Samurai • Unique • No Items. Crab Hero is considered a distinct card from the Crab Oni for Uniqueness.
Battle: Bow Yakamo to destroy any one Item card in opposing army.
card.flavor: It is rumored a Dragon samurai-maiden took his hand with an ancient blade. - Kakita Yuri

card.name: Hida Yakamo Oni
card.text:
Crab Clan Oni • Shadowlands • Nonhuman • No Followers. May not Focus.
Oni gains a 1F/1C bonus for each Crab Personality you control. Crab Oni cannot be committed to an Attacking or Defending Army that has other units. No other unit may be committed to the Oni's Army.
card.flavor: A pact was made, blood was spilled and a name was stolen. Now, two destinies are as one.

card.name: Hisa
card.text: Unaligned Samurai
card.flavor: Do not be wary of men who take risks with titles and lands, be wary of men who have nothing to lose. - The Tao of Shinsei

card.name: Honorable Seppuku
card.text: Political Reaction: Play this card after one of your Samurai creates, is targeted by, or is affected by an effect that dishonors him or her or causes you to lose Honor. Lower the loss (if any) to 0, the Samurai commits seppuku, and then you gain an amount of Honor equal to the Samurai's Personal Honor.
card.flavor: "I heard my orders. I also heard Leshanu's orders." - Moshi Keika

card.name: Horiuchi Shoan
card.text: Unicorn Clan Shugenja • Cavalry
card.flavor: "She was a simple girl, and when the wars came, her family was one of its first casualties." - Ide Tadaji

card.name: Hurricane
card.text: Starting with you and going clockwise, each player destroys a Holding of the player to his or her right.
card.flavor: "The storms rage against him. Osano-Wo ignores him. The traitor leads his own to destruction; we only clear the path ahead." - Bayushi Yojiro

card.name: Iaijutsu Challenge
card.text: Limited: One of your Personalities challenges another player's Personality. If the challenge is refused, Iaijutsu Challenge dishonors the other player's Personality and causes the other player to lose 7 Honor. The winner's controller gains 5 Honor.

card.name: Iaijutsu Duel
card.text: Battle: A Personality in your army issues an unrefusable challenge to an opposing Personality. You need not control either Personality. If the Personality in your army is not yours and the challenge gains a cost, the controller of the Personality may choose to not pay the cost and send this card back to your hand. The winner's controller gains 5 Honor.

card.name: Ide Tadaji
card.text:
Unicorn Clan Diplomat • Unique • May not challenge or be assigned to attack or defend.
Political Reaction: Bow when the Imperial Favor is used. The Favor's effect is negated, but the Favor is still discarded.

card.name: Ikoma Ujiaki
card.text:
Lion Clan Samurai
Political Reaction: After a Lion Clan Personality is killed in battle, bow to dishonor a Personality in the opposing army.
card.flavor: He who raises his hand against a Lion raises his hand against the Emperor.

card.name: Immortal Steel
card.text: Limited: Bow this Shugenja and destroy this spell. Target weapon has all Force and Chi bonuses doubled for the rest of the game. Only one Immortal Steel can affect a weapon. If the weapon's bonuses change, refigure the doubled amount.
card.flavor: I saw the Shugenja's lips moving across his sword with gentle kisses and the samurai looked up to me with a hungry grin. - Hida Tampako

card.name: Imperial Acrobats
card.text:
Bow to provide 2 Gold and 1 Honor.
Limited: Bow to gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: Hosting the troupe brought many dignitaries to our court, and it is always wise to entertain your enemy just before you launch your attack.

card.name: Imperial Quest
card.text: Target a Personality with more than 2 Chi. Bow that Personality, who may remain bowed by his controller. Until the Personality straightens or leaves play, the Personality's controller gains 2 Honor each time he chooses not to straighten the Personality during his Straighten Phase. Dishonor the Personality if he straightens before his controller's third Straighten Phase from now.

card.name: Inheritance
card.text: Inheritance produces 5 Gold to put a single card into play. Inheritance is then destroyed. Inheritance is destroyed at the end of the turn if unused.

card.name: Intersecting Highways
card.text:
Battle: Terrain
All allied Personalities in this Battle gain a 2F bonus until the end of the turn.
card.flavor: "Do not allow yourself to become isolated, for here, your enemy can call for allies to crush you." - Master Suana

card.name: Iris Festival
card.text: All Shadowlands cards in play are destroyed.
card.flavor: A splinter of light can burst through the darkest coulds, and hope can bring victory to the lost.

card.name: Isawa Kaede
card.text:
Phoenix Clan Shugenja. Master of the Void.
Open Elemental: Bow this card and discard a card from one of your Provinces. Replace the discarded card. Draw a card from your Fate Deck.

card.name: Isawa Tadaka
card.text:
Phoenix Clan Shugenja • Master of Earth
Open Elemental: Bow Tadaka and discard a Fate Card. All Provinces you control gain a bonus to their strength equal to the focus of the discard until the end of the turn.
card.flavor: "No one understands the Shadowlands as does Tadaka. It is said the mask he wears hides a scar from that blackened land." - Shiba Katsuda

card.name: Isawa Tomo
card.text:
Phoenix Clan Shugenja • Master of Water
Battle Elemental: Bow this card to move a unit from one of the Defender's Provinces to another.
card.flavor: "His training was not in battle, but it is as if he has a fundamental understanding of tactics and strategy." - Shiba Tsukune

card.name: Isawa Tsuke
card.text:
Phoenix Clan Shugenja • Master of Fire • Unique
Limited Elemental: Bow and play a Fate card face down. Issue a Challenge that cannot be refused. Isawa cannot focus, but the Fate card played acts as a Focus. Tsuke cannot be killed by the outcome of the duel.

card.name: Isawa Uona
card.text:
Phoenix Clan Shugenja • Master of Air
Open Elemental: Bow the Master of Air and discard a Fate card with a Focus Value of X. Look at X face down cards.
card.flavor: "She is naive, but talented. As the youngest of the Elemental Masters, she will no doubt bring a fresh outlook to the Council of Five." - Isawa Tomo

card.name: Iuchi Daiyu
card.text:
Unicorn Clan Shugenja • Cavalry
Cards in this unit cannot be the target of ranged attacks.
card.flavor: "They seemed invulnerable to our archers as they continued their charge, and their horsemen cut down our samurai as if they were standing still." - Matsu Gohei

card.name: Iuchi Karasu
card.text:
Unicorn Clan Shugenja
Open: Bow Iuchi Karasu. Move a Follower from one of your Personalities and attach it to another of your Personalities.
card.flavor: Battered and broken, his flesh torn into ribbons, Karasu awoke from the nightmare with a single thought: Fate must be destroyed.

card.name: Iuchi Takaai
card.text:
Unicorn Clan Shugenja
Open: Bow this card to give all cards in a target unit the Cavalry trait until the end of the turn.
card.flavor: "His knowledge of barbarian magics has made him an unpredictable asset on the battlefield." - Shinjo Yokatsu

card.name: Jade Bow
card.text:
Weapon
Battle: Bow this Personality for a Ranged 4 Attack.
card.flavor: "The sword is the soul. The sword is all. So is there honor in killing from afar? Perhaps, but only if the bow has its own honor, its own spirit that lends grace to the shot." - Kakita's The Sword

card.name: Kakita Toshimoko
card.text:
Crane Clan Iaijutsu Master • Unique • Samurai • May not refuse a duel. Lose 5 Honor if Toshimoko loses a duel.
Limited: Bow to challenge any samurai to a duel. If refused, samurai is dishonored.
card.flavor: "For the coward, there if no life. For the hero, there is no death."

card.name: Kakita Yinobu
card.text:
Crane Clan Master Orator
Political Reaction: Bow this card and discard a Fate card or cards to reduce any loss of Family Honor by the Focus Value of the discarded card(s). This effect will not prevent a Personality from becoming dishonored. You may not discard cards once the Honor Loss has been reduced to zero.

card.name: Kakita Yoshi
card.text:
Crane Clan Liason • No Followers. May not Challenge or be assigned to defend.
Open Political: Bow to take the Imperial Favor.
card.flavor: "With all the secrets he knows, it would not surprise me if he had a bit of Scorpion blood in his veins."

card.name: Kakita Yuri
card.text:
Crane Clan Negotiator
Political Battle: Bow the Negotiator to send home unbowed one unit that is attacking you. You must pay gold equal to the Force of the unit.
card.flavor: "When your gold runs dry, Crane, we'll find out what kind of mettle you're made of." - Matsu Gohei

card.name: Ki-Rin
card.text:
Unaligned Creature • Unique
While Ki-Rin is unbowed and honorable, Personalities with a Personal Honor of zero, four, or five cannot assign or move into armies attacking your Provinces.

card.name: Kitsu Toju
card.text:
Lion Clan Shugenja
Limited: Bow and discard a card from your Fate hand to gain Honor equal to Focus Value of discard.
card.flavor: "What are you willing to sacrifice for victory, samurai?"

card.name: Kitsuki Yasu
card.text:
Dragon Clan Justicator • Samurai
Political Reaction: Bow Kitsuki Yasu when a Samurai is challenged. Force the Samurai to accept the challenge.
card.flavor: The greatest irony of all: his "evidence" may have saved the Scorpion from destruction.

card.name: Kolat Assassin
card.text:
Limited: Destroy a Personality with under 5 Chi. Lose 4 Honor.
Limited: Destroy a Retainer. Lose 4 Honor.

card.name: Kolat Infiltrator
card.text: Reaction: Play immediately after any holding has been bowed to negate the effects of that holding.
card.flavor: "But I was certain Lord Doji's gift was in my pouch! Where can it be?" - A courier's last words.

card.name: Kolat Master
card.text: Limited: Take control of another player's Personality with under 4 Chi for the rest of the game. Destroy each of the Personality's Followers with an Honor requirement over 0. Lose 4 Honor.
card.flavor: With proper preparation, anyone can be... anyone.

card.name: Kolat Servant
card.text:
Unaligned
Limited: Bow the Servant and target a Stronghold. Bow the Stronghold, if unbowed. As long as this card remains bowed, the target Stronghold may not straighten. Kolat Servant may remain bowed.

card.name: Kuni Yori
card.text:
Crab Clan Shugenja
Limited: Bow Kuni Yori and discard a Fate card. Force an opponent to randomly discard a card from his or her Fate hand.
card.flavor: Nature is neither friend no foe; it takes what blood you offer, then vanishes.

card.name: Kyoso no Oni
card.text:
Oni • Nonhuman • Shadowlands
Lose 3 Honor.
Cannot attach Followers or Items.
After Kyoso enters play: Destroy one of your Holdings.
Battle: Bow Kyoso: Ranged 7 Attack.

card.name: Lesser Mujina
card.text: Creature • Cavalry • Lose 1 Honor.
card.flavor: The mujina forced into the Empire by the surge from the deep Shadowlands are far more malicious than their weaker cousins. The only consolation is that they can be cut with a sword. Sometimes.

card.name: Look into the Void
card.text: Elemental Open: Bow this Shugenja and discard a card from your hand to draw a Fate card.

card.name: Market Place
card.text:
Bow to produce 2 Gold.
If Market Place is controlled by a Crane Clan player, it produces 3 Gold when bowed.
card.flavor: It is not the hand of a courtier that guides the Crane now, but the iron gauntlet of a warrior.

card.name: Marries a Barbarian
card.text: Limited: Dishonor a Samurai.

card.name: Marsh Troll
card.text:
Shadowlands Creature
During your endphase, Marsh Troll destroys (devours) one other card in its unit (your choice). If the Troll devours its attached Personality, the player to your right may attach him to one of his Personalities. If declined, the next player to the right may attach the Troll, and so on. If no player wants the Troll, it is destroyed.

card.name: Martyr
card.text: Reaction: Play this card after the death of your Personality, targeting the card that destroyed him or her. That card's controller loses 5 Honor. In a battle, the target may be any Personality in the opposing army.

card.name: Mask of the Oni
card.text: Open: Bow the Mask to give the attached Personality the ability to perform any one action that an Oni in play can perform, until the end of the turn. Lose 1 Honor.
card.flavor: Her face twisted as her laughter rang out like brass bells from behind purest porcelain.

card.name: Master of the Tea Ceremony
card.text:
Retainer.
Reaction: Before you lose Honor, bow the Master of the Tea Ceremony to lower the loss to 1.

card.name: Master Smith
card.text:
Retainer
