Bow the Master Smith to produce 3 Gold.
Limited: Bow the Master Smith. Place a +2F/+2C Weapon token on a Personality. No Personality can have more than one Weapon token at any time. This token is considered a Weapon and an Item.

card.name: Matsu Agetoki
card.text:
Lion Clan Samurai • Cavalry
This unit cannot be the target of ranged attacks.
card.flavor: "I laugh at the man who fears death! I laugh at the man who does not live to feel the wind in his hair and the scents of battle all around him! I was born a Lion, and by the Fortunes, I will die like one!"

card.name: Matsu Gohei
card.text:
Lion Clan Samurai
Gains a 2F bonus when attacking.
card.flavor: He who questions my courage will watch my army destroy his homeland as he feels my steel rip his heart.

card.name: Matsu Hiroru
card.text:
Ninja Assassin • Only Ninja Followers.
Limited: Bow to challenge a bowed Personality, who may not refuse. Ninja Assassin may focus once before the duel. Lose 4 Honor.
Limited: Destroy any one bowed Retainer. Lose 4 Honor.

card.name: Matsu Imura
card.text:
Lion Clan Beastmaster
Limited: Bow to train a new animal, adding a 1F token creature Follower to Beastmaster.
Limited: Bow to take control of any creature Follower in play with a Force of 3 or less. Target Follower becomes attached to the Beastmaster.

card.name: Matsu Tsuko
card.text:
Lion Clan Champion • Samurai • Unique • Double Chi • Tactician
Will only join Lion Clan Player.
card.flavor: "There is no loyalty but to the Emperor. There is no honor but to die in his name."

card.name: Matsu Yojo
card.text: Lion Clan Samurai
card.flavor: He remembers their fallen Champion's last words: "So is the doom of mortal man, that he cannot see his true enemy, even when he puts his head in its jaws..."

card.name: Meditation
card.text: Limited: Give a Personality +1F/+2C.

card.name: Mercy
card.text: Reaction: Play during the resolution phase of any combat that you have won. The opposing army is not destroyed, and you gain 3 Honor for each card spared. The Defender's Province may still be destroyed normally.

card.name: Mirumoto Daini
card.text: Dragon Clan Samurai
card.flavor: "Beneath the shadow of the mountains, my brother looks up at the stars, certain that his destiny lies among them. But what fate can save him from himself?" - Hitomi

card.name: Mirumoto Hitomi
card.text: Dragon Clan Samurai • Toturi's Army • Followers in this unit are immune to Fear.
card.flavor: "With her brother's sword in her hand and vengeance beating in her heart, she entered the war with one purpose. She ended the war with another..." - A Chronicle of the War, Volume I

card.name: Mirumoto Sukune
card.text:
Dragon Clan Samurai • Cavalry
Battle: Bow Mirumoto Sukune for a Ranged 3 Attack.
card.flavor: "Your will must guide us, my Lady Champion. Your soul, and yours alone..."

card.name: Mists of Illusion
card.text: Open: Bow this Shugenja to add 5F to one Personality you control until the end of the turn. Opposing units and Provinces cannot be destroyed by an army containing this Personality when Mists of Illusion is used.
card.flavor: "What you see if not half as important as showing you what I want you to see." - Bayushi Kachiko

card.name: Miya Yoto
card.text:
Unaligned Arbitrator
Battle: Bow this card to bow and remove any unit from a battle. This action may only be performed for a battle in which you have no units and are not the Defender.
card.flavor: The Art of War is the way of preserving Peace. - Sun Tzu

card.name: Moat
card.text:
Fortification.
Each Personality and Follower has -1F while attacking this Province.

card.name: Morito Tokei
card.text: Unaligned Shugenja • Toturi's Army
card.flavor: Also once a Unicorn, he followed his brother after his banishment, and has nothing but dark curses to say about the Otaku battle maiden.

card.name: Moshi Wakiza
card.text:
Centipede Clan Shugenja • Yoritomo's Alliance
Battle: Bow Moshi Wakiza for a Ranged 4 Attack.
card.flavor: She has traded her freedom for the Mantis Isles and her brother's name for a ring of gold. But she has not forgotten how to fight...

card.name: Moto Tsume
card.text:
Unaligned Samurai • Shadowlands • Lose 4 Honor. Will not enter play if your Family Honor is above zero.
Any Personality with Personal Honor greater than one and assigned to the same army is bowed before the battle action phase.

card.name: Naga Bowmen
card.text:
Naga
Battle: Bow the Naga Bowmen for a Ranged 3 Attack.
card.flavor: "The Crab cheered, rallying beside the forces of the Qamar as the bowemen cut a wide swath in the dark horde." - from Daini's Tale, vol. III

card.name: Naga Bushi
card.text: Naga
card.flavor: "The Naga have no care for the concept of Bushido. Their warriors are not samurai, and they have no thought of honor beyond what their Qamar commands. They are a perfect ally for the Crab." - Otaku Kamoko

card.name: Naga Shugenja
card.text:
Shugenja • Nonhuman
Open: Bow the Naga Shugenja to give a 1F bonus to all Naga cards in play until the end of the turn.
card.flavor: "Among the Naga, the Cobra shugenjas weave spells of pearl and jade. Their bodies may be twisted with mutation, but their souls are pure." - The Daini

card.name: Naga Spearmen
card.text:
Naga
Battle: Bow the Naga Spearmen for a Ranged 2 Attack.
card.flavor: "They move in utter harmony and absolute unity. When one warrior falls, another steps forward to take his place. I could believe that creatures such as these were cut from a single piece of stone..." - Kaiu Suman

card.name: Naga Warlord
card.text:
Naga Samurai • Nonhuman
All other Naga cards in the Naga Warlord's unit have a 1F bonus while they remain in his unit.
card.flavor: "It is the duty of my soul to see you die, Dragon. And if I cannot kill you in this life, then I will return a thousand times to see you fall."

card.name: Naka Kuro
card.text:
Unaligned Shugenja • Unique • Toturi's Army • Grand Master of the Elements
Reaction Elemental: Bow Naka Kuro during the appropriate phase to produce any Elemental action on any card in play. Naka Kuro can only duplicate once any Spell that must be discarded.
Reaction: Bow Naka Kuro. Negate any one Elemental effect.

card.name: Necromancer
card.text:
Unaligned Shugenja • Shadowlands • Lose 3 Honor.
Necromancer gains 1F for each Shadowlands Follower attached to him.
Limited: Bow to put a Shadowlands Follower into play attached to Necromancer (without gold cost).

card.name: Night Medallion
card.text:
Unique • The Night Medallion can only be attached to a Kolat or Ninja.
The Night Medallion adds +2 to every numeral printed on this Personality's card. This bonus does not apply to copied abilities.
card.flavor: I am the source of your fear, the cause of your hatred. Let your spirit go, Hiroru, and it will come to me.

card.name: Ninja Genin
card.text: Ninja
card.flavor: "Where it is light, we cannot be found. Where the shadows do not go, we live, and where the darkness ends, there is the heart of the ninja."

card.name: Ninja Spy
card.text:
Unaligned Ninja. Followers the Ninja Spy attaches must Ninja.
Open: Bow the Ninja Spy to look at a player's hand. Lose 1 Honor.
Open: Bow the Ninja Spy to look at all face-down cards in a player's Provinces. Lose 1 Honor.

card.name: Ninja Stronghold
card.text: Bow this card to put any Ninja card into play without gold cost. Variable cost cards may not be paid for in this manner.
card.flavor: "They are nothing more than an excuse for incompetent bodyguards and peasant superstition. There are no ninja, and I will hear nothing more on the matter." - Akodo Kage

card.name: Ninja Thief
card.text: Limited: Move an Item from one Personality to another. Lose 3 Honor.

card.name: Occult Murders
card.text: Beginning with you and proceeding in turn order, each player destroys a Personality or Retainer of the player to his right.

card.name: Occupied Terrain
card.text:
Battle: Terrain
During the resolution phase, if the Defender's Province is being destroyed, the Attacking Player may select one of the Defender's holdings which is destroyed instead of the Province.

card.name: Oni no Akuma
card.text:
Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Unique • Lose 3 Honor.
When Oni no Akuma is brought into play, it destroys the Province in which it appeared.
card.flavor: "Its flesh is marred and leathery, and it has three malevolent eyes striking terror into the soul." - from The Journal of Kuni Mokuna

card.name: Oni no Shikibu
card.text:
Unaligned • Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Destroy one of your other Personalities the first time this card is put into play.
In your Dynasty Phase, if this card is Honorable or Dishonorable Dead, you may bring it back into play, losing 2 Honor.

card.name: Tsuburu no Oni
card.text:
Oni • Nonhuman • Shadowlands • Cavalry
Lose 5 Honor. Destroy one of your Personalities as an additional cost of bringing Tsuburu into play.
Can not attach Followers or Armor.
After a battle's Combat Segment ends, if Tsuburu is at its battlefield and there are no defending units there: Give Tsuburu +6F.

card.name: Oracle of Earth
card.text:
Retainer. Unique.
Elemental Battle: Bow the Oracle of Earth and pay 1 Gold to play a Terrain, which destroys any Terrain Card in play and cannot be destroyed.

card.name: Oracle of Fire
card.text:
Retainer. Unique.
Elemental Reaction: Before a duel begins, if your Personality can focus, bow the Oracle of Fire and pay 1 Gold to play your Fate deck's top card as an extra Focus card.

card.name: Oracle of Water
card.text:
Retainer. Unique.
Elemental Battle: Bow the Oracle of Water and pay 1 Gold to move a unit from your home into this battle.

card.name: Oracle of Wind
card.text:
Retainer. Unique.
Elemental Open: Pay any amount of Gold to look at an equal number of face-down cards.

card.name: Otaku Kamoko
card.text: Unicorn Clan Battle Maiden • Samurai • Cavalry • Otaku Kamoko will only attach Cavalry Followers. Kamoko gains a 1F bonus when attacking.
card.flavor: Alone and despondent, the Mistress of the South Wind still seeks the truth of her mother's death. But while she searches, a thousand Unicorn die on Matsu spears...

card.name: Outflank
card.text: Battle: Give a defending Personality +3F.

card.name: Pearl Divers
card.text:
Retainer.
Bow Pearl Divers to produce 1 Gold, plus 1 Gold for each Port in play.

card.name: Peasant Revolt
card.text: Each Personality and Follower with over 2 Force bows. No Personality or Follower with over 2 Force can straighten before your next turn.

card.name: Personal Champion
card.text: Reaction: When a Personality challenges the Personal Champion's Personality, bow the Personal Champion to have him duel instead of his Personality. The Personal Champion has 3 Chi for dueling and counts as a Personality during the duel.

card.name: Plague
card.text: All Followers in play with 3F or less are destroyed.
card.flavor: Their tongues turned black ad their eyes boiled white. The quiet companion of war spares only a few.

card.name: Poisoned Weapon
card.text: Reaction: Play this card during a duel after players reveal Focus cards (if any) and before the duel resolves. Lower the Chi of the other player's Personality by 3. (If a Personality in a duel is destroyed before the duel resolves, the duel ends without resolution.) Lose 4 Honor. This action does not target the Personality.

card.name: Port
card.text: Bow the Port to produce 2 Gold, plus 1 Gold for each Marketplace in play.

card.name: Proposal of Peace
card.text: Until the beginning of your second turn from now, negate all Honor gains for bringing Personalities into play.

card.name: Rally Troops
card.text: Reaction: When one of your Personalities is about to be destroyed, move all of that Personality's Followers to any other Personality or Personalities (bowed or unbowed) you control who are not assigned to a battle this turn.

card.name: Rallying Cry
card.text: Reaction: Play this card after a Resolution Segment. Your units in the battle do not become bowed by the combat.

card.name: Ratling Bushi
card.text:
Creature
Ratling Bushi gains +1F for each Ratling Pack in this unit.

card.name: Ratling Pack
card.text: Ratling. Creature.

card.name: Reflective Pool
card.text: Open Elemental: Bow this Shugenja and destroy this spell to give one of your target Personalities the ability to perform an action that copies any action on any Personality in play. This ability goes away at the end of the turn.

card.name: Refuse Advantage
card.text: Battle: You may only play this card as the Attacker or Defender when your army is facing an army (with units) with a lower total Force than your army's total Force. Apply a penalty until the end of the battle to your Army's Force sufficient to reduce the Force total of your Army to equal that of the opposing army. You gain 8 additional Honor if you win the battle.

card.name: Remorseful Seppuku
card.text: Limited: Make a Dishonored Samurai commit seppuku.

card.name: Retired General
card.text:
Retainer.
Open: Bow the Retired General to give a Personality +2F.

card.name: Retreat
card.text:
Battle: Any one of your units is removed from this battle bowed. The Personality is dishonored if your army had a higher total Force when this card was played.
This action can target a bowed Personality.

card.name: Rise of the Phoenix
card.text: Starting with you and going clockwise, each player may return one of his or her Honorable Dead Personalities to play, waving all costs.

card.name: Sacrificial Altar
card.text: Bow the Sacrificial Altar and destroy one of your Personalities or Followers to produce an amount of Gold equal to twice the Personality's or Follower's Force. Lose an amount of Honor equal to the Personality's or Follower's Force.

card.name: Sake Works
card.text:
Bow to produce 2 Gold.
Limited: Bow Sake Works and one of your Personalities to bow any one Personality with Personal Honor less than 2.
card.flavor: "The regard samurai hold for temperance is one I will never understand." - Bayushi Kachiko

card.name: Samurai Cavalry
card.text:
Cavalry
Battle: Bow the Samurai Cavalry for a Ranged 3 Attack.
card.flavor: "If you stand against us, you stand against Emperor Toturi, and there is nothing we would not do to avenge such an insult." - Shinjo Yokatsu

card.name: Samurai Warriors
card.text:
Samurai.
Battle: Bow Samurai Warriors for a Ranged 3 Attack.

card.name: Sanctified Temple
card.text:
Bow Sanctified Temple to produce 2 Gold.
Limited: Bow Sanctified Temple and pay 2 Gold to gain 2 Honor.

card.name: Sanzo
card.text: Unaligned Samurai • Cavalry
card.flavor: "His eyes shone with a dark light, and his face was drawn and pale. I fear he may have found what he was searching for..." - Isawa Norikazu

card.name: Scribe
card.text:
Scribe can only be attached to a Shugenja.
Reaction: Bow Scribe and pay the gold cost of any spell as it is being destroyed to attach that spell to the Scribe's unbowed Shugenja rather than destroying it. This may only be done once per spell per Scribe.

card.name: Shadow Samurai
card.text:
Shadowlands • Nonhuman
When brought into play, the Force of Shadow Samurai is set equal to the Force of the first Honorable Dead Samurai from the top of your discard pile. This value will not change after the Shadow Samurai is brought into play. If at any time you have no Honorable Dead, Shadow Samurai is destroyed.

card.name: Shady Dealings
card.text: Reaction: Play when you are putting a Fate card into play to produce 5 gold. Bow your Stronghold if it is unbowed. Your Stronghold may not straighten until, as a Limited Action, you produce 5G to "repay", and destroy this card.

card.name: Shame
card.text: Political Limited: Target a dishonored Personality. That Personality's controller loses 7 Honor. No more copies of Shame may target that Personality until he is restored to honor and dishonored again.

card.name: Shiba Katsuda
card.text: Phoenix Clan Samurai
card.flavor: His uncle was Champion before Ujimitsu, and he has recognized a familiar light in the current Champion's eyes when his gaze falls upon him...

card.name: Shiba Tsukune
card.text:
Phoenix Clan Samurai.
Reaction: When Tsukune enters a duel with a Shugenja, she gains +3C.

card.name: Shiba Ujimitsu
card.text: Phoenix Clan Champion • Samurai • Double Chi • Will only join Phoenix player. During your Dynasty Phase, if this card is Honorable Dead, it may be returned to play without cost by exchanging it with a Personality you control. Ujimitsu keeps all attached cards, tokens and permanent changes of the replaced Personality. That Personality is discarded from play.
card.flavor: "Be strong, be wise. Know that even though I may fall, I will rise again to stand beside you."

card.name: Shinjo Hanari
card.text:
Unicorn Clan Samurai • Cavalry
Battle: Bow for Ranged 3 Attack.
card.flavor: "Hida Tsuru thinks he has something to teach me about courage, eh? Well, I do not need tricks to teach him a thing or two about honor."

card.name: Shinjo Yasamura
card.text:
Unicorn Clan Samurai • Cavalry
Open: Once per turn, he can give one Follower in this unit the Cavalry trait until the end of the turn.
card.flavor: "I saw him there with the golden horizon behind him, and I knew our armies would suffer a terrible fate that day."

card.name: Shinjo Yokatsu
card.text:
Unicorn Clan Champion • Unique • Samurai • Cavalry • Tactician
Shinjo Yokatsu will only join a Unicorn player. All Followers in this unit are considered Cavalry.
card.flavor: Toshimoko doubted the testimony we brought forward, favoring the "evidence" of the Kitsuki. If he wants a traitor, we shall find one for him.

card.name: Shuriken of Serpents
card.text: Battle: Bow and destroy the Shuriken of Serpents for a Ranged 6 Attack.
card.flavor: She lifted her hand, and I saw it, writhing and hissing from her fingertips. As it sprang toward my throat, I heard her whisper, "Too late, my friend. And you were so very close..."

card.name: Shuten Doji
card.text:
Unaligned Shadowlands • Nonhuman
Shuten Doji enters play with four 1F/1C tokens. During your events phase, Shuten Doji must "eat" (destroy) one token on any other card in play, which becomes a 1F/1C token on Shuten Doji. If none are available, the Shuten Doji loses 3 tokens.

card.name: Solar Eclipse
card.text: Negate any current effects of Spells and innate abilities. Shugenja cannot cast Spells or use innate abilities until your next turn.

card.name: Spirit Guide
card.text: Open: If this Personality is a Shugenja, bow Spirit Guide to straighten this Personality.

card.name: The Star of Laramun
card.text: While the Star of Laramun is attached, this Personality gains the trait Double Chi.
card.flavor: The Unicorn brought it from the Burning Sands long ago, but I fear we have not yet seen its full potential.

card.name: Summon Faeries
card.text: Open: Bow this Shugenja to bow (if necessary) a target Shugenja. If the Shugenja using Summon Faeries is a Phoenix Personality, then the target Shugenja does not straighten during that player's next straighten phase.

card.name: Mirumoto Sensei
card.text:
Dragon Clan Sensei
After each time a Weapon attaches to a Dragon Clan Samurai you control with no Weapons, attach a +0F/+0C Wakizashi Weapon Item token to him, ignoring restrictions.
Battle: Once per battle, target and bow two Weapons attached to a Samurai you control: Target a Personality opposing the Samurai. Your Samurai issues him an unrefusable challenge.

card.name: Temple of the Ancestors
card.text: Limited: Bow the temple and one of your Personalities with a Personal Honor greater than two to gain 3 Honor.
card.flavor: "I have borrowed my name from my ancestors. I must return it to them untarnished." - Matsu Daidu

card.name: Oni no Byoki
card.text:
Nonhuman. Shadowlands. Lose 3 Honor.
Battle: Twice per battle, place a -1C Plague token on a Personality in this battle without a Plague token.

card.name: Test of Honor
card.text: Political Limited: Target a Human Personality. Discard the top card of his controller's Fate deck. If that card's Focus value is greater than the target's Personal Honor, Dishonor and destroy the target.

card.name: Test of Stone
card.text: One of your Personalities issues an unrefuseable challenge to another player's Personality. The winner's controller gains 4 Honor. Dishonor the loser.

card.name: Test of the Emerald Champion
card.text: Target one of your Personalities. Each other player, in turn order, may target one of his Personalities; your Personality challenges each of them immediately after they are targeted. Each duel's winner gains 3 Honor; destroy the loser. If you lose none of these duels, remove your Personality from the game and gain a province to the left of your leftmost province.

card.name: The Deafening War Drums of Fu Leng
card.text:
Unique
Deafening War Drums give the attached Personality a 2F bonus for every Fu Leng card in this unit.
Battle: Fear 3.
card.flavor: We heard thunder from over the hills, and laughter from the mouths of dead men.

card.name: The Demon Bride of Fu Leng
card.text:
Unaligned • Unique • Shadowlands • Nonhuman
Limited: Bow the Bride to take control of and attach any one Shadowlands Follower in play.
Battle: Fear 4.

card.name: The Egg of P'an Ku
card.text:
Unique.
Limited: Target a Personality, including a Unique Personality or one who will not join you. After entering play, this card becomes a copy of that Personality's printed card plus all permanent changes in effect on it. None of the Personality's costs need to be paid and no entering-play effects are produced.

card.name: Fist of Osano-Wo
card.text: Limited: Bow this Shugenja and destroy this card: Target a Holding. Destroy it.

card.name: The Jade Hand
card.text:
Unique
The Jade Hand may not be moved, stolen or destroyed. This Personality gains a 3F/2C bonus when opposed by any Shadowlands card in a battle or duel.
card.flavor: It signified the return of a hero who would rise up to redeem his Clan from their own deeds of darkness and corruption.

card.name: Togashi Hoshi
card.text: Unaligned Man-Beast • Creature • Unique • Cavalry • Togashi Hoshi can have no Followers or Armor. He will join a Monk player for 2 less gold. He will not commit during a Maneuvers Segment if a Dragon is already committed to the opposing army (this does not refer to Dragon Clan Personalities). Hoshi is considered a Dragon and is affected by all cards that affect Dragons.

card.name: Togashi Mitsu
card.text:
Dragon Clan Tattooed Man. Samurai. Monk. Toturi's Army.
Open: Gain up to five 1F/1C Fire tokens on Togashi Mitsu. He cannot have more than five Fire tokens and cannot straighten if he has any Fire tokens. Remove one Fire token instead of straightening him during the Straighten Phase. He bows after any battle he is in, if he has Fire tokens, as if he were an attacking Personality.

card.name: Togashi Yokuni
card.text: Dragon Clan Champion • Unique • Samurai • Shugenja • Double Chi • Will only join Dragon Clan Player.
card.flavor: Just before the beginning of the Clan War, Yokuni disappeared, leaving a disgraced ronin in charge of his armies...

card.name: Togashi Yoshi
card.text:
Dragon Clan Shugenja
Reaction: After a Personality you control has entered a duel, but before the first focus, you may bow Yoshi to draw and discard your top Fate Card. Add its Focus Value to that Personality's Chi until the end of the turn. This card is not considered a Focus.

card.name: Toku
card.text: Unaligned Samurai • Toturi's Army
card.flavor: "When ten thousand men clash with arms and fire, it is always a single man's actions that make the difference." - from The Tao of Shinsei

card.name: Torrential Rain
card.text: Battle Elemental: Bow this Shugenja and destroy this Spell to end this battle without resolution. All units go home bowed.

card.name: Toturi
card.text:
Unaligned Samurai • Double Chi • Unique • Toturi's Army • Lose 5 Honor. Toturi enters play dishonored. Will not join Crab, Phoenix, or Scorpion Clan.
Reaction: The first time Toturi is restored to honorable status, you gain 5 Honor, and Toturi gains a 2F/3C bonus permanently.
card.flavor: One must bow to offer aid to a fallen man.

card.name: Trade Route
card.text: Bow the Trade Route to produce 3 Gold, plus 2 Gold for each Marketplace in play.

card.name: Traversable Terrain
card.text: Battle Terrain: Move one of your units into this battle from the Province it is attacking or defending. You cannot play this card is you have no units in the battle.

card.name: Unexpected Allies
card.text: Starting with you and going clockwise, each player reveals his or her Dynasty deck's top card. If the card is a Personality, the player brings it into play, ignoring Honor requirements, waving the Gold cost, and negating entering-play effects. If the Card is not a Personality, the player discards it.

card.name: Unscalable Walls
card.text:
Fortification.
This Province gains +4 Strength while Unscalable Walls are attached.

card.name: Void Dragon
card.text:
Unaligned Creature • Shugenja • Cavalry • Unique
Cannot attach Followers or Items.
Once per turn, after an attacking army including Void Dragon destroys a Province during battle resolution, you may discard the Defender's hand.

card.name: Water Dragon
card.text:
Unaligned Creature • Shugenja • Cavalry • Unique
Cannot attach Followers or Items.
Elemental Reaction: During the Events Phase: Target a Shugenja and an ability on him. Water Dragon copies the ability until the turn ends.

card.name: Way of Deception
card.text: Battle: Switch the locations of two of your units led by unbowed Personalities. These units are not considered to be moving.

card.name: Wind Born Speed
card.text: Open: Bow this shugenja to give all cards in one unit the trait: Cavalry until the end of the turn.
card.flavor: "When the infantry charged, we found the spearmen were not on the crest of the hill, but to our flank, cutting down troops like wheat." - Doji Hoturi

card.name: Winds of Change
card.text: Elemental Limited: Bow this Shugenja to discard a Dynasty card in a Province and replace it with the top card of its player's Dynasty deck.

card.name: Wings of Fire
card.text: Open Elemental: Bow this Shugenja to give a target Follower or Personality the Cavalry trait until the end of the turn.
card.flavor: "Suddenly, the Crab forces burst into an unearthly fire... and they began to fly." - Otaku Kamoko

card.name: Yasuki Taka
card.text:
Crab Clan Wily Trader
Open: Bow Wily Trader and any one of your gold-producing holdings to straighten any holding in play.
card.flavor: Wily Trader is worth 1 Koku.

card.name: Yogo Junzo
card.text:
Unaligned Undead Shugenja • Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Lose 4 Honor.
Battle: Fear 4.
card.flavor: The guardian of the first Black Scroll has fallen prey to its corruptive power. Now he searches for the remaining scrolls... but for what purpose?

card.name: Yotsu Seiki
card.text:
Unaligned Shugenja
Battle: Bow for Ranged Attack equal to her Chi.
card.flavor: She stood alone against the approaching samurai, a smile playing delicately on her lips.

card.name: Charter of the Crab Clan
card.text:
Unique
Bow to produce 4 gold when bringing a Crab Personality into play.
This holding is destroyed immediately if you ever control a Shadowlands card.
card.flavor: Toturi stood before us, a crown of Jade upon his brow. "I say to the Crab, return to your ancient oaths and find what you have lost ...

card.name: Charter of the Crane Clan
card.text:
Unique
Bow to produce 4 gold when bringing a Crane Personality into play.
This holding is destroyed immediately if one of your gold-producing holdings is destroyed.
card.flavor: "... to the Crane, make good your promises to restore honor and wealth to the lands of Rokugan ...

card.name: Charter of the Dragon Clan
card.text:
Unique
Bow to produce 4 gold when bringing a Dragon Clan Personality into play.
This holding is destroyed immediately if you ever discard an elemental ring from your hand.
card.flavor: "... Dragon, seek your own ways, and renew your mysteries. Heal the wounds of the past ...

card.name: Charter of the Lion Clan
card.text:
Unique
Bow to produce 4 gold when bringing a Lion Personality into play.
This holding is destroyed immediately if one of your Provinces is destroyed in a battle.
card.flavor: "... and I bid the Clan of the Lion to defend Rokugan in battle against all enemies, near and far ...

card.name: Charter of the Mantis Clan
card.text:
Unique
Bow to produce 4 gold when bringing a Yoritomo's Alliance Personality into play.
This holding is destroyed immediately if any player ever has more Provinces than you do.
card.flavor: "... it shall be the duty of the Mantis to regent all disputes and troubles of the unaligned lands ...

card.name: Charter of the Phoenix Clan
card.text:
Unique
Bow to produce 4 gold when bringing a Phoenix Personality into play.
This holding is destroyed immediately if any player ever has more shugenja in play than you do.
card.flavor: "... to reclaim their magic, and to recover their lost knowledge, let the Phoenix be granted time to rebuild and grow strong again ...

card.name: Charter of the Scorpion Clan
card.text:
Unique
Bow to produce 4 gold when bringing a Scorpion Personality into play.
This holding is destroyed immediately if one of your ninja or kolat actions is canceled.
card.flavor: "... the duty of the Scorpion, to defend the Emperor from threats he cannot see ...

card.name: Charter of the Unicorn Clan
card.text:
Unique
Bow to produce 4 gold when bringing a Unicorn Personality into play.
This holding is destroyed immediately if at the beginning of one of your events phases there is a dishonored Personality in play who was dishonored before your previous events phase.
card.flavor: "... and the Unicorn shall be my eyes and ears, bringing justice and honor to all clans of the Empire." - The Coronation of Toturi I.

card.name: Charter of Toturi's Army
card.text:
Unique
Bow to produce 4 gold when bringing a Toturi's Army Personality into play.
This holding is destroyed immediately if a use of the Imperial Favor is ever canceled.
card.flavor: "... Swear your oaths to me, my valient friends, for I know your worth among men. The Emperor's house will be reborn..."

card.name: Treaty with the Naga
card.text:
Unique
Bow to produce 4 gold when bringing a Naga Personality into play.
This holding is destroyed immediately if your Family Honor is ever below negative five.
card.flavor: "... Our cousins of the Naga shall be recognized as a free and allied nation, welcomed within our borders and in our Imperial Court ...

card.name: Vows of the Brotherhood
card.text:
Unique
Bow to produce 4 gold when bringing a Monk Personality into play.
This holding is destroyed immediately if any player has more elemental rings in play than you.
card.flavor: "... Take the new Tao, gentle brothers, and learn its ways, that we all might prosper from its wisdom ...

card.name: Writings of Kuni Yori
card.text:
Unique • Shadowlands
Bow to produce 4 gold when bringing a Shadowlands Personality into play.
This holding is destroyed immediately if any player ever has more total Fear strength in play than you.
card.flavor: "Behold, dark cousins, all is not lost... gather together, and over the bodies of the living, we will restore the rule of the Dead..." - Kuni Yori's 'Oaths and Betrayals'

card.name: Ancestral Standard of the Crab
card.text:
Unique • May only be attached to a Crab Clan Personality • Followers in this army attached to a Crab Personality receive a +1F bonus. All opposing Crab Personalities get a -1F penalty.
Reaction: Bow when a Crab Personality is destroyed to move one follower from that unit and attach it to this Personality.

card.name: Ancestral Standard of the Crane
card.text:
Unique • May only be attached to a Crane Clan Personality • Followers in this army attached to a Crane Personality receive a +1F bonus. All opposing Crane Personalities get a -1F penalty.
Reaction: Bow when a Crane Personality is destroyed to move one follower from that unit and attach it to this Personality.

card.name: Ancestral Standard of the Dragon
card.text:
Unique • May only be attached to a Dragon Clan Personality • Followers in this army attached to a Dragon Personality receive a +1F bonus. All opposing Dragon Personalities get a -1F penalty.
Reaction: Bow when a Dragon Personality is destroyed to move one follower from that unit and attach it to this Personality.

card.name: Ancestral Standard of the Lion
card.text:
Unique • May only be attached to a Lion Clan Personality • Followers in this army attached to a Lion Personality receive a +1F bonus. All opposing Lion Personalities get a -1F penalty.
Reaction: Bow when a Lion Personality is destroyed to move one follower from that unit and attach it to this Personality.

card.name: Ancestral Standard of the Phoenix
card.text:
Unique • May only be attached to a Phoenix Clan Personality • Followers in this army attached to a Phoenix Personality receive a +1F bonus. All opposing Phoenix Personalities get a -1F penalty.
Reaction: Bow when a Phoenix Personality is destroyed to move one follower from that unit and attach it to this Personality.

card.name: Ancestral Standard of the Unicorn
card.text:
Unique • May only be attached to a Unicorn Clan Personality • Followers in this army attached to a Unicorn Personality receive a +1F bonus. All opposing Unicorn Personalities get a -1F penalty.
Reaction: Bow when a Unicorn Personality is destroyed to move one follower from that unit and attach it to this Personality.

card.name: Tetsuya's Bo
card.text:
Unique Weapon • Gain 2 Honor.
Battle: Bow Tetsuya's Bo. Target any one opposing Personality whose Chi is lower than the number of Monk Personalities in this army. Send the target Personality home bowed.
card.flavor: "When you believe you can do nothing, then all things are possible." - Hoshi Wayan

card.name: The Daidoji Yari
card.text:
Unique Weapon • Gain 2 Honor.
Battle: Bow The Daidoji Yari. Target any one opposing Personality whose Chi is lower than the number of Crane Personalities in this army. Send the target Personality home bowed.
card.flavor: The tear of a kami and the soul of the wind: these are the courage in the heart of the Daidoji blade.

card.name: The Hiruma Tetsubo
card.text:
Unique Weapon • Gain 2 Honor.
Battle: Bow The Hiruma Tetsubo. Target any one opposing Personality whose Chi is lower than the number of Crab Personalities in this army. Send the target Personality home bowed.
card.flavor: Solid stone and hammered steel, the tetsubo of the first Hida was given to his most trusted lieutenant.

card.name: The Ikoma Tessen
card.text:
Unique Weapon • Gain 2 Honor.
Battle: Bow The Ikoma Tessen. Target any one opposing Personality whose Chi is lower than the number of Lion Personalities in this army. Send the target Personality home bowed.
card.flavor: Torn from the stars with a battle cry, Akodo's wedding gift to his son is still borne by their children.

card.name: The Isawa Naginata
card.text:
Unique Weapon • Gain 2 Honor.
Battle: Bow The Isawa Naginata. Target any one opposing Personality whose Chi is lower than the number of Phoenix Personalities in this army. Send the target Personality home bowed.
card.flavor: "See how its balde shines like a piece of the Sun herself? That is no coincidence..." - Shiba Tetsu

card.name: The Isha's Yumi
card.text:
Unique Weapon • Gain 2 Honor.
Battle: Bow The Isha's Yumi. Target any one opposing Personality whose Chi is lower than the number of Naga Personalities in this army. Send the target Personality home bowed.
card.flavor: It belonged to the greatest of Naga heroes, the Qatol, who gave his life to the darkness between the stars.

card.name: The Kitsune Nagamaki
card.text:
Unique Weapon • Gain 2 Honor.
Battle: Bow The Kitsune Nagamaki. Target any one opposing Personality whose Chi is lower than the number of Yoritomo's Alliance Personalities in this army. Send the target Personality home bowed.
card.flavor: Made of glass and steel, it was forged by the son of Hantei a thousand years ago.

card.name: The Lost Ono Of Osano-Wo
card.text:
Unique Weapon • Shadowlands
Battle: Bow The Lost Ono of Osano-Wo. Target any one opposing Personality whose Chi is lower than the number of Shadowlands Personalities in this army. Send the target Personality home bowed.

card.name: The Mirumoto Wakizashi
card.text:

card.flavor: Forged from a dark jewel and a strange red ore, it was the last sword made by Togashi Nyoko.

card.name: The Otaku Nageyari
card.text:
Unique Weapon • Gain 2 Honor.

card.flavor: The Lady's daughter bore this yari across the desert sands, and now it bears her soul.

card.name: The Yogo Jitte
card.text:
Unique Weapon • Gain 2 Honor.
Battle: Bow The Yogo Jitte. Target any one opposing Personality whose Chi is lower than the number of Scorpion Personalities in this army. Send the target Personality home bowed.
card.flavor: Spiderweb and shadow, loss and pain: these are the steel of the Scorpion.

card.name: Toturi's Daisho
card.text:
Unique Weapon • Gain 2 Honor.
Battle: Bow Toturi's Daisho. Target any one opposing Personality whose Chi is lower than the number of Toturi's Army Personalities in this army. Send the target Personality home bowed.
card.flavor: "The Emperor may be dead, but his honor will live on forever." - Toku

card.name: Annexation

card.name: Dairya
card.text:
Unaligned Samurai • Unique • Cavalry • Toturi's Army
Battle: Bow for a Ranged 3 Attack.
card.flavor: You call me a masterless man. You are wrong. I am my own master.

card.name: Designer Wins
card.text: If your face appears on this card, then you win the game.
card.flavor: Lump it, Fanboy!

card.name: Duty of the Magistrate

card.text:
Crab Clan Shadow Samurai • Toturi's Army • Experienced • Unique • Won't join a player that has Shadowlands cards in play. Can't be sacrificed to the Terrible Standard of Fu Leng.

Battle: Sukune and an opposing Shadowlands card are both discarded from play.

card.name: Imperial Ambassador
card.text:
Retainer

card.flavor: He who speaks with anger will be heard for his anger, but his words will be forgotten.

card.name: Kachiko's Kiss
card.text: If this is the first time a Kachiko's Kiss resolved this game, lose 10 Honor, remove the Imperial Favor from the game, prevent Dark Lord's Favor from being played until the game ends, and shuffle this card into your deck instead of discarding it; otherwise, return the Favor to the game uncontrolled, and end the restriction against playing Dark Lord's Favor.

card.name: Motto Seiki
card.text:
Unaligned • Shugenja
Battle: Bow for a ranged attack equal to his Chi.

Naga • Nonhuman • Unique • Abomination has a Chi Value equal to the number of other Naga cards in play.

card.name: Seer

Retainer

card.name: Seppun Baka
card.text:
Unaligned Sycophant

card.name: Tao of Shinsei

card.name: Tattoo Madness

card.text:
Scorpion Clan Deceiver • Samurai • Unique • This card is considered to be the Egg of Pan Ku for Uniqueness • Will not join Crane Clan.
Limited: Bow to cause all Crane players to lose two honor.
card.flavor: "He is not you, my dearest Hoturi, he is better than you. But the others will believe he is you, and while I hold you here, he will be the doom of your Clan."

card.name: The Farther You Fall

card.flavor: "The higher you fly, my Lord, the farther you have to fall." - Bayushi Kachiko

card.text: Unaligned Shadowlands • Unique • Non-human • Lose 5 Honor. No Items. May not challenge or be challenged. The War Machine has Force = 0 if it has no Followers attached. The War Machine destroys all of its Followers when it bows. Followers add no Force to this Unit.

card.name: Time of the Void

card.name: A Samurai Never Stands Alone
card.text:
Delayed Terrain

card.flavor: "Kaneka draws honorable bushi to him much as his father did. Where will his destiny lie, I wonder: proving that he is his father's son or that he is his own man?" - Akodo Ijiasu

card.name: Agasha's Illusion
card.text:
May only be attached to a Dragon Shugenja.

card.name: Ancestral Sword of the Scorpion
card.text: Weapon • Unique • When controlled by a Scorpion Clan Personality, this sword gains a +1F/+1C bonus for every Scorpion Clan Personality you control. Any other Scorpion Clan players lose 6 honor when this item is brought into play for the first time.

card.name: Armor of Osano-Wo
card.text:
The Armor of Osano-Wo cannot be attached to a Shadowlands Personality. This Personality cannot be targeted with Black Scroll effects.
Elemental Reaction: Instead of destroying the Province that this Personality is attacking, you can put the Ring of Earth into play.

card.name: Arrival of the Unicorns

card.name: Bayushi Dozan
card.text:
Scorpion Clan Samurai

Scorpion Clan Champion • Samurai • Inexperienced • Tactician • Unique • Will only join Scorpion Clan.

card.name: Cavalry Raiders
card.text:
Cavalry
Battle: Bow for a Ranged 3 Attack. If this is a cavalry unit, you may then return this unit to your fief.

card.name: Daikua
card.text:
Mantis Clan Scout

The gold cost of this card is 2 for Scorpion players.

Fortification

Limited: Bow Hatsuko to look at one face-down card in a player's Province.

Scorpion Clan Shugenja • Cavalry
Open: Bow to bow any gold producing holding which causes an honor loss when bowed for gold.

card.name: The Exalted Ugu

Unaligned Nonhuman • Goblin Shaman • Shugenja • Shadowlands

card.name: The Secret Entrance
card.text: Reaction: Play immediately before any actions are performed in a battle action phase. card.text: Kiho Battle: Bow one of your Shugenja or Monks in this battle. Destroy any one Item in this battle with a Focus value less than the caster's Chi.

card.name: Toturi is Drugged
card.text: Ninja Open: If it is the Action Phase, discard cards with total combined Focus values greater than the target's Chi: Target a Personality. Lose 2 Honor. Bow the target.

card.name: War Wagon
card.text:

card.name: Yogo Shidachi
card.text:
Scorpion Clan Shugenja
Battle: Switch the positions of two of your unbowed Personalities. This can be done once per turn.

card.name: A Vision of Truth

card.name: Agasha Nabe
card.text:
Dragon Clan Shugenja
Battle: Destroy any token on Nabe to straighten him. This may be done once per battle.
card.flavor: As the armies of the Dragon marched on Shoju, he knew that even hopes of escape were fading into the setting sun.

card.name: Asahina Uojin
card.text:
Crane Clan Shugenja
Open: Bow to give a 2F/2C bonus to any Crane Personality.
card.flavor: Drawing from the souls of a thousand fallen Cranes, Uokin gave that strength to the men who charged into Shoju's army.

card.name: Bayushi Dairu
card.text:
Scorpion Clan Samurai • Unique
Battle: Bow Dairu to give a -1C venom token to any opposing Personality. While that Personality has any venom tokens, any time he performs any action, he gains an additional -1C venom token. card.flavor: Kachiko's son has her wits, but he has a Crane's eyes.

card.name: Bayushi House Guard

card.name: Bayushi Kyono
card.text:
Scorpion Clan Samurai
Reaction: Bow Kyono to cancel a use of the Tactician ability by an opposing Personality. The Tactician ability is considered to have been used for the turn.
card.flavor:
Hokitare said, "Shoju's prodigy Kyono is who we must be concerned with, my Lady."
Tsuko glared at him. "I fear no one, samurai."

card.name: Bayushi Yojiro
card.text:
Scorpion Clan Imperial Magistrate • Will not join a 'Shadow Stronghold of the Bayushi' Scorpion Clan player.
Has a 2F/2C bonus while you have the Imperial Favor.
card.flavor: His choice saved his life, but cost him his honor and his heritage.

card.name: Defenders of the Realm
card.text: Reaction: Play this card when one of your Provinces is about to be destroyed by an Event. No Provinces are destroyed by the Event.

card.name: Disloyalty
card.text: Limited: Destroy any one retainer in play. Lose 4 honor.
card.flavor: "Cut off the right arm and the left will be wholly occupied trying to stop the flow of blood." - from Bayushi's Lies

card.name: Doji Satsume
card.text:
Crane Clan Champion • Emerald Champion • Unique • Double chi • Will only join Crane player. May attach the Emerald Armor without gold cost.

card.name: Fury of the Earth
card.text:
Kiho Elemental Battle: Bow one of your Shugenja or Monks in this battle. Reduce this Province's Strength by the caster's Chi (to a minimum of 0).
Kiho Elemental Battle: Bow one of your Shugenja or Monks in this battle. Destroy a Fortification at this Province with a Gold cost equal to or less than the caster's Chi.

card.name: Gift of Fealty
card.text: Political Limited: Give control of one of your Personalities to another player, until the end of the game.
card.flavor: Though he is close to my heart, I will send him far to serve my cause.

card.name: Hasagawa
card.text:
Mantis Clan Samurai

card.flavor:
"He is a ronin, Shoju-sama," Dozan objected.
"If he carries a sword and will fight the Lion, I do not care what he is!"

card.name: Hida Matyu

Crab Clan Cartographer
