When the Porcelain Mask of Fu Leng is destroyed, destroy this Personality. During each of your Events Phases, remove a Porcelain token. When you remove the last Porcelain token, destroy the Porcelain Mask of Fu Leng.

card.name: Qamar
card.text:
Naga Champion • Unique • Nonhuman • Tactician • Will only join a Naga Clan player. This unit is immune to Fear.
Open: Bow to straighten any Naga Personality in play.
card.flavor: "I am not here to protect you. I am here for my people and my home, not your Throne."

card.name: Rampant Plague
card.text: All players give one -1C Plague token to one of their own Personalities and any one other Personality in play. During each of your Events Phases, all players must repeat this. A player may, during his Dynasty Phase, destroy all of his Personalities with Plague tokens and becomes immune to the plague. He cannot be the target of plague tokens this game. When all players are immune, the plague ends.

card.name: Ratling Conscripts
card.text:
Ratling Pack • Creature • Lose 1 Honor.
Reaction: If the Ratling Conscripts are on the winning side of a battle, place a 1F Experience token on them at the end of the Resolution Segment.

card.name: Ratling Scavenger
card.text:
Ratling • Creature
Items being attached to Ratling Scavenger cost 2 less Gold, to a minimum of 1.

card.name: Ratling Thief
card.text:
Unaligned Creature
Limited: Bow to challenge any Personality with an item card attached to a duel that cannot be refused. Designate a target item if there is more than one. If the Thief wins the duel, attach the item to the Thief. The loser of this duel does not die. Ratling Thief has +3C for this action.

card.name: Setsuban Festival
card.text: Destroy all tokens.

card.name: Shadowlands Madmen
card.text:
Shadowlands • Lose 3 Honor.
The Madmen add +1 to the strength of any Fear effect produced from this unit.
card.flavor: "Lord Doji assured me all was well when he left to speak to Lady Bayushi, but then returned with an army of madmen and burned down the Kakita palace." - Kakita Yoshi

card.name: Shadowmadness
card.text: Battle: Play on a unit that has both Shadowlands and non-Shadowlands Followers. The non-Shadowlands Followers have their Force doubled until the end of the turn, and are then destroyed.

card.name: Shagara
card.text:
Naga Bushi • Nonhuman
Battle: Bow for a Ranged 2 Attack.
card.flavor: "Lose your fear of them!" he called out to the Phoenix samurai. "They are not your ancestors, they are only dead men! Fight or we will be lost!"

card.name: Shapeshifting
card.text:
Black Scroll • Unique • Whenever this Shugenja straightens, give him a -1C Corruption token.
Limited: Bow this Shugenja to switch two base values on one of your Personalities. The switch can be any two of: Force, Chi, and Personal Honor. This change is permanent.
card.flavor:
When shadows loom, it is my time
To discover my doom, discover my rhyme

card.name: Shiba House Guard
card.text:
Unique. Only a Phoenix Clan Personality can attach the Shiba House Guard.
The Shiba House Guard's printed Force equals their Personality's Chi.

card.name: Shiba Tetsu
card.text:
Phoenix Clan Samurai
Battle: Shiba Tetsu gains a Force bonus equal to the Chi of any one Shugenja in his army. This may be done once per battle.
card.flavor: He was meant to be a shugenja, but the need of the Clan dictated his destiny.

card.name: Shinjo House Guard
card.text:
Cavalry. Unique. Only a Unicorn Clan Personality can attach the Shinjo House Guard.
Reaction: After the Cavalry Maneuvers Segment, if the Shinjo House Guard is the only Follower in this unit and their Personality has the Cavalry trait, assign this unit to attack or defend.

card.name: Shinjo Tsuburo
card.text:
Unicorn Clan Samurai • Cavalry
Reaction: Bow Tsuburo to redirect to himself a Ranged Attack that was originally targeting another card in this army. If the Ranged Attack is not strong enough to destroy him, it has no effect.

card.name: Shosuro Hametsu
card.text:
Scorpion Clan Poison Master
Limited: Bow to give a Personality a Poison token if they do not have one. Lose 2 Honor. A Personality with a Poison token may destroy it as a Reaction to entering a duel. When a strike is declared, the opposing Personality's Chi is reduced by 2 until the end of the turn.

card.name: Shosuro Taberu
card.text:
Scorpion Clan Manipulator
Political Reaction: Bow when a holding is bowed by another player in order to gain Honor. You gain the Honor instead.

card.name: Shosuro Tage
card.text:
Scorpion Clan Infiltrator • Unique
Open: This effect may only be taken during a Player's Action Phase. Target a Personality with a Chi of 3 or less controlled by the current player. This Personality must be assigned to attack an opposing Province this turn, if it is possible to do so when the Attack Phase occurs. Lose 2 Honor.

card.name: Skeletal Archers
card.text:
Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Lose 3 Honor.
Battle: Bow for a Ranged 3 Attack.
Battle: Fear 2.
card.flavor: "One wonders how they can be so accurate with no eyes or muscle to guide their aim." - Mirumoto Sukune

card.name: Soshi Bantaro
card.text:
Scorpion Clan Shugenja
Reaction: Bow to redirect any spell effect to himself for which he could be a legal target.
card.flavor: When his Lord fell, he was not strong enough to protect him. This time, his strength will have to be enough.

card.name: Stale Wind
card.text: Limited: Bow this Shugenja. All Personalities in play with a Personal Honor of less than two gain the trait: Shadowlands until the end of the turn.
card.flavor: This dark land is like a disease and it must be stopped. Your little prideful war will not stop it. Your honor will not stop it. Only working together can we stop it. - Lord Dashmar

card.name: Strike at the Tail
card.text: Battle: Bow one of your units to destroy a number of opposing Followers with total Force less than or equal to the Force your unit had before bowing. If a Unicorn Clan Personality leads your unit, the unit gains +2F for this effect.

card.name: Suspended Terrain
card.text:
Delayed Terrain
Battle: When the Resolution Segment for this battle ends, bow all units still in it. This bowing is not a result of battle and cannot be negated. These units cannot straighten during their controllers' next Straighten Phases.

card.name: Sympathetic Energies
card.text: Open: Bow this Shugenja to move a target token from one target Personality to another target Personality who can legally have it.

card.name: Temple of Bishamon
card.text:
You must have at least 5 Family Honor to bring the Temple of Bishamon into play.
Limited: Bow the Temple of Bishamon to gain 1 Honor.
Battle: Bow the Temple of Bishamon to bow a card with the Shadowlands trait attacking one of your Provinces. You may take this action during a battle in which you have no units.

card.name: Terrible Standard of Fu Leng
card.text:
Shadowlands • Unique • Lose 5 Honor. The Standard gains a +1F token for each opposing unit destroyed in the resolution phase of this battle.
Battle: Fear 2.
Limited: Once per game, destroy any Hida Sukune in play to give a +4F to the Standard until the end of the turn.

card.name: Test of Might
card.text: Battle: One of your Personalities issues an unrefusable challenge to an opposing Personality. This duel compares Force versus Force. The winner gains 3 Honor. Bow the loser.

card.name: Tetsubo
card.text:
Weapon
As a challenger in a duel, this Personality has the first option to focus or strike. This Personality has a -1C penalty while in a duel.
card.flavor: "So the Emerald Champion is dead? A pity. Perhaps a hammer will serve where a sword did not?" - Hida O-Ushi

card.name: The Falling Darkness
card.text: All Personalities have their Force reduced by their Personal Honor until the beginning of your next turn.
card.flavor: When darkness falls, the dark things feed on fear...

card.name: Festering Pit of Fu Leng
card.text:
Unique • Shadowlands
Reaction: When paying for a Shadowlands card, bow the Festering Pit of Fu Leng to lower the card's Gold cost by 5 until the turn ends. Lose 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "The eight kami who founded the Empire have long since departed, but their creations live on. Are you surprised, then, that the ninth Kami's creation lives on as well?" - Isawa Mitori

card.name: The Fire from Within
card.text:
Elemental Fire Battle: Bow this Shugenja: Produce two consecutive Ranged Attacks with strengths equal to the caster's Chi.
Elemental Fire Battle: Bow this Shugenja: Produce a Ranged Attack with strength equal to twice the caster's Chi.

card.name: The Hooded Ronin
card.text:
Unaligned Samurai • Unique • Ashigaru • The Hooded Ronin enters play bowed.
Limited: Bow to challenge any Samurai, or any Personality with the Shadowlands trait, to a duel. Shadowlands Personalities must accept. Samurai may refuse and be dishonored. Winner of this duel gains 4 Honor.

card.name: The Laughing Monk
card.text:
Unaligned Monk • No Followers or armor.
Limited: Bow to remove any one token from any Personality in play (with the consent of the Personality's controller).

card.name: The Nameless One
card.text:
Phoenix Clan Shugenja • Unique • Gains +2C when dueling a Shadowlands Personality.
Limited: Bow to challenge any Shadowlands Personality to a duel which cannot be refused.
card.flavor: Once an Elemental Master, now his name has been stricken from the Histories of the Phoenix and his daughter carries out his duty.

card.name: The Obsidian Hand
card.text:
Unique. Lose 3 Honor.
This Personality is immune to the effects of corruption tokens.
Reaction: When entering a duel, this Personality gains a Chi bonus equal to the Personal Honor of the opponent until the end of the turn.

card.name: The Rising Sun
card.text: Until your next turn begins, raise the Chi of each Personality in the game by his or her Personal Honor.

card.name: Threat of War
card.text: Open: This card can only be played during an opponent's turn and you must bow a samurai to play it. This turn, the target opponent must bow a samurai each time he bows a holding, or the holding generates no effects.

card.name: Thunder Dragon
card.text:
Unaligned Creature • Shugenja • Cavalry • Unique
Cannot attach Followers or Items.
Battle: Once per battle: Target an opposing Personality. Bow him.

card.name: Togashi Gaijutsu
card.text:
Dragon Clan Tattoo Artist • Unique
Reaction: Bow as one of your Dragon Clan Samurai is being brought into play at full gold cost. Instead of gaining the Personality's personal honor, draw and discard the top card of your fate deck. The Samurai gains a permanent Force and Chi bonus equal to the Focus Value of the discard.

card.name: Tomb of Jade
card.text: Limited: Bow this Shugenja and destroy this Spell to destroy a Shadowlands card.

card.name: Touch of Despair
card.text:
Black Scroll • Unique • Whenever this Shugenja straightens, give him a -1C Corruption token.
Limited: Bow this Shugenja to give any Personality in play the trait: Shadowlands permanently.
card.flavor:
My doom you have chased, my end you have sought
My evil embraced, in my web you are caught.

card.name: Touch of Fu Leng
card.text:
Black Scroll • Unique • Whenever this Shugenja straightens, give him a -1C Corruption token.
Open: Bow this Shugenja to give any of your Personalities the ability Battle: Fear X, where X is the Chi of this Shugenja. This ability lasts until the end of the turn.
card.flavor:
From where I hide, I hold the Empire's fate
But when you learn my name, it shall be too late.

card.name: Utter Defeat
card.text: Reaction: Before a Personality is destroyed by a battle resolution or for losing a duel: He is completely humiliated. Negate the destruction. Dishonor him. While he remains in play, he can not be rehonored, can not commit seppuku except from a card's effect, and his controller loses 1 Honor after each of his Dynasty Phases begins.

card.name: Wakizashi
card.text:
Weapon
A Personality who has one Weapon can attach the Wakizashi. This Personality can have two Weapons.
card.flavor: It is as important to samurai as their katanas. One carries their souls, the other their honor.

card.name: Warhorses
card.text: This Personality gains the Cavalry trait while Warhorses are attached.

card.name: When Darkness Draws Near
card.text: Battle: Send an allying unit home from this battle, bowed. If the unit's controller no longer has any units in any battle and has had no units in armies during any Resolution Segment this turn, he or she loses 2 Honor.

card.name: Winning Kachiko's Favor
card.text: Reaction: Play when you or another Player lobbies for the Imperial Favor. You may pay gold to increase your temporary Honor on a 1 gold equals 1 Honor basis.
card.flavor: Petting scorpions with a compassionate hand only gets you a sting. - The Tao of Shinsei

card.name: Yasuki Nokatsu
card.text:
Crab Clan Taskmaster
All Followers attached to Yasuki Nokatsu have a 1F bonus while they are attached.
card.flavor: Mujina? Rebel? I think not, my dear Doji...

card.name: Yuki No Onna
card.text:
Unaligned Snow Maiden • Nonhuman
Yuki no Onna gains +1F/+1C for each Forest in play.
Limited: Yuki no Onna bows to challenge a Shadowlands Personality. The challenge is unrefusable if the Personality's controller controls any Forests.
card.flavor: Some legends say she is the spirit of the Isawa woodlands given form to protect the secrets of the Phoenix from evil.

card.name: Mirumoto Bujun
card.text:
Dragon Clan Samurai.
Weapons being attached to Mirumoto Bujun have their Gold cost reduced by 2.

card.name: Seppun Hotaitaka
card.text:
Unaligned Samurai. Toturi's Army.
Whenever you attach a Follower to Seppun Hotaitaka, you can draw one Fate card from your deck and add it to your hand.

card.name: A Good Day to Die
card.text:
To put this card into play you must bow one of your shugenja that is in this battle and has one or more Corruption tokens. Lose 5 honor.
Battle Terrain: The result of this battle is a tie. The Province is not destroyed.
card.flavor: Tadaka saw Tsuke throwing fire from Otosan Uchi's walls and he knew what he had to do...

card.name: A Moment of Clarity
card.text: Reaction: Play when one of your Personalities is about to enter a duel. You may perform one Open action that targets this Personality before the duel begins.
card.flavor: "I took a breath and when I let it go, I felt my fear go with it." - Mirumoto Daini

card.name: A Moment of Truth - TotV
card.text: Reaction: Play along with any other Fate card to increase the focus value of that card by one. This may be done while focusing in a duel.
card.flavor: All too often, the outcome of a duel comes down to a single moment of truth.

card.name: A Soul of Thunder
card.text: Target a Personality you control. If you control him when your next turn begins, gain 4 Honor. Until the game ends, other players may take the action, "Limited: Any number of times per turn, target a Personality you control: He issues an unrefusable challenge to this Event's original target."

card.name: Agasha Gennai
card.text:
Dragon Clan Shugenja
While Agasha Gennai is unbowed, you can discard one Fate card from your hand during your End Phase to draw an additional Fate card.
card.flavor: Seek what the future holds, for in the wind, the shards of fortune fly.

card.name: Agasha Tunnels
card.text: Limited: Once per turn, you may search the tunnels; turn over and discard the top card of your fate deck, continuing to do so until you turn over a spell. Show the spell to your opponents, then put it in your hand.
card.flavor: They say the Agasha Library was ruined by the forces of Fu Leng. The Agasha know otherwise...

card.name: Akiyoshi - exp
card.text:
Unaligned Samurai • Toturi's Army • Experienced • Unique
Reaction: Bow when an Experienced Personality is about to be destroyed. The Personality is reshuffled into that player's dynasty deck instead of being destroyed.
card.flavor: Wearing her fallen brother's armor and disguised as a ronin, Kachiko's geisha has served both her mistress and Toturi in their darkest hours.

card.name: Akodo Tactical School
card.text:
Unique • May only be put into play by a Lion Clan Player.
Battle: Bow to straighten a Lion Samurai in this battle.
card.flavor:
Lesson One: Victory is hidden behind veils of defeat.
Lesson Two: How many veils do you wear?

card.name: al-Hazaad
card.text:
Unaligned Wizard • Shugenja • May not bow to produce spell effects. Only one spell per turn may be attached to al-Hazaad. Will join Unicorn player for 2 less gold.
Open: Destroy a spell that is attached to al-Hazaad to give him a 2F/2C bonus until the end of this turn.

card.name: al-Rashid
card.text: Unaligned Warrior • Will join Unicorn player for 2 less gold • al-Rashid may play a focus card before the challenged Personality when he is the challenger in a duel. All of al-Rashid's focus cards are played face-up.
card.flavor: "Their tactics resembled the Unicorn, but fiercer and bolder. Toturi and Yakamo listened to him, but one more intently than the other."

card.name: An Exhibition
card.text: Political Reaction: Play to double the honor gain as you bow an honor-producing holding. You may only play one Exhibition each time you bow a holding.

card.name: Ancestral Standard of the Scorpion
card.text:
Unique • May only be attached to a Scorpion Clan Personality. Followers in this army attached to a Scorpion Clan Personality receive a +1F. All opposing Scorpion Personalities receive a -1F penalty in battle.
Reaction: Bow when a Scorpion Personality is destroyed to move one Follower from that unit and attach it to this Personality.

card.name: Ancient Armor of the Qamar
card.text:
Unique. May only be attached to a Naga Personality with Force greater than two or who has the Tactician trait. Gain 3 Honor. Attaches to Qamar without gold cost.
Actions on cards with the Shadowlands trait cannot target this unit or cards in this Personality's army.

card.name: As Far as the Eye Can See
card.text: This Region may enter play even if there is already a Region attached to this Province. This Province may attach any number of Regions, but may not attach more than one of each. If this Region is destroyed or moved, you must destroy all but one Region on this Province.

card.name: Asako Ishio
card.text:
Phoenix Clan Drummer • While Ishio is unbowed, cards in his army are immune to fear.
Battle: Bow Ishio to send one opposing Shadowlands Personality home from this battle, without bowing.
card.flavor: Drums have been used for centuries to drive evil spirits away.

card.name: Asako Togama
card.text:
Phoenix Clan Scribe • Shugenja • May not bow to produce spell effects.
Limited: Bow to retrieve a spell from any player's discard pile and attach it to Togama. Costs must be paid normally. Togama may not retrieve any spell card more than once.
card.flavor: "When the last times come, we will have need of his quick hands and eyes." - Asako Oyo

card.name: Ashan
card.text:
Naga Shugenja • Nonhuman
Battle: Bow to return one of your Naga Personalities to your fief, bowed. This action may target bowed units.
card.flavor: "The ogre held the Naga high above its head - but he vanished from its grip with a flash of white and the smell of the seashore." - Isawa Tadaka

card.name: Augury
card.text: Limited: Bow this Shugenja and destroy this spell. Name an event in your deck, then search through your Dynasty deck, and then if necessary your Provinces, for it. Reveal it to the other players and reshuffle your Dynasty deck. Place the card on top of either your Dynasty deck or your discard pile.

card.name: Battle Standard of Shinsei
card.text:
Unique • May only be attached to a Monk Personality. Followers in this army attached to a Monk Personality receive a +1F. All opposing Monk Personalities receive a -1F penalty in battle.
Reaction: Bow when a Monk Personality is destroyed to move one Follower from that unit and attach it to this Personality.

card.name: Battle Standard of the Mantis
card.text:
Unique • May only be attached to a Mantis Clan Personality. Followers in this army attached to a Mantis Clan Personality receive a +1F. All opposing Mantis Personalities receive a -1F penalty in battle.
Reaction: Bow when a Mantis Personality is destroyed to move one Follower from that unit and attach it to this Personality.

card.name: Battle Standard of the Naga
card.text:
Unique • May only be attached to a Naga Personality. Followers in this army attached to a Naga Personality receive a +1F. All opposing Naga Personalities receive a -1F penalty in battle.
Reaction: Bow when a Naga Personality is destroyed to move one Naga Follower from that unit and attach it to this Personality.

card.name: Bayushi Goshiu - exp
card.text:
Scorpion Clan Diplomat • Experienced • Unique
Political Reaction: Bow Goshiu when another player is about to prevent a loss of honor. This action is negated, and the loss of honor occurs normally.
Political Reaction: Bow Goshiu when someone is about to lose honor to redirect that honor loss to a different player.

card.name: Bayushi Hisa - exp
card.text:
Scorpion Clan Samurai • Experienced • Unique
Reaction: Prior to infantry assignment you may look at one of the defender's face-down Dynasty cards. If Hisa is not assigned to attack this Province during infantry assignment, he is bowed immediately after infantry assignment.

card.name: Bayushi Kachiko - exp2
card.text:
Scorpion Clan Thunder • Experienced 2 • Unique • May attach the Broken Sword of the Scorpion without gold cost • This unit may not be targeted by Ninja, Kolat, or Assassin actions. While Kachiko is honorable, you may achieve an honor victory, and all Shadowlands cards have their gold costs increased by two.
Reaction: Negate the effects of any Black Scroll as it is being used.

card.name: Bayushi Marumo
card.text:
Scorpion Clan Samurai • No items except weapons and armor.
Battle: Once per turn, this unit may move to a different Province of the Defender. You may not perform this action if this unit has more than one Follower.

card.name: Bonds of Darkness
card.text: Until the end of the game, all Shadowlands Personalities have the ability Battle: Bow any one opposing Shadowlands card. This can be done once per battle per Personality.
card.flavor: Do not fear the bonds of darkness. Evil will always turn uponm itself.

card.name: Burning Your Essence
card.text: This card has a Focus value of 6 when focused in a duel, discarded for a Tactician Force bonus, or used for its Focus value with an ability on a Personality. The Personality permanently has -2C after the duel or ability resolves.
card.flavor: "We are the newest family of the Dragon, but we will save the clan from its foes and restore the honor lost when the Agasha fled to the Phoenix." - Tamori Shaitung

card.name: Chi Strike
card.text: Play this card face-up as a focus for a monk you control. All of your opponent's focus cards that have already been played are discarded without effect (Chi bonuses are lost).
card.flavor: You need no armor, you need no sword. You need only to know that you cannot be defeated. - The Tao of Shinsei

card.name: Concealed Weapon
card.text: Reaction: Play this card when one of your Personalities is entering a duel to be able to attach one weapon to this Personality. All costs must be paid normally. Lose honor equal to half of the weapon's gold cost if your Personality is not a ninja.
card.flavor: Of course I am ready, Doji-san. Shall we begin?

card.name: Contested Ground
card.text: Terrain Battle: Each player has the ability, "Battle: Any number of times per turn, bow one or more of your target cards, in one unit, which have equal or greater total Force than the enemy target: Destroy a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers."

card.name: Coordinated Fire
card.text: Reaction: Play this card when you are making a ranged attack. Combine ranged attacks from cards in more than one unit.
card.flavor: There were three archers - one Crab, one Lion, and one Naga - and each shared a single target, cutting down unstoppable oni with each volley.

card.name: Corrupt Geisha House
card.text:
Shadowlands • Lose 3 Honor.
Bow the Corrupt Geisha House and lose 1 Honor to produce 2 Gold. If a Scorpion player controls the Corrupt Geisha House, it produces 3 Gold when bowed.
card.flavor: Though the maidens seem lovely and demure, painted faces cannot hide demonic eyes.

card.name: Corrupt Gold Mines
card.text:
Shadowlands
Lose 1 Honor when brought into play.
Bow and lose 1 Honor to produce 1 gold. If Corrupt Gold Mine is controlled by a Dragon Clan player, it produces 2 gold.
card.flavor: A black-glass rose has deep roots...

card.name: Corrupt Stables
card.text:
Shadowlands
Lose 1 Honor when brought into play.
Bow and lose 1 Honor to produce 1 gold. If Corrupt Stables is controlled by a Unicorn Clan player, it produces 2 gold.
card.flavor: "There is a traitor in our midst, my lord. One with dark allegiances..." - Shinjo Yasamura

card.name: Corrupted Region
card.text:
All Shadowlands Personalities and Followers in a battle at this Province receive a +1F bonus.
All non-Shadowlands Personalities bowing to produce spell effects during a battle at this region receive a -1C corruption token.
card.flavor: "Who would have known that our fields would turn into these blackened and foul wastelands?" - Isawa Tadaka

card.name: Counting the Lost
card.text: Limited: All Personalities aligned to your clan that are not also aligned to the clan of the player controlling them are declared 'lost'. They are bowed, dishonored and permanently lose 1F, 1C, 1 Personal Honor and your clan's alignment.
card.flavor: "Choose a side, Goemon. Choose a side or choose my blade." - Matsu Seijuro

card.name: Crystal Gate
card.text:
Fortification
No more than two units that contain Shadowlands cards may attack this Province at any one time. Additional such units may not be committed, and actions that would bring further such units to attack this province are cancelled.
card.flavor: "Its warm glow splits the darkness, keeping the foul beasts at bay." - Asahina Tomo

card.name: Curse of the Jackal
card.text: Battle: Bow this shugenja and target one opposing Follower whose force is less than the Chi of this shugenja. Replace that Follower with a 1F Jackal token that is a Cavalry Creature Follower. The replaced card is discarded from play.
card.flavor: It was difficult to tell whether Yokatsu was leading the charge or fleeing his charges.

card.name: Dark Lord's Favor
card.text:
Shadowlands
You can play only one Dark Lord's Favor per turn. You cannot play this card if another player has less Family Honor than you.
Open: Target a Personality. Dishonor him. Lose 7 Honor.
Limited: Target a player. He discards a card. Lose 7 Honor.
Battle: Target a card. Reduce its Force to 0. Lose 7 Honor.
Reaction: Before a player gains Honor. Negate the gain. Lose 7 Honor.

card.name: Dashmar - exp
card.text: Venerable Naga Lord • Nonhuman • Unique • Experienced • Will not join Scorpion Clan • While Dashmar is in play, all non-Naga Personalities entering play for Naga players have their gold cost reduced by one. Political Reaction: Bow Dashmar to cancel any Political Action as it's being performed.

card.name: Depth of the Void
card.text: Limited: Bow this shugenja and look at the top two cards of your Fate deck. You may discard or return to the top of your deck either or both of those cards. If either card is a spell, item, or Follower, you may show the card to the other players and place it at the bottom of your Fate deck.

card.name: Disenlightenment
card.text: Limited: Choose a player who has the same number or fewer elemental Rings in play as you do. You and the other player must each shufle all of your rings back into your Fate Deck.
card.flavor: "There is no time for doubt or fear. Only the purest hearts will survive this day!" - Ikoma Tsanuri

card.name: Distractions of the Flesh
card.text: Reaction: Play this card when a player is putting an elemental ring into play. Draw and discard your top Fate card. If the focus value of the discard is less than the number of elemental rings that player has in play, the ring card is shuffled back into the player's Fate deck instead of entering into play.

card.name: Doji Chomei
card.text:
Crane Clan Samurai • Yoritomo's Alliance
Mantis Followers being attached to Chomei have their Gold cost reduced by 3.
card.flavor: In the time since Toturi's coronation, Chomei traveled the width of Rokugan. Now he is drawn back to the islands of the Mantis, eager to forge new alliances against the troubled times ahead.

card.name: Doji Hoturi - exp2
card.text:
Crane Clan Thunder • Crane Champion • Samurai • Double Chi • Experienced 2 • Unique. Will only join Crane Clan • This unit may not be targeted with the Imperial Favor.
Battle: Challenge an opposing Personality to a duel. If the duel is refused, the opposing unit is sent home from the battle, bowed. This action may be performed once per battle.

card.name: Doji Kuwanan - exp
card.text:
Crane Clan Champion • Samurai • Experienced • Unique • Tactician
Doji Kuwanan will only join a Crane player.
card.flavor: "We negotiated once, and it almost destroyed out clan. The time for talking is over."

card.name: Doji Shizue
card.text:
Crane Clan Storyteller
Political Reaction: Bow Doji Shizue when another player is gaining or losing Honor. The Honor gain or loss is increased by 1 point. You gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "I cannot go with you, Hiroru. There is a traitor in the Imperial Court, and I must discover his plot before it is too late..."

card.name: Doji Yosai - exp
card.text:
Crane Clan Liason • Experienced • Unique • No Followers
Reaction Political: Bow to produce any political action on a card in play that is legal to be produced at this time.
card.flavor: "Once I served the Emperor's causes. Now I will thwart them even if it means my honor and soul."

card.name: Elite Heavy Infantry
card.text: This Follower contributes its Force total to its army's total during battle resolution even if its Personality is bowed. This Follower is immune to Fear effects.
card.flavor: "When the Crab stand again on the walls of Hiruma Castle, the darkness with three faces will make itself known to its ancient enemies. All things, then, will be in the hand of man." - Isawa Norikazu

card.name: Elite Light Infantry
card.text: This Follower contributes its Force total to its army's total during battle resolution even if its Personality is bowed. This Follower is immune to Fear effects.
card.flavor: Once no more than ronin under the banner of Toturi the Black, now these simple ashigaru and freemen have sworn their honor to the Emperor and bear the monk of Rokugan's highest office.

card.name: Elite Medium Infantry
card.text: This Follower contributes its Force total to its army's total during battle resolution even if its Personality is bowed. This Follower is immune to Fear effects.
card.flavor: It only took a moment for the peace of Toturi's reign to be shattered by the news of his disappearance. How long before the clans wage war for his throne?

card.name: Enlightened Ruler
card.text: All players gain 5 honor for each Elemental Ring they have in play.
card.flavor: "We do not seek to rule, we seek him who is destined to rule." - Tetsuya

card.name: Eshru
card.text:
Naga Slayer • Nonhuman • May attach Crystal items for free.
Battle: Bow for a Ranged 4 attack that targets a Shadowlands card.
Battle: Bow to challenge an opposing Shadowlands Personality to a duel that may not be refused.

card.name: Essence of Air
card.text: Elemental Air Limited: Bow this Shugenja, who may remain bowed: Turn all cards in your Provinces face-up. Your Provinces fill face-up, and cards filling them this way may not have their costs reduced. These effects last until this Shugenja is not bowed or in play, or a number of your Provinces equal to this Shugenja's Chi fill in one turn.

card.name: Essence of Earth
card.text: Elemental Battle: Bow this shugenja to give one of your defending Personalities in this battle a 4F/2C bonus until the end of the turn.
card.flavor: "Your fires are finished, Tsuke! Now is the time we die together. Time for this corrupted Phoenix to be born again!" - Isawa Tadaka

card.name: Factionism
card.text: Until the end of the game, players may only extend an invitation to ally to one player per turn.

card.name: Familiar Surroundings
card.text: Reaction: Play this card after the last Maneuvers Segment of this Attack Phase. Until the phase ends, the Defender selects the order in which battles resolve instead of the Attacker.
card.flavor: "My lady Dejiko, they had great horns on their heads and the strength of ogres. We drove them off before they could reach the Tombs." - Kitsu Akua

card.name: Fatal Mistake
card.text: Reaction: Play this card as a focus in a duel. In addition to any other effects of this duel, the loser of this duel is killed (destroyed).
card.flavor: Just a slip of the wrist is all it takes to start a blood feud.

card.name: Festival of Long Sticks
card.text: All goblin cards in play are bowed. Any unit with a goblin card gains a 1F goblin nonhuman Shadowlands Follower token for every goblin card in the unit.

card.name: Final Stand
card.text: Battle: This card must be played on one of your samurai with a Personal Honor of 3 or greater. All Followers attached to this Personality have their Force doubled until after the resolution phase of this battle. This unit is destroyed at the end of this battle's resolution phase. This card can only target a defending Personality or a Personality that is attacking a player with family honor below zero.

card.name: Flight of Doves
card.text:
Air
Limited: Bow this Shugenja and destroy this card: Until the game ends, Honor gains from actions on a target Holding are increased by 1.
card.flavor: "The way of the shugenja is the way of peace. While we may serve on the field of battle, we must never forget this simple truth." - Agasha Ueda

card.name: Flying Carpet
card.text:
Unique • The carpet's abilities cannot be activated if there are any Followers in this unit. This Personality gains the trait Cavalry.
Battle: move this unit into the current battle.
Battle: move this unit from the current battle to your fief.
card.flavor: It is a new kind of magic that will have to learn to use before it is used against us.

card.name: Fog
card.text: Battle Terrain: This terrain takes effect immediately upon being played. No Ranged Attacks may be performed while this card is in play.
card.flavor: The Emperor's archers readied their bows, but Uona made certain their efforts would be in vain.

card.name: For the Empire
card.text: Limited: One of your Samurai issues an unrefusable challenge to a Shadowlands Personality, or one of your Shadowlands Personalities issues an unrefusable challenge to a Samurai. If the Samurai wins he permanently gains +1 Personal Honor and his controller gains 3 Honor, and if the Shadowlands Personality wins he permanently gains +1F/+1C.

card.name: Forgiveness
card.text: Kiho Open: Bow one of your monks or shugenja to restore any Personality in play to honorable status.
card.flavor: "With his dying gasp, he held my hand tight and spoke through blood spangled lips. I nodded and squeezed his hand tight, accepting his forgiveness as he accepted mine." - Bayushi Kachiko

card.name: Gaijin Merchant
card.text: All Followers and items being attached to this unit have their gold costs reduced by two. All gold costs on abilities in this unit are reduced by two, to a minimum of one.

card.name: Gekkai
card.text:
Unaligned Monk
Focus cards played by Gekkai are treated as if they had a focus value of one higher.
Reaction: When this Personality is entering a duel, you may take the top card of your fate deck and add it to your hand.
card.flavor: "I never even saw him strike, but I heard the samurai's muffled cry." - Kakita Toshimoko

card.name: Goblin Madcaps
card.text:
Nonhuman • Shadowlands • Lose 2 Honor.
If Goblin Madcaps are in a unit with a non-Goblin Personality or non-Goblin Follower, destroy Goblin Madcaps.
Battle: Fear 2.
card.flavor: Some of the goblins coming through Shinomen Forest bear familiar tattoos.

card.name: Goblin Sneaks
card.text:
Nonhuman • Shadowlands • Lose 2 Honor.
If Goblin Sneaks have been destroyed, you may bring them into play from your discard pile without Gold cost during any of your End Phases.
card.flavor: "We have lost them. The only thing worse than the ones that are all teeth are the ones that won't fight." - Toritaka Sensaichi

card.name: Goblin War Standard
card.text: Shadowlands • All Goblin Personalities and Followers in this army gain a 1F bonus. All Goblin Personalities in this army gain a 1C bonus.
card.flavor: "We make flag! Scary, innit?"

card.name: Goblin Wizard
card.text: Goblin Shugenja • Nonhuman • Shadowlands • Lose 4 Honor.

card.name: Harima
card.text:
Unaligned Monk
Reaction: Bow when an Oracle is bowed to produce an action. The Oracle's action is canceled and all effects are negated.
Limited: Bow Harima and an Oracle you control to straighten an Oracle.
card.flavor: Forewarned is not necessarily forearmed.

card.name: Heavy Mounted Infantry
card.text:
Cavalry
Battle: Once per battle, remove the Cavalry trait from Heavy Mounted Infantry until the end of the turn to give it +2F.

card.name: Hida Amoro - exp
card.text: Crab Clan Undead Berserker • Shadowlands • Experienced • Unique • Lose 5 Honor • May only attach zombie and skeleton Followers, but may do so without gold cost. When Amoro is brought into play, experienced, other Followers attached to Amoro are destroyed. Amoro is unaffected by Plague tokens.

card.name: Hida O-Ushi - exp
card.text:
Crab Clan Bully • Samurai • Experienced • Unique
Battle: Bow O-Ushi. Bow any one opposing Personality with a lower Force.
Reaction: Bow O-Ushi when she is entering a duel. Change the duel to a contest of Force versus Force. All other conditions and effects of the duel are unchanged.

card.name: Hida Tadashiro
card.text:
Crab Clan Samurai
Reaction: If Hida Tadashiro is destroyed by an action or effect that does not also destroy some or all attached Followers, those Followers can be attached to any of your Personalities to which they could legally be attached.
card.flavor: He stands deep within the darkness, ready to atone for his family's sins.

card.name: Hida War College
card.text:
Unique • May only be put into play by a Crab Clan Player.
Open: Bow to give a human Crab Personality the Tactician trait until end of the turn.
card.flavor:
Lesson one: Anything but the truth is a lie.
Lesson two: Trust nothing but the truth.

card.name: Hida Yakamo - exp2
card.text:
Crab Clan Thunder • Crab Champion • Samurai • Experienced 2 • Unique • Tactician • Hida Yakamo will only join a Crab player. Hida Yakamo can attach the Jade Hand and the Ancestral Sword of Hantei without Gold cost.
Battle: Straighten Hida Yakamo (if necessary) and assign him as a defender in any battle with Shadowlands cards in the attacking army. Yakamo need not be invited as an ally and cannot be sent home from this battle.

card.name: Hitomi - exp2
card.text:
Dragon Clan Champion • Samurai • Dragon Thunder • Shugenja • Unique • Experienced 2 • Hitomo will only join a Dragon player. Hitomi can attach the Obsidian Hand without Gold cost.
Limited: If she has the Obsidian Hand, bow Hitomi. Destroy any one Dragon in play (this does not refer to Dragon Clan Personalities). Hitomi permanently gains the innate abilities of that Dragon.

card.name: Hizuka
card.text:
Unaligned Monk • Defender of the Temples • Hizuka gains a 2F bonus when defending.
Battle: Bring Hizuka into play in the defending army if he is face-up in a Province being attacked by one or more units. All costs and requirements are waived.
card.flavor: "Not today, samurai. Not while I still live."

card.name: Horde of Fu Leng
card.text:
Nonhuman • Shadowlands • Lose 6 Honor • May only be attached to a Shadowlands Personality • May be attached to a Fu Leng Personality for 3 less gold.
Battle: Fear X, where X is equal to the number of Fu Leng cards in this unit.

card.name: Horsebowmen
card.text:
Cavalry
Battle: Bow Horsebowmen for a Ranged 3 Attack.
card.flavor: The example of the Unicorn has spurred the Great Clans to experiment with fighting styles that would have seemed foolish before.

card.name: I Believed in You
card.text: Political Limited: Make a Personality with an Honor Requirement higher than his controller's Family Honor commit seppuku.

card.name: Ikoma Tsanuri - exp
card.text:
Lion Clan Champion • Samurai • Tactician • Double Chi • Experienced • Unique • Ikoma Tsanuri will only join a Lion player. Ignore all effects of Terrain and Regions while Ikoma Tsanuri is in this army.
Battle: Once per battle in which Ikoma Tsanuri is in the defending army, target an opposing Personality, who is sent home bowed. This is considered a use of the Imperial Favor.
card.flavor: "If you must ask what honor is, you will never know."

card.name: In Time of War
card.text: Until the end of the game, during each turn, a player's Family Honor can not rise over its value when that turn began plus 5.

card.name: Isawa Suma
card.text:
Phoenix Clan Shugenja
Spells attached to Suma that destroy themselves when cast are not destroyed. Instead, Suma loses Chi equal to half the spell's focus value (rounded up), permanently.
card.flavor: "His will is nearly indomitable, but I fear for the strain on his soul." - Isawa Uona

card.name: Isawa Tadaka - exp2
card.text:
Phoenix Clan Thunder • Shugenja • Experienced 2 • Unique • Master of Earth
Reaction: Bow to cancel any spell or innate ability targeting one of your cards.
Battle: Bow Tadaka to destroy a number of opposing Shadowlands cards equal to or less than Tadaka's Chi. You cannot target a Personality with followers attached unless you are also targeting all the followers in that unit. Tadaka is destroyed.

card.name: Isawa Uona - exp2
card.text:
Phoenix Clan Shugenja • Experienced 2 • Unique • Shadowlands • Master of Air
Open: Look at another player's Fate Hand and face down cards in his Provinces. This action does not bow Uona, but may only be performed twice per game.

card.name: Isha - exp
card.text:
Naga Hunter • Experienced • Unique • Tactician
Reaction: Before the defender performs his or her first battle action, you can play a Terrain for this battle.
Reaction: If Qamar is about to be destroyed, attach all of Qamar's cards and tokens to Isha. Until the end of the game, Isha is considered the Qamar.
card.flavor: His hand released the bowstring, and the arrow sped as if given wings.

card.name: Iuchi Karasu - exp
card.text:
Unicorn Clan Shugenja • Experienced • Unique
Battle: Once per turn, switch the locations (Provinces or unassigned) of any two of your units. You can target bowed Personalities with this action.

card.name: Izaku Library
card.text: Bow the Izaku Library to produce 5 Gold when paying for a Spell.
card.flavor: "The oldest texts in the Izaku Library make reference to other, still older works. If the Masters know of these ancient texts, they do not speak of them to us." - Asako Itaru

card.name: Jade Dragon
card.text:
Unaligned Creature • Calvary • No Items or Followers
Shadowlands cards cannot target the Jade Dragon with actions.
Battle: Ranged 6 attack that can only target Shadowlands cards. This does not bow the Jade Dragon, but may only be done twice per battle.

card.name: Jiujutsu Duel
card.text: Reaction: Play when you are entering a duel. All items controlled by both Personalities in the duel are bowed. These items give no bonuses and produce no effects during this duel.
card.flavor: Bloody and battered, the two Yakamos stood face to face, weapons and glares locked. One would perish, the other would find his destiny...

card.name: Junzo's Battle Standard
card.text:
Unique • May only be attached to a Shadowlands Personality. Followers in this army attached to a Shadowlands Personality receive a +1F. All opposing Shadowlands Personalities receive a -1F penalty in battle.
Reaction: Bow when a Shadowlands Personality is destroyed to move one Follower from that unit and attach it to this Personality.

card.name: Kage - exp2
card.text:
Unaligned Kolat Master • Unique • Experienced 2 Akodo Kage
Limited: Bow Kage and announce a target number. Draw and discard the top card of your Fate deck. If the target number is less than the card's Focus value, bow a number of Followers, and Personalities without unbowed Followers, equal to the target number.

card.name: Kakita Kenjutsu School
card.text:
Unique • May only be put into play by a Crane Clan Player.
Battle: Bow to give a Crane Samurai a 2F/1C bonus.
Reaction: Bow when one of your Crane Samurai is entering a duel to give him a 1F/2C bonus.
card.flavor:
Lesson one: You cannot be courageous without first learning compassion.
Lesson two: You cannot be compassionate without first learning courage.

card.name: Kakita Yoshi - exp
card.text:
Crane Clan Liason • Experienced • Unique
Political Reaction: Bow Kakita Yoshi immediately after you or another player discards the Imperial Favor to produce one of the standard Imperial Favor effects. Yoshi produces the exact same effect again for you. Yoshi's action is considered a use of the Imperial Favor.

card.name: Kappuksu - exp
card.text:
Unaligned Goblin Warmonger • Experienced • Unique • Shadowlands
Kappuksu cannot be destroyed if he has Goblin Followers. The Followers are destroyed instead, and Kappuksu returns to your fief bowed.
Battle: Replace one of your units in this battle with Kappuksu's unit, if Kappuksu is not assigned to a battle.

card.name: Kaze-Do
card.text: Kiho Elemental Battle Bow one of your Monks or Shugenja to send home, without bowing, an opposing unit led by a Personality with Force lower than the caster's Chi.
card.flavor: "Strength is found in more than just arms." - Hoshi Wayan

card.name: Kitsu Okura
card.text:
Lion Clan Shugenja
Kitsu Okura cannot bow as part of a lobby attempt. This unit cannot be targeted with an effect of the Imperial Favor.
card.flavor: His eyes, once unsure and thoughtful, have been tempered by war and hardened by defeat. Where there had been hope, now there is only steel.

card.name: Kitsu Toju - exp
card.text:
Lion Clan Shugenja • Experienced • Unique
Reaction: Bow Toju when the player with the highest honor is bowing a Personality to lobby for the Imperial Favor. Toju is interfering with the lobby attempt, which is no longer automatic. All players may bow Personalities and give gifts to aid or oppose the attempt. Toju's Personal Honor is counted against the attempt.

card.name: Know the School
card.text: Limited: Bow one of your Personalities and name a family. For the rest of the game, if this Personality faces a Personality from that family in a duel, he or she gains a 3C bonus for that duel. Remember that in Rokugan a person's family name comes before his own. Personalities without a family name are unaffected.

card.name: Kolat Spy
card.text: Limited: Turn all of the face-down Dynasty cards in the target player's Provinces face-up. Lose 1 honor. Events are not resolved until that player's next event phase.
card.flavor: "If we continue like dogs, barking and biting each other's heels, we will die like dogs." - Otaku Kamoko

card.name: Komaro
card.text:
Unaligned Monk

card.flavor: "He may be a monk, but his karma will not save his life when I catch him beneath my hammer." - Hida O-Ushi

card.name: Kuni Sensin
card.text:
Crab Clan Samurai
Personalities with Shadowlands cards in their unit may not refuse challenges from Sensin.

card.name: Kyujutsu
card.text:

Reaction: Add 1 to the strength of a Ranged Attack as it's being performed.

card.name: Lady Kitsune
card.text:
Unaligned Foxwife • Creature
Lower the Honor requirement of each Personality you bring into play by Kitsune's Personal Honor. (Honor Requirements may drop under 0.) Human Personalities each gain +1C while in Kitsune's army. If Kitsune becomes Dishonored, destroy her.
card.flavor: "As long as you pay proper respect to the kami, I will be glad of your company."

card.name: Legions of Fu Leng

card.name: Lessons From the Past
card.text: Limited: If you have the experienced version of a Personality in play and the inexperienced version face up in your Province, play the inexperienced under the experienced version as if the experienced version had been brought out to "update" the Personality.
card.flavor: Despite Ginawa's effort to avoid the portrait, it drew tears from him all the same...

card.name: Light Mounted Infantry
card.text:
Cavalry

card.name: Matsu Gohei - exp
card.text:
Lion Clan Samurai • Experienced • Unique

card.name: Mighty Protection

card.name: Mirumoto Yukihira
card.text:

Limited: Bow Yukihira and target a weapon in play. Target weapon receives a permanent +1F/+1C bonus. This may be performed once per weapon.

card.name: Moshi Wakiza - exp
card.text:
Centipede Clan Shugenja • Yoritomo's Alliance • Experienced • Unique
Battle: Bow Moshi Wakiza for a Ranged 2 Attack that can target a Personality with attached Followers. This attack cannot be combined with other ranged attacks, but its strength can be increased.

card.name: Mounted Spearmen
card.text:
Cavalry
Battle: Bow for a Ranged 2 Attack. This attack can't have its strength increased, but may be combined with other Ranged Attacks from within the unit.

card.name: Mujina Chieftain
card.text: Unaligned Chief of Mujina • Nonhuman • Cavalry • Only Mujina Followers. Lose 2 Honor. Mujina Followers being attached to the Mujina Chief have their gold cost reduced by 4. All Mujina Followers attached have a 1F bonus.

Retainer

card.flavor: "They are useful, but very careless. Sometimes intentionally so." - Kaiu Suman

This spell acts in all ways as a terrain card put into play from your hand. It has no other effects.

card.name: Necromancer - exp
card.text:
Unaligned Shugenja • Experienced • Unique • Shadowlands • Lose 5 Honor.
Limited: Bow to attach a dead Follower from any player's discard pile. The Follower gains the trait Shadowlands, has its honor requirement reduced to 0, and the ability Battle: Fear 3. All of these changes are permanent. Lose 2 Honor.

card.name: Ninja Stalkers
card.text:
Ninja • Will only attach to a Ninja Personality.

card.text:

Battle: Bow this Personality to give a -2C poison token to an opposing Personality. Lose 3 honor. This is considered a Ranged Attack.

card.text:
Weapon • May only be attached to a Shadowlands Personality.
Obsidian Blade has an additional +2C bonus when this Personality is facing a non-Shadowlands Personality in a duel.
card.flavor: Long thought to have been lost, it completes the set of three.

card.name: Offer of Fealty
card.text: Reaction: Play immediately after one of your Personalities wins a duel where the loser is killed. You may attach any Followers from the loser's unit that will legally attach to your Personality.
card.flavor: Do not be so quick to follow your master. Your strength is needed in this world, not the next.

card.name: One with the Elements
card.text: Kiho Reaction: Bow one of your Monks. Cancel and negate the effects of any one Spell or Kiho that targets you, your cards, or your army. This cannot affect a Spell or Kiho with a Gold cost greater than the Monk's Chi. Shugenja cannot use this Kiho.
card.flavor: "The Elements are not the means to an end... they are the beginning and the end." - from The Tao of Shinsei

card.name: Oni no Ianwa
card.text:
Unaligned Oni • Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Unique • Lose 4 Honor • No items or Followers.
You must discard your whole hand to put this Personality into play. You may not put the Ring of Void into play while Ianwa is in play.
Any player may, as an Open action, discard a fate card to reduce Ianwa's Force by the focus value of the discard, until the end of the turn.

card.name: Pekkle no Oni
card.text:
Oni • Nonhuman • Shadowlands • Supai
After the first time each turn Pekkle enters play: Gain 3 Honor.
After Pekkle is destroyed: Lose 10 honor.
Political Limited: Bow Pekkle: Gain 1 Honor.

card.name: Oni no Ugulu
card.text:
Unaligned Nonhuman • Shadowlands • Lose 5 honor.
Human Personalities cannot use Open or Battle actions to move into the same Province as Oni no Ugulu.
card.flavor: "Tell me, Asako-sama," Yori hissed to the lump of flesh that had been a man, "how does it feel to lose your name?"

card.name: Oracle of the Void
card.text:
Retainer • Unique
Elemental Limited: Bow Oracle of the Void and pay 1 Gold to either draw a Fate card or discard a card from your hand. Show the card to all players.
Elemental Reaction: During your End Phase, if you have fewer than five cards in your hand, bow Oracle of the Void to draw cards until you have five in your hand. Lose 2 honor each time you draw. These losses cannot be modified.

card.name: Otaku Kamoko - exp2
card.text:
Unicorn Clan Thunder • Samurai • Experienced 2 • Cavalry • Double Chi • Unique • Otaku Kamoko will only attach Calvary Followers.
Limited: Bow Otaku Kamoko and discard a card from one of your Provinces. Refill the Province with any one Personality from your Dynasty deck, face-down. Reshuffle the deck.
Reaction: Bow Otaku Kamoko. Destroy any one Personality leaving this battle.

card.name: Qamar - exp
card.text:
Naga Champion • Unique • Tactician • Experienced • Qamar will only join Naga Player. Whenever a player puts a Naga Follower into play from his or her hand, that player can draw one Fate card at the beginning of his or her next End Phase.
Limited: Bow Qamar. Add any one Naga card from your Fate deck to your hand. Reshuffle the deck.

card.name: Radakast - exp
card.text:
Naga Constrictor • Experienced • Unique
Battle: Destroy any one opposing Creature card with a Force less than or equal to Radakast's. Radakast permanently gains 1F.

card.name: Rebuilding the Kaiu Walls
card.text: Until the end of the game, all fortifications cost 4 less gold.

card.name: Regions of Rokugan
card.text: Beginning with you and proceeding once in turn order, each player may search his Dynasty deck for a Region and attach it to one of his Provinces that does not have a Region, paying all costs.

card.name: Rest, My Brother
card.text: Kiho Limited: Bow one of your shugenja or monks to destroy any one card in play that currently has the Shadowlands trait, but does not have the Shadowlands trait printed on the card.
card.flavor: The monk touched the shugenja's forehead and whispered quietly. I felt a black wind rush out of Tsuke's crumbling body as if his bones had turned as brittle as rice stalks.

card.name: River Delta
card.text: Limited: Once per turn, pay 3 Gold. Attach a 1F Naga Follower to one of your Naga Personalities.
card.flavor: "Sleep is for the weak. Only through strength can we triumph." - Shahadet

card.name: Ruins of the Isawa Library
card.text:
Unique • May only be put into play by a Phoenix Clan Player.
Open: Bow to be able to attach a spell to a Phoenix Shugenja immediately. All costs must be paid normally.
card.flavor: Once it was the greatest library in Rokugan, but now that title belongs to the Izaku Libarary, owned by the Brotherhood.

card.name: Ryokan's Sword
card.text:
Weapon
When this Personality focuses, you may play your Fate deck's top card as the Focus card. Do not look at the card until someone strikes. If you cannot focus with the card, discard it when you reveal it.

card.name: Sailors
card.text:
Open: Bow the Sailors to bow any Port, Geisha House or Sake Works in play.
Open: Bow the Sailors to increase the gold production of any one Port Geisha House or Sake Works by two until the end of the turn.

card.name: Salute of the Samurai
card.text: Reaction: Before a battle resolves, if you are an ally: If the total Force of your units in that army is greater than the total Force of your allied leader's units there, you gain any Honor for destroying units in this battle's resolution, instead of the allied leader.

card.name: Sanctified Ground
card.text: All Shadowlands cards in a battle at this Province have a -1F penalty. All Shadowlands Personalities in a battle at this Province also have a -1C penalty.
card.flavor: Junzo's armies were forced to retreat, but the only place to go was the one place they dared not...

card.name: Seikua - exp
card.text:
Unaligned Monk • Experienced • Unique • No Followers • Seikua gains +1F/+1C for each Elemental Ring in play.
Battle: Give Seikua an additional 2F/2C bonus for each Elemental Ring in play. Seikua is destroyed after this battle's resolution phase.

card.name: Shahadet's Legion
card.text:
Naga Follower • Unique • May only be attached to a Naga Personality.
Battle: Ranged 3 Attack. This does not bow this card. Useable once per battle.
Battle: Bow for a Ranged 3 Attack.

card.name: Shiba Tsukune - exp
card.text:
Phoenix Clan Champion • Samurai • Unique • Experienced • Shiba Tsukune will only join a Phoenix player.
Shiba Tsukune has a 1F/2C bonus while allying or in an army with allies.
card.flavor: "Never again shall darkness tain our noble house. Never again, I swear to you..."

card.name: Shinjo Hanari - exp
card.text:
Unicorn Clan Samurai • Experienced • Unique • Cavalry
Battle: Bow a Small Farm to give Hanari a 1F bonus.
Battle: Bow for a Ranged 3 Attack.
card.flavor: "I laughed as I watched them charge into the Shadowlands creatures; I never thought I'd be thankful to see their barbarian tricks." - Hida Tsuru

card.name: Shinjo Riding Stables
card.text:
Unique • May only be put into play by a Unicorn Clan Player.
Battle: Bow to give a Unicorn Calvary Samurai a 1F bonus for each opposing infantry unit.
card.flavor: "The undead are not so frightening when you ride them down and smash them under galloping hooves." - Otaku Kamoko

card.name: Shinjo Sanetama
card.text:
Unicorn Clan Master of the Hunt • Cavalry
Reaction: Bow Shinjo Sanetama when an Infantry unit is moving into or out of a battle he is in. The move is canceled if all the units in Shinjo Sanetama's army are Cavalry.
card.flavor: "Sanetama, to the east, and Yasamura, to the west. Our troops will protect the Empire, even without the Emperor to guide us." - Shinjo Yokatsu

card.name: Shinjo Shirasu
card.text:
Unicorn Clan Magistrate • Samurai • Cavalry
Limited: Bow Shinjo Shirasu. Issue an unrefusable challenge to a Dishonored Personality.
card.flavor: Temporary leader of the magistrates after the death of the Emerald Champion, Shirasu has become troubled with the cries of an Empire.

card.name: Shinjo Yasamura - exp
card.text:
Unicorn Clan Samurai • Cavalry • Tactician • Experienced • Unique
Draw a Fate card when this card enters play.
card.flavor: "Now that I know Destiny's price, I am ready to embrace it with open eyes and an open heart."

card.name: Shinobi
card.text: Reaction: Play immediately after a Ninja card has all costs paid to bring it into play. That card is not considered a Ninja card until it uses an ability or attaches a ninja-only card. Ninja action cards are not affected by this card.
card.flavor: Shinobi: the art of hiding in plain sight.

card.name: Shiryo no Asahina
card.text:
Crane Clan Ancestor • Unique
This Personality does not need to bow to lobby for the Imperial Favor. Items that require the discarding of the Imperial Favor can be attached to this Personality without discarding the Favor.
card.flavor: "The courageous heart has no room for revenge, Hoturi. Only forgiveness."

card.name: Shiryo no Asako
card.text:
Phoenix Clan Ancestor • Unique
Battle: Destroy this Personality to destroy any one opposing Shadowlands card. You may attach this Follower to any other Phoenix Personality at this battle. If none are available who will accept it, this Follower is destroyed with its Personality normally.
card.flavor: "We will rise again, but not in the form you know."

card.name: Shiryo no Ide
card.text:
Unicorn Clan Ancestor • Unique • Cavalry
This Personality gains 1F for each opposing nonhuman or creature Personality during battle.
card.flavor: "We are part of a great plan, but not the plan you think."

card.name: Shiryo no Ikoma

card.name: The Ancestral Home of the Lion
card.text: Open: Bow to give a Lion Personality +2 Force bonus for attacking until the end of the turn.
card.flavor:
Tsuko and Rokugan

When Toturi's army approached Otosan Uchi, two Lion armies were there. One, led by Ikoma Tsanuri, carried the banner of the Emperor, ready to fulfill their oaths to protect the Emperor at all costs. The other, led by Kitsu Motso, carried the banner of the Lion, ready to kill or die for the empire.

As he watched, the armies charged at each other with a thunderous cry. Discipline quickly descended into disorder, and Lion fought Lion, regardless of family or allegiance.

No longer able to stomach the bloodshed between the members of his former clan, Toturi charged his army into the midst of the battle as Junzo's army simply watched and laughed. Toturi's battle cry erupted from the middle of the fighting and a deep silence fell across the battlefield.

About to engage each other, Tsanuri and Motso both turned to look at Toturi, and the thousands of bloody Lions waited for a command - any command. Toturi raised his sword high and pointed it at Junzo.

"For Matsu Tsuko, and for Rokugan!"

Behind the the feral smiles of their three commanders, a single army turned towards the army of Yogo Junzo and the battle cry of ten thousand Lions, old and new, echoed through the walls of Otosan Uchi.

card.name: The Ruined Fortress of the Scorpion

card.flavor:
Kachiko's Bluff

Shadows moved along the hallways of the Imperial Palace preparing for the arrival of the army of the Seven Thunders. The Emperor stormed about the palace as all of his own preparations met with failure. Everywhere he turned, his guards were dead or missing. The gates were open and drawbridges dropped. He threw open a panel and found his wife and seized her by her kimono, lifting her high in the air. "You! You are the cause of all of this! I will kill you!"

She smiled. "You cannot. Only when the Thunders are assembled can you kill us. Every creature in the world has rules it must follow and you are no exception." She looked the Emperor, her gaze turning poison. "Killing me now violates laws that are greater than even your power."

The Emperor's fists clenched, his eyes burst with black fire and his voice rattled the foundations of the palace. He threw her to the floor and stormed away. Kachiko was still for a moment, then her body began to shudder from the strain of hiding her fear. "You were right about that, Yokuni," She whispered. "I pray you are wrong about the rest."

card.name: The Ruins of Isawa Castle
card.text: Reaction: Bow this card at any time at which a Kiho can be played. Search through your fate deck, retrieve any Kiho, and play it. Reshuffle the deck.

card.name: The Sacred Temple of the Phoenix
card.text:
Bow to produce five gold when bringing a spell or Shugenja into play.
Bow to produce seven gold when bringing a spell or Shugenja into play. The Shugenja involved gains the trait Shadowlands permanently, and you may not gain honor for bringing this card into play.
card.flavor:
The Last Master

On the night before the assault on Otosan Uchi, Isawa Kaede, filled with visions of doom and dark prophesy, fled from the camp into the night. She spoke to Tadaka for only a moment, and she told him of her dreams and visions. "He is calling me," she told him. When Tadaka asked her who was calling her, all Kaede could say was, "The Oracle. He calls me, Tadaka. He calls me."

On the walls of Otosan Uchi, the Master of Fire waited for his brothers and sisters. His mind finally eaten away by the corruption in his blood, he hurled black fire down upon his former Clan. The Elemental Masters, incomplete as they were, tried to stop his assault, but one by one they fell under the corrupt power of his fire. Only Isawa Tadaka had the strength to withstand the pain of his fire, and while the Master of Earth's magic distracted his cousin, Shiba Ujimitsu was able to strike down the fire Master.

Tsuke's blood was as black as midnight and burned Ujimitsu like flaming pitch. The Phoenix Champion screamed as he fell from the walls like a comet. He clung to life just long enough to whisper seven words to Shiba Tsukune, and put the Clan sword in her hands. Then he died. With a new-found fire in her eyes, she and Isawa Osugi lifted the bloody and burned Isawa Tadaka to his feet. They could only pray the Phoenix Thunder had the strength to hold on to life long enough to face the Dark Emperor within.

card.name: The Shadow Stronghold of the Bayushi

card.name: Bayushi Paneki - exp3

Limited: If it is your turn: Target a card in your hand and a card in another player's hand. Switch them.

card.name: The War Fortress of the Crab
card.text: Open: Bow to add +3 Strength to any Province until the end of the turn. This action may be performed in a battle in which you have no Units.
card.flavor:
The Two Deaths of Yakamo

When the armies of the Clans finally united under Yakamo and Toturi, the Crab Hero charged into the fray, his tetsubo and jade hand killing and crushing enemies as he went. Finally, his body bruised and bloodied, he saw the oni that stole his name. Yakamo kept his fury in check and advanced on the creature, but when it turned to look at him with his own face and eyes, he could contain himself no longer.

The duel was deadly and swift, and just when it seemed Yakamo had the upper hand, the oni's acrid blood sprayed into his eyes, blinding the hero with pain. He stumbled backward, swinging his testubo blindly, hoping to keep the oni at bay until he could recover. He heard the oni cry out in pain ad when his vision cleared, he saw Mirumoto Hitomi crushing the oni's head with her obsidian hand.

Yakamo stood, his body aching with every movement. Hitomi waited. Yakamo shook his head, "I cannot afford the luxury of killing you."

"I thought you were Kisada's son," she whispered, her voice filled with hate. "I suppose he is the coward I always suspected him to be."

Hitomi's taunt was successful. Yakamo charged her, but the fresh Dragon was too quick for the wounded Crab. His tetsubo was on the ground and her blade was at his throat in a moment. "I won't kill you now, but you'll always remember that I could have."

card.flavor:
And so they fall...

Fu Leng's grip held fast about Kachiko's throat. Doji Hoturi charged again, but the Dark Lord put his hand through the Crane's chest and watched the Crane fall back, his eyes full of pain and surprise.

Tadaka sent arrows of jade at the dark lord, who reflected them back at the Master of Earth, riddling his tainted body with purity.

Toturi was next. The dark lord caught Toturi's blade in his grip, and twisted it until Toturi lost his grip. Fu Leng smacked the ronin with the katana's pommel sending him back into the darkness.

Yakamo screamed out of the shadows of the throne room and ran forward, but Fu Leng changed the darkness about the hero into chains and bound Yakamo to the floor. At the door, Hitomi watched with the last black scroll and her obsidian hand ... and did nothing.

"You have failed, Scorpion," Fu Leng whispered to Kachiko. "I will kill your comrades and keep you as a trophy."

"Then take a good look at your trophy, dark one," she said. "For its the last look you'll get."

Only then did Fu Leng notice her black hair flowing freely over her shoulders. He looked down and saw the long needle hair pins in her hands ...
