card.name: Doji Domotai - exp3
card.text:
Crane Clan • Clan Champion • Samurai • Duelist • Experienced 3 • Unique • Loyal
Your defending Crane Clan Personalities at Domotai's location have a Force bonus equal to their Personal Honor.
Battle: Domotai challenges a target Personality opposing her. Destroy the duel's loser. The winner gains 3 Honor.

card.name: Doji Ayano
card.text: Crane Clan • Courtier • Samurai
card.flavor: "A Scorpion courtier can be a useful ally or a dangerous enemy - or both at the same time. Crane and Scorpion both draw power from the courts, and so we understand each other in a way no other clans in the Empire can."

card.name: Kakita Hideo
card.text: Crane Clan • Samurai • Duelist
card.flavor: In a land where questions or right and wrong are settled by a flash of steel, a Kakita-trained duelist can be the ultimate answer.

card.name: Doji Hakuseki
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Duelist • Magistrate
Limited: Target another player's Personality. His controller may choose to have you gain 3 Honor. If he does not choose this, the Personality can not use his abilities until your next turn begins.

card.name: Daidoji Eitoku
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Scout
While Eitoku is defending, enemy units can not assign or move to his battlefield after Infantry Maneuvers.

card.name: Daidoji Nagiko
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Unique
Battle: Target an enemy unit. Move Nagiko to the current battlefield. Ranged 3 Attack that must target a (legal) card in the target unit.

card.name: Doji Sesshu
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai
Sesshu has +2F and +2PH (even if out of play) while your Family Honor is 21 or more.

card.name: Kitsuki Taiko
card.text: Dragon Clan • Samurai • Magistrate
card.flavor: "In the years prior to and following the ascension of the Divine Empress, a group of young samurai of various clans came together by chance, unaware of the greater role they would play in the fate of the Empire..." - The Miya Records

card.name: Mirumoto Ichizo
card.text: Dragon Clan • Samurai • Duelist
card.flavor: "It is said that the swordmasters of the Dragon have but one peer: the duelists of the Kakita. Young Ichizo has made it a point to prove this perception wrong." - Matsu Yufu

card.name: Togashi Jomei
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Monk
If you have resolved a Kiho action this turn that Jomei performed, he can assign even if bowed, has +2F while bowed, and adds his Force to his unit's Force even if bowed.

card.name: Togashi Miyoko
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Monk • Defender of the Temples
If there is a Temple in play, Miyoko has +3F and can not assign to attack.

card.name: Togashi Satsu - exp4
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Clan Champion • Samurai • Monk • Shugenja • Cavalry • Duelist • Dragon • Experienced 4 • Unique • Loyal
Your Dragon Clan Personalities at Satsu's location have a Force bonus equal to the number of Rings you control.
Limited: Once per game, even if Satsu is dead: Search your Fate deck, hand or discard pile for a Ring. Show it. Put it into play or into your hand.

card.name: Akodo Shunori
card.text: Lion Clan • Samurai • Tactician
card.flavor: "War is more than tactics written in ancient tomes. War means the death of warriors who proudly fall to serve the Empire. My teachers say my star is bright, that I will soon lead a unit into battle. I do not wish my brothers in arms to die, but we must all do our duty."

card.name: Akodo Seiichi
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Tactician
Tactical Battle: Bow Seiichi: Bow each unit opposing him with lower total Force than Seiichi's Force.
card.flavor: "The Army of Fire was nothing compared to the might of the Lion! What gaigin could stand before the Right Hand of the Empress?"

card.name: Ikoma Akiyama
card.text: Lion Clan • Samurai • Poet • Historian While attacking, Akiyama has +1F for each honorably dead Personality you own.

card.name: Matsu Takeko
card.text: Lion Clan • Samurai • Hero

card.name: Matsu Yoshino - exp2
card.text:
Lion Clan • Clan Champion • Samurai • Tactician • Hero • Experienced 2 • Unique • Loyal
Your attacking Lion Clan Personalities at Yoshino's location have a Force bonus equal to their Personal Honor.
Tactical Battle: Destroy a target Personality with no attachments. You may then target and destroy an attachment.

card.name: Tsuruchi Kansuke
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Scout
Battle: Bow Kansuke: Ranged 3 Attack. If Kansuke or his target is dishonorable, the Attack has +2 strength and you may compare it to the target's base rather than current Force.

card.name: Moshi Euiko
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Water • Shugenja • Naval
While Euiko has a spell attached, she has the Fire keyword.
Reaction: Before targeting a Ranged Attack from one of your actions: Increase its strength by 1.

card.name: Tsuruchi Mitsuzuka
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai
Battle: Bow Mitsuzuka: Ranged 4 Attack. If this did not destroy its target, you may take an additional Battle action.

card.name: Yoritomo Eriko
card.text: Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Magistrate
card.flavor: "I serve a clan whose morals change with the seasons. I killed a man who may have been my father. I do not know who I am, but I know that my path is mine and mine alone."

card.name: Yoritomo Naizen - exp2
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Clan Champion • Samurai • Naval • Experienced 2 • Unique • Loyal
After one of your Mantis Clan Personalities in Naizen's army bows to pay a cost, if that Personality has not straightened this battle: Straighten him.
Battle: Even if Naizen is bowed: Move a target Personality to the current battlefield if there are any units in the enemy army there. If this moved Naizen, straighten him.

card.name: Yoritomo Saburo
card.text: Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Scout
card.flavor: "The War of Dark Fire is over, and the Empire is safe. Why then does the prophetess Kitsune Narako continue to warn of impending doom? What threat lies hidden on the horizon?"

card.name: Isawa Takesi
card.text: Phoenix Clan • Shugenja • Fire

card.name: Isawa Ochiai - exp
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Elemental Master • Shugenja • Fire • Duelist • Experienced • Unique • Loyal
Fire Shugenja at Ochiai's location need not bow as a cost of Fire actions they perform.
Open: Target another player's Personality. After the first time he assigns to attack this turn, Ochiai challenges him. The loser bows and can not straighten until after his controller's next Straighten Phase.

card.name: Shiba Miiko
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Samurai • Yojimbo
Your Personalities at Miiko's location have +1F for each of your Shugenja there.

card.name: Shiba Ikku
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Samurai • Yojimbo • Duelist
Reaction: Before Focus Effects resolve in a duel Ikku is in: Switch one of your focused cards with a Spell from your hand.

card.name: Isawa Oharu
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Shugenja • Air
Reaction: After an action from one of Oharu's Spells resolves, even if she is bowed: Straighten her. Give her a -1C Exhaustion token.

card.name: Isawa Umeko
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Air • Shugenja
Battle: Bow Umeko: Ranged Attack with strength equal to her Personal Honor.

card.name: Bayushi Nomen
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Courtier
Actions performed by Personalities who were dishonorable when the action was announced can not target Nomen or Personalities in Nomen's army.

card.name: Bayushi Paneki - exp4
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Clan Champion • Samurai • Tactician • Hero • Experienced 4 • Unique • Loyal
After another player's action resolves that targeted one or more Personalities at Paneki's location: The player loses 1 Honor.
Battle: Target a Personality; if he is a Courtier, he may be at any location. Destroy him if he is Dishonorable. Dishonor him.

card.name: Bayushi Eisaku
card.text: Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Kensai • Bitter Lies
card.flavor: "The way of Bitter Lies is to embrace the madness of a fight. There is no reason, no elegance, to be found in battle - only confusion, blood, and death. Embrace it and you will find victory."

card.name: Shosuro Uyeda
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Courtier
Political Limited: Bow Uyeda: Target a dishonorable Personality. His controller loses 2 Honor.

card.name: Bayushi Kurumi
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Courtier
Political Battle: Even if Kurumi is not at the current battlefield, bow her: Target a Personality. His controller may dishonor him. If he did not become dishonorable (or was already dishonorable), give him -3F.
card.flavor: "Indeed, Cranes are useful friends. But I can offer you so much more...."

card.name: Bayushi Hisoka
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Courtier • Unique
After Hisoka enters play: Target a card. While Hisoka remains in play, after each time that card bows, its controller loses 2 Honor.

card.name: Bayushi Hisato
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Samurai
Hisato can not attach Items, except Armor and Weapons.
Battle: If Hisato is at a battlefield and has only one Follower or no Followers: Move him to another battlefield.

card.name: Moto Suren
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Cavalry
Battle: If Suren is opposed: Target a Personality at any battlefield. Bow him or destroy one of his attachments.

card.name: Daigotsu - exp2
card.text:
Spider Clan • Clan Champion • Shugenja • Duelist • Shadowlands • Experienced 2 • Unique • Loyal
Lose 20 Honor.
Personalities opposing Daigotsu have a Force penalty equal to their Personal Honor.
Battle/Open: Even if Daigotsu is bowed: Straighten a target Shadowlands Personality and bow or straighten a target Shadowlands card.

card.name: Michio
card.text:
Spider Clan • Monk
Reaction: After a Kiho action resolves, even if Michio is bowed: Bow or straighten a target Personality who performed it.

card.name: Chuda Hiroe
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Shugenja
After Hiroe enters play: Lose 4 Honor.
card.flavor: "The Empress thinks that she can keep us tamed now that she knows our nature. All she has done is unleash us."

card.name: Chuda Rintaro
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shugenja • Shadowlands
Open: Target another player's Personality: After each time he assigns this turn, he suffers -2F/-1C and gains the Shadowlands keyword (until the end of the turn).

card.name: Moto Chagatai - exp5
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Clan Champion • Samurai • Tacticia • Cavalry • The Khan • Experienced 5 • Unique • Loyal
Before the first time each phase another player's card's effect bows a Unicorn Clan Personality at Chagatai's location: Negate the bowing.
Battle: Target one or two Personalities opposing Chagatai. The enemy leader may move one or both home. If one or both still oppose Chagatai, the enemy leader must choose one of the targets (even at home), who is destroyed.

card.name: Moto Taban
card.text: Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Scout
card.flavor: "During the Lion Clan's march to Shiro Moto, he tailed the Lion army, risking capture to watch his enemies' movements. He is glad to serve his Clan, though he worries that he will never see combat if he excels in his duties." - Moto Hideyo

card.name: Shinjo Meikoku
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry
Meikoku has Tactician while opposed by an Infantry Personality.

card.name: Utaku Kohana
card.text: Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Battle Maiden
card.flavor: Kohana shares a zest for life that cannot be subdued by the months spent in battle. She remains filled with hope and optimism despite the losses the Unicorn have suffered since her gempukku.

card.name: Pokku
card.text:
Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Goblin • Scout
After Pokku enters play: Lose 3 Honor.
card.flavor: "He is an ugly, wretched little creature that assumes far too much. Still, he has proven useful from time to time. I cannot bring myself to kill him." - Chuda Hiroe

card.name: Kodomo
card.text:
Ronin • Scout
When Kodomo performs a Recon action, once per turn: You may waive any cost of bowing her.

card.name: Warrior Challenge
card.text: Battle: Target one of your unbowed Personalities: He challenges a target Personality opposing him. Destroy the loser. The winner's controller takes the Imperial Favor.

card.name: Unfortunate Incident
card.text:
Political
Limited: Target another player with higher Family Honor than yours. He has shamed his clan, and loses 5 Honor. Until the game ends, he may ignore Honor Requirements when bringing Personalities into play.
card.flavor: "I heard of your kinsman's untimely death, and I mourn him as well. I can only try to rule as he would have."

card.name: Raze to the Ground
card.text: Limited: Your raiders destroy a target Holding controlled by a player with three or more Holdings in play.

card.name: Shout of Defiance
card.text:
You may have up to 6 copies of this card in your deck.
Shout Heroic Battle: Target one of your Personalities: He gains +1F, an additional +1F if he is a Hero, and an addtional +1F if he is opposed.

card.name: Combined Efforts
card.text: Reaction: After engaging, if your current army contains any allying units: Target one or two units in your army. The targets, and all allying units in your army, do not bow from this battle's resolution.

card.name: Shout of Challenge
card.text: Shout Heroic Battle: Target one of your opposed Personalities who has been targeted by a Heroic action this turn: Move one of your target units to the current battlefield. If it moved, straighten the unit and give its Personality +1F.

card.name: Shout of Victory
card.text: Shout Heroic Battle: Target one of your Personalities who has been targeted by a Shout action this turn: He gains +3F. Bow a target Personality opposing him with lower Force. Destroy that target if your Personality has performed two or more other Shout actions with different titles from each other in this battle.

card.name: Never Stand Alone
card.text:
Open: Remove a target Personality in a discard pile from the game.
Limited: Target a discarded (not dead) Personality you own. Put the Personality face-up in one of your provinces, discarding a card from it if necessary.
card.flavor: "MIRUMOTO!"

card.name: Greater Sacrifice
card.text: Battle: Destroy your target unbowed Samurai Personality: Destroy a target enemy unit with total Force less than or equal to your Samurai's unit's total Force, plus your Samurai's Personal Honor if your Family Honor is higher than its starting value.
card.flavor: Accepting one's death can buy life for many.

card.name: Forewarning
card.text:
Reaction: Before an Event resolves: Its effects do not happen.
Battle: Target your Personality: Destroy a target Terrain.
card.flavor: "There are prophets among us, for the first time in centuries," the Voice of the Empress said. "We wish to hear their warnings."

card.name: The Crab's Strength
card.text: Battle: Target one of your opposed Crab Clan Personalities: Give him +4F. Until the battle ends, actions taken by enemy players that target him have the additional cost, "Discard a card."

card.name: The Crane's Strength
card.text: Battle: Target one of your Crane Clan Personalities: Destroy a target Personality or Follower opposing him with no attached Followers and Force less than your Personality's Personal Honor plus two.

card.name: The Dragon's Strength
card.text: Battle: Target one of your opposed Dragon Clan Personalities: Look at the top 5 cards of your Fate deck. If one of those is a Ring, you may show it, put it in your hand, and gain 2 Honor.

card.name: The Lion's Strength
card.text: Battle: Target one of your opposed Lion Clan Personalities: Target a Personality not at the current battlefield. Move him to the current battlefield. Straighten him if you do not control him.

card.name: The Mantis's Strength
card.text: Battle: Target one of your unbowed Mantis Clan Personalities: Ranged Attack with strength equal to his Chi, and +2 strength if he is a Magistrate.

card.name: The Phoenix's Strength
card.text: Battle: Target one of your opposed Phoenix Clan Shugenja: Attach a Spell to him (paying all costs). You may take an additional Battle action from the Spell.

card.name: The Scorpion's Strength
card.text: Battle: Target one of your Scorpion Clan Personalities: Bow, then move home, a target dishonorable Personality opposing him. You may target and dishonor a Personality in the enemy army.

card.name: The Spider's Strength
card.text: Fear Battle: Target one of your opposed Spider Clan Personalities: Give him a Force bonus equal to the Force of a target bowed Personality at his battlefield. Reduce the bowed Personality's Force to 0.

card.name: The Unicorn's Strength
card.text: Battle: Target one of your opposed Unicorn Clan Personalities: Target a Personality or Follower opposing him with less Force. Reduce the opposing target's Force to 0.

card.name: Wandering Scout
card.text:
Cavalry • Scout
Battle: Even if this card is bowed: Straighten it.
card.flavor: "They travel in front of the armies and watch for the enemy. There are few songs of valorous scouts. It is a necessary, lonely duty." - Hiruma Todori

card.name: Sword of Victory
card.text:
Weapon
After a Personality is destroyed for losing a duel to this Personality, or after battle resolution destroys one or more Personalities while this card is in the winning army: Give this card a +2F token.

Armor • Unique

Armor • Unique
This Personality has a minimum Chi of 5.
Can only attach to a Crane Clan Personality.

Political Limited: Bow this card: Take the Imperial Favor.

card.name: Koutetsu Mukei

Armor • Unique
This Personality has a minimum Chi of 5.

After this Personality wins a duel: Give him a +2F token.
Open: Bow this card: Straighten a target Ring.

card.text:
Armor • Unique
This Personality has a minimum Chi of 5.

Battle: Move one of the Defender's target Personalities to the current battlefield. If he moved, straighten him and gain 2 Honor.

card.name: Koutetsu Unabara

This Personality has a minimum Chi of 5.

This Personality has a minimum Chi of 5.

Battle: Straighten this Personality: Reduce a target enemy Personality's Force to 0.

card.name: Koutetsu Chikara
card.text:
Armor • Unique
This Personality has a minimum Chi of 5.
Can only attach to a Unicorn Clan Personality.
Battle: Target an enemy unit with less total Force than this unit. Move the enemy unit home. Bow it if it moved.

card.name: The Seventh Tower
card.text: Battle: Target one of your Personalities and discard a card: Destroy a target unit opposing him with less total Force than your Personality's Force.

card.name: Razor of the Dawn Castle
card.text: Before another player's card's effect destroys one of your Samurai: Once per turn, you may delay the destruction until the current turn ends.

card.name: Mountain's Shadow Dojo
card.text: Battle: Even if this Stronghold is bowed, target one of your Crane Clan Samurai at the current battlefield: Ranged 3 Attack. Move him home or to another battlefield.

card.name: Ayamari
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Kenku • Creature • Nonhuman • Ninja
Battle: Once per battle: Bow a target Personality with lower Chi opposing Ayamari. Ayamari may then fly away, moving to another location.
card.flavor: Curiosity can lead the kenku to many strange activities.

card.name: The Maw's Grave
card.text:
Your Nonhuman Personalities have +1F. You do not gain or lose Honor. You can not take Political actions.
Open: Bow this Stronghold: Bring a target dead Shadowlands Nonhuman Personality you own into play, waiving costs. At the end of the turn, remove it from the game.

card.name: Mountain Summit Temple
card.text: Limited: Bow one of your target Monk Personalities: Put one of your Rings from your hand into play, from play into your hand, or from your discard pile into your hand.

card.name: Sushi Stand
card.text:
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Limited: Bow this card: Show the top card of your Fate deck. You may pay Gold equal to its Focus Value. If you do so, put it in your hand and give control of this card to the player on your left. Otherwise, put the Fate card on the bottom of your deck.

card.name: Crossroads Fortress
card.text: Reaction: After you assign an attacking unit, discard a card: Draw a card.

card.name: Eastern Hub Port
card.text:
Equipping is a Battle/Open action for you.
After the first Battle action resolves each turn that attached a card to one of your Personalities: You may take an additional Battle action.

card.name: Kyuden Ashinagabachi
card.text: After each of your Ranged Attacks resolves: If it did not destroy its target, reduce the target's Force by the Ranged Attack's strength.

card.name: Kyuden Asako
card.text:
Reaction: After one of your Temples bows: Straighten one of your target Shugenja or Monks.
Open: Bow one of your target Shugenja or Monks: Straighten one of your target Temples.

card.name: The Agasha Foundries
card.text:
Equipping Spells that share an elemental keyword with their Shugenja is an Open action for you.
Reaction: Even if this Stronghold is bowed, after a Shugenja bows as a cost of performing an action on a Spell: Straighten him.

card.name: Deception's Veil Dojo
card.text: Political Limited: Bow one of your target Courtiers: Target another player's Personality. That player may choose to dishonor him (even if already dishonorable). If he chooses not to, he loses 3 Honor and may ignore Honor Requirements when playing Personalities until the end of the game.

card.name: Kyuden Wasuremono
card.text: Battle: Bow one of your target Samurai or Ninja Personalities: Give a target Personality opposing him Force and Chi penalties equal to one less than your Personality's Chi.

card.name: Strict Training
card.text: Battle: Bow a target Personality in your army: Bow a target Personality with lower Chi opposing him.
card.flavor: Straighten your posture! Remember your lessons! Follow them, or you will perish at the first sign of battle!

card.name: The Ruined City
card.text:
You do not lose Honor from Fate and Spider Clan cards you own.
Your Spider Clan Personalities have the ability, "Battle: Bow a target unit with zero total Force or with the lowest non-zero total Force (including ties) among all units at the current battlefield."

card.name: The Utaku Plains
card.text:
Your Personalities have +1 PH while in play.
Battle: Choose your performing Personality: Reduce the Force of a target enemy Personality or Follower by your Personality's Personal Honor.
card.flavor: The honor of the Utaku is unquestionable.

card.name: The Temple of Death
card.text:
Battle: Remove a Personality in any discard pile from the game: Bow a target Personality.
Open: Remove a Personality in any discard pile from the game: Straighten a target Personality.

card.name: Horiuchi Rikako
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Shugenja • Unique • Loyal • Advisor from the Shogun
Battle: Move Rikako to the current battlefield. Straighten a card in your army there.
Limited: Bow Rikako: Look at the top four cards of your Fate Deck. If one is an Item, show it and put it in your hand. Put the rest back in any order.

card.name: Writ of the Herald
card.text:
Writ
Pay 2 less Gold for attaching this card to a Courtier or Magistrate, or 4 less Gold for attaching it to an Imperial or Shogun Personality.
Open: Destroy this card: Take the Imperial Favor.
card.flavor: "Go forth, heralds, and spread the word across the Empire." - Miya Shoin

card.name: Arrival of the Phoenix
card.text: Until your second Events Phase from now, Samurai in armies with Shugenja have +2F, and Shugenja need not bow as a cost of performing actions on Spells and Kihos while in an army with a Samurai.
card.flavor: Isawa Ochiai appeared over the capital. "No more!" her voice boomed across the city. "This city shall not fall as Otosan Uchi did!"

card.name: Utaku Genshi
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Battle Maiden
Reaction: After an Attack Phase ends in which another player destroyed any of your provinces, even if Genshi is bowed: Straighten her. Declare an additional Attack Phase. No unit other than her unit can assign or move to attack that phase.

card.name: Favor of the Jade Champion
card.text: After the next time this game a non-Maho action on an opposed Spell or Shugenja resolves: The Spell's or Shugenja's controller gains the Imperial Favor and 2 Honor. He may straighten all Shugenja who performed the action.
card.flavor: Only those who carry the kami's favor can hope for victory.

card.name: Mantle of the Jade Champion - exp
card.text:
Experienced • Unique
Attaches to a Jade Champion paying 4 less Gold. This card has a Force bonus equal to the highest Focus Value of any Spell in this unit.
Reaction: Before paying costs of an action on a Spell or Kiho, bow this card: Waive any cost of bowing this Personality.

card.name: Trials of Jade
card.text: Reaction: After you resolve an Open, Limited or Battle action with an element keyword: Take an addtional action of the same type with an element keyword.
card.flavor: A true Jade Champion requires skill and knowledge, precision and understanding. Power is never enough.

card.name: The Race Begins
card.text: If any other player has more provinces and higher Honor than you, gain a province to the left of your leftmost province.
card.flavor: In the year 1169, following the Khan's march on the capital, the Great Clans looked to the throne and wondered who should sit upon it.

card.name: Soul of Bushido
card.text: Open: Until the end of the turn, any player gains 1 Honor after each time he resolves a Bushido Virtue action and loses 3 Honor after he resolves a Dark Virtue action.
card.flavor: Without bushido, a bushi is nothing more than a fool with a sword.

card.name: Power of the Masters
card.text: Until the end of the game, while you control exactly five Elemental Masters with five different element keywords betwee them, each of your Elemental Master Personalities has the ability "Open: Bow a target Personality."

card.name: The Throne Stands Empty
card.text: The player with the Imperial Favor discards it. Until your second Events Phase from now, no player can take the Favor and Personalities cannot lobby. Dishonor Moto Chagatai.

card.name: City Gate
card.text:
Castle • City
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Battle: If you have exactly one province, bow this card: Move home a target Personality attacking your Province.

card.name: Clan Estate
card.text: Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold, or 3 Gold if paying for a Cavalry card.
card.flavor: "You want me to help you gather information?" Kohana said suspiciously. "Why should I trust you, Scorpion?" "Because we have both seen the Second Prophecy," Eisaku said. "We both fear for the Empire."

card.name: Temple of the Righteous Emperor
card.text:
Temple • Singular
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Reaction: Before a player gains Honor from an Action card during the Attack Phase: Negate the Honor gain. The player draws a card.

Battle: Destroy a target Terrain, or a target Region attached to this battlefield's province. If you destroyed a Terrain, you may take an additional Battle action to play a Terrain from your hand.

card.name: Shinjo Kirita
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Gunso
Open: Even if Kirita is bowed: Straighten him.

card.name: Utaku Jisoo
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Battle Maiden
Battle: Bow Jisoo: Ranged Attack with strength equal to her Personal Honor. Gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "She is wild and mischievous and furious on the battlefield. I fear she may never grow up." - Utaku Yu-Pan

card.name: Utaku Kohana - exp
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Battle Maiden • Paragon • Experienced • Unique
After the resolution of an action which gave a Force penalty to any enemy cards at the current battlefield, if Kohana is there: Gain 1 Honor.
Battle: Bow Kohana: Bow a target enemy Personality with lower Personal Honor.
card.flavor: "Sisters, charge with me!"

card.name: Fubiri no Oni
card.text:
Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Oni
After Fuburi enters play: Lose 6 Honor.
Limited: Destroy one of your Holdings: Create a Shadowlands, Nonhuman, Oni Personality with Force and Chi each equal to the Holding's base Gold Cost stat. Lose 4 Honor.

card.name: Glukku
card.text:
Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Goblin • Scout
After Glukku enters play: Lose 4 Honor.
card.flavor: The Yasuki licked his lips nervously. "Tell your master that I know where... where what he wants is located. I can tell him everything he wants to know, if the price is right.

card.name: Shikibu no Oni - exp
card.text:
Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Oni • Overlord • Experienced Oni no Shikibu • Unique
After Shikibu enters play: Lose 8 Honor.
Before an action destroys Shikibu: Negate the destruction. If the destruction fails, choose one of your Personalities at Shikibu's location; he is consumed by Jigoku. Remove the chosen Personality from the game.

card.name: Kimogen
card.text:
Monk • Hero • Order of Heroes
Reaction: After you destroy one or more provinces or units by winning a battle, bow Kimogen: Give a target Personality in your army a +3F Valor token and gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "Our order seeks out those with potential and helps them unlock the greatness within their spirit."

card.name: Kuri
card.text:
Naval • Pirate • Smuggler
Equipping is an Open action for you.
Limited: Discard an Item from your hand: Straighten a target Holding.
card.flavor: "You want me to face an unknown enemy and certain death, with no promise of glory? Well... what are you paying?"

card.name: Kuronada
card.text: Ronin • Samurai • Duelist • Kensai • Tactician • Hero
card.flavor: Samurai without a lord to serve, the ronin of Rokugan possess a freedom others cannot match, but they have none of that which the clans grant to their vassals. For many, but not all, freedom eventually proves insufficient in the face of hunger.

card.name: Seiko
card.text:
Ronin • Ninja
After Seiko enters play: Lose 2 Honor.
Reaction: When an action would target Seiko: It instead targets another copy of Seiko or Yoshe that you control, if legal.
card.flavor: "I have heard rumors of a pair of warriors, bitter enemies, whose skills are incomparable." - Utagawa

card.name: Yoshe
card.text:
Ronin • Samurai
After Yoshe enters play: Lose 2 Honor.
Reaction: Before another player's action resolves that targeted Yoshe, bow all unbowed cards in Yoshe's unit: Negate the action's effects.
card.flavor: "If they could turn their enmity aside, they would be a tremendous asset to our cause." - Utagawa

card.name: Fortified Fields
card.text:
(This card is not Singular.)
At this province's battlefields, the Attacker may not take Battle actions before the Defender's first opportunity to take a Battle action or pass.
card.flavor: The commander grimaced as he surveyed the field. "If we get through that," he said, "we deserve the prize on the other side."

card.name: Holy Site
card.text:
Temple • Unique
This province does not hold Dynasty cards.
Reaction: Before battle resolution or before an action or trait resolves, destroy this card: Negate this Province's destruction from the resolution, or action's or trait's effects.
card.flavor: "Cross this threshold with malice, samurai, and your soul is imperiled forever."

card.name: Aggressive Landing
card.text: Battle: Target your Naval Personality: Give him +1F. You may take an additional Battle action.
card.flavor: The Mantis are the undisputed masters of the sea. As most of warfare occurs on the mainland, they are accustomed to rapid deployment.

card.name: Beloved of the Clan
card.text:
Political
Limited: Until your next turn begins, reduce Honor gains from Reaction, Limited, and Open actions by 1 (minimum 0).
Battle: If any enemy units are at the current battlefield: Move your target Personality there. Straighten him if he moved.
card.flavor: She smiled, and the court seemed to brighten in response.

card.name: Decisive Strike
card.text: Reaction: After a Dynasty Phase ends, if you have 30 or more Honor, lose 10 Honor: Draw one card for each player in the game. You may straighten one or more of your units up to the number of cards you drew.
card.flavor: "Swift can defeat strength as often as not."

card.name: Defensive Tactics
card.text: Tactical Battle: Target your Tactician: Set the Force of each Personality at the current battlefield to the Personality's own Chi.

card.name: Deftly Wielded
card.text: Battle: Attach a Weapon from your hand to your target Kensai Personality, paying 3 less Gold. If this attached a Weapon, you may target and bow another player's Weapon or Personality without Weapons.
card.flavor: "My blade and I are one!"

card.name: Desperate Plea
card.text:
Unique
Political Limited: Gain 5 Honor. Permanently reduce the strength of each of your provinces by 5. After your next Events Phase begins, lose 5 Honor; effects do not negate or reduce this loss.

card.name: Entangling Terrain
card.text: Terrain Battle: Before this battle's resolution, straighten each bowed Personality and Follower at this battlefield. After this battle's resolution, destroy each card this straightened.
card.flavor: "This cannot be natural!" the samurai cursed.

card.name: Flame of Truth
card.text: Fire Kiho Battle: Bow your target Shugenja: Ranged 4 Attack. Gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: Without Satsu's visions, the Dragon were forced to seek an inner strength, just as their Champion had always asked of them.

card.name: Flanked by Nightmares
card.text: Battle: If your current army has more units than the current enemy army, bow your target Shadowlands Personality: The enemy leader targets and destroys a Personality in his current army.
card.flavor: "There are rumors of a new illness, perhaps even a plague, striking rural settlements. I wish to know if this is true." - Kuni Daigo, Jade Champion

card.name: Gentle Blade of Winter
card.text: Kata Limited: Put this card into play in your home. Discard any other Kata cards you control. While this card is in play, you have the ability, "Reaction: After a Battle action resolves, if it was performed by one of your Personalities who now has a Weapon: Give a target enemy Personality or Follower -3F."

card.name: Hand of Osano-Wo
card.text:
Thunder • Kiho
Battle: Target your unbowed Monk, and bow him unless he is Tattooed: Destroy a target enemy attachment. If its Personality now has no Followers, you may make a Ranged 3 Attack targeting him.
card.flavor: "If one understands the nature of the elements, their power can be borrowed for a short time." - Togashi Miyoko

card.name: Hateful Curse
card.text: Kiho Maho Limited: Dishonor your target unbowed Shugenja: Bow a target Personality. Lose 2 Honor.

card.name: Hold!
card.text: Reaction: Before another player's action's resolution, target your unbowed Commander at the current battlefield: Choose one of your Personalities there. Choose whether to negate his bowing or his movement from that action.
card.flavor: "We shall hold until the last moment, and then unleash the mountain's fury upon them!"

card.name: Ideal Grounds
card.text: Recon Open: Target your unbowed Scout, and bow him if he is not Crab Clan: Target a province. Your Personalities and Followers at the target province's battlefields have +1F. All other Personalities and Followers there have -1F.

card.name: Keeping Enemies Close
card.text: Recon Open: Target your unbowed Scout, and bow him if he is not Mantis Clan: Target a province. Your Personalities have Naval while at that province's battlefield.

card.name: Laborious Effort
card.text: Battle: Target your Samurai Personality, and bow your target Artisan at any location: Look at the top 5 cards of your Fate deck. If one of them is a Weapon, you may attach it to the Samurai. You may take an additional Battle action.

card.name: Let Them Run
card.text: Reaction: After a Combat Segment ends: Move home all bowed Personalities at the current battlefield.
card.flavor: "They've lost. Why should I care if they stay or go?" - Hida Sozen

card.name: Might of Paragons
card.text: Open: Before each time another player's action resolves, if it targeted one or more of your Paragon Personalities, you gain 1 Honor, and each of those targeted Paragons gains +1F.

card.name: Musha Shugyo
card.text:
Unique
Limited: Target your Samurai Personality: Until the end of the game, he may not refuse challenges, you must declare a normal attack every turn and assign him (if legal), and you gain 2 Honor after each time he wins a duel or his army wins a battle against an enemy army.

card.name: My Ally's Strength
card.text: Reaction: After one of your Personalities is destroyed: Give a target Personality with a different Clan alignment a Force bonus equal to the destroyed Personality's base Force.

card.name: No Escape
card.text: Battle: Target your unbowed Magistrate, and bow him if he is not Scorpion Clan: Reduce a target enemy Personality's Force to his own Personal Honor. If he is dishonorable, destroy his attachments.
card.flavor: "The Kuroiban will be no more." - Chuda Mishime

card.name: Old Rivalries
card.text:
Unique
Battle: Target two of your unbowed Personalities: Each gains +1F, and during this battle's resolution, each contributes his own Force to his unit's Force even if bowed.

card.name: Only the Well-Trained Listen
card.text: Battle: Target your Commander or Tactician and bow one or more of your target Followers: Target an enemy unit with lower total Force than the total Force of the Followers you targeted. If this action bowed them, destroy that unit.
card.flavor: "Hold to your orders, and the day will be ours!"

card.name: Peaceful Interlude
card.text: Limited: After each battle resolution in which you destroyed one or more Provinces or units as the winner, you may target a Personality; if you do, dishonor him, and his controller loses 2 Honor.
card.flavor: Sometimes, public opinion can turn on victorious warriors.

card.name: Political Influence
card.text: Political Battle: Bow your target Courtier: Target one to three enemy Personalities. Reduce each one's Force by your Courtier's Personal Honor or Chi (you choose). Gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "If we lose ourselves, we lose everything."

card.name: Powerful Blow
card.text: Battle: Bow your target Commander: Destroy a target enemy unit with fewer Followers than your Commander's unit.

card.name: Regroup and Redeploy
card.text: Battle: If you control any opposed Personalities at the current battlefield: Move a target Personality there. Straighten him if he moved.
card.flavor: "The Empire is greater than any one man, even an Emperor. Rokugan will exist so long as man exists." - Omen

card.name: Reprimand
card.text: Political Open: Target another player's Personality with one or more unbowed attachments. His controller may choose to bow all attachments in that Personality's unit. If he does not choose this, gain 3 Honor.
card.flavor: "Do not give me excuses! We will not fail now!" - Bayushi Nomen

card.name: Resurgence
card.text: Battle: Destroy your target opposed Samurai Personality: Move one to three target Personalities in your home to the current battlefield. Straighten all Personalities this moved.

card.name: Roaring to Shake Heaven
card.text: Fear Battle: Target your Samurai Personality: Give all Personalities and Followers in the current enemy army -1F.
card.flavor: "We are the Lion! Let all of Rokugan know that we stand ready to serve the Emperor and Empire!" - Akodo Shigetoshi

card.name: Sacrificial Lands
card.text: Limited: Destroy your rightmost province: Draw one card for each player in the game. You may straighten one or more of your units up to the number of cards you drew.

card.name: Shelter for Refugees
card.text: Reaction: After you destroy a province as the Attacker: Bring a target non-Unique Holding in your discard pile into play, bowed.
card.flavor: "More than warriors pay the price of war. The effects reach far and cost much." - Asahina Hira

card.name: Silent Rot
card.text:
Ninja
Battle: Target your unbowed Ninja: Target an enemy card. Bow it if it has no attachments. Destroy it if it has any Poison tokens.
card.flavor:
Death walks silently
A hidden blade or poison
Ends all your worries

card.name: Stalemate
card.text: Battle: Target an enemy Personality. You may take an additional Battle action after this one. Bow him after the next time this turn an action resolves that he performed.
card.flavor: "Please. Spare me the effort cleaning you off of my blade." - Kakita Hideshi

card.name: Stolen Blade
card.text: Battle/Open: Dishonor your target unbowed Personality: Target an Item in your hand: Attach it to the Personality, reducing the Gold cost to attach it by the Personality's Chi.
card.flavor: "It cuts as well as my own."

card.name: Strength in Simplicity
card.text: Battle: Target your opposed Personality: Give the current battlefield's province +3 strength or -3 strength.
card.flavor: "Sometimes the best tactic is to not overthink the battle. Have faith in the strength of your men. Let them show you to be a genius." - Hida Sozen

card.name: Sublime Peacock Stance
card.text: Battle: Bow a Weapon attached to your target opposed Personality: Gain 3 Honor.
card.flavor: "Our lord's divinity is lost. The Empire stands upon a precipice, and the Heavens judge the actions of all men. The time for introspection must pass!" - Mirumoto Mareshi

card.name: Subtle Reminder
card.text: Battle: Target your unbowed Magistrate, and bow him if he is not Mantis Clan: Bow a target enemy Personality with lower Personal Honor than your Magistrate's Chi. The enemy leader discards a card from his hand.
card.flavor: "Remember your place. You are the informant, I am the magistrate."

card.name: Swift Darkness
card.text: Ninja Battle: Move your target opposed Ninja Personality home: Move one or more other target Ninja Personalities in your home to the current battlefield.
card.flavor: "When one threat departs, the guards think that they have chased it off. Amusing, yes?" - Bayushi Kasata

card.name: Threat of Execution
card.text: Battle: Target your unbowed Magistrate, and bow him unless he is Crane Clan: Bow a target Personality with lower Personal Honor than your Magistrate's Chi. You may target and bow a dishonorable Personality.
card.flavor: Some crimes demand worse than seppuku.

card.name: Tiger Climbing Mountain
card.text:
Kiho
Battle: Target your unbowed Monk: Move a target enemy Personality home. Give your Monk +2F. Lose 3 Honor.
card.flavor: The Togashi order of tattooed monks learned much from fighting Chosai's minions.

card.name: Underhanded Attack
card.text: Recon Open: Target your unbowed Scout, and bow him if he is not Crane Clan: Target a province. After engaging in a battle at its battlefield, all your Scout Personalities there have the ability, "Battle: Move to an adjacent battlefield" while they remain there.

card.name: Undermining Command
card.text: Political Open: Target your unbowed Courtier: Reduce a target Personality's Force by the Force of one of his target Followers or Items. If this targeted another player's Item, put it in its owner's hand.

card.name: Undignified Death
card.text: Battle: Target your unbowed Personality: Destroy a target enemy Personality without attachments and with a lower base Gold Cost. The destroyed Personality contributes Force to this battle's enemy army even while he is dead (only if the army has one or more units).

card.name: Unpleasant Discovery
card.text: Battle: Target your unbowed opposed Magistrate, and bow him if he is not Dragon Clan: Look at the top five cards of your deck. You may put two of them in your hand. Put the rest on top of the deck in any order.
card.flavor: "This monk is Tainted," Agito growled.

card.name: Victory March
card.text: Terrain Battle: Before this battle's resolution, if there are any enemy units at the current battlefield, your units do not bow from this battle's resolution.
card.flavor: "Tell your children stories of your victory and all it entails, that they may take pride in them, and learn from them." - Ikoma Otemi

card.name: Yakamo's End
card.text: Terrain Battle: While this card is in play, negate the straightening of any cards at its battlefield.
card.flavor: Lord Sun lay on the broken and destroyed ground. With a heaving breath he spoke his last words.

card.name: Adepts of Mighty Pokku
card.text:
Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Goblin
After this card enters play: Lose 4 Honor.
Battle: Target an enemy attachment. Transfer it to this Personality or destroy it.
card.flavor: "Bakemono always treated like jokes, like throw-away troops! No more!" - Pokku

card.name: Dojo Applicants
card.text: Limited: If this Personality is a Kensai: Look at the top four cards of your deck. If one is a Weapon, you may bow this card; if you do, you may attach the Weapon to this Kensai, paying 3 less Gold.
card.flavor: "Trust in steel. All else will fail you."

card.name: Imperial City Guards
card.text:
Imperial
This card has -3F while this Personality is dishonorable.
card.flavor: It is a prestigious duty on the path to greater and better things.

card.name: Seppun Miharu
card.text:
Imperial • Unique
Ranged Attacks targeting cards in this unit have -3 strength.
Reaction: Before a unit moves to or from this card's location: Negate the movement.

card.name: Traveling Smugglers
card.text: Battle: If this Personality is opposed, bow this card: Give him +3F.
card.flavor: "No clan would admit to doing business with them, but war leads many to ask few questions." - Yoritomo Utemaro

card.name: Wakened Dead
card.text:
Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Undead
After this card enters play: Lose 4 Honor.
After each time a Fear or Maho effect bows one or more enemy cards at this battlefield: Give this card +1F for each card that effect bowed.
Fear Battle: Bow a target enemy Follower.

card.name: Wandering Ronin
card.text:
Ronin
Open: Even if this card is bowed: Straighten it and transfer it to another one of your target Personalities.

card.name: Armor of Light
card.text:
Armor • Unique
Can only attach to a Samurai.
Reaction: Before another player's action starts to resolve, if a Follower or Item bowed to pay the action's cost: Negate the action's effects on this Personality.

card.name: Blessed Tessen
card.text:
Tessen
Attaches to a Courtier or Artisan paying 2 less Gold.
Reaction: After another player's action targets this Personality, bow this card: Gain 2 Honor after the action's resolution.
card.flavor: "Touched once by the Empress, it forever bears the blessing of her divinity." - Doji Ayano

card.name: Eku
card.text:
Weapon
Battle: If this Personality is Naval: Give him +2F.
card.flavor: "The Mantis army can only attack the coast for their first assault, yet that is no limitation at all. They land with lightning speed exactly where you do not expect them. It is better to confront them on the mainland than attempt to stop their arrival." - Akodo Hijikata

card.name: Footman's Pike
card.text:
Weapon • Unique
Attacking enemy Personalities can not assign to this Personality's battlefield during Cavalry Maneuvers.
Battle: Bow this card: Destroy a target Cavalry card.

card.name: Katana of Twilight
card.text:
Weapon • Unique
Focus Effect: After this duel ends, if your Personality won it, draw a card.
Reaction: After this Personality wins a duel: Draw a card.

card.name: Keen Blade
card.text:
Weapon
Battle: Destroy a target Armor.
card.flavor: "Carve away the armor, and the man underneath will die just as easily as any other. You simply need to know where to cut, and have the right blade for the task." - Kaiu Taru

card.name: Ornate Armor
card.text:
Armor
Battle: Discard a card: Gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: Armor forged for the courts places emphasis on appearance and style over practicality. It may forge new alliances and draw attention to one's wealth, yet even the vainest samurai will wear another suit on the battlefield.

card.name: Skin of the Naga
card.text:
Unique
This Personality has Nonhuman and Naga. Negate all penalties to his Force or Chi.

card.name: Ward of the Kami
card.text:
Armor • Kami
After this item attaches: It permanently becomes a Spell as well as an Item.
card.flavor: "Why settle for protection from the physical when you can be armored for all things?"

card.name: Dance of the Kami
card.text:
Kami
Battle: Bow this card: Name an element keyword. Straighten all cards in this army with that keyword. Give all Personalities in this army with that keyword +1F.
card.flavor: "Even our simplest acts have power beyond normal comprehension. Never forget that." - Isawa Mizuhiko

card.name: Seeking the Path
card.text:
Focus Effect: You may increase the Focus Value of one of your focused cards that is a Ring by 1.
Open: Destroy this card: Put a target Ring in your discard pile into your hand.
card.flavor: The path to enlightenment cannot be cleared.

card.name: The Earth's Wrath
card.text:
If this Personality is Earth or Fire, he has +2F.
Earth Fire Battle: Bow this Spell: Ranged 3 Attack.
card.flavor: "Lady Ochiai's path is true, but there are times when other methods must be employed. This is my path." - Isawa Chishaki

card.name: Transcendence of Flesh
card.text: Maho Limited: Destroy this Spell: Give this Shugenja a +4F/-1C token. Permanently give him Shadowlands and Undead. Lose 3 Honor.

card.name: Wrack the Soul
card.text: Maho Open: Bow this Shugenja: A target Personality has a minimum Chi of 1 (until the end of the turn). Reduce his Chi to 1. Lose 4 Honor.
card.flavor: "Your will is broken. Your flesh serves only me. To war, slave." - Chuda Hiroe

card.name: Great Falls Castle
card.text:
Equipping Weapons is a Battle/Open ability for you.
Reaction: After you attach a Weapon from your hand: Draw a card.
card.flavor: "It is a center of learning and the arts, as well as one of our greatest weapons storehouses." - Mirumoto Kei

card.name: Broken Reef Keep
card.text:
Your Personalities do not gain Force bonuses from Tactical actions.
Your non-Naval Personalities have Tactician while in an army with a Naval Personality.

card.name: Private Shrine
card.text:
Temple • Singular
Battle: Bow this card: Give all your honorable Personalities at the current battlefield +1F, or +2F if the current battlefield is at this card's province.
card.flavor: "Even the greatest warrior needs a place to reflect. Even a Hida can crave a moment of serenity." - Hida Kuon

card.name: Surprising Resistance
card.text: Battle: Bow or move home your target unit: Bow a target enemy unit.
card.flavor: "I have no wish to fight you, young samurai," the old Asahina said, "but nor will I allow war to cross the threshold of this temple."

card.name: The Heart Speaks
card.text: Until the end of the game, lobbying is an Open action for you.
card.flavor: "The spirit of Rokugan is more than steel. It is in the respect between two old friends, or even that between two old enemies. Politics and sincerity are its lifeblood, and war is only its visceral unpleasantness." - Otomo Taneji

card.name: Aneo
card.text:
Ronin • Shugenja • Fire
Reaction: After an action resolves that Aneo performed and that destroyed an enemy card at a battlefield: Straighten a card attached to Aneo.
card.flavor: "The samurai of the Great Clans have no time for a masterless man, but the kami hear my voice and lend me their aid."

card.name: Seppun Goharu
card.text:
Imperial • Samurai • Yojimbo
Goharu's base Force equals the highest Personal Honor among all Personalities at his location.
Battle: Bow and move home a target Personality who is Spider Clan, Unicorn Clan, or dishonorable.

card.name: Hunger of the Dead
card.text: All Personalities in play gain a -1F/-1C Corruption token.
card.flavor: "There are times when the veil between worlds parts, and dark spirits roam the land. Many lives are lost, but even the dead can die." - Kuni Kiyoshi

card.name: Consecration of Steel
card.text: Until your second turn from now begins, all your Personalities with the Magistrate or Kensai keyword have +1F/+1C while they are in play.
card.flavor: "The Heavens have blessed this steel. Now go forth and use it to slay your lord's enemies."

card.name: Regional Treasurer
card.text:
Retainer
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Open: Bow this card: Straighten your target Samurai Personality. Until your next turn ends, he does not straighten.
card.flavor: "The position of Imperial Treasurer shall be created, in order to supervise the security and distribution of the throne's wealth." - The New Emeror

card.name: Hida Manoru
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Scout • Jade Legion
Recon Open: Target a province. Your Crab Clan Personalities have +1F, and Shadowlands Personalities have -1F, while at that province's battlefield.
card.flavor: "I am no mindless brute. I am a Crab warrior, and you should fear me."

card.name: Kakita Taminoko
card.text:
Crane Clan • Courtier
Political Limited: Bow Taminoko: Target another player's honorable Personality. The player may choose to dishonor him. If he does not choose this, gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "Samurai are made for more than war. If we cannot rise above simple violence, then how can we hope for a better world for the future?"

card.name: Togashi Chunoken
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Monk • Tattooed
Reaction: Even if Chunoken is bowed, after a Combat Segment ends, if he is at the current battlefield: Straighten him.
card.flavor: "Many mistake piety for passivity. No one repeats the mistake."

card.name: Matsu Notsuo
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai
Notsuo does not bow from battle resolution.
card.flavor: "I need steel and battle. Words mean nothing."

card.name: Tsuruchi Saya
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai
Battle: Ranged 5 Attack.
card.flavor: "You are of no use to me dead. I do not care what condition you are in, however."

card.name: Isawa Itsuoko
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Earth • Shugenja
Battle: Bow Itsuoko or one of her Spells: Bow a target enemy Personality. If he is an Oni, until the turn ends, negate all effects that straighten him.
card.flavor: "Sometimes purification requires power, pure and simple."

card.name: Shosuro Miyoto
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Ninja
Battle: Bow a target enemy Personality with one or more Poison tokens.
card.flavor: "I only kill the corrupt. It is a tragedy that so many are easily corrupted."

card.name: Daigotsu Bundoru
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai • Paragon
After Bundoru enters play: Lose 2 Honor.
Fear Battle: Bow all Followers with 4 or lower Force in a target enemy unit.
card.flavor: "I need no eyes to see the truth. To me, all is darkness."

card.name: Utaku Kioko
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Battle Maiden
Reaction: After an enemy Personality assigns or moves to Kioko's battlefield: Gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "She fills her soul with duty and anger to fill the emptiness left there by war." - Utaku Kohana

card.name: Daku no Oni
card.text:
Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Oni
After Daku enters play: Lose 6 Honor.
Battle: Target a Personality opposing Daku, or a Holding controlled by the enemy leader. Bow the targeted card. Destroy it if it is a Farm or Ashigaru.
card.flavor: "I do not care what it is called or what it can do. I will kill it, and then I will find another." - Hida Manoru

card.name: Hitofu
card.text:
Samurai • Hero • Ronin
Battle: If there are fewer units on your side than on the enemy side at this battlefield: Bow a target enemy unit.
card.flavor: "I never know where my next meal will come from. What do I care who sits upon the throne?"

card.name: Sacred Valley
card.text:
Singular
Reaction: Before the resolution of another player's action begins, bow this card: reduce all Honor losses to you from the action's effects by 2.
card.flavor: Such places are favored by those who have brought shame to their family name, that they might find atonement.

card.name: As the Breakers
card.text:
Kiho • Water
Battle: Bow your target Shugenja or Monk. Bow a target enemy Personality with lower Chi. You may move your Shugenja or Monk home.
card.flavor: Be as the water, and your strength will ebb and flow. Be as the stone, and your perseverance knows no limit.

card.name: Call Forth the Dead
card.text:
Kiho • Maho
Limited: Target your Shugenja: Create a 2F/2C Shadowlands • Undead Personality. Lose 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "What need have I for magistrates and soldiers? They follow my orders without question, and death is not a concern." - The Onyx Champion

card.name: Dance of the Winds
card.text:
Kiho • Air
Battle: Target your unbowed Shugenja or Monk: Move a target enemy Personality home. If this is the first Battle action taken in this battle, negate any effects this turn that move the Personality.
card.flavor: "Entreating the kami to destruction is a simpleton's task. Creating beauty is far more difficult."

card.name: Discovering Lost Lore
card.text: Limited: Target your Artisan: Target a Spell or Item in your discard pile. Attach it to your target Personality. Gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "By the Fortunes! Could this really be the chop of Isawa Hochiu?"

card.name: Drinking One's Life
card.text: Open: Target your Oni Personality: Target another Personality. Lose 3 Honor. While your Oni remains in play, after the start of each player's turn, give the other Personality a +1F/-1C token.
card.flavor: "Even a samurai is good for something." - Omoni

card.name: Facilitation
card.text:
Unique
Limited: If you have attached a Unique Spell this turn: Draw 2 cards.
card.flavor: "I asked for the firestorm spell! No, the other one!"

card.name: Intercession
card.text:
Political
Open: Take the Imperial Favor. Lose 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "If you please, this is a matter best left to Imperial discretion."

card.name: Military Assessment
card.text:
Recon
Limited: Target your Scout. Target a province. After each time that one or more of your units moves home or returns home from the province's battlefield (including battle resolution), straighten those units.
card.flavor: There are few generals who do not use scouts. Such an advantage is not quickly discarded.

card.name: War-Torn Plains
card.text:
Terrain
Battle: Before this battle's resolution, if there are fewer units on your side than on the enemy side at this battlefield, give each of your Personalities there +2F.
card.flavor: Once it had critical importance, but now it has been despoiled by too many battles.

card.name: Imperial Couriers
card.text:
Imperial
Reaction: After this card attaches from your hand: Straighten this Personality.
Limited: After your next End Phase ends, if this card is in play, return it to your hand.
card.flavor: The Miya heralds bring messages of hope for those who serve the Emperor's will.

card.name: Scholarly Attendant
card.text: Limited: Transfer your target attachment to your target Personality.
card.flavor: "I think you might find your argument more effective if you remind the Lion ambassador of the writings of sensei Akodo Tishikaru, my lord."

card.name: Osano-Wo's Rebuke
card.text:
Thunder
This Shugenja has +2F.
Battle: Bow this Spell: Bow a target card in the enemy army with fewer attachments than this Shugenja.
card.flavor: "You will die. But first, you will suffer!"

card.name: Inheriting an Heirloom
card.text: Until the game ends, during each player's End Phase, he may draw an additional card if he put any Weapons or Armors into play from his hand that turn.
card.flavor: "This is the blade I carried when I witnessed the Empress's ascension. Now it is yours. Use it to bring honor to your family and your Empress."

card.name: Night of the Blood Moon
card.text: After each resolution of a Maho action this turn, straighten a Personality who performed it.
card.flavor: Once per winter, the Obsidian Dragon pays homage to its sinister father. On that night, the blood cultists seek sacrifice.

card.name: The Karmic Cycle
card.text: Starting with you, each player may discard his hand, then draw a number of cards equal to the number of cards he discarded.
card.flavor: "There is a time of suffering that all must endure. Our time has passed, and we have survived. We must now rebuild." - Moto Chen

card.name: Winter Solstice
card.text:
Winter
Until your next turn begins, your Holdings now in play produce one additional Gold when they bow to produce Gold.
card.flavor: "War never truly stops trade. During the long winter months, its continuation is a bit more obvious." - Naoharu

card.name: Winter's Embrace
card.text:
Winter
Until your second turn from now begins, all provinces have +3 Strength.
card.flavor: "Some call it a curse, others a blessing. It traps one in one's home, and yet protects one's home from all who would attack." - Asako Barei

card.name: Word of Heaven
card.text: Until your second turn from now begins, Reactions have the additional cost "Bow one of your Personalities or Followers."
card.flavor: The Emperor's word is the Word of Heaven, too pure to be heard by the masses.

card.name: Revered Sensei
card.text:
Retainer • Singular
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Open: Bow this card: Your target Samurai Personality has +3F while he is opposed this turn.
card.flavor: To sit at the feet of an elder sensei is an honor most young samurai will never know.

card.name: Hida Hikita
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Commander
Battle: Bow your target Follower: Reduce the Force of a target enemy card to 0.

card.name: Hida Tatsuma
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Hero
Tatsuma has a Force bonus equal to his Personal Honor while he is the only Personality in an army.
card.flavor: "Long has the Wall been silent, but it will not be so forever. When the demons return, they shall find me waiting."

card.name: Hida Togeriso
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Lorekeeper
Limited: Show a random card in another player's hand. Togeriso gains a Force bonus equal to its Focus Value.
card.flavor: "I would prefer a simple conversation, but if you insist, we can do battle first. Then I will talk to your unconscious body."

card.name: Hida Yumiya
card.text:
Crab Clan • Shadowlands • Berserker • Damned
Personalities and Followers without Shadowlands have -1F while opposing Yumiya.
card.flavor: "Let the war end. I wish to return to the Wall. I am not worthy to fight samurai, not even Crane."

card.name: Hiruma Rohitsu
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Scout
Battle: Bow Rohitsu unless you targeted the current battlefield's province with a Recon action this turn: A target card in the enemy army may not use its base abilities.
card.flavor: "I have fought in the mountains all my life. What does it matter which mountains, and what fools I kill?"

card.name: Kaiu Kyoka
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Commander • Unique
Battle: Bow or move home your target Crab Clan Personality: Straighten your target unit.
card.flavor: "We are to hold the line, but advance no further. Lord Kuon will arrive within two days time."

card.name: Kuni Sagara
card.text:
Crab Clan • Shugenja
Sagara attaches Maho Spells paying 1 less Gold.
card.flavor: "I am no traitor, nor am I a fool. I simply prefer to keep my options open. Who knows what circumstances the future holds?"

card.name: Daidoji Murata
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Scout
Recon Open: Target two provinces. During battles at their battlefields, actions may not be taken before the Defender's first chance to take a Battle action or pass.
card.flavor: "Sleep well, my lady. There will be no treachery tonight. This much I swear."

card.name: Daidoji Reita
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Scout
Recon Open: Target your province. Defending Personalties have +1F while at its battlefield. Your other provinces gain +2 strength.
card.flavor: "Their deaths are a mercy, but I will enjoy them nevertheless."

card.name: Doji Hariya
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Artisan • Kensai
Limited: Discard a card: Create a +2F Weapon and attach it to Hariya.
card.flavor: "I will not limit myself to the duel. I will master all aspects of the blade, and in doing so, I will master myself."

card.name: Doji Numata
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Magistrate • Governor
Battle: Bow a target enemy dishonorable Personality. Increase or decrease the strength of this battlefield's province by Numata's Personal Honor.
card.flavor: "I oversee taxes, regulate merchants, and appoint city guards. My duty is not glorious, but I serve the Emperor as much as any other samurai."

card.name: Doji Odaka
card.text:
Crane Clan • Courtier • Imperial • Unique
Political Open: Discard the Imperial Favor: Bow a target Personality with lower Personal Honor than Odaka.
card.flavor: "Before you begin, Lord Kuon," Domotai interrupted, "my magistrates have discovered something relevant that my interest you."

card.name: Kakita Omori
card.text: Crane Clan • Artisan
card.flavor: "A Lion or Crab would say that I have wasted my life in pursuit of art. I say they have wasted theirs spilling blood. My art will live on, but their glory ends with death."

card.name: Kakita Takashima
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Duelist
Takashima has +1C during the resolution of any duel he is in.
card.flavor: "We may be at peace in the morning, my Hida friend, but I find I am not a morning person."

card.name: Kitsuki Kenichi
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Magistrate
Open: A target dishonorable Personality has a minimum Chi of 1. Give him -2F/-2C.
card.flavor: "It is likely the reinforcements will not be sufficient," he said. "We must be prepared for the Northern Watchtowers to fall, my lady."

card.name: Kitsuki Tsuboko
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Duelist • Justicar
Reaction: Before Focus Effects resolve in a duel involving Tsuboko: All Focus Effects in that duel are negated.
card.flavor: "Fusami's students are among our most dangerous soldiers," Iweko said. "See to it she is given only the finest warriors to train."

card.name: Mirumoto Ishino
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Kensai
Battle: Discard a card from your hand: Reduce a target enemy Personality's Force by the discarded card's Focus Value. Draw a card. If you discarded a Weapon, bow the target.
card.flavor: "He has all of his cousin's rage, and none of Kenzo's restraint." - Mirumoto Kei

card.name: Mirumoto Kuroki
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Cavalry
Battle: Bow Kuroki: Ranged 3 Attack.
card.flavor: The Dragon cavalry appeared from nowhere, raining death down upon the flaming legions and keeping well out of reach. In moments, the ground was covered in smoldering corpses.

card.name: Mirumoto Takehiro
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Tactician
Battle: Target an enemy Personality. Neither Takehiro nor the targeted Personality may perform actions until this battle ends.
card.flavor: The Dragon encampment burst into flames without warning. "Infiltrators!" the commander shouted. "Fall Back!"

card.name: Togashi Osawa
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Monk • Tattooed
Open: Even if Osawa is bowed: Straighten him.
card.flavor: "My Champion's orders are clear, Mantis," Osawa said sadly. "Each time one of your clan enters our land without permission, we will burn one of your cities to the ground."

card.name: Akodo Hiroshi
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Tactician • Gunso
Battle: Attach your target discarded Follower to a target Personality in Hiroshi's army.
card.flavor: "I need war to fuel my Lion's heart. If it is barbarians I must kill for honor and glory, so be it."

card.name: Akodo Yanagi
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Hero
Battle: If the enemy side has more units than your side at this battlefield: Give Yanagi +5F.
card.flavor: A woman of uncommon skill and daring, she has survived countless battles and turned defeat into vicotry. Among the rank and file of the Lion, she is a legend.

card.name: Ikoma Hagio
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai
Hagio has +1F while attacking.
Reaction: Even if Hagio is bowed, before battle resolution, if he is at the current battlefield: Straighten him.
card.flavor: "Korin's second son is little like his father, quick-tempered and unapologetic, but he is a Lion to his core. He will serve the clan well." - Akodo Shigetoshi

card.name: Ikoma Tomoi
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Warden • Unique
Battle: If any enemy units are at the current battlefield: Move your target Personality there. You may discard a Bushido Virtue card; if you do, straighten him.
card.flavor: "News from the Emperor's court! We are to secure our northern border while the Akodo and Matsu begin preparing to march!"

card.name: Matsu Ishigaki
card.text: Lion Clan • Samurai • Commander
card.flavor: "Supplies and relief for the Unicorn? A likely story. The Empire will not tolerate your meddling any longer, Phoenix."

card.name: Matsu Naomasa
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Paragon
Reaction: After one of your Bushido Virtue actions targets Naomasa: Gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "Be cautious, Scorpion," she warned. "You may be the Emperor's hosts, but your actions are not without consequence."

card.name: Kitsune Ando
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Scout
Battle: If the current battlefield was targeted by a Recon action this turn: Destroy a target enemy attachment.
card.flavor: "The time for games has ended," Saburo warned. "It comes for the prophet now, and only we can stop it."

card.name: Moshi Awako
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Thunder • Shugenja • Fist of Osano-Wo
Ranged Attacks from Thunder actions Awako performs may target Personalities with attached Followers.
Battle: Ranged 2 Attack.
card.flavor: "We carry the favor of Thunder. Stand aside or face the storm's wrath."

card.name: Moshi Nakata
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Commander • Unique
While Nakata is at the current battlefield, Ranged Attacks from your actions have +1 strength.
card.flavor: "Lord Naizen commands all trade north of Rokugan halted immediately. Something in the northern mountains is amiss."

card.name: Sakarah
card.text: Mantis Clan • Nonhuman • Ningyo • Naval
card.flavor: "You humans call it Thunder. We call it an avatar of the Spawn-Father. Names mean nothing. Its power must be recognized, however."

card.name: Tsuruchi Onaka
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Magistrate • Accuser
Will not be controlled by a Scorpion Clan player.
Open: Bow Onaka: Dishonor a target honorable Personality with lower Personal Honor than Onaka's Chi. Rehonor the Personality before the end of the turn.
card.flavor: "Tell me all you know of Noritoshi and Jimen."

card.name: Yoritomo Kisho
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Gunso
Battle: Ranged 3 Attack with +1 strength for each Follower in Kisho's army.
card.flavor: "It is not enough to best your enemy in battle. He must be humiliated if he is truly to be defeated."

card.name: Yoritomo Sunagawa
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Tactician • Commander
Battle: Bow your target Follower: Ranged Attack with strength equal to the Follower's Force.
card.flavor: "You pirates dare raid a Mantis ship? My ship? You must all be mad!"

card.name: Asako Kanta
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Courtier
Political Open: Straighten a target Temple.
card.flavor: "The Phoenix have little need for assistance, my lords, but if you wish to defend the sacred temples that are open to all, then surely we will not stand in your way."

card.name: Asako Serizawa
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Void • Shugenja • Inquisitor • Magistrate
Open: Bow Serizawa: Give -4F to a target Personality with lower Personal Honor than Serizawa's Chi.
card.flavor: "Perhaps we should investigate the possible link between these barbarians and the Dark Oracle of Fire. Nokatsu's death was but the first."

card.name: Asako Suda
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Void • Monk
Battle: Discard a Kiho card or Spell: Bow a target enemy card.
card.flavor: "The universe holds wonders we cannot begin to imagine! How can we discover its secrets if we are forever consumed by war?"

card.name: Isawa Yutako
card.text: Phoenix Clan • Water • Shugenja • Cavalry
card.flavor: "Bring these men that have plagued our Dragon allies so badly. I will quench their flames and their passion for war, and send them rushing into the mountains from which they came."

card.name: Shiba Ikokawa
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Fire • Shugenja • Duelist • Unique • Legion of Flame
Battle: Bow a target enemy Personality with lower Chi. You may discard a card; if you do, the enemy leader chooses and destroys one of the Personality's attachments.
card.flavor: "You bring fire? Against the Phoenix? Is this some manner of joke?"

card.name: Shiba Raiden
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Samurai • Gunso • Yojimbo • Legion of Flame
Battle: Bow or straighten a target Personality whose Force is different from his own base Force.
card.flavor: "Fire burns within him, yearning for freedom. His path will be a violent one, I fear." - Isawa Ochiai

card.name: Shiba Shigenobu
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Samurai • Imperial • Magistrate
Limited: Dishonor a target Personality with lower Personal Honor than the number of Imperial Personalities you control. If this dishonored him, gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "Seppun Katsura is my sensei, and Seppun Tashime my lord. I will fail neither of them."

card.name: Bayushi Ishikura
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Kensai • Commander • Bitter Lies • Unique
Your other Personalities with a keyword that includes "Bitter Lies" have +1F.
Battle: Bow Ishikura or one of his Weapons: Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality with lower Chi than Ishikura and without a Weapon or Armor attached.
card.flavor: "I need no poison or stealth. You will see me coming with your eyes wide open, and still you will not be able to stop me."

card.name: Bayushi Shigeru
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Courtier • Samurai
Political Reaction: After Shigeru enters play: A target player loses 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "An ambassador from the Badger Clan?" the courtier scoffed. "No such invitation was extended! This is a civilized court, after all."

card.name: Shosuro Nitsu
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Ninja
Battle: Give one or two target enemy Personalities one -1F Poison token each. You may move Nitsu home.
card.flavor: "It is not a personal matter. You have simply seen things you should not have. I take no pleasure in your deaths."

card.name: Shosuro Takagi
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Magistrate • Yojimbo
Reaction: After another player's Battle action targets a Courtier at Takagi's location: That player loses 2 Honor.
card.flavor: After the rash of assassinations the previous summer, the Scorpion took no chances in securing the Emperor's protection. No inch of the castle was left unsecured.

card.name: Soshi Mayumi
card.text: Scorpion Clan • Shugenja
card.flavor: The Scorpion protect the Emperor's lands, as do the Lion, and his honor, as do the Crane. But they also protect his secrets, a burden no other clan could bear.

card.name: Yogo Fujitani
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Nonhuman • Foxwife • Courtier
After Fujitani is destroyed: Lose 5 Honor.
card.flavor: "Time spent among your people changed my sister forever, and I must know why. They called her Snowflake."

card.name: Daigotsu Buroki
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai • Paragon • Dark Stone
After Buroki enters play: Lose 4 Honor.
Fear Battle: Target a unit. Bow each Follower in it with 3 or lower Force. You may discard a Dark Virtue card; if you do, destroy all bowed Followers in the unit.
card.flavor: "Some have not lost their talent for brutality." - Michio

card.name: Daigotsu Churo
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Undead • Samurai
After Churo enters play: Lose 4 Honor.
Reaction: After an action targets Churo: Either negate the action's effects that bow Churo or negate the action's effects that move Churo.
card.flavor: "I am no mindless beast, but I shall feast on your flesh just the same."

card.name: Daigotsu Minoko
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai • Duelist • Obsidian Claw
After Minoko enters play: Lose 3 Honor.
After Minoko challenges a Personality: That Personality loses Duelist.
card.flavor: "Steel against obsidian. Are you so sure you know the outcome already?"

card.name: Daigotsu Yuhmi
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai • Nonhuman • Infiltrator • Unique
After Yuhmi enters play: Lose 5 Honor.
Fear Battle: Target an enemy Follower. Bow each Follower and Personality with 4 or lower Force in its unit. Destroy the targeted Follower.
card.flavor: "No one knows his secrets. Not even me." - Daigotsu

card.name: Goju Asagi
card.text: Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Ninja • Assassin
card.flavor: "Unleash your beasts if you wish, Dragon," Daigotsu said. "I fear they will have little opportunity to slay this new Emperor."

card.name: Hongo
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Monk • Kensai
After Hongo enters play: Lose 2 Honor.
Battle: Attach a target Weapon from your hand to Hongo.
card.flavor: "The Spider may be in hiding, but a monk travels where he wishes, and few have the courage to question a sohei."

card.name: Iuchi Hotaru
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Water • Shugenja • Cavalry
Hotaru has Tactician while he has a spell attached.
card.flavor: "I will wash away the Scorpion's sins in a wave of vengeance and purification."

card.name: Moto Juncheng
card.text: Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry
card.flavor: "I fear no Scorpion, no barbarian, nor even a wrathful Emperor. I fear only a life of boredom, and I will have none of it."

card.name: Moto Xiao
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Commander • Unique
Followers in Xiao's army have +1F.
Battle/Open: Straighten all Followers in a target unit.
card.flavor: "It has been far too long since I killed a man in the northern steppes. Ride, men! Ride to the mountains!"

card.name: Shinjo Ki-Chang
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Commander
Battle: Even if Ki-Chang is not at the current battlefield, if any enemy units are there: Move your target Personality with a Follower there.
card.flavor: "The day of our redemption is at hand, brothers. Glorious service to the new Emperor will erase all our father's crimes!"

card.name: Shinjo Ming-li
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Kensai
Battle: Bow a target enemy Personality without attachments. Destroy him if Ming-li has a Weapon and higher Force.
card.flavor: "Young? Perhaps I am. War is my craft all the same, and one day they will remember me as a master."

card.name: Shinjo Shinlao
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Scout
Recon Open: Target two of another player's provinces. Give them -1 strength.
card.flavor: "I know the northern paths, my Khan. I have traveled them all my life." "Very good," Chen replied. "You will ride at the front of my armies."

card.name: Utaku Yumiko
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Battle Maiden
Fear Battle: Give -1F to all Personalities and Followers opposing Yumiko.
card.flavor: "I am the sight that will usher your soul to the next world."

card.name: Akaru no Oni
card.text:
Shadowlands • Oni • Nonhuman
After this card enters play: Lose 5 Honor.
Limited: Bow a target unit with total Gold Cost less than or equal to the Gold Production of its controller's Stronghold plus 2.
card.flavor: "Never enter one's lair. Burn it from without. Enter its lair and yuor time in this world has come to an end." - Kuni Kiyoshi

card.name: Furu no Oni
card.text:
Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Oni
Furu no Oni costs 1 less Gold to bring into play for each province destroyed this game.
After Furu no Oni enters play: Lose 6 Honor.
Battle: Bow a target card in the enemy army.
card.flavor: "A serpent of fire and thorn, born from blackened, molten earth. An accursed beast best killed from afar."

card.name: Mokku
card.text:
Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Goblin
After Mokku enters play: Lose 3 Honor.
Fire Battle: Destroy your target Goblin: Destroy a target enemy Follower.
card.flavor: "Who is brave enough to receive sacrament? Who strong enough to bear the pain of magic mud?"

card.name: Shukku
card.text:
Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Goblin • Berserker
After Shukku enters play: Lose 3 Honor.
Fear Battle: Destroy Shukku: Give -4F to a target enemy Follower or Personality without attachments. If its Force is now 0, destroy it.
card.flavor: "Pokku very wise. As long as he let me kill more samurai, I follow him wherever he wish."

card.name: Kincho the Sixth
card.text:
Innkeeper of the House of the Blue Tanuki
