Battle: Even if Kincho is home: Straighten all Followers attached to a target Commander or Tactician.
card.flavor: "I have never seen him without a smile, save the day that merchant told him the sake shipment would be delayed. That... was unpleasant." - Kuri the Smuggler

card.name: Malevolent Kappa
card.text:
Nonhuman • Kappa
This card has +2F/+1C while opposing a Samurai.
card.flavor: "Wretched river spirits! More mischievous than a kitsune, and more dangerous than a goblin. I would hunt them all if they were not so resilient!" - Shiba Raiden

card.name: Oishi
card.text:
Ronin • Samurai • Duelist • Unique
Reaction: After Oishi enters play from a province: Create a 2F/2C/2PH Ronin • Samurai Personality.
Iaijutsu Battle: Discard a card: Target an enemy card without attachments. Destroy it if its Force is less than or equal to the discarded card's Focus Value plus 1.
card.flavor: "Be watchful, Chikara. Learn from all you see."

card.name: Terasaka
card.text:
Ronin • Samurai
While there are two or more different Clan alignments among Personalities you control, Terasaka costs 1 less Gold to bring into play for each such Clan alignment.
card.flavor: "Tell me why you would go to the trouble of filling the Legion of Two Thousand with ronin. I am not interested in joining to fulfill some hidden agenda."

card.name: Open Shore Market
card.text:
Market
Battle/Open: Bow this card: Attach a target attachment from your hand to your target Personality.
card.flavor: "Anything you want can be found for a price. If time is of the essence, however, you might consider bringing all the koku you can muster." - Yoritomo Buntaro

card.name: Public Garden
card.text:
This card does not count against the number of Regions a province can attach.
Battle: Move home your target unit at this province's battlefield: Give this province +3 strength.
card.flavor: "This new Empire shall exist as more than a mere battlefield." - Miya Shoin

card.name: Temple of Tsukune
card.text:
Temple
After a Personality enters play from this province: Bow him.
Reaction: After a non-Personality card (including this card) enters play from this province: Refill this province face-up.
card.flavor: The Order of Rebirth is devoted to the Fortune Tsukune, and they offer their aid to all who wish to better themselves.

card.name: A Game of Sadane
card.text:
Political
Battle: Dishonor your target unbowed Personality: Dishonor a target Personality opposing him. After the next resolution of an action that was performed by a dishonorable Personality at this battlefield, bow that Personality.
card.flavor: "Your kimono is most lovely. My grandmother had one like it when she was your age, I believe."

card.name: A Rival Eliminated
card.text: Battle: Give your target Duelist +2F, and an additional +3F if he is opposed.
card.flavor: "Ensure that our commanders are in place to fulfill the Emperor's orders. No others." - Bayushi Paneki

card.name: An Imperial Marriage
card.text:
Imperial • Political
Limited: Target your unbowed Courtier: A target Personality permanently gains Imperial and the ability, "Limited: Take the Imperial Favor."
card.flavor: "An Otomo, Miya, or Seppun has no greater value than as a spouse." - Bayushi Paneki

card.name: Buoyed by the Kami
card.text:
Kiho • Water
Battle: If any enemy units are at the current battlefield, target your unbowed Monk or Shugenja: Move him there. If he has the Water keyword, you may target another of your units and move it there. If it moved, straighten it.
card.flavor: "There is no more glorious experience in life!"

card.name: Burned Village
card.text:
Terrain
Battle: Before this battle's resolution, discard all cards in or attached to this battlefield's province.
card.flavor: "They leave nothing intact," Satsu said, his eyes ablaze. "They are monsters, and they will suffer a monster's death."

card.name: Certain Death
card.text: Open: Pay Gold equal to the attachment's Gold Cost minus 3: Destroy another player's target attachment.
card.flavor: "This could be my masterpiece. If the ogres will not bend their knee, then I will shape them into something that will." - Omoni

card.name: Clan Rivalries
card.text: Battle: Bow your target Personality: Straighten another target Personality with lower Chi. If the targeted Personalities share no Clan alignments, you may target and straighten a third Personality.
card.flavor: "I said stand aside, Crane! The glory of this battle will be mine and mine alone!"

card.name: Dangerous Reconnaissance
card.text:
Recon
Limited: Target your unbowed Scout: Target a province. Draw a card. During your End Phase this turn, draw an additional card if you destroyed the targeted province in battle resolution.
card.flavor: "We must find a way to break the Yobanjin line and find the Oracle's lair. Slay the general, and the army crumbles."

card.name: Desperation Strikes
card.text: Battle: Your opposed non-Yojimbo Personalities at the current battlefield each gain a Force bonus equal to the number of your Yojimbo Personalities there.
card.flavor: The Yasuki War has left many cold, homeless, and starving. Not all are willing to go quietly into the next life.

card.name: Discreet Retreat
card.text:
Political
Battle: Move your target Courtier home: Give a target Personality +4F or -4F.
card.flavor: "Lady Domotai bid me bring her word to you at the front, commander. I will await your convenience back at the encampment."

card.name: Endless Road
card.text:
Terrain
Battle: After the resolution of any action that moved one or more units, straighten them.
card.flavor: The Emperor's first winter was an exceptionally mild one. Many took it as a fortuitous omen, and a sign of a peaceful reign. They could not have known what was to come.

card.name: Eradicate All Doubt
card.text: Battle: Straighten a target bowed Personality, and target another Personality in the same army. If this straightened the bowed Personality, reduce the other Personality's Force to 0.
card.flavor: "Sureness is strength. Certainty of purpose is assurance of victory."

card.name: Traditions of Steel
card.text:
Focus Effect: Before this duel's resolution, raise the Focus Value of each of your focused cards to 3.
Battle: Target your opposed Samurai: Before this battle's resolution, raise his Force to 6.
card.flavor: "The most difficult problems can strain even the greatest alliance. Often it is best to simply eliminate the problem at hand, that the alliance might flourish." - Bayushi Eisaku

card.name: First-Hand Account
card.text: Reaction: After battle resolution, if you destroyed any enemy units or a province in that resolution: Give each Personality and Follower in your army a +1F Victory token.
card.flavor: "Yes, I spent two seasons stationed in the Dragon lands, near the northern border. Tell Shigetoshi-sama that my formal recommendation for troop placement is as follows..."

card.name: Fluid Formation
card.text: Battle: Target your Tactician: Target one or more of your Followers. Straighten each targeted Follower. You may transfer any number of the targeted Followers to any of your Personalities in your current army.
card.flavor: "Let us see how these barbarians respond to the full might of the Lion!" - Akodo Shigetoshi

card.name: Games of Court
card.text:
Political • Unique
Limited: Each player chooses a card in his hand. Show all chosen cards. If the base Focus Value of a player's card is different from each other chosen card's base Focus Value, he gains Honor equal to his card's Focus Value; otherwise, he loses Honor equal to his card's Focus Value.

card.name: Half-Breath Strike
card.text:
Iaijutsu
Reaction: After the resolution of another player's action that targeted your Duelist during a battle, show another Iaijutsu card in your hand: Target an enemy Personality with 3C or lower at the current battlefield. His controller may destroy him. If he is not destroyed, gain 3 Honor.
card.flavor: "He was alive when I began the breath, and with his ancestors when it was finished."

card.name: Hasty Exit
card.text:
Ninja
Battle: Move one or more target unbowed Ninja Personalities with no non-Ninja Followers from the current battlefield to another battlefield.
card.flavor: "Do not tarry when your task is complete," the Shadow Dragon hissed. "I do so hate dawdling."

card.name: Honor & Steel
card.text:
Bushido Virtue
Battle: Give your target Paragon +1F for each Bushido Virtue in your discard pile. You may target an enemy Personality and give him -1F for each Dark Virtue in his controller's discard pile. Gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "Our time will come, 'Champion.' But only once this threat has been resolved." - Kakita Noritoshi

card.name: Honor the Ancestors
card.text:
Political
Battle: Move home a target enemy Personality with Force lower than or equal to the number of your honorably dead Personalities. If he moved, bow him and gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "This will be a battle unlike any the Lion have ever known. Guide us, Lady Matsu. Let us act in your name." - Matsu Kenji

card.name: I Carry Two Blades!
card.text: Reaction: After one of your Weapons is destroyed, target a non-Unique Weapon in your hand or discard pile: Attach it to your target Personality, paying 4 less Gold.
card.flavor: "Unfortunately for you, my last opponent had no more need of his when we were finished."

card.name: Imperial Decree
card.text:
Political • Imperial
Battle: If you control the Imperial Favor: Move a target enemy Personality home. You may discard the Imperial Favor as a cost; if you do, gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "The first formal decree of the Emperor is this: all wars between the Great Clans will end within one week, and an accord will be submitted to the Imperial Palace."

card.name: Imperial Intercession
card.text:
Imperial • Political
Battle: Bow your target Courtier at any location, and discard the Imperial Favor unless he is Imperial: Bow a target attacking Personality. Straighten a target defending Personality.
card.flavor: "Stop! Stop this! It solves nothing!"

card.name: Incredible Resilience
card.text:
Unique
Reaction: After the resolution of an enemy player's Battle action that targeted one of your Personalities: The player chooses and bows one of his unbowed Personalities at the current battlefield.
card.flavor: "If these are the best that can be sent against me, I scarcely see the point."

card.name: Kami Unleashed
card.text:
Kami • Tattoo
Battle: Target your unbowed Personality, and bow him unless he is Tattooed: Ranged Attack with strength equal to your Personality's Force.
card.flavor: "We have faced these flaming madmen before, but an entire army? That shall be a welcome challenge!" - Togashi Hogai

card.name: Low Stance
card.text:
Focus Effect: Before this duel's resolution, negate all bonuses to each focused card's Focus Value.
Battle: Target your unbowed Samurai Personality: Target an enemy Personality. After this Combat Segment ends, reduce his Force to 0.
card.flavor: "Your accusations will amount to nothing if they go unheard."

card.name: Mounting a Defense
card.text: Limited: Target your Commander Personality: Show the top 4 cards of your Dynasty deck. Discard a card from one of your provinces and refill it face-up with one of the shown cards. Put the remaining shown cards on the bottom of your deck in any order.
card.flavor: "The Emperor's lands will not be invaded. Not while we Lion draw breath." - Akodo Shigetoshi

card.name: Phantom Blade Kata
card.text:
Kata • Spirit
Limited: Put this card into play in your home. Discard any other Kata cards you control. While this card is in play, you have the ability, "Spirit Limited: Discard a card: Create a +2F Spirit • Weapon Item and attach it to your target Personality."
card.flavor: "Guide my hand, mother," the warrior whispered.

card.name: Power Corrupting
card.text:
Kiho • Maho
Open: Target your unbowed Shugenja and destroy another of your target Personalities: Create a 7F/4C Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Oni Personality. Lose 3 Honor. Your Shugenja permanently gains Shadowlands.
card.flavor: "We failed to gain the throne, perhaps, but we gained much all the same." - Chuda Mishime

card.name: Pragmatism
card.text: Battle: Target your unbowed dishonorable Samurai Personality: Bow a target enemy card. You may move it's unit home. Lose 5 Honor.
card.flavor: "I had no need to kill you. You were simply in the way. In the next life, do not be so foolish."

card.name: Raising Heaven's Banner
card.text:
Terrain
Battle: Your opposed Personalities and Followers have +2F while you have two or more different Clan alignments among Personalities on your army.
card.flavor: "The Empire stands threatened," the Emperor said. "Who among my people shall defend it?"

card.name: Reinforced Border
card.text:
Focus Effect: Put a Ring in your discard pile into your hand.
Battle: Move your target Samurai Personality to a battlefield with one or more enemy units. Straighten his unit if he moved into a defending army.
card.flavor: "We no longer require the intervention of others" - Togashi Satsu

card.name: Riding the Clouds
card.text:
Air • Kiho
Battle/Open: Target your Monk: Straighten him. He does not contribute Force during battle resolutions this turn.
card.flavor: "How can you bring word to the general through such resistance?" The monk laughed. "It is not so difficult!"

card.name: Selfless Devotion
card.text: Open: Target your Shugenja Personality: After the next time this turn he assigns, create a 2F/2C/2PH Samurai • Yojimbo Personality at his battlefield. Remove the Yojimbo from the game before the end of this turn.
card.flavor: "Let the barbarians come. Whether the burn or not, they will never touch you, my lord."

card.name: Setting Sun Strike
card.text:
Heroic
Reaction: After another player's action targets your Hero Personality during a Combat Segment: Give the Hero +3F. Straighten him before this battle's resolution.
card.flavor: "A man with no fear of death is a man whom death fears." - Tao of Shinsei

card.name: Shisa Infestation
card.text:
Unique
Open: Permanently increase or decrease the strength of all provinces by 1.
card.flavor: Shisa are mischievous, but not evil. They can either serve as guardians, or vandals, and can change their affiliation multiple times in the span of an afternoon.

card.name: Siege Tactics
card.text:
Siege
Battle: Give your target opposed Personality +1F for each province that has been destroyed this game.
Battle: If any enemy units are at the current battlefield: Move your target Personality at another battlefield to the current battlefield.
card.flavor: "The Emperor commands peace," Kuon said. "It is peace the Crab shall deliver."

card.name: Spin the Karmic Wheel
card.text:
Kiho
Reaction: After an action targets one of your Personalities, target your Monk: The action's effects that would destroy your Personality shuffle him into your Dynasty deck instead.
card.flavor: "Perhaps you will find victory in your next life."

card.name: Split the Reed
card.text: Battle: Target your Kensai Personality: Destroy a target enemy attachment. If your Kensai now has a Weapon attached, you may take an additional Battle action.
card.flavor: "Yes, I desire peace. So much so that I would kill to achieve it, if need be."

card.name: Strength of the Dead
card.text:
Maho • Kiho
Battle: Target your unbowed Monk or Shugenja: He gains a Force bonus equal to the Force of a target dead Personality. Lose 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "The wanyudo is a reincarnated tyrant, a madman who must inflict pain and death even after his own life has ended." - Kuni Kiyoshi

card.name: Subtle Corruption
card.text:
Limited: Target a face-up Personality in your province. Reduce any Honor loss from his card for entering play by 4.
Fear Battle: Bow all Followers with a Force of 4 or lower in a target unit.
card.flavor: "No, my lord. We found nothing of any consequence within the Shinomen Mori. The reports were in error."

card.name: The Sea's Lightning
card.text:
Thunder
Battle: Target your opposed Naval Personality: This battle's resolution does not bow your Personalities.
card.flavor: "It seems your papers are not in order, my friends! I am afraid we must confiscate your cargo to spare you the dishonor of transporting it illegally!"

card.name: Undone by Truth
card.text:
Political
Limited: Bow your target Magistrate: Dishonor a target Personality with lower Personal Honor than your Magistrate's Chi.
card.flavor: "Innocent? I have testimony from three different sources confirming my allegations. Your malfeasance is at an end!"

card.name: Unexpected Arrival
card.text: Battle: If any enemy units are at the current battlefield: Target a Personality in one of your provinces. Bring him into play at the current battlefield, paying 2 less Gold and ignoring his Honor Requirement.
card.flavor: "Whether in court or on the battlefield, the Scorpion rarely attack in an expected manner." - Akodo's Leadership

card.name: Unsavory Practices
card.text: Limited: Target your Artisan Personality: Your target Weapon permanently gains the ability, "Battle: Bow this card: Destroy a target card in the enemy army with a Gold Cost of 6 or lower and no attachments."
card.flavor: Some still cling to the old means of testing a new blade, means many find barbaric and outdated.

card.name: Unworthy Rivals
card.text: Battle: Target your Personality: Target an enemy Personality with lower Force, lower Chi, and lower Personal Honor: Bow his unit. Until the turn ends, negate the straightening of any cards now in the unit.
card.flavor: "This will not do at all. Deal with it immediately." - Shosuro Jimen

card.name: Word of Fire
card.text:
Fire • Kiho
Battle: Target your unbowed Monk or Shugenja Personality: Reduce a target enemy card's Force by your Personality's Chi. If your Personality has the Fire keyword, bow the targeted enemy card.
card.flavor: "It is possible, my Emperor, that this Army of Fire may have advance agents already within the Empire," the Badger ambassador said grimly.

card.name: Wrath of the Elements
card.text: Battle: Bow one of your Spells in your current army: Ranged 4 Attack that may target a Personality with attached Followers.
card.flavor: "If even a Dark Oracle imagines that the Phoenix will be easily defeated, then even the pawns of Jigoku will learn something this day." - Isawa Mizuhiko

card.name: Cavalry Officer
card.text:
Cavalry
Reaction: After this card enters play: Create a 1F Cavalry Follower and attach it to a target Personality without Followers.
card.flavor: "The left flank, my lord. It needs cavalry reinforcement immediately or it will break."

card.name: Death Ravagers
card.text:
Oni • Shadowlands
Will only attach to an Oni.
After this card enters play: Lose 4 Honor.
Before the end of your End Phase, if this unit was not in an attacking army this turn: Destroy this card.
card.flavor: "Lesser oni spawn that hunt in packs. Clever demons are the worst kind." - Hiruma Todori

card.name: Imperial Elite Guard
card.text:
Imperial
Battle: Destroy a target enemy card without attachments.
card.flavor: "Too many times in history has our family failed," Seppun Katsura told them. "If this Emperor dies, it will be only because there is not a single Seppun left alive to protect him."

card.name: Legion of Death
card.text:
Shadowlands • Undead • Unique
After this card enters play: Lose 4 Honor.
Fear Battle: Bow a target enemy Personality with lower Force than the number of Shadowlands cards in your current army.
card.flavor: "Easily created, loyal to a fault, and they never get tired. Honestly, it is a miracle the Empire still stands." - Hida Benjiro

card.name: Moonless Riders
card.text:
Cavalry • Unique
Battle: Bow a target enemy Infantry Personality.
card.flavor: "They are wave men operating out of Nanashi Mura. I find the use of such forces unpleasant, but there are no finer or quicker scouts in the Empire when the battlefield is shrouded in darkness." - Toturi Shigekawa

card.name: Student of Ninjutsu
card.text:
Ninja
Battle: If this card is in your hand: Attach it to your target personality.
card.flavor: "Young and naive, with a peculiar sense of idealism, and utterly without hesitation in obeying any order, even certain death. One might call them useful, yes." - Shosuro Toson

card.name: Armor of the Ryu
card.text:
Armor • Unique
This Personality has Cavalry.
Battle: If any enemy units are at the current battlefield: Move this Personality home or to the current battlefield.
card.flavor: A new and divine dynasty has returned the favor of the Heavens to mankind. Those fortunate enough to receive their blessings are changed forever by it.

card.name: Balanced Yari
card.text:
Weapon
Battle resolution does not bow cards in this unit.
card.flavor: "Most samurai favor the katana, but there are a multitude of weapons to choose from. Some offer unique advantages often overlooked." - Shiba Tsukimi

card.name: Five Harmonies Blend
card.text: Battle: Destroy this card: Straighten this Personality.
card.flavor: The greatest artisans, most skilled courtiers, most influential merchants, and a multitude of others assembled in the Scorpion lands, hoping to gain the Emperor's notice.

card.name: Fubatsu No-Dachi
card.text:
Weapon • Unique
Battle: Bow this card: Destroy a target card in the enemy army without attachments and with a Gold Cost of 6 or less.
card.flavor: "This youngster is making quite a name for himself. Where did this sudden explosion of skill come from, I wonder?" - Kaiu Genji

card.name: Layered Plates
card.text:
Armor
Negate effects that move this unit to a battlefield.
Reaction: Before this Personality is destroyed, destroy this card: Negate that destruction of the Personality.
card.flavor: "Highly effective in protecting the warrior beneath, but very limiting in terms of movement and reaction speed. A necessary trade-off, from time to time." - Daidoji Kikaze

card.name: Oyumi
card.text:
Weapon
Battle: Ranged 3 Attack.
Battle: Discard this card from your hand and pay 3 Gold: Ranged 3 Attack.
card.flavor: "A disgusting weapon, used only by peasants and bandits. A true samurai is not tempted by such toys." - Akodo Shigetoshi

card.name: Might of the Shadowlands
card.text:
Maho • Singular
Battle: Even if this card is not at the current battlefield: Target one or more Shadowlands cards at the current battlefield. Give each target +1F, or +2F if it is Undead. Lose 3 Honor.
card.flavor: Fire coursed over the ranks of the dead, but they only grew stronger from it.

card.name: Piercing the Heavens
card.text:
Air
Limited: Bow this Spell: Discard a card from one of your provinces, refilling the province face-up.
card.flavor: Throughout the Empire, shrines and temples swelled with attendants. Proof that the Heavens favored those who were worthy inspired tens of thousands to seek their blessings.

card.name: Seeking the Ancestors
card.text:
Void
Limited: Bow this Shugenja, or bow this Spell if this Shugenja has the Void keyword, and discard a face-up card from one of your provinces: Show the top card of your Fate deck. Put it in your hand if its Focus Value is lower than this Shugenja's Chi.
card.flavor: Not only the Lion consult their ancestors.

card.name: The Winds' Favor
card.text:
Air
Open: Bow this Shugenja: Target a Personality. After the next time this turn he assigns to attack you, gain 2 Honor and straighten this Shugenja.
card.flavor: "Turn your blade away, samurai. You cannot win the day. The kami will not permit it."

card.name: Shattered Peaks Castle
card.text: Battle/Open: Even if this card is bowed: Straighten your target unit.
card.flavor: The castle was built into the base of a mountain. An army of demons shattered the mountain, but the castle remains. This is the strength of the Crab.

card.name: Seven Fold Palace
card.text: Political Open: Choose your performing Personality with 1 Personal Honor or higher: Take the Imperial Favor.
card.flavor: To the Crane politics is like art: when skill is married to practice, success is assured.

card.name: Scouting Ahead
card.text:
Recon
Limited: Target your unbowed Scout: Target a province. After engaging in a battle at its battlefield, give all Scouts in your units that assigned there the ability, "Battle: Move this unit to, or home from, the current battlefield" until the battle at the province's battlefield ends.
card.flavor: "A day and a half in that direction. It is our best chance for success."

card.name: Presenting Papers
card.text:
Political
Reaction: After an action targets another player's Personality, target your unbowed Courtier: Negate the Personality's movement to battlefields from that action's effects.
card.flavor: Standard procedure requires all travelers to submit their papers. Many choose to overlook it, but honor demands adherence.

card.name: Mutual Hatred
card.text:
Dark Virtue
Battle: Target your unbowed Samurai: Target an enemy Personality. Before this battle's resolution, destroy both targets if they are opposing each other.
card.flavor: "A paragon of honor and a slave to duty, pitted against one another. How else could it end?" - The Sensei

card.name: I Do Not Die So Easily!
card.text: Reaction: After another player's action targets your Personality during a battle: Negate his destruction from the action's effects. After the resolution of your next Battle action this battle, destroy him.
card.flavor: "He was so enraptured by games and manipulations that he was not prepared to be confronted." - Tashime

card.name: Imperial Adjudication
card.text:
Iaijutsu • Imperial • Political
Open: Target your unbowed Duelist: He challenges another player's target Personality. If that Personality is honorable, his controller looks at the top three cards of his Fate Deck, then may refuse the duel; if he refuses, bow and dishonor the Personality, and discard those cards. Destroy the duel's loser.

card.name: Defensive Nature
card.text:
Political
Battle/Open: Target your unbowed Magistrate: Bow or straighten a target Personality with lower Personal Honor than your Magistrate's Chi.
card.flavor: "Three men, carrying weapons but no armor. Please be quiet, my lady. This will only take a moment."

card.name: Desperate Battle
card.text: Battle: If you control exactly one defending Personality at the current battlefield and he is unbowed, target and destroy him: Destroy a target enemy unit with equal or or lower Force than your Personality's Force plus 5.
card.flavor: "A god made mortal, perhaps, but an old man just the same. How difficult can it be to kill him?" - Yogo Kazunori

card.name: A False Accusation
card.text:
Political
Reaction: After the resolution of another player's action, if the action dishonored any of the player's own Personalities: Target and destroy one of those Personalities.
Battle: Target a Personality with the lowest Personal Honor at this battlefield (you choose if there is a tie). Reduce his Force to 0.

card.name: Tsudo no Oni
card.text:
Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Oni
After Tsudo enters play: Lose 6 Honor.
Battle: Destroy a target enemy card. That card's owner may target and destroy one of your cards at the current battlefield, other than this card.
card.flavor: "Be careful what you wish for," Akio warned. "I can count on one hand those who have faced an Oni Lord."

card.name: Yogo Kazunori
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Courtier • Shugenja • Hero • Villain • Unique
Political Limited: Target a dishonorable Personality. His controller loses 2 Honor.
Reaction: Before another player's action destroys Kazunori: Negate the destruction. You may move Kazunori home. If he moved, you may dishonor a Personality.
card.flavor: "So thin a line, between hero and monster."

card.name: Shiba Kosoku
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Samurai • Yojimbo
Reaction: When another player's action would target one of your Shugenja at Kosoku's location: It targets Kosoku instead, if legal.
card.flavor: "I would be honored to stand by your side, Tashime-sama. Whatever you require of me, it shall be done without question."

card.name: Yoritomo Iwata
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Commander
Reaction: After the resolution of one of your Ranged Attack actions, if Iwata is at the current battlefield: Give your target Personality in Iwata's army +2F.
card.flavor: "It seems there are things more important than glory or money. If I had learned earlier, perhaps I would not have ventured into the Shadowlands in the first place."

card.name: Tamori Shaiko
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Fire • Shugenja • Tattooed • Unique
Battle: Destroy Shaiko unless the targeted card's Force is equal to or lower than hers: Destroy a target enemy card without attachments.
card.flavor: "Brilliant, versatile, and completely without fear. I knew her only a short time, but I find that I miss her with each passing day." - Seppun Tashime

card.name: Kakita Aichiko
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Duelist • Unique
Reaction: Before Focus Effects resolve in a duel involving Aichiko: Set the Focus Value of one of your focused cards equal to Aichiko's Personal Honor.
card.flavor: "Hachimoto was a valiant opponent, and he met his fate without fear. I celebrate his memory and honor his family."

card.name: Hiruma Akio
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Gunso • Scout
Battle: If this battlefield's province has been targeted by a Recon action this turn: Bow a target enemy card without attachments.
card.flavor: "My brother prefers to travel the Empire and protect 'prophets.' I need only the Shadowlands, and demons to kill."

card.name: Essence of Destruction
card.text:
Black Scroll • Unique
If this Personality ever has a number of Corruption tokens equal to or greater than his base Chi: Destroy him.
Battle: Any number of times per turn, give this Personality a -1C Corruption token: Bow a target unit. Lose 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "You shall plague the Empire no longer!"

card.name: Seppun Blade
card.text:
Weapon
Battle: Bow this card, and discard a card unless this unit is opposed: Draw a card.
card.flavor: "An exquisite weapon, due more to the exceptional nature of those who carry them than any secret of its forging." - Miya Shoin, Imperial Herald

card.name: Order of Venom
card.text:
Shadowlands
After this card enters play: Lose 2 Honor.
Reaction: After a Kiho action is announced: Lose 1 Honor. Straighten this Personality. After the Kiho action ends, bow this Personality.
card.flavor: Few have any idea how deadly they are.

card.name: Dragon Attendants
card.text: Limited: Bow this card: Bow a target Follower with a lower Focus Value.
card.flavor: "They served the Divine Empress, prior to her ascension to the throne. Now they serve a new Kitsuki lord, with the same devotion and dedication for which they are known." - Togashi Satsu, Voice of the Empress

card.name: Doomed Undertaking
card.text:
Terrain
Battle: Non-Shadowlands Personalities have -2F/-1C while at this battlefield.
card.flavor: "They are completely mad, the entire lot of them. I suspect we will never see any of them again." - A Crab guard upon the Wall

card.name: Final Duty
card.text: Battle: If your current army has lower total Force than the current enemy army: Ranged 6 Attack.
card.flavor: "If I must die this way to wash away my brother's sins," Fosu said, "then so be it. I only wish Mariko could be spared."

card.name: Exposing Secrets
card.text:
Political
Open: If you have not taken an action from any copy of this card this turn, bow your target Courtier: Target another player. After the resolution of the next Reaction he takes this turn, he loses 3 Honor.
card.flavor: "You Crane pretend your honor is as flawless as your attire. We all know the truth!"

card.name: Training Maneuvers
card.text:
Terrain
Battle: If you control a Tactician or Scout Personality at the current battlefield: Your Personalities and Followers have +1F while there.
card.flavor: "A bushi's life consists of endless weeks and months of rigorous practice, puncuated by hours or days in the maddening chaos of battle." - Matsu Youko

card.name: Searching the Libraries
card.text: Open: Straighten a target Shugenja with a Spell attached.
card.flavor: "I am convinced that all but the greatest mysteries of the universe have been solved. We simply have not been able to put the pieces together as of yet." - Asako Bairei

card.name: Crippling Strike
card.text:
Kiho
Battle: Target your unbowed Monk, and bow him or one of your Rings: Bow a target enemy card.
card.flavor: "Spells mean as little as armor. Neither can save you from me." - Suikotsu

card.name: Expected Arrival
card.text:
Kiho
Battle: Target your unbowed Shugenja or Monk: Bow or straighten a target Unique Personality.
card.flavor: "I believe you will find everything in readiness, my lord. If you will follow me, we have arranged for the meeting you desire to take place immediately."

card.name: Essence of Evil
card.text:
Maho • Kiho
Battle/Open: Bow your target Shadowlands Shugenja at any location: Straighten one or two target Shadowlands Personalities.
card.flavor: "If good and evil must both exist, then why does it seem that those who succumb to evil are so much more powerful than good?" - Isawa Mariko

card.name: Fatal Error
card.text:
Fear
Open: Target your unbowed Personality: Target another Personality with lower Force. After each time this turn an action resolves that he performed, bow him.
card.flavor: "Are you challenging me, samurai? Draw your steel, and let us see who is the stronger man."

card.name: Demonic Possession
card.text:
Fear
Battle: Target your unbowed Oni: Target an enemy Personality. Give him -2F after each resolution of an action (including this action) taken during this battle.
card.flavor: "I hear your whispers but I will not succumb! I will die first!" The demon laughed. "That is perfectly acceptable."

card.name: Dance of Flames
card.text:
Fire • Kiho
Limited: Bow your target Shugenja or Monk: Give him a number of +1F Fire tokens equal to his Chi, plus one if he has the Fire keyword.
card.flavor: "I carry no steel so that my enemies will draw close enough for me to see their faces as they die."

card.name: Censure of Thunder
card.text:
Thunder • Kiho
Battle: Target your Shugenja, and bow him unless he is Thunder: Give a target enemy Personality -4F. If he now has 0F, you may take an additional Battle action.
card.flavor: "Your very existence is an offense to the Thunder Dragon, demon. Feel its wrath!"

card.name: Ritual of Binding
card.text:
Maho
Battle: Move your target opposed Shugenja home and destroy one of his Spells: Draw two cards.
card.flavor: "The method of binding great evil requires scrolls of incredible power. The risk in creating them, not to mention the binding process, must be warranted." - Asako Fosu

card.name: Unleashed Fury
card.text: Battle: Bow a target enemy unit. At your next opportunity to take a Battle action in this battle, you must pass.
card.flavor: "Your deceit and treachery have cost the lives of good and honorable samurai! For that, I promise you, you will suffer."

card.name: Cavalry Tactics
card.text: Battle: If any enemy units are at the current battlefield: Move your target Cavalry unit there. If it moved, straighten it and gain 2 honor.
card.flavor: "They bear Imperial colors, but we have to be sure. Send a scout detachment to greet them at once." - Moto Rena

card.name: Hanayashiki
card.text:
Singular
Limited: Bow this card: Straighten a target Magistrate.
card.flavor: "The village of Hanayashiki is famous for its order and serenity. It is a popular destination for magistrates who need reaffirmation." - Seppun Katsura

card.name: Seppun Tashime
card.text:
Samurai • Imperial • Magistrate • Paragon• Unique
Limited: Bow a target dishonorable personality.
card.flavor: "I will not endure an Empire in chaos, and I will not suffer a traitor to the throne to draw breath while I live."

card.name: Shinjo Ji-tae
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Commander
Battle: Move your target Personality home.
card.flavor: "Many among the Shinjo see the war as a means of washing away the sins of their fathers. Their zeal for battle, their willingness to sacrifice for the clan, has not gone unnoticed.

card.name: Shinjo Kai Li
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Scout
Reaction: After engaging, if Kai Li is at the current battlefield and you targeted its province with a Recon action this turn: You have the first chance to take a Battle action in this battle, which must come from a Terrain or Region.
card.flavor: "I would hold parley with Fu Leng himself, if it would bring my people victory over the hated Lion!"

card.name: Moto Sihung
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry
Battle: Bow Sihung: Ranged 4 Attack.
card.flavor: "Stop the Lion army at any cost," Rena commanded. Sihung smiled. "Our crops next year will be fed with a sea of Lion blood, my lord."

card.name: Moto Rena
card.text: Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Commander • Unique
card.flavor: The war between the Lion and the Unicorn was long and brutal. Many were made heroes or martyrs in the process. Some, however, were made tyrants.

card.name: Momiji
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Monk • Kensai • Order of Venom
After Momiji enters play: Lose 4 Honor
card.flavor: "I embraced the Dark Lord's blessings, and I have been made into so much more than what I was."

card.name: Daigotsu Rasetsu
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai
After Rasetsu enters play: Lose 5 Honor.
Battle/Open: Even if Rasetsu is bowed: Straighten him.
card.flavor: "Rediculous samurai, with their honor. They make for entertaining games, but little else."

card.name: Chuda Seikai
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Shugenja • Unique
After Seikai enters play: Lose 4 Honor.
Battle: Even if Seikai is not at the current battlefield: Give your target Undead card +3F.
card.flavor: "He does not speak, but then, given his abilities, he rarely has need to." - Suikotsu

card.name: The Student
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Student
The Student has +1F while you control The Sensei.
card.flavor: "First I shall learn how an honorable samurai must act, and then I shall learn how I must act."

card.name: The Sensei
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Sensei
Limited: The Sensei imparts his knowledge. Give another target Personality +3F.
card.flavor: "Do not be deceived by what you see, or what you are told. The world can only truly be perceived by the mind, and with the will to understand the truth."

card.name: Shosuro Takuma
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Ninja • Actor
Open: Target a Personality. After the next time this turn his unit is assigned or moves to a battlefield, give him a -1F Poison token.
card.flavor: "I can be anywhere. I can be anyone. When you accept a meal from your spouse or offer an embrace to your child, can you be sure it is not me?"

card.name: Isawa Kumai
card.text: Phoenix Clan • Air • Void • Shugenja • Alchemist • Ishiken
card.flavor: "I draw back the veil and become one with the world. All that has been, is, and shall be is revealed to me. To return to this flesh is... difficult."

card.name: Isawa Mariko
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Earth • Shugenja
Mariko has +2F while she has a Spell attached.
card.flavor: "I am no 'little one', sensei, and I will not stand by while others perform a duty in my stead. I am Phoenix. If my rebirth must come early, then let my name be remembered as a dutiful samurai."

card.name: Asako Fosu
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Void • Shugenja • Inquisitor • Magistrate • Unique
Limited: If you have exactly one Province: Discard any cards in it, refilling it face up.
Limited: Bow Fosu: Draw a card. If there are now two or more cards in your hand, discard one.
card.flavor: "Go home, little one. Leave this sacrifice for an old man."

card.name: Yoritomo Iwata - exp
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Commander • Experienced • Unique
Limited: Target your Mantis Clan Personality. If he is Naval, straighten him. If he is not Naval, give him Naval.
card.flavor: "There is nothing quite as thrilling as battle. Except possibly commerce."

card.name: Tsuruchi Suzuki
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Scout
Suzuki has +2F while at a battlefield whose province was targeted by a Recon Action this turn.
card.flavor: "Who dictates that honor must bind our lives into a narrow view? Life is an adventure, and I will experience every rich moment of it."

card.name: My Grandfather's Daisho
card.text:
Weapon
Battle: Straighten a target Item in your army. You may bow a target enemy Item.
card.flavor: "He carried it in service to his Emperor, and one day I shall carry it in service of mine. All praise the Son of Heaven, the Divine Emperor." - Hida Kisada, Son of Kuon

card.name: Essence of the East Wind
card.text:
Air
Battle: Bow this Shugenja: Your target bowed Personality contributes his Force during this battle's resolution even if bowed.
card.flavor:
"The situation is grim," the Ichiro said. "The Badger cannot stand alone."
"And they will not," answered the Mantis ambassador.

card.name: Shadowed Steel
card.text:
Ninja • Unique
Battle: Bow a target card with one or more Poison tokens.
card.flavor: "A minor order of vassals, created from Scorpion cast-offs generations ago. They have some degree of skill, but their primary benefit is their expendability." - Yogo Kazunori

card.name: Imperial Arrival
card.text:
Imperial
Until your second turn from now begins, Personalities have +1F, or +2F if they are Magistrates, while opposing one or more dishonorable Personalities.
card.flavor: Regardless of the circumstances, an Imperial magistrate must be received with courtesy and hospitality.

card.name: Conspiracy
card.text: Choose a Personality. After the next time this game he is destroyed while in an army, you, then the player who last controlled the Personality, each lose 5 Honor.
card.flavor: Some long so desperately for their goals to be achieved that they would consort with whoever can assist them.

card.name: The Loss of the Soul
card.text: Look at the top 5 cards of your Fate deck. You may show one of them that is a Spell, then put it in your hand. Put the remaining cards on the bottom of the deck in any order.
card.flavor: "Agasha Kyoso's tale is tragic for her family and clan, but she chose her own path. Her soul's fate is sealed." - Seppun Tashime

card.name: The Second Death of Kisada
card.text: You may destroy a target Personality with one or more Poison tokens. If this destroyed a Personality, his owner may destroy a Ninja Personality.
card.flavor: "He returned to the world young and vital, but rapidly aged to his true years. He was accompanied in death by two dozen assassins despite his age. Who could ask for more?" - Hida Kuon

card.name: Forward Camp
card.text:
Bow this card: Produce 1 Gold.
After an attack is declared: Straighten this card.
card.flavor: Despite tradition, the interruption of an Imperial visitor is not always welcome in times of strife.

card.name: Hida Hachimoto
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Kensai • Hero • Unique
Hachimoto uses his base Force as his duel stat.
card.flavor: "Born and trained among the Dragon, he was nevertheless a loyal Crab. His skill and humor will be missed upon the Wall." - Hida Benjiro

card.name: Hida Kagura
card.text: Crab Clan • Samurai • Berserker
card.flavor: "The death of Kisada exacerbated the situation between the Crab and the Crane. Even now that the war is over, they continue to hate one another. Who benefits?" - The Sensei

card.name: Yasuki Tijaki
card.text:
Crab Clan • Courtier
Political Limited: A target Personality may not perform Political Actions, or any actions if he is Crane Clan.
card.flavor: "Only a fool initiates a duel he cannot win." - Doji Kishio

card.name: Kakita Tasaka
card.text: Crane Clan • Samurai • Duelist
card.flavor: "The Crane were not responsible for Kisada's death, but celebrated it all the same. Such a predictable response. Arrogance makes an opponent weak." - The Sensei

card.name: Daidoji Inada
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Scout
After Inada turns face-up in a province: Dishonor him.
Battle: Bow a target enemy card without attachments. Destroy it if Inada is honorable.
card.flavor: "Will the Crane ever escape the stain of the Harriers' dishonor?" - Doji Domotai

card.name: Doji Kishio
card.text:
Crane Clan • Courtier
Political Open: Discard the Imperial Favor: Straighten a target Holding.
card.flavor: "I will show that perfumed fool how a samurai dies. Better to die with honor and glory than live as a fearful, delicate flower." - Yasuki Tijaki

card.name: Kitsuki Umibe
card.text: Dragon Clan • Courtier • Ambassador
card.flavor: "An appointment to the Yasuki lands is burdensome indeed. Fortunately, he possesses the patience and decorum to see the job done and done correctly." - Kitsuki Berii

card.name: Togashi Sho
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Fire • Monk • Tattooed
Sho has +3F if a Tattoo card is in your discard pile.
card.flavor: "My presence encourages appropriate behavior in others, and I need not even speak. I believe the Lion refer to it as 'deterrence.'"

card.name: Mirumoto Eikaru
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Duelist
After Eikaru enters play from one of your provinces: Draw a card.
card.flavor: "Given a choice, he would have preferred the life of a courtier. Unfortunately his skill with the blade necessitated a different path." - Kitsuki Umibe

card.name: Akodo Tsudoken
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Tactician • Commander • Unique
Battle/Open: Even if Tsudoken is bowed: Straighten your target unit.
card.flavor: "The burdens of command are without number, and it is a rare man who can handle them all without difficulty. I can only strive to be such a man."

card.name: Ikoma Ryudo
card.text:
Lion Clan • Courtier
Political Battle: Even if Ryudo is not at the current battlefield, bow him: Give your target opposed Personality +4F.
card.flavor: "The Ikoma are the voice of the Lion, but they can also serve as its memory. None are better at such a task than Ryudo." - Akodo Tsudoken

card.name: Matsu Youko
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai
Fear Battle: Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers.
card.flavor: "I have no use for fools or formalities. I am a warrior, not some weak-willed courtier."

card.name: Matsu Shunran
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Paragon
Shunran has +2F while attacking.
Units may not be assigned opposing Shunran during Cavalry Maneuvers.
card.flavor: "Remain close to me, Ineko-sama. I will ensure that no harm comes to you."

card.name: Moshi Enju
card.text: Mantis Clan • Thunder • Shugenja • Naval
card.flavor: A great many Moshi are assigned to serve as first mates to Yoritomo captains. Their skill at speaking to the kami is a great boon to the Mantis, and their deferential nature is perhaps even more valuable to their captains.

card.name: Striking the Balance
card.text:
Dark Virtue • Bushido Virtue
Limited: One of your target Samurai Personalities permanently gains Paragon. After the next time he assigns, you may either give him a +1PH token and gain 1 Honor, or a +1F token and lose 3 Honor.

card.name: Front Line Camp
card.text:
Unique
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Open: Bow this card: A target Region's abilities may not be used.
card.flavor: "For perhaps the first time, the Great Clans united against a threat from beyond the Empire on the order of their Emperor, standing shoulder to shoulder as one vast legion." - The Ikoma Histories

card.name: Miya Shoin - exp
card.text:
Courtier • Imperial • Herald • Experienced • Unique
Political Open: Bow Shoin: The player with the Imperial Favor discards it.
card.flavor: "I have seen too many wars, and too many Emperors die. I will not stand idly by and let this new Dynasty fall to some malignant madman from the northern wastelands."

card.name: Opportunistic Ronin
card.text:
Ronin
Battle: Destroy a target Terrain.
card.flavor: "There is a time and place for a man like me to intervene. When I do, I make certain that I benefit, and that those around me will never be the same. How else can I be remembered forever?"

card.name: Limbs of Fudo
card.text:
Fudo • Singular
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Open: Bow this card: Give each Personality and Follower in a target unit +1F.
card.flavor: "Fudo's interpretation of the Tao is not well received in many areas, and even some among the Brotherhood call it into question."

card.name: Imperial Legionaries
card.text:
Imperial
Political Battle: Even if this card is bowed: Straighten your target Imperial Personality or Follower.
card.flavor: "The Empire has no room for this brand of madness," Jimen said. "Slaughter the Yobanjin to a man. Destroy every relic of their presence. Burn the earth where they touched it. I want nothing of them to remain."

card.name: Imperial Command
card.text:
Political • Imperial
Reaction: After a target card is destroyed: Remove it from the game.
Reaction: When an action would target your Unique Personality, pay 2 Gold: The action targets another of your Personalities instead, if legal.
card.flavor: "The Emperor must hear of this!"

card.name: The War of Dark Fire
card.text: Choose another player. Until your next turn begins, negate all his Honor gains during Action Phases and Dynasty Phases.
card.flavor: "In the winter of 1170, the legions of the Dark Oracle assaulted the northern border of Rokugan, and the Empire faltered under their assault." - The Ikoma Histories

card.name: Festival of Drifting Souls
card.text:
Festival
Until your next turn begins, after the first time each turn a player attaches a card from his hand, draw a card.
card.flavor: On the day of the festival, all who have lost someone to war float a candle, hoping the souls of the loved ones can find their way to the next life in peace.

card.name: Harmony Has Been Found
card.text: Kiho Limited: Bow your target Monk or Shugenja: Put a Ring into play from your hand.
card.flavor: The Dragon now face their greatest test since the ascension of Hitomi.

card.name: The Water Dragon's Favor
card.text:
Water • Kiho
Battle: Bow your target Shugenja or Monk: Straighten your target unit. If your Shugenja or Monk has the Water keyword, you may target and straighten another unit.
card.flavor: "You look weary, my friend! Let me offer you refreshment!"

card.name: United
card.text: Battle/Open: Target five of your non-Shadowlands Personalities, no two of whom share a Clan alignment: Give each of them +4F. Negate their movement home from other players' action until the turn ends.
card.flavor: "It was a glorious battle against an impossible foe. Many lives were lost, and yet honor won the day." - The Ikoma Histories

card.name: A Magistrate's Blade
card.text:
Weapon
This Personality has Imperial and Magistrate.
card.flavor: "There is little that a magistrate cannot accomplish with the proper tools at his disposal. An emissary of the throne should have strength of steel that matches the strength of his honor." - Seppun Katsura

card.name: Friendly Traveler Sake
card.text:
Sake
(This card is controlled by the controller of the Personality it is attached to.)
Limited: Transfer this card to a Personality controlled by another player. It if attaches, gain Honor equal to the Personality's Personal Honor.
card.flavor: The finest in all of Rokugan.

card.name: Ritual of Summoning
card.text:
Maho
Limited: Destroy this card: Permanently set the performing Shugenja's Force and Chi to 5, and permanently give him Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Oni and the ability, "Battle: Bow this card: Ranged 7 Attack." Lose 3 Honor.
card.flavor: "You wanted power so badly, little human. Was it worth it?"

card.name: Mirumoto Minawa
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Kensai
Battle: Bow a target enemy Personality with lower Force and lower Chi.
card.flavor: "I am Minawa, son of Choten, son of Bujun, and this is my grandfather's sword, Truth. Stand down, or it will taste your blood."

card.name: Akodo Shigetoshi - exp2
card.text:
Lion Clan • Clan Champion • Samurai • Tactician • Commander • Experienced 2 • Loyal • Unique
Reaction: After Shigetoshi enters play: Create a 2F Follower and attach it to a target Personality.
Battle: Destroy your target Personality or Follower: Destroy a target enemy card; if your own targeted card was a Follower, the targeted enemy card must have no attachments.

card.name: Yoritomo Naizen - exp3
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Clan Champion • Samurai • Naval • Commander • Experienced 3 • Loyal • Unique
Battle: Ranged 6 Attack.
Battle: Target a Follower in your hand or discard pile. Attach it to your target Personality, paying 3 less Gold. You may take an additional Battle action.
card.flavor: "He is called the Scourge of Storms. On the seas, he cannot be defeated." - Akodo Shigetoshi

card.name: Yoritomo Suwa
card.text: Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Commander
card.flavor: "The founder of the Mantis Clan was the son of the Thunder Dragon and the grandson of the Kami Hida. The Mantis do not accept their destiny, they seize it and make it their own." - Moto Chen

card.name: Bayushi Sakai
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Kensai • Bitter Lies
Battle: Bow Sakai or a Weapon attached to him: Bow a target enemy Personality. If he is dishonorable, you may target and destroy one of his attachments.
card.flavor: "A weak spirit means a weak blade. I shall destroy both."

card.name: Chuda Shuzo
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Shugenja
After Shuzo enters play: Lose 6 Honor.
Limited: Discard a card and pay 2 Gold: Create a 2F/2C/0PH Shadowlands • Undead Personality.
card.flavor: "Resist and die. Surrender and die. Just die."

card.name: Daigotsu Taizo
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai • Undead
After Taizo enters play: Lose 5 Honor.
card.flavor: "Do you recognize him, young samurai? If he your father, brother, cousin? Is he your past or your future?" - Chuda Mishime

card.name: Shinjo Hwarang
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Commander
Battle: If Hwarang is opposed: Bow or straighten a target Personality.
card.flavor: The Shinjo family has worked hard to eliminate the shame of their grandfathers. After the last war, many believe that the family has now redeemed itself."

card.name: Know Your Center
card.text:
Battle: Target your unbowed Personality with 3 or higher Chi: Destroy a target Terrain.
Battle: Move your target unit at a battlefield to a battlefield where there are enemy units.
card.flavor: "Our Champion commands us to hold this position. We will not fail her." - Mirumoto Mareshi

card.name: Heavenly Tetsubo of the Crab
card.text:
Weapon • Unique
Will only attach to a Crab Clan Personality.
Battle: Even if you control no units at the current battlefield and even if this unit is not there: Give its province +3 or -3 strength.
card.flavor: "To the Crab, the Empress grants the strength of the Heavens, that the Crab's might shall never be rivaled." - The Voice of the Empress

card.name: Heavenly Blade of the Crane
card.text:
Weapon • Unique
Will only attach to a Crane Clan Personality.
Open: Bow this card: Target another player with one or more unbowed Personalities. He may choose to bow one of them. If he did not bow a Personality, gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "To the Crane, the Empress grants the beauty of the Heavens, to mirror their own." - The Voice of the Empress

card.name: Heavenly Daisho of the Dragon
card.text:
Weapon • Unique
Will only attach to a Dragon Clan Personality.
Reaction: Even if this card is bowed, after an action resolves which this Personality performed: Straighten this unit.
card.flavor: "To the Dragon, the Empress grants the twin gifts of purpose and form, that they might never be without them." - The Voice of the Empress

card.name: Heavenly Jumonji-yari of the Lion
card.text:
Weapon • Unique
Will only attach to a Lion Clan Personality.
Battle: Bow this card: Give your target attacking Lion Clan Personality +3F.
card.flavor: "To the Lion, the Empress grants the fury of the Heavens, that all might fear their wrath." - The Voice of the Empress

card.name: Heavenly Kama of the Mantis
card.text:
Weapon • Unique
Will only attach to a Mantis Clan Personality.
Battle/Open: Even if this card is bowed, lose 1 Honor: Straighten your target Holding.
card.flavor: "To the Mantis, the Empress grants the certainty of the Heavens, that they might never waver." - The Voice of the Empress

card.name: Heavenly Yari of the Phoenix
card.text:
Weapon • Unique
Will only attach to a Phoenix Clan Personality.
Reaction: After the resolution of an action whose effects attached a Spell from your hand, bow this card: Straighten a target Personality. Give him +2F.
card.flavor: "To the Phoenix, the Empress grants the fire of Heaven, that it might burn brightly in the world of man." - The Voice of the Empress

card.name: Heavenly Ninja-to of the Scorpion
card.text:
Weapon • Unique
Will only attach to a Scorpion Clan Personality.
Your provinces have +2 strength while this card is in play.
card.flavor: "To the Scorpion, the Empress grants the shadow of Heaven, that they might be ever hidden." - The Voice of the Empress

card.name: Heavenly Lance of the Unicorn
card.text:
Weapon • Unique
Will only attach to a Unicorn Clan Personality.
Open: Bow this card: Either straighten or remove Cavalry from a target Personality.
card.flavor: "To the Unicorn, the Empress grants the will of the Heavens, that their path might never stray again." - The Voice of the Empress

card.name: Shiro Daidoji
card.text:
Your Samurai have +1F while defending.
Battle: Even if this card is bowed, bow your performing Personality: Ranged Attack with strength equal to his Force. Gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: Site of the oldest dojo in the Daidoji lands, it is the symbol of their greatest pride.

card.name: Shrine of Champions
card.text:
Temple
Battle: Even if this card is bowed and even if you control no units at the current battlefield, bow one of your Temples: Move a target attacking Personality home.
card.flavor: "The greatest among us, Ujimitsu, Tsukune, Mirabu... here we remember them." - Shiba Tsukimi

card.name: Fields of the Dead
card.text:
You do not lose Honor from cards you own.
Maho Limited: If there is a Personality in a discard pile, pay 3 Gold: Create a 2F/2C/0PH Shadowlands • Undead Personality.
card.flavor: Daigotsu learned much from the Jackals.

card.name: Blowdarts
card.text:
Ninja • Weapon
Will only attach to a Ninja Personality.
Limited: Destroy this card: Give a -1F Poison token to one or two target Personalities.
card.flavor: "They are difficult to use accurately, but extremely effective when mastered." - Shosuro Toson, Ninja Master of the Scorpion Clan

card.name: Midnight Assault
card.text: Until your next turn begins, negate all Honor gains during Attack Phases.
card.flavor: The Spider Clan, commanded to dissolve and dispose of their banners on pain of death, still exists. They simply choose their battles more carefully.

card.name: The Stone Discovered
card.text: You may put a Follower, Item, or Spell from your discard pile into your hand.
card.flavor: "There is a legend among the zokujin of an ancient power called the Blood-White Stone. If it were ever rediscovered, it would change the destiny of their race forever." - Asako Bairei

card.name: Under Siege
card.text: Until your next turn begins, all provinces have -2 strength.
card.flavor: "There are precious few fortresses in the Empire that can withstand a true siege. This is a lesson the Crab must not learn the hard way." - Kaiu Taru

card.name: Family Histories
card.text:
Unique
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold, plus 1 Gold for each of your provinces destroyed this game.
Limited: Bow this card: Gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: The tales of a thousand heroes are contained within, giving inspiration to generations of their descendants.

card.name: Simple Merchants
card.text:
Unique
Bow this card: Produce 4 Gold, plus 1 additional Gold for each Farm, Mine, and Port you control.
card.flavor: "Common peasants, selling their excess in order to make a better life for their families. They deserve their purpose." - Yoritomo Utemaro, Imperial Treasurer

card.name: Hida Rokurota
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Commander • Unique
Battle: Attach a target Follower from your hand or discard pile to your target Personality.
card.flavor: "What are you waiting for? Will you let a few goblins and a volcano halt your progress?"

card.name: Hida Shinko
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Berserker
Battle: Destroy Shinko: Destroy a target enemy card without attachments.
card.flavor: "Even the Damned fear her. Some believe her father was a demon. Personally, I doubt that. I have never seen a demon as ferocious as her." - Hida Reiha

card.name: Hiruma Etsuro
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Scout • Unique
Recon Limited: Give a target province -2 strength.
card.flavor: "There is nowhere he cannot go, nothing he cannot hunt. Were he a Scorpion, I would fear him above all others." - Hiruma Todori

card.name: Daidoji Harada
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Scout
Harada has +2F while he is opposing a Personality whose controller has lower Family Honor than you.
card.flavor: "If the Army of Fire should return, the Crane will remain in place to defeat them. The glory must not go to the Scorpion."

card.name: Doji Kato
card.text:
Crane Clan • Courtier • Unique
Political Battle: Even if Kato is not at the current battlefield: Move a target bowed Personality home. If you do not control him, gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "We have to find some way to overcome the alliance of Emerald Champion and Imperial Chancellor, Nagori-sama. Perhaps we should consider how the Advisor might be of use to us."

card.name: Kakita Toshiro
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Duelist • Unique
Iaijutsu Battle: Bow Toshiro: Bow a target enemy card without attachments, and with lower Chi than Toshiro if the card is a Personality.
card.flavor: "You might have lived to see another dawn, had you not questioned my family's honor."

card.name: Akodo Kurogane
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Tactician • Unique
Battle: If there are more units on your side of the current battlefield than on the enemy side, bow all cards in your target unit: Destroy a target non-Unique Personality.
card.flavor: "Place the tenth through twentieth legions on review, and schedule additional maneuvers. Victory is no justification for lack of discipline."

card.name: Ikoma Igawa
card.text:
Lion Clan • Courtier • Unique
Reaction: After engaging in a battle, if Igawa is in the current attacking army, discard a card: The Defender chooses and discards a card from his hand.
card.flavor: "The Crane and the Scorpion are so preoccupied with one another that little effort is expended against anyone else. I never fail to recognize opportunity."

card.name: Moshi Takako
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Thunder • Shugenja • Naval • Unique
Battle: Bow Takako, choose a number from 1 to 10, and pay that much Gold: Ranged Attack with strength equal to the number chosen.
card.flavor: "Channeling the power of Thunder can have devastating effect, but the cost can be considerable."

card.name: Tsuruchi Oguri
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Scout • Unique
Battle: Bow Oguri: Ranged 4 Attack. You may move Oguri home. If he moved, straighten him.
card.flavor: "What use are the courts, with their stifling rules and mind-numbing conversation? Give me the open air and prey to hunt."

card.name: Yoritomo Sasake
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Commander
Battle: Straighten your target Follower.
card.flavor: "It is only because I am an honorable servant of the Mantis Clan that I do not kill you for your insult. Call me a pirate again, and I will leave you only enough teeth to warn others."

card.name: Isawa Reido
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Fire • Shugenja • Unique
Battle: Destroy your target Personality or Follower: Destroy a target Personality or Follower without attachments and with equal or lower Force than your targeted Personality or Follower.
card.flavor: "Do you doubt the power of the elements? I will show you the truth found in fire!"

card.name: Isawa Tanaka
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Water • Shugenja • Cavalry
Battle: Move your target Personality at any location to a battlefield where there are one or more enemy units.
card.flavor: "Why must there always be war? Why can man not turn away from conflict and embrace our place in the universe? So long as war exists, the Phoenix must stand ready."

card.name: Bayushi Kayama
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Kensai • Bitter Lies • Unique
While Kayama has a Weapon, he contributes Force during battle resolution even while bowed.
Battle: Bow Kayama: Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers.
card.flavor: "I have no need of poison, stealth, or subtlety. Face me and understand why."

card.name: Bayushi Tsubaki
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Ninja • Unique
Limited: Bow Tsubaki: Bow a target Personality and give him a -1F Poison token.
card.flavor: "We were simply having a stroll by the lake when sensei-sama collapsed in mid-sentence! We all tried but there was nothing we could do!" - A student of the late Sensei Togama

card.name: Daigotsu Oki
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Oni • Courtier • Infilitrator • Unique
After Oki enters play: Gain 3 Honor.
Political Open: Destroy Oki: Target a Personality with lower Personal Honor than Oki. His unit may not be assigned and will not move to battlefields this turn.
card.flavor: "Oh, Fortunes, aren't you a darling! Where is your mother, little one?"

card.name: Iuchi Kota
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Shugenja • Cavalry • Unique
Kota has +2F while he has a Spell attached.
Battle: Attach a target Spell from your hand to Kota.
card.flavor: "His training with the Kuni family has left him with certain... social deficits." - Moto Akikazu

card.name: Shinjo Kodama
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Commander • Unique
Open: Straighten all Cavalry cards in a target unit.
card.flavor: "I have no agenda, no driving quest, no political aspirations. I am a soldier, nothing more. I hope only to serve with distinction, that my sons will be proud of me."

card.name: Utaku Yanai
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Battle Maiden
Battle: Give a target enemy Personality or Follower -2F. If its Force is now 0, bow it and gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "With respect, Ikoma-sama, your maps are woefully out of date. This village belongs to the Unicorn. I trust we can resolve this matter without needless bloodshed?"

card.name: Pokupo
card.text:
Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Goblin • Scout
After Pokupo enters play: Lose 2 Honor.
Pokupo has +1F while you control Pokku.
card.flavor: "The notion of that little wretch Pokku having spawned fills me with horror... and nausea." - Chuda Hiroe

card.name: Kyogen
card.text:
Ronin • Actor
Open: Give Kyogen a keyword on your target Personality.
card.flavor: "Now I will perform for you the tragic tale of Matsu Itagi and Hida Tadaka, great men undone by pride despite all their prowess."

card.name: Undefended Border
card.text:
Unique
Battle: Bow this card: Give your target Personality +1F, and an additional +1F if he is a Scout or Tactician.
card.flavor: "I know an inlet, one with no patrols or waystations. If you want to gain entrance to their lands, this is the way to do it." - Yoritomo Han-ku

card.name: Do Not Turn Your Back!
card.text:
Unique
Battle/Open: Straighten your target Personality.
Battle: Target your unbowed Commander Personality: Straighten one or two target units.
card.flavor: "I am not finished yet! Draw your weapon and face me!"

card.name: Fields of Battle
card.text:
Terrain
Battle: While at this battlefield, Personalities with 0 or 1 Personal Honor may not use their base abilities and have -1F.
card.flavor: What begins as a relatively minor dispute may be settled with the blood of thousands. But honor will be assuaged.

card.name: Mastery of the Blade
card.text: Battle: Straighten your target Personality with a Weapon. You may move him home.
card.flavor: The brutality of the so-called Spider monks is well known, even only a few years after they appeared. Their mastery of the bisento is a thing of legend.

card.name: Outmatched
card.text:
Unique
Battle: Bow your target Personality: Bow one or two target enemy Personalities, each with lower Chi and lower Personal Honor than your Personality.
card.flavor: "Did you honestly think you could hide from me? And here, of all places!"

card.name: The Cresting Wave
card.text: Battle: Give each of your opposed Personalities and Followers at the current battlefield +1F.
card.flavor: "When the bodies pile up around you like a mountain, and your enemies must crawl over their dead comrades to crash against you in waves, that is the only time I feel alive." - Hida Shinko

card.name: Wrathful Defense
card.text: Battle: Bow your target Personality: Move a target enemy Personality home. Until the turn ends, negate his movement from costs or effects of actions.
card.flavor: "They are miserable, cowardly creatures, unless you threaten something they consider theirs." - Kuni Kiyoshi

card.name: Dutiful Yojimbo
card.text:
Yojimbo • Unique
Attaches to a Unique Personality paying 2 less Gold.
Battle: Even if this card is bowed: Straighten a target non-Unique card in a unit.
card.flavor: "Conduct your negotiations without fear, my lord. You will not be interrupted."

card.name: Heavy Regulars
card.text: Battle: Destroy this card: Ranged 5 Attack.
card.flavor: The backbone of any fighting force, the heavy regulars often follow the front line troops and seek to break the formation of the enemy line.

card.name: Seppun Heavy Infantry
card.text: Battle resolution does not bow cards in this unit.
card.flavor: "They have sworn to die to a man before the Empress comes to any harm. I have seen them on maneuver, and I believe their devotion is genuine." - Otomo Taneji

card.name: Spearmen Legion
card.text: Battle: Bow this card: Ranged 4 Attack.
card.flavor: Quickly trained and eager for glory, they rarely survive more than a handful of battles. Those who do quickly become the favored forces of their commander.

card.name: Traveling Wardens
card.text:
Cavalry • Unique
Battle: Give a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers -3F.
card.flavor: "It is the duty of the Lion Clan to secure all clan borders. I need to see your traveling papers immediately."

card.name: Infamous Blade
card.text:
Weapon • Unique
Battle: Bow this card: Destroy a target enemy Follower.
card.flavor: "This blade was stained with the blood of forty-seven men, and none of them claimed in battle. Are you fit to wield it and fulfill its legacy?" - Shosuro Toson

card.name: Straw Horse
card.text:
Unique
This Personality has the Cavalry keyword.
card.flavor: "Some legends say they ferry the spirits of the dead between the realm of mortals and their final destination. To me it is just a spectacularly ugly place to put my saddle." - Shinjo Kodoma

card.name: Yari
card.text:
Weapon
Reaction: After an action targets this Personality: Negate all Force penalties on this Personality from the action.
card.flavor: Useful and inexpensive to produce, the yari is a popular choice for forces that are not expected to survive on the battlefield.

card.name: Breath of the Dragon
card.text:
Fire • Unique
Battle: Bow and destroy this Shugenja: Destroy a target enemy Personality without attachments. You may then target an enemy Personality and destroy all his attachments.
card.flavor: "Go now, and do not look back. I will deal with this rabble." - Isawa Reido

card.name: Earthen Blade
card.text:
Earth • Unique
Your Personalities with a Weapon have +2F.
card.flavor: "The ritual draws upon fire, water, and air to enhance the natural strength and power of earth. The blade born of this ritual can cut through anything, and will never break." - Isawa Emori

card.name: Rejuvenating Vapors
card.text:
Water
Battle: Even if this unit is not at the current battlefield, bow this Shugenja: Target your Personality. Give him +3F if he is unbowed. Straighten him.
card.flavor: "Let the strength and clarity of water wash away your fatigue, my friend. Stand and fight once more."

card.name: Lost Traveler Castle
card.text: After the first time each turn you choose a Personality to bring into play during your Dynasty Phase: You may pay 2 less Gold, and after he enters play, gain Honor equal to his Personal Honor.

card.name: Sunrise Keep
card.text:
After the first time each turn you choose a Personality to bring into play during your Dynasty Phase: You may pay 2 less Gold for him and ignore his Honor Requirement.
Battle: Even if this card is bowed, target your opposed Personality: Give him +2F.

card.name: Daidoji Kimpira
card.text: Crane Clan • Samurai
card.flavor: "From the time of my family's creation, we have been the defenders of the Crane. On the battlefield, or in the courts, we stand between our clan and those who would do it harm."

card.name: Hida Kuon - exp6
card.text:
Crab Clan • Clan Champion • Samurai • Berserker • Commander • Hero • Experienced 6 • Loyal • Unique
After the first each battle another player's action targets Kuon: If he is the only Personality in his army, the action's (remaining) effects do not happen.
Battle: Even if Kuon is bowed, if any enemy units are at the current battlefield: Move your target Personality there. If he moved, straighten him.
card.flavor: "We stand against the darkness."

card.name: Festival of Cherry Blossoms
card.text:
Festival
After the next time this game another player gains Honor, you gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "Kitsuki-san, I hear that the Kakita Daimyo and the Emerald Champion are in conflict." "Ah, Shinjo-san. Crane and Scorpion: together they create the dance of the court."

card.name: Family Keep
card.text:
Castle
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold, or 3 Gold if paying for a card with a base Gold Cost of 9 or more.
Open: If it is not your turn, you have only one Province, and you have one or zero cards in your hand: Draw a card.
card.flavor: The largest castles are divided among families.

card.name: Token of Destiny
card.text:
Unique
Reaction: After another player's action targets this Personality, destroy this card: Negate the Personality's destruction from the action's effects.
card.flavor: "I felt light-headed for a moment, and then it simply broke. I wonder what could have happened?"

card.name: Thunderous Report
card.text:
Thunder
Battle: Bow this Shugenja and destroy this Spell: Bow each Follower and Personality at this battlefield without attachments and with lower Force than the performing Shugenja's Chi.
card.flavor: "None can stand against the fury of the thunder and live." - Moshi Takako

card.name: Elite Archers
card.text: Battle: Discard a card: Ranged Attack with strength equal to the discarded card's Focus Value plus 1.
card.flavor: "Our units on the front line have mingled with the enemy. Choose your targets carefully. Officers are your priority. Fire at will."

card.name: Iron Fan
card.text:
Tessen • Weapon
Reaction: After another player's Battle action targets this Personality: Give a target enemy Personality or Follower -3F.
card.flavor: "It serves for a commander to signal his forces, a courtier to conceal her intent, and a warrior to strike down his enemies. How can one fail to appreciate its versatility?" - Ikoma Hagio

card.name: Under Cover of Night
card.text:
Terrain
Battle: Before this battle's resolution, you may target and bow a Personality with the highest Personal Honor at this battlefield (including ties).
card.flavor: "Travel papers and magistrates' stations would interfere with our work. This matter requires discretion."

card.name: Timely Assistance
card.text: Limited: Bow your target Personality: Give another target Personality a Force bonus equal to your Personality's Force. Straighten the first targeted Personality after your next End Phase begins.
card.flavor: "Come along, brother. Things here are about to become a bit too interesting."

card.name: Prayer for Guidance
card.text:
Bushido Virtue
Battle/Open: Target your honorable Samurai: After the next time this turn he is destroyed or bowed by another player's action or by battle resolution, gain 3 Honor.
card.flavor: "Guide my hand, mother. Give me the will to be the hand of the Scorpion."

card.name: Obfuscation
card.text: Battle: Attach a target attachment from your hand or discard pile to your target Personality. You may take an additional action to use one of the attachment's base Battle abilities.
card.flavor: "Mask one thing with another, and even before a crowd, your actions will go unnoticed." - Kyogen

card.name: Forward Reconnaissance
card.text:
Recon
Open: Target a province. During battles at the province's battlefield, Terrain actions may only be taken by a player with a Scout Personality in his army.
card.flavor: "Find out all you can. Leave signs for other scouts, in case you are killed." - Hiruma Todori

card.name: For My Brothers!
card.text: Battle: Remove your target dead Personality from the game: Give a target enemy Personality or Follower a Force penalty equal to the removed Personality's base Force.
card.flavor: "I heard your boasting, braggart! My brothers will take issue with your disgraceful slander in the next world!"

card.name: Well-Defended Border
card.text:
Unique
Attacking Personalities and Followers have -1F while at this province's battlefield.
Reaction: After another player's Dynasty Phase begins, if he controls any units and did not assign any to attack this province this turn: Gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: The invasion in the north has caused many clans to carefully re-evaluate their own defenses.

card.name: Arugai no Oni
card.text:
Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Oni • Unique
After Arugai enters play: Lose 8 Honor.
Reaction: After another player's action targets an Oni at Arugai's location: Negate the Oni's destruction from the action's effects.
card.flavor: "It is not a complex opponent, but it can be very difficult to kill once and for all." - Hida Benjiro

card.name: Daigotsu Shinjitsu
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai • Paragon • Dark Truth
After Shinjitsu enters play: Lose 4 Honor.
Battle: Discard a Dark Virtue card: Give Shinjitsu a Force bonus equal to the discarded card's Focus Value plus 1.
card.flavor: "My name means truth. Can you see the truth of the world in my face, fool?"

card.name: Chuda Fukuzo
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Bog Hag • Shugenja • Infiltrator • Unique
After Fukuzo enters play: Lose 2 Honor.
Maho Reaction: After the resolution of an action that destroyed any Personalities at Fukuzo's battlefield: Give Fukuzo a Force bonus equal to one of the Personalities' Force.
card.flavor: "I find the form of a human most useful for all manner of proper mischief."

card.name: Bayushi Sihaken
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Magistrate
Reaction: After Sihaken's army destroys one or more provinces or enemy units by winning a battle: The Defender loses 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "Scorpions make surprisingly effective magistrates. After all, who knows the law better than those who make a habit of breaking it?" - Kitsuki Hanbei

card.name: Shiba Nobuyuki
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Samurai • Yojimbo • Unique
Battle/Open: Give Nobuyuki a Force bonus equal to your target Shugenja's Chi.
card.flavor: "It is my duty to stand at the side of the Isawa, no matter the danger. As long as I live, they need not fear for their lives."

card.name: Tamori Masako
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Earth • Shugenja
Reaction: After Masako's unit assigns or moves to a battlefield: Give the battlefield's province +3 or -3 strength.
card.flavor: "We must ensure that our lands can never be threatened again. His army is lost, but the Dark Oracle lives on."

card.name: Mirumoto Ayabe
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Kensai • Commander • Unique
Battle: Even if Ayabe is bowed: Straighten a target Personality with one or more attachments. Then, bow all attachments in that Personality's unit.
