card.flavor: "Your legions have our thanks for your assistance, and you are free to remain as long as you like... but we have nothing to feed you."

card.name: Kitsuki Hanbei
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Magistrate • Unique
Open: Give -3F to a target Personality with lower Personal Honor than Hanbei's Chi.
card.flavor: "The Dragon and their tedious emphasis on 'evidence' can be most troubling. If they were not the family of the Empress, we would have to unsure they were no longer a concern." - Bayushi Sihaken

card.name: Espionage
card.text: Look at all face-down cards in one other player's provinces.
card.flavor: "All clans seek information on their enemies, even if they choose to believe otherwise. The Scorpion are far better at it than most, but even they let down their guard down eventually." - Kyogen

card.name: Dramatic Assassination
card.text: Ninja Limited: Bow your target Ninja Personality and pay Gold equal to the targeted unit's total Gold Cost: Destroy a target unit. Lose 4 Honor.
card.flavor: "Messy, yes, but sometimes it is better to be effective than neat." - Soshi Ganrou

card.name: The Field of the Winds
card.text: Battle: Even if this card is bowed, bow your performing Cavalry Follower: Target a unit opposing the Follower. Move your Follower's unit, or the enemy unit, home or to a battlefield where it would be opposed.
card.flavor: The Three Armies will love on.

card.name: Hidden Moon Dojo
card.text: Open: Look at all face-down cards in a target player's provinces. If you destroy a province this turn, its owner will not refill provinces during his next Action Phase.
card.flavor: "We are the night." - Shosuro Toson

card.name: Sinister Bisento of the Spider
card.text:
Weapon • Unique
Will only attach to a Spider Clan Personality.
Reaction: Even if this card is bowed, after an action resolves during which a card was destroyed at this card's location: Straighten this unit.
card.flavor: "The Empress chose to overlook us when bestowing her gifts upon the Great Clans. Unfortunate, but we are not without patrons of our own." - Daigotsu

card.name: Moto Chen - exp3
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Clan Champion • Samurai • Cavalry • Tactician • Commander • Experienced 3 • Loyal • Unique
After another player's Political action targets Chen: Its effects do not happen.
Battle: Target an enemy unit with lower total Force than Chen's unit. Chen tramples it. Destroy it. You may target and destroy a Kolat card in the enemy army.
card.flavor: "The Unicorn will become greater than they have ever been."

card.name: Moto Qu Yuan
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Commander
After the resolution of an action that moved a unit: If the unit is now in Qu Yuan's army, straighten it.
card.flavor: "Move faster or I shall bring the blessings of the Lord of Death upon you!"

card.name: Daigotsu - exp3
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Clan Champion • Samurai • Shugenja • Duelist • Experienced 3 • Loyal • Unique
After Daigotsu enters play: Lose 40 Honor.
Battle: Permanently give a target enemy Personality with lower Chi Shadowlands. He succumbs to the Dark Lord's will. Take control of him (if you do so, he joins your army). If you now control him, destroy him after this battle ends.
card.flavor: "I am the future of the Empire."

card.name: Bayushi Paneki - exp5
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Clan Champion • Samurai • Tactician • Hero • Experienced 5 • Loyal • Unique
After Paneki assigns to a battlefield at a province: You may discard a Dynasty card in one of the Defender's provinces.
Political Battle: Bow a target Personality. Destroy him if he is dishonorable. You may target and dishonor a Personality.
card.flavor: "Deception is my strength."

card.name: Hiruma Gohachiro
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Commander
Reaction: After another player's action targets another Personality in Gohachiro's army: Negate the Personality's destruction from the action's effects.
card.flavor: "What is found shall never be lost again."

card.name: Hiruma Seiko
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Scout
Battle: If a Recon action has targeted the current battlefield's province this turn: Ranged 4 Attack.
card.flavor: "Let others hide behind their fans and lace. I prefer blood and stone."

card.name: Doji Domotai - exp4
card.text:
Crane Clan • Clan Champion • Samurai • Duelist • Experienced 4 • Loyal • Unique
Political Reaction: Even if Domotai is bowed, after the resolution of your action for which you discarded the Imperial Favor as a cost or effect: Draw a card.
Iaijutsu Battle: Domotai challenges a target enemy Personality. Destroy the duel's loser. If Domotai wins, gain 3 Honor and take the Imperial Favor.
card.flavor: "Honor is my strength."

card.name: Daidoji Sakihiko
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Scout
Recon Open: Target a province. Other players' Personalities have -1F while at that province's battlefields.
card.flavor: "My father patrolled these lands, as did his father. We will not let you bring your full strength against the Crane."

card.name: Doji Senta
card.text:
Crane Clan • Courtier
Political Limited: Discard the Imperial Favor: Dishonor another player's target honorable Personality.
card.flavor: "Yes it was a dreadful thing. I tell you of it only so that you will know not to invite him to your next festival."

card.name: Mirumoto Kei - exp2
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Clan Champion • Samurai • Cavalry • Duelist • Tactician • Experienced 2 • Loyal • Unique
After Kei enters play: You may create a +2F/+1C Weapon Item and attach it to your target Personality.
Battle: Kei challenges a target enemy Personality. Destroy the duel's loser.
card.flavor: "The Dragon shall not be as they have been. They shall be greater still, and honor the Empress with their service."

card.name: Matsu Mari
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Hero
Reaction: After an action targets Mari: Negate her movement from the action's effects.
card.flavor: "Yes, my weapon is unusual. If you doubt it, come test your skill against mine. Do not fear. I promise you will not bloody your sword."

card.name: Tsuruchi Sanjo
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Magistrate
Battle: Target a Personality with lower Personal Honor than Sanjo's Chi. Move him home.
card.flavor: "Most of my kinsmen prefer to use a bow. I prefer to face my opponents a little more directly. There is no substitute for standing over a bloodied, defeated foe."

card.name: Shiba Tsukimi - exp3
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Clan Champion • Samurai • Duelist • Experienced 3 • Loyal • Unique • Shiba's Soul
Your Samurai at Tsukimi's location have a Force bonus equal to the highest Chi of any Shugenja you control.
Battle: Bow a target enemy unit. If you control an Elemental Master, you may target and destroy an attachment. Gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "My life, my soul, for the Phoenix."

card.name: Daigotsu Setsuko
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai • Paragon
After Setsuko enters play: Lose 4 Honor and look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Show up to two of them that are Dark Virtue cards. Put any cards you showed into your hand.
card.flavor: "With all my strength and devotion, I serve the Lost Kami, and his blessings are many. What samurai can claim as much?"

card.name: Soshi Ganrou
card.text: Scorpion Clan • Air • Shugenja • Ninja
card.flavor: "Some people lie almost as often as they breathe. They never notice that the air hears everything. And I hear everything the air hears."

card.name: Asako Katashi
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Fire • Shugenja • Inquisitor • Magistrate
Battle/Limited: Bow a target Shugenja with lower Personal Honor than Katashi's Chi. If the targeted Shugenja bowed, you may target and straighten a Shugenja.
card.flavor: "Fosuta has betrayed us. I will hunt him and his dark magics to the ends of the earth, if need be."

card.name: Tsuruchi Omori
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai
Battle: Ranged 2 Attack.
card.flavor: "If the Dragon are unwilling to do what must be done, then they should stand aside and allow the Mantis to do it. Why should the people suffer because the Dragon are weak?"

card.name: Agasha Ueda
card.text: Phoenix Clan • Air • Water • Shugenja • Cavalry • Alchemist
card.flavor: The Agasha left the Dragon decades ago. Their knowledge of alchemy has given the Phoenix great insight into the interaction of the elements - though the Isawa would be loathe to admit this.

card.name: Moshi Kamiya
card.text: Mantis Clan • Thunder • Shugenja
card.flavor: The Thunder Dragon, the divine patron of heroes, dwells now within the mortal realm. The Mantis are its servants and its guardians, and for their service they share a portion of its limitless power.

card.name: Matsu Satsune
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Commander • Paragon
Battle: Discard a card: Straighten a target unit in Satsune's army. If you discarded a Bushido Virtue, you may target and bow an enemy Follower or Personality without attachments.
card.flavor: "Our cause is righteous. We do not falter. The enemies of the Empire have reason to fear when they see our banners fluttering in the wind!"

card.name: Akodo Sagashite
card.text: Lion Clan • Samurai • Commander
card.flavor: "Pitiful. All of you are pitiful. They expect me to train you to be Lion soldiers? You have joined the greatest army in all the Empire and you must become worthy of that title. I will break you pitiful wretches, but fret not. Before I am done with you, I will forge you anew into warriors."

card.name: Mirumoto Ino
card.text: Dragon Clan • Samurai • Kensai
card.flavor: "There is no mirror in our spirit. There is no light with which we can see. All we see is but an illusion. The final strike is letting go." - Ino's Koan

card.name: Kakita Okirou
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Artisan • Orator • Poet
Open: Discard a card: Before the next time this turn a target player gains or loses Honor, reduce the loss or gain by the Focus Value of the discarded card.
card.flavor: "The flight of an arrow, the flight of a bird - so different, and yet both bring wonder to our hearts."

card.name: Doji Hatashi
card.text: Crane Clan • Courtier
card.flavor: "No, I am not a renowned duelist or a great artist. But I am skilled in the ways of the courts, and I move among the lords and great ones of the Empire doing the work of my clan."

card.name: Hida Eijiko
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Commander
Battle: Bow your target Follower: Straighten one or two target Crab Clan Personalities.
card.flavor: "When the Crab stand shoulder-to-shoulder, victory is the only outcome. Anything else is merely temporary."

card.name: Smuggler's Port
card.text:
Port
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Reaction: When paying a Gold cost, if your Family Honor is 1 or higher, bow this card and lose 2 Honor: Produce 3 Gold.
card.flavor: "Isolate those ports the clan requires. Burn all the rest." - Yoritomo Naizen

card.name: My Father's Shrine
card.text:
Temple
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Limited: Bow your target Personality: Gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "My every victory is in his name, and I hope only that my efforts find favor with his spirit."

card.name: Keukegen
card.text:
Nonhuman • Keukegen
Reaction: Even if this card is bowed, after another player's Personality straightens: Straighten this card.
card.flavor: "They are largely harmless, and prefer to avoid being seen whenever possible. They would be completely benign, save that they are so hideous." - Horiuchi Rikako

card.name: Dragon's Guard City
card.text: Battle/Open: Choose your performing Personality: Attach a target Follower in your hand or discard pile to him.
card.flavor: Claimed by the Mantis for the purposes of protection, the arrangement has proven mutually beneficial.

card.name: Nagataka
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Monk • Kensai
After Nagataka enters play: Lose 5 Honor.
card.flavor: "We serve Daigotsu, as all will in time. Accept me as your master, and embrace the inevitable."

card.name: Utaku Anhui
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Battle Maiden
Battle: Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality without attachments and with Force lower than Anhui's Personal Honor. If this bowed a card, gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "Anhui is beautiful, and her caustic wit is nearly as deadly as her prowess on the battlefield. In short, the quintessential Battle Maiden." - Ide Eien

card.name: Twice-Cutting Spirit
card.text: Battle: Target your opposed Samurai Personality: Give him a Force bonus equal to his own Personal Honor. Give a target enemy Personality a Force penalty equal to your Samurai's Chi.
card.flavor: "Their armies seem endless! But we are the Empire's hope, and we shall not fail." - Utaku Tayoi

card.name: Strength of the Bamboo
card.text:
Heroic
Reaction: After an action targets your Hero Personality: Negate his destruction from the action's effects. Give him +1F.
card.flavor: "I will not be defeated by you. I will spring up like a bent bamboo and I will destroy you." - Kuronada

card.name: Convenient Disaster
card.text: Limited: Target a Holding controlled by a player who controls three or more Holdings. Permanently remove one of its abilities.
card.flavor: "With all the chaos in the north, no one will notice if a few extra Crane holdings burn. Except the Crane, of course." - Shosuro Miyoto

card.name: A Walking Death
card.text:
Plague
Until the game ends, after each of your Events Phases ends, each player, starting with you, gives a target Personality controlled by the player on his left a -1C Plague token.
card.flavor:
"It will take months for it to spread."
"Yes. Delicious, is it not?"

card.name: Central Castle
card.text: Reaction: After the resolution of an action performed by your Personality during battle for which you discarded a card due to its effects: Draw a card.
card.flavor: "Also known as Crossroads Fortress, it is the hub around which the Lion Clan provinces are organized. It is the unassailable center, the steel at the core of their lands." - Moto Chen

card.name: Seven Seas Port
card.text:
Port
Recon Open: Target a province. Your Mantis Clan Personalities and your Scout Followers have +1F while at that province's battlefield.
card.flavor: "There is no province that cannot be assailed from the mainland port of the Mantis. It is a key aspect of their military offense." - Hida Kuon

card.name: The Shadowed Dojo
card.text:
You do not lose Honor from cards you own.
Battle: Even if this card is bowed, show or discard a card in your hand: Give a target Personality or Follower a Force penalty equal to your card's Focus Value. Destroy the enemy card if it has no attachments, its Force is now 0, and you discarded a Dark Virtue.

card.name: Black Hearts, Red Blades
card.text:
Ninja
Battle: Target two of your Ninja Personalities without non-Ninja Followers: Move them home. If both of them moved, discard any cards in the current battlefield's province and draw two cards.
card.flavor: "I cannot take to the battlefield against you, but I can still declare a war."

card.name: The Elements Align
card.text: Limited Bow this Shugenja and destroy this Spell: Put a Ring into play from your hand. If the performing Shugenja and the Ring share an element keyword, straighten the Shugenja.
card.flavor: It is important that a shugenja maintains a balance within the mind.

card.name: Hida Ogano
card.text: Crab Clan • Samurai • Berserker
card.flavor: His only fear is that he will die before he has finished killing.

card.name: Isawa Nakajima
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Earth • Shugenja • Avalanche Guard
While Nakajima has a Spell attached, he may assign even if bowed and he contributes Force to his army's total Force even if bowed.
card.flavor: "I know of Wotan and House Tamori, and I have heard of his tricks. If we were to face each-other, I am certain that it would take more than an unexpected strategy to stop me."

card.name: Iuchi Xiong
card.text: Unicorn Clan • Water • Shugenja • Cavalry
card.flavor: The Iuchi excel in their command of the element of water. With that power at their side, the Iuchi manipulate speed and distance to bring strength of mobility to their armies.

card.name: Shame Never Dies
card.text:
Political
Reaction: After the resolution of an action that moved home or destroyed a dishonorable Personality at a battlefield, target your Courtier, and bow him unless he is Scorpion Clan: The Personality's owner loses 3 Honor.
card.flavor: "I do your family a service in ridding them of you, and they shall pay for it!"

card.name: Hiruma Masato
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Scout
Masato has +3C while facing a Shadowlands Personality in a a duel.
card.flavor: "We cannot sit on the wall and wait. That gives the enemy too great an advantage."

card.name: Shosuro Tomoko
card.text: Scorpion Clan • Ninja
card.flavor: "My mask is my real face. I am a bringer of death and a destroyer of beginnings."

card.name: Souls of Virtue
card.text: Battle: Target your Paragon who has performed a Bushido Virtue or Dark Virtue action this turn: Give him +3F and straighten him.
card.flavor: "Do not waver at the sight of our enemy! Remember the heroes of the past and let their example fill you soul with strength!" - Matsu Satsune

card.name: Belly of Fudo
card.text:
Fudo • Unique
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold, plus 1 Gold if you control any other Fudo cards.
Open: Even if this card is bowed: Straighten a target Fudo card that has not produced Gold this turn.
card.flavor: "Fudo was a great prophet, and a student of the Tao without compare."

card.name: Lightwater Bay
card.text:
Singular
Battle: Bow this card and discard a card: Draw a card.
card.flavor: "The sun's light turns its waters to gold, and they glow like the being whose favor they display. Truly, a place of majesty." - Yoritomo Singh

card.name: Untaken
card.text: Limited: Turn all cards in provinces face up.

card.name: Liquid Courage
card.text:
Battle: Remove a Sake token from your target unbowed Personality: Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers and with 4 or lower Force.
Open: Pay 2 Gold: Target a Personality. He visits a Sake house. Give him two +1F Sake tokens.
card.flavor: "What did you call me?"

card.name: Whispers of the Dying Sun
card.text: Choose a (non-Stronghold) card in play. Each of its base abilities may be used one additional time this turn.
card.flavor: "The fire... is a lie."

card.name: Whispers of the Dying Moon
card.text: Choose a (non-Stronghold) card in play. Its base abilities may not be used this turn.
card.flavor: "Build a wall to the north", Hitomi gasped as she drew her final breath. Yet the warning proved too late. The forces of the Dark Oracle of Fire cascaded down the Dragon Mountains, wreaking havoc in their wake.

card.name: The Lost Path
card.text: Choose a Celestial in play. Remove it from the game. After the next time this game a Celestial enters play, remove it from the game.
card.flavor: "In times of great calamity, one cannot lose sight of the Celestial Order. Do not lose faith in the kami, or they will lose faith in you." - Isawa Kimi

card.name: Kaiu Smithy
card.text:
Artisan • Retainer • Singular
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Limited: Bow this card and discard a card: Put a target non-Unique Weapon from your discard pile into your hand.
card.flavor: "Put your back into it, boys - Lord Kuon needs replacements for the front line by dawn!" - Yasuki Otsuka

card.name: Hiruma Hidora
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Scout • Jade Hand
Battle: Bow Hidora unless you targeted the current battlefield's province with a Recon action this turn: Ranged 4 Attack, with +2 strength if the targeted card is Shadowlands.
card.flavor: "These things, these destroyers... jade affects them, but not as severely as it should. What manner of demons are these?"

card.name: Hida Suteru
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Commander • Kolat • Yojimbo • Unique • Master Steel
Battle: Transfer your target Follower at any location to your target Personality. Straighten the Follower if it transferred.
card.flavor: "He is the personal yojimbo of Jinn-Kuen and the master of the Yasuki defenses. The family's provinces are in good hands." - Hida Kuon

card.name: Hida Ikarukani
card.text:
Crab Clan • Berserker • Angry Crab
After the resolution of an action that destroyed Ikarukani while he was at a battlefield: The enemy leader chooses and destroys one of his unbowed Personalities at the current battlefield.
card.flavor: "When the rage overtakes him, he is less a man than a thing. A mindless, muderous beast." - Hiruma Todori

card.name: Hida Kitamura
card.text: Crab Clan • Samurai • Commander
card.flavor: "These new enemies are without number," Kuon said gravely. "They are as the sand on the beaches. We must use every resource to combat them. Nothing can be spared. Nothing."

card.name: Hida Fosuko
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Hero
Reaction: Even if Fosuko is bowed, before another player's Battle action destroys her: Delay her destruction until the current Combat Segment ends.
card.flavor: "Against this new foe, no one was safe. Not the most experienced veteran, nor the youngest scout. A new age of war had begun." - The Imperial Histories

card.name: Hida Tobashi
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Veteran • Unique • Wyrm Rider
While Tobashi has exactly one Follower, that Follower has Cavalry.
Fear Battle: Bow all Followers with 3 or lower Force in a target enemy unit.
card.flavor: "The ones without wings are much easier to ride, but harder to control. Their hides are too thick!"

card.name: Yasuki Otsuka
card.text:
Crab Clan • Artisan
Reaction: After Otsuka enters play, bow him: Bring your target Holding from a province or discard pile into play (bowed), paying 3 less gold.
card.flavor: "You don't make art with a calligraphy brush, old man! You hew it from stone with your two hands and a hammer!"

card.name: Doji Tsubota
card.text:
Crane Clan • Courtier
Political Open: Discard the Imperial Favor: Until your next turn ends, negate a target Personality's next straightening.
card.flavor: "Dealing with the Crab requires great courage, a nimble mind, and a high tolerance for sake."

card.name: Daidoji Yorio
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Magistrate
Battle: Bow Yorio: Bow a target enemy Personality with lower Personal Honor than Yorio's Chi. Gain 1 Honor. Straighten Yorio before this battle's resolution.
card.flavor: "Destruction is a terrible thing, and my heart mourns for what has been lost. But we can not allow this plague to spread in the Crane lands."

card.name: Daidoji Kirimi
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Scout • Iron Samurai
Recon Open: Target a province: After it is destroyed this turn, gain 3 Honor.
card.flavor: "If the Wall is taken, this will be a common sight. But my kin and I will be here, ready to defend our clan."

card.name: Kakita Kensho-in - exp
card.text:
Crane Clan • Obsidian • Samurai • Duelist • Artisan • Experienced • Unique
After Kensho-in wins a duel: Before the next time this turn another player's action bows, moves, or destroys her, negate that effect.
card.flavor: "Ambition is not a bad thing. Such a pity you lacked the skill to back it up."

card.name: Doji Bukita
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Artisan
Limited: Discard the top card of your Fate deck: Choose another player. He may choose to lose 2 Honor. If he did not choose this, gain Honor equal to the card's Focus Value.
card.flavor: "My stories are true, even if they are fiction. If some dishonorable cur finds himself in one, who is really to blame?"

card.name: Doji Shikana
card.text: Crane Clan • Samurai
card.flavor: "She looks as delicate as a plum blossom and as flashy as this year's fashionable kimono. Don't be fooled - I watched her carve up three bandits at a border crossing last week." - Shosuro Nitsu

card.name: Kakita Sadaka
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Duelist
Iaijutsu Battle: Bow Sadaka unless she won a duel this turn: Move a target enemy attacking Personality with equal or lower Chi home.
card.flavor: "Bayushi-san, you are not without skill. But you trust to your armor and not to your spirit, and that is your downfall."

card.name: Mirumoto Kondo
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Kensai
Battle: If any enemy units are at the current battlefield, you may bow a Weapon in Kondo's unit: Move your target unit there. If you bowed a Weapon and the unit moved, straighten the unit.

card.name: Togashi Shintaro
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Fire • Monk • Tattooed
After Shintaro enters play: Give him three +1F Fire tokens.
Battle: Destroy a Fire token on Shintaro: Ranged 3 Attack.
card.flavor: "The lion, the sakura, the tiger, and now the dragon..."

card.name: Togashi Kazuki - exp
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Monk • Samurai • Tattooed • Yojimbo • Experienced • Unique
Open: Set a target Personality's Force equal to Kazuki's.
Reaction: When another player's action would target a Personality in Kazuki's army, discard a Ring from your hand or bow one of your Rings: The action instead targets another legal Personality in his army.

card.name: Mirumoto Washizuka
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Duelist
Iaijutsu Battle: Bow Washizuka unless he won a duel this turn: Move a target enemy defending Personality with equal or lower Chi home.
card.flavor: "The Water-Gull style of swordmanship is my own. If you doubt its strength, test yourself against my blades."

card.name: Kitsuki Yodo
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Magistrate
Political Limited: Bow Yodo: Target another player's Personality with lower Personal Honor than Yodo's Chi. The Personality's controller may dishonor him. If he is now honorable, gain Honor equal to his Personal Honor.

card.name: Togashi Satsu - exp5
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Monk • Samurai • Duelist • Imperial • Tattooed • Loyal • Experienced 5 • Unique • Voice of the Empress
Open: Bow Satsu or one of your Rings: Draw a card.
card.flavor: "The Soul of Togashi no longer guides him, but wisdom still fills his eyes. He speaks for the Empress, yet still advises his clan." - Mirumoto Kei

card.name: Akodo Shunori - exp
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Tactician • Commander • Experienced • Unique
Battle: Even if Shunori is bowed: Target one or two of your Tacticians. Straighten their units. You may move either or both of them home.

card.name: Ikoma Tobikuma
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Tactician
Tactical Open: Give Tobikuma either Cavalry, Naval or Philosoper.

card.name: Matsu Benika - exp2
card.text:
Lion Clan • Jade • Samurai • Beastmaster • Commander • Hero • Experienced 2 • Unique
Your Nonhuman cards have +1F.
Battle/Limited: Create and attach a 1F Nonhuman • Cat Follower to your target Commander.

card.name: Akodo Nagataka
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Deathseeker
Before a battle's resolution, if Nagataka is at the current battlefield: Destroy him.
Battle: Destroy Nagataka: Give each of your Followers and Personalities at the current battlefield +1F.

card.name: Matsu Kasei
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai
Battle: Move a target Personality to the current battlefield if there are any units there on the side opposing his controller's. Straighten him if he moved.

card.name: Akodo Masao
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Hero • Kensai
Masao has +3F while attacking unless he has any non-Weapon attachments.

card.name: Kitsune Iwarou
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Scout
Battle: If a Recon action targeted this battlefield's province this turn and you have 2 or fewer cards in your hand: Draw a card.

card.name: Tsuruchi Nabeta
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai
Battle: Bow Nabeta: Ranged 4 Attack. Straighten Nabeta before this battle's resolution.

card.name: Yoritomo Souhiko
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Commander
Battle: If Souhiko is opposed: Bring a target face-up Personality from one of your provinces into play at the current battlefield, paying 2 less Gold.

card.name: Moshi Chuuna
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Thunder • Shugenja
Limited: Bow Chuuna or one of her Spells: Target a Personality. After the next time this turn he assigns or moves to a battlefield, bow him.

card.name: Tsuruchi Mochisa - exp
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Magistrate • Yojimbo • Experienced • Unique
Battle: Ranged 6 Attack that is compared against the targeted card's Gold Cost instead of Force.

card.name: Yoritomo Utemaro - exp2
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Hero • Imperial • Experienced 2 • Loyal • Unique • Imperial Treasurer
Limited: Give a target Personality a -2 Gold Cost token.
Reaction: When paying a Gold cost, bow Utemaro unless the cost is on a Fate card: Produce 3 Gold.

card.name: Yoritomo Eihiko
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Magistrate • Extortionist
Reaction: After you announce an action: Reduce the Gold Cost of a target card (in play) by 2 until the action ends.

card.name: Shiba Ningen - exp3
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Void • Shugenja • Elemental Master • Experienced 3 • Unique
Your Void Shugenja have +1F.
Limited: Gain 2 Honor. Create a 2F/2C/2PH Phoenix Clan • Samurai • Yojimbo Personality. You may not use this ability again while the created Yojimbo remains in play.

card.name: Isawa Mizuhiko - exp
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Jade • Water • Shugenja • Naval • Magistrate • Experienced • Unique
Open: Even if Mizuhiko is bowed: Either straighten this unit or give Mizuhiko and each of this Followers Cavalry.

card.name: Shiba Yukihito
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Samurai • Duelist • Yojimbo
Iaijutsu Battle: Bow Yukihito unless he won a duel this turn: Ranged 3 Attack with +1 strength for each Shugenja you control.

card.name: Asako Misako
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Courtier
Political Battle: If Misako is in your home, target your Shugenja: Move a target enemy Personality home. Gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "We want peace, yes. That is why we must be unafraid to act."

card.name: Shiba Sakaki
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Samurai
Battle: Even if Sakaki is bowed, if there are any enemy units at the current battlefield: Move him there. If he moved, straighten him.

card.name: Shosuro Sogetsu
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Ninja
Battle: Reduce a target Personality's Force to 0. If the Personality has any Poison tokens, you may move Sogetsu home.
card.flavor: "It is as if Jimen is sending the whole family after these two. If the targets are such criminals, should not it be a matter for the Emerald Magistrates?"

card.name: Bayushi Komiya
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Courtier
Political Open: Bow Komiya: Bow a target dishonorable Personality.
card.flavor: "You wish to arrest me? Come now, are you sure that's wise? You wouldn't want to cause another incident, like, say, the one last season at the Seven Blossoms, would you?"

card.name: Bayushi Hisoka - exp
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Courtier • Imperial • Experienced • Loyal • Unique • Imperial Chancellor
Political Reaction: Once per game, after Hisoka enters play, pay 4 Gold: Destroy a province belonging to a target player with 2 or more provinces. Until the game ends, once in each of his turns, he may refill one of his provinces face up.
Political Limited: A target player with 4 or more provinces loses 2 honor.

card.name: Bayushi Minoru
card.text: Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Kensai • Bitter Lies • Loyal
card.flavor: "I will fight in my homeland! I will fight at the Wall! I will fight bushi! I will fight walking dead men! I will fight the gods themselves if need me - and I will teach them all to fear the Dark Sword of Bitter Lies!"

card.name: Shosuro Ohba
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Ninja
Ohba has +1F for each Poison token in the current enemy army.
card.flavor: "We kill the boy, and we kill the man, no matter who they once were, no matter what their crimes are. We follow orders, Sogetsu, neh?"

card.name: Soshi Yoshihara
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Air • Shugenja
Open: Bow Yoshihara: Give a target Personality a Force penalty equal to Yoshihara's Chi. If the Personality's Force is now 0, he loses 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "Testimony from spirits is inadmissible in court, my lord, but with a little effort we can use the kami to make his weakness public."

card.name: Daigotsu Isoroku
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai • Commander • Undead
After Isoroku enters play: Lose 5 Honor.
Fear Battle: If you control more Undead cards at the current battlefield than the enemy leader controls units there: Bow a target enemy unit.

card.name: Daigotsu Gahseng
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai • Paragon • Dark Pride
After Gahseng enters play: Lose 5 Honor.
Reaction: After an action's resolution ends, if you discarded a Dark Virtue as a cost or effect of the action: Put the Dark Virtue in your hand.

card.name: Isawa Fosuta - exp
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Shugenja • Inquisitor • Experienced • Unique • Onyx Champion
After Fosuta enters play: Lose 8 honor.
Maho Open: Bow Fosuta: Lose 6 Honor. While Fosuta remains bowed, you may negate his straightening and, at the start of each turn, you may target a Personality and give him a -1F/-1C Curse token. After the next time this game Fosuta straightens or leaves play, destroy all Curse tokens.

card.name: Gakku
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Goblin • Scout
After Gakku enters play: Lose 3 Honor.

card.name: Torao
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Monk • Kensai
After Torao enters play: Lose 3 Honor.
Battle/Open: Straighten a target Personality with a Weapon.
card.flavor: "He will never forgive Iweko for the insult he believes she embodies, but for now there is a greater enemy." - Michio

card.name: Udo
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Shugenja • Artisan • Master Chef
After Udo enters play: Lose 4 Honor.
Maho Reaction: After the resolution of an action that destroyed a Follower or Personality: Create a 2F/2C/0PH Shadowlands • Undead Personality at Udo's location.
card.flavor: "Hurry! My master's legions are hungry!"

card.name: Daigotsu Susumu - exp
card.text:
Spider Clan • Courtier • Imperial • Experienced • Loyal • Unique • Imperial Advisor
Political Fear Limited: Bow Susumu unless the targeted Personality is non-Unique: Bow a target Personality. He may not perform actions this turn.

card.name: Utaku Hana
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Battle Maiden
Battle: Ranged Attack with strength equal to Hana's Personal Honor.

card.name: Moto Jin-sahn - exp
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Commander • Imperial • Experienced • Loyal • Unique • Favored of the Lords of Death • Shogun
Jin-Sahn has +1F for each dead Personality in the Defender's discard pile.
Battle: Target an enemy Personality with lower Force than Jin-Sahn. Bow him. Bow his unit if its total Force is lower than Jin-Sahn's. Destroy the Personality if his Force is 4 or less.

card.name: Shinjo Tae-hyun
card.text: Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Commander • Topaz Champion

card.name: Shinjo Rina
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Scout
Battle: Discard a card: Give Rina +2F, or +3F if the discarded card has a Recon ability.

card.name: Shinjo Hansu
card.text:

Phoenix Clan • Void • Shugenja • Commander
Reaction: After Takashi enters play, once per game: Create two 2F/2C/2PH Phoenix Clan • Samurai • Yojimbo Personalities at Takashi's location.
card.flavor: "When one is attuned with the Void, eradicating creatures such as these is a trivial problem."

card.name: Bayushi Kindebu
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Courtier • Samurai
After your Dynasty Phase begins, if none of the other players controls a dishonorable Personality: Destroy Kindebu.
card.flavor: "The Crane are finished. The Scorpion domination of the courts cannot be shaken by those haughty, condescending idiots."

card.name: Bayushi Mago
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Kensai • Bitter Lies
Battle: Show the top card of your Fate deck: Target a card without attachments in an enemy unit. If your Fate card's Focus Value is odd, or lower than the Focus Value of one of Mago's Weapons, bow the enemy card.
card.flavor: Soon the Scorpion were spread far too thin as they struggled to contain the outbreaks.

card.name: Bayushi Suboru
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Ninja
Battle/Open: Target a non-Unique Personality with the Ninja keyword or with a Poison token. Set Suboru's Force and Chi equal to the other Personality's base Force and Chi. Suboru copies the other Personality's base abilities that do not themselves copy abilities.
card.flavor: "He is whomever you require." - Shosuro Toson

card.name: Mirumoto Shiki
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Imperial • Magistrate • Unique
After an action destroys an enemy card at the current battlefield, if Shiki is there: Gain 1 Honor, or 2 Honor if the card was dishonorable before it was destroyed.
Battle: Ranged 4 Attack that may target a dishonorable Personality with attached Followers.

card.name: Naggru
card.text:
Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Goblin
After Naggru enters play: Lose 3 Honor.
Battle: Give Naggru +3F. Destroy him after this battle's resolution ends.
card.flavor: "Serve humans? Bah! Why do that? Stupid, weak, arrogant things. Good only to steal from, and to eat."

card.name: Utaku Tairu
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Tactician
Battle: Even if Tairu is bowed, if there are any enemy units at the current battlefield: Move Tairu there. Straighten his unit if he moved.
card.flavor: While not as famous as the Battle Maidens of the Unicorn, the Utaku Infantry serve an essential rols in all three Unicorn armies.

card.name: Utaku Toshie
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Battle Maiden • Hero
Toshie has +1F for each Battle Maiden in her army.
card.flavor: "The plague may have started in the lands of the Unicorn, but, I assue you, the heart of the Utaku remain pure. No bodily disease is a match for a pure soul!"

card.name: Utogu no Oni
card.text:
Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Oni
After Utogu enters play: Lose 5 Honor.
Battle: Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality with equal or lower Gold Cost and no Followers.
card.flavor: "Its hunger is limitless. It will consume you, your comrades, the ground you stand on... everything. Avoid them at all costs." - Hiruma Todori

card.name: Moto Chuluun
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry
After a battle's resolution, if Chuluun was ever opposed during the battle: Destroy Chuluun.
card.flavor: "A race? You know who you face, yes? I am Chuluun, grandson of Marik, the swiftest raider ever to live! Astride my steed, none will catch me, not while I still live!"

card.name: Shinjo Yamauchi
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Commander • Hero
Battle: Target your unbowed Personality or Follower, and bow it unless you are a defending player: Ranged Attack with strength equal to its Force.
card.flavor: "My strategy? Shoot them in the eye. It is remarkably effective."

card.name: Moshi Sayoko - exp
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Air • Thunder • Shugenja • Sensei • Storm Rider • Experienced • Loyal • Unique
Battle: Take two additional Battle actions.
card.flavor: The sensei holds no qualms in sailing into the midst of her problems. She is much like her predecessor, which is perhaps exactly what the Moshi need to inspire them in these turbulent times.

card.name: Isawa Mitsuko
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Air • Shugenja • Inquisitor • Magistrate • Unique • Elemental Master
Reaction: Even if Mitsuko is bowed, after the resolution of an action that bowed one of your Air Shugenja as a cost, once per phase: Straighten that Shugenja.
Open: Straighten a target Holding.
card.flavor: "The Empress has commanded all to search, and the Phoenix will not be found wanting!"

card.name: Generosity
card.text: Until your next turn begins, all players have the ability, "Reaction: When paying a Gold cost, once per game: Produce 3 Gold."
card.flavor: A samurai serves those under his authority as much as they serve him.

card.name: Oyo Seido
card.text:
Temple
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Limited: If you have not lost Honor from cards you own this game and your Family Honor is 5 or lower: Gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: In the heart of the Isawa Forest lies a temple for a forgotten madman. Only the Asako remember his name, but all who visit share in his inner peace.

card.name: Offices of the Emerald Magistrates
card.text:
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Reaction: When paying the Gold cost of an action on a Strategy, if you control a Magistrate: Produce 2 Gold.
card.flavor: "You worried you would be underfunded? What part of 'any sacrifice' did you not understand?" - Shosuro Jimen

card.name: Spider Cultist
card.text:
Retainer • Shadowlands
After this card enters play: Lose 3 Honor.
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold, or 3 Gold if paying for an Oni.
card.flavor: "Those who seek power can have all their desires satiated. My aid is cheap, since my price is paid simply by using what I offer you."

card.name: Hiruma Shigeo
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai
Open: Bow a target attachment.
card.flavor: "Let's make a deal. You keep speaking of the Wall falling, and I'll break your skull. Sound good?"

card.name: Hida Kosho - exp
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Hero • Experienced • Unique • Sumai Master
Battle: You may take this action even if Kosho is not at the current battlefield if you are the Defender: Bow a target enemy Personality or Follower with lower Force.
card.flavor: "What, did you forget about me? Here, I'll give you something to remember me by."

card.name: Hiruma Gondo
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Berserker • Hero
After a battle's resolution, if you lost the battle and its resolution destroyed any of your units or provinces: Destroy Gondo.
card.flavor: "I am Hiruma Gondo, son of Hiruma Yugure, hero of Oblivion's Gate! I fought at the Battle of the Burning Wall, I faced the Crane, and ten men have fallen before my blade! I have never known defeat - you have no chance!"

card.name: Hida Harou
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Commander
Battle: Straighten your target Follower. You may take an additional Battle action, which must be performed by that Follower.
card.flavor: The Crab rebuild, as they always have, and Reiha holds vengeance in her heart.

card.name: Hiruma Toshio
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Scout
Recon Open: Target a province. After the next time this turn any of your Scout Personalities assign to that province's battlefield, create two 1F Followers and attach them to any of those Scouts. Before this turn ends, remove those Followers from the game.
card.flavor: "Call for reinforcements."

card.name: Asahina Ekei - exp
card.text:
Crane Clan • Air • Shugenja • Artisan • Experienced • Unique
Battle/Open: Even if Ekei is not at the current battlefield: Straighten a target Personality.
card.flavor: "Do the Spider bring us closer to war or pull us back from the brink? We can but trust in the Empress to understand their game."

card.name: Doji Nenkai
card.text:
Crane Clan • Courtier • Magistrate • Seductress
Open: Target a Personality with lower Personal Honor than Nenkai's Chi. Set the targeted Personality's Force equal to his own Chi.
card.flavor: "Kurumi needs to learn the lesson of subtlety."

card.name: Daidoji Yuki
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Iron Crane • Scout
After the resolution of a Recon action: Give Yuki +1F.
Battle: Ranged 3 Attack with +1 strength for each Recon action that has resolved this turn. Gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "We are told to seek out what does not exist."

card.name: Kakita Kado
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Duelist
After you focus in a duel involving Kado: Give him +1F/+1C.
After a challenge is issued from an action Kado performed: Give him +1F
card.flavor: "His skills are deceptive. He is deadlier than you would ever guess." - Kakita Hideo

card.name: Doji Kazuo
card.text:
Crane Clan • Courtier • Samurai • Duelist
After one of your Personalities loses a duel, or if another player ever has more Family Honor than you: Destroy Kazuo.
card.flavor: "If samurai of other clans do not secretly wish themselves Crane, they are fools."

card.name: Mirumoto Bokusui
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Duelist
After one of your Personalities loses a duel, or if another player ever controls more Rings than you: Destroy Bokusui.
card.flavor: "We are the Dragon, and our wisdom will never fail! After we have dealt with this 'Army of Fire' we will show the Empire how to purge the plague zombies."

card.name: Togashi Kyoshi
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Water • Monk • Tattooed
You may use your Stronghold's abilities even if it is bowed.
Battle: Give a target enemy Personality or Follower a Force penalty equal to Kyoshi's Chi. If the targeted card's Force is now 0, bow it.
card.flavor: "Water shapes all and takes the shape of all."

card.name: Mirumoto Dakotsu
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Kensai • Hero
While Dakotsu has a Weapon, you may assign him even if he is bowed, and he contributes his Force to his army's total Force even if bowed.
card.flavor: "To me, Dragons! We shall show these interlopers what it means to face the fury of the Mirumoto!"

card.name: Akodo Kin
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Commander
Battle: If you are the Attacker: Give +1F to each of your Personalities and Followers in Kin's army.
card.flavor: "The Wall is just stone and our blades are just steel. Neither is the true mettle of Rokugan."

card.name: Akodo Senichi
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Deathseeker
Senichi has +1F while attacking.
Reaction: Before another player's card effect destroys one of your Lion Clan Samurai Personalities in Senichi's army, destroy Senichi: Negate the Personality's destruction. Gain 3 Honor.
card.flavor: "These mountains will not save you, gaijin!"

card.name: Akodo Shigo
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Hero
Fear Battle: Give -3F to the Personality and each Follower in a target enemy unit. Give Shigo +2F.
card.flavor: "A late-born son has nothing but his actions to carry him to great prestige." - Akodo Shigetoshi

card.name: Matsu Akuto
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Paragon
After you lose Honor, or after a battle resolution that destroyed one or more of your units: Destroy Akuto.
card.flavor: "Some have asked how he courted one so lovely as Reisei. He replied simply that he was the only one worthy of her favor." - Ikoma Asa

card.name: Akodo Ryozo
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Tactician • Paragon • Unique
Battle: Ranged Attack with strength equal to Ryozo's Force or Personal Honor.
card.flavor: "I care not what mon the samurai beside me wears. If he wields his weapons in defense of Rokugan, he is my brother."

card.name: Yuhmi no Oni
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Oni • Unique
Yuhmi has +2F while you control Daigotsu Yuhmi.
After Yuhmi enters play: Lose 8 Honor.
Battle: Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality with lower Force and no Followers.
card.flavor: "Even chaos knows its master." - Omoni

card.name: Daigotsu Yuhmi - exp
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Samurai • Infiltrator • Experienced • Unique
After Yuhmi enters play: Lose 8 Honor.
Fear Battle: Bow each Follower and Personality with 7 or lower Force in a target enemy unit.
card.flavor: "From my lord's severed arm, I fashioned an oni, and from it sprang Yuhmi. Perfection always seeks its true form." - Omoni

card.name: The Dread Kar
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Monk • Kensai
After Kar enters play: Lose 3 Honor.
Battle: Discard a card: Bow a target card without attachments in an enemy unit. If you discarded a Kiho or Weapon, draw a card.
card.flavor: "An enigma even among the Spider. Some say he hails from a distant land, but I think he merely has nothing to say." - Tetsuo

card.name: Daigotsu Azuma
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai • Paragon • Dark Destiny
After Azuma enters play: Lose 4 Honor.
Fear Battle: Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality with lower Force and no attachments.
card.flavor: "Did you hear about Ruri? She married a Hida! Hida Ruri! I would laugh were it not so absurd!"

card.name: Daigotsu Koneru
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai • Paragon • Dark Ambition
After Koneru enters play: Lose 4 Honor.
After a battle's resolution, if Koneru was ever at its battlefield during the battle, and you did not destroy any enemy players' cards or provinces during that battle: Destroy Koneru.
card.flavor: "I have the strength you lack to do what must be done. I will save the Empire for my lord.

card.name: Last Line of Defense
card.text: Until the game ends, increase the strength of each of your provinces by 2 and, after each time an Attacker destroys one of your provinces during battle resolution, he draws 2 cards.
card.flavor: As long as one samurai remains, Rokugan will not fall.

card.name: A Cleansing Death
card.text: Reaction: After the resolution of a Battle action that destroyed one of your Deathseekers: Bring a target face-up Personality in one of your provinces into play at the current battlefield, paying 3 less Gold. Gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "Break that line, no matter the cost!"

card.name: One with the Flame
card.text:
Fire • Kiho
Battle: Bow your target Monk without Weapons: Give him +1C if he is Fire or has one or more Fire tokens. You may target and destroy an enemy Personality with equal or lower Chi than your Monk.
card.flavor: "Your technique is strong, but no match for the Palm of a Thousand Burning Miseries!" - Togashi Taro

card.name: Pinned Down
card.text:
Reaction: Before the resolution of another player's action, target your Kensai at the current battlefield and bow one of his Weapons: Choose an enemy Personality, and negate either his straightening or his movement from that action.
Battle: Target your Personality and bow one of his Weapons: Bow a target enemy card with no Weapons.

card.name: Intimidating Stance
card.text:
Fear • Iaijutsu
Battle: Target your unbowed Duelist: Move a target enemy Personality with equal or lower Chi home.
card.flavor: The duelist casually slid into the open-handed stance of the Kakita, and the ronin immediately regretted taking on the Magistrate's commission.

card.name: Knowledge from Within
card.text:
Void • Kiho
Open: If you control a Ring, bow your target Shugenja or Monk: Draw 2 cards.
card.flavor: The Togashi and the Asako are the most monastic families in the Empire, but even they differ in approach. The Asako view Enlightenment as a path along which one is elevated, while the Togashi begin from a position of strength and attempt to become one with the universe.

card.name: Search for Survivors
card.text:
Recon
Limited: Target your unbowed Scout, and bow him unless he is Crab Clan: Target a province. After the province is destroyed this turn, you may target your discarded (not dead) Personality and bring him into play, paying 5 less Gold.
card.flavor: "We leave no man behind." - Hiruma Todori

card.name: Snow-Swept Summit
card.text:
Winter • Terrain
Battle: You may take this action even if you control no units at the current battlefield while any Cavalry units are there: Before this battle's resolution, reduce the Force of each Personality and Follower at the current battlefield to 3.
card.flavor: In the icy mountains, cavalry ceases to be an advantage.

card.name: Stand Down!
card.text:
Battle: Give all attacking Personalities at the current battlefield -1F.
Battle: Gain 1 Honor.
Reaction: After the resolution of an action that moved one or more Personalities to the attacking side at the current battlefield: Target and bow one of them.

card.name: Hope Against Hope
card.text: Battle: Destroy your target Unique Personality or Lion Clan Personality: Bow a target enemy unit. Draw a card if your Personality was a Tactician when this targeted him.
card.flavor: "Slowly we are being pushed back. Shigetoshi's genius knows no limits, but how long can we hold out against the darkness?" - Akodo Kin

card.name: Wind-Borne Aid
card.text: Battle: If there are any enemy units at the current battlefield and you control a Shugenja, target your Samurai Personality: If he is at the current battlefield, move him to any location, otherwise move him to the current battlefield.
card.flavor: "We must keep units in the north, to guard against the new Army of Fire, and yet these zombies must be dealt with quickly." - Asako Hoshimi

card.name: Yojimbo's Glory
card.text: Battle: Target your unbowed Yojimbo Personality: Move him to a location where you control a Shugenja. You may take an additional Battle action, which must be performed by the Yojimbo.
card.flavor: "It seems as though no road in all the northern provinces is free from threat. No shugenja should travel without a Shiba to protect him." - Shiba Nobuyuki

card.name: Learn by Doing
card.text:
Kiho
Battle: Target your unbowed Monk without Weapons: Bow a target enemy Personality with Force equal to or lower than your Monk's Personal Honor plus Chi. Draw a card. If this action was taken as an additional action, give your Monk +3F.
card.flavor: "Find strength in life!" - Togashi Taro

card.name: Travel Swiftly
card.text:
This card's Gold Cost is 0 if you are a Crab Clan player.
Reaction: After engaging, if there are any units in the current enemy army, target one to three Commander Personalities in your home: Straighten their units and move them to the current battlefield. Cards now in their units will not straighten during your next Straighten Phase.

card.name: Determined Force
card.text:
Battle: Set this battlefield's province's strength equal to its base strength.
Battle: Ranged 2 Attack.
Reaction: Before the resolution of a Battle action taken by another player without units at the current battlefield, if none of the action's effects can move the other player's units to the current battlefield: The action's effects do not happen.

Errata: Last action now reads...
Reaction: Before the resolution of a Battle action taken by another player who controlled no units at the current battlefield when the action was announced, if none of the action's effects can move the other player's units to the current battlefield: The action's effects do not happen.

card.name: Arrows Do Not Falter
card.text:
Focus Effect: If your Personality in this duel is the challenged, and has a base Ranged Attack ability, destroy a Follower, or Personality without Followers, with 4 or lower Force in the challenger's unit. Lose 3 Honor.
Reaction: After a Ranged Attack targets a card: Give the Ranged Attack +2 strength.

card.name: Riding in Harmony
card.text: Battle: Target your Battle Maiden Personality: Give her a Force bonus equal to her Personal Honor. Gain 2 Honor if she is opposed.
card.flavor: "We fight with all of our skill, but we are few in number. We need reinforements soon, or this section of the line will be lost." - Utaku Yu-Pan

card.name: Saving Kazumasa
card.text: Battle: If you have targeted the current battlefield's province with a Recon action this turn: Move your target Cavalry unit there. If it moved, you may straighten it, and you many straighten all Unaligned Human Personalities there.
card.flavor: "I still live. I still serve." - Kazumasa

card.name: Strike from the Shadows
card.text:
Ninja
Reaction: After engaging, if you are the Attacker, target your Ninja Personality at the current battlefield: You have the first opportunity to take a Battle action in this battle, which must be performed by a Ninja. You may discard any cards in the current battlefield's province; if this discarded a Personality, draw a card.

card.name: The Dead Do Not Rest
card.text:
Maho • Kiho
Battle: Bow your target Shugenja at any location: Move one to three target Undead Personalities in your home to the current battlefield, even if any of them have been in an attacking army at a battlefield during its battle's resolution. Straighten their units if they moved. Destroy them after this battle's resolution.

card.name: Arranged Guilt
card.text:
Political
Limited: Dishonor and destroy your target unbowed Courtier or Magistrate Personality: Dishonor another player's target Personality. You, then that Personality's owner, each lose 3 Honor.
card.flavor: "If the Empress wishes evidence, we will make sure she gets it."

card.name: Prepare for the Worst
card.text:
Recon
Open: If it is not your turn, target your Scout Personality: Target your province that has not been targeted by another card titled Prepare for the Worst this turn. Attacking Personalities and Followers have -1F while at that province's battlefield. Before this turn ends, if the province was not destroyed, gain 3 Honor.

card.name: Apprehending the Villain
card.text:
Reaction: After the resolution of an action that was performed by an enemy Personality who is now dishonorable: Move your target Personality to the current battlefield. Straighten his unit if he moved.
Battle/Open: Straighten your target Magistrate.
card.flavor: Escape was impossible.

card.name: Heavy Elite
card.text:
Elite
Ranged Attacks targeting cards in this unit have -2 strength.
Battle: Destroy a target enemy card with equal or lower Force and no attachments. Draw a card.
card.flavor: The most skilled and experienced of troops, given the finest of equipment. They are the blade that destroys a commander's enemies.

card.name: Flawless Assassin
card.text:
Ninja
Limited: Give a target Personality without a Poison token a -1F Poison token.
Reaction: After one of your Personalities moves to or from this unit's location, if this unit has no non-Ninja Personalities or Followers: Move this unit to any location.

card.name: Sister of the Sun
card.text:
Enlightened • Unique
This card has +1F for each Ring you control.
Battle/Open: Straighten a target Ring.
card.flavor: Former adherents of Amaterasu and later Lord Sun, they have embraced the reign of the Jade Sun. The benevolent Heavens have showered favor upon them for their piety.

card.name: Utaku Gunso
card.text:
Cavalry • Battle Maiden • Gunso
Open: Transfer your target attachment to your target Personality.
card.flavor: "We have suffered greatly at the hands of our enemies, and this winter shall be black indeed. But we shall not despair, for our souls are filled with honor and virtue. We shall endure, and serve the Khan in the honor of our ancestors. We are Utaku." - Utaku Yu-Pan

card.name: Wanyudo
card.text:
Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Oni
After this card enters play: Lose 4 Honor.
Reaction: After the resolution of another player's Battle action that destroyed this card or its Personality: Target a card without attachments in an enemy unit at the current battlefield. Remove it from the game.

card.name: Moto Kang - exp
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Commander • Villain • Experienced • Loyal • Unique
Kang enters play paying 1 less Gold for each Shugenja you control.
Battle: Attach a target attachment from your hand to your target Personality. You may take an additional Battle action to use an ability on the attachment.
card.flavor: "Good, bad, we all die the same. Alone."

card.name: Burn the Village
card.text: Limited: Each player may target one or two Personalities, each of whose base Gold Cost is equal to or lower than his controller's Stronghold's Gold production plus two. Destroy the targeted Personalities. Remove all of them that are Shadowlands from the game.
card.flavor: Extreme times call for extreme measures.

card.name: Twin Soul Temple
card.text:
Temple
Battle: Target your unbowed Samurai, and you may bow one of your Shugenja at any location: Target an enemy Follower or Personality without Followers. Destroy it if its Force is lower than your Samurai's Force plus the Chi of any Shugenja you bowed.

card.name: Thunder Dragon Bay
card.text:
Thunder
After the resolution of one of your Thunder actions: Give your target Personality +1F.
Battle: Lightning strikes your enemies. Ranged 4 Attack.
card.flavor: "Yoritomo guides us. Thunder sustains us. In turn, we honor both." - Yoritomo Naizen

card.name: Last Step Castle
card.text: Open: Even if this card is bowed, bow your target Personality: Give each of your provinces a strength bonus equal to his base Chi. If it is not your turn, before this turn ends, gain 2 Honor if none of your provinces were destroyed this turn.

card.name: Roaring Sky
card.text:
Thunder
Battle: If this card is in your hand, attach it to your target Shugenja: You may take an additional Battle action to use another ability on this card.
Battle: Bow this Shugenja unless he is Thunder: Bow a target enemy card without unbowed attachments.

card.name: Wander Among the Stars
card.text:
Void
Limited: Bow this Shugenja unless he is Void, and destroy this card: Draw a card.
Reaction: Even if this card is in your discard pile, before another player's action destroys three or more of your Personalities simultaneously, target your Shugenja and remove this card from the game: Negate their destruction.

card.name: In Aikune's Name
card.text:
Fire • Unique
Focus Effect: If your Personality in this duel has the Fire keyword, give this card +1 Focus Value.
Battle: Destroy this Shugenja: Destroy two target cards without attachments in the enemy army.
card.flavor: "Power is to be used!" - Isawa Takino

card.name: Flash of Bright Wings
card.text:
Air • Political
Attaches to an Air Shugenja paying 1 less Gold.
Open: Bow this Shugenja: Set a target Personality's Force equal to his own Personal Honor.
card.flavor: "Honor is not a weakness. Art is not useless. It is not the plague that threatens our clan's life, it is forgetfulness." - Kakita Omori

card.name: Allure of Jigoku
card.text:
Fear • Maho
After this card enters play: Lose 5 Honor.
This Shugenja has a Force bonus equal to his base Chi.
Battle: Bow this card: Bow a target card without attachments in an enemy unit.
card.flavor: "Do you think it so easy, to hunt my lord like he was a rapid dog?" - Chuda Hiroe

card.name: Chain and Sword
card.text:
Weapon • Unique
Battle: Bow this card: Give a target enemy card -3F.
Battle: Bow this card: Straighten this Personality.
card.flavor: A master of weapons can use whatever exotic tools are at his disposal to mercilessly dispatch his foes.

card.name: Scout Armor
card.text:
Armor
Reaction: After the resolution of an action that bowed this Personality: Straighten him.
card.flavor: "A scout's protection is his speed and his stealth. His armor must not impede either, yet provide enough cover in case of emergencies." - Hida Fubatsu

card.name: Peasant Armor
card.text:
Armor
After a battle's resolution, if this card is at the current battlefield: Destroy this card.
Limited: If this card is in your discard pile, pay 3 Gold; this cost will not be reduced: Put this card into your hand.
card.flavor: "Light, cheap, and plentiful - perfect to arm thousands of hastily trained peasants." - Hida Fubatsu

card.name: Dance of Blades
card.text:
Iaijutsu • Kata
Limited: Put this card into play in your home. Discard any other Kata cards you control. While this card remains in play, you have the ability, "Reaction: After one of your Personalities wins a duel, if he has a Weapon: Draw a card."
card.flavor: Never step inside a duelist's range.

card.name: Civility
card.text:
Bushido Virtue
Open: Target your discarded (not dead) Samurai Personality: Bring him into play.
card.flavor: "When you encounter your enemy on the road, treat him as an honored friend. One of you may not survive the next meeting."

card.name: Enticement

card.text:
Maho • Plague
Battle: Bow this Shugenja: Lose 3 Honor. Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers and with equal or lower Chi than this Shugenja. If this destroyed a card, create a 2F/2C/0PH Shadowlands • Undead Personality in your current army.
card.flavor: "Will they save their Empire at any cost?" - Chuda Mishime

card.name: Talisman of Sakkaku
card.text:
Unique
Attaches to a Scorpion Clan Personality paying 1 less Gold.
Reaction: After you announce an action, bow this card: The action will not have its targeting changed.
card.flavor: "Trickery will have no power over you." - Ryoshun

card.name: Talisman of Yume-do
card.text:
Unique
Attaches to a Crane Clan Personality paying 1 less Gold.
Limited: Bow this card: Look at a target face-down card.
card.flavor: "The Realm of Dreams will grant you its insight." - Ryoshun

card.name: Talisman of Yomi
card.text:
Weapon • Unique
Attaches to a Phoenix Clan Personality paying 1 less Gold.
Battle: If this Personality is honorable: Move a target enemy unit home. Bow it if it moved.
card.flavor: "The strength of your ancestors will chastise your enemies." - Ryoshun

card.name: Rising Sun Blade
card.text:
Weapon
Battle: Bow this card: Destroy a target enemy card without attachments and with 5 or lower Force.
card.flavor: "Contain yourself, Shimura-san," Kei replied. "The Empire relies on us to hold the north, and bloodlust shall not sweep away our sense of duty."

card.name: Radiant Steel
card.text:
Weapon
Focus Effect: If you are a Dragon Clan player, give this card +1 Focus Value.
Battle: Bow this card: Destroy a target Weapon or Armor.
card.flavor: "Kei-sama, the Ox and the Badger stand beside the Dragon in this battle." - Morito Garin

card.name: Iweko's Journals
card.text:
Unique
Attaches to a Scorpion Clan Personality paying 1 less Gold.
Reaction: After the resolution of an action from one of your Political Strategies, bow this Personality and this card: Draw a card.
card.flavor: "They offer fascinating insights into the mind of a brilliant Kitsuki." - Bayushi Hisoka

card.name: Excellent Armor
card.text:
Armor
Reaction: After another player's action targets a card in this unit, destroy this card: Negate this Personality's destruction from the action's effects.
card.flavor: "Yes, let the Army of Fire return. I have unfinished business with them, I think." - Tamori Shimura

card.name: Agasha Kitsuki's Ashes
card.text:
Unique
Attaches to a Crane Clan Personality paying 2 less Gold.
Battle: Move this Personality home: Target an enemy Personality with lower Personal Honor than this Personality's Chi. Move him home. If he moved, his controller loses 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "All ancestors must be honored." - Daidoji Kirimi

card.name: Claws of the Wolf
card.text:
Ronin
This card has +1F for each other Ronin you control.
After this unit assigns, if you are a Crab Clan player: The player with the Imperial Favor discards it.
card.flavor: "Lord Sezaru cared for action, not politics."

card.name: The Masters' Guard
card.text:
Yojimbo
This card attaches to a Phoenix Clan Personality paying 1 less Gold.
Reaction: After a Ranged Attack targets a card in this unit: Negate the Ranged Attack's effects.
card.flavor: The only warriors considered worthy of such a task.

card.name: Defenders of Nanashi
card.text:
This unit may not be assigned to attack.
Battle: If this card is in your hand: Attach it to your target Personality.
Open: Destroy this card.
card.flavor: "We did not ask for this duty, but we will not shirk it."

card.name: Order of the Wooden Blade
card.text:
Order of the Wooden Blade
Battle: Bow a target enemy card without attachments. Destroy it if this action was taken as an additional action.
card.flavor: Outside of the Togashi, few monks are permitted to use steel blades. Some have no need to do so.

card.name: Iron Gauntlet Brothers
card.text:
Ranged Attacks targeting a card in this unit have -2 strength.
Battle: Bow each card with lower Gold Cost than this card in a target unit. Destroy any cards with 0 Gold Cost in the unit.
card.flavor: "All of us, the last survivors of our individual units. There is a reason for that."

card.name: East Wind Riders
card.text:
Cavalry • Scout
This card has +1F while attached to a Unicorn Clan Personality.
Recon Limited: Target a province, or two provinces if you are a Unicorn Clan player. After each time you destroy one of those provinces by battle resolution this turn, you may put a Ring from your discard pile into your hand.

card.name: Mountain Herd
card.text:
Cavalry
Attaches to a Dragon Clan Personality paying 1 less Gold.
This unit may assign to a defending army during Cavalry maneuvers even if it is not Cavalry.
card.flavor: Saved from death, used in service of a Champion.

card.name: The Silent Blade
card.text:
Ninja
Will only attach to a Ninja Personality.
Battle: Ranged 3 Attack that may target a Personality with Followers if he has one or more Poison tokens.
card.flavor: "Tonight, Noritoshi will die!"

card.name: Two Men At A River
card.text:
Focus Effect: In this duel's resolution, if the difference between each player's total score in the duel is 2 or less, the duel is a tie.
Battle: In this battle's resolution, if the difference between each army's total Force is 4 or less, and there are one or more units on both sides, the battle is a tie.
card.flavor: "Two strangers, perfectly matched, meet and face off at a crossroads. Such is the stuff of legend." - Shosuro Atesharu

card.name: Part the Waves
card.text:
Iaijutsu
Focus Effect: You may attach a Weapon from your discard pile to this Personality after this duel ends.
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Duelist: Bow a target enemy card without attachments.
card.flavor: "Calamity is no excuse not to practice!"

card.name: Foolish Pride
card.text:
Political
This card has -1 Gold Cost for each Courtier you control.
Battle: Bow a target Personality with 0 Personal Honor. His controller loses 2 Honor.
Battle/Open: Straighten a target Personality with 4 or higher Personal Honor.
card.flavor: "If they were allies, they would be unstoppable." - Otomo Taneji

card.name: Cricket Tattoo
card.text:
Water • Tattoo
Battle: Choose your performing Tattooed Personality: Straighten his unit. If he has Water, you may move him to the current battlefield.
card.flavor: For many, the tattooed order of ise zumi that served the Dragon were a peculiarity. Since the Army of Fire came, they are a source of awe and sometimes fear.

card.name: The Cost of Pride
card.text:
Reaction: After a Ranged Attack targets one of your cards: Give the Ranged Attack -3 strength.
Battle: Bow or straighten a target Personality whose Force is different from his base Force.
card.flavor: "More than one samurai has allowed confidence in his abilities to turn to arrogance, leading only to death. With the trials before the Empire, how many more will perish?" - Seppun Tashime

card.name: Stare Into the Void
card.text:
Void • Kiho
Battle: Choose your performing Monk or Shugenja: Look at the top 5 cards of your Fate deck and put them back in any order. Draw a card if your performer has Void.
card.flavor: "One cannot stare into the Void. One can but allow it to stare into you." - Isawa Kimi

card.name: Strength of Will
card.text:
Open: Destroy one or more target tokens on your target Personality.
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Personality: Bow a target unit with lower total Gold Cost than your Personality's unit. You may target and destroy an enemy card with a base Gold Cost of 0.
card.flavor: During such trying times, there are many who embrace those traits that once might have been considered weakness.

card.name: Stand as One
card.text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Yojimbo: Bow a target enemy card, which must have no attachments unless you control a Shugenja.
card.flavor: "Perhaps some do not understand, or even think it foolish. But I honor the pledge of my ancestor to stand before the Isawa and shield them from all harm. My duty is greater than my life, but not my honor." - Shiba Yoshimi

card.name: Remember Their Valor
card.text: Battle/Open: Choose your performing Deathseeker: For each honorably dead Personality in your discard pile, give your Deathseeker +2F and gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "Filthy undead!" the Deathseeker howled. "These were men of honor and strength, and you will desecrate their bodies no longer!"

card.name: Scouting Far Afield
card.text: Battle: Bow or destroy your performing opposed Personality: Put a target Battle Strategy from your discard pile into your hand. If your performer's Force was 6 or higher when you chose him, you may take an additional Battle action.
card.flavor: Hiruma and Shinjo fought shoulder to shoulder, pressing desperate forays deep behind the Destroyer's lines, seeking any hint of their enemy's objective.

card.name: Precious Burden
card.text: Battle: Give +2F to each Magistrate and Scorpion Clan Personality in your army with Chi greater than a target enemy Personality's Personal Honor.
card.flavor: "To the north, the Dragon, Ox and Badger stand with the Imperial Legions. To the south, the Crab, Lion and Unicorn hold fast. The Empire is ringed with honor and steel." - Miya Shoin

card.name: Province Assaulted
card.text:
Limited: Pay 4 Gold: Each player may target and destroy a Personality with a base Gold Cost equal to or less than his controller's stronghold's Gold Production plus 2.
Open: If it is not your turn, bow your Stronghold: Straighten one or two target units.
card.flavor: "They have left us unmolested for now. We will all die before we lose the castle." - Hiruma Gohachiro

card.name: Blessings of Sky
card.text:
Air • Kiho
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Shugenja and bow one of your Temples: Move your Shugenja and a target enemy Personality home. Bow each of their units that moved. If your Shugenja has Air, gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "We know that Kali-ma seeks something, and we must not rest until we find it." - Isawa Kumai

card.name: Plagued Terrain
card.text:
Plague • Terrain
Battle: Give a -1C Plague token to each Personality at the current battlefield without a Plague token. After each time a Personality moves to this battlefield, give him a -1C Plague token.
card.flavor: "It used to be a well-tended and fertile land. Now it is a wretched place for a war." - Bayushi Arashi

card.name: Honor's Hope
card.text: Open: Choose your performing Personality: Permanently give him the ability, "Battle: Bow this Personality: Ranged Attack with strength equal to his Personal Honor. If this destroys the Ranged Attack's target, gain 2 Honor."
card.flavor: "The Destroyers are powerful and numerous, but they have no honor. We will strengthen ourselves with bushido and drive them from the Empire." - Utaku Hana

card.name: Shadow's Talon
card.text:
Iaijutsu
Focus Effect: Look at the top 3 cards of your Fate deck. Discard one of them and add one of them to your focused cards. Draw a card.
card.flavor: "A duel then, for honor's sake," Hakuseki said. "Then we will put aside history and think only of the Empress' commmands."

card.name: Silent Struggle
card.text:
Ninja
Limited: Choose your performing unbowed Ninja Personality: Create a battlefield (not at any province). Only Ninja Personalities will move to it or from it. Assign your Ninja's unit to attack there. Assign another player's target unit to defend there, even if its Personality is bowed. Fight a battle there (after this action's resolution). After the battle ends, lose 5 Honor.

card.name: My Life Is Yours
card.text:
Bushido Virtue
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Samurai: Bow a target enemy Personality with equal or lower Personal Honor. You may target and bow another enemy Personality with a base Gold Cost of 6 or less.
card.flavor: "We have no coice but to trust the other clans. The Empire will suffer if they fail us." - Hida Benjiro

card.name: Only Actions Speak
card.text:
Reaction: After an action is announced: Negate all Honor gains until after the action's resolution. At that time, if this negated any gains, negate all Honor gains until the end of this phase and draw a card.
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Personality: Bow a target enemy card with lower Force and without attachments. Bow its unit if your Personality has 7 or more base Force.

card.name: Honor & Strength
card.text: Battle: Choose your performing Magistrate Personality: Target an enemy Personality with lower Personal Honor than your Magistrate's Chi. Move both Personalities home. If the enemy Personality is dishonorable, you may target and straighten a Personality.
card.flavor: "Divine One, my magistrates work tirelessly to create stability. With the cooperation of the Crane and the Scorpion, success is assured." - Shosuro Jimen

card.name: Fire Blossom
card.text:
Kiho
Battle: Choose your performing opposed Monk or Shugenja: Give him two +1F Fire tokens. You may target and bow an enemy card with lower Force (after adding the Fire tokens).
card.flavor: "Chosai knows much about fire, yes. But we have our own store of wisdom, and we are quite willing to share it with him." - Togashi Sho

card.name: Masked in Shadows
card.text:
Ninja • Terrain
Battle: If you control a Ninja at this battlefield: While this card is in play, negate other players' actions' effects that move their own non-Ninja Personalities or your Ninja Personalities to or from the current battlefield.
card.flavor: With nowhere to run, and the fog too thick for him to see their arrival, the family believed that Noritoshi would be doomed.

card.name: Innuendo
card.text:
Political
Open: Target a Personality. Unflattering rumors in court distract him. Give him -1F for each of your Courtiers in play.
card.flavor: "If Lord Noritoshi were so innocent, why has he not appeared in court? Why is he on the run? I will tell you why..."

card.name: Feinting Position
card.text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Scout, and bow him unless a Recon action has targeted the current battlefield's province this turn: Move a target enemy Personality home. If he moved, gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "Your surveying has done us a great service, Lord Shinjo," the Hida said, "but we have one more task for your men. I promise that your contributions will not be forgotten..."

card.name: A Pure Heart
card.text: Battle/Open: Choose your performing Paragon: Give him a Force bonus equal to his own Personal Honor.
card.flavor: A pure heart can drive you to greater heights on the battlefield, but will purity of the heart protect you from the plague?

card.name: Patrolling the Roads
card.text: Battle/Open: Choose your performing unbowed Magistrate: Target a Personality with lower Personal Honor than your Magistrate's Chi. Reduce the Personality's Force to his own Personal Honor. If his Force is now 0, gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "Lady Kei is sequestered beneath Jousai Tengen. It is our job to watch the roads so that none approach before the birth of the heir." - Mirumoto Mori

card.name: Reckless Confrontation
card.text: Battle: Choose your performing Personality: Reduce the Force of each Personality and Follower in a target enemy unit by your Personality's Personal Honor. Gain 1 Honor for each Personality and Follower in that unit whose Force is now 0.
card.flavor: "You are a man of honor and dignity, and I... I acted in haste, and shamed my family. I humbly apologize and ask your forgiveness for my actions."

card.name: Claw and Shell
card.text:
Open: Destroy one or two Personalities or attachments with base Gold Cost of 0.
Battle: Target an enemy Personality. Bow him if he is attacking. Destroy him if his base Gold Cost is 6 or less.
card.flavor: With the Unicorn provoking the undead hordes into advancing on the Crab line, the shock troops of the Crab moved forward, and trapped the monsters between the defensive line and a flanking attack force.

card.name: Proper Deference
card.text:
Political Reaction: Before a turn ends, if the active player has gained 8 or more Honor this turn, excluding gains from battle resolution: Set his Family Honor equal to its value when the turn began. Draw a card.
Battle: Give a target Personality or Follower -4F.
card.flavor: "The hand that wielded the blade was mine, but the honor of the victory was yours, my Lord."

card.name: Narrow Cliffs
card.text:
Terrain
Battle: Your Ranged Attacks have +2 strength. Other player's Ranged Attacks have -2 strength.
card.flavor: "When the Yobanjin approach through the pass, we will have the higher ground. Their forces will be pinned, and the monks should buy us enough time to whittle down their ranks from above." - Ikoma Satoru

card.name: Heedless Assault
