card.text: Battle: Give your performing unbowed Berserker Personality a Force penalty up to his current Force: Give a target enemy Follower or Personality an equal Force penalty. Destroy your Berserker if he now has 0 Force and no attachments. Destroy the enemy card if it now has 0 Force and no attachments.
card.flavor: The Damned rushed forward and cut through the remaining zombies, heedless of their own injuries.

card.name: Unwavering Commitment
card.text:
This card costs 1 less Gold for each unit you control at the current battlefield.
Battle: Move a target enemy Personality home. If you are a Scorpion Clan player, his controller loses 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "The delicious irony is that, should Jimen and Noritoshi put aside their differences, they could unite their clans in singular purpose. Fortunately, that will never happen." - Daigotsu Susumu

card.name: Questionable Charity
card.text:
Fear • Maho • Kiho
Spider Clan players may play this card paying 1 less Gold.
Limited: Bow your performing Shugenja: Lose 6 Honor. You take in the families of the Dragonfly. Create two 2F/2C/0PH Shadowlands • Undead Personalities.
card.flavor: "Come with me, friends! Quickly!"

card.name: Unexpected Sympathy
card.text:
Crab Clan players may play this card paying 1 less Gold.
Limited: You take in the families of the Dragonfly. Create two 1F Followers and attach them to one or two of your target Personalities.
card.flavor: "We know what it means to be cast out of one's homeland at the hands of an inhuman enemy. You are welcome here." - Hiruma Todori

card.name: Asijin's Legacy
card.text:
Heroic
Battle: Choose your performing Personality who is a Hero or an Unaligned Human: Choose one of his base abilities. You may use it a second time this turn. You may take an additional Battle action to use that ability.
card.flavor: The Tonbo are known for their diplomatic abilities and their unique shugenja schools. Still, the Dragonfly always remember than their Clan's founder was an excellent duelist.

card.name: Inexorable Defeat
card.text:
Battle/Open: Destroy a target Terrain or Region. Lose 2 Honor.
Battle: If any enemy units are at the current battlefield, choose your performing Personality: Move him there. Straighten his unit if he moved. You scorch the earth behind him. If he moved, negate the movement of any other units to that battlefield. Lose 2 Honor.

card.name: Impetuous Challenge
card.text:
Iaijutsu
Focus Effect: After this duel ends, if the duel's loser did not focus, destroy him.
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Personality: He challenges a target enemy Personality. Bow the duel's loser's unit.
card.flavor: Failure to respond quickly means death.

card.name: Deathly Aura
card.text:
Dark Virtue
Reaction: After engaging, if you are the Attacker, choose your performing Samurai: You have the first chance to take a Battle action in this battle, which must be performed by that Samurai.
card.flavor: Daigotsu smiled. "You have found the Ebon Daughter's stronghold? I know what we must do."

card.name: Hasty Evaluation
card.text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Cavalry Scout Personality, and bow him unless a Recon action has targeted this battlefield's province this turn: Move a target enemy unit home. You may target one of your Personalities and move him to the current battlefield.
card.flavor: The wounds of the previous two wars lie deep. The Unicorn Clan and the Lion Clan stand wary of each other's intentions.

card.name: Concealed Scroll
card.text: Battle: If you have attached a Spell this battle to a Shugenja who was opposed at the time: Draw 2 cards.
card.flavor: "Battle is a terrible thing for any soul, even more so for a priest of the kami. But we have our duty, as do all samurai, and we must be prepared for any eventuality." - Isawa Sawao

card.name: Choose Your Fight
card.text:
Terrain
May be played even if there is already a Terrain at the current battlefield.
Battle: Choose your performing Tactician: Destroy all other Terrains in play. Draw a card.
card.flavor: With the wrong location, one can lose a battle before it begins.

card.name: The Wind Never Stops
card.text: Reaction: After the resolution of a Battle action you took that gave a Force penalty to an enemy Follower or Personality without Followers, choose your performing unbowed Battle Maiden at the current battlefield: Ranged Attack with strength equal to her Personal Honor which must target the enemy card.
card.flavor: The Utaku charged without any sign of fear. Their thunderous assault trampled their foes under their wake.

card.name: Overpowering Assault
card.text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Commander and bow his performing Follower: Destroy a target enemy card without attachments.
card.flavor: Nothing can stand against Rokugani honor and resolve.

card.name: Thoughtful Present
card.text: Open: Bow your performing Artisan Personality and discard the top card of your Fate deck: Target a Personality. Bow him if his Chi is lower than the Focus Value of the discarded card.
card.flavor: The Doji excel in finding the perfect gift for their adversaries, garnering favors and advantage along the way.

card.name: Mountain Storehouse
card.text:
Singular
Battle: If any enemy units are at the current battlefield, which must be this province's battlefield unless you are a Lion Clan player, bow this card and choose a performing Personality in your home: Move him to the current battlefield. Straighten his unit if he moved into a defending army.
card.flavor: A well-kept secret of the Toturi Dynasty.

card.name: The Oni's Footsteps
card.text:
Shadowlands
Your Shadowlands Personalities with one or more Shadowlands Followers have +1F.
Reaction: After a Personality enters play from this province: Permanently give him Shadowlands.
card.flavor: A wretched place, considered cursed and haunted by demons by most who know of it. No one travels there, so it provided the Spider a perfect refuge from the plague.

card.name: Mouth of the Plague
card.text:
Fire • Mountain • Plague
This province does not hold Dynasty cards unless you are a Crane Clan player.
Battle: Give -1C Plague token to one or two target Personalities.
card.flavor: "We sow our seeds within it, and allow the kami themselves to spread the death of all samurai." The Ebon daughter laughed. "The children of Doji are first, but far from last."

card.name: Nitoru
card.text:
Ronin • Samurai
Battle: Target an enemy unit with fewer cards than the number of different Clan alignments among Personalities at the current battlefield. Move it home.
card.flavor: "I carry my father's blade as well as my own. I am warrior enough for both, and I will gladly prove it to any who doubt me."

card.name: The Cursed Dead
card.text:
Shadowlands • Undead • Plague
After The Cursed Dead enters play: Lose 4 Honor.
The Cursed Dead will not be destroyed for having 0 Chi.
Battle: Give a target enemy Follower or Personality -4F. If its Force is now 0, bow it.
card.flavor: "Wretched abominations, the likes of which cannot be permitted to exist." - Kuni Daigo

card.name: Karatsu
card.text: Ronin • Shugenja • Cavalry • Commander • Scout • Villain
card.flavor: He gripped the dying ronin's throat, energy crackling along his arm. "I do not care about your foolish legion," he whispered. "I seek my son, Kuronada, and I will hold his heart in my hands as he dies!"

card.name: Gutobo - exp
card.text:
Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Goblin • Scout • Experienced • Unique
After Gutobo enters play: Lose 4 Honor.
Battle: If a Recon action has targeted the current battlefield's province this turn: Destroy a target enemy card without attachments.
card.flavor: "Flesh makes us strong. Pity there are no more Horiuchi."

card.name: The Quiet Death
card.text:
Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Oni
After The Quiet Death enters play: Lose 3 Honor.
Battle/Open: Target another player's Personality. Negate his movement (this turn).
card.flavor: "Its form is like that of cloth or cotton, easily torn and easily mended. It wraps around the legs, slowing movement, then forces itself into the throat. Fire alone can destroy it, but also its victims." - The Book of Kuni Mokuna

card.name: Utaku Yu-Pan - exp2
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Battle Maiden • Daimyo • Paragon • Experienced 2 • Loyal • Unique
Your other Battle Maidens have +1F and +1PH while attacking.
Battle: Even if Yu-Pan is bowed: Straighten her. You may target and destroy an enemy Personality or Follower with 0 Force.
card.flavor: The years weigh heavily upon her shoulders. She has seen countless tragedies yet she remains strong of heart and resolve.

card.name: Utaku Kana
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Battle Maiden
Kana has +1F while attacking for each other Battle Maiden in her army.
Battle: Give a target enemy Personality or Follower a Force penalty equal to Kana's Personal Honor. If the enemy card's Force is now zero, gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "Kana is only at home on the battlefield" - Utaku Yu-Pan

card.name: Shinjo Hee-Young
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Scout • Loyal
Battle: If Hee-Young is face-up in one of your Provinces: Bring her into play at the current battlefield, ignoring costs if a Recon action has targeted the current battlefield's province this turn.
card.flavor: She laughed. "Of course I can make it through enemy lines, my lord."

card.name: Shinjo Dong-Min
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Commander
Reaction: After the resolution of an action that Dong-Min performed, if he is opposed: Give a target Personality or Follower in Dong-Min's army +3F.
card.flavor: "A true commander bolsters his troops and helps each warrior fight as a legion."

card.name: Inugami
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Nonhuman • Dog • Cavalry • Guardian • Spirit
Will not attach cards.
Reaction: After the resolution of another player's action that bowed, moved, or destroyed one of your Human Personalities while he was at Inugami's battlefield: Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality without attachments.

card.name: Ide Kin
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Courtier • Recruiter
Political Open: Bow Kin: Create a 1F Cavalry Follower and attach it to your target Personality.
card.flavor: "Five hundred more warriors for the fight south, my lord. You will want for nothing as long as I am in charge."

card.name: Daigotsu Arima
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai
After Arima enters play: Lose 5 Honor.
Battle/Open: Straighten your target Personality.
card.flavor: "We know where the Ebon Daughter is now, and we shall crush her and her pathetic servitors. In the end, Daigotsu shall reign over all."

card.name: Chuda Otsu
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Shugenja • Undead
After Otsu enters play: Lose 5 Honor.
card.flavor:
"We must find a way to disrupt the Ebon Daughter's control over her creations," Mishime said.
"I am sure it can be done, my lord," Otsu answered. "My death has given me valuable insight in this regard."

card.name: Daigotsu Shimekiri
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai • Paragon • Dark Art • The Fallen Crane
After Shimekiri enters play: Lose 4 Honor.
Battle: Remove a Fate card in your discard pile from the game: Ranged Attack with strength equal to its Focus Value, and +1 strength if you removed a Dark Virtue.
card.flavor: "He is powerful, beautiful, merciless."

card.name: Daigotsu Setsuko - exp
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai • Paragon • Experienced • Unique • Dark Perfection
After Setsuko enters play: Lose 4 Honor and put a Dark Virtue from your discard pile into your hand.
Open: Give Setsuko Cavalry, Duelist, or Tactician.
card.flavor: "The stakes are high, but it is such a delightful game."

card.name: Chuda Mishime - exp2
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Shugenja • Daimyo • Experienced 2 • Loyal • Unique
After Mishime enters play: Lose 4 Honor.
Maho Battle: Bow Mishime: Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality without attachments. If this destroyed a card, create a 2F/2C/0PH Shadowlands • Undead Personality in your current army.
card.flavor: "Die!"

card.name: Chuda Kanashi
card.text:
Spider Clan • Nonhuman • Jorogumo • Shugenja • Artisan • Infiltrator • Origami Master
After Kanashi enters play: Gain 2 Honor.
Limited: Give a target Personality a -1F Web token. If his Force is now 0, bow him.
card.flavor: "We are not your allies, but we are enemies of the Destroyer. I could explain, but you will be joining my web shortly, so there is little point."

card.name: Ao-bozu
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Oni • Monk • Kensai
After Ao-bozu enters play: Lose 4 Honor, create a +1F Weapon Item, and attach it to Ao-bozu.
Fear Battle: Bow a target enemy Personality with fewer attachments than Ao-bozu.
card.flavor: "There are things that walk as a man which are not man. Their true countenance is horror incarnate." - The Book of Kuni Mokuna

card.name: Yogo Rieko - exp
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Air • Shugenja • Ninja • Kuroiban • Experienced • Unique
Battle/Open: Transfer a Poison token from a target Personality to another target Personality.
Battle/Open: Even if Rieko is bowed: Straighten a target Personality.
card.flavor: Although the Kuroiban could find no way to stem the plague, or the zombies it produced, Rieko continued to fight them wherever they appeared.

card.name: Bayushi Keirei
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Ninja • Acrobat
Battle: If Keirei is at the current battlefield: Move him to an adjacent battlefield. You may target and give a -1F Poison token to a Personality at the current battlefield or at Keirei's new battlefield.
card.flavor: "He is merciless to his foes. His methods are unconventional and completely effective." - Shosuro Jimen

card.name: Bayushi Eiyu
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Kensai • Bitter Lies
Battle: Show the top card of your Fate deck: Target an enemy Personality. If the card's Focus Value is odd, or lower than the Focus Value of one of Eiyu's Weapons, move the Personality home.
card.flavor: The madness of the Bitter Lies proved effective even against Kali-ma's forces.

card.name: Shiba Kotaro
card.text: Phoenix Clan • Samurai • Duelist • Yojimbo
card.flavor: Where once the Phoenix struggled to divine the nature of the universe, now they have a more focused goal: determining the methods and goals of the Destroyers, and finding ways to combat the plague ravaging the Empire.

card.name: Imaishi
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Air • Shugenja • Summoner
Battle: Bow Imaishi or one of his Spells: Target an enemy unit with a number of cards equal to or lower than the number of cards in Imaishi's unit. Move it home. If it moved, gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: Some Phoenix, eager to avenge the clan's losses during the War of Dark Fire, moved to confront the renewed Yobanjin army.

card.name: Isawa Ochiai - exp3
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Fire • Shugenja • Duelist • Elemental Master • Experienced 3 • Loyal • Unique
Before the resolution of a duel involving your Fire Personality at Ochiai's location: Give each of your focused cards +1 Focus Value.
Battle/Limited: Ochiai challenges another player's target Personality. Ochiai has the first chance to focus in the duel and must use this chance to focus if possible. Bow the duel's loser.

card.name: Isawa Shun
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Earth • Shugenja • Inquisitor • Magistrate
Battle: Bow a target enemy Personality with Personal Honor lower than Shun's Chi. Gain 2 Honor if the targeted Personality is dishonorable or a Shugenja.
card.flavor: "It has been six months since Mizuhiko was seen in Phoenix lands. If the worst has occured, we must find him."

card.name: Isawa Hachiko
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Void • Shugenja • Ishiken
Limited: Look at the top card of your Fate deck. You may put it at the bottom of the deck.
card.flavor: "I tried to divine their intent once, and it almost destroyed me. The nature of the Destroyers is simply too alien. Other methods must be used."

card.name: Asako Bairei - exp4
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Water • Shugenja • Cavalry • Naval • Elemental Master • Genius • Scribe • Experienced 4 • Unique
Your Water Shugenja in Bairei's army have Naval.
Battle: Show the top card of your Fate Deck. If it is a Spell or Kiho, draw it.
card.flavor: "The spirit of water ensures that change is constant, and that there is always something new to learn."

card.name: Tsuruchi Gidayu - exp
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Magistrate • Experienced • Unique • Charitable
Battle/Open: Bow a target attachment.
Battle: Destroy a target enemy card without attachments and that has a lower Gold Cost than Gidayu.
card.flavor: "Of course I volunteered for this duty. Sailing to a mysterious land in search of secrets and adventure? What fool would not?"

card.name: Tsuruchi Kuze
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Perfect
Battle: Ranged 6 Attack.
card.flavor: "Lord Naizen and his forces prepare to sail to a distant land in accordance with the Empress' wishes," Nobumoto said to his men. "In their absence, we shall scourge the land of these plague zombies from a safe distance, and earn the gratitude of an Empire."

card.name: Yoritomo Tahei
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Scout • Trap Expert
Battle: Bow Tahei unless a Recon action has targeted this battlefield's province this turn: Tahei leads the enemy into a trap. Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality.
card.flavor: "The ruthlessness of a Yoritomo paired with the training of a Hiruma. I find him quite unpleasant." - Moshi Kalani

card.name: Tsuruchi Ogata
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Magistrate
Limited: Straighten and take control of another player's target non-Unique bowed Holding with Gold Cost lower than Ogata's Chi. The Holding will not be destroyed while you control it. Before your Dynasty Phase begins, return control of it to its owner.
card.flavor: "The plague leaves some unable to tend their lands. We shall stand in their place, if we must."

card.name: Yoritomo Chiako
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Commander
Chiako enters play paying 1 less Gold.
You may not assign this unit to, and Chiako will not move into, a defending army.
card.flavor: "To the Mantis, the Divine Empress assigns the task of reaching the Ivory Kingdoms, to determine what there could have given rise to these Destroyers." - Voice of the Empress

card.name: Tsuruchi Ohashi
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Scout
Battle: Bow Ohashi unless a Recon action has targeted this battlefield's province this turn: Move a target unit home.
card.flavor: "The plague has been costly, but confined. Now it spreads like fire throughout the land, with no apparent cause. Some force is behind this. We must find it."

card.name: Matsu Mikura - exp
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Naval • Hero • Experienced • Unique
Battle: Bow Mikura: Ranged 4 Attack.
card.flavor: "She is a valiant warrior, if a quiet one. She serves within the Imperial City, and has completed two tours of duty on the Deathless as well. I see in her the qualities that make her lady Kenji great."

card.name: Kitsu Iwao
card.text:
Lion Clan • Spirit • Shugenja
Battle/Open: Copy an ability that does not itself copy abilities from your target dead non-Unique Personality to Iwao.
card.flavor: "Our ancestors are unwavering in their support of this war. One has gone so far as to fight his way across the veil of death to lend aid to his great-great-grandchildren. Never doubt the resolve of the Lion!" - Kitsu Kiyoko

card.name: Matsu Kenji - exp
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Tactician • Commander • Daimyo • Paragon • Experienced • Loyal • Unique
Battle: Bow a target enemy card. If this bowed a card, gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "I have tasted love once, and shall never know its like again. Marriage? It is a duty, like war, but I fear I shall be far greater and the latter than the former.

card.name: Matsu Haruya
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Deathseeker • Hero
After Haruya is destroyed during an Attack Phase: Gain 3 Honor.
Battle: Bow a target enemy card with lower Force.
card.flavor: Some among the Lion, the most seasoned veterans of the War of Dark Fire, were sent to aid the Dragon.

card.name: Head of Fudo
card.text:
Fudo • Unique
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold, plus 1 Gold for each other Fudo card you control.
Limited: Bow this card: Look at the top four cards of your Dynasty deck. If one is a Fudo Holding, you may put it into play (bowed) ignoring its Gold Cost.
card.flavor: "What was Fudo really? None can say." - Tanari

card.name: Heart of Fudo
card.text:
Fudo • Unique
Limited: Remove from the game three of your Fudo Holdings with different titles: Create a 10F/5C/0PH Nonhuman • Fudo Personality with the trait "Cards' effects will not bow this Personality or move him home."
Reaction: Before one of your Nonhumans with 8 or higher Force is destroyed, destroy this card: Negate the Nonhuman's destruction.

card.name: Spider Netsuke
card.text:
Unique
This Personality has Shadowlands.
Non-Shadowlands Personalities may not assign to an army with this unit.
Fear Battle: Bow this card: Move a target enemy Personality home. Until the turn ends, negate his movement.
card.flavor: "We have ways of identifying ourselves." - Chuda Hiroe

card.name: Overwhelming Numbers
card.text: Battle: If your current army has more units than the current enemy army: The enemy leader chooses and bows one of his unbowed Personalities in his current army.
card.flavor: "By the Fortunes, is there no end to them? How many must I kill? Stay back, abominations! Back!"

card.name: Aoyama
card.text:
Ronin • Tactician
Aoyama has +2F while in an army with another Tactician.
card.flavor: "She is much like Tamago, but utterly without emotion of any kind. I know not who these Fifth Wind are, but if she is their representative, I find them distasteful." - The journals of Utagawa

card.name: Ikoma Satoru
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Tactician
Battle: Even if Satoru is bowed: Move him to a battlefield with one or more enemy units. Straighten his unit if it moved.
card.flavor:
"In times such as these, Korin, we will need your family's knowledge of history more than ever."
"It shall be yours, now and always, Lord Shigetoshi."

card.name: Alone with One's Thoughts
card.text: Limited: Target a Personality who has fewer Sake tokens than he did at the start of this turn: He drinks to remove his hangover. Give him three +1F Sake tokens.
card.flavor: "The sake drives the demons away, but they come back. They always come back."

card.name: Hida Satoshi
card.text: Crab Clan • Samurai • Tactician
card.flavor: "'I see no way we can retake the Crab lands with our current resources," Satashi said. 'No matter,' Reiha replied. ' We will continue to fight the enemies of the empire for as long as a single Crab warrior draws breath.'" - The Tale of the Jade Widow

card.name: Tennyo
card.text:
Crab Clan • Nonhuman • Tennyo • Cavalry • Scout • Spirit
Battle: Bow Tennyo unless a Recon action has targeted this battlefield's province this turn: Bow a target enemy card without attachments. Destroy the targeted card if it is an attachment.
card.flavor: "No one knows why these spirits decided to fight the Destroyers. I, for one, welcome all the help we can get." - Hida Benjiro

card.name: Hida Shimonai
card.text:
Crab Clan • Shadowlands • Berserker • Damned
Battle: Bow a target enemy card with lower Force.
card.flavor: "They are no different from any other Shadowlands creature. Destroyers can die."

card.name: Hida Kichiro
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Commander
Battle: Straighten your target Personality or Follower.
card.flavor: The Crab fought daily to destroy the inexorable army. Despite their greatest efforts, the Crab warriors found themselves retreating from the constant battle.

card.name: Hida Demopen
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Hero
Battle: Discard a Heroic Strategy: Ranged 5 Attack.
card.flavor: "How can you put so much value in paintings, fans, and perfumes, when bushi fall to an unending foe?"

card.name: Hida Tenshi
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai
Battle: Bow Tenshi: Reduce the Force of a target enemy Personality or Follower by an amount equal to Tenshi's Force.
card.flavor: "I am young and I know my weaknesses. I find my own, unique ways to help the war effort."

card.name: Tetsu Kama Mine
card.text:
Mine • Singular
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Reaction: After you attach an Item from your hand to a Kensai or Lion Clan Personality, bow this card: Draw a card.
card.flavor: "For their aid in its defense, the yield of our greatest mine shall ever be shared with the Lion." - Mirumoto Kei

card.name: Triumph Before Battle
card.text: Until your next turn begins, after each time an enemy Personality is destroyed during a battle by an action one of your Personalities performed, gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: A Lion warrior's inspiring presence can push his soldiers past their breaking point. Often, a Lion army succeeds beyond expectations because they believe they can.

card.name: A Tranquil Mind
card.text: Until the game ends, before each player's End Phase begins, he may look at a number of cards from the top of his Fate deck equal to the number of Rings he controls and put them back in any order.
card.flavor: "The Great Clans snipe at each other, driven to distraction by the threat of the zombie infestation. Can we afford dissent in the face of destruction?" - Tanari

card.name: Water Dragon's Guidance
card.text:
Water • Dragon • Unique
After this card enters play: You may put the Ring of Water from your discard pile into your hand.
Open: Discard this card: Give your target Personality Naval. If you control the Ring of Water, give him and his Followers Cavalry.
card.flavor: The element of change blesses those who value adaptation and strength.

card.name: On All Sides
card.text: Starting with you, each player may target and destroy a Personality with a base Gold Cost equal to or less than his controller's Stronghold's Gold Production plus 2.
card.flavor: "We fight, back to back, to preserve the beauty and strength of the Emerald Empire. Inspired by the memory of Hida Tadaka and Matsu Itagi, we fight as true brothers." - Akodo Shigetoshi

card.name: Void Dragon's Guidance
card.text:
Void • Dragon • Unique
After this card enters play: You may put the Ring of the Void from your discard pile into your hand.
Battle/Open: Discard this card: Look at the top 5 cards of any Fate deck. Put them back in any order. If you control the Ring of the Void, draw a card.

card.name: Fire Dragon's Guidance
card.text:
Fire • Dragon • Unique
After this card enters play: You may put the Ring of Fire from your discard pile into your hand.
Battle: Discard this card: Ranged 5 Attack. If you control the Ring of Fire, you may make another consecutive Ranged 5 Attack.
card.flavor: The element of destruction blesses those who value courage and intelligence.

card.name: Earth Dragon's Guidance
card.text:
Earth • Dragon • Unique
After this card enters play: You may put the Ring of Earth from your discard pile into your hand.
Battle: Discard this card: Bow a target enemy unit. If you control the Ring of Earth, until the turn ends, negate the straightening of any cards now in the unit.

card.name: Air Dragon's Guidance
card.text:
Air • Dragon • Unique
After this card enters play: You may put the Ring of Air from your discard pile into your hand.
Battle/Open: Discard this card: Straigten your target unit. If you control the Ring of Air, you may target and straighten another target unit.

card.name: Touch of the Flames
card.text:
Fire
Focus Effect: If your Personality in this duel is Fire, draw a card.
Battle: Bow this Shugenja and destroy this card: Destroy a target unit with fewer cards in it than the number of different element keywords on all of your Shugenja in this army.
card.flavor: "Must fire always destroy?" - Isawa Sawao

card.name: Tetsubo of Earth
card.text:
Earth
If this Shugenja is Earth, Ranged Attacks targeting him have -2 strength.
Limited: Once per game: Create a +3F/+0C Earth • Weapon Item with the ability "Reaction: After an action targets this Personality: Negate his movement from the action's effects" and attach it to this Shugenja.

card.name: Thunder's Blessing
card.text:
Thunder
While this Shugenja is Thunder, he has Naval.
Limited: Destroy this card: You may equip Spells as a Battle action. After the resolution of an Equip Battle action you took, you may take an additional Battle action from a Spell it attached.
card.flavor: "Sample the blessings of Heaven, my friend!"

card.name: Trust the Void
card.text:
Void • Unique
Limited: Bow this Shugenja unless he is Void, and destroy this card: Show the top 3 cards of your Fate deck. Choose another player, who may target one of the cards. Discard the targeted card and draw 2 cards.
card.flavor: "All is well, Ningen-san. You have earned your rest. Kimi will take your place as you desire." - Isawa Ochiai

card.name: Fortress of the Forgotten
card.text: Battle: If any enemy units are at the current battlefield: Target a non-Unique Personality face-up in one of your provinces. Bring him into play at the current battlefield. If he is a Berserker, you may ignore his Gold cost; if you do and he entered play, destroy him before this turn ends.
card.flavor: "We go forth to die." - Hida Ikarukani

card.name: Seawatch Castle
card.text: Iaijutsu Battle: Even if this card is bowed, choose your performing unbowed Personality: He challenges a target enemy Personality. Move the duel's loser home. The winner's controller takes the Imperial Favor.
card.flavor: The serenity of the waves has given rise to a unique dueling style, popular among prominent yojimbo.

card.name: Great Hall of Records
card.text: Battle: Straighten your target Personality. Give him +3F if he is opposed and a Hero.
card.flavor: "Our duty is to maintain a record of all the Lion's exploits. Not only that they can be remembered, but that they can inspire new generations to greatness." - Ikoma Korin

card.name: Shelter of the Earth
card.text:
Earth
Open: Destroy this card: Create a +3F Armor Item, or +4F if the performing Shugenja is Earth, and attach it to him.
card.flavor: The kami of Earth are slow to rouse and slow to act. However, once they have decided to protect a place or person, they are slow to yield, even to the most ferocious of blows.

card.name: Steed of the Ebbing Tides
card.text:
Air • Water
Open: Bow this Shugenja unless he is Air or Water: Give your target Samurai Personality Cavalry.
card.flavor: "This invocation was created by the Unicorn during their time in the Burning Sands. What is fascinating is how the spell was refined after the Unicorn met the Isawa..." - Asako Bairei

card.name: Fearsome Mempo
card.text:
Cursed
Reaction: After engaging in a battle: Give -2F to a target Personality or Follower opposing this card.
card.flavor: "Fear can be instilled in many ways. One of the simplest is to make your foe question who he faces." - Yogo Kazunori

card.name: Awakened Blade
card.text:
Kami • Weapon • Unique
Battle: Destroy this card: Destroy a target enemy card with lower Force than this Personality's Force (before destroying this card) and no Weapons or Armor.
card.flavor: Swords whose kami have awakened are great treasures. Entire generations seek to be worthy of them.

card.name: Ambitious Merchant
card.text:
Merchant • Unique
Reaction: When paying a Gold Cost, destroy your target Holding: Produce 3 Gold.
card.flavor: No true samurai troubles himself with petty things such as commerce or business. This provides opportunity to one who is wealthly and daring enough to handle such things for the noble classes.

card.name: Aspiring Ronin
card.text:
Ronin
Will only attach to a Samurai Personality.
card.flavor: To advance in life, a ronin needs to serve a samurai, a lord with lands, family, and future. Merchants or peasants might supply money for the next meal, but only the samurai of the clans can supply a chance for the ronin to better herself.

card.name: Succumb to Vice
card.text: Limited: Bow and dishonor your performing Personality with one or more Sake tokens, and pay Gold equal to the targeted unit's total Gold Cost: Destroy a target unit.
card.flavor: Members of the samurai caste are taught to control their emotions. This leads to tragedy when one has had too much to drink.

card.name: Coordinated Assault
card.text:
Tactical
Battle: Choose one to three performing Tacticians: Give each of them +3F.
card.flavor: The superiority of the Lion leadership lies not in one general, or even several. The Lion are peerless on the battlefield because every leader of men can be trusted to implement even the most complex of plans on the spur of the moment.

card.name: Ominous Battlefield
card.text:
Terrain
Battle: Before this battle's resolution, you may target and bow a Nonhuman or Cavalry card (at the current battlefield).
card.flavor: Horses are swift, and the more exotic denizens of the empire bring strange and powerful abilities to battle. But no animal can match the spirit and discipline of the children of the Sun and Moon.

card.name: Sohei's Duty
card.text: Battle: If you control a Temple and any enemy units are at the current battlefield, choose your performing Monk: Move him there. Straighten his unit if he moved. If he is now in a defending army, you may take an additional Battle action to use a base ability on a card in his unit.
card.flavor: Warrior orders among monks are keen to defend their shrines.

card.name: Howls of the Dead
card.text: Open: Choose one to three performing Undead Personalities: Give them and each of their Undead Followers Cavalry.
card.flavor: Peasant legends state that the howling of the wind is caused by the shrieks of lost souls. On some nights, the legends are true.

card.name: Demand Obedience
card.text: Battle: Choose your performing Samurai Personality: Look at the top 5 cards of your Fate deck. You may attach one of them that is a Follower to your Samurai. Put the remaining cards at the bottom of the deck in any order.
card.flavor: Samurai are the pinnacle of society. When they call, it is an honor to follow.

card.name: Shadowed Words
card.text:
Political
Limited: Choose your performing Courtier or Ninja Personality: Shuffle one or two target Political Strategies from your discard pile into your deck. Remove this card from the game.
card.flavor: Not all treaties are arranged by courtiers, nor all deals finalized in the courts. Sometimes, politics come to fruition in the most unorthodox places, facilitated by the most unlikely individuals.

card.name: Shattered Stone Kata
card.text:
Kata
Limited: Put this card into play in your home. Discard any other Kata cards there. While this card remains in play, you have the ability, "Battle: If you are taking this action as an additional action, choose your performing unbowed Monk: Ranged Attack with strength equal to his Chi plus 1."

card.name: Subversive Whispers
card.text:
Kiho • Unique
Open: Bow your performing Shugenja: Discard a face-down card in a province or a face-up Personality in a province.
card.flavor:
"We cannot defeat him in battle, master."
"We will not need to."

card.name: Deny the Horde
card.text: Battle: If your army has fewer units than the enemy army, choose your unbowed performing Samurai or Berserker: The enemy leader targets and destroys one of his Personalities in his current army.
card.flavor: The resiliency of the Crab is legendary within Rokugan. Their armies stand against overwhelming odds, yet emerge victorious.

card.name: Planned Adversity
card.text:
Unique
Limited: Destroy one of your non-Unique Holdings: Search your Dynasty deck for a non-Unique Holding. Put the new Holding into play (bowed).
card.flavor: "Leaders have plans in place for both times of plenty and times of strife. Visionaries can create either condition upon demand." - Yasuki Jinn-Kuen's Assessment

card.name: Deny the Darkness
card.text:
Jade
Battle: Choose your unbowed performing defending Personality: Bow a target enemy Personality, and if he is Shadowlands, negate his straightening (until the turn ends).
card.flavor: For over a thousand years, the defenders of the Empire have found ways to protect Rokugan. Even the forces of the Shadowlands have been broken before Rokugan's protectors.

card.name: Iuchi Quan
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Water • Shugenja • Cavalry • Scout
Recon Limited: Target a province. Quan divines the landscape. After the next Cavalry Maneuvers segment this turn, you may assign a unit (with an unbowed Personality) to that province's battlefield.
card.flavor: "The normal route is blocked by floods, but I have found another way."

card.name: Shinjo Liu Ying
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Tactician • Unique
Battle: Move a target enemy Personality home.
card.flavor: "Vainglorious? Far from it. I merely advise that few other generals could have routed the enemy so utterly."

card.name: Fettered Minion
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai • Undead
After Fettered Minion enters play: Lose 3 Honor.
Fettered Minion has +3F while in an army with another Undead card.
card.flavor: For the poor souls claimed by Jigoku, service is eternal. There is no escape. Even death promises but a moment's respite from endless conflict.

card.name: Kazuwaru
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Ogre • Kensai • Unique
After Kazuwaru enters play: Lose 4 Honor.
Battle: Give a target enemy Personality a -3F Maimed token. You may create a +3F Improvised • Weapon Item and attach it to Kazuwaru.
card.flavor: "You broke my club, samural. You will provide me another."

card.name: Bayushi Orijitte
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Kensai • Bitter Lies • Unique
Battle: Show the top card of your Fate deck: If its Focus Value is odd, or is lower than the Focus Value of one of Orijitte's Weapons, draw it.
card.flavor: Only fools believe that the masters of the school of Bitter Lies prevail merely through good fortune.

card.name: Shosuro Nishu
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Ninja
Battle: Even if Nishu is not at the current battlefield, bow him: Give a target Ninja +2F.
card.flavor: Upon passing their gempukku, some Scorpion are given dark outfits, exotic weapons, and training in unusual skills. They believe they have been singled out for greatness. They are merely distractions.

card.name: Agasha Yuhiko
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Fire • Void • Shugenja • Alchemist
Battle: Discard a card with an element keyword: Give Yuhiko a Force bonus equal to the discarded card's Focus Value. You may make a Ranged Attack with strength equal to the discarded card's Focus Value.
card.flavor: The kami are in all things, watching, listening. Those who can speak with them learn great secrets.

card.name: Shiba Kyushi
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Fire • Samurai • Yojimbo • Unique
Battle: Bow Kyushi unless you control a Shugenja: Ranged 4 Attack.
card.flavor: "I beg your forgiveness, Isawa-san. There is an assassin on the roof. If you would indulge me with a moment to deal with him, we will shortly be able to continue our journey."

card.name: Yoritomo Gazuke
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Thunder • Shugenja
Battle: Ranged 4 Attack.
card.flavor: "My speech is crude, my bearing common, and my schooling lacking. I do not know of the glorious histories of the empire, nor can I speak with eloquence of its culture. But the Thunder Dragon has spoken to me, and that alone makes me your peer."

card.name: Yoritomo Kakeko
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Unique
Battle: Bow a target enemy card without attachments.
card.flavor: "Oppose me? You will be fortunate if you live long enough to amuse me. I shall descend upon you like the storm itself, and you shall find no solace, harbor, or respite from my wrath."

card.name: Kitsu Marimi
card.text:
Lion Clan • Water • Shugenja • Unique
Limited: Create a 2F/2C/3PH Lion Clan • Samurai • Ancestor • Spirit Personality. Remove it from the game after your next turn begins.
card.flavor: "I am a Lion. My ancestors lend me their strength. You cannot hope to stand against a thousand years of honorable service to the Empire."

card.name: Akodo Tetsuru
card.text: Lion Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Tactician
card.flavor: "Lord Shigetoshi has commanded that the province be captured by nightfall. Be sure to let the governor escape, so that his clansmen can hear the folly of opposing the Lion."

card.name: Tamori Ochimo
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Earth • Monk • Shugenja • Alchemist • Unique
Battle: You may discard a card with an element keyword: Bow a target enemy card without attachments. If you discarded a card, destroy the enemy card.
card.flavor: "I speak for the Earth. The Earth grows weary of being trod upon."

card.name: Mirumoto Miyami
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Kensai
Battle: Bow Miyami or one of her Weapons: Straighten your target unit.
card.flavor: Mirumoto taught that kenjutsi was for killing. His descendents remember his lessons. Every parry, every feint, every strike builds towards victory.

card.name: Kakita Furegami
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Duelist
Iaijutsu Battle: Target an enemy Personality with lower Chi. Set his Force to 0. If Furegami has won a duel this turn, bow the enemy Personality.
card.flavor: "One man, one sword, one strike. All other styles are false."

card.name: Asahina Okimoto
card.text:
Crane Clan • Air • Courtier • Shugenja • Unique
Political Reaction: After the resolution of a Political action you took: Gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "Samurai across the Empire are moved to great deeds by poems and tales. Why would the kami be any different?"

card.name: Kuni Iyedo
card.text:
Crab Clan • Earth • Shugenja • Commander
Battle: Attach a target Follower in your hand to your target Personality in Iyedo's army.
card.flavor: "I will keep you pure, and you will keep them safe. We are the Crab, and we shall endure the trials to come."

card.name: Hida Mochitoko
card.text:
Crab Clan • Jade • Samurai • Hero • Unique
Battle: If Mochitoko is the only Personality in his army: Bow a target card in an enemy unit.
card.flavor: "I am not impressed by your pretty words or by the failures you call soldiers at your side. I will not relent until you are broken at my feet."

card.name: Strategic Keep
card.text:
Castle
Bow this card: Produce 4 Gold.
Your provinces have +1 strength.
card.flavor: "Castles should please the senses, protect their occupants, and guard valuable resources. Too many forsake the first for the second and third." - Kakita Omori

card.name: Exotic Goods
card.text:
Artisan • Merchant • Retainer
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Open: Choose your performing Artisan Personality: Target another player's unbowed Personality. His controller may bow him. If he did not bow, gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "Curiosoties and trinkets are sought after throughout the empire. They can also be very difficult to procure."

card.name: A Life for a Soul
card.text: Starting with you, each player may choose a dead Personality he owns and bring him into play, ignoring costs and Honor Requirement. Permanently give each Personality this brought into play Undead and Shadowlands, and his controller loses 3 Honor.
card.flavor: "Death is not eternal." - Kuni Yori

card.name: Celestial Disfavor
card.text: Until the game ends, after each time an attack is declared, each player in turn order from the Attacker chooses and bows one of his unbowed Personalities with his Clan alignment and a base Gold Cost of 6 or less.
card.flavor: "The Elemental Dragons rarely interfere in the affairs of mortals. When they do, the empire trembles."

card.name: Tanuki Tricks
card.text: Battle: Target a Personality whose Chi plus number of attachments is 3 or lower. Bow him or move him home.
card.flavor: "Not all mischief is malevolent." - Kincho the Sixth

card.name: Daigotsu Chaozhu - exp2
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai • Cavalry • Tactician • Kolat • Paragon • Experienced 2 Moto Chaozhu • Unique
After Chaozhu enters play: Lose 5 Honor.
Battle: Discard a Dark Virtue card: Bow a target enemy Personality. Destroy him if he has no attachments.
card.flavor: "The Unicorn trusted us. Merely one more of my brother's mistakes."

card.name: Iron Kabuto
card.text: Negate all current and new Force penalties on this Personality.
card.flavor: "Fresh from the forge. Take them. Perhaps they can protect even dolts such as you simpletons. Now find Noritoshi!" - Shosuro Jimen

card.name: Kataoko
card.text:
Ronin • Ninja
Kataoko has +2F while in an army with another Ninja.
card.flavor: "Even the most just and noble of organizations requires the skills of a born killer from time to time. I need not consider her a friend to benefit from her talents." - The journals of Utagawa

card.name: Torakichi
card.text:
Ronin • Scout
Torakichi has +2F while in an army with a Naval Personality.
card.flavor: "He moves through the forest like a shadow. With his assistance, the Legion's ability to gather intelligence has increased tenfold." - The journals of Utagawa

card.name: Nakadai
card.text:
Ronin • Fire • Monk
Reaction: After Nakadai enters play: Give her four +1F Fire tokens.
card.flavor: "She practices a style she calls Fire of the World's Birth. I asked her once about the Togashi, but she laughed and called them neophytes." - The journals of Utagawa

card.name: Festival of Founding
card.text: Have a happy fifteenth anniversary. Draw a card.
card.flavor: Regardless of other circumstances, during the Festival of Founding, all citizens of the Emerald Empire give thanks and celebrate the foundation of Rokugan, remembering the Kami and their valor.

card.name: Blue Tanuki Serving Girl
card.text:
Serving Girl of the Blue Tanuki
Limited: Pay 2 Gold: Give a target Personality a +1F Sake token.
Limited: Target a Personality. He has had too much to drink. Transfer a Sake token from him to another target Personality.
card.flavor: "This is one of the Lord Kincho's favorite blends, sama. I am certain you will enjoy it."

card.name: Heartlands
card.text:
Farm • Singular
Limited: Pay 3 Gold: Create a 1F/1C/1PH Personality with your Clan alignment.
card.flavor: Many of the greatest tales are of Champions and their families, but just as many great heroes arise from obscurity in the rural provinces, destiny cannot be easily predicted.

card.name: Iaijutsu Student
card.text:
This card has +1F while attached to a Duelist.
Reaction: After this Personality wins a duel: Give him +2F or gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "I do not know where Lord Noritoshi has gone. If you love me as you say, Muhito, you will not ask this question again, not even for the Emerald Champion." - Kakita Korihime

card.name: Freedom of the Air
card.text:
Air
Open: If it is your turn or if this Shugenja is Air: Straighten this Shugenja.
card.flavor: "Nothing living remains within this village. The kami shall bear me away for purification, but not before I have purified this place. I weep for destruction, but it is necessary for life."

card.name: Grip of the Earth
card.text:
Earth
Battle: Destroy this card: Bow a target enemy card. Negate its straightening if this Shugenja is Earth.
card.flavor: "What blood sorcery has created, the earth can consume. Their contagion will pose no threat when imprisoned far beneath the Earth." - Isawa Emori

card.name: Drunken Nostalgia
card.text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Personality: Bow a target enemy Personality with fewer Sake tokens than your Personality.
card.flavor: "My mother... my mother was a good woman! She was a good woman and she... wait... wait, no, she died. My aunt! Now she was... wait, no, that's not right. No, I want to talk about my father!"

card.name: Paneki's Disgrace
card.text:
Shadowlands • Undead • Samurai • Tactician • Plague • Experienced 6 Bayushi Paneki • Unique
After Paneki's Disgrace enters play: Lose 4 Honor.
Open: If Paneki's Disgrace is dead: Bring him into play.
Battle: You may discard a card from the current battlefield's province. Bow a target enemy card. Destroy it if it has no attachments, you discarded a card, and the enemy card's Gold Cost is lower than the discarded card's Gold Cost.

card.name: Bishamon's Guidance
card.text:
Fortune • Unique
After this card enters play: Choose your Personality in play. He has +2F while this card remains in play.
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Personality and discard this card: Destroy a target enemy card without attachments and with lower Force than your Personality.

card.name: Osano Wo's Guidance
card.text:
Fortune • Fire • Thunder • Unique
After this card enters play: Choose your Personality in play. While this card remains in play, he has +4F while defending.
Battle: Discard this card: Ranged 6 Attack.
card.flavor: "Our ancestors look down upon us this day, and the Fortunes themselves. Will they be proud of what they see? Or turn away in shame? I know the answer, brothers!" - Hida Benjiro

card.name: Untouchable Escort
card.text: Choose one of your units in play. Negate all bowing and movement of cards in that unit from other players' actions this turn.
card.flavor: Tensions rose between the Clans as each struggled to defeat all the troubles that suddenly threatened all parts of the empire. Only Imperial papers now allowed safe, untroubled passage over clan borders.

card.name: Crossing the Forbidden Sea
card.text: Until your next turn begins, units with a total Gold Cost of 6 or less may not be assigned to battlefields.
card.flavor: Yoritomo Buntaro's voice dropped to an awed whisper. "The shores of the Ivory Kingdoms are within sight, my lord."

card.name: Fortune Favors the Bold
card.text: Until your next turn begins, you have the ability, "Reaction: When another player's Battle action would target one of your cards in a unit at the current battlefield: Choose another of your cards in a unit at the current battlefield. The action targets that card instead, if legal."
card.flavor: "I will stop you here, zombies," Matsu Kita shouted. Her eyes caught a familiar figure standing at the head of the horde. She paled but did not falter.

card.name: Festival of Coronation
card.text: If you control the Imperial Favor, draw a card. Otherwise, take the Imperial Favor.
card.flavor: "As the second year of the Divine Empress Iweko I begins, the Empire is assaulted by forces beyond anything we have ever witnessed. Despite the pain, despite the suffering, the faith of our people in the Empress does not waver, for she is of the Heavens." - Miya Shoin, Imperial Herald

card.name: The God-Beast Unleashed
card.text: Choose one of your Personalities in play. Discard the top card of your Fate deck. Give your Personality a bonus to his Force, Chi, or Personal Honor equal to the discarded card's Focus Value.
card.flavor: "The samurai of this wretched Empire have offended the goddess," the rakshasa hissed. "Unleash the god-beast, and let them understand the enormity of her wrath."

card.name: Wooden Barricade
card.text:
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Open: Even if this card is bowed, choose your two performing Personalities: Transfer a target attachment on one of them to the other. If the attachment transferred, straighten it.
card.flavor: The Scorpion prepared for the invasion with defenses along their southern border. They waited, and hoped it would be enough to stem the tide.

card.name: Hidden Entrance
card.text:
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Battle: Bow this card and destroy your performing unbowed defending Personality: Destroy a target enemy unit with total Force less than or equal to your Personality's Force plus Personal Honor.
card.flavor: There are always means for a besieged army to strike at its foes, although the men who do so usually die for their heroism.

card.name: Dockside Market
card.text:
Market
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold, plus 1 Gold if you control one or more Ports, plus 1 Gold if you control one or more other Markets.
card.flavor: "What fresh goods!" she proclaimed loudly and picked up an exotic fruit. "I must have this for my husband's household."

card.name: Fertile Plains
card.text:
Farm
After this card enters play: Choose zero to two bowed Gold-producing Holdings. While this card remains in play, each of those Holdings produces one additional Gold when it bows to produce Gold.

card.name: Hida Shikoujin
card.text:
Crab Clan • Berserker • Ender of Dreams
Enters play paying 1 less Gold if any other player controls 4 or more Personalities.
Battle: Bow Shikoujin: Destroy a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with equal or lower Force.
card.flavor: "The god-beast of Kali-ma comes. We will fight and die, but its heart's blood will stain the earth."

card.name: Kaiu Futaro
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Commander
Battle: Bow your performing Follower: Ranged Attack with strength equal to the Follower's Force plus 1.
card.flavor: "Never have the Crab and Scorpion had common ground. I will defend their lands to the death, if only to preserve that tradition."

card.name: Hida Maruken
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Hero
Battle: Target an enemy card. If Maruken is the only Personality in his army, or the enemy card has no attachments and lower Force, bow it.
card.flavor: "He has never lost ground to the Destroyers. When he is on the front line, he only stops killing them when he is rotated off to rest." - Hida Benjiro

card.name: Hida Benjiro - exp2
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Commander • Hero • Rikugunshokan • Experienced 2 • Loyal • Unique
Battle: Benjiro challenges a target enemy Personality. Both Personalities use their Force as their duel stat. Destroy the duel's loser.
card.flavor: "I awake with the garbled words of an ogre in my ear, Kiyoshi. And I have strange dreams that I think may lead to the demon's defeat. What does it all mean?"

card.name: Hiruma Ikuya
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Scout
Battle: If a Recon action has targeted this battlefield's province this turn: Draw a card. Discard a card.
card.flavor: "The Destroyers have not turned back, but there are tens of thousands of them between us and the Empire. Shiro Hiruma remains cut off, my lord."

card.name: Hiruma Todori - exp3
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Commander • Daimyo • Hero • Scout • Experienced 3 • Loyal • Unique
Battle: Move your target Personality to Todori's battlefield. If he moved and you are the Defender, straighten him.
card.flavor: "For a year, our brothers have been trapped behind enemy lines while the Destroyers push forward. No longer. I will either free them, or know their fate."

card.name: Kuni Shikehime
card.text:
Crab Clan • Shugenja • Witch Hunter
Shikehime has +3F while opposed by one or more Shadowlands Personalities.
card.flavor: "Your methods of gaining information are interesting, friend Bayushi," she said with a smile. "If you will allow me, I think you may find my methods equally of interest."

card.name: Daidoji Arima
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Iron Crane • Scout
Arima has +2F while defending.
Battle: Ranged 3 Attack.
card.flavor: "Akagi-sensei taught me everything he knew, and then he told me 'I know nothing. Go and find your own way.' This beast has been the death of hundreds, but it shall be another step on the path for me."

card.name: Daidoji Yaichiro - exp
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Iron Crane • Scout • Experienced • Unique
After Yaichiro enters play: Create a 2F Follower and attach it to him.
Battle: Even if Yaichiro is bowed, if any enemy units are at the current battlefield: Move Yaichiro there. Straighten his unit if he moved.
card.flavor: "I saw my death and lived. Now I fear nothing."

card.name: Doji Shikishi
card.text:
Crane Clan • Courtier • Artisan
You may take the rulebook Battle action that has a cost of discarding the Imperial Favor even if you control no units at the current battlefield.
Political Open: Bow Shikishi: Take the Imperial Favor. You may not use your Stronghold's abilities this turn.

card.name: Doji Kusari
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Commander • Paragon • Unique
Enters play paying 1 less Gold if you are a Lion Clan player.
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Personality: Ranged Attack with strength equal to his Personal Honor.
card.flavor: "Battle holds no uncertainties. If I live, I will see my family again. If I die, I will see her again."

card.name: Doji Tajihi
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Magistrate
Dishonorable Personalities opposing Tajihi have -2F.
card.flavor: "Shosuro-san, your story bores me. Given the state of your clan's lands, I should think you have better things to do that stir up trouble in my province. Go home and find some way to be of use to your lord."

card.name: Doji Umakai
card.text:
Crane Clan • Courtier
Political Open: Discard the Imperial Favor and bow Umakai: Bow a target Personality. If his base Gold Cost is 0, destroy him. If his unit's total Gold Cost is lower than Umakai's Gold Cost, take the Imperial Favor.
card.flavor: "The gossip about Beniha and her Yojimbo is very amusing, but remember that the powerful have better things to do than gossip."

card.name: Kakita Mimaro
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Duelist
Iaijutsu Reaction: After Mimaro wins a duel: Bow a target Personality or Follower with 4 or lower Force at Mimaro's battlefield.
card.flavor: "I do not understand all the things I have heard about my lord and his enemy. That does not matter. I am ready to carry out his commands, whatever they may be."

card.name: Tamori Kuroko
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Earth • Shugenja • Alchemist • Artisan
Limited: Either bow Kuroko, pay 3 Gold, or discard a card: Create a +2F/+1C Earth • Weapon Item and attach it to your target Personality.
card.flavor: "Not all of us can afford to be consumed by wrath. If we do, the way shall consume our mountains altogether."

card.name: Mirumoto Kalen
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Topaz Champion
Battle: Ranged 4 Attack.
card.flavor: "His training uder the sensei Fusami has transformed him from a brash young upstart to a calculating, efficient warrior. Already the Yobanjin fear his name." - Mirumoto Kenzo

card.name: Kitsuki Nakai
card.text: Dragon Clan • Samurai • Duelist • Magistrate
card.flavor: "The Empress's life is in danger, and I am forced to admit that I am not surprised that we did not predict the attack. After all, as the Tao says, 'A stray dog sees only what it chases.'"

card.name: Mirumoto Asakazu
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Duelist
Iaijutsu Reaction: After you form a focus pool for a duel involving Asakazu: Put a card from it into your hand. You may then put a card from your hand into your focus pool.
card.flavor: Asakazu fell back into his stance, a hand on the hilt of both his blades. "Hojatsu's Legacy Style, Sensei Chojiro."

card.name: Mirumoto Tobushi
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Kensai
Reaction: After Tobushi enters play: Create one or two +2F/+1C Weapon Items and attach them to him.
card.flavor: In the midst of death, there was new life; as Kenzo's forces fought desperately to lead the Army of Fire away from Jousei Tengen, our Lady gave birth to her heir in a vault deep inside the fortress.

card.name: Mirumoto Kenzo - exp2
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Duelist • Kensai • Experienced 2 • Unique • Redeemer
After you form a focus pool in a duel involving Kenzo: You may put one additional card from the top of your Fate deck into your focus pool.
Iaijutsu Battle: Bow a target enemy Personality: Give Kenzo a +1F token.
card.flavor: His father's example taught him the cost of Ambition.

card.name: Togashi Furai
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Fire • Monk • Tattooed
Furai has +1C while he has any Fire tokens.
Battle: Ranged 2 Attack, with +2 strength if Furai has any Fire tokens.
card.flavor: "Do not think me a mere nursemaid. The fires of compassion burn within me, and I will defend our clan to the death!"

card.name: Akodo Areru
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Commander • Imperial • Imperial Legion
Battle: Bow your performing Follower: Ranged Attack with strength equal to its Force, and +2 strength if you are attacking.
card.flavor: "His mother married a Scorpion, and Areru was fostered back to her clan. His parentage is suspect, but his honor is above reproach." - Moto Jin-sahn

card.name: Ikoma Toruken
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Magistrate
Battle: Bow or straighten a target Personality with lower Personal Honor than Toruken's Chi.
card.flavor: "The Wardens enforce the law and our borders, maintaining communication and security in times of war. Without them, the duties of the Right Hand would be vastly more difficult." - Matsu Kenji

card.name: Akodo Kusamoto
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Tactician • Justicar
Reaction: After Kusamoto enters play from a province: Put a target non-Unique Battle Strategy from your discard pile into your hand.
card.flavor: "He is cunning where his brother is reckless, bold where his brother is brash. Only the Fortunes could help any who face the two of them together." - Akodo Seiichi

card.name: Ikoma Hagio - exp
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Tactician • Commander • Daimyo • Experienced • Loyal • Unique
Other attacking Personalities in Hagio's army have +1F.
Battle: Even if Hagio is not at the current battlefield, if any enemy units are there: Move your target unit there. Straighten it if it moved.
card.flavor: "The Lion are wounded, but defeated? Never."

card.name: Matsu Otsuko
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Deathseeker
Reaction: After Otsuko or another Deathseeker Personality in her army is destroyed: Reduce the Force of a target Personality or Follower in the current enemy army to 0. Gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "This war has dwindled the ranks of the Deathseekers. Those few who remain have their shame compounded by their survival. They find no peace in life." - Akodo Shigetoshi

card.name: Matsu Misuka
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Hero
Battle: Ranged 2 Attack.
card.flavor: "The demons push, and we fall back. They unleash horrors beyond imagining, and we fall back. They think that we shall break, but we are unbreakable! When we have taken their full measure, then finally they will shatter at our strike!"

card.name: Matsu Kinihara
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Paragon
Battle: Bow a target enemy Personality with lower Personal Honor. You may show a Bushido Virtue from your hand. If you did, you may target and destroy an attachment in that Personality's unit.
card.flavor: "Come, then, gaijin. Come and taste my steel."

card.name: Yoritomo Kaemon
card.text: Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Kabuki Master
card.flavor: "We went to the Ivory Kingdoms to strengthen ties and find allies, and instead found a land already visited by the Destroyers. Were we seeing our own future?"

card.name: Yoritomo Rai
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Commander
Reaction: After Rai enters play: Attach a target Follower from your hand or discard pile to Rai, paying 4 less Gold.
card.flavor: "What was the greater shock? Finding the land in ruins, or that the man who still stood was wielding familiar kama?"

card.name: Moshi Yuriko
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Thunder • Shugenja • Naval
Battle: Bow a target enemy card without attachments.
card.flavor: "Share your inner tranquility with the sea, and the sea shall be calmed."

card.name: Tsuruchi Nobumoto - exp2
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Naval • Daimyo • Experienced 2 • Loyal • Unique
Battle: Bow Nobumoto: Ranged 7 Attack. You may move Nobumoto home.
card.flavor: "The Scorpion deserve their pleas to go unanswered. Only duty brings is to their aid."

card.name: Tsuruchi Chiko
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Scout
Battle: Bow Chiko: Ranged 4 Attack.
Battle: If a Recon action has targeted the current battlefield's province this turn: Ranged 4 Attack.
card.flavor: "If these creatures wish to fight us in our own forests, they will find only their deaths."

card.name: Tsuruchi Shisuken - exp
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Commander • Experienced • Unique
Battle: Ranged 4 Attack.
Battle: Straighten your target Personality or Follower. That card may use each of its base Ranged Attack abilities a second time this turn.
card.flavor: "The gaijin claims the blood of Aramasu. It has the ring of truth."

card.name: Yoritomo Manzo
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Extorionist • Magistrate
Battle: Bow or straighten a target card with lower Gold Cost than Manzo in a unit.
card.flavor: "Enforce the laws of the land or benefit myself? I do not see that these are mutually exclusive."

card.name: Asako Ayako
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Air • Shugenja • Inquisitor • Magistrate
Battle: Give -4F to a target enemy Personality with lower Personal Honor than Ayako's Chi. If the Personality's Force is now 0, gain 2 Honor and you may move Ayako home.
card.flavor: "Lady Kimi was handpicked as the successor to Lord Ningen. The council is complete once more."

card.name: Isawa Takahiro
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Earth • Shugenja
Battle: Bow one to three target enemy units with a combined Gold Cost less than or equal to Takahiro's unit's Gold Cost. Destroy any of those targeted units that have a total base Gold Cost of 0.
card.flavor: "Run, barbarian, and tell your dark master to send more burning men."

card.name: Isawa Toshio
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Air • Shugenja
Open: Transer your target Spell to your target Shugenja.
card.flavor: "We should be defending our lands from the Army of Fire, Goto, not ferrying messages to the Lion. Where is the glory in this?"

card.name: Isawa Shioki
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Fire • Water • Shugenja • Cavalry • Alchemist
Shioki has +1F for each Spell in her unit.
Battle: Bow Shioki or one of her Spells: Ranged 4 Attack.
card.flavor: "The Agasha may have pioneered alchemical magic, but it will be the Isawa who ultimately master it."

card.name: Shiba Morihiko - exp
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Samurai • Duelist • Yojimbo • Experienced • Unique
Reaction: After engaging at Morihiko's battlefield, bow Morihiko unless you control a Shugenja: The Attacker has the first opportunity to take a Battle action or pass during this battle.
card.flavor: "Place Mizuhiko under my protection, my Lords. I understand him; we share the same loss."

card.name: Shiba Goto
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Samurai • Duelist • Yojimbo
Iaijutsu Battle: Bow a target enemy card without attachments.
card.flavor: As the Destroyer forces approached, Goto stepped in front of his change. "Here's your chance for glory, eh, Toshio? Is this glorious enough for you now?"

card.name: Bayushi Jutsushi - exp
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Courtier • Imperial • Magistrate • Yojimbo • Experienced • Loyal • Unique
Limited: Dishonor a target Personality.
Battle: Bow Jutsushi: Destroy a target non-Unique dishonorable Personality.
card.flavor: "From simple magistrate to the hatamoto of Kyuden Bayushi, and now to an Imperial Yojimbo. He is one to watch." - Shosuro Toson

card.name: Bayushi Shigehiro
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Kensai • Bitter Lies
Battle: Show the top card of your Fate deck: Give a target enemy Personality or Follower a Force penalty equal to the shown card's Focus Value. If the shown card is a Weapon, you may attach it to Shigehiro, paying 4 less Gold.
card.flavor: "The Destroyers push forward into our lands. We must stop them here, lest they threaten the Imperial City."

card.name: Bayushi Miyako - exp2
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Duelist • Kensai • Experienced 2 Toturi Miyako • Loyal • Unique
Before Focus Effects resolve in a duel involving Miyako: Give the last card you focused in that duel a Focus Value bonus equal to its base Focus Value.
Iaijutsu Battle: Miyako challenges a target enemy Personality. Destroy the duel's loser.
card.flavor: "I will not let my clan fail in these troubling times."

card.name: Bayushi Himaru
card.text: Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Tactician
card.flavor: The Ghul Lord was finally defeated by the combined might of Rokugan. Its effects would be forever remembered by those who survived its wrath. Its zombie minions still roamed the land, weakened by the lack of powerful leadership yet ever threatening. And the Scorpion continued to mourn the death of Ryoko Owari.

card.name: Shosuro Ritsuko
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Ninja • Actor
Open: Remove Ritsuko from the game: She dons a new disguise. Bring your target dead non-Unique Scorpion Clan Personality into play, ignoring costs.
card.flavor: "Some call her the winter phantom, and surely she has killed as many as the winter itself." - Shosuro Toson

card.name: Bayushi Darisu
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Courtier • Samurai • Magistrate • Sycophant
Political Reaction: After Darisu enters play: Dishonor a target Personality.
card.flavor: "Many people dismiss him for a lickspittle. They do not notice his sly, insinuating hints that direct the flow of conversation." - Shosuro Jimen

card.name: Daigotsu Hotako - exp2
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai • Naval • Obsidian Champion • Paragon • Experienced 2 Yoritomo Hotako • Unique
After Hotako enters play: Lose 8 Honor.
Fear Battle: Reduce a target enemy Personality's or Follower's Force to 0. It is paralyzed with fear. It may not perform actions.
card.flavor: "I scarcely remember what I was before."

card.name: Daigotsu Akihime
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai • Paragon • Dark Beauty
After Akihime enters play: Lose 3 Honor.
Akihime has +1F for each Dark Virtue in your Fate discard pile.
card.flavor: "I pray to the Fortunes as I do to Fu Leng, and my prayers are often answered. Who shall dare say I am not worthy?"

card.name: Daigotsu Shaiko - exp
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Fire • Shugenja • Tattooed • Undead • Experienced Tamori Shaiko • Unique
After Shaiko enters play: Lose 6 Honor.
Maho Battle: Destroy your performing unbowed Undead card: Destroy a target enemy card without attachments.
card.flavor: "I remember my life, but feel nothing for it. I was born anew in death, and in death I shall live."

card.name: Bakunai
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Goblin • Commander
After Bakunai enters play: Lose 4 Honor.
Fear Battle: Bow a target enemy Personality with less Force than the number of Goblins in Bakunai's army.
card.flavor: "A brute, even for a goblin, and more cunning by far than most. His brand of evil is almost... human." - Chuda Mishime

card.name: Goju Katsume
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shugenja • Ninja
Maho Battle: Bow Katsume: Ranged 4 Attack. If the Ranged Attack targeted a Personality, you may compare it against his Chi instead of Force.
card.flavor: "Death comes silently and takes those whose time has come. Am I not death, then?"

card.name: Shinran
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Monk • Kensai
After Shinran enters play: Lose 6 Honor.
Battle/Open: Attach a target Weapon to Shinran from your hand or discard pile, paying 4 less Gold if Shinran is defending.
card.flavor: "One a Dragon blade, the other a Crane. I shall use them far better than their former masters."

card.name: Ugaro
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Ogre • Undead
After Ugaro enters play: Lose 6 Honor.
Battle: Target an enemy Follower or Personality without attachments. Ugaro crushes its legs. Bow the targeted card. Negate its straightening and its unit's movement this turn.
card.flavor: "Born of plague, unnatural in every regard." - Kayomasa

card.name: Iuchi Jadaran
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Water • Shugenja • Cavalry • Commander
Battle: Move your target Personality to Jadaran's battlefield.
card.flavor: "I do not know how to fight the Destroyers, my lord, but an Army of Fire? Oh yes, I know very well how to deal with fire."

card.name: Moto Shanyu
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • White Guard
Battle: If you control any Cavalry units at the current battlefield: Move Shanyu there. If he moved, Ranged 4 Attack.
card.flavor: "My grandfather was a storyteller, and told many tales of rakshasa, lord Tsusung-sama. How can I help you?"

card.name: Moto Munoru
card.text: Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Tactician
card.flavor: "When I was a child, I remember my grandfather's stories of peace, before the Moto tribe returned. He claimed those times where dull, and drove a warrior mad with boredom. One day I hope to experience such a thing myself."

card.name: Shinjo Jalair
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Scout
Reaction: After the resolution of a Battle action that brought one of your Personalities into play at the current battlefield, if Jalair is there: You may take an additional Battle action.
card.flavor: "War is the enemy of freedom. I will destroy our enemies, if for no other reason than that the plains are free once more."

card.name: Shinjo Dun - exp
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Tactician • Experienced • Unique
Negate Dun's Force bonuses from Tactical actions.
Reaction: After the resolution of a Tactical action that Dun performed: Draw a card.
card.flavor: He studied under the Akodo masters at their famed War College, but he will never forget the brutality and lightning quick strikes of his Unicorn heritage.

card.name: Utaku Jin-lao
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Battle Maiden
Reaction: After the resolution of an action that gave a Personality opposing Jin-lao a Force penalty, if the Personality's Force is now 0: Target the Personality. He may not perform actions.
card.flavor: "The beast the Destroyers unleashed... such a thing cannot be real!"

card.name: Utaku Fujiko - exp
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Commander • Battle Maiden • Experienced • Unique
Before you gain Honor from Battle Resolution, if Fujiko is in the winning army: Increase your Honor gain for each card destroyed from resolution by 1.
Battle: Reduce the Force of a target enemy Personality or Follower to 0. Draw a card.
card.flavor: "Forward, my sisters! Forward... to war!"

card.name: Koji
card.text:
Ronin • Samurai
You may not assign this unit to, or move Koji to, a battlefield, unless there are at least 2 different Clan alignments among Personalities already in your army there or currently assigning there.
card.flavor: "One commander sees you as expendable. If there are two, they are too busy posturing to think of you at all."

card.name: Hozumi
card.text:
Ronin • Samurai • Cavalry • Unique
Battle: Bow Hozumi or one of your Rings: Ranged 4 Attack.

card.name: Ichiro Kaagi
card.text:
Badger Clan • Samurai • Brute
Battle: Bow a target enemy Personality or Follower with lower Force.
card.flavor: "Strength of arms can't overcome the flame's endless hunger!" the fiery barbarian screamed. The Badger cracked his fingers and replied, "Forgive me if I try."

card.name: Otomo Seimi
card.text:
Courtier • Imperial • Unique
Political Limited: Discard the Imperial Favor: Gain 2 Honor.
Political Limited: Discard the Imperial Favor: Another player loses 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "Help your earthly suffering? Why would I care about worldly concerns. My concern is the state of the Heavens, and the Imperial Court as their representatives!"

card.name: Rus'tik'tik
card.text:
Nonhuman • Ratling • One Tribe • Rememberer
Battle: Rus'tik'tik heralds the exploits of heroes. Give all non-Shadowlands Nonhuman cards at the current battlefield +1F.
card.flavor: It was not enough to remember his people. He also meant for the world to remember them as well.

card.name: Hidden Valley
card.text:
Singular
Your Ninja Personalities have +1F while opposed.
Reaction: After a Ranged Attack targets your Ninja: Give the Ranged Attack -2 strength.
card.flavor: All of the Scorpion's defenses were sorely tested.

card.name: Mountainous Region
card.text:
Mountain
If you are the Defender, when choosing the battlefield at which to fight the next battle: You choose instead of the Attacker.
Personalities will not move to this province's battlefield.
Your defending Personalities have +1F while at this province's battlefield.

card.name: Takaikabe Mura
card.text:
Singular
Limited: Create a 0F Follower and attach it to your target Kensai Personality.
card.flavor: The Dragon had endured terrible hardships, but their resolve only hardened.

card.name: Bitter Lies Student
card.text:
Bitter Lies
Enters play paying 1 less Gold if you are a Scorpion Clan player.
Battle/Open: Remove this card from the game: Search your discard pile, then Fate deck, for a non-Unique Weapon. You may attach it to your target Personality.

card.name: Moto Hunters
card.text:
Cavalry
Battle: Draw a card. You may target and bow an enemy Infantry Personality or Follower.
card.flavor: Once they rode in order to hunt food for their people. They still hunt, but their purpose is not so benign.

card.name: Elemental Disciple
card.text:
Void
This card has +1F while you control a Ring.
Battle: Look at the top 4 cards of your Fate deck. Put them back in any order. You may take an additional Battle action.
card.flavor: "Serenity in the face of adversity is a skill that must be learned."

card.name: Hiroshi's Legion
card.text:
Unique
Will only attach to a Tactician.
Battle/Open: If this card is in your hand or discard pile: Attach it to your target Personality.
card.flavor: Can even the greatest tactician stand against unending foes?

card.name: Hiruma House Guard - exp
card.text:
Experienced • Unique
Will only attach to a Crab Clan personality.
Reaction: After another player's Battle action targets a card in this unit: Choose whether to negate the bowing or the movement of any cards in this unit from the action's effects.
card.flavor: They live, and so they fight.

card.name: Hired Thugs
card.text:
Focus Effect: Choose a number from 0 to 3, and pay that much Gold: Increase this card's Focus Value by the number chosen.
Battle: Choose a number from 1 to 3, and pay that much Gold: Give this card a Force bonus equal to the number chosen.
card.flavor: Kei sneered. "Just pay them and send them to the front. See if they live to enjoy their spoils."

card.name: Night Watchers
card.text:
Ninja
Reaction: After another player's Battle action targets your Ninja Personality, if this card is in your hand: Attach it to the Personality. If he is no longer a legal target for the action, the action's costs are ignored and its effects do not happen.
card.flavor: "Be as the night, ever hidden, ever silent."

card.name: Undying Warriors
card.text:
Shadowlands • Undead
After this card enters play: Lose 4 Honor.
Fear Battle: Destroy a target enemy card without attachments.
Limited: If this card is in your discard pile: Attach it to your target Personality.
card.flavor: "The masks protect you, not them." - Michio

card.name: Stripped Armor
card.text:
Armor
Ranged Attacks targeting cards in this unit have -2 strength.
card.flavor: "Protection is important, of course, but mobility is even more important. Would you prefer to survive being hit, or avoid being hit at all?" - Hiruma Etsuro

card.name: Rekai's Yumi
card.text:
Weapon • Unique
Battle: If any enemy units are at the current battlefield, bow this card: Move this Personality there. If he moved, Ranged 4 Attack.
card.flavor: "My mother wielded many weapons. They all have evil within them, but none more so than her yumi. It cries out to be quenched with the blood of honorable samurai." - Daidoji Kikaze

card.name: Talisman of Jigoku
card.text:
Unique
Attaches to a Crab Clan Personality paying 1 less Gold.
Actions performed by another player's Shadowlands Personality may not target this Personality.
card.flavor: "Taru is gone, but his gift remains. We must find it and use it against them." - Kuni Kiyoshi

card.name: Ancient Tome
card.text: Limited: Bow your Stronghold: Draw a card.
card.flavor: "It seems impossible to believe," Barei said animatedly, "but I believe this creature, this so-called 'god-beast' is in fact the broken form of some gaijin deity that Kali-Ma destroyed. What power, to slay a god!"

card.name: Tsuruchi's Legacy
card.text:
Weapon • Unique
Ranged Attacks from other cards in this unit have +1 strength.
Battle: Bow this card: Ranged 4 Attack.
