card.flavor: "Guide my hand, Grandfather Wasp, and let me purge the Empress's enemies from the Empire." - Tsuruchi Nobumoto

card.name: Yagimaki's Fist
card.text:
Weapon • Unique
Battle: Destroy a target enemy card with lower Gold Cost than this card and no attachments.
card.flavor: "I know not which has greater punch, this, or the sake Yagimaki brews. I have used the latter to strip the lacquer from armor." - Hida Fubatsu

card.name: Whirlwind
card.text:
Air
Open: Bow this Shugneja and destroy this card: Target a Personality, who must have equal or lower Chi than this Shugenja unless this Shugenja is Air. The Personality's unit may not be assigned to attack this turn.
card.flavor: "Allow me to show you what a 'gentle breeze' can do..."

card.name: One with the World
card.text:
This Shugenja has +1F for each Ring you control.
Limited: Bow this card: Put one of your Rings from your hand into play, from play into your hand, or from your discard pile into your hand.
card.flavor: "We will emerge from this tumult victorious. Our enemies cannot win because they are only of one world." - Seppun Kiharu

card.name: Flood the Earth
card.text:
Thunder
Will only attach to a Thunder Shugenja.
Battle: Destroy this card and bow this Shugenja: Create a Terrain Strategy with the ability "Battle: Non-Naval Personalities at this battlefield bow after the resolution of each action they perform," and take an additional Battle action to play it (if legal).

card.name: The Unmaking
card.text:
Void
Battle: If this Shugenja is unbowed, bow him unless he is Void and destroy this card: Put a target enemy card without attachments on the bottom of its owner's appropriate deck.
card.flavor: "Return to the elements," Kimi sang. "Find greater purpose in a new existence."

card.name: Flow of the Water
card.text:
Water
While this Shugenja is Water, he has Cavalry and Naval.
card.flavor: "If the reports are correct, the Dragon fortress will be overrun within a day. We should cut our losses and prepare a counterattack," the Shiba said, but Yutako shook her head. "We will arrive in time. After all, the Dark Oracles have a history of underestimating the speed of the Water tensai."

card.name: Preparing the Bodies
card.text:
Maho
Open: Bow this Shugenja: Straighten one or two target Undead cards.
card.flavor: "If they don't bite, they won't catch the plague!" the Chuda cackled.

card.name: Fires of the Heart
card.text:
Fire
Battle: Even if this unit is not at the current battlefield, choose your unbowed performing Samurai there, bow this Shugenja, and destroy this card: Ranged Attack with strength equal to the Samurai's Force, +1 strength if this Shugenja is Fire.
card.flavor: "The fire wielded by our enemies is nothing compared to the fire of courage in a samurai's heart."

card.name: Hands of Stone
card.text:
Earth
Attaches to an Earth Shugenja paying 1 less Gold.
Open: Target a province and bow this Shugenja: Until this turn ends, all players must choose that province's battlefield whenever they assign or move units after Infantry Maneuvers, if it is a legal choice. (If two of these effects apply to different provinces, each causes the other to fail.)

card.name: Soldiers of Clay
card.text:
Earth
Attaches to an Earth Shugenja paying 1 less Gold.
Limited: Destroy this card: Create three 1F Nonhuman • Clay Soldier Followers and attach them to one to three of your target Personalities.
card.flavor: "Welcome, my friends. Let us make war." - Isawa Emori

card.name: Sudden Rebuke
card.text:
Political
Battle: Bow your performing Courtier at any location: Reduce a target enemy Personality's Force to 0. If he is dishonorable, bow his controller's stronghold.
card.flavor: "Do you think a fluttering fan will hide your loss of face?" Shigeru demanded.

card.name: Delayed Conflict
card.text: Battle: Starting with you, each player targets one of his Personalities (at the current battlefield). Move each of them home. This movement will not be negated.
card.flavor: "The Empire needs you for now, samurai. When this war is over, I will have blood."

card.name: Waylay the Messenger
card.text:
Recon
Open: Bow your performing Scout: Target a province. During the next battle this turn at that province's battlefield, you have the ability, "Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Scout: Ranged 6 Attack." Before this turn ends, if there were never any units on the enemy side at that province's battlefield, put this card into your hand.

card.name: Attuned to the Elements
card.text: Battle/Open: Choose one or more of your performing unbowed Shugenja or Monk Personalities, up to the number of Rings you control: Give each of them +3F.
card.flavor: The ise zumi struck with the sound of thunder, and the sharp report of the Yobanjin's bones breaking.

card.name: Perfect Aim
card.text:
This card has -1 Gold Cost for each Unique Samurai you control.
Battle: Choose your performing Samurai, and you may bow him: Ranged 3 Attack, with a strength bonus equal to your Samurai's Force if he bowed.
card.flavor: Many criminals underestimate a Miya messenger's ability to defend himself, a mistake that often proves fatal.

card.name: Fearless Defense
card.text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Personality and bow all unbowed cards in his unit: Bow a target enemy Personality. Destroy him if his unit's total Gold Cost is lower than your Personality's unit's total Gold Cost.
card.flavor: "I have been fighting demons for my entire life, Destroyer! What makes you think you are so different?"

card.name: Clan Conflict
card.text: Battle/Open: Bow one or two target Personalities controlled by a player who controls two Personalities who do not share a Clan alignment.
card.flavor: "Please, put aside your differences so that we may face the larger threat," Miya Kibu pleaded. His words fell on deaf ears.

card.name: Shatter the Line
card.text:
Tactical
This card has -1 Gold Cost for each Tactician you control at the current battlefield.
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Tactician: Destroy a target enemy card without attachments.
card.flavor: "Break them," Shigetoshi ordered.

card.name: Conscript Troops
card.text: Open: Choose your performing Commander: Look at the top 5 cards of your Fate deck. If one of them is a Follower, you may attach it to him, paying 4 less Gold. Put the remaining cards on the bottom of your deck in any order.

card.name: Death is Not the End
card.text:
Maho • Kiho
Limited: Choose your performing dead non-Unique Shugenja: Bring him into play. Permanently give him Undead and Shadowlands. Lose 5 Honor.
card.flavor: "Plague provides an exquisite opportunity to eliminate rivals without suspicion. We should have them more frequently." - Chuda Atsuro

card.name: Honorable Death
card.text: Limited: Put this card in play in your home. While this card remains in play, at the end of each of your Action Phases, give each of your Deathseeker Personalities a +1F Fury token; then, for each of your Deathseekers who has a number of Fury tokens greater than or equal to his base Force, destroy him and gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "Your Deathseekers seem overjoyed to die. It makes little sense to me." - Hida Benjiro

card.name: Sullied Gift
card.text: Open: Bow your performing Artisan Personality: Bow a target Personality.
card.flavor: In the cutthroat world of Rokugani politics, displaying a painting with the wrong connotations could mean the end of a promising young courtier's career.

card.name: Dove Tattoo
card.text:
Political • Tattoo • Kiho
Open: Choose your performing unbowed Tattooed Personality: You show the elegance of the Dove Tattoo. Gain 5 Honor. Take the Imperial Favor. Permanently increase the Family Honor required for an Honor Victory by 5 for all players.
card.flavor: "Peace," she said softly. "We can spread it among the less enlightened."

card.name: Essence of Death
card.text:
Ninja
Battle: Choose your performing Ninja Personality: Give a target enemy Personality -4F. If his Force is now 0, give your Ninja a Force bonus equal to the Personality's base force.
card.flavor: "I drink in your life as it seeps into the world around you, leaving your body a lifeless husk. Thank you for this gift."

card.name: Merciless Tactics
card.text: Battle: Choose your performing Paragon: If his unit assigned to the current battlefield or if there are any enemy units there, move him there. Straighten his unit if he moved. Lose 3 Honor.
card.flavor: "Burn the village to the ground and there will be no threat of plague. Any pity is weakness, and weakness will be our death." - Daigotsu Gyoken

card.name: Startling Attack
card.text:
Iaijutsu
Reaction: After another player's Personality enters play, if it is not the Dynasty Phase, choose your performing unbowed Duelist or Samurai: He challenges the Personality. Destroy the duel's loser.
card.flavor: "I have no idea how you got here, gainjin demon, but I know how you will leave!"

card.name: Fire on My Command
card.text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Commander and your performing Follower: Ranged Attack with strength equal to the Follower's Force +2.
card.flavor: The pass's defenders moved as one, an impenetrable shield of whirling steel, cutting down all who approached. Finally, their foes lay down their arms and began stringing their bows.

card.name: Endless Rain
card.text: Battle: Choose your performing Personality or Follower, and you may bow it: Ranged 2 Attack. If you bowed a card to pay this action's cost, put this card into your hand instead of discarding it after the action's resolution.
card.flavor: "I'm sorry, our archers are out of arrows," Shisuken said, and the commander frowned. After a moment's silence, Shisuken laughed. "I'm kidding! We're Tsuruchi! Of course we have more arrows!"

card.name: Feign Weakness
card.text: Battle: Dishonor your performing Personality: Move home a target enemy Personality with equal or lower Force. You may move your Personality home.
card.flavor: "They thought us defeated, and turned to face what they believed to be a greater threat. Our deception bought us the time needed to recover."

card.name: Downhill Assault
card.text: Battle: Choose your performing Battle Maiden: Reduce a target enemy Personality or Follower's Force by an amount equal to your Battle Maiden's Personal Honor. If the enemy card's Force is now 0, gain 2 Honor, and you may take an additional Battle action.
card.flavor: "The additional speed afforded by the downhill run will negate the extra mass the Destroyers carry. This will work!" - Shinjo Dun

card.name: Earthen Fist
card.text:
Earth • Kiho
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Monk: Reduce the Force of a target enemy Personality by an amount equal to your Monk's Force. Reduce or increase the current battlefield's province's strength by the same amount. Lose 3 Honor.
card.flavor: Strike the center, and the structure crumbles.

card.name: Invincible Determination
card.text:
Heroic
Battle: Choose your performing Hero: Until this battle ends, after the resolution of each action that targeted him, bow each enemy Personality who performed that action.
card.flavor: Benika stood alone at the center of the battlefield, screaming for more of the creatures to approach her, and each foe that moved towards her was quickly cut down.

card.name: Swell the Ranks
card.text: Battle: Create a 2F/2C/2PH Ronin Personality on your side at the current battlefield. Remove him from the game after this battle ends.
card.flavor: "Their equipment is substandard and their training highly suspect, but they will fight to the death in hopes of securing a better life for their children." - Akodo Shigetoshi

card.name: Sought for Justice
card.text: Open: Bow your performing Magistrate Personality: Bow a target Personality with lower Personal Honor than your Magistrate's Chi. If that Personality is dishonorable, negate his next straightening this game.
card.flavor: A Magistrate's Charge, Part 1 - Despite the external threats to the empire, the magistrates did not turn a blind eye to internal crimes.

card.name: Knowledge of the Land
card.text: Battle: Bow your performing Scout: Bow a target enemy card without unbowed attachments. If a Recon action has targeted the current battlefield's province this turn, draw a card.
card.flavor: "We will harry their scouting party at every step and lead them away from the Fortress, my Lady," Kenzo said. "That will buy you enough time to recover and for reinforcements to arrive."

card.name: Weight of Numbers
card.text:
This card has -1 Gold Cost for each non-Unique Samurai or Ninja Personality you control.
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Samurai or Ninja Personality: Bow a target enemy card without unbowed attachments. Negate its straightening this turn.
card.flavor: The combined might of the clans is enough to defeat any single foe - but when the Empire is beset on all sides, how can it survive?

card.name: Battle Fatigue
card.text:
Battle/Open: Destroy a target Region.
Battle: Bow a target enemy Personality who has performed an action from a Battle Strategy this turn.
card.flavor: "None in the Empire would dare question the valor of the clans arrayed against the Destroyers. But they are men, and they tire. How much longer can they fight?" - Miya Anzai

card.name: Travel Light
card.text:
Reaction: After a Celestial is revealed in a province: Shuffle it into its owner's deck.
Battle: Straighten your target Personality. Draw a card if he has two or fewer keywords.
card.flavor: "I will let neither Heaven nor Earth weigh me down."

card.name: Wrath
card.text:
Dark Virtue
Battle/Open: Bow your performing Samurai: Bow a target Personality with lower Force and no attachments. If this is a Combat Segment, destroy the Personality.
card.flavor: "We must cut the zombies off at their source. Kill the weak, so the strong may survive." - Daigotsu

card.name: Distractions in Court
card.text:
Political
Reaction: After another player's action is announced, bow your performing Courtier or Magistrate: Reduce all Honor losses by 5 until the action ends.
Open: Discard the Imperial Favor: Bow a target Personality.
card.flavor: "Is that the real matter at hand, friend Crane?"

card.name: Protect the Caravan
card.text: Open: Straighten your target Holding.
card.flavor: Even within Rokugan, maintaining supply lines was crucial to maintaining the war effort.

card.name: Sudden Strike
card.text:
Kiho
Open: Bow your performing Monk without Weapons: Bow a target Personality with equal or lower Chi.
card.flavor: With the Empire overrun, each citizen was expected to fight, with whatever weapons they could muster.

card.name: Smoke Cover
card.text:
Ninja
Reaction: After another player targets your Ninja Personality with a Battle action from a Strategy: The action's costs are ignored and its effects do not happen. That player may take an additional Battle action. Before this turn ends, if the Strategy is in that player's discard pile, that player may put the Strategy into his hand.

card.name: Savagery
card.text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Nonhuman Personality: Give a target enemy Personality a -3F Maimed token. You may create a +3F Improvised • Weapon Item and attach it to your Nonhuman.
card.flavor: The last thing seen by the Crab samurai was the sight of his own arm being used as a weapon.

card.name: Secured Borders
card.text:
Recon
Open: Choose your performing unbowed Scout: Target one to three provinces. You may increase their strengths by an amount equal to your Scout's Chi.
card.flavor: Not every wall had fallen.

card.name: Shameful and Cowardly
card.text:
Political
Battle: Dishonor one or two target enemy personalities. Give each target -3F.
card.flavor: "If we cannot fight with our honor intact, we have already lost." - Akodo Shigetoshi

card.name: Stable Ground
card.text:
Terrain
Battle: Before this battle's resolution, straighten each card at this battlefield with 5 or greater force.
card.flavor: "Calm sat over the field like the land itself was holding its breath, knowing what was coming." - Excerpt from the Ikoma Histories

card.name: Force of Spirit
card.text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Paragon: Ranged Attack with strength equal to his Personal Honor. If the Ranged Attack targeted a Personality, you may compare it against his Chi instead of Force.
card.flavor: Some believe that noble intentions and purity of spirit will always triumph. They believe that failure only comes through weakness of self.

card.name: The Art of Ninjutsu
card.text:
Kata • Ninja
Limited: Put this card into play in your home. Discard any other Kata cards you control. While this card remains in play, your Ninja Personalities and Followers have Cavalry, and during Cavalry Maneuvers, their units may only be assigned to battlefields with enemy units.

card.name: Imperial Orders
card.text:
Political
Battle: Bow one or more of your performing Courtiers at any location: Target a unit. Move it home if its total Force is less than or equal to the combined Personal Honor of the Courtiers performing this action. This movement will not be negated, and the Personality will not move again this turn.

card.name: Timely Save
card.text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Yojimbo, and bow him unless he has won a duel this turn: Ranged 4 Attack, with +1 strength if you control a Shugenja.
card.flavor: The Phoenix believed that salvation would be found by their scholars, as long as they were given the time they needed to find it.

card.name: Mysterious Ailment
card.text:
Ninja • Political
Open: If you control no non-Ninja Personalities: Target a Personality with one or more Poison tokens. He is too sick to attend an important event. Bow and dishonor him. Reduce each of his controller's Honor gains by 1 until your next turn begins.
card.flavor: "I fear your lord shall not be in court today."

card.name: Ultimate Sacrifice
card.text:
Unique
Battle: Discard a card from your hand: Destroy a target enemy card without attachments.
card.flavor: "The entire unit was slaughtered to a man, but they delayed the god-beast long enough for us to confront it on the field of battle with our full force. Their names shall never be forgotten." - Utaku Yu-Pan

card.name: Under Arrest
card.text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Magistrate: Move home a target attacking enemy Personality with lower Personal Honor than your Magistrate's Chi; if the enemy Personality is dishonorable, this movement will not be negated and he will not move again this turn.
card.flavor: A Magistrate's Charge, Part 3 - An accusation of war profiteering could lead to arrest if the accused was lucky. Summary execution was not unheard of.

card.name: Unmoving as the Mountain
card.text:
Heroic
Open: Choose your performing Hero: While he is opposed at the current battlefield and no other units are in his army, negate his bowing and movement from other players' actions' effects.
card.flavor: "Come on! Save me the trouble of chasing you down!"

card.name: Unstoppable Cut
card.text:
Reaction: After an action targets your performing Kensai: Negate his movement from the action's effects.
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Kensai and bow one or two of his Weapons: Bow a target enemy card without attachments. If you bowed two Weapons, you may target and bow another enemy card without attachments.

card.name: Superior Mobility
card.text:
Battle: Straighten your target unit.
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Personality and bow a card in his unit: Move a target enemy Personality home. If the movement fails, destroy him.

card.name: Fury of Suitengu
card.text:
Thunder • Kiho
Battle: Choose your performing Thunder Shugenja: Starting with you, each player may target and bow zero to two non-Naval Personalities (at the current battlefield).
card.flavor: "The Fortune of the Sea has a wrathful temper, but his followers among the Mantis are hardy indeed." - Asako Bairei

card.name: Farthest Fortress
card.text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Personality: You may attach a Weapon from your hand to him. You may then target and bow an enemy Personality with lower Force. If you attached a Weapon and bowed a Personality, draw a card.
card.flavor: The Dragon's most remote holding safeguards its treasures from war.

card.name: Fortress of Blackened Sight
card.text:
Limited: Look at the top two cards of your Fate deck. You may rearrange them.
Battle: Even if this card is bowed, bow your performing Personality or one of his Weapons: Bow a target enemy Personality without Weapons or Armor.
card.flavor: The Scorpion swordsmen trained with vigor, knowing that their greatest test was finally upon them.

card.name: Outsider Keep
card.text: Reaction: After engaging at a battlefield where you control an opposed unit: Give each of your Personalities there +1F. Draw a card. Discard a card unless one of your Personalities there is a Tactician.
card.flavor: Once, the castle trained berserk Moto to fight the Shadowlands. The training has shifted to include more targets.

card.name: Cycle of Heaven
card.text: Open: Shuffle an Event card from your discard pile into your Dynasty deck. The Event, by title, may resolve one additional time for you this game.
card.flavor: "There is to all things a pattern, indiscernable to the mortal eye. Only the most blatant instances ever catch our attention." - Isawa Kimi

card.name: Tsi Mokotsu
card.text:
Oriole Clan • Retainer
Bow this card: Produce 3 Gold.
Limited: Bow this card: Create a +1F/+1C Weapon Item and attach it to your target Personality.
card.flavor: "Perhaps it will be used for display, or carried by a great warrior. I never know for certain, but I will find its true form regardless."

card.name: Writ of Reprimand
card.text:
Writ
Will only attach to a Courtier or Magistrate Personality.
Limited: Destroy this card: Dishonor a target Personality.
card.flavor: "Censure from the Divine Empress or her Champions can cripple every aspect of a samurai's career." - Shosuro Jimen

card.name: Kuronada - exp
card.text:
Ronin • Samurai • Duelist • Kensai • Tactician • Hero • Experienced • Unique
Iaijutsu Battle: Bow a target non-Unique enemy Personality.
card.flavor: "An incredibly gifted warrior and officer who will help lead the Legion against the enemies of the Empire. These rumors of his father, whom he claims is dead, trouble me, however." - The journals of Utagawa

card.name: Daigotsu's Wrath
card.text:
Fear
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Kensai Personality, Paragon Personality, and Nonhuman Personality (who must be three different cards): Bow a target enemy unit.
card.flavor: "This Empire will one day be the Dark Lord's. I would not insult him by allowing you to remain in it."

card.name: Mastering the Elements
card.text:
Unique
Reaction: After this card enters play, target your Spell and pay Gold equal to its base Gold Cost: This card permanently copies the Spell's keywords, traits, and its base abilities that do not themselves copy abilities.

(MRP)
card.flavor: Some shugenja focus on a single element. Some find that far too limiting.

card.name: Raido no Oni
card.text:
Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Oni
Will only enter play from a province.
After Raido enters play: Lose 6 Honor.
Raido may not perform Battle actions while your current army has higher total Force than the current enemy army.

(MRP)
card.flavor: "I have seen them fighting the Destroyers, and fighting alongside the Destroyers. I prefer to let them kill themselves, honestly." - Hida Fujita

card.name: Coastal Waters
card.text: Market and Port Holdings enter play from this province paying 1 less Gold to a minimum of 1.
card.flavor: "The benefits of land and sea, combined in one location. This is where the Mantis are truly at home, between two worlds." - Yoritomo Naizen

card.name: Bottled Fire
card.text: Limited: Bow this card: Give a target Personality a +1F Sake token.
card.flavor: "I see you enjoy the Iron Lotus blend! You must have a strong constitution indeed, cousin! I tell you what... as a personal favor, let me share a little something with you. It will change your life." - Yasuki Jin-Kuen

card.name: Left Hand's Wrath
card.text:
Iaijutsu
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Scout Personality, Duelist Personality, and Artisan Personality (who must be three different cards): Bow a target enemy unit.
card.flavor: "They think it a joke to arouse the ire of the Crane. They have no idea what they have done."

card.name: Underhand's Wrath
card.text:
Political
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Kensai Personality, Magistrate Personality, and Ninja Personality (who must be three different cards): Bow a target enemy unit.
card.flavor: "Wrong the Scorpion and it is only a matter of time. We are a plague of sorts ourselves, you might say." - Shosuro Ritsuko

card.name: Veteran's Experience
card.text:
Heroic
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Scout Personality, Commander Personality, and Hero Personality (who must be three different cards): Bow a target enemy unit.
card.flavor: "It is a fearsome beast, to be sure. I have seen worse, and killed it. These gaijin mean nothing to me."

card.name: Recruitment Center
card.text:
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Limited: Bow this card: Give this card a Recruiter token.
Limited: Destroy one or more Recruiter tokens on this card, and destroy this card: Create a number of 2F/2C/2PH Ronin • Samurai Personalities equal to the number of Recruiter tokens you destroyed.
card.flavor: "We are unconcerned with your past." - Yoritomo Jera

card.name: Utagawa - exp2
card.text:
Ronin • Samurai • Duelist • Tactician • Experienced 2 • Unique
Iaijutsu Battle: Utagawa challenges a target enemy Personality. Destroy the duel's loser.
card.flavor: "I do not know her past or her real name, nor do I need to. She is a consummate warrior and a brilliant strategist, for which she has my respect. But she knows a terrible secret, and for that I can never trust her." - Akodo Shigetoshi

card.name: Rallying the Recruits
card.text:
Limited: Give your target Holding a Recruiter token.
Battle: Destroy a Recruiter token on one of your cards: Create a 2F/2C/2PH Ronin • Samurai Personality at the current battlefield.
card.flavor: "When you woke up this morning, you may have been wave man scum, but no longer! Today, your ancestors weep for joy, for today you are samurai! To war!"

card.name: Ekibyogami's Spite
card.text:
Fortune • Unique
After this card enters play: You may destroy a Personality who has a Plague token.
Battle: Discard this card: Give a target Personality two -1C Plague tokens.
card.flavor: "Disease. No weapon can slay it, no armor can turn it aside. Ekibyogami waits, and the Empire trembles." - Isawa Tanaka

card.name: Inari's Blessing
card.text:
Fortune • Unique
If you are a Dragon Clan player, your Farm Holdings enter play paying 1 less Gold, to a minimum of 1.
Open: Discard this card: Inari sends the Frost Dragon to ruin the crops. Destroy a target Farm.
card.flavor: "Food. Warmth. Simple things that Inari can both provide and withhold." - Kitsune Mizuru

card.name: Ignoble Demise
card.text: You may destroy a dishonorable Personality.
card.flavor: The Empire is not a kind place for those who brought shame upon themselves. They find new enemies at every turn, and old allies shun their presence. Among the dishonored, few live long enough to clear their names.

card.name: Jimen's Decree
card.text:
Political • Winter
Before the next time this game an Event resolves, its effects do not happen. (Discard it.)
card.flavor: The attempt on the Empress' life prompted the Emerald Champion to cancel Winter Court for the year. Courtiers discussed whether this was appropriate, while others pondered if this was a ploy for him to seize power. One samurai concluded that it was time to act.

card.name: Lack of Vigilance
card.text: Name a card. Until your next turn begins, Fate cards with that title may not be played and will not enter play. (This includes taking actions from Strategies and Rings out of play.)
card.flavor: The Voice of the Empress speaks in her name. When an assassin attempted to take her life, the Voice again let her will be known to the Empire. The assassin's broken body spoke with a clarity that no words could match.

card.name: Stand Alone
card.text: Choose your Personality in play. Permanently give him Hero and the trait "While this Personality is the only one on his side, he contributes his Force even if bowed."
card.flavor: In most cases, a lone warrior beset by foes will die, unheralded and unremembered. In a rare few batters, the lone warrior prevails and is remembered forever.

card.name: Corrupt Governor
card.text:
Governor • Political • Retainer
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Limited: Target a player with higher Family Honor than his starting Honor. Increase his next Honor loss this turn by 1.
card.flavor: "Yes, Ai-sama, I know very well that these are urgent times. However, that does not mean we should not consider the opportunity for profit."

card.name: Dark Oracle of Fire - exp2
card.text:
Shadowlands • Fire • Dark Oracle • Retainer • Experienced 2 • Unique
After this card enters play: Lose 6 Honor and straighten it.
Battle: Bow this card: Ranged 5 Attack; negate any reduction of its strength.
card.flavor: "I will burn the Empire one bit at a time, and its people will suffer every moment of its long, torturous death."

card.name: Private Farm
card.text:
Farm
After this card enters play: Discard a card.
Bow this card: Produce 1 Gold.
card.flavor: Although the unaligned lands are predominantly empty, there are still many within them who live simple lives in service to the Empress. It is perhaps in their hands that the Empire's future rests.

card.name: Temple of Redemption
card.text:
Temple
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Before you lose Honor from an action that targeted or was performed by one of your Monk or Shugenja Personalities: You may have him commit seppuku. If you did and the seppuku destroyed him, reduce the Honor loss to 1.

card.name: Hida Akeno
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Sumai
Open: A target Personality with lower Force may not perform his base abilities (this turn).
card.flavor: "Your arms, your fists, your fingers - use whatever you need to crush your foe to the ground."

card.name: Hida Desora
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Commander
After Desora enters play: Create a 1F Follower and attach it to him.
card.flavor: "These new battle lines will hold. Finally, we have the advantage over the hateful Destroyers."

card.name: Hida Eijiko - exp
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Commander • Experienced • Unique
Open: Even if Eijiko is bowed: Straighten your target unit with one or more Followers.
card.flavor: "It is odd to view our neighbors with anything but disdain, but I cannot deny the truth. The Scorpion have proved their worth in this war many times over. We must adopt their ruthlessness if we are to reclaim our lands and cleanse our shame."

card.name: Hida Tokido
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Hero
Battle: Bow Tokido: The resolution of the current battle will not bow your Personalities.
card.flavor: "He fights with efficiency, with every strike a kill. He is fearless in the face of the enemy. He is an inspiration to the young warriors who have faced so much adversity since their gempukku." - Hida Fubatsu

card.name: Hida Yiu
card.text:
Crab Clan • Berserker
Reaction: After Yiu enters play: Bow a target Personality with lower Force. Until that Personality leaves play, his next straightening will be negated.
card.flavor: "Charge, you fools! Break the enemy lines!"

card.name: Kuni Kiyoshi - exp2
card.text:
Crab Clan • Earth • Shugenja • Daimyo • Witch Hunter • Experienced 2 • Unique
Enter play ignoring Honor Requirements if you are a Crab Clan or Scorpion Clan player.
Battle: Even if Kiyoshi is bowed: Bow or straighten a target Personality with Force lower than the current battlefield's province's strength. If that Personality is Shadowlands, his controller discards a card.

card.name: Toritaka Horoiso
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Scout • Spirit
Recon Open: Target a province. After the next time this turn you engage in a battle at that province's battlefield, if Horoiso is there, create a 3F/3C/3PH Crab Clan • Samurai • Scout • Spirit Personality in his army. Remove the Spirit from the game after the battle ends.
card.flavor: Duty is impossible to relinquish, even in death.

card.name: Asahina Beniha - exp
card.text:
Crane Clan • Air • Courtier • Shugenja • Daimyo • Experienced • Loyal • Unique
Political Battle: Even if Beniha is not at the current battlefield: Move a target opposed Personality home. If he is yours, gain 2 Honor. If the movement failed or he is Undead, you may destroy him.
card.flavor: "This is an opportunity for us. The hospitality of the Crane will be offered to all of the court."

card.name: Daidoji Kagami
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Iron Crane • Yojimbo
Kagami has the additional cost, "Bow your Courtier or Shugenja," to enter play.
Kagami's unit may not assign, and Kagami will not move, into an attacking army.
Negate Kagami's destruction from other player's cards' effects.

card.name: Daidoji Sadayori
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Iron Crane • Scout
Battle: Bow a target enemy card without attachments. Destroy it if a Recon action targeted the current battlefield's province this turn.
card.flavor: "Damn the Destroyers, damn the Crab, damn the Scorpion. They can invade all they want, but we will always be here to stop them."

card.name: Doji Nukada
card.text:
Crane Clan • Artisan • Poet
Political Reaction: After an action's resolution ends, if another player lost Honor (for any reason) during that resolution: Nukada's poems immortalize the shame. That player loses 1 Honor. Gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "Such a fascinating comment, Bayushi-san. I am sure it will rivet all who hear of it."

card.name: Doji Shikatsu
card.text:
Crane Clan • Courtier • Governor • Magistrate
After you lose Honor from another player's action: Give one of your Personalities a +1F Revenge token.
Political Open: Discard the Imperial Favor: Target another player's Personality. After the next time the Personality's unit is assigned this turn, dishonor him and gain 2 Honor.

card.name: Kakita Noritoshi - exp3
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Duelist • Daimyo • Kenshinzen • Experienced 3 • Loyal • Unique
Shosuro Jimen will not enter play while Noritoshi is in play.
Before Focus Effects resolve in a duel involving Noritoshi: Double the Focus Value of one of your focused cards.
Iaijutsu Battle: Noritoshi challenges a target enemy Personality. Destroy the duel's loser.

card.name: Kakita Yosuga
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Duelist • Artisan • Master of Ceremonies
Iaijutsu Limited: Target another player's Personality. His controller may dishonor him. If he is now honorable, gain 1 Honor and choose one of his abilities; it may not be used until your next turn begins.
card.flavor: "The Embassy stands open at your order, Beniha-sama"

card.name: Kitsuki Bokuko
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Magistrate
After you lose Honor from another player's action: Give one of your Personalities a +1F Revenge token.
Open: Bow Bokuko: Bow a target Personality with lower Personal Honor than Bokuko's Chi. Straighten Bokuko if the Personality is dishonorable and it is your turn.

card.name: Mirumoto Hojatsu
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Duelist • Kensai • Unique
Negate other players' Focus Effects in a duel involving Hojatsu.
Iaijutsu Battle: Destroy a target enemy card without attachments.
card.flavor: "With each breath, a master strikes. With each step, a master cuts down an enemy. As one man can defeat another, so one man can defeat a thousand." - Hojatsu's Legacy

card.name: Mirumoto Kijima
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Duelist
Kijima has a Force bonus equal to the highest Focus Value among all Iaijutsu Strategies in your discard pile.
card.flavor: "Leave the Kakita to focus on their 'art'. As we face these dark days of war, our technique remains the more practical - and essential - school."

card.name: Mirumoto Tsubasa
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Kensai • Poet
Battle: Give a target enemy Personality or Follower a Force penalty equal to Tsubasa's Force.
card.flavor: "She is a gifted artist and poet, although she is better known for her swordmanship. It is a tragedy that war makes murder with even the gentlest spirits." - Togashi Maya

card.name: Tamori Wotan - exp
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Fire • Void • Shugenja • Tattooed • Experienced • Unique
Will not be controlled by a Phoenix Clan player.
Limited: Look at the top four cards of your Fate deck. You may put one of those cards at the bottom of your deck.
Battle: Wotan shows no mercy. Destroy a target bowed enemy card.

card.name: Togashi Okamoto
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Fire • Tattooed • Monk
Battle/Open: Give Okamoto five +1F Fire tokens. Before this turn ends, remove five or all of Okamoto's Fire tokens, whichever is less, bow him, and negate his straightening until your next turn begins.
card.flavor: "After fighting the Yobanjin for so long, he welcomes fighting the Destroyers. He claims it feels good to fight without taking lives. I think he misses the point." - Togashi Shiori

card.name: Togashi Shiori - exp
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Void • Monk • Tattooed • Experienced • Unique
Battle: Bow a target enemy Personality with higher Force than his own Chi. He may not perform actions this turn.
card.flavor: "When I bore the name Hitomi, I was consumed by rage and hatred. Now I am Togashi, and while the rage and hate are tempered, they have never fully disappeared."

card.name: Akodo Ebiro
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Deathseeker • Hero
Battle: Bow a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, that is Undead or has equal or lower Force than Ebiro.
card.flavor: The Lion continued to devastate the zombie hordes, hunting them down whenever they could be found within the Empire's heart.

card.name: Akodo Raemon
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Tactician
Reaction: After the resolution of a Tactical action that Raemon performed, if he is at the current battlefield: Ranged Attack with strength equal to Raemon's Force minus two.
card.flavor: "We cannot currently help the other clans, but we are far from defenseless."

card.name: Akodo Seiichi - exp
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Tactician • Experienced • Unique
Battle: Straighten a target card in a unit. You may target and bow an enemy card with Force lower than or equal to Seiichi's Force.
card.flavor: "I will not stand aside when the fate of the Empire is at stake. Other clans may wish to sit at home and hope for the best, but the Lion shall never be among them."

card.name: Matsu Amuro
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Hero
Open: Target a Personality. Amuro inspires him to greatness. Give the Personality Hero.
card.flavor: "Bandits continue to infest our lands. Only those parasites seem to truly understand that the Lion will not allow the Destroyer threat to destroy Rokugan."

card.name: Matsu Ato
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Paragon
Ato has +3F while attacking.
card.flavor: Since their inception, the Lion Wardens have secured the clan's borders. With the threat of the undead lingering, the Wardens have gained a new importance in the Lion's military strategy.

card.name: Matsu Fumiyo - exp
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Paragon • Experienced • Unique
Fear Battle: Bow each card with equal or lower Force than Fumiyo in a target enemy unit. Gain 1 Honor for each card this bowed.
card.flavor: "She is young, but brave. She is relentless, inquisitive, and cunning. She is the greatest samurai-ko I have ever met, and she seems wholly unaware of her own importance." - Moto Jin-sahn

card.name: Matsu Sako
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Commander
Limited: Discard a card: Create a 2F Follower and attach it to your target Commander.
card.flavor: "Stand beside a Matsu. Share in her rage, her drive, her passion to fight in the Empress' name. Watch as her foes crumble before her fury. You will never doubt the honor of fighting at their side." - Isawa Emori

card.name: Moshi Kalani - exp
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Commander • Experienced • Unique
Kalani has +1F for each other Naval card in his army.
Battle: Even if Kalani is bowed: Target your Personality. If his unit assigned to the current battlefield or if any enemy units are there, move him there. Straighten his unit if he moved.

card.name: Moshi Kinyo
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Thunder • Water • Shugenja • Naval
Kinyo has Cavalry while she has a Water Spell attached.
Battle: Reduce the Force of a target enemy Personality or Follower to 0.
card.flavor: "I feel something... something reaching across the seas... something from the Empire? Who is this Kamarou?"

card.name: Tsuruchi Seisha
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Commander
Battle: You may take an additional Battle action which must be performed by one of Seisha's Followers.
card.flavor: "There are eyes upon us still, lord Kalani. The few enemies that we have seen this far? They are only the first of many."

card.name: Tsuruchi Toburo
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Scout
Battle: Bow Toburo: Ranged 3 Attack. If you targeted the current battlefield's province with a Recon action this turn, and there are more units on the enemy side than on yours there, you may make another Ranged 3 Attack.
card.flavor: "Winter slows the tide of war, but I find it a grand opportunity to thin the enemy ranks from afar."

card.name: Yoritomo Ai
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Corrupt • Governor • Magistrate
Open: Pay 2 Gold: A target non-Unique Holding's base abilities may not be used this turn.
card.flavor: "Many of lord Naizen's favored vassals are far from the Empire, and even more will perish in the war. This is a time of unprecedented opportunity for those bold enough to seize it."

card.name: Yoritomo Eihiko - exp
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Magistrate • Extortionist • Experienced • Unique
Open: Reduce the Gold Cost of a target card (in play) to 0.
card.flavor: "It would be a terrible disgrace for your cousin's indiscretions to come to light, Doji-san. I think it would be in your best interests to ensure the Tsuruchi legions on the southern front are properly reinforced by the Daidoji."

card.name: Agasha Kamarou
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Thunder • Water • Shugenja • Cavalry
Kamarou has Naval while she has a Thunder Spell attached.
Battle: Switch the locations of your target Personality and Kamarou. Straighten their units if they moved.
card.flavor: "I understand the risks, Bairei-sama. I will reach the Mantis or die in the attempt. It is my duty."

card.name: Agasha Kokiden
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Air • Shugenja • Imperial • Inquisitor • Magistrate • Sycophant
Political Limited: Bow Kokiden or one of her Spells: A target dishonorable Personality's controller loses 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "Such a pretty thing, is it not? A mere trifle, meant to distract from unpleasant thoughts. Who can believe such a thing could threaten the Divine One? Someone's incompetence is to blame, I am sure."

card.name: Asako Hitsuko
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Void • Water • Shugenja • Alchemist • Inquisitor • Magistrate
Battle: Starting with you, each player must target and move home half, rounded down, of his Personalities at the current battlefield. You may destroy one of the targeted Personalities whose movement failed.
card.flavor: "The scroll we have in not the scroll we had. Where is it now? Where did this one come from?"

card.name: Isawa Furiko
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Fire • Shugenja
Furiko has +1F while she has a Spell attached.
Battle: Ranged 4 Attack.
card.flavor: "While Chosei's knowledge of Fire was unmatched, he had forgotten that the Phoenix had long study of all the elements, and they had the courage to use it in the Empress's service. With the aid of the Dragon Clan, they joined the Dark Oracle in battle." - Chronicle of Bright Fire

card.name: Isawa Kumai - exp
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Air • Void • Shugenja • Alchemist • Ishiken • Experienced • Unique
Open: Even if Kumai is bowed: Straighten your target Air Shugenja.
Reaction: After the resolution of an action from whose effects you drew a card: Put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck. Draw a card.
card.flavor: "It is moving."

card.name: Isawa Kuniki
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Earth • Shugenja • Defender
After you lose Honor from another player's action: Give one of your Personalities a +1F Revenge token.
Reaction: After the resolution of an action on a Spell which Kuniki performed, if he is at the current battlefield: Give its province +4 strength. Negate Kuniki's next destruction (this turn).

card.name: Shiba Gohiko
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Samurai • Duelist • Yojimbo
Open: If it is not your turn: Straighten your Stronghold.
card.flavor:
"We will never forget our oaths, but this war is bleeding us dry," Tsukimi said. "I can only leave a few of you to defend this place."
"Do not worry, my Champion, all will be well here," Gohiko replied.

card.name: Bayushi Azumamoru
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Kensai • Bitter Lies • Poison Blade
Battle: Bow Azumamoru or one of his Weapons and show the top card of your Fate deck: Give a target enemy Personality a number of -1F Poison tokens equal to the card's Focus Value. If the Personality's Force is now zero, or lower than his base Force, bow him.
card.flavor: "Come closer, close enough for just one scratch..."

card.name: Bayushi Jou
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Courtier • Intimidator
Political Reaction: After another player's Battle action targets Jou: The player may choose to lose 2 Honor. If he did not choose this, negate the action's (remaining) effects.
Battle: Even if Jou is bowed: Move her home.
card.flavor: "Kakita Korihime-sama. What a delight to see you."

card.name: Bayushi Muhito - exp2
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Ninja • Duelist • Yojimbo • Experienced 2 • Unique • Champion of Rei
Reaction: After the resolution of another player's Battle action: Move Muhito to a different location.
Battle: Give a target enemy Personality -2C for each of his Poison tokens.
card.flavor: "You are right to mistrust Jimen, but Noritoshi is no better. Denounce him, my love. Do not let his shame become yours."

card.name: Bayushi Saito
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Magistrate
Battle: Give Saito a Force bonus equal to the Force of a target enemy Personality or Follower. If this targeted a dishonorable Personality, reduce his Force to zero.
card.flavor: "Watch him, Saito. He will act against us, and show himself as the traitor he really is. Until then, watch him." - Shosuro Jimen

card.name: Shosuro Jimen - exp2
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Courtier • Duelist • Imperial • Magistrate • Villain • Experienced 2 • Loyal • Unique • Emerald Champion • Poison Master
After the resolution of a Battle action which Jimen performed: You may move him home.
Political Limited: Target another player's Personality. You may either dishonor him or have his controller lose 2 Honor. Dishonor all copies of Kakita Noritoshi in play.
card.flavor: "No one is beyond my grasp."

card.name: Shosuro Shigemasa
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Ninja
Battle: Ranged Attack with strength equal to the number of Poison tokens in play plus two.
card.flavor: "They see me and all they remember is how unusual I look. The notion of what I am and can do is lost upon them. Just as I wish it."

card.name: Soshi Hirotsugu
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Air • Shugenja • Ninja
Battle: Give each of your Scorpion Clan and Crab Clan Personalities in Hirotsugu's army +1F, or +2F if they are opposed.
card.flavor: Under the watchful eye of the Jade Champion, the Soshi and the Kuni systematically reclaimed the ground taken by the destroyers, one dead demon at a time.

card.name: Chuda Inisi
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Shugenja • Incubator
After Inishi enters play: Lose 3 Honor.
Maho Open: Destroy Inisi: Undead rise from his corpse. Create three 2F/2C/0PH Shadowlands • Undead Personalities.
card.flavor: "The samurai say they serve until death. I would not do so little."

card.name: Daigotsu Gahseng - exp
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai • Paragon • Experienced • Unique • Dark Pride
After Gahseng enters play: Lose 6 Honor.
Battle/Open: Target a Dark Virtue Strategy in your discard pile. Take an additional action to play it for one of its Battle, Limited, or Open actions, as appropriate to the current phase. Remove it from the game after its action ends.
card.flavor: "We protect what will be ours."

card.name: Daigotsu Sahara - exp
card.text:
Spider Clan • Samurai • Experienced • Loyal • Unique
Sahara uses his base Force as his duel stat.
Battle: Sahara challenges a target enemy Personality. Destroy the duel's loser.
card.flavor: His standing among the Spider grew greatly when they realized the value to them of the Sparrow.

card.name: Fosuta no Oni
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Oni • Slave
After Fosuta enters play: Lose 3 Honor.
card.flavor: "It may have cost him the last of his soul, but Fosuta finally has the power he craves." - Chuda Mishime

card.name: Hachigoro
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai • Undead
After Hachigoro enters play: Lose 3 Honor.
Battle: If Hachigoro is dead: He claws out of his grave. Bring him into play at the current battlefield paying 2 less Gold, or ignoring his costs if the enemy leader is a Lion Clan player.
card.flavor: Not all of the walking dead were on the same side, but this meant little to the living.

card.name: Katahide
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Monk • Kensai • Order of Venom
After Katahide enters play: Lose 5 Honor.
Reaction: After a Battle action resolves which Katahide performed: Take an additional Battle action which Katahide must perform.
card.flavor: Hiding among the Mantis has lead him to the Ivory Kingdoms... and many great mysteries.

card.name: Yoritomo Aranai
card.text:
Spider Clan • Mantis Clan • Samurai • Infiltrator • Paragon • Dark Storm
Fear Battle: Bow a target enemy card with lower Gold Cost. If Aranai has performed a Dark Virtue action this turn, negate the card's straightening this turn.
card.flavor: "To the Ivory Kingdoms I shall go, and none shall feel the shadow of the Spider that walks among them."

card.name: Iuchi Katamari - exp
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Water • Shugenja • Cavalry • Magistrate • Experienced • Unique • Doomseeker
Katamari has -1F unless you are a Unicorn Clan or Crab Clan player.
Battle: Target an enemy card that is either an attachment, or a Personality with lower Personal Honor than Katamari's Chi. Bow the targeted card. Destroy it if it is Nonhuman.
card.flavor: "Your doom is now, demon."

card.name: Moto Jeng-Yun
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Commander
Fear Limited: Target another player's Personality. After the Cavalry Maneuvers Segment this turn, you may assign him, even if he is not at home, to a battlefield where you control one or more units.
card.flavor: "The Lords of Death teach us discipline. Fear brings chaos, and chaos brings ruin."

card.name: Shinjo Chu-Yeung
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Tactician
Battle: Ranged 4 Attack.
card.flavor: "The Empress has sent the Mantis to the Ivory Kingdoms. I trust her wisdom, and I trust that someday the reason why she sent them rather than the children of Lady Shinjo to execute this mission will be made known to us."

card.name: Shinjo Hwarang - exp
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Commander • Experienced • Unique
After Hwarang enters play: Create a 0F Cavalry Follower and attach it to your target Personality.
Battle: Bow your performing Follower: Destroy or straighten a target card without attachments in a unit.
card.flavor: "Their leader is exposed. Kill him."

card.name: Shinjo Meng-Do
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Scout
Limited: Meng-Do recruits a new scout. Create a 2F/2C/2PH Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Scout Personality.
card.flavor: "Yes, we may lose a generation to these wars. But I will gladly sacrifice a generation, if through victory the Empire remains to produce generations more." - Moto Jin-sahn

card.name: Shinjo Tobasa
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry
Tobasa has -1F while there are any Cavalry units on the enemy side at his battlefield.
card.flavor: "Strike. Fade. Sow disarray. Engage where you are many and they are few."

card.name: Utaku Liu-Xeung
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Battle Maiden • Paragon
Reaction: After engaging at Liu-Xeung's battlefield: Give a target Personality or Follower opposing her a Force penalty equal to Liu-Xeung's Personal Honor.
card.flavor: "Liu-Xeung laughed. Of course they have had time to fortify their position! That is why Lady Yu-Pan sent me, to break their lines!" - Hiruma Todori, notes from the field

card.name: Ieyoshi
card.text:
Samurai • Hero
Reaction: After Ieyoshi enters play: Choose a Clan alignment. Permanently give all unaligned copes of Ieyoshi you own, in and out of play, that Clan alignment.
card.flavor: "My allegiance can be bought, but it is absolute."

card.name: Seppun Ujifusa
card.text:
Samurai • Banker • Imperial • Imperial Bank of Rokugan
Reaction: When paying a Gold cost, bow Ujifusa: Produce 2 Gold.
Ujifusa is worth One Koku.
card.flavor: "Yoritomo Utemaro is the most efficient treasurer the Empire could wish for. My worries, it seems, were for nothing."

card.name: Takaharu
card.text:
Ninja • Assassin
Reaction: When another player's Battle action would target a Ninja at Takaharu's battlefield: It targets a different Ninja you control at that battlefield, if legal.
card.flavor: He bears the name of a killer and acts to preserve its legacy rather than reform it.

card.name: Ujisato
card.text:
Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Oni • Unique • Devourer of Dreams
Limited: Give a target Personality a -1C Haunted token.
Open: Target a dead Personality who was destroyed this turn for having 0 Chi. Remove him from the game. Ujisato feeds on his soul. Give Ujisato a +1F Soul token.
card.flavor: "It hungers." - Shahai

card.name: Yukataka no Onna
card.text:
Nonhuman • Snow Maiden
Yukataka has +1F for each Winter and Forest card in play and in your discard piles.
Open: Target a Personality. His unit may not assign and he will not move to battlefields (this turn) unless his controller has a Forest or Winter card in play or in his discard piles.
card.flavor: "There is blood on the snow."

card.name: Ancestral Temple
card.text:
Temple • Unique
Limited: Bow your performing Personality and remove your performing dead Personality from the game: Draw a card.
card.flavor: "We face an enemy unlike any the world has ever seen. You may look at one another and wonder, what must we do? Ask instead, what would our ancestors have done? They would fight, and they would win." - Ikoma Hagio

card.name: Snow-Covered Plain
card.text:
Winter
Battle: Even if you control no units at the current battlefield, destroy this card: A blizzard strikes suddenly. Give the current battlefield's province +2 strength.
card.flavor: "It seems so peaceful and quiet. Like so much else in the world, it is a lie. Death awaits just beyond the horizon." - Hida Sozen

card.name: Treacherous Defile
card.text:
Mountain
Battle: Choose your two unbowed performing Personalities who each have a Clan alignment but do not share a Clan alignment: Bow a target enemy attacking Follower or Personality without Followers.
card.flavor: "A falling mountain crushed one god a thousand years ago," Shigetoshi said. "If needs be, it will happen again."

card.name: Archery Unit
card.text: Battle: Bow this card: Ranged 4 Attack that is compared against the targeted card's base Force.
card.flavor: "Their armor is of thickest iron and all-encompassing. They are invulnerable to our arrows save for the smallest of openings. Let us remind the Empire why the Tsuruchi are feared!" - Tsuruchi Nobumoto

card.name: Cavalry for Hire
card.text:
Cavalry
Reaction: After an action targets a card in this unit: Negate this card's destruction from the action's effects.
Battle: Move a target enemy Personality home. If the movement failed, bow him.
card.flavor: "Show me the coin and a target."

card.name: Fifth Wind Cavalry
card.text:
Cavalry • Unique
This Personality has Tactician.
card.flavor: "We ride not for coin, but in memory of the man you called Hida Otoya. He was among our greatest minds, and his skill put our name upon the lips of the Crab Clan."

card.name: Midnight Shadows
card.text:
Ninja
Battle: Ranged 4 Attack. If this targeted a Personality with any Poison tokens, destroy him.
card.flavor: "They specialize in striking with a light kiss of death, delivered via shuriken in the dead of night. Ineffective against the Destroyers, but not without uses." - Shosuro Toson

card.name: Retired Magistrates
card.text:
Magistrate
Political Reaction: After the resolution of an action this Personality performed, if any player lost Honor from that action: Straighten your target Personality.
card.flavor: "No, no, no! It should be handled as the Bloodspeaker outbreak in 1117 was. Why, I remember when..."

card.name: Serene Brother
card.text:
Focus Effect: You may add a Ring from your discard pile or hand to your focused cards. If you do, discard this card.
Battle: Ranged Attack with strength equal to the number of Rings you control plus two.
card.flavor: "Even in the face of devastation, you must seek inner peace. War must not destroy our souls."

card.name: Stone Guardian
card.text:
Nonhuman • Golem • Earth
Will only attach to a Shugenja.
Negate this card's destruction from other players' actions.
card.flavor: "I do not know what that is, but I can see the magic that animates it. Give me but a moment and it will be yours to command, Kalani-sama." - Moshi Kinyo

card.name: Tsume Spearmen
card.text:
Iron Crane • Scout
This card has +3F while defending.
Battle: Bow this card: Ranged Attack with strength equal to this card's Force.
card.flavor: A minor vassal family of the Crane, the Tsume are well known for their skill with the simple spear.

card.name: Armor of the Loyal Son
card.text:
Armor • Cursed • Unique
Before an action destroys this Personality, this card, or both, if this card is unbowed: Destroy another of your Personalities with the same Clan alignment as this Personality. If this destroyed a Personality, negate the action's destruction of this Personality and this card.
card.flavor: Its tale of woe continues on unhindered.

card.name: Daisho
card.text:
Weapon
Reaction: After this card enters play, if this Personality may attach two Weapons: Create a +1F/+1C Wakizashi • Weapon Item and attach it to him (if legal).
card.flavor: The katana and wakizashi are symbols of a noble of the samurai caste. Each blade remains priceless for what it represents, more than for their value in war.

card.name: Dependable Gear
card.text:
Armor
Reaction: After another player's Battle action targets this Personality: Negate either the action's effects that move him or the action's effects that bow him.
card.flavor: "I have worn it into war a dozen times. It may be ugly and scarred from battle, but it keeps me alive." - Kaiu Kyoka

card.name: Impromptu Weapon
card.text:
Weapon
After this Personality enters a duel: He loses Duelist until after the duel ends.
Reaction: After the resolution of an action that created a duel which this Personality won: Gain 3 Honor.
card.flavor: "I need no steel to deal with the likes of you."

card.name: Tsangusuri
card.text:
Nemuranai
Reaction: Even if this card is bowed, after it bows or is destroyed: Straighten this Personality.
card.flavor: The Asahina are the masters of forging powerful fetishes and have remained so for generations. Others are eager to challenge that title.

card.name: All Water Flows
card.text:
Water
Battle: Bow this card: Bow a target enemy card without attachments. If this Shugenja is Water, give him a Force bonus equal to the enemy card's base Force.
card.flavor: "All energy exists among the kami. It can be moved and shared among those who can wield it properly." - Moshi Awako

card.name: Castle of Earth
card.text:
Earth
This Shugenja has +1F while he is Earth.
Battle: Bow this Shugenja or one of your Rings: Increase or reduce this battlefield's province's strength by 4.
card.flavor: "Rest, cousins," Emori said. "The respite is brief, but enjoy it while you can."

card.name: Consumption by Fire
card.text:
Fire
This Shugenja has +2F while he is Fire.
Battle: Bow this card, and destroy it unless the targeted card is at the current battlefield: Ranged 3 Attack that may target a card in the Defender's home.
card.flavor: "The cold of winter only increases the potency of fire." - Tamori Wotan

card.name: Drawing the Void
card.text:
Void
Attaches to a Void Shugenja paying 1 less Gold.
Open: Bow this card: Before the next time this turn you draw a card, you may draw it from the bottom of your deck.
card.flavor: "There is so much beyond the world that mortals know," Kimi whispered.

card.name: Guardian of Earth
card.text:
Earth
Open: Bow this Shugenja unless he is Earth and destroy this card: Create a 4F/0C/0PH Nonhuman • Golem • Earth • Samurai • Yojimbo Personality with the trait "Will not be destroyed for having 0 Chi."
card.flavor: "We must spare the lives of our men when we can," Ochiai said. "Emori, if you please."

card.name: Stealing the Essence
card.text:
Maho
Battle: Bow this card and destroy your performing Undead Personality or Follower: It explodes with dark energy. Ranged 5 Attack.
card.flavor: "Your wounds will not allow you to continue the fight," Inisi whispered. "I am sorry, but you better serve your lord this way. It is for the best."

card.name: The Kami's Whisper
card.text:
Air • Kami
Political Limited: Bow this Shugenja: Dishonor a target Personality, who must have Chi equal to or lower than your Shugenja's Chi unless your Shugenja is Air.
card.flavor: "He is not your friend," the wind whispered. "Remember what happened last season? Remember how he looked at you?"

card.name: Touch of Thunder
card.text:
Thunder
Battle: Destroy this card: Ranged 4 Attack.
Battle: If this Shugenja is Thunder, destroy this card: Ranged 3 Attack. You may make another Ranged 3 Attack.
card.flavor: "It is a most unusual sensation, channeling the Thunder," Kamiya said. "Painful, but not unpleasant."

card.name: 1,000 Cuts Technique
card.text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Kensai and bow two of his Weapons: Destroy a target enemy unit.
card.flavor: "You were defeated when you believed I was as good as dead. I was victorious the moment I decided that I would live to see my next sunrise."

card.name: Atone Through Life
card.text: Reaction: After the resolution of a Battle action that destroyed one of your Personalities, choose your performing Deathseeker at the current battlefield: Straighten him. Give him a Force bonus equal to his current Force.
card.flavor: "Yes, I seek death. But I am still a Lion, and my honor demands that I fight until the day my torment ends." - Akodo Senichi

card.name: Balance in Water
card.text:
Water • Kiho
Battle: Choose your performing Monk or Shugenja: Move a target Personality to the current battlefield if there are any units there on the side opposing his controller's. If he moved, and another player controls him or the performer is Water, straighten the targeted Personality's unit.

card.name: Bestial Rage
card.text: Battle/Open: Choose your performing unbowed Nonhuman Personality and destroy one of your Personalities at his location: Give your Nonhuman a number of +1F Frenzy tokens equal to the destroyed Personality's base Force. Negate the bowing and movement of your Nonhuman (this turn).
card.flavor: "How does one fight a creature that disregards all pain, all wounds, in its blinding desire to destroy one's being?" - Isawa Mitsuko

card.name: Calculated Offensive
card.text: Battle: Choose your performing Tactician: Give him +2F. Give another of your target Personalities at any location +2F.
card.flavor: "We can muster only a fraction of our usual strength, hatamoto-sama, as our supplies are dangerously low. We can only deploy our greatest force where we can best affect the defenses."

card.name: Compromised
card.text: Limited: Choose your performing face-up Paragon Personality in one of your provinces: He infiltrates the Mantis and steals Koku from them. Reduce his Gold Cost by 2. Lose 4 Honor. The province will not be destroyed by battle resolution this turn.
card.flavor: "Have no fear, master," she answered. "I will find the secrets you seek, and none shall ever know I am among them."

card.name: Concentrated Fire
card.text:
Recon
Open: Bow one or more of your performing Scout Personalities: Destroy a target enemy Follower, or Personality without attachments, with lower Force than your Scouts' total Force.
card.flavor: "Iron is strong, but it can be broken. And we will break it, again and again." - Hiruma Todori

card.name: Controlling the Seas
card.text:
Thunder • Kiho
Open: Choose your performing unbowed Thunder Personality: Target one to three Personalities. Either give Naval to, or remove Naval from, each one seperately.
Reaction: After the resolution of another player's Battle action, choose your performing Thunder Shugenja at the current battlefield: Give a target enemy Personality or Follower -3F.

card.name: Crippling Weather
card.text:
Winter
Battle: Destroy all terrains in play. Until this battle ends, no new terrains may be played. After each time this battle an action ends, bow any Personalities who performed it.
card.flavor: Winter stops all wars. Yet all sides plot on, preparing for the inevitable spring.

card.name: Croplands
card.text:
Terrain
Battle: You have the ability, "Battle: Any number of times per turn, if any enemy units are at the current battlefield, choose your performing Personality and pay 2 Gold: Create a 1F Follower and attach it to him." (While this card remains in play.)
card.flavor: No clan lightly abandons its fields.

card.name: Draw Attention
card.text:
Focus Effect: After a Personality loses this duel, his controller loses 2 Honor.
Reaction: After the resolution of one of your Battle actions whose effects destroyed an enemy card: Gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "My blade will break his body, my victory will break his name." - Kakita Hideo

card.name: Endless Stamina
card.text: Open: Choose your performing Personality with a base Gold Cost of 7 or more: Straighten him. You may target and bow a Personality with a Gold Cost equal to or lower than his controller's stronghold's Gold production plus two.
card.flavor: "I will find time for rest when this war is concluded or, failing that, when my soul reaches the next world. For now, my lord has need of me."

card.name: Favor of Artisans
card.text:
Political • Winter
Limited: Choose your performing unbowed Artisan Personality: He offers an exquisite gift. Another target player may choose to have you gain 2 Honor. If he did not choose this, he loses 2 Honor. Draw a card.
card.flavor: "Even in this time of war, we should not forget to thank our allies for their friendship. Thank you."

card.name: Heroic Inspiration
card.text:
Heroic
Battle: If your side has fewer units than the enemy side, choose your performing Hero: Move him to the current battlefield. Straighten his unit if he moved. You may take an additional Battle action to take an action from a Strategy, which he must perform.
card.flavor: "Deserters and cowards have no use in my command."

card.name: Hidden in the Shadows
card.text:
Ninja
Battle/Open: Straighten one or two target Ninja cards.
card.flavor: "Do you truly wish to question the nature of the intelligence I provide, or do you wish to accept it and make use of it?" Shosuro Toson was impassive in his mask. "I have no preference, lord Lion."

card.name: Hunting the Daughter
card.text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Scout, and bow him unless the current battlefield's province was targeted by a Recon action this turn: Move another player's target Personality to this battlefield. Straighten him. If you are a Crab Clan player, you may take an additional Battle action.
card.flavor: "We will find her, Lady Reiha," Kiyoshi said. "I will flay the flesh from her bones until she confesses her sins."

card.name: Iainuki
card.text: Battle: Choose your performing bowed Kensai: Give a target enemy Personality -4F. If his Force is now 0, bow him and negate his movement (this turn). Straighten your Kensai's unit.
card.flavor: "Feign a staggered stance, allow your enemy to assume you are undone, and then strike at the base. Question the honor of the maneuver as you like, but you will live to face another foe."

card.name: Infamous Strike
card.text:
Political
Battle: Bow a target enemy dishonorable Personality. His controller loses 2 Honor. Your delegates go to war in court. Choose a player. Give all his Personalities +1F or -1F.
card.flavor: Heated words in court have drastic consequences.

card.name: Know the Terrain
card.text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Tactician: Bow a target enemy card, which must have no attachments unless you control a Terrain.
card.flavor: The Destroyers fell before Yu-Pan's assault. "Formidable and resilient they may be," the battle maiden shouted, "but they are nearly mindless, and fail to comprehend their disadvantages!"

card.name: Leaked Information
card.text:
Political
Limited: Choose your performing unbowed Magistrate: Target a Personality with Personal Honor equal to or lower than your Magistrate's Chi. The Personality's unit may not assign to a battlefield this turn unless your Magistrate is there. After each time your Magistrate's unit assigns this turn, assign the Personality's unit to the same battlefield (if legal).

card.name: Legendary Feud
card.text:
Political
Open: Dishonor your performing unbowed Personality: Dishonor a target Personality. After the next time he assigns this turn, his controller loses 2 Honor.
card.flavor: Jimen believed Noritoshi was involved in the attempt to kill him. Noritoshi believed Jimen was attempting to seize power. Only tragedy could follow.

card.name: Muscle and Steel
card.text: Reaction: After another player's action targets one of your Personalities, bow one of his attachments with a base Gold Cost of 7 or more: Negate either the action's bowing, destruction, or movement of cards in his unit.
card.flavor: "See to it that she is protected. It does not matter if you have to commit a thousand men and the finest blades ever forged by the Kakita, do not allow her to share my wife's fate." - Kakita Noritoshi

card.name: No Pure Breaths
card.text:
Maho • Kiho
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Monk: Ranged Attack with strength equal to his Force. Lose 5 Honor.
card.flavor: "Can you keep your faith in the Celestial Order when the air from your lungs turns to pure corruption?"

card.name: Out of Nowhere
card.text: Ninja Battle: Choose your performing face-up Ninja Personality in your province, and you may choose another such performing Ninja if there are units on the enemy side at the current battlefield: Your Ninja emerge from the shadows. Bring them into play at the current battlefield.

card.name: Panther Tattoo
card.text:
Tattoo
Battle: If there are any enemy units at the current battlefield, choose your performing Tattooed Personality who is face-up in one of your provinces or discarded (not dead): Bring him into play at the current battlefield, paying 2 less Gold and ignoring Honor Requirements.

card.name: Preparedness
card.text:
Dark Virtue • Unique
Limited: Target one of your provinces. Search your Dynasty deck for a non-Unique Samurai, show him and put him on top of your Dynasty deck. Discard a card from the province, refilling it face-up.
card.flavor: "Your lord is expecting me, samurai."

card.name: Preserve Your Forces
card.text: Reaction: After another player's action targets your Personality at the current battlefield, choose your performing Commander there: Transfer one or more of the Personality's Followers to one of your other Personalities (at any location).
card.flavor: "The left flank is overwhelmed. Transfer what forces you can from it - although most will die, a few will live to avenge their comrades on a later day." - Mirumoto Ayabe

card.name: Pure Breath
card.text:
Water • Kiho
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Monk: Target an enemy Personality who, unless your Monk is Water, must have Chi lower than or equal to your Monk's Chi plus Personal Honor. You may target and destroy one of the targeted Personality's attachments. Move him home.

card.name: Rain of Justice
card.text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Magistrate: Ranged Attack with strength equal to his Chi plus one. If this destroyed a card, choose a player, who gains or loses 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "The Crab have proven to be quite capable as allies." - Bayushi Hikoko

card.name: Rally Through Sacrifice
card.text: Reaction: After an action resolves that destroyed one of your Personalities during a battle, choose your performing Personality at the current battlefield: Attach a target Follower from your hand or discard pile to the performer, paying 4 less Gold.
card.flavor: "Leadership tells us that a noble example can inspire samurai to greatness. I tell you that a suitable death on the battlefield can inspire even more." - Tangen's Lies

card.name: Reckless Assault
card.text: Battle: Choose your performing opposed Berserker: Give him +4F/-1C. After the next time this battle another player's Battle action destroys him, you may target and destroy an enemy card without attachments.
card.flavor: "The Destroyers stand between us and our home. They will regret that." - Hida Shimonai

card.name: Second-hand Goods
card.text: Open: Remove one of your attachments with a base Gold Cost of 4 or more from the game: Draw 2 cards.
card.flavor: With the attention of the Mantis elsewhere, every grade of merchant tried to expand his business.

card.name: Shatter the Wave
card.text:
Heroic
Battle: If your side has fewer units than the enemy side, choose your performing unbowed Hero: Bow a target enemy card.
card.flavor: "Fatigued, starved, and surrounded. Even in this state, my brethren shall prevail this day." - Hida Benjiro

card.name: Shuriken and Smoke
card.text:
Ninja
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Ninja Personality: Ranged 5 Attack. You may move your Ninja home.
card.flavor: Takaharu left his mark behind him, as if he wanted people to know it was him.

card.name: Snowy Plains
card.text:
Terrain • Winter
Battle: Personalities and Followers at this battlefield have -1F while their controller has no Winter cards in any of his discard piles.
card.flavor: "War during the winter? Madness!" - Kakita Korihime

card.name: Southern Blockade
card.text: Open: If it is not the active player's first turn of the game: Target a province and put this card into play. While this card remains in play, Personalities and Holdings will not enter play from that province and its player has the ability "Limited: Pay 4 Gold: Discard a card in play titled Southern Blockade."
card.flavor: "Most samurai disdain discussing money. They assume that food, troops, and weapons are theirs by right. Most samurai are fools." - Yoritomo Utemaro

card.name: Strike Quickly
card.text: Battle: If you are the Defender, choose your performing unbowed Personality: Move him to the current battlefield. You may take an additional Battle action to use one of his base abilities. After the additional action ends, or you choose not to take it, move him home.
card.flavor: "We will find a way to destroy the creature. It is inevitable." - Moto Tsusung

card.name: Subversive Influence
card.text:
Kolat
Reaction: Before an Event resolves: It does not resolve. Shuffle it into its owner's deck.
Open: Shuffle each Kami Celestial in play into its owner's deck.
card.flavor:
"Here, this is a list of my favorite tea houses."
"I thank you for your kindness."

card.name: Taxing the Scum
card.text: Open: Choose your performing unbowed Magistrate or Courtier: Target another player's dishonorable Personality. Increase all Honor Requirements on Personalities in and out of play by 10 (except - HR). Choose a player, who gains or loses 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "There is always a price to pay."

card.name: Temporizing Ground
card.text:
Terrain
Battle: After the resolution of each action, except this one, the player who took the action targets one of his unbowed Personalities or Followers with a Force of 1 or greater at the current battlefield and gives that card -3F.
card.flavor: "When the position is such that neither side will gain by making the first move, it is called temporizing ground." - Sun Tao

card.name: The Testament of Fire
card.text: Battle/Open: If you have put a Ring into play this turn: Draw a card. You may put a Ring in your Fate discard pile into your hand.
card.flavor: "Brave soul, I have learned much from our duel. I honor what you have taught me, and I pray that the Lords of Death will reward you well." - Mirumoto Washizuka

card.name: Unnatural Hunger
card.text:
This card has -1 Gold Cost for each Undead Personality you control.
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Undead Personality: Destroy a target enemy card without attachments.
card.flavor: "You can hear things in the night, moving on the battlefield, feasting on the dead. I do not understand how the Crab were not all driven mad centuries ago." - Utaku Yu-Pan

card.name: Vigorous Sparring
card.text: Battle: Choose your performing Battle Maiden: Bow a target enemy Personality or Follower with Force equal to or lower than your Battle Maiden's Personal Honor. Gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor:
"I do not see the need for such constant drills, my lord Jin-sahn."
"Even in the face of constant war, discipline must be maintained, Danjuro-san."

card.name: Waves Rush to the Shore
card.text:
Kata
Limited: Put this card into play in your home. Discard any other Kata cards you control. While this card remains in play, you have the ability, "Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Personality with a Weapon: Bow a target enemy card without attached Weapons or Armor."

card.name: Well Scouted Target
card.text:
Battle: Choose your performing Scout: Increase or reduce the current battlefield's province's strength by 3. If you targeted that province with a Recon action this turn, you may take an additional Battle action.
Reaction: After a Ranged Attack targets a card: Give the Ranged Attack +2 strength.
card.flavor: The Dark Oracle of Fire was powerful but not invulnerable.

card.name: Winter Pilgrimage
card.text:
Winter
Open: Target a Samurai Personality. He goes on a winter pilgrimage. His unit may not be assigned to battlefields this turn.
card.flavor: "My father's shrine is two days' travel through the snow and ice. If I leave now, I can reach it by the anniversary of his death. I cannot bear to fail him by not offering my prayers."

card.name: Winter Seige
card.text:
Siege • Winter
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Commander: Give a target enemy Follower or Personality -4F. Starvation begins to set in. If it has no attachments and its Force is now 0, destroy it.
card.flavor: The irony that the Khan's march taught the Lion much about winter warfare was not lost upon their commanders.

card.name: With My Last Breath
card.text: Battle: Choose your performing Personality: Straighten him. Before the current Combat Segment ends, destroy him. You may take an additional Battle action.
card.flavor: "Far to the south the Crab Clan held on to the bloody margins of their lands. From Lady Reiha to the lowliest ji-samurai, they refused to surrender to the might of the Destroyer's armies." - Chronicle of Bright Fire

card.name: Embassy of the Crane
card.text:
Imperial • Market
