Invest [PAY 4]: Give Gojiro two +1F tokens. (After this card enters play, you may also pay the Invest cost to get the effect, once.)
After Gojiro enters play, lose 1 Honor.
card.flavor: Not all Crab who fall are victims of the Taint.

card.name: Hida Tadama
card.text:
Crab Clan • Berserker • Commander • Favored of the Celestial Dragon • Samurai • Unique
After the first time each phase Tadama is destroyed, bring him into play in your home, ignoring costs, and bow him.
card.flavor: "I carry the Heaven's power! Flee or die!"

card.name: Kaiu Sokakaze
card.text: Crab Clan • Samurai • Siege • Tactician
card.flavor: "The Kaiu were not idle in the peace that followed the Destroyer War. When the Dark Naga came, they were ready." - Otomo Hiroshi, Chronicle of the Serpent War

card.name: Toritaka Chokichi - exp
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Scout • Experienced • Unique
Battle: Bow a target Spider Clan Personality or, if Chokichi has a Follower, bow a target enemy card without attachments.
card.flavor: "Serpents or Spider, it makes no difference. All enemies of the Crab will perish."

card.name: Yasuki Daisuki
card.text:
Crab Clan • Courtier • Merchant • Expendable
(Draw a card after your Expendable card is destroyed.)
card.flavor: "A dangerous assignment? Surely not. My lord loves me too much for that."

card.name: Asahina Kitiaru - exp
card.text:
Crane Clan • Courtier • Monk • Experienced • Unique
Limited, [BOW]: Search your discard pile, then Fate deck, for a Ring. Show it and put it in your hand. Discard a card.
card.flavor: "Purify your heart. Only when you perceive your center can you be sure what desires are yours, and what is being forced on you by another."

card.name: Asahina Shigemitsu - exp
card.text:
Crane Clan • Air • Favored of the Air Dragon • Cavalry • Experienced • Shugenja • Unique
Open, [BOW]: Target one or two of your Provinces. After the first time this turn a Personality attacks one of those Provinces, gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "Peace, yes! But not at the cost of our honor! Never at the cost of honor!"

card.name: Daidoji Soken
card.text:
Crane Clan • Courtier • Merchant
[BOW]: Produce 3 Gold.
card.flavor: "I am no warrior, and nothing I can do can stop the Fudoists or their incomprehensible enemies. But I can put tools into the hands of those that can, and I will work night and day to see that this is done."

card.name: Doji Razan
card.text:
Crane Clan • Courtier • Magistrate • Samurai • Duelist
Invest [PAY 1]: Give Razan a +1C token. (After this card enters play, you may also pay the Invest cost to get the effect, once.)
Limited: Destroy a target Fudo card. Destroy Razan.
card.flavor: "Destroy this shrine! We shall have no more of this heresy!"

card.name: Daidoji Tametaka - exp
card.text:
Crane Clan • Commander • Iron Crane • Samurai • Scout • Experienced • Unique
Tametaka loses any duel against Yoritomo Hiromi.
Battle: Reduce the Force of a target enemy Personality or Follower to 0.
card.flavor: "Many Daidoji call themselves 'Iron Cranes'. Tametaka is one of the few who deserve the name. What a fight that was!" - Yoritomo Hiromi

card.name: Daidoji Tobei
card.text:
Crane Clan • Fallen • Samurai • Scout • Destined
(Draw a card after your Destined card enters play.)
After Tobei enters play, lose 1 Honor.
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 2 Attack.
card.flavor: "No clan or family was left untouched by the madness; it struck whenever and wherever a weakness could be found." - Chronicle of the Heretic War, Part II

card.name: Kitsuki Nakai - exp
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Magistrate • Samurai • Topaz Champion • Duelist • Experienced • Unique
Open: Give a target Personality -2F, or -3F if he is dishonorable.
card.flavor: "You are not the first Topaz Champion to find yourself in the Colonies, my friend," Kaiu Onizuka said with a smile. "Let us see what grand work we can find you."

card.name: Mirumoto Bojan
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Fallen • Samurai • Destined
(Draw a card after your Destined card enters play.)
After Bojan enters play, lose 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "P'an Ku!" he rasped. "P'an Ku! Do not withhold your blessings! Shower them upon us!"

card.name: Mirumoto Katagi - exp
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Experienced • Kensai • Unique
Battle, [PAY *]: Equip a target non-Unique Weapon in your discard pile to Katagi.
card.flavor: "The Colonies have provided me with a multitude of new weapons to master. Shall I show you, Crab? Or you, Scorpion? Who wants to be first?"

card.name: Mirumoto Omero
card.text: Dragon Clan • Samurai • Conqueror • Kensai
card.flavor: "Given a choice, I would not call the Spider allies. My lord wishes it, however, so I will slay any Crab or Scorpion who wishes them harm. That is the role of a samurai."

card.name: Togashi Noritada
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Fire • Monk • Tattooed
Invest [PAY 3]: Give Noritada two +1F Fire tokens. (After this card enters play, you may also pay the Invest cost to get the effect, once.)
card.flavor: "Most believe the Fire Dragon to be them most devastating. Few consider the power of the Frost Dragon."

card.name: Akodo Dairuko - exp
card.text:
Lion Clan • Clan Champion • Paragon • Samurai • Steel Lion • Conqueror • Experienced • Loyal • Tactician • Unique
Battle: Bow a target enemy Personality with lower Personal Honor. Destroy him if he is Unaligned.
card.flavor: "We shall wait no more! The Lion Clan marches today, and we shall not rest until Legulus is crushed beneath our feet."

card.name: Akodo Kamina - exp
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Experienced • Tactician • Unique
Battle: Ranged 3 Attack, or Ranged 4 Attack if the target is Lion Clan or Unaligned.
card.flavor: "No rest. No compromise. We will not rest until our Clan is pure and whole, a forged blade against the enemies of the Empire."

card.name: Akodo Nojima
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Fallen • Cavalry
After Nojima enters play, lose 1 Honor.
Destroy Nojima if he is ever in an army with a Personality with 3 or more Personal Honor.
card.flavor: His entire Clan had turned against him. No matter. He would keep moving and fight on for as long as he lived.

card.name: Ikoma Ayumu - exp
card.text:
Lion Clan • Hero • Samurai • Experienced • Tactician • Unique
Will not gain Fallen or Shadowlands.
The rulebook Tactical Advantage is an Open action for you if you target Ayumu with it.
card.flavor: "Ayumu is a beacon of hope to us all. Despite temptation, he remained true to the Clan." - Akodo Dairuko

card.name: Kitsu Ririko
card.text:
Lion Clan • Water • Destined • Shugenja
(Draw a card after your Destined card enters play.)
Ririko enters play ignoring Honor Requirement if you are a Unicorn Clan player.
card.flavor: "Relax, brother. This pain shall end soon."

card.name: Kitsune Yuko
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Earth • Kitsune • Nonhuman • Spirit • Shugenja
Invest [PAY 2]: Gain 1 Honor. (After this card enters play, you may also pay the Invest cost to get the effect, once.)
Limited, [BOW]: Gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "Don't be surprised, Doji-san. There is more to the Mantis than war."

card.name: Moshi Rukia - exp
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Thunder • Experienced • Naval • Shugenja • Unique
Battle: Bow a target enemy card without attachments. Destroy it if it is an attachment.
card.flavor: "Unfair? Blasphemous? The Crane are merely jealous. It is unfortunate for them that not one among the Asahina can match my power or resolve."

card.name: Moshi Sasako - exp
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Thunder • Conqueror • Experienced • Naval • Shugenja • Unique
Tireless Battle: Straighten Sasako. (Tireless actions may be taken while bowed.)
card.flavor: "The suffering... the slaughter. This war has ended just as Master Chukage predicted before he gave me the texts he had found and bid me to flee. I do not know what madness he has discovered, but it has wounded the Mantis deeply."

card.name: Tsuruchi Gombei
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Fallen • Samurai • Scout • Naval
After Gombei enters play, lose 1 Honor.

Maho Battle: Discard this Celestial. Give each Personality at this battlefield a -1C Blood token.
card.flavor: "Learn this lesson well: Blood and power are the only truths. All else is illusion." - Shahai

card.name: A Great Victory
card.text: Limited: After each battle resolution (this turn) in which your army destroyed an enemy army or Province, give each of your Personalities in that army a +1F/+1C token.
card.flavor: "I never thought I would want to share a victory with you," Tsudoken said over the cheers. "I never thought I would let you," Yuri replied with a grin.

card.name: Imminent Victory
card.text: Battle: If you destroy the enemy army or Province in this battle's resolution, give a +1F/+1C token to each of your Personalities in your army (at battle resolution).
card.flavor: "This is the hard part," the commander said to her aide. "Their blood is up, but will their discipline remain?"

card.name: Oracle of the Void - exp
card.text:
Void • Oracle • Retainer • Experienced • Unique
Negate this card's destruction.
Limited: Bow this card: The next two cards in provinces you refill (this turn) may be refilled face-up.
Limited: Bow this card: Draw a card.
card.flavor: "I see all. There is nothing beyond my sight."

card.name: Hidden Weapons
card.text:
You may Equip Weapons from under this Holding as a Battle/Limited action.
Limited: Put a Weapon in your hand under this Holding (face-down).
card.flavor: Honorable clans do not engage in deceit and misdirection. However, where they choose to store their weapons is no one's business but their own.

card.name: Imperial Sword
card.text:
Imperial • Weapon
This Personality has +1F while he is Imperial.
card.flavor: Let this blade guide your honor.

card.name: Chagatai's Wrath
card.text:
Unique
Limited: End the Action Phase. Discard this Celestial.
card.flavor: "I do not care what the reality of the situation is. I care only that my father is remembered as the great man he was. If it is only the peasants who remember him, that is a start." - Moto Taigo

card.name: The Inevitable Grasp of Conquest
card.text:
Maigo no Musha • Unique
Your Personalities have Conqueror.
Battle: Destroy one of your Provinces. Other players' cards will not destroy your Personalities this battle. Discard this Celestial.
card.flavor: As the threat of the Yodotai lingered in the mortal world, so too did it begin to manifest in the worlds beyond.

card.name: The Ways of Sensei Wu
card.text:
Fortune • Unique
Battle: Put a target Battle Strategy from your discard pile into your hand. Discard this Celestial.
card.flavor: "A sensei from the early Empire, a man who studied the ways of Akodo and Sun Tao. He sits amid the Heavens as a Fortune, and we venerate him." - Akodo Dairuko

card.name: Changing the Game
card.text: Limited: Search your hand, then your discard pile, and then your Fate deck for a card titled Blood of the Preserver. Show it. Remove it from the game to gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "Unfortunate circumstances prevent me from presenting this to your mother, as would be my wish," Kanpeki said with a low bow. "In her stead, naturally, I sought out the most worthy scion of the Imperial families to serve as her representative."

card.name: Marriage of the Emerald Champion
card.text: Limited: Put this Event into play. Target your Personality. While this Event remains in play, he will not be dishonored and you will not lose Honor from other players' actions that have targeted him. After your second turn from now begins, discard this Event.
card.flavor: The wedding of an individual like the Emerald Champion is an occasion of rare gravity indeed. The intended's family gains incredible wealth and renown, and typically hosts a celebration of enormous scope.

card.name: The Asahina's Shame
card.text: Open: Players may not use abilities on Personalities this turn.
card.flavor: "For centuries, you concealed the presence of a heretical sect from the Brotherhood of Shinsei within our lands because you believed that they were harmless eccentrics."

card.name: Purge of Fudoism
card.text: Limited: Starting with you, each player targets (if possible) and destroys a card with the printed Fallen, Fudo, or Shadowlands keyword.
card.flavor: Throughout the Colonies, the monasteries and hidden strongholds of the Fudo cult were sought out and put to the torch. Those who had embraced the blasphemous philosphy either recanted and were taken into custody, or refused, and were slain outright.

card.name: House of Prophecy
card.text:
Destined
(Draw a card after your Destined card enters play.)
[BOW]: Produce 3 Gold.
card.flavor: "The name is completely preposterous, and the claims they make are nigh blasphemous, but occasionally I find them useful." - Otomo Suikihime

card.name: Exotic Market
card.text:
Market
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
[BOW]: When paying for an Item, it enters play for 3 less Gold.
card.flavor: "The Colonies are a remarkable place. The things I see each day in this market are unlike anything ever encountered in the Empire."

card.name: The Sorrow - exp
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Magistrate • Paragon • Samurai • Yojimbo • Experienced Bayushi Tenzan • Loyal • Unique
While you control a Courtier, The Sorrow's printed ability is Battle/Limited.
Battle: Give a target Personality -4F.
card.flavor: "What drives you to him, Tenzan? Her order? Your grandfather's legacy? Your father's failure? Maybe it is your wife's willingness to drown in the darkness with you? Oh Tenzan, ever the Sorrow, ever the fool." - Bayushi Misaki

card.name: Jade Pearl Inn
card.text:
Interrupt: After you Recruit this Holding from a Province, search your Dynasty deck for a non-Unique, Gold-producing Holding with a printed Gold Cost of 1 and refill the Province face-up with it.
[BOW]: Produce 3 Gold.
card.flavor: A night of food, drink, and conversation can reinvigorate farmers, merchants, and samurai alike.

card.name: Hida Kaiji - exp
card.text:
Crab Clan • Berserker • Mutant • Nonhuman • Experienced • Unique
Will not attack or defend with other Personalities, and other Personalities will not attack or defend with Kaiji.
Kaiji has +2F while unopposed, or +1F for each Personality opposing him with 6 or lower printed Force.
card.flavor: "Run, little worms!"

card.name: Hiruma Koru
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Scout
Invest [PAY 1]: Create a 0F Follower and attach it to Koru. (After this card enters play, you may also pay the Invest cost to get the effect, once.)
card.flavor: "His mother was a Yasuki. Still, you wouldn't guess it from the way he fights." - Kaiu Esumi

card.name: Yasuki Jiro
card.text:
Crab Clan • Courtier • Kolat • Merchant • Shadowlands
Political Limited, [PAY 3]: Dishonor a target Personality.
card.flavor: "I am sure this is all a misunderstanding. Please, let this gift for your family serve as my amends."

card.name: Kaiu Esumi - exp
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Siege • Experienced • Tactician • Unique
Battle: Destroy a target enemy attachment.
card.flavor: "He seems to grow only more callous with each passing year." - Kaiu Kawachi

card.name: Asahina Umehiko
card.text:
Crane Clan • Air • Gardener • Expendable • Shugenja
(Draw a card after your Expendable card is destroyed).
Your Political actions may not target Umehiko.
card.flavor: "Our family once sheltered the followers of Fudo, thinking them harmless, if a bit confused. That time is over, and now I will aid in cleansing the Empire of their wrongful thinking."

card.name: Daidoji Gensai
card.text:
Crane Clan • Iron Crane • Samurai • Scout • Cavalry
Home Battle: If Gensai would be opposed, move him to the current battlefield. After he moves, you may discard a card to make a Ranged Attack with strength equal to the card's Focus Value.
card.flavor: "It would be easy, so easy, to take the shot. Were we not enemies a short while ago? Why do we now treat the Mantis as partners?"

card.name: Daidoji Tametaka - exp2
card.text:
Crane Clan • Commander • Iron Crane • Samurai • Scout • Experienced 2 • Unique
Mantis Clan players ignore Tametaka's Honor Requirement.
Battle: Give a target enemy Personality three -1F tokens.
card.flavor: "Our deals with the Mantis benefit both clans, filling our coffers and giving them a reason to watch out for our interests. What more could a Daidoji ask for?"

card.name: Doji Kurohime
card.text:
Crane Clan • Courtier
Limited, [BOW]: Straighten a target Honor-producing Holding that has not produced Gold this turn.
card.flavor: "No, I do not want to talk to you and no, you may not sit at my table. Bother me again and I will show you what my real anger looks like."

card.name: Doji Tatsuki - exp
card.text:
Crane Clan • Artisan • Courtier • Orator • Samurai • Turquoise Champion • Experienced • Unique
After another player's turn begins, straighten Tatsuki.
card.flavor: "Divine Empress, honored members of the Imperial Court, I bring you a tale of grief and woe, a tale of courage and duty fulfilled. I bring you the tale of the Imperial Legions and their fight to cleanse the Colonies of an insidious foe."

card.name: Kakita Ujirou
card.text:
Crane Clan • Magistrate • Samurai • Duelist • Reserve
(You may Recruit a Reserve card, if it would be opposed, as an Absent Battle action.)
Ujirou enters play for 2 less Gold if any other player is Mantis Clan. Ujirou enters play for 4 less Gold if you are the Defender.
card.flavor: "I am not impressed by doors."

card.name: Mirumoto Hatsuto
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Kensai
Battle: Give a target enemy Infantry Personality or Follower -3F.
card.flavor: "I long for a foe worthy enough to warrant my getting down from my horse. So far, not one have presented them self."

card.name: Kitsuki Miroken
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Courtier • Magistrate
Miroken has +2F while opposing a dishonorable or Gaijin card.
card.flavor: The Dragon were known to many for their acceptance of strange ways, but even they could not abide the notion of gaijin infiltrating the lands of Rokugan.

card.name: Mirumoto Kalen - exp
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Experienced • Unique
Fire Battle: Ranged 3 Attack. You may take an additional action to use Kalen's second printed ability.
Fire Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 3 Attack.
card.flavor: As his hands touched the bow, it seemed that the whispers of the wind grew louder and more lucid, almost like voices. "It cannot be," he whispered.

card.name: Tamori Shinji
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Earth • Reserve • Shugenja
(You may Recruit a Reserve card, if it would be opposed, as an Absent Battle action.)
Enters play for 4 less Gold if you are the Defender.
card.flavor: "The mountain does not move, eh, Crab? We shall see about that!"

card.name: Togashi Obote
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Monk • Tattooed • Void
Void Limited: Discard a card to give Obote a Force bonus equal to its Focus Value.
card.flavor: "In times of conflict and uncertainty, it becomes more important than ever to seek the center and find peace."

card.name: Togashi Noboru - exp2
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Daimyo • Fire • Monk • Tattooed • Experienced 2 • Loyal • Unique
Political Limited: Take the Imperial Favor.
card.flavor: "Apologize? Kuni Renyu is as unworthy of my apology as he is the regard many hold him in. In a just world, his idiocy and recklessness would be punished and bring him shame. Among the Crab, I suppose, such things are virtues."

card.name: Akodo Kano - exp
card.text:
Lion Clan • Master Tactician • Samurai • Experienced • Tactician • Unique
Kano's Force bonuses from the rulebook Tactical Advantage action are increased by 2.
card.flavor: "The blood of champions flowed through Kano's veins, and great was his desire to further prove his worth, even after the final defeat of the Dark Naga." - The Ikoma Histories

card.name: Akodo Uehara - exp
card.text:
Lion Clan • Imperial • Imperial Explorer • Samurai • Scout • Experienced • Tactician • Unique
Limited: Put a target Terrain from your discard pile into your hand. Discard a card.
card.flavor: "Many years have I taught at the War College. Now my clan has a different need of me. I cannot hesitate in teh faceof duty."

card.name: Kitsu Tamao
card.text:
Lion Clan • Water • Shugenja
Interrupt: After you Recruit Tamao, create a 2F/2C/3PH Lion Clan • Ancestor • Samurai • Spirit Personality.
card.flavor: "Your marriage seems to have softened you, brother. Does this mild weather disturb your stomach?"

card.name: Matsu Miura
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Naval
Battle: Give a target enemy Personality or Follower a Force penalty equal to Miura's Personal Honor.
card.flavor: "You must spend more time with the living, sister. You seem to have confused pity for discomfort."

card.name: Matsu Ryohei
card.text:
Lion Clan • Paragon • Samurai • Cavalry • Destined • Reserve
(You may Recruit a Reserve card, if it would be opposed, as an Absent Battle action.)
(Draw a card after your Destined card enters play.)
card.flavor: The threat posed by the Yodotai was not yet concluded.

card.name: Kitsune Merihiko - exp
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Earth • Ivory Champion's Advisor • Experienced • Shugenja • Unique
Your Nonhuman Spirits have the ability, "Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 3 Attack."
card.flavor: Following the war with the Crane, few will ever underestimate the children of Chikushudo again.

card.name: Kitsune Yamazaru
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Earth • Shugenja
Interrupt: After you Recruit Yamazaru, create a 3F/2C/3PH Mantis Clan • Monkey • Nonhuman • Spirit Personality with the ability, "Battle: Discard a card to give a target enemy Personality or Follower a Force penalty equal to the card's Focus Value."
card.flavor: "Let them play with us, friend."

card.name: Moshi Ikako
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Air • Fire • Naval • Reserve • Shugenja
(You may Recruit a Reserve card, if it would be opposed, as an Absent Battle action.)
Fire Battle: Ranged 1 Attack.
card.flavor: The Moshi family's familiarity with both Air and Fire serves them very well indeed.

card.name: Tsuruchi Shusaku
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Go Master • Samurai • Scout • Destined
(Draw a card after your Destined card enters play.)
Repeatable Battle, [PAY 2]: Give Shusaku +1F.
(Repeatable actions may be used any number of times per turn.)
card.flavor: "I find the game offers many insights for my other duties."

card.name: Yoritomo Toganin
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Magistrate • Naval
Invest [PAY 5]: Give Toganin three +1F tokens. (After this card enters play, you may also pay the Invest cost to get the effect, once.)
Toganin has +1F if any other player is Crane Clan.
card.flavor: The Colonies offered unprecedented opportunities for gain, and for graft.

card.name: Yoritomo Yashinko - exp
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Courtier • Experienced • Unique
Crane Clan players may Proclaim Yashinko.
[BOW]: Produce 3 Gold.
card.flavor: "A pity my husband is not here to show them what proper artwork is. Did I tell you of the sculpture he made in the Otomo Winter Court? These youngsters simply lack that sort of talent."

card.name: Isawa Tsumaro
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Air • Elemental Master • Tejina • Loyal • Shugenja • Unique
Air Home Engage: Move your target Air Shugenja home. Create a 0F/3C/0PH Air • Illusion • Shugenja Personality at the current battlefield; remove him from the game after the battle ends. While the Illusion is there, abilities on the target's spells have Home.
card.flavor: "Believe what your eyes tell you? Ridiculous!"

card.name: Natsumi - exp
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Nonhuman • Ryu • Water • Cavalry • Conqueror • Experienced • Shugenja • Unique
Will not attach Followers or Items.
card.flavor: "It is simply an amazing creature. Raw power and beauty given form. Its nature is mercurial, and its wrath both easily aroused and placated. That it is willing to enlist such wrath for our needs is both a blessing and a terrible risk." - Asako Chukage

card.name: Shiba Heirei
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Samurai • Yojimbo
Battle: If Heirei is opposed, discard a card to give him a Force bonus equal to the card's Focus Value.
card.flavor: "There are a great many things that remain unknown about the history of the Fudo movement. With what I have learned, I must believe that this is for the best."

card.name: The Broken Man
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Earth • Henshin • Monk
Invest [PAY 5]: Give The Broken Man two +1F tokens. (After this card enters play, you may also pay the Invest cost to get the effect, once.)
Earth Battle: Bow a target enemy card with lower Force.
card.flavor: "The secrets of the Earth shattered his mind. He has recovered, but all trace of his old life are lost forever."

card.name: Bayushi Jin-e
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Ninja
Will not attach Armor.
Ninja Open, [BOW]: Give a target Personality and Jin-e each a -1F/-1C Poison token.
card.flavor: "It is an unfortunate death, but one must be practical. Not every samurai can die gloriously, and not everyone deserves an honorable death. A man like me knows this better than any."

card.name: Bayushi Wateru
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Ninja • Samurai • Yojimbo • Reserve
(You may Recruit a Reserve card, if it would be opposed, as an Absent Battle action.)
Ninja Interrupt: After you Recruit Wateru during battle, take an additional Battle action.
card.flavor: "She is fast and discreet... the perfect yojimbo, really."

card.name: Bayushi Dijuro
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Siege • Tactician • Unique
Siege Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 3 Attack. If this destroyed a card, give this Province +2 or -2 strength.
card.flavor: "Patience is the foundation of strength. Those who do not understand this have already lost the battle."

card.name: Shosuro Chizuru
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Actor • Artisan • Loyal
Open: Discard a card to give a target Personality a Force or Personal Honor bonus equal to the card's Focus Value. The target has a maximum Personal Honor of 4.
card.flavor: "What a grand time! What a glorious place! Already I have been a Shinjo, a Mirumoto, and a Yasuki. What will be my next role in the Second City?"

card.name: Shosuro Takazaki
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Courtier • Ninja • Expendable
(Draw a card after your Expendable card is destroyed).
Political Engage: Other players do not gain Honor for destroying your cards in this battle's resolution.
card.flavor: "No, my Crane friend, I do not think so."

card.name: Daigotsu Kanpeki - exp2
card.text:
Spider Clan • Clan Champion • Monk • Paragon • Samurai • Conqueror • Experienced 2 • Kensai • Loyal • Unique
Tireless Open: Take the Imperial Favor. (You may use Tireless abilities even if bowed.)
card.flavor: Kanpeki met the accusing eyes of the court. "What ha happened in the past is irrelevant," he said. "We were at war then. It is different now. I serve the Empress, just as you do."

card.name: Goju Obayashi
card.text:
Spider Clan • Ninja • Shadowlands
After Obayashi enters play, lose 2 Honor.
Ninja Tireless Battle: Move Obayashi home. (You may use Tireless abilities even if bowed.)
card.flavor: The creature faded away with a low hiss. The apprentice made to sheath his weapon, but Kodanshi granned his arm. "No!" he whispered. "It is not truly gone!"

card.name: Nonaka
card.text: Spider Clan • Monk • Kensai
card.flavor: "There will never be peace between us!" the Crab shouted, and charged. "I disagree," Nonaka whispered, and bug his blade into the Crab's belly.

card.name: Daigotsu Chiboshi
card.text:
Spider Clan • Commander • Samurai • Shadowlands • Conqueror • Reserve
(You may Recruit a Reserve card, if it would be opposed, as an Absent Battle action.)
Battle, [PAY *]: Equip a Follower to Chiboshi. You may take an additional Battle action.
card.flavor: "Is there any challenge in leading soldiers with no will?"

card.name: Susumu Takada
card.text:
Spider Clan • Courtier • Master of Guile • Loyal
Invest [PAY 3]: Discard a card to gain Honor equal to its Focus Value. (After this card enters play, you may also pay the Invest cost to get the effect, once.)
card.flavor: "It is called the Blood of the Preserver," Takada told the court, "and it is our gift to Iweko Shibatsu."

card.name: Daigotsu Endo
card.text:
Spider Clan • Nonhuman • Samurai • Shadowlands • Undead • Destined
(Draw a card after your Destined card enters play.)
Limited, [PAY *]: If Endo is dead, Recruit him.
card.flavor: He stared at his decayed hand. "Emma-O has forgotten me," he whispered hoarsely.

card.name: Usui
card.text:
Earth • Fudo • Monk
After Usui enters play, lose 1 Honor.
Earth Battle: Give this Province +2 strength.
card.flavor: "Fudo fought the Mad Dragon centuries ago. His teachings exposed it to us. Were it not for this, the dragon would never have been defeated!" The monk sneered. "You should be thanking us!"

card.name: Iweko Seiken
card.text:
Heir • Imperial • Paragon • Samurai • Unique
Seiken will not be dishonored or gain a Clan alignment.
Interrupt: After you Recruit Seiken, Recruit a non-Unique Samurai with lower Gold Cost, ignoring costs.
Political Open, [BOW]: Take the Imperial Favor.
card.flavor: "Why does my little brother defend them? He knows their evil best of all."

card.name: Iweko Shibatsu
card.text:
Courtier • Heir • Imperial • Unique
Spider Clan players ignore Shibatsu's Honor Requirement. Will not gain a Clan alignment.
After Shibatsu enters play, gain 3 Honor.
After Shibatsu leaves play, lose 10 Honor.
Limited, [BOW]: Gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "I do not begrudge my brother his popularity. I only wish he would open his eyes."

card.name: Kitsune Kichi - exp
card.text:
Earth • Kitsune • Nonhuman • Onyx Champion • Shadowlands • Experienced • Shugenja • Unique
After Kichi enters play, lose 3 Honor and create a 4F/2C/0PH Badger • Nonhuman • Shadowlands • Spirit Personality with the ability, "Battle, [BOW]: Melee 4 Attack."
card.flavor: "I will not," she rasped. "I refuse to die."

card.name: Isidoros
card.text:
Gaijin • Yodotai
After Isidoros enters play, lose 2 Honor.
Battle: Straighten your target Follower.
card.flavor: "I do not wish to spend another moment in these wretched lands. Do you?" When none answered, he snarled, "Then do not question the commander again!"

card.name: Ide Mutsuken
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Courtier • Imperial • Liaison • Unique
Open, [BOW]: The active player must choose and bow one of his unbowed Personalities.
card.flavor: "Lady Suikihime, it is a radiant pleasure to see you once again. Your return to power will be cause for celebration, certainly. The Unicorn would be delighted to arrange the festivities, if you wish."

card.name: Iuchi Wattu
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Water • Shugenja
Limited: If Wattu is face-up in your Province, put him in your discard pile, honorably dead. If there are no other dead copies of Wattu there, refill the Province face-up.
card.flavor: "The river yield their bounty readily to those who know the proper means to ask. Arrogance ill suits a priest of the kami."

card.name: Shinjo Kinto - exp2
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Commander of the 9th Legion • Commander • Imperial • Samurai • Scout • Cavalry • Experienced 2 • Unique
Battle: Target two Personalities at different locations controlled by the same player. Switch their locations. After they move, straighten their units if you do not control them.
card.flavor: "I have taken a city, spent time as a 'guest' of the Spider, and now relinquish the city back to the woman from whom I took it. This is a mad land."

card.name: Shinjo Sujikaro
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry
Battle, [BOW]: Melee 3 Attack.
card.flavor: The Unicorn forces were driven to the brink of exhaustion, serving as they did at the forefront of the Imperial Commander's war against the cult of Fudo. Others aided in the purge, to be sure, but Shinjo Kinto truly trusted none save his own kinsmen.

card.name: Seasoned Ashigaru
card.text:
Ashigaru
Melee Attacks may not target this Follower.
card.flavor: "You may take rest from your worries, my lord samurai-sama. No enemy shall threaten this place in your absence. We shall not permit such a thing."

card.name: Black Riders
card.text:
Cavalry
Limited: Straighten another player's target Holding with Gold Cost equal to or lower than this Follower's Force. You, and not its owner, may use its Gold-producing and cost-reducing traits (this turn) as if you controlled it.
card.flavor: Their unit's name skirts the edge of heresy, resembling as it does the lost Black Guard of the Dark Moto.

card.name: Disciples of Ganesh
card.text:
Gaijin
This Follower has +2F while defending.
After this Follower is destroyed during battle, gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "The god of our fathers was lost long ago to the demon goddess Kali-Ma. We pay homage to his memory and pray for his return."

card.name: Senior Infantry Legion
card.text: Other Followers in this unit have +1F.
card.flavor: "In a well-structured fighting force, the young and inexperienced among your men will look to the veterans, those with experience and age, to distinguish them, and they will draw strength from their company." - Akodo's Leadership

card.name: Floating Reserve
card.text:
Reserve
(You may Equip a Reserve attachment, if it would be opposed, as a Battle action.)
card.flavor: "Foolish generals build armies that are like the mountain or the burning plains. Build an army like the wind and the river, and you shall wind your way to victory." - The Journal of Yogo Haruto

card.name: Long-Range Scouts
card.text:
Scout • Cavalry
Home Battle/Open: Transfer this card to your target Personality. (Home actions may be used from home.)
card.flavor: "Not one of those cultists escapes us, do you understand? Kinto demanded of the scouts. "You will scour every inch of this insane land until we have cleansed them all."

card.name: Court Scribe
card.text: Political Open, [BOW]: Increase the next Honor gain or loss (this turn) from your cards by 1 (Proclaiming gains are not from your cards).
card.flavor: "yes, very good, my lord. I think perhaps, if I may, a reference to the lady Doji-sama's recent performance in the poetry contest might emphasize your point with even more strength."

card.name: Legion of the Fallen
card.text:
Nonhuman • Shadowlands • Undead
After this Follower enters play, lose 3 Honor.
Before the first time this game another player's card destroys this Follower, negate the destruction.
card.flavor: "Deploy them against the Crab only when there is no chance of defeat," Kanpeki ordered. "I will not fuel Renyu's pitiable attempts to brand us traitors to the throne."

card.name: Commander's Steed
card.text:
Horse • Nonhuman • Cavalry
Will only attach to a Human.
This Personality has Conqueror.
card.flavor: "An exquisite, powerful creature. Fit only for those who prove themselves worthy and deserving of command." - Shinjo Kinto

card.name: Legulus's Legion
card.text:
Gaijin • Yodotai
After this Follower enters play, lose 3 Honor.
Battle, [BOW]: Melee Attack with strength equal to this Follower's Force.
card.flavor: "Remember your training, men, and today you will baptize your blades in the blood of samurai!" - Aulus

card.name: Stonemason's Hammer
card.text:
Weapon
This Personality has +1F while he is Siege.
Battle, [BOW]: Give this Province +2 Strength.
card.flavor: "The reconstruction of the Second City will be my glorious exit from this life. I shall leave my station as a samurai fulfilled, knowing that I aided in the most significant reconstruction of this generation." - Kaiu Iemasa

card.name: Khalimpeh-jiak
card.text:
Weapon
Engage, [BOW]: Give a target enemy Personality or Follower -2F.
card.flavor:
"What in the realms is that?" Esumi demanded.
"I have no idea," Gorobei grunted. "It looks ridiculous."
"Should we try it?" Esumi asked.
"Of course we should!"

card.name: Fortune's Charm
card.text:
Nemuranai
As a Focus Effect, the duel's winner may take an additional action.
Ranged and Melee Attacks targeting this Personality have -2 strength.
Before another player's card destroys this Personality during the Action Phase, negate the destruction and destroy this Item.

card.name: Dagger of Crystal Wind
card.text:
Nemuranai • Weapon
After your turn begins, give this Personality a +1F Obsession token; then, if he as more Obsession tokens than printed Chi, destroy him.
card.flavor: "I hear strange whispers in my mind whenever I hold the blade; whispers I cannot quite understand, that make me think of darkness and luminescent tattoos."

card.name: Ningen's 'Treatise on the Nezumi'
card.text: Multiplayer Open, [BOW]: Target a player. Until your next turn begins, each of you must invite the other to ally (if legal), and during Maneuvers, the invited one must assign a unit to an army where the other has a unit, and may not assign units elsewhere.
card.flavor: "It is rumored that my predecessor had a fondness for the simple, innocent Nezumi. I can understand how their childlike demeanor might be pleasant company." - Isawa Kimi

card.name: Tankoji
card.text:
Weapon
Battle, [BOW]: Actions from cards in a target Personality's unit may not target cards in this unit.
card.flavor: "Haha! What do you expect to do with that thing? It is not a real weapon, after all, and... Agh! Stop! I'm sorry! Stop hitting me!"

card.name: Tsujiken's Coin
card.text:
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
This card is worth 1 Koku.
card.flavor: "Take this as a token of my appreciation," the crime master said with a smile. "If anyone mistreats you, simply show it to them. If they do not cease, then I will want to know their name for a brief conversation."

card.name: The Earth's Armor
card.text:
Earth
While this Shugenja is defending, other players' cards will not bow him.
card.flavor: Norimichi's laughter rang out across the plain. "A mere priest?" he chuckled. "Defenseless? My poor children, you have made the most terrible mistake of your lives. Let me show you what the power of Earth can do."

card.name: Blistering Rain
card.text: Water Battle, [BOW]: Give a target Personality or Follower a Force penalty equal to your target Personality's Chi.
card.flavor: "If you were ill prepared for the weather, my dears, you should have remained at home."

card.name: Searing Siege
card.text: Repeatable Fire Battle: Discard a card to make a Ranged Attack with strength equal to its Focus Value or this Shugenja's Chi, whichever is higher. (Repeatable actions may be used any number of times per turn.)
card.flavor: "It is quite pretty, really, is it not?" - Isawa Koiso

card.name: The Wind's Champion
card.text: Air Open, [BOW]: Bow this Shugenja to create a 2C/0PH Illusion • Samurai • Spirit Personality with Force equal to this Shugenja's Chi, plus 1 if he is Air. Destroy this Spell.
card.flavor: "Where is your courage now?" the Crane said with a laugh. "Fleeing before nothing? What a shameful disgrace to live with."

card.name: Yojimbo of Earth
card.text: Earth Limited, [BOW]: Create a 1F Clay Soldier • Nonhuman • Yojimbo Follower and attach it to your target Shugenja without Followers.
card.flavor: "Thank you for this gift. I will use it in good faith, and it shall be returned when my task is complete."

card.name: Drawing on All Things
card.text:
This Shugenja has the element keywords of every Ring you control.
Open, [BOW]: Bow your target unbowed Ring. Straighten this Shugenja.
card.flavor: "Wind and stone, stream and flame. All that is and is not can be channeled by the spirit that balances itself in harmony with the universe."

card.name: Banished from the Realm
card.text: Open, [BOW]: Give your target Spirit Expendable. (Draw a card after your Expendable card is destroyed.)
card.flavor: "If I am to be denied the company of my ancestors," the Lion growled, "then I see no reason I should have to tolerate the presence of lesser spirits."

card.name: Chikushudo's Infusion
card.text:
This Shugenja has Cavalry while he is Shadowlands.
Open, [BOW]: Give a target Nonhuman card Cavalry.
card.flavor: With just a little bit of aid from one such as myself, the flesh of a natural creature can share in both the power of Jigoku as well as the Realm of Animals." - Kitsune Kichi

card.name: Reverse Fate
card.text: Void Interrupt, [BOW]: Give the first card discarded by the action +1FV or -1FV. (This does not affect cards focused in a duel).
card.flavor: "That which was shall not be, and that which would not have been, is. The tapestry of the Void allows all things to be rewritten." - Isawa Kimi

card.name: Move the Troops
card.text: Open, [PAY 2]: If this Strategy is in your discard pile, put it into your hand before this phase ends.
card.flavor: "Soon, we may not be able to engage the Spider without political ramifications. We must act, and quickly, before opportunity escapes us."

card.name: Provoked Violence
card.text: Political Open, [PAY *]: Bow your target unbowed Courtier. Destroy a target attachment with Gold Cost less than or equal to the amount of Gold paid, plus 3 if you control a Yojimbo.
card.flavor: "Be on your guard," he warned. "He is impatient, and I may prod him into a foolish reaction."

card.name: Two Steady Breaths
card.text:
Discipline [PAY 2] (You may pay the Discipline cost to play this card from the discard pile. Remove it from the game after the action resolves.)
Limited, [PAY 1]: Give your target face-up Personality out of play Destined. (Draw a card after your Destined card enters play.)
card.flavor: "Calm your mind," he cautioned the young warrior. "The secret of the universe lies where the world stands still."

card.name: Respect
card.text:
Kata • Kharmic
When Recruiting a Personality, if his Honor Requirement is higher than his owner's Family Honor, he costs 2 more Gold to Recruit.
Political Limited: Put this Kata into play. Discard all your other Kata.
card.artist: "Let us be reasonable to each other."

card.name: A Small Favor
card.text: Battle, [PAY 3]: Bow a target Personality. Lose 1 Honor.
card.flavor: The request had come easily to his lips, and the answer now lay in his hand. The pouch weighed heavily, burdened by the expectation of the future.

card.name: Lonely Battlefield
card.text:
Terrain
Personalities without Followers have -2F. Commanders have +1F.
Battle: Destroy a Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play.
card.flavor: The Colonies had seen much chaos over the years, and the bloodshed was not yet done.

card.name: Unchecked Fury
card.text:
Kata
Limited: Put this Kata into play. Discard all your other Kata in play with different titles.
Battle, [PAY *]: If this card is in play, Equip a Spell to your target unbowed, opposed Shugenja. You may take an additional action.
card.flavor: "You should fear the wrath of the Kuni," he said quietly. "Let me remind you why."

card.name: Benediction
card.text: Open: Destroy your target Holding. Give a Province +3 strength.
card.flavor: Despite the chaos, despite the conflict, and despite the unchecked madness, the priests continued their sacred work without ceasing.

card.name: Expensive Achievement
card.text:
Discipline [PAY 2] (You may pay 2 Gold to play this Discipline from your discard pile, then remove it from the game after its action resolves.)
Battle: Give this Province +2 or -2 Strength.
card.flavor: When need drives, few samurai care about expenses.

card.name: Desire
card.text: Political Open: Bow your target unbowed Human Personality. Target another player's unbowed Human Personality. His controller may bow him and gain 1 Honor. If he did not choose this, dishonor both targets, and both their controllers lose 3 Honor.
card.flavor: "Love is a game in Rokugan's courts... but sometimes the game costs both players their hearts, or even their lives." - Doji Shizue

card.name: Demonstrating Technique
card.text: Iaijutsu Political Limited: Your target unbowed Personality challenges another player's target Personality. Each Personality must focus exactly once, if possible. The winner draws a card. Dishonor the loser.
card.flavor: The rivalry between the Kakita and the Mirumoto will likely never be resolved, but each generation tries anew.

card.name: Unpleasant Truths
card.text: Battle: Give a target Personality a Force penalty equal to his printed Personal Honor. If he is dishonorable, bow him.
card.flavor: "In my life, I have often found that honor is not a guarantee of virtue." - The Writings of Agasha Kitsuki

card.name: Return to Action
card.text:
Discipline [PAY 2] (You may pay 2 Gold to play this Discipline from your discard pile, then remove it from the game after its action resolves.)
Absent Battle: If you are the Defender, target your Personality at home and move him to this battlefield. After he moves, straighten him.

card.name: The Legion's Might
card.text:
Battle: Ranged 1 Attack.
Favor Political Battle: Discard the Imperial Favor to make a Ranged 3 Attack.
card.flavor: The soldiers of the Imperial Legion are among the finest in Rokugan. A single legion's support can turn the tide of a war.

card.name: Never Without a Weapon
card.text: Battle, [PAY 5]: Discard a card to create a Weapon Item with a Force Modifier equal to the discarded card's Focus Value and attach it to your target Personality.
card.flavor: "Crab-san, I am not interested in listening to you blather about your clan's 'slighted honor.' If you will not let me drink in peace, you will give me the satisfaction of a rousing brawl, and as long as I have a hand, I can find a weapon." - Mirumoto Hatsuto

card.name: Lost Equipment
card.text: Engage: Bow a target enemy attachment.
card.flavor: "The followers of Fudo may be slightly less mad than P'an Ku's victims, but they are no less dangerous. It is our task to root out all who harbor forbidden texts, and we will not be stopped. Incidentally, if you do not remember to bring all of your spells, you cannot stop us." - Asako Misora

card.name: Find Your Center
card.text:
Kata • Kharmic
Limited: Put this Kata into play. Discard all your other Kata in play.
Battle: If this card is in play, straighten a Ring.
card.flavor: "Anyone can find their center in the quiet of a temple. Only one who truly understands the flow of the elements can do it in the tumult of battle." - Togashi Noburo

card.name: Knowledge and Power
card.text:
Discipline [PAY 1] (You may pay 1 Gold to play this Discipline from your discard pile, then remove it from the game after its action resolves.)
Limited, [PAY 1]: Destroy one or two of a target Personality's tokens. Give him as many +1F tokens as the number of tokens this destroyed.
card.flavor: "I understand!"

card.name: Planted Evidence
card.text: Ninja Limited, [PAY 10]: Destroy a target Personality with 3 or lower Chi, or with 4 or lower Chi if you control a Ninja Personality. Lose Honor equal to your Starting Family Honor.
card.flavor: "The Crab do not know enough to let sleeping horrors lie. I am going to enjoy this." - Goju Obayashi

card.name: Sleight of Hand
card.text: Battle, [PAY 4]: Target your opposed Personality. Put a non-Unique Battle Strategy from your discard pile into your hand. If your Personality is a Magistrate, you may take an additional action.
card.flavor: "My arm will be sore for days, but it will be worth it. I slipped those papers on him as neat as you please." - Yoritomo Tarao

card.name: The Way of the World
card.text: Absent Battle: If he would be opposed, move your target Personality at home to the current battlefield. If he is a Monk, give him +2F.
card.flavor: "Kuni Renyu was not totally satisfied with the peace brought by the defeat of P'an Ku and sought to make his dissatisfaction known to Togashi Noburo. Noburo would not yield the point, and so the Crab and Dragon were slowly but surely brought into conflict." - Asako Chukage

card.name: Concealed Reserves
card.text: Battle: Give Reserve to your target Personality in a Province. (You may Recruit a Reserve card, if it would be opposed, as an Absent Battle action.)

card.name: Dying Remonstration
card.text:
Bushido Virtue • Sincerity
Political Open: Your target unbowed Human Personality commits seppuku. A target player loses Honor equal to the Personality's Personal Honor or 4, whichever is lower.
card.flavor: Kanshi was the samurai's final means of protest. Where all words would fail, the pinnacle of persuasion was a quiet death.

card.name: A Moving Battle
card.text:
Terrain
Before this battle resolves, you may move one of your opposed attacking Personalities at this battlefield to an adjacent, unresolved battlefield.
Battle: Destroy a target Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play.
card.flavor: "A samurai's mind may desire peace, but his heart aches for war." - Daigotsu Kanpeki

card.name: Expanding the Gardens
card.text: Limited: Give one or two target Gold-producing Holdings +1 Gold Production each (this turn).
card.flavor: A kyuden's gardens are often as memorable as the palace itself, weighing heavily in the minds of potential dignitaries. Rival lords are always expanding their grounds, waging polite wars to outdo one another.

card.name: Thoughtless Sacrifice
card.text: Battle: Target your unbowed Personality. Target an enemy unit with Force equal to or lower than your Personality's Force, or Force plus Personal Honor if he is defending. Destroy both targets.
card.flavor: "In true combat, self-preservation cannot be your goal. Every thought, every motion, indeed every breath, must be spent only towards the destruction of your enemy." - Akodo's Leadership

card.name: Unseemly Alliance
card.text: Political Open: Bow your target unbowed Courtier. All Personalities have -1F for each Clan Alignment in their army (this turn).
card.flavor: "There are three aspects to making an unlikely alliance work. First, know his strengths. Second, know his weaknesses. Last, and most important, know when to stay out of his way." - Bayushi Makubesu

card.name: Vast Paddy Fields
card.text:
Farm
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold. If you bowed this Holding while paying to Recruit a Farm Holding, refill the Province face-up.
card.flavor: "They bring wealth, and thus, power. How fortunate that the Crane have so many." - Doji Etsuki

card.name: Togashi Ango
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Monk • Soul of Togashi Chikato • Tattooed
Ango has +1F/+1C for each Ring you control.
card.flavor: "I do not believe this lesson delivered the proper impact." Ango smiled. "Let me try again."

card.name: Rice Paddy
card.text:
Farm
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Battle, [BOW]: Bow a target enemy attacking Follower. Destroy this Holding.
card.flavor: "In the end, all the wealth of the Empire wells out of this mud. Something to contemplate, yes?" - Isawa Amiki

card.name: Temple of Harmony
card.text:
Temple
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
[BOW]: When paying for a Monk, he enters play for 3 less Gold.
card.flavor: "How many give harmony the service of their words! How few serve it with their actions!" - Isawa Kamiko

card.name: Collapsing Bridge
card.text:
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Open: Give a Province +3 strength. Destroy this Holding.
card.flavor: A Kaiu builds everything perfectly, even things he intends to break.

card.name: Alliance
card.text:
You do not pay the extra two Gold for bringing Personalities with the named Clan Alignment into play.
Open: Put this Event into play. Name a Clan Alignment other than your own.
card.flavor: "Our clans have shared both friendship and enmity. We must now ask ourselves, which one brought greater benefit to us both"

card.name: Yasuki Makoto
card.text:
Crab Clan • Courtier • Kolat • Merchant
Your Holdings enter play for 1 less Gold.
Economic Home Battle, [BOW]: Target an enemy Personality. His controller may pay 4 Gold. If he did, he loses 1 Honor. If he does not, dishonor the target and move him home.
card.flavor: They shall never die.

card.name: Deeds and Words
card.text:
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Interrupt: If it is the Action Phase, reduce one of the Honor gains or losses from the action to 0. Destroy this Holding.
card.flavor: The historians wait for the final word on the conflicts in the Colonies, so they know which tone to use within their records.

card.name: Daidoji Ujirou
card.text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Scout • Soul of Daidoji Gempachi
Engage: Raise Ujirou's Force, and the Force of a target Personality in his army, to equal to Force of a target enemy card.
card.flavor: "There is always someone trying to cause problems."

card.name: Doji Soeka
card.text:
Crane Clan • Courtier • Magistrate • Seductress • Soul of Doji Nenkai
Open: Target a Personality with lower Personal Honor than Soeka's Chi. Set his Force equal to his own Chi.
card.flavor: "Honor brings strength, and I am more than willing to remind the dishonorable of their weakness."

card.name: Susumu Neya
card.text:
Spider Clan • Courtier • Orator
Political Open, [BOW]: Give a target Personality (in play) +1PH or -1PH.
Favor Political Interrupt, [BOW]: Discard the Imperial Favor to increase or decrease a Proclaim Honor gain by 1.
card.flavor: "I am pleased you could join me this evening. Sit, and let us speak of things that are too sensitive for other ears."

card.name: Togashi Korimi
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Earth • Monk • Soul of Togashi Oki • Tattooed
Korimi has +2F while defending.
Interrupt, [BOW]: After you Recruit Korimi, draw a card.
card.flavor: "Is modesty not a form of pride? I thought you were above such things, Shiba-sama." The ambassador did not argue, but neither did his face cease its blushing."

card.name: Famous Bazaar
card.text:
Market
After you Recruit this Holding from a Province, refill the Province face-up.
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
card.flavor: "I enjoy coming here more than I should admit, dear friend. They have every fabric I could possibly want!"

card.name: Tamori Seiken
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Earth • Mountaineer • Cavalry • Shugenja
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to this battle. Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
card.flavor: "Only an uncultured brute would exploit the gifts of the kami for war." - Asahina Akahiko

card.name: Matsu Misato
card.text:
Lion Clan • Paragon • Samurai
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 3 Attack with +1 strength for every 10 points of Family Honor you have.
card.flavor: "Do you think age could dull her reflexes? Even time itself seems to cower before Misato-sensei's stare and pauses before her stance." - Matsu Tayuko

card.name: Moshi Madohime
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Scout • Thunder • Naval • Shugenja
(Once a turn, the Attacker gets the first Battle action, if it's from a Naval Personality's unit. Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
Thunder Battle: Fear 2.
card.flavor: "What shame is there in serving the Yoritomo family in war? My mother has performed her duty thus, and she is a revered member of this bloodline."

card.name: Political Standoff
card.text:
Kharmic
After a player gains Honor, or any of his opponents lose Honor from the rulebook or cards they do not own, give him an equal number of Influence tokens. A player who begins his turn with 50 or more Influence tokens wins the game. This Event will not be discarded or have its effects prevented.
Political Open: If no player controls a copy of Political Standoff, put this Event into play.

card.name: Minikui no Oni
card.text:
Nonhuman • Oni • Shadowlands
After you Recruit Minikui, lose 5 Honor.
Battle: Fear with a strength equal to your target Oni's Chi.
card.flavor: "One of these wretched beasts nearly set us to war with the Crab. Ensure that none of these filth can be found anywhere in our lands." - Akodo Dairuko

card.name: Severed From the Emperor
card.text:
You cannot win an Honor Victory or control the Imperial Favor. You have the ability, "Repeatable Interrupt: Negate a Favor action after it targets your cards (the Imperial Favor is still discarded). Lose 5 Honor."
Open: Put this Event into play. Discard the Imperial Favor if you control it.
card.flavor: "The Colonies have their purpose, certainly, but respectable? There are gaijin living there." - Bayushi Nitoshi

card.name: Utaku's Destiny
card.text:
One-Handed • Sword • Destined • Weapon
(Draw a card after you Equip a Destined card.)
card.flavor: "Let them stare. This was my grandmother's weapon, and I carry it proudly!" - Utaku Sang-Ju

card.name: Isawa Hibana
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Fire • Shugenja
(Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
Fire Battle/Open: Give Hibana -3F. Give your target non-Water Personality +3F.
card.flavor: "Fire is my gift, and I sahre it with any of my kin who can bear its weight."

card.name: Isawa Kouka
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Soul of Isawa Kimi • Void • Shugenja
(Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
Void Tireless Open: Give Kouka Air, Earth, Fire, or Water. (Tireless actions can be taken even while bowed.)
card.flavor: "How glorious the mountains are! What wisdom can be found here! Small wonder the Togashi build their monasteries on great heights."

card.name: Wisdom Gained
card.text:
Unique
Open: Starting with you, each player may search his discard pile and Fate deck for a Ring, show it, and put it in his hand.
card.flavor: Some seek the wisdom of the universe within monasteries, severing themselves from all outside influences. Others immerse themselves in the natural world in hopes of becoming one with it.

card.name: Ashigaru Fort
card.text:
Farm
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Open: If it is not your turn, target a Personality. Straighten his unit. Destroy this Holding.
card.flavor: "First lesson of war, Ichiro: Ashigaru form the backbone of any army. Treat them well."

card.name: Tsuruchi Longbow
card.text:
Bow • Two-Handed • Weapon
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 2 Attack. You may destroy this Item to move this Personality home.
card.flavor: "The yumi made by the Tsuruchi family are the best in the Empire. But if you think that is the secret of their kyujutsu techniques, then you are a fool." - Daidoji Ibara

card.name: Small-Time Bully
card.text:
Retainer
After you Recruit this Holding, if you control a Courtier or Magistrate, you may dishonor a Personality.
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
card.flavor: "He is an unimaginative brawler who goes after those weaker than himself. Perfect." - Yogo Haruto

card.name: Favors
card.text: Political Limited: Bow your target unbowed Courtier. A target player gains or loses 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "Doing a favor for a Scorpion is almost as nerve-wracking as obtaining one." - Doji Dainagon

card.name: Copper Mine
card.text:
Mine
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold, or 3 Gold if you are a Lion Clan player.
card.flavor: These rich mines would keep the Lion Clan wealthy, were the funds not needed to field the clan's extensive armies.

card.name: Brilliant Cascade Inn
card.text:
Geisha House
Reduce by 1 all Honor gains during the Action Phase for players without Personalities in play.
[BOW]: Produce 1 Gold.
Political Limited, [BOW]: Target a dishonorable Personality. His controller loses Honor equal to his printed Personal Honor or 2, whichever is lower.
card.flavor: "Yes, it looks elegant, but I would not be seen entering if I were you." - Doji Dainagon

card.name: Wandering Caravan
card.text:
Market • Retainer
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold, or 3 Gold if it is not your turn.
card.flavor: "And what do I have here? Does this amuse you, little one?"

card.name: Frontline Encampment
card.text:
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Limited: Give your target Personality +2F. Destroy this Holding.
card.flavor: P'an Ku's influence was only one of countless problems the Colonies faces. War, it seemed, was never far from them.

card.name: Iron Mine
card.text:
Mine
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold, or 3 Gold if you are a Crab Clan player.
card.flavor: Kuni Renyu will return to the mainland soon, and with him will arrive a torrent of turmoil and change.

card.name: Investigation
card.text: Interrupt, [PAY 2]: If the action is on an Assassin, Kolat, or Ninja card, then after it targets you, your cards or your tokens, negate its remaining effects except for Honor losses to its player, and he loses 5 Honor.
card.flavor: Even in a land where testimony has greater weight than evidence, few will deny the proof verified by their own eyes.

card.name: Yasuki Trader
card.text:
Retainer
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Limited, [BOW]: Shuffle an Item in your discard pile into your deck.
card.flavor: "They go everywhere and none of the other clans ever think about them, except to scorn their money-grubbing ways. I admire their brilliance." - Kuni Renyu

card.name: Moto Chinua
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Soul of Shinjo Genya • Cavalry
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to this battle.)
Battle: Bow a target non-Unique enemy Personality with no attachments and higher Force.
card.flavor: "Are you so sure of your strength, friend? Come test it against my blade."

card.name: Asako Sadaki
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Monk • Soul of Asako Suda • Void
Void Battle: Discard a Kiho or Spell from your hand to bow a target enemy card.
card.flavor: "My heart is a peaceful one, so I do not wish to kill you. But it is important that you not err in mistaking this for weakness."

card.name: Hida Ayahi
card.text:
Crab Clan • Berserker • Samurai • Soul of Hida Kashin
Battle, [BOW]: Destroy one or more target enemy Followers with total Force less than or equal to Ayahi's Force.
card.flavor: "I make sure to have the final say in every argument and the final blow in any fight."

card.name: Hida Kisada, the Little Bear
card.text:
Crab Clan • Clan Champion • Samurai • Siege • Experienced • Kensai • Loyal • Tactician • Unique
Your Provinces have +1 strength. Fear effects, Melee Attacks, and Ranged Attacks targeting your Crab Clan Personalities in Kisada's army have -1 strength.
Tireless Battle/Open: Straighten your target Follower or Personality.

card.name: Hiruma Itta
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai
Battle: Ranged 2 Attack (Destroy a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with 2 or lower Force).
card.flavor: "Quiet. Do you hear that?"

card.name: Hida Toranosuke
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai
Home Battle: Target your Personality at any location. Switch his and Toranosuke's location. Straighten their units as they move.
card.flavor: "There are few things that raise my ire more than a proselytizing Spider."

card.name: Hida Saiyuki
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Soul of Kaiu Hisayuki
Increase by 1 all Force bonuses Saiyuki receives (for the duration of the Force bonus).
card.flavor: Saiyuki finds great joy in the time before each battle, thinking of the carnage that will soon overtake his mind.

card.name: Hiruma Tsurao
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Scout • Soul of Hiruma Todori
Battle: Straighten your target Follower.
card.flavor: "Any Hiruma can track a target across the Empire. Only Tsurao can tell me where it plans to go." - Hida Kisada

card.name: Hiruma Moritoki
card.text: Crab Clan • Samurai • Scholar • Scout
card.flavor: "Brawn will only get you so far. Wits will take you to the finish."

card.name: Everpresent Fear
card.text: Battle: Fear with strength equal to the number of your Shadowlands Personalities at the current battlefield.
card.flavor: "If I cannot have fearless men, then by the storm I want men who will fight regardless!" - Yoritomo Hiromi

card.name: Yasuki Tono
card.text: Crab Clan • Courtier • Merchant
card.flavor: "The Heavens themselves have moved for love. In the end, only duty weighs more upon a man's shoulders."

card.name: Temple to the Elements
card.text:
Temple
[BOW]: Produce 5 Gold.
Open: Give your target Monk or Shugenja Air, Earth, Fire, or Water.
card.flavor: Everyone in the Empire acknowledges the power of the elements, but few understand them as deeply as the orders of monks and shugenja among the clans do.

card.name: Doji Etsuki
card.text:
Crane Clan • Governor • Magistrate • Samurai • Soul of Doji Numata
Battle: Bow a target enemy dishonorable Personality. Raise or lower this Province's strength by Etsuki's Personal Honor.
card.flavor: "The affair in the Colonies has created an unbelievable amount of paperwork and dishonor. I intend to use this to our advantage."

card.name: Kakita Amiki
card.text:
Crane Clan • Courtier • Samurai • Soul of Kakita Funaki • Duelist
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists.)
Political Limited, [BOW]: Another player's target Personality may challenge Amiki. If he does not, his abilities may not be used until your next turn begins. Destroy the duel's loser.
card.flavor: "My friend, I am quite happy to settle our disagreement here."

card.name: Ikoma Shika
card.text: Lion Clan • Samurai • Scout
card.flavor: "Her time among the Colonies and hunting the Yodotai have only added deadly experience to her prodigious talent. I would not trade her for any number of the Hiruma or Tsuruchi's vaunted scouts." - Akodo Dairuko

card.name: Doji Dainagon
card.text:
Crane Clan • Courtier • Imperial
Dainagon may Lobby as an Open action.
card.flavor: "In the aftermath of a crisis, the bold find opportunities."

card.name: Doji Makoto, the Smiling Blade
card.text:
Crane Clan • Clan Champion • Courtier • Samurai • Duelist • Experienced • Loyal • Unique
Your other Crane Clan Personalities have +1PH.
Favor Political Limited: Discard the Imperial Favor to draw a card.
card.flavor: "I am sure this will be a most interesting year."

card.name: Mirumoto Yasushi
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Soul of Mirumoto Kyuzo
Interrupt: After you Recruit Yasushi, give him a +1F or +1C token.
card.flavor: "The Dragon are known for their quiet, philosophical, enigmatic ways. This is why few anticipate the straightforward practicality of the Mirumoto. How fortunate for the Dragon." - Asako Izuna

card.name: Clear Water Village
card.text:
Village
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Battle/Open, [BOW]: Target a Personality. Negate future Fear effects on his unit (this turn).
card.flavor: Despite the dark events in the Empire and Colonies, it remains a symbol of trade and hope.

card.name: Tamori Katsumi
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Earth • Soul of Tamori Shaitung • Shugenja
(Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
Earth Battle: Discard a Kiho or a Spell from your hand to give this Province a strength bonus equal to the card's Focus Value.
card.flavor: The Tamori are many things; warriors, alchemists, philosophers, and pragmatists. It is easy to forget that they are also priests.

card.name: Mirumoto Tsukazu
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Soul of Mirumoto Minawa • Kensai
(Kensai may attach two Weapons, as long as neither is Two-Handed.)
Battle: Bow a target enemy Personality with lower Force and lower Chi.
card.flavor: "My father died defending the High House of Light with this sword. I will do no less! None shall cross this threshold while I draw breath!"

card.name: Mirumoto Shikei, the Laughing Dragon
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Clan Champion • Monk • Naga • Samurai • Tattooed • Duelist • Experienced • Kensai • Loyal • Unique
Limited: Look at the top three cards of your Fate deck. You may exchange one of them with one from your hand. Put the cards back in any order.
Battle/Open: Straighten your target Ring.
card.flavor: Who trusts the man who laughs?

card.name: Mirumoto Hikuryo
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Duelist
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists.)
Battle: Fear 2, or 3 if the target is dishonorable.
card.flavor: "Are you surprised, Kakita-san? This duel was decided before the swords were drawn."

card.name: Mirumoto Higaru
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Soul of Mirumoto Rosanjin • Kensai
(Kensai may attach two Weapons, as long as neither is Two-Handed.)
card.flavor: The Mirumoto style is called "Niten-Ichi," which means "two swords as one." It teaches the use of two swords at once, flurries of strikes, and the disruption of the enemy's rhythm. In parts of the Empire, it is called "the Coward's Way." But never to a Mirumoto's face.

card.name: Mirumoto Nokkai
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Tattooed • Soul of Mirumoto Tsuge
Nokkai has +1F/+1C while dueling, or opposed by, a Phoenix Clan Personality.
After the first time each turn Nokkai challenges a Personality, draw a card.
card.flavor: "My family may have forgotten, but I? I will never forget."

card.name: Tamori Shaisen
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Alchemist • Earth • Imperial • Soul of Tamori Shosei • Shugenja
Earth Limited, [BOW]: Shaisen prays to the Fortunes. If you control a Temple, gain 1 Honor. You may bow your Temple to straighten Shaisen.
card.flavor: "He possesses his father's wisdom and studious nature. He is an asset to our entire clan." - Mirumoto Shikei

card.name: Akodo Dairuko, the Steel Lion
card.text:
Lion Clan • Clan Champion • Samurai • Paragon • Experienced 2 • Loyal • Tactician • Unique
You may target defending Personalities with the rulebook Favor Political Battle action. After you destroy an enemy card during battle (including resolution), gain 1 Honor.
Battle: Give all your other attacking Lion Clan Samurai at Dairuko's battlefield +1F and +1PH.

card.name: Akodo Kenaro
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Soul of Akodo Ijiasu • War Leader • Tactician
(Battle: Discard a card to give this Tactician a Force bonus equal to the card's Focus Value.)
card.flavor: "Some say that one Akodo general is worth a hundred of any lesser school. I find such a statement boastful - we are worth perhaps only forty."

card.name: Matsu Agai
card.text:
Lion Clan • Deathseeker • Samurai • Soul of Matsu Agoro
Battle: Fear 3 (Bow a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with 3 or lower Force).
card.flavor: "My honor is lost, but you are hardly worthy to take my life and end my shame."

card.name: Isawa Amihiko
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Earth • Mountaineer • Soul of Isawa Wakasa • Shugenja
(Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
Earth Interrupt: If the action is an Attacker's Battle action taken before the Defender's first opportunity to act or pass, discard a card to negate its effects, and gain 2 Honor if the card was a Spell.
card.flavor: "The earth cries out for order, and I shall serve it!"

card.name: Matsu Choiko
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Soul of Matsu Ryoichi
Battle: Target another of your Lion Clan Personalities. Give Choiko a Force or Chi bonus equal to the target's Personal Honor.
card.flavor: Few Matsu exalt in the brotherhood of fellow Lion as much as she.

card.name: Matsu Tayuko
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Soul of Matsu Aoiko
Tayuko has +2F while attacking.
card.flavor: "Fill your soul with duty, and fear cannot enter it. Fill your mind with devotion, and failure leaves it. Fill your strike with honor, and your enemy cannot withstand it."

card.name: Matsu Rutaro
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Soul of Matsu Turi
Favor and Lobby actions cannot target Rutaro.
card.flavor: "Some have called him a monster for his actions in battle. They simply lack knowledge of what a true monster is." - Matsu Agai

card.name: Iweko Honor Guard
card.text:
Guard • Imperial
Negate Fear effects targeting this Follower. This Follower has +2F while you control the Imperial Favor. If this Personality ever attacks, destroy this Follower.
card.flavor: Appointment to the Imperial Palace is an honor that only a fool would turn away from.

card.name: Ikoma Yoshimoko
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Scout
Battle: Fear 2, or Fear 3 if you control a Terrain.
card.flavor: "My sister's tactics are... inventive. Our enemies laid down their weapons once, believing she had twenty archers hidden behind her." - Ikoma Ichimoko

card.name: Yoritomo Ichido
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Soul of Kindari • Naval
(Once a turn, the Attacker gets the first Battle action, if it's from a Naval Personality's unit.)
Battle, [BOW]: Move a target enemy non-Naval Personality home and bow his unit as he moves.
card.flavor: "Dishonorable? Underhanded? My friend, I'm afraid you are merely upset our tactics are so effective."

card.name: Kitsune Parumba
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Earth • Shugenja
(Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
Earth Interrupt: After you Recruit Parumba, create a 3F/2C/3PH Mantis Clan • Boar • Nonhuman • Spirit with the ability, "Battle: Melee 2 Attack."
card.flavor: "My name? MY parents were fascinated with the Naga, and I have to say I may have inherited their curiosity."

card.name: Yoritomo Matsuo
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Soul of Seppun Matsuo • Kensai • Naval
(Kensai may attach two Weapons, as long as neither is Two-Handed.)
Equipping Weapons to Matsuo is a Battle/Open action for you.
card.flavor: "My ancestry is strange, true, but then - everybody's strange."

card.name: Kitsune Kohaki
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Earth • Kitsune • Nonhuman • Spirit • Shugenja
(Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
card.flavor: The spirits of the Realm of Animals, Chikushudo, share a special connection to the Kitsune Forest. They have, over the centuries, formed a close bond with the Kitsune family, as well.

card.name: Tsuruchi Rin
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Bounty Hunter • Samurai
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 2 Attack. If this destroys a card, produce 1 Gold (which can be used later this phase).
card.flavor: More than one criminal has mistaken a Tsuruchi's wish to collect their bounty as a sign that they can be bribed. It is not a mistake made twice.

card.name: Tsuruchi Kaito
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 3 Attack.
Tireless Battle: Move Kaito home.
card.flavor: "Yes, I am certain I would have lost in an extended, face-to-face fight with him. You see, then, why I avoided it?"

card.name: Yoritomo Hiromi, the Growing Storm
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Clan Champion • Samurai • Thunder • Experienced 2 • Kensai • Loyal • Naval • Unique
Personalities opposing Hiromi have -1F if you took the first Battle action in this battle (including during that action).
Thunder Engage: Your Ranged Attacks during this battle have +1 Strength.
card.flavor: "The Colonies are many things, but never dull."

card.name: Bayushi Shizuka
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Courtier • Samurai • Soul of Bayushi Saya
Political Open: Target a Personality. After the next time (this turn) his controller assigns him, targets him, or resolves an action on a card in his unit, his controller loses Honor equal to his Personal Honor, then dishonor him.
card.flavor: "Leave the Colonies? Akodo-san, I think that would be unwise."

card.name: Court Attendants
card.text:
Can only attach to a Courtier.
Limited, [BOW]: Straighten a target Personality with a Political ability.
card.flavor:
"My students can handle whatever is required of them," said Dainagon.
"Care to wager on that?" Makiko asked.

card.name: Agasha Kyokuta
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Alchemist • Fire • Soul of Agasha Yuhiko • Void • Shugenja
(Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
Fire Void Battle: Discard a card with an element keyword to give Kyokuta a Force bonus equal to the card's Focus Value. You may make a Ranged Attack with strength equal to that Focus Value.
card.flavor: "Shall I show you what I see?"

card.name: Isawa Kamiko
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Air • Cavalry • Shugenja
(Once per turn, as an Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to this battlefield. Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
Air Battle, [BOW]: Move home a target Personality.
card.flavor: "The kami of the air love to dance, and it amuses them greatly when I try to dance with them."

card.name: Shiba Michiki
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Samurai • Yojimbo
After you lose Honor from your own cards, Michiki commits Seppuku. (Honor loss from dying dishonorably is from the rulebook, not your own cards.)
card.flavor: "I will never serve a lord whom I do not respect."

card.name: Isawa Shunryu, the Infinite Eye
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Elemental Master • Void • Loyal • Shugenja • Unique
Before you draw cards at the end of your turn, draw a card.
Void Home Battle, [BOW]: Give all your opposed Samurai +1F, or all enemy Personalities -1F.
card.flavor: "Master Kimi was a voice of power and wisdom. For now, I can only echo it."

card.name: Ninube Shiho
card.text:
Spider Clan • Ninja • Shadowlands • Unmaker • Shugenja
After you Recruit Shiho, lose 1 Honor.
Ninja Battle: Put Shiho on top of your Dynasty deck (face-down). Put all cards without attachments in a target enemy Personality's unit on the bottom of their appropriate deck.
card.flavor: "I sustain myself on the essence of the honorable. Delicious."

card.name: Isawa Kosea
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Earth • Shugenja
(Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
Earth Battle, [PAY *]: Equip a Spell to Kosea. You may take an additional action from the Spell.
card.flavor: "His power is great, and he uses it with grace and wisdom. I am sure he will progress far in this life." - Asako Sadaki

card.name: Shiba Eraki
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Ritual Master • Samurai • Soul of Shiba Yoma • Yojimbo
Before your Spell or Kiho action resolves, if Eraki is at the current battlefield, give him +1F/+1C.
card.flavor: "It is simple enough. Set your mind in the correct pattern and your body will conform."

card.name: Shiba Tsukimi, the Blind Phoenix
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Clan Champion • Daimyo • Samurai • Shiba's Soul • Cavalry • Duelist • Experienced 5 • Loyal
(Tsukimi is not Unique).
Tsukimi has the element keywords of all Personalities you control. Tsukimi can attach Spells and has Shugenja while she has a Spell.
card.flavor: "The longer I live, the less change seems to matter."

card.name: Shiba Myoushi
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Samurai • Soul of Shiba Yobei • Yojimbo
After a Spell action that targeted Myoushi resolves, give him a Void token.
Repeatable Battle/Open: Destroy a Void token on Myoushi to give him +1F, +1C, or +1PH.
card.flavor: "I am not a shugenja, but the Void gives me all things."

card.name: Bayushi Akane
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Courtier • Soul of Bayushi Kurumi
Political Home Battle, [BOW]: Target a Personality. His controller may dishonor him. If he did not become dishonorable (or was already dishonorable), give him -3F.
card.flavor: "Something obviously troubles you, Kakita-sama... there must be some way that I can help."

card.name: Shosuro Hotaka
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Courtier • Destined
Invest [PAY 2]: Discard a card from your hand to make a target player lose Honor equal to half the Focus Value, rounded up.
card.flavor: "He was instrumental in Otomo Suikihime's escape and restoration to power. Of course, she does not know here was merely following orders... let her believe that he is her savior for now." - Bayushi Shibata

card.name: Bayushi Nitoshi, the Poison Mask
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Clan Champion • Courtier • Ninja • Samurai • Shoju's Soul • Sociopath • Experienced 2 • Loyal • Unique
You may use your Stronghold's abilities twice per turn.
Political Limited/Engage: Dishonor a target Personality.
card.flavor: "I'm afraid it is too soon to die, yet. There is still unfinished business."

card.name: Shosuro Keiichi
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Ninja • Samurai • Soul of Shosuro Osamito
Ninja Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 3 Attack. You may discard a card to straighten Keiichi.
card.flavor: Even an impenetrable keep is no obstacle to a skillful and clever shinobi.

card.name: Bayushi Meiko
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Courtier • Samurai • Soul of Bayushi Maemi
Ranged Attacks targeting Meiko have -3 strength.
Battle: Give a target enemy Personality -3F. Dishonor him if his Force is now 0.
card.flavor: "And now, you will tell no one."

card.name: Shosuro Rokujo
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Courtier • Goryo • Nonhuman • Shugenja
(Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
card.flavor: "Can you even recall how you died?" Akane asked. The woman could not reply. She only stared with abyssal eyes.

card.name: Yogo Honami
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Courtier • Spirit • Shugenja
(Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
Political Interrupt, [BOW]: Increase any Honor loss from the action by 1.
card.flavor: "Your father intends to visit me soon," the spirit said. Nitoshi narrowed his eyes.

card.name: Moto Alagh
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Soul of Moto Yuudai • Cavalry • Conqueror
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to this battlefield. A Conqueror's unit doesn't bow after battle.)
card.flavor: They were charged with exploration of the outside world. They were very good at their assignment.
