card.name: Daigotsu Geiko
card.text:
Spider Clan • Samurai • Soul of Daigotsu Keigo
After a Dark Virtue, Fear, or Maho action resolves, if Geiko is at the current battlefield, give him +1F.
card.flavor: "I have no quarrel with you, Crab. If you choose to force the issue, it will be by your own action that your life reaches its end."

card.name: Daigotsu Kanpeki, the Shadow Emperor
card.text:
Spider Clan • Clan Champion • Monk • Paragon • Samurai • Conqueror • Kensai • Experienced 3 • Loyal • Unique
Reduce your Honor losses from your cards by 1, to a minimum of 1. After your Fear action at Kanpeki's battlefield bows a Follower, destroy it.
Battle: Take two additional Battle actions.
card.flavor: "I serve the Empress. Though Shibatsu has earned our respect, he knows his brother possesses a strength that can be respected as well."

card.name: Daigotsu Roburo
card.text:
Spider Clan • Paragon • Samurai • Shadowlands • Soul of Daigotsu Bundoru
Battle: Fear 4 (Bow a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with 4 or lower Force).
card.flavor: "Your presence among us is a great honor, Shibatsu-sama. So long as you are among us, one of my finest men will protect you at all times. Roburo is such a man, and will give his life for yours, if necessary." - Daigotsu Kanpeki

card.name: Susumu Yanada
card.text:
Spider Clan • Courtier
You are considered to have +5 Family Honor when Lobbying checks Honor.
Interrupt, [BOW]: The Fear action destroys any cards it bows.
card.flavor: "Our ranks grow with each passing year, my friend. I depend upon your presence in the outer courts to ensure that we remain both prestigious and accessible to those who might serve us." - Susumu Kurako

card.name: Hiyamako
card.text:
Spider Clan • Monk • Kensai
(Kensai may attach two Weapons, as long as neither is Two-Handed.)
card.flavor: "A Spider, a monk, and a woman?" the Crab laughed. "How completely insignificant!" A flick of her wrists extended her blades. "You will regret every one of those words," she said calmly.

card.name: Sandayu
card.text:
Spider Clan • Monk • Order of the Spider • Soul of Torao • Kensai
(Kensai may attach two Weapons, as long as neither is Two-Handed.)
Battle/Open: Straighten a target Personality with a Weapon.
card.flavor: It was said by most that peace reigned in the Colonies, and such was surely true. All things are relative, however, and peace is no different.

card.name: Suikotsu
card.text:
Spider Clan • Monk • Order of Venom • Kensai
Battle: Bow a target enemy Personality with lower Force and without a Weapon.
card.flavor: The Order of the Spider are monks in service of the Spider Clan. One sect within that larger order, the Order of Venom, is responsible for maintaining relations with the greater Brotherhood of Shinsei, tense though those relations might be.

card.name: Daigotsu Onosaka
card.text:
Spider Clan • Samurai • Shadowlands
Interrupt: Give one of the action's Fear effects +1 strength.
card.flavor: "There is much to be found in the Colonies that can augment one's power, if you are strong enough to seize it."

card.name: Brothers of Jade
card.text:
Jade • Monk
Battle: Straighten a target Daimyo, Duelist, or Kensai Personality.
card.flavor: "They are advisors and guides, but sometimes the Togashi are willing to take a more direct hand in the affairs of the Empire." - Mirumoto Shikei

card.name: Myuken
card.text:
Actor • Ronin • Soul of Kyogen
Open: Myuken copies one keyword from your target Personality.
card.flavor: "Watch now, honorable guests, as I reinact the final moments of the great Toturi I, the Splendid Emperor!"

card.name: Legion of Toshigoku
card.text:
Spirit • Expendable
(Draw a card after your Expendable card dies.)
Tireless Battle: Destroy this Follower (Tireless actions can be taken even while bowed).
card.flavor: The restless spirits of the Realm of Slaughter do not carry the Shadowlands Taint, but they are murderous and unpredictable regardless.

card.name: Horobei
card.text:
Ronin • Samurai • Yojimbo • Duelist • Kensai
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists. Kensai may attach two Weapons, as long as neither is Two-Handed.)
card.flavor: "I am a man without a master, yes. I am samurai nonetheless. Do not believe that because my blade can be hired, that my honor is for sale. I would sooner die with my honor intact and your blood upon my sword than perish having disgraced myself."

card.name: Komori Taruko
card.text:
Air • Bat Clan • Shugenja
(Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
Air Tireless Open: Straighten Taruko. (Tireless actions can be taken even while bowed.)
card.flavor: The shugenja of the Bat Clan are tasked with communicating with the spirits of the dead, should the Empress require such a thing. They are not without other gifts, however.

card.name: Blessed Sword
card.text:
One-Handed • Sword • Weapon
After you Equip this Item, gain 1 Honor.
Before this Personality is dishonored, destroy this Item and negate the dishonoring.
card.flavor: "Every sword has a spirit. The goal of the swordsman is to awaken it." - Kakita Izumiko

card.name: Ogre Bushi
card.text:
Nonhuman • Ogre • Shadowlands
Cannot attach Armor or Followers.
card.flavor: "There is nothing in the Shadowlands that I fear. There is little that I find worthy of consideration at all. Were I to lower myself to respect such an enemy, however... perhaps a skilled ogre warrior might be such a foe." - Hida Kisada

card.name: Rae Sensei
card.text:
Phoenix Clan
Actions on your Spells have Home if you target your Samurai with them.

(+1 Province Strength, -1 Gold Production)
card.flavor: "A man who has seen the Dragon of Fire occupy the Imperial City as well as the Destroyer Horde defeated by honorable samurai has much to teach us all." - Shiba Tsukimi

card.name: Souls of the Fallen
card.text:
Spirit
This Personality cannot attack unless he is a Shugenja.
Battle: Fear 2, or Fear 4 if the target is a Follower.
card.flavor: "They are not bound or raised like the filthy undead. They have a purpose yet unfulfilled, and you are in their way." - Kitsu Miro

card.name: Noekam
card.text:
Commander • Nonhuman • Shadowlands • Undead • Zombie
After you Recruit Noekam, lose 5 Honor. Noekam's Undead Followers have +1F.
Battle: Fear with strength equal to the number of Undead cards in this unit.
card.flavor: "Many think me dead. They are right, of course, and I find the irony inescapable. How can they assume that which is dead can die again?"

card.name: Hida Reigoro
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Soul of Hida Renga
Battle: Bow Reigoro's target unbowed Follower. The enemy leader targets and bows one of his unbowed Followers or Personalities.
card.flavor: "We are the simplest family in all of Rokugan. Get in our way and get hit. That's all there is to it."

card.name: Yotsu Shinzai
card.text:
Soul of Yotsu Seiki • Shugenja
(Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged Attack with strength equal to Shinzai's Chi.
card.flavor: "My line is long, honorable, and generally overlooked. I will change the latter during my lifetime, I assure you of that."

card.name: Moto Ulagan
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Water • Shugenja
(Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
Water Limited: A target Personality in a discard pile becomes honorably dead.
card.flavor: "Death is the humbling fate awaiting us all."

card.name: Ide Okinomi
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Courtier • Merchant • Loyal
Economic Open, [BOW]: If it is another player's turn, he may pay 2 Gold. If he did not, gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "War is nothing to be celebrated. It is my duty to find better ways."

card.name: Moto Okano
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai
Battle: Give a target enemy Personality or Follower -3F.
card.flavor: The Moto honor the ways of their ancestors, but are viewed as barbarians by many in the Empire.

card.name: Moto Naleesh, the Living Goddess
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Clan Champion • Commander • Kami • Naga • Paragon • Samurai • Cavalry • Experienced • Loyal • Tactician • Unique
Infantry Personalities opposing Naleesh have -1F. After you Recruit a Personality during battle, gain 1 Honor.
Engage: Give Reserve to a target face-up Unicorn Clan Personality in your Province.
card.flavor: We are ready, thuderous and overwhelming.

card.name: Utaku Hyo-Yeon
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Scout • Soul of Shinjo Hee-Young • Cavalry • Loyal • Reserve
(You may Recruit a Reserve Personality, if he would be opposed, as an Absent Battle action.)
card.flavor: "It's time for our generation to show our strength."

card.name: Utaku Izimi
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Battle Maiden • Samurai • Soul of Utaku Etsuko • Cavalry
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to this battle.)
Battle: Bow a target enemy Infantry Personality with no Followers and lower Force.
card.flavor: The Utaku worked tirelessly to protect the villages during the chaos. Their actions will not be forgotten.

card.name: Doji Katata
card.text:
Crane Clan • Courtier
Katata cannot attack or defend. You may take Favor Battle actions one additional time per turn.
Political Home Battle/Open, [BOW]: Take the Imperial Favor.
card.flavor: "I think an important point has been overlooked."

card.name: Baraunghar Scouts
card.text:
Scout • Cavalry
Open: Create a 3F/1C/1PH Scout • Cavalry Personality. Remove this Follower from the game.
card.flavor: "Trying to anticipate the tactics of the Unicorn is pointless. They move and shift just when you think you have discerned their attack. No, better to simply prepare for a counter-move." - Akodo Dairuko

card.name: Kikage Zumi Initiates
card.text:
Tattooed
Negate Fear effects targeting this Follower.
Battle: Fear 2 (Bow a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with 2 or lower Force).
card.flavor: "The Togashi seek knowledge of inner truth and purpose. Violence can be truth. Destruction can be a purpose." - Tamori Yayu

card.name: Chagatai's Legion
card.text:
Cavalry
Battle, [BOW]: Destroy a target Terrain.
card.flavor: Despite the controversy heaped upon Chagatai's name, the Legion has never been disbanded. Their ruthlessness and fury honor his memory.

card.name: Firestorm Legion
card.text:
Shugenja
(Followers cannot attach or cast Spells/)
Attaches to a Phoenix Clan Personality for 1 less Gold.
Fire Battle, [BOW]: Ranged Attack with strength equal to this Personality's Chi.
card.flavor: A Phoenix roused to violence is a terrible thing to behold.

card.name: Ashigaru Spearmen
card.text:
Ashigaru
When you Equip this Follower from your hand, draw a card after your next Dynasty Phase begins.
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 1 Attack.
card.flavor: One samurai may be worth twenty peasants on the battlefield, but the ratio is never quite that equal.

card.name: Heavy Infantry
card.flavor: With their peerless Kaiu smiths and brutal Hida training, the Crab Clan can field forces enemies find simply too hard to kill and too strong to stop.

card.name: Shield Wall
card.text: Ranged Attacks cannot target cards in this unit.
card.flavor: "The famed archers of the Mantis Clan, stopped by a bit of wood? How embarrassing." - Bayushi Nitoshi

card.name: Light Cavalry
card.text:
Cavalry
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to this battle.)
card.flavor: "I am honored to serve, but it seems every week some new authority attempts to co-opt our troops. It's as if the Unicorn are slowly being turned into the personal army of the Imperials and Chosen." - Shinjo Tselu

card.name: Light Infantry
card.flavor: "A general may be great, and a duelist may be peerless, but it is still armies that win wars and hold land." - Hida Kisada

card.name: Plague Zombies
card.text:
Nonhuman • Shadowlands • Undead
After you Equip this Follower, lose 4 Honor. After your turn begins, give this Personality a -1C Plague token.
Battle: Fear 3.
card.flavor: Nameless undead soldiers and the would-be warlords who thought to control them both march in its ranks.

card.name: The Desiccated
card.text:
Nonhuman • Shadowlands • Undead
You may Equip this Follower from your discard pile.
After you Equip this Follower, lose 3 Honor.
card.flavor: The advance scout looked around, surveying the remains of the fallen foe. He never heard the bodies rising up behind him.

card.name: Skeletal Troops
card.text:
Nonhuman • Shadowlands • Undead
After you Equip this Follower, lose 2 Honor.
Battle: Fear 3 (Bow a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with 3 or lower Force).
card.flavor: "How fares your honor now? How worthwhile are your ideals, trampled beneath rotting feet?" - Noekam

card.name: Spearmen
card.text: Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 2 Attack (Destroy a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with 2 or lower Force).
card.flavor: Not as deadly at range as an archer, nor as useful in close quarters fighting as a swordsman. However, the versatility of the spear appeals to many warriors.

card.name: Aligned with the Elements
card.text:
Battle: Bow your target unbowed Ring. Bow a target enemy card without attachments.
Battle: Target your bowed Ring and an attachment. Straighten both targets.
card.flavor: The Dragon Clan remains blessed by the Heavens, even without Togashi's presence in Ningen-do.

card.name: In Awe of the Earth
card.text: Earth Battle, [BOW]: Fear with strength equal to this Shugenja's Chi, plus 1 if he is Earth. (Bow a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with Force equal to or lower than the Fear's strength)
card.flavor: Most people rarely consider the unbridled power of the earth beneath their feet. When faced with the reality of it, many are unable to prevent their spirit from shrinking in fear.

card.name: Dotanuki
card.text:
Sword • Two-Handed • Weapon
This Item has +2C while this Personality is dueling a Personality with lower Force.
card.flavor: "The greater curve means greater cutting. And of course, the quality is absolute. A stunning no-dachi... Where did you find such a weapon?" - Akodo Daiken

card.name: Tsukai-sagasu
card.text: Open, [BOW]: If this Personality is a Shugenja, straighten him.
card.flavor: "I am told the threat of the Shadowlands is contained. Quieted. We have been told this before, and we stand vigilant for the day it will be proven wrong again."

card.name: A Champion's Strike
card.text: Battle: Target your unbowed Unique Samurai. Destroy one or more target enemy Followers with a total Force less than or equal to your Samurai's.
card.flavor: Only the foolish would ever question a Mirumoto's form. There are plenty of fools in the world.

card.name: Naginata
card.text: Polearm • Two-Handed • Weapon
card.flavor: Held in the same esteem as the daisho, the naginata is the samurai's preferred polearm. With a blade forged similarly to a wakizashi, expertly balanced, and offering superior reach, it is sometimes even favored over a samurai's own katana. For such a noble weapon to be in the hands of a commoner is strictly forbidden.

card.name: Blanketed Forest
card.text:
Forest • Terrain • Winter
The snow blocks travel. Personalities cannot move to or from this battlefield.
Battle: Destroy a Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play.
card.flavor: "Moto Chagatai changed war forever with his winter march. Who else shall follow his tactically brilliant madness?"

card.name: Ancestral Armor of the Crane Clan - exp
card.text:
Armor • Experienced • Unique
Can only attach to a Crane Clan Personality. After you Equip this Item, gain 2 Honor. This Personality may Lobby as an Open action. After this Personality Lobbies, gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: It has seen many battles, yet remains pristine, elegant, and unstained. Sasageru embodies the eternal spirit of the Crane.

card.name: Ancestral Armor of the Dragon Clan - exp
card.text:
Armor • Experienced • Unique
Can only attach to a Dragon Clan Personality. After you Equip this Item, gain 2 Honor.
Battle/Open, [BOW]: Straighten your target Ring.
card.flavor: Mended by the Tamori priests, its name is lost to history. The once-broken armor of Togashi awaits the destiny of its clan in silence.

card.name: Ancestral Armor of the Phoenix Clan - exp
card.text:
Armor • Experienced • Unique
Can only attach to a Phoenix Clan Personality. After you Equip this Item, gain 2 Honor.
Battle/Open, [BOW]: Another player may discard a Spell or Kiho from his hand. If he does not, he must target and bow one of his unbowed Personalities.
card.flavor: Mezameru houses an awakened spirit.

card.name: Heavy Infantry Dojo
card.text:
Dojo
[BOW]: Produce 3 Gold.
Battle, [BOW]: Give your target Personality +2F.
card.flavor: "Tell us how many men you need, and I shall make sure you have them."

card.name: Regal Furisode
card.text: This Personality has +1PH. You may use rulebook Favor abilities two times per turn. When this Personality Lobbies, add his Personal Honor to the Family Honor check. He may Lobby even if you have already Lobbied once this turn.
card.flavor: To be noticed by the sun, one cannot stand in shadows.

card.name: Hellbeast
card.text:
Shadowlands
After you Equip this Item, lose 4 Honor.
This Personality has Cavalry.
Battle: Fear 2.
card.flavor: All manner of horrors crawled from the second pit. Every day saw a new nightmare.

card.name: House of the Red Lotus
card.text:
Geisha House
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Political Interrupt, [BOW]: Reduce a Proclaim action's Honor gain by 1, and lose 1 Honor.
card.flavor: The House shall thrive forever, under good guidance.

card.name: Today We Die
card.text: Limited: Target a Samurai Personality who has not been targeted by a Today We Die this game. Until the game ends, he cannot Lobby, after the end of each of his controller's Action Phases, if he can legally assign, his controller must declare an attack and assign him, and give him a +1F/+1C token after each battle resolution he is in.
card.flavor: "I go to my ancestors, head held high!"

card.name: Sadamune Blade
card.text:
One-Handed • Sword • Weapon
As a Focus Effect, after this duel ends, if your Personality won it, you may attach this Item to him, ignoring costs.
card.flavor: "A gift from the Kaiu, my Lady." Min-Hee peered at the blade. "Exquisite," she remarked, "but how odd. This is not the Kaiu family's stamp."

card.name: Record of Failure
card.text:
Attaches to a Courtier for 2 less Gold.
Political Limited: Target a dishonorably dead Personality. His owner loses Honor equal to the Personality's printed Personal Honor. Remove this Item from the game.
card.flavor: "To even speak his name in remembrance fills my heart with shame, but for the sake of our family, I must do so regardless."

card.name: Come One at a Time
card.text:
Terrain
While there is exactly one defending Personality, he has the ability, "Repeatable Battle: Challenge a target enemy Personality. Destroy the loser" and each player has the ability, "Repeatable Battle: Move home your target attacking Personality. Bow him as he moves."
Battle: Destroy a Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play. Take an additional action from it.

card.name: Seeking the Way
card.text: Air Battle: Bow this Shugenja to move home a target attacking Personality and himself. Gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "This is not your path, friend. Come with me and we shall plumb the mysteries of the universe together."

card.name: Akodo Dojo
card.text:
Dojo
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
[BOW]: When paying for a Follower, it enters play for 3 less Gold.
card.flavor: The Lion Clan Champion remains an Akodo. The family has fully returned to their seat of power within the clan.

card.name: Overwhelming Power
card.text: Void Battle/Open, [BOW]: Give this Shugenja a Force bonus equal to half his Chi, rounded up.
card.flavor: The elements flowed into him, giving him their strength. "I apologize," he said to the bandits in a booming voice. "I think I surely must have misunderstood you."

card.name: Ancestral Armor of the Spider Clan
card.text:
Armor • Weapon • Unique
Can only attach to a Spider Clan Personality. After you Equip this Item, gain 2 Honor. Does not count towards a Personality's maximum number of Weapons.
Battle, [BOW]: Fear 4.
card.flavor: Never worn, never tested, never named. The Ancestral Armor of the Spider awaits its first master. Patient. And hungry.

card.name: Spiked Tetsubo
card.text:
Heavy Weapon • One-Handed • Weapon
After this Personality enters a duel, the other Personality in the duel loses Duelist.
card.flavor: "The elegance of the blade is not suited for every task. Sometimes the simple ways are better." - Hida Kisada

card.name: In Stillness, Forge the Soul
card.text: Open: Target your unbowed Personality. Look at the top five cards of your Fate deck. You may Equip one of them that is a Weapon to him. Put the remaining cards back in any order. If he is a Kensai and you did not Equip a Weapon, you may put this Strategy back in your hand.
card.flavor: "If there is one brilliant thing that the Dragon have grasped it is this: a soul is never a finished thing. It must always be seeking." - Asako Sadaki

card.name: Imperial Dojo
card.text:
Dojo • Imperial
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Limited, [BOW]: If you have two or fewer Provinces, discard any face-up Holdings in your Provinces, refilling those Provinces face-up.
card.flavor: "We enforce the Imperial will."

card.name: Todori Sensei
card.text:
Crab Clan
Your Stronghold has no traits and abilities. Battle, [BOW]: Bow your target unbowed Follower. Ranged Attack with Strength equal to its Force.
card.flavor: "Hiruma Todori was one of my heroes as a child. My father spoke of him as a great man, and his greatness has not diminished with age." - Hida Kisada

card.name: Palm Strike
card.text: Kiho Battle: Target your unbowed Monk without a Weapon. Bow a target enemy Personality without a Weapon.
card.flavor: "Too close," the monk said sadly. "Let us try again."

card.name: Satoru Sensei
card.text:
Lion Clan
Battle, [BOW]: Target your non-Unique Samurai face-up in a Province. Give him Reserve. Unless he is a Scout and you control a Terrain, give him +2 Gold Cost.

(-1 Province Strength)
card.flavor: "Ikoma Satoru once gained us great honor as Turquoise Champion. Now he has put that aside to teach our youths the purpose of a true Lion."

card.name: Mirumoto Niwa
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Soul of Mirumoto Kei • Kensai
(Kensai may attach two Weapons, as long as neither is Two-Handed.)
Battle: Niwa challenges a target enemy Personality. He may refuse; if he does, give Niwa +3F. Give the duel's loser -3F.
card.flavor: "Dragon armies rarely announce their arrival. Or whose side they are on." - Matsu Nagatsu

card.name: Gidayu Sensei
card.text:
Mantis Clan
Interrupt, [BOW]: One of the action's Ranged Attacks may be combined with one Ranged Attack action from your target card in any unit.

(-1 Province Strength, -1 Family Honor)

card.name: Daigotsu Meguro
card.text:
Spider Clan • Samurai • Shadowlands
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 2 Attack.
Battle, [BOW]: Give a target enemy Personality a -2F token.
card.flavor: "I have outlived all those who called me a monster. The Dark Lord's power sustains me. My enemies merely gnash their teeth in fury from the next world."

card.name: Jiramu's Court
card.text:
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Open, [BOW]: Straighten your target Courtier.
card.flavor: The Seppun family is one of the most revered noble houses within the Empire.

card.name: Jutsushi Sensei
card.text:
Scorpion Clan
Your Samurai have +1F while opposing a dishonorable Personality.

(-1 Province Strength)
card.flavor: "There are no roles he has not played within our ranks, and his skill in all is prodigious. If he imparts even a fraction of his skill to his students, then we all benefit." - Bayushi Nitoshi

card.name: Tetsuo Sensei
card.text:
Spider Clan
Limited, [BOW]: Give Conqueror to your target Personality with a Weapon (A Conqueror's unit doesn't bow after battle).

(-1 Province Strength)
card.flavor: "I can conduct my affairs within the Colonies with peace of mind, knowing that Tetsuo and Kurako have the Empire well in hand." - Daigotsu Kanpeki

card.name: Yoritomo Takuya
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Soul of Yoritomo Bussho • Naval
(Once a turn, the Attacker gets the first Battle action, if it's from a Naval Personality's unit.)
Battle: Personalities that did not assign to this battlefield cannot move here.
card.flavor: "Few know the proper way," Takuya said to his Champion. "And those who find it, I will deal with."

card.name: Words of Consecration
card.text:
After you Equip this Spell, if this Shugenja is Air, a target player gains or loses 1 Honor.
Air Open: Bow this Shugenja to target another player's Personality. After the next time (this turn) the target assigns to attack you, gain 1 Honor, or 2 Honor if you control a Temple.
card.flavor: "This is a sacred place," the priest whispered.

card.name: Ancestral Aid
card.text: Battle, [BOW]: Move your target Personality home.
card.flavor: "Thank you, ancient cousin," the priestess said. "Thank you for your aid. Return to the peace of the next world with my gratitude."

card.name: Deafening Thunder
card.text: Thunder Battle, [BOW]: Give a target enemy Personality or Follower a Force penalty equal to this Shugenja's Chi. If its Force is now 0 or this Shugenja is Thunder, you may destroy this Spell to take an additional Battle action.
card.flavor: The war between the Crane and Mantis was ended, but memories of it remained fresh.

card.name: A Champion's Tactics
card.text: Battle: If he would be opposed, move your target unbowed Personality at home to the current battlefield. If he is Cavalry, Scout, or a Clan Champion, you may take an additional action to use a printed ability on a card in his unit.
card.flavor: "Nothing warms my heart more than a show of confidence from my fellow warriors."

card.name: Fueling the Flames
card.text:
Fire Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 2 Attack. (Destroy a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with 2 or lower Force.)
Fire Battle: Bow this Shugenja to make a Ranged 6 Attack. Destroy this Shugenja.
card.flavor: "If I call upon the kami to aid me, the fire will burn. If I give myself to the kami, the fire will burn everything."

card.name: Versatile Army
card.text:
This ability's Gold cost is 0 if you control both a Cavalry unit and an Infantry unit at this battlefield.
Battle, [PAY 3]: Straighten or bow a target Personality.
card.flavor: "Diversity is a great strength that allows a commander to use his forces in any way that circumstance demands." - Akodo's Leadership

card.name: Insight
card.text:
Insight
Dark Virtue Battle: Target your Samurai. Look at the top three cards of any Fate deck. You may rearrange them. You may take an additional Battle action to play one of them that is a Battle Strategy.
card.flavor: "True insight cannot be taught. One can learn many things, but without practice, one ultimately knows nothing." - Naka Mahatsu

card.name: Shielded by Tempest
card.text:
Air Open: Transfer this Spell to your target Air Shugenja.
Air Battle, [BOW]: If this Shugenja is opposed, give this Province +2 strength and gain 1 Honor. Move this Shugenja home.
card.flavor: "If the Mantis believe that they alone can wield the power of the storm, then they are more foolish than I imagined."

card.name: Contentious Terrain
card.text:
Terrain
Your Personalities at this battlefield have +1F.
Battle: Destroy a Terrain (if able). Put this card into play.
card.flavor: The fate of battle can hand on the tiniest advantage. It is the general's duty to gather them all for his army.

card.name: Secrets on the Wind
card.text:
After you Equip this Spell, give it a number of tokens equal to this Shugenja's Chi.
Air Limited: Bow this Shugenja, and destroy a token on this Spell unless he is Scorpion Clan, to dishonor a target Personality.
card.flavor: There is nothing that the spirits of the wind do not see.

card.name: Journey's End
card.text: Interrupt: After the Battle action resolves, if it moved your Personality to a battlefield, then take an additional action.
card.flavor: The journey to and from the Colonies is long and arduous, with little else along the path than danger and desert oblivion. Whatever the destination, the first sight of civilization is always welcome.

card.name: Summon Undead Champion
card.text: Maho Limited: Bow this Shugenja and destroy this Spell to create a 5F/2C Champion • Shadowlands • Undead Personality and lose 4 Honor.
card.flavor: "If I have need of my vassals, death is not an excuse to refrain from serving." - Daigotsu Kanpeki

card.name: Touch of Death
card.text: Maho Limited: Bow this Shugenja and destroy this Spell to destroy a target bowed Personality with equal or lower Chi.
card.flavor: "You raised your hand against me. That was a terrible mistake." - Tairao

card.name: Stand or Run
card.text: Iaijutsu Battle: Your target unbowed Personality challenges a target enemy Personality. If he is unbowed, he may refuse. If he does, move him home and bow him as he moves. Destroy the duel's loser.
card.flavor: "I give you the opportunity to not sully my blade with your worthless life."

card.name: Ascendance
card.text: Battle: Fear that is a copy of a Fear effect on a card in your army.
card.flavor: The Obsidian Moon is feared more than loved, unlike the Jade Sun. Also unlike the Jade Sun, it seems the moon delights in fear.

card.name: Slanderer
card.text:
Retainer
[BOW]: Produce 5 Gold.
Political Limited, [BOW]: If you control a Courtier or Magistrate, dishonor a target Personality.
card.flavor: "She is just another one of my tools, but a highly effective one." - Bayushi Nitoshi

card.name: Inexplicable Challenge
card.text: Political Battle: Target your Courtier at any location. Bow a target enemy card without attachments. A target player gains or loses 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "What's the matter, Matsu-san? Haven't the stomach to kill a man of the court? Well I am just as much a warrior as you, and I have no qualms with dying on the battlefield. Now fight me!"

card.name: Blind Honor
card.text:
Terrain
Personalities at this battlefield have a Force penalty equal to their Personal Honor.
Battle: Destroy a Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play.
card.flavor: "Your self-imposed guidelines only hamper you, fool."

card.name: Banish All Shadows
card.text: Kiho Limited: Bow your target unbowed Monk or Shugenja. Look at the top four cards of your Fate deck. Put one in your hand. Shuffle the deck.
card.flavor: "Empty your mind. Empty your soul. Empty your desire, and you shall have it all."

card.name: Faint Praise
card.text: Political Open: Before the next time this turn a player gains Honor from an action he took, he loses that amount of Honor instead of gaining it.
card.flavor: "Him? No, I have never heard of him. Of course, if he were truly incompetent I am sure I would have." - Bayushi Nitoshi

card.name: Final Sacrifice
card.text: Interrupt: Target your Yojimbo. The action must target him, if legal.
card.flavor: "it is the fate of every yojimbo looks for, and fears; for with him dead, who will deal with the next assassin?" - Shiba Myoushi

card.name: Do Not Delay!
card.text: Iaijutsu Limited: Your target unbowed Personality challenges a target Personality. He may refuse. If he does not refuse, destroy the duel's loser. If he does refuse, permanently give your Personality the ability, "Battle: Challenge a target enemy Personality. Bow the loser."
card.flavor: "You can face me now, or you may face me later. Delay will not make me falter." - Mirumoto Yonekura

card.name: A Time for Action
card.text: Open: Each player with 21 or more Family Honor loses 5 Honor.
card.flavor: "Because the battle has ended, you think that we should grow comfortable? There is never a better time for action than when it is not yet needed. Now is the time for preparation."

card.name: Oppression
card.text: Political Battle: Move home your target Courtier. Give the current Province +3 strength, and if the enemy leader controls a dishonorable Personality at its battlefield, he loses 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "They should be honored to serve the whims of their masters." - Kakita Kazan

card.name: Open Emotion
card.text:
Honesty
Bushido Virtue Open: Rehonor a target Samurai.
Bushido Virtue Open: Target your unbowed Samurai. Show a Strategy in your hand. Once this turn, while you are the Defender, you may take a Battle action from that card as an Engage action.
card.flavor: Honesty takes many forms.

card.name: Humble House
card.text:
Sake House
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Limited, [BOW]: Give a target Personality a +1F Sake token. Remove it after your next turn begins.
card.flavor: "Even cheap sake tastes sweet in the presence of friends!"

card.name: Wheels within Wheels
card.text: Open: Your target honorable Human Personality commits Seppuku. You may rehonor one of your Personalities. Gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: The simplest actions can put into motion plots that rob honorable men of their name and their lives.

card.name: Unassailable Defense
card.text: Battle: Bow your target unbowed Personality. Fear with strength equal to his Force. If he is a Yojimbo, and you control a Courtier or Shugenja (at any location), after each card bows from the Fear, destroy it.
card.flavor: "Take cover, my lady! I will deal with these dogs in a manner they deserve!"

card.name: Okura is Released
card.text: Interrupt: After any Fear effect from the action bows a card, destroy it.
card.flavor: "I have not drawn breath in some time..."

card.name: Expert Archers
card.text:
Can only attach to a Samurai.
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 3 Attack. (Destroy a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with 3 or lower Force).
card.flavor: "Everyone thinks they can outshoot a Tsuruchi until they are killed by one." - Tsuruchi Natsuki

card.name: Army Like a Tide
card.text: Battle: Target your Personality, or one or two of your Personalities if you have fewer Provinces than any other player. Give them each +1F and Conqueror (A Conqueror's unit doesn't bow after battle).
card.flavor: "Advance, then recede. Move your army like water, and you will never be left defenseless." - Moto Naleesh

card.name: Watch Commander
card.text: Before this Personality enters a duel in which he was challenged, create a 2F/3C/2PH Samurai • Yojimbo • Duelist Personality at his location, who enters the duel instead. After the duel ends, remove him from the game, and destroy this Follower if you lost.
card.flavor: "My lord, allow me."

card.name: Sanctioned Duel
card.text: Iaijutsu Limited: Your target unbowed Personality challenges another player's target Personality who may refuse. If he refuses, dishonor him and gain 2 Honor. Destroy the duel's loser.
card.flavor: "In the duel there is simplicity. Honor. Truth." - Doji Kazuo

card.name: Karyuudo
card.text:
Dog • Hunter • Nonhuman • Scout • Spirit • Cavalry
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to this battle.)
card.flavor: The spirits from the realms beyond the mortal world are varied and often terrible. The spirits of Chikushudo are often tenacious and always fearless.

card.name: Gekido no Oni
card.text:
Nonhuman • Oni • Shadowlands
After you Recruit Gekido, lose 3 Honor. Cannot attach Followers or Items.
Battle/Open: Give Gekido +2F/+3C until this phase ends. After the phase ends, give Gekido -2F/-2C until your next turn ends.
card.flavor: "Shoot it in the eye!" he whispered to the archer. "Before it sees us!"

card.name: Soul's Sacrifice
card.text: Battle: Target your unbowed Samurai with 3 or higher Personal Honor. Permanently give him Shadowlands • Undead. Move home a target enemy Personality.
card.flavor: "My purity, freely given, so that I might punish the enemies of my clan."

card.name: Ramifications
card.text: Political Battle: Move home a target Personality with 0 Personal Honor and, as he moves, his controller loses 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "Shibatsu, you know I have love in my heart for you, but you keep questionable company. Some might comment on how it reflects on you."

card.name: Treachery and Deceit
card.text: Battle: Move home a target Personality whose unit's total Force is 7 or higher.
card.flavor: "A knife in the back is so passe and unfashionable. A few words and the right seal on a scroll can accomplish so much more without all the drama and fanfare." - Bayushi Nitoshi

card.name: Deep Harbor
card.text:
Port
[BOW]: Produce 1 Gold.
[BOW]: When paying for a Holding, it enters play for 2 less Gold.
card.flavor: "I am sure Hiromi-san intends to abide by our agreement. I am also sure he will be creative in interpreting some of the details, so watch any Mantis merchants closely." - Doji Makoto

card.name: The Sun Returns
card.text: Interrupt: Bow your target unbowed Tactician. Negate the effects of a Battle or Engage action.
card.flavor: The Jade Sun and its counterpart, the Obsidian Moon, are the two most powerful entities in Rokugan's cosmology. Both are revered and feared in equal measure by all those who dwell within Rokugan and its Colonies.

card.name: The Turtle's Shell
card.text: Interrupt: Negate the action's Melee or Ranged Attacks.
card.flavor: "My brothers have fallen, but they can still protect me! Long enough to avenge their deaths, at least!"

card.name: The Wrath of Osano-Wo
card.text: Kiho Thunder Battle: Bow your target unbowed Monk or Shugenja. Ranged Attack with strength equal to his Chi.
card.flavor: Of all the wrathful Fortunes whose tempers should not be tested, the Fortune of Fire and Thunder is foremost among them.

card.name: Uncertainty
card.text: Battle/Open: A target Personality has a minimum Chi of 1. Give him -2F/-2C.
card.flavor: "Are you certain?" a tiny whisper resounded in his mind. "Are you certain this is the path you should choose?"

card.name: Unwelcome Supervision
card.text: Limited: A target player discards a card at random.
card.flavor: "Now, now, do not forget your customary closing. We would not wish to cause anyone to grow suspicious, would we?"

card.name: Men of Cunning
card.text: Open, [PAY 1]: Lose 1 Honor. Target a Personality. His controller may discard a card. If he does, draw a card. If he does not, bow the Personality.
card.flavor: "To refuse an advantage because it is 'underhanded' is not only disrespectful to those you lead, it is also the most selfish act that I can think of." - Tangen's Lies

card.name: Wounded in Battle
card.text: Battle: Target a Personality who has not been targeted by a Wounded in Battle this turn. Until the battle ends, if he is a Samurai, he is not destroyed for having 0 Chi. Give him -2C.
card.flavor: "Now is no time for rest, brothers! Those of you who can stand, take up your steel and follow me!"

card.name: The Remote Monastery of the Dragon (1)
card.text:
Temple
You cannot Recruit Monks with another Clan alignment. After all players reveal Strongholds, search your Fate deck for a non-Fudo, non-Void Ring. Put it into play.
card.flavor: Dwelling within the mountains means embracing the impractical.

card.name: The Eternal Temple of the Phoenix (1)
card.text:
Temple
Limited: Bow your target unbowed Shugenja. Look at the top three cards of your Fate deck. If one of them is a Kiho or Spell, you may show it, put it into your hand, and then, discard a card.
card.flavor: The Shiba carry the blood of the Kami, but the Isawa rule the Phoenix.

card.name: The Sinister Citadel of the Spider (1)
card.text: Battle: Fear 3.
card.flavor: It is a strange place to call home, in the dark where the sunlight scarcely reaches.

card.name: The Golden Plains of the Unicorn (1)
card.text: Battle/Engage: If he would be opposed, move to the current battlefield your target unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit at any location.
card.flavor: Some Unicorn favor simple beauty. They are similar to their Lion neighbors in that regard.

card.name: Reprisal
card.text: Battle: Give your target defending or your target opposed Personality +1F for each card in his unit (including himself). After this Attack Phase ends, if he was defending and you have fewer Provinces than the Attacker, declare an additional Attack Phase against him, during which your other Personalities cannot attack.
card.flavor: "I will see this insult answered."

card.name: Fire and Air
card.text:
Fire Battle: Bow this Shugenja to make a Ranged 2 Attack. (Destroy a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with 2 or lower Force.)
Air Battle: Move this Shugenja to an adjacent, unresolved battlefield or move him home.
card.flavor: Fire and air, blended together, can melt the flesh from an enemy's bones.

card.name: Ward of Air
card.text:
Before this Shugenja, or any Personality if this Shugenja is Air, is detroyed by a Battle action, you may destroy this Spell to negate it.
Air Battle: Move this Shugenja home.
card.flavor: Clans with a strong tradition of Air magic, including the Crane and Scorpion, can attest that the wind is a powerful defense indeed.

card.name: Fearful Volley
card.text:
Battle: Fear 2 (Bow a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with 2 or lower Force).
Battle: Bow your target unbowed Scout. Ranged 3 Attack (Destroy a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with 3 or lower Force).
card.flavor: "It's surprising how many you can fire off at once if you'd rather just scare than kill them." - Tsuruchi Shichiro

card.name: The Sinister Citadel of the Spider (2)
card.text:
Tireless Dynasty: If any of your Provinces have been destroyed this game, turn a card in one of your Provinces face-up.
Tireless Battle: Fear 3.
card.flavor: The Spider swell in the hidden, cursed places that the other Great Clans do not covet. It gives them the privacy their endeavors require.

card.name: The Golden Plains of the Unicorn (2)
card.text:
You may use the Cycle player ability twice in your first turn.
Battle/Engage: If he would be opposed, move to the current battlefield your target unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit at any location.
card.flavor: It is a place of resplendent luxury and unparalleled exoticism.

card.name: The Remote Monastery of the Dragon (2)
card.text:
Temple
You cannot Recruit Monks with another Clan alignment. You have +1 maximum and starting hand size. After all players reveal Strongholds, search your Fate deck for a non-Fudo, non-Void Ring. Put it into play.
card.flavor: There is beauty in the most unlikely of places.

card.name: The Eternal Temple of the Phoenix (2)
card.text:
Temple
Limited: Bow your target unbowed Shugenja. Look at the top three cards of your Fate deck. If one of them is a Kiho or Spell, you may show it and put it into your hand.
card.flavor: The Agasha and Asako families serve the Phoenix in lesser ways, rarely gaining the attention of the other Great Clans.

card.name: Swift Sword Cut
card.text: Battle: Target and bow your unbowed Kensai or one of his unbowed Weapons. Destroy a target enemy Follower, Item, or Personality without attachments, that has Force equal to or less than your Kensai's Chi.
card.flavor: One perfect cut overcomes any enemy.

card.name: Otomo Demiyah
card.text:
Courtier • Imperial
Political Interrupt: After you Recruit Demiyah, a target player gains or loses 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "The crisis in the Colonies? What does it matter to me? I am of Imperial birth. Such things come and go, and impact me not at all."

card.name: Storm-Forged Blade
card.text:
One-Handed • Sword • Thunder • Weapon
Thunder Battle: Move this Personality home. Straighten his unit as he moves.
card.flavor: "Forged with fire ignited from lightning, hammered beneath the prayers of Osano-Wo's priests, some say these blades carry the Fortune of Thunder's blessing." - Tsuruchi Nishima

card.name: Haiku School
card.text: [BOW]: Produce 2 Gold, or 3 Gold if you control a Courtier and the Imperial Favor.
card.flavor: There is no greater battle than the one waged with poetry and wordplay within.

card.name: Light Yari
card.text:
Spear • Two-Handed • Weapon
Battle, [BOW]: Melee 2 Attack (Destroy a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with 2 or lower Force).
card.flavor: Although the samurai favors his daisho above all other weapons, any competent warrior would never discount the many advantages of the yari. In the hands of the untrained, it is a viable defense against aggressive forces. In the hands of a samurai, it is a tactical instrument of death.

card.name: Uncovering the Culprit
card.text: Battle: Bow your target unbowed Personality. Bow a target enemy card. Its controller discards a card at random if your Personality is a Magistrate.
card.flavor: "Every man is guilty of something. One simply needs to dig deep enough to find it."

card.name: Hojatsu Sensei
card.text:
Dragon Clan
Interrupt, [BOW]: Challenges created by the action and issued by your Personality with a Weapon bow the other Personality after he loses the duel or refuses the challenge.

(-1 Starting Honor)
card.flavor: "He bears the name of one of history's greatest swordsmen, and each day he proves worthy of its burden." - Mirumoto Shikei

card.name: Touch the Emptiness
card.text: Void Battle, [BOW]: Give a target enemy Personality or Follower -2F. If this Shugenja is Void, one ability in the target's unit cannot be used.
card.flavor: When shown the truth of the Void, those who are unlearned in the ways of the kami are often struck down by the full tapestry of all that is.

card.name: Akikazu Sensei
card.text:
Unicorn Clan
Battle, [BOW]: Target a dead Personality. Fear with strength equal to his Force.

(-1 Province Strength, -1 Starting Family Honor)
card.flavor: "I hold different philosophies, but I do not deny that Moto Akikazu is one of our most brilliant minds. We are fortunate that he continues to teach." - Moto Naleesh

card.name: Inspired Devotion
card.text: Battle/Open: Give your target Personality +2F or you may, if he is a Yojimbo, give him a Force bonus equal to the highest Chi among all Courtiers and Shugenja you control (at any location).
card.flavor: "Rest, Isawa-san. I will ensure you are not disturbed."

card.name: Servitors of Stone
card.text: Earth Battle, [BOW]: Straighten a target card in a unit.
card.flavor: "I have a message for the Ivory Champion, little ones. Can you carry it for me?" - Isawa Norimichi

card.name: Suitengu's Embrace
card.text: Water Battle, [BOW]: Bow a target enemy card without attachments, or bow this Shugenja to bow a target enemy card with attachments.
card.flavor: The Fortunes of the Sea is both wrathful and hungry. Those who entreat his power need only ensure that it is used to sate his needs.

card.name: Wary Peace
card.text: Political Open: Target another player who controls an attachment and destroy your target attachment. He may choose and destroy one of his attachments. If he did not choose this, gain Honor equal to the Focus Value of your destroyed attachment.
card.flavor: Peace brought about through questionable means is itself questionable.

card.name: Flashy Technique
card.text:
As a Focus Effect, this duel's winner gains 1 Honor after it ends.
Open: If you have not played another Flashy Technique this turn, Personalities have -1F while attacking.
card.flavor: "Yes, it is impressive. Impressive and shallow." - Kakita Ibara

card.name: Feared Duelist
card.text: Interrupt: After your Personality wins any duel created by the action, permanently give him the ability, "Battle: Fear 4." You cannot gain Honor from the action.
card.flavor: "I think you mean to restate your argument. I am sure you did not mean to sully the Asahina family's reputation."

card.name: Tonfajutsu
card.text:
Battle: Bow your target unbowed Weapon. Destroy a target enemy attachment.
Battle: Give a target Personality with a Weapon +2F.
card.flavor: Tonfa are farming implements transformed into defensive weapons. In the hands of a master, they are devastating out of all proportion to their simple appearance.

card.name: Kitsu Miro
card.text:
Lion Clan • Sodan Senzo • Water • Shugenja
Home Battle, [BOW]: Create a 2F/2C/3PH Lion Clan • Ancestor • Samurai • Spirit Personality at the current battlefield. Remove him from the game after the battle ends. (Home actions can be taken from home.)
card.flavor: The ancestors of the Lion, like their living counterparts, sometimes find peace and harmony only in war.

card.name: Tea House
card.text:
[BOW]: Produce 1 Gold.
Battle/Open, [BOW]: Target your Personality. Negate all current and future (this turn) Chi penalties on him from other players' cards, and tokens they created.
card.flavor: "They are civilized places where peace and hospitality reign. I am sure that without them the Empire would collapse into chaos." - Isawa Kamiko

card.name: Merchant Atoll
card.text:
Castle • Port
Your Provinces have +1 strength.
[BOW]: Produce 5 Gold.
card.flavor: "The war is over, but I do not intend to lose the pace. Keep and eye on merchants with Crane patrons." - Yoritomo Hiromi

card.name: Oriole Imperial Vanguard
card.text:
Imperial
This Personality has +1PH.
After the first time each phase a Political action targets this Personality, negate its remaining effects.
card.flavor: A small clan, honored by the Imperial family for their talents. They are sometimes made retainers to samurai who have performed some great favor for the Throne.

card.name: Hida Advisor
card.text:
Retainer
[BOW]: Produce 1 Gold.
Open, [BOW]: Transfer your target Follower from one of your unbowed Personalities to another.
card.flavor: "Crush them."

card.name: Geisha House
card.text:
Geisha House
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold, or 3 Gold if you are a Scorpion Clan player.
card.flavor: The Scorpion will do what must be done to safeguard the Empire, even if others consider it distasteful.

card.name: Gold Mine
card.text:
Mine
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold, or 3 Gold if you are a Dragon Clan player.
card.flavor: "How did we allow the Colonies to fall so far from grace? We must be vigilant, lest it continue down a spiral of ruin."

card.name: Iuchi Honma
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Water • Cavalry • Shugenja
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to this battlefield. Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
card.flavor: The death and destruction in the Colonies have only convinced the Unicorn to send more to the uncivilized land.

card.name: Kobune Port
card.text:
Port
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold, or 3 Gold if you are a Mantis Clan player.
card.flavor: "The sea! The sea! Sources of riches and storms! Still, there is something to be said for a bath and some good sake in port."

card.name: School of Wizardry
card.text: [BOW]: When paying for a Human Shugenja, he enters play for 0 Gold.
card.flavor: People call 'wizardly' that which they do not understand.

card.name: Secluded Outpost
card.text:
[BOW]: Produce 4 Gold.
Tireless Interrupt, [PAY *]: If this Holding bowed to produce Gold to Recruit a Personality, Equip an attachment to him from your hand for 4 less Gold after he enters play.
card.flavor: "A small force that can be quickly summoned is sometimes better than a larger one that arrives too late." - Shinjo Tselu

card.name: Shinomen Marsh
card.text:
Swamp
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold, or 3 Gold if you are a Spider Clan player.
card.flavor: "It is filled with wonders and dangers. I should like to go there someday." - Kitsune Parumba

card.name: Shrine to Hachiman
card.text:
Temple
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Battle/Open: Straighten a target attachment.
card.flavor: The Fortune of Battle is honored by samurai throughout the Empire. No one knows how he decides of whom to take notice.

card.name: Wyrm Riders
card.text:
Nonhuman • Wyrm • Cavalry
After you Equip this Follower, lose 2 Honor.
Battle: Ranged 2 Attack (Destroy a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with 2 or lower Force).
card.flavor: "Our alliance with the Crab has given us valuable insights to all manner of... exotic beasts." - Bayushi Irezu

card.name: Ikoma Ichimoko
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Scout
Battle: Give a target enemy Follower or Personality -2F.
card.flavor: "Ichimoko prefers to disable, rather than kill. My sister's desire to allow others the glory is curious, though it has made her many friends." - Ikoma Yoshimoko

card.name: Silver Mine
card.text:
Mine
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold, or 3 Gold if you are a Phoenix Clan player.
card.flavor: "Silver shines when cared for and corrodes when left alone. Rather like the human spirit, in my opinion." - Isawa Kouka

card.name: Stables
card.text:
Stables
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold, or 3 Gold if you are a Unicorn Clan player.
card.flavor: "Soon, my friend. Soon we will be home and you will be properly spoiled."

card.name: Vigilant Eyes
card.text:
Insight
Dark Virtue Open: Target your unbowed Samurai. Give a target Personality a Force penalty equal to your Samurai's Force.
card.flavor: "A single man, keen of senses and sure of purpose, can bring doom upon his enemies without them ever knowing of his presence." - Daigotsu Kanpeki

card.name: Pack Tactics
card.text: Battle: Bow two of your target unbowed Personalities and target an enemy Personality. Bow his unit.
card.flavor: "Underestimating a pack of goblins is not a mistake that is repeated. For one reason or another." - Hiruma Tensin

card.name: Kitsu Suki
card.text:
Lion Clan • Water • Shugenja
Limited: Each player who controls an Ancestor gains 1 Honor. For any player who controls no Ancestors and has higher Honor than his starting Family Honor, you may choose to have him lose 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "Perhaps an acceptable samurai can speak of their own honor, but a great one knows of their grandfather's. And his grandfather, and on."

card.name: Iuchi Chiwa
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Soul of Iuchi Eiji • Cavalry • Shugenja
(Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
Absent Home Battle, [BOW]: If he would be opposed, move your target Personality at home to the current battlefield. If he is defending, straighten him as he moves.
card.flavor: The Unicorn have powerful rituals and spells from beyond Rokugan's borders.

card.name: Ide Kotono
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Courtier • Guard • Imperial • Samurai • Soul of Shinjo Haruko • Cavalry
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to this battle.)
Political Interrupt, [BOW]: If the action is Lobby, it does not give the Imperial Favor, and its player may Lobby once more this turn.
card.flavor: The Unicorn are not known as a subtle clan, but the Ide hold much power in the Courts.

card.name: Shinjo Tobita
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai
Battle: Fear 3 (Bow a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with 3 or lower Force).
card.flavor: "Stare into my eyes, and you shall see the death you so desperately seek."

card.name: Medium Cavalry
card.text:
Cavalry
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to this battle.)
card.flavor: Cavalry units are a part of every army in Rokugan. The advantage of a highly mobile force that can trample foot soldiers is expensive but often far more valuable than the cost.

card.name: The White Guard
card.text:
Cavalry
Battle: Fear 4 that cannot target a Cavalry card (Bow a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with 4 or lower Force).
card.flavor: They dress in the colors and symbols of death, howling the names of the Gods of Death. Thundering across the battlefield thus, even the sturdiest soul is given pause.

card.name: Gumbai-Uchiwa
card.text:
One-Handed • Tessen • Weapon
After this Item leaves play, remove it from the game.
You may Equip this Item from your discard pile as a Battle action.
card.flavor: It is the symbol of the general, his chosen weapon, and a signal to his troops.

card.name: Heavy Yari
card.text:
Spear • Two-Handed • Weapon
Battle, [BOW]: Melee 2 Attack (Destroy a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with 2 or lower Force).
card.flavor: One cannot discount an opponent's reach. To make this mistake invites disaster.

card.name: Ancestral Armor of the Lion Clan - exp
card.text:
Armor • Experienced • Unique
Can only attach to a Lion Clan Personality. After you Equip this Item, gain 2 Honor.
Battle, [BOW]: If he would be opposed, move a target Personality at any location to this battlefield. Straighten his unit if you do not control him.
card.flavor: Finally free of Taint, Junsui's ready to reclaim its honor.

card.name: Ancestral Armor of the Unicorn Clan - exp
card.text:
Armor • Experienced • Unique
Can only attach to a Unicorn Clan Personality. After you Equip this Item, gain 2 Honor.
Interrupt, [BOW]: The action cannot move Personalities.
card.flavor: Once proudly worn by the Champion of the Unicorn, Yuki has not been donned in generations. In Far Traveler Castle, it awaits a worthy Shinjo.

card.name: Ambush Pits
card.text:
Terrain
Before this battle resolves, bow all Followers at its battlefield with 2 or lower Force.
Battle: Destroy a Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play.
card.flavor: "It does not matter how much you prepare for battle. The enemy shall always fight a way to surprise you."

card.name: Roaming Caravan
card.text:
Market • Retainer
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Battle, [BOW]: Target another player's Personality at any location who was moved home from the current battlefield. Straighten his unit and move him there.
card.flavor: "If I could choose, I would travel the Empire with them." - Moto Naleesh

card.name: Walking the Way
card.text: Limited: Bow this Shugenja and destroy this Spell to search your Fate deck for a card and put it in your hand.
card.flavor: Walking the Way refers to the rare gift some shugenja possess for opening a gateway that leads outside the mortal realm, but returns it to a different location.

card.name: Defensive Grill
card.text: Absent Battle: Move a target Personality (at the current battlefield) to an unresolved battlefield where he would be opposed. (You may take Absent actions without presence.)
card.flavor:
"It looks like their defenses gathered on the northern front, my lord."
"Is it battle they want? Let us give it to them."

card.name: Sudden Movement
card.text:
As a Focus Effect, give the duel's winner +3F.
Battle: Target two Personalities controlled by the same player at different locations. Switch their locations. Straighten both their units as they move.
card.flavor: Only a poor commander fails to account for sudden changes in an enemy's position.

card.name: For the Fallen
card.text: Battle: Give one or two of your target opposed Personalities each +2F, or +3F if any of your dead Personalities have 3 or more Personal Honor.
card.flavor: "Take up the fight! Do not let them have died in vain!" - Moto Naleesh

card.name: Hatsu Suru no Oni
card.text:
Nonhuman • Oni • Shadowlands
After you Recruit Hatsu Suru, lose 5 Honor.
After another player's card destroys Hatsu Suru, remove it from the game, lose 4 Honor, and create two 2F/2C/0PH Nonhuman • Oni • Shadowlands Personalities at Hatsu Suru's former location.
card.flavor: "One of Fu Leng's first creations." - Kuni Renyu

card.name: Ashalan Blade
card.text:
Sword • Two-Handed • Weapon
Battle/Open: Destroy this Item. Give a target Ashalan Blade +3F/+3C.
card.flavor: "I've never seen a metal like that!" the Kaiu beamed. The Tsi crossed his arms. "I do not trust it."

card.name: Exquisite Nagamaki of the Fox Clan
card.text:
Polearm • Two-Handed • Weapon
Battle, [BOW]: Melee 3 Attack (Destroy a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with 3 or lower Force).
card.flavor: "I honor two lords: our traditions, and my Champion." - Kitsune Haruki

card.name: Determined Challenge
card.text: Battle: Target your unbowed attacking Personality. Move a target enemy Personality at any location to the current battlefield. Straighten him as he moves.
card.flavor: "When a man faces an enemy stronger than himself, then you see the strength of his will." - Hida Kisada

card.name: The Greater Threat
card.text: Absent Battle: If he would be opposed, move your target unbowed Personality at home to the current battlefield. If he moved and is a Yojimbo, make a Fear effect with strength equal to the highest Chi among all Courtiers and Shugenja you control (at any location). (You may take Absent actions without presence.)
card.flavor: A good yojimbo draws the eye.

card.name: Ancestral Armor of the Crab Clan - exp
card.text:
Armor • Experienced • Unique
Can only attach to a Crab Clan Personality. After you Equip this Item, gain 2 Honor.
Tireless Battle/Open: Straighten this Personality, and straighten his attachments if he is defending.
card.flavor: Forged by Kaiu himself, refitted for every Crab Champion, Fukutsu is a symbol of the Clan's undying vigilance.

card.name: Hiruma Fujito
card.text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Scout
Battle: Target Fujito's Follower. Fear with strength equal to its Force (Bow a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with Force equal to or lower than the Fear's strength).
card.flavor: "Is this it? My grandfather told me tales of the horrors in his days. You - are nothing."

card.name: Creating Order
card.text:
Unique
Battle/Open: Target a Personality. Either negate all current and new Force bonuses and penalties on him from actions, or straighten his unit.
card.flavor: "With this blade, you take up the station as magistrate. Honor it, as your father did, and much glory shall be yours."

card.name: Bamboo Harvesters - exp
card.text:
Forest • Experienced • Unique
This Holding will not straighten before your third turn.
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Limited, [BOW]: Draw a card. If you now have 6 or more cards in your hand, discard a card.
card.flavor: "We are fortunate bamboo grows so quickly and in so many place. It is as if it was blessed by the Heavens!"

card.name: Border Keep - exp
card.text:
Experienced • Unique
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Limited: Once per game, put one to three cards in your hand at the bottom of your deck. Draw cards equal to the number you put at the bottom.
card.flavor: "There is peace for now, surely, but it does not mean our neighbors should be trusted. Watch them closely."

card.name: A Game of Dice
card.text:
Unique
Limited, [PAY 3]: Draw two additional cards before your turn ends.
card.flavor: The uneasy resumption of peace between the Crane and the Mantis was not liked by all, but all obeyed. They simply found more acceptable outlets for their rivalries.

card.name: Colonial Harbor
card.text:
Port
Your Stronghold's abilities have Tireless (Tireless actions may be taken while bowed.)
[BOW]: Produce 5 Gold.
card.flavor: "If Hiromi-sama wishes me to trade with the Crane, then I shall. But I will not trust them." - Yoritomo Kanahashi

card.name: Entrenched Position
card.text:
Interrupt: Negate a Battle action's effects taken by the Attacker if it is taken before the Defender's first normal opportunity to act or pass.
Battle: Bow a target enemy card without attachments.
card.flavor: "Feel the drum fill your soul with power! Give me a hundred men and a dozen drummers, and I can take any objective!" - Kaiu Sokakaze

card.name: Kharmic Strike
card.text:
Kharmic
(Repeatable Limited, [PAY 2]: Discard a Kharmic card to draw a card.)
As a Focus Effect, when this duel resolves, both Personalities lose the duel. (This is not a tie.)
card.flavor: "Whether or not I win is ultimately of no consequence, so long as my enemy loses." - Shosuro Nobu

card.name: Oriole Katana
card.text:
One-Handed • Sword • Weapon
This Personality has Conqueror (A Conqueror's unit doesn't bow after battle).
card.flavor: The sword of a Tsi artisan is unparalleled in the Empire. Forged from seven layers of folded steel, often taking years to forge properly, and Oriole blade is the perfect expression of swordsmanship. One cannot even be forged without the blessing of an Emperor.

card.name: Glimpse of the Unicorn
card.text: Dynasty: Draw a card. (You may only take Dyansty actions during your Dynasty Phase.)
card.flavor: The ki-rin is an ancient and sacred creature of legend. It appears in the mortal realm perhaps once each generation, and those who see it are blessed.

card.name: Military Alliance
card.text:
Unique
After each time an Attacker destroys a province by winning a battle, he gains 3 Honor.
Open: Put this Event into play.
card.flavor: "I bring you a gift, the head of the man who shamed both our houses. Perhaps now we can grow in strength together once again."

card.name: Bayushi Toshimo
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Bitter Lies • Paragon • Samurai • Yojimbo • Kensai • Loyal
(Kensai may attach two Weapons, as long as neither is Two-Handed.)
Battle: Bow a target enemy card without attachments. If Toshimo has a Weapon or you control a Courtier, the card cannot straighten.
card.flavor: "I fear you must come out of retirement," the man told Toshimo. "Do this, and Nitoshi-sama may be swayed to forgive your past indiscretions."

card.name: Bayushi Dakatsu
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Magistrate • Samurai • Soul of Shosuro Takagi • Yojimbo
After another player's Battle action targets a Courtier at Dakatsu's location, the player loses 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "A yojimbo's deterrence can take many forms. It is good to defend against attack, but better to prevent one in the first place."

card.name: Bayushi Masashi
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Yojimbo
Battle: Fear 2. This may target a Personality with Followers if he has 0 Personal Honor (Bow a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with 2 or lower Force).
card.flavor: Among predominant courtiers, there exist three main desirable qualities for a potential yojimbo. The first is obviously skill. The second is loyalty. The final, and most overlooked, is silence.

card.name: Coward!
card.text: Battle: Target your unbowed Samurai and target a Personality in the Defender's home. Straighten his unit. The Defender may move him to the current battlefield. If he chose not to, he loses 2 Honor, dishonor the Personality, and you may draw two cards.
card.flavor: "Those who fear to act have already failed." - Tao of Shinsei

card.name: Ancestral Armor of the Scorpion Clan
card.text:
Armor • Experienced Shoju's Armor • Unique
Can only attach to a Scorpion Clan Personality. After you Equip this Item, another player loses 2 Honor.
Limited, [BOW]: Target a Personality. Bow him if he is dishonorable. Dishonor him.
card.flavor: The armor of Shoju rests as a sentinel in Traitor's Grove. On some nights, it calls the Scorpion Champion's name.

card.name: My Lord's Favor
card.text:
Political Open: Target your Personality. Take the Imperial Favor.
Favor Political Battle/Open: Discard the Imperial Favor to straighten your target Personality's unit.
card.flavor: "For one's worth to be recognized by one's own lord is one of the most sublime pleasures a samurai can enjoy." - Akodo's Leadership

card.name: The Company You Keep
card.text: Political Open: Target a Personality. Personalities his controller Recruits (this turn) with greater Personal Honor than the target has now are dishonored before they enter play.
card.flavor: "Rest now. Let me tend to your wounds. It is the least that I can do for your valor."

card.name: Yozo's Inspiration
card.text:
Unique
Limited: Until your second turn from now begins, your Personalities have +1F while attacking a player who declared an attack against you since your last turn ended.
card.flavor: Punishment to the wicked. Vengeance for the just.

card.name: Frost Dragon Festival
card.text:
Festival • Unique
Limited: Give all other players' non-Unique Holdings -1 Gold Production until your next turn begins.
card.flavor: The Fortune of Rice's wrathful aspect is not celebrated so much as begged for mercy and a swift departure.

card.name: Merchant Guard
card.text: This Follower has +1F while you control a Market.
card.flavor: "Let the thieves come," the merchant said, her smile glinting. "We have better protection now."

card.name: The Amethyst Court
card.text:
Unique
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
[BOW]: Bow your target unbowed Courtier or Artisan. Produce Gold equal to his Chi.
card.flavor: "The position affords those who hold it the authority of the Empress. It has been woefully underutilized thus far." - Asako Izuna

card.name: The Emerald Dojo
card.text:
Dojo • Unique
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Open, [BOW]: Straighten your target Personality.
card.flavor: "Forge your spirit into steel through honor and discipline. Become like the blade that is your soul." - Utaku Ji-Yun

card.name: The Ivory Dojo
card.text:
Dojo • Unique
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Open, [BOW]: Bow your target unbowed Personality. Bow a target dishonorable Personality.
card.flavor: "There are few of us, but numbers are not important. What matters is our heart." - Shinjo Tselu

card.name: The Jade Temple
card.text:
Temple • Unique
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Battle, [BOW]: Straighten your target Spell. You may use its abilities a second time.
card.flavor: "The Emerald shields the body, but Jade shields the spirit. We are the shepards of this Empire. Never forget." - Asahina Nanae

card.name: The Obsidian Dueling Grounds
card.text:
Unique
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Limited, [BOW]: Permanently give your target Samurai Shadowlands. Give him three +1F tokens. Destroy this Holding. Lose 4 Honor.
card.flavor: "It is unfortunate that certain traditions must be abandoned in the face of necessity." - Daigotsu Kanpeki

card.name: The Onyx Dueling Circle
card.text:
Unique
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Limited, [BOW]: Destroy your target Shugenja. Create a 5F/2C/0PH Nonhuman • Oni • Shadowlands Personality. Destroy this Holding. Lose 4 Honor.
card.flavor: "Ikoma Ayumu has disgraced everything. I shall see him suffer legendary torment for this insult." - Chuda Hikano

card.name: The Ruby Dojo
card.text:
Dojo • Unique
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Political Limited, [BOW]: Bow your target unbowed Magistrate Personality. Dishonor a target Personality.
card.flavor: "I will see you made into warriors worthy of the Emerald name." - Tsuruchi Nobukatsu

card.name: The Topaz Dojo
card.text:
Dojo • Unique
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Open, [BOW]: Give a +1F/+1C Training token to a target Personality with no printed abilities and no Training token.
card.flavor: "The title lasts only a year, but its effects are felt for a lifetime." - Kitsuki Nakai

card.name: The Turquoise Court
card.text:
Unique
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Political Limited, [BOW]: Bow your target unbowed Personality: You, or any player if the Personality is an Artisan, gain or lose 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "Poetry, paintings, plays... nothing thrills the soul like a tale of battle." - Ikoma Satoru

card.name: Vengeful Populace
card.text:
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Battle, [BOW]: Bow your target unbowed Follower or Item. Bow a target enemy Personality without attachments.
card.flavor: "If there is one thing that the riot at the Second City has taught me, it is that even ordinary peasants can be a force to reckon with, given the right circumstances." - Shinjo Tselu

card.name: Resist Magic
card.text: Interrupt: After an action on a Kiho, Shugenja, or Spell targets your cards, negate its remaining effects.
card.flavor: "We seek the deeper mysteries of the Elements," Hizumi said. "A pity you did not."

card.name: Disrupting the Rhythm
card.text: Battle: You may use an ability on your target Weapon an additional time this turn. Straighten it if it is attached to a Kensai. You may take an additional action.
card.flavor: "If my opponent breathes on one, draws on two, and strikes on three, then I aim to strike between two and three. Know your opponent's rhythm and strike when he cannot." - Mirumoto's Niten

card.name: Encircled Terrain
card.text:
Terrain
Before this battle resolves, the Attacker and Defender, in the order of your choice, each choose one of their own Personalities at its battlefield. Move all other Personalities there home.
Battle: Destroy a Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play.
card.flavor: "Some welcome peace, and some stir up conflict. Again." - Shiba Tsukimi

card.name: Secluded Shrine
card.text:
Temple
[BOW]: Produce 1 Gold.
Limited: If you have not lost Honor from cards you own this game and your Family Honor is below your starting Honor, gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "A simple place, but one that never fails to fill my heart with peace." - Asahina Umeko

card.name: Tsuruchi Natsuki
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Magistrate • Samurai • Soul of Tsuruchi Masako
Interrupt: Give one of the action's Ranged Attacks +1 strength.
card.flavor: "If I told you why the Tsuruchi are the best archers in Rokugan, then it would no longer be a secret, would it?"

card.name: Bounty Hunter
card.text: Battle: Bow a target attachment or a target dishonorable Personality.
card.flavor: "The reward is for the man to be brought in alive. More difficult, perhaps, but also better pay."

card.name: Ancestral Armor of the Mantis Clan
card.text:
Armor • Experienced Yoritomo's Armor • Unique
Can only attach to a Mantis Clan Personality. After you Equip this Item, gain 2 Honor.
Open, [BOW]: Straighten your target Holding.
card.flavor: Forged by the Suzume, blessed by the Kitsune and Moshi, and tested by the Tsuruchi, Kaminari has not been donned since the death of its first and only master.

card.name: Tsuruchi Gosho
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Scout • Thunder • Naval • Reserve
(You may Recruit a Reserve Personality, if he would be opposed, as an Absent Battle action.)
Thunder Interrupt: After you Recruit Gosho at this battlefield, Ranged 3 Attack.
card.flavor: "I have been told that it is a simple trick, to shoot an unprepared for. Perhaps so. But it is an exceptionally effective trick."

card.name: Higher Ground
card.text:
Terrain
Your Ranged Attacks have +1 strength. Other player's Ranged Attacks have -1 strength.
Battle: Destroy a Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play.
card.flavor: "Every good general tries to have it. A better general knows how to do without it." - Akodo Dairuko

card.name: Kaeru Contractor
card.text:
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
[BOW]: When paying for an action on a Strategy, it costs 3 less Gold.
card.flavor: "After all, there are many ways of knowing what another lord is planning." - Bayushi Nitoshi

card.name: Ambush
card.text: Limited: Target your unbowed Personality and another player's Personality. Create a battlefield (not at any Province). Assign your Personality to attack there. Assign the other Personality to defend there, even if he is bowed. Other Personalities cannot move there. Fight a battle there (after this action resolves). After the battle ends, lose 5 Honor.
card.flavor: "Is this how it ends for me? Finally on the other side of this event?"

card.name: Kaiu Nakagawa
card.text:
Crab Clan • Engineer • Samurai • Siege • Soul of Kaiu Shoichi
Engage: If your attacking army has fewer Personalities than the enemy army, the Defender chooses a number of units in his army equal to the difference, and they move home.
card.flavor: "I have no time to retire. The Crab Clan needs me."

card.name: Carrion's Breath
card.text:
Shadowlands
After you Recruit this Holding, lose 1 Honor.
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Battle/Open, [BOW]: Fear effects from all cards (now) in a target Personality's unit have +1 strength.
card.flavor: It remains a place or horror and fear.

card.name: Sasada
card.text:
Mantis Clan • Ningyo • Nonhuman • Scout • Storm Rider • Naval
(Once a turn, the Attacker gets the first Battle action, if it's from a Naval Personality's unit.)
Tireless Battle/Open: Bow your target unbowed Port. Straighten Sasada.
card.flavor: "Hello, my old friend. I am glad to see you too have avoided the Dark Naga's grasp."

card.name: Kuni Tomokazu
card.text:
Crab Clan • Earth • Soul of Kuni Takaniro • Shugenja
(Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
Negate Fear effects targeting cards in this unit. Ranged Attacks targeting cards in this unit have -2 strength.
card.flavor: "I will never trust a Spider, no matter what they tell me."

card.name: Asahina Umeko
card.text:
Crane Clan • Air • Soul of Asahina Kimita • Shugenja
(Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
card.flavor: "The Phoenix? The Phoenix are always fretting about something. I do not fear their interest in our family, for the Crane Clan takes care of its own."

card.name: Mist
card.text:
Terrain
Ranged Attacks from any player's cards have -2 strength unless he controls a Scout at this battlefield.
Battle/Engage: Destroy a Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play.
card.flavor: "Know your terrain. Know it so well that it does not matter if you cannot see it." - Daidoji Tametaka

card.name: Togashi Ogure
card.text:
Dragon Clan • Monk • Soul of Hoshi Akiyama
Battle: Discard a Kiho to give Ogure +2F, or +3F if he is defending.
Battle: Bow your target unbowed Ring. Take two additional Battle actions.
card.flavor: The temptation to apply the teachings of kaze-do can be overwhelming.

card.name: Matsu Morito
card.text:
Lion Clan • Deathseeker • Samurai • Soul of Matsu Sanraku
Battle, [BOW]: Move home a target enemy unit.
card.flavor: "He broke the enemy line as if it were air, and assaulted the command group itself. They fled, giving the day to the Lion." - Akodo Kenaro

card.name: Daigotsu Konishi
card.text:
Spider Clan • Samurai • Shadowlands
Battle: Give a target enemy Follower or Personality -2F.
card.flavor: "Throughout history, that which has belonged to the Lost has been taken away unjustly. I will not allow our holdings to be taken from us ever again."

card.name: Isawa Uzuyumi
card.text:
Phoenix Clan • Soul of Isawa Riake • Water • Shugenja
(Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
Water Home Battle, [BOW]: Move a target unit at any battlefield to a different, unresolved battlefield.
card.flavor: "No, Lion-san, I have not studied Akodo's works. Water speaks clearly enough on this matter."

card.name: Shosuro Tagiso
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Ninja • Samurai • Soul of Shosuro Hihiko
Ninja Battle: Discard a card from this Province. If the card is a Personality, give Tagiso +2F.
card.flavor: They found the governor's body outside in the morning. Magistrates determined that he had accidentally fallen from his balcony the previous night. Why no one heard his fall was never explained.

card.name: Shosuro Tosaku
card.text:
Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Soul of Bayushi Tai • Spy
Limited: Choose a Province and turn its card face-up (if necessary). Reduce the Province's strength by the Personal Honor of any Personality in it.
card.flavor:
"Your informant is late," the yojimbo growled impatiently.
"No," Hotaka replied, lifting his eyes, "he's been here this whole time."

card.name: Tairao
card.text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Soul of Chuda Rintaro • Shugenja
(Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
Open: Target another player's Personality. After each time he assigns this turn, give him -2F/-1C and Shadowlands (this turn).
card.flavor: "Once I might have had a family, a legacy to serve in the name of the Spider. My people betrayed the clan, and now I am nothing but a remnant."

card.name: Shinjo Okiau
card.text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Scout • Soul of Shinjo Aniji • Cavalry
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to this battle.)
card.flavor: The children of the Four Winds indulge their wanderlust across the vast plains of the Empire.

card.name: Spearmen Cavalry
card.text:
Cavalry
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 2 Attack.
card.flavor: "The daidoji favor the spear, which serves them well in small mounted expeditions." - Kakita Tadanobu

card.name: Haramaki-do
card.text:
Armor
This Personality has +1PH.
Battle: Fear 3.
card.flavor: More wars mean more innovations for armors. For the first time in centuries, armor-makers are breaking the molds of tradition, and a new age of armor-smithing has awakened.

card.name: Do-Maru
card.text:
Armor
This Personality has +1PH.
Battle: Fear 2 (Bow a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with 2 or lower Force).
