card.flavor: Every suit of armor must be custom-fitted for the wearer. New suits are commissioned before the samurai's gempukku, and ancestral suits are rarely worn.

card.name: A Ready Soul
card.text: Battle, [PAY *]: Equip a Weapon to your target Personality, paying 3 less Gold if he is a Kensai and opposed.
card.flavor: "A true samurai always grasps his sword - if not with his hand, then with his soul. Should his soul be ready, so is his sword." - Mirumoto Yonekura

card.name: A Stout Heart
card.text: Interrupt: Negate the action's Fear effects.
card.flavor: "I applaud your bravery, but this can only end one way."

card.name: Confusion at Court
card.text: Political Interrupt: Negate the effects of a Favor action, its player discards the Imperial Favor.
card.flavor: "Perhaps, Seiken, but they were serving diligently until a particular untimely arrival threw the courts into chaos."

card.name: Doji Shirarou
card.text:
Crane Clan • Artisan • Samurai • Soul of Doji Bukita
Limited: Discard the top card of your Fate deck. Target another player, who may choose to lose 2 Honor. If he does not choose this, gain Honor equal to the card's Focus Value.
card.flavor: "Really, Tametaka. I expected you to see the value of an unexpected strategic move."

card.name: Focus
card.flavor: "Our schools use different words to discuss it, but both the Mirumoto and the Kakita agree that no duelist can do without it." - Mirumoto Shikei

card.name: Oath of Fealty
card.text: Limited: Permanently remove all Clan Alignments from all your Human Personalities without your Clan Alignment, permanently give them your Clan Alignment, and give them each a +1F/+1C token.
card.flavor: "My service is a gift, Renyu-sama," the Asahina said politely, "so that you know our offer is sincere."

card.name: Sneak Attack
card.text: Engage: The Attacker has the first opportunity to take a Battle action or pass in this battle.
card.flavor: Surprise is a tactic in warfare like any other. But sometimes, it is difficult to see where acceptable strategy ends and dishonorable actions begin.

card.name: Incendiary Archers
card.text:
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 2 Attack.
Battle: Fear 2.
card.flavor: "Something as simple as a little fire can quickly cause chaos in the ranks of the undisciplined." - Akodo Kano

card.name: Dainiko
card.text:
Fire • Monk • Ronin • Soul of Nakadai
After you Recruit Dainiko, give her four +1F Fire tokens.
card.flavor: "I revel in the forms of the five elements. This is the form of the Flawless Summer Breeze. Is it not spectacular?"

card.name: Weakness Exposed
card.text: Iaijutsu Battle: Your target unbowed Personality challenges a target enemy Personality. Bow the loser. Destroy him if he is defending.
card.flavor: "This tiny box. All that you were, all that you had, you threw away for the contents of this tiny box. Was your life worth so little?"

card.name: Sleep
card.text: Ritual Air Limited: Bow one or more of your target unbowed Shugenja. Discard an equal number of cards from the top of your Fate deck. Bow zero or more target Personalities with total Chi less than the total of the cards' Focus Values. Destroy this Spell.
card.flavor: She would not have smiled in her dreams if she had known.

card.name: Gaijin Sorcerer
card.text:
Gaijin • Shugenja
While your ritual is resolving, Gaijin Sorcerer counts as two Shugenja.
card.flavor: "Perhaps his outlandish garb makes him so effective," Iuchi Yupadi said, not entirely joking.

card.name: War
card.text:
Unique
Battle: Target your Personality. If you win this battle and your army's total Force is greater than this Province's strength, destroy the Province and your Personality.
card.flavor: The tragedy of being served by a caste of warriors is that they will always seek war, no matter the circumstance.

card.name: The Exquisite Palace of the Crane (1)
card.text:
Limited: Target a Holding. Until the phase ends, either give it +1 Gold Production, or increase Honor gains from its abilities by 1.

(MRP)
card.flavor: Built to honor the founder of the Crane Clan, it is among their most beautiful and radiant treasures.

card.name: The Exquisite Palace of the Crane (2)
card.text:
You are considered to have +5 Family Honor when Lobbying checks Honor.
Limited: Target a Holding. Until the phase ends, either give it +1 Gold Production, or increase Honor gains from its abilities by 1.

(MRP)
card.flavor: As splendid as the Crane themselves.

card.name: Akagi Sensei
card.text:
Crane Clan
Reduce your Honor gains from Holdings by 1.
Absent Battle, [BOW]: Move your target Scout Personality home or, if he would be opposed, move your target Scout Personality at home to the current battlefield.

(MRP)
card.flavor: "Mobility, students, will win more wars than honor."

card.name: Kataoka
card.text:
Ronin • Samurai • Commander • Cavalry
Enters play for 1 less Gold for each Farm other players control.
card.flavor: "Onward, men! The commander has ordered these heretics driven from the Colonies, and the madmen slain. I for one will see this order fulfilled!"

card.name: Horse
card.text:
Horse • Nonhuman • Cavalry
Attaches to Kataoka ignoring costs.
Will only attach to a Human.
This Personality has Cavalry.
card.flavor: "Spirited," the battle maiden said, almost approving.

card.name: Expansive Range
card.text:
Dojo
[BOW]: Produce 3 Gold.
Interrupt, [BOW]: Give a Ranged Attack +1 strength.
card.flavor: "What a wonderful view you've discovered!" he marveled. "Too bad it is wasted on a dull, single-minded bushi like you."

card.name: Taken Hostage
card.text: Battle: Target your Personality. Give a target enemy Follower or Personality a Force penalty equal to your Personality's Chi plus Personal Honor. Destroy your Personality.
card.flavor: Kanaye shoved the Scorpion roughly. "I think you will benefit from a little Mantis hospitality," he told Makubesu. "Or at least the Mantis will benefit. You? I do not care."

card.name: Sudden Storm
card.text:
Terrain
After a Personality moves to this battlefield, his controller must target and bow an unbowed card in his unit.
Absent Battle/Engage: Destroy a Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play. (Absent actions may be taken without presence.)
card.flavor: "I understand you Mantis enjoy the rain," Shunsuko whispered. "Let us see just how much."

card.name: Carpenter Shrine
card.text:
Temple • Fortification
(Fortifications attach to the Province from which they entered play.)
This Fortification enters play bowed.
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Open, [BOW]: Gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: Few places have as many shrines to the dead as The Great Carpenter Wall.

card.name: Seppun Teshan
card.text:
Air • Courtier • Hidden Guard • Imperial • Shugenja
(Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
Teshan Lobbies without bowing.
card.flavor: "This is the Blood that I have heard so much of, then? The very sight of it sickens me, yet I cannot deny that it radiates power such as I have never experienced."

card.name: Oneiyara
card.text:
Ronin • Duelist • Kensai
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists. Kensai may attach two Weapons, as long as neither is Two-Handed.)
Iaijutsu Battle: Oneiyara challenges a target enemy Personality. After the duel, Fear equal to Oneiyara's Force that targets the loser.
card.flavor: "I See with one eye what you cannot with two. I see victory."

card.name: The Blessing
card.text: Economic Open: Target your Holding. After your next turn begins, give it a +1 Gold Production Wealth token.
card.flavor: The Emperor's Blessing will help the needy rebuild their homes, restoring them to their former glory.

card.name: Denial
card.text:
After a player's Favor action resolves, he loses 2 Honor.
Open: Put this Event into play. Discard it after your second turn from now begins.
card.flavor: "It does not matter if you think you do not play the game," she said, smiling. "Everyone plays. Those who claim to avoid it simply lose."

card.name: Auspicious Arrival
card.text: Political Battle/Open: Take the Imperial Favor.
card.flavor: The arrival of an Imperial heir is cause for circumstance for every city.

card.name: Alchemy Lab
card.text:
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Open, [BOW]: Increase a positive numeral on your target Spell by 1. (2 is a numeral, two is not.)
card.flavor: The Tamori are the greatest researchers of alchemy, a process they call mizugusuri. The brightest of them could bind the elements to complex concoctions, ready to be imbibed.

card.name: Bookkeeper
card.text:
Merchant • Retainer
[BOW]: Produce 1 Gold. Give this Holding a +1 Gold Production Wealth token if you are bringing a Holding into play.
card.flavor: A necessary evil, should one desire to keep one's Imperial taxes in line.

card.name: Temple of Serenity
card.text:
Temple
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Battle, [PAY *], [BOW]: Equip a Spell to your target opposed Shugenja for 2 less Gold. Gain 1 Honor, or 2 Honor if the target is defending.
card.flavor: "There is a reason we place our temples in remote lands. We must be close to the elements to train."

card.name: Kaiu Engineers
card.text:
Retainer
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Battle/Open: Transfer your target Fortification at any Province to any of your other Provinces.
card.flavor: The Kaiu practice destroying their creations, if only to recreate them without the weakness they exploited.

card.name: Summer Court
card.text:
[BOW]: Produce 3 Gold.
Open, [BOW]: Straighten a target Sensei.
card.flavor: "Of course the Second City is the most suitable location. You must agree, however, that it has often been plagued by strife and chaos. All I suggest is this... would it not be wise to have a suitable location for more delicate pursuits? Why not here, at Twin Forks?"

card.name: Cloth Market
card.text:
Market • Kharmic
(Repeatable Limited, [PAY 2]: Discard a Kharmic card from your Province and refill it face-up.)
[BOW]: Produce 5 Gold.
card.flavor: Though it has taken time, some clever samurai have learned a great deal about techniques used by the Ivory Kingdoms to make unusual and exotic silk and cloth.

card.name: House of Disgrace
card.text:
After this Holding enters play, lose 3 Honor.
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold, or lose 1 Honor to produce 3 Gold.
Tireless Open: Give another player's target Personality -2PH.
card.flavor: "Let us step inside for just a moment, my friend. I only need to see someone."

card.name: Hotei's Smile
card.text:
Sake House
[BOW]: Produce 5 Gold.
Battle: Straighten your target Personality. Bow him before this battle resolves.
card.flavor: "The Fortune of Contentment himself would find our selection cause for joy! Drink, my friends! Drink!"

card.name: Voice of Experience
card.text:
Retainer • Kharmic
(Repeatable Limited, [PAY 2]: Discard a Kharmic card from your Province and refill it face-up.)
[BOW]: Produce 3 Gold.
Interrupt: After each time the action discards or shows any cards, you may give them +1FV. (Focused cards cannot gain this bonus.)
card.flavor: "Learn from my mistakes, students," Ichizo said.

card.name: Temple of the Heavenly Crab
card.text:
Temple
Invest [PAY 1]: Until the game ends, this Holding also straightens at the start of other players' turns. (After this card enters play, you may also pay the Invest cost to get the effect.)
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
card.flavor: Never shall it fall.

card.name: Bountiful Fields
card.text:
Farm
[BOW]: Produce 4 Gold.
Battle, [BOW]: Target two or more of your Personalities with Force penalties from the same source. Negate those penalties.
card.flavor: "The Scorpion had more food than they could harvest, but we will not be so wasteful with their land." - Akodo Kenaro

card.name: Shigekawa's Court
card.text:
Imperial • Retainer
You are considered to have +5 Family Honor when Lobbying checks Honor.
[BOW]: Produce 1 Gold.
Open, [BOW]: Straighten a target Personality who Lobbied this turn.
card.flavor: "Toturi Shigekawa was a great and honorable man. Here we honor his memory and ideals."

card.name: Tunnel Network
card.text:
Fortification • Kharmic
Battle, [BOW]: Move your target Personality home.
Absent Battle, [BOW]: Move your target Personality at home to this battlefield.
card.flavor: Few samurai give thought to the ground beneath their feet...

card.name: Defensive Memorial
card.text:
Fortification
(Fortifications attach to the Province from which they entered play.)
This Fortification enters play bowed. This Province has +2 strength.
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
card.flavor: "We remember our dead, and we draw strength from their memory." - Kaiu Nakagawa

card.name: Bitter Lies Technique
card.text: Battle: Bow your target unbowed Personality. Fear equal to his Force. If he is a Kensai, you may bow one of his Weapons to straighten him.
card.flavor: Akagi laughed and cut down two more. "Are you enjoying yourself?" he demanded of his foes. "I certainly am!"

card.name: Hida Zaiberu
card.text:
Drunkard • Samurai
Cannot attach Followers.
Battle: Zaiberu is belligerent. Give a target enemy Follower or Personality -2F.
card.flavor: "I will decide when I've had enough, peasant! Now... bring me more drink!"

card.name: Hiruma Maiko
card.text:
Samurai • Scout • Reserve
(You may Recruit a Reserve Personality, if they would be opposed, as an Absent Battle action.)
Maiko enters play for 1 less Gold if you are Lion Clan.
card.flavor: "Good morning, Ikoma-san! I thought we might continue our little archery contest. Do you wish to make it interesting?"

card.name: Kuni Shinoda, Advisor to the Jade Champion
card.text:
Earth • Hero • Jade • Magistrate • Scout • Experienced 2 • Shugenja • Tactician • Unique
Jade Battle: Fear 3, or 5 if the target is Shadowlands, that may target a Personality with Followers.
card.flavor: "If only a part of what Renyu-sama says of the Spider in the Colonies is true... it is very disturbing indeed."

card.name: Toritaka Isai
card.text:
Samurai • Scout
Battle, [BOW]: Bow a target enemy card.
card.flavor:
"I do not know how the other clans learned of Kaiji," the commander said, "but it is making things difficult in the city. I suspect the Dragon. Go and find out whatever you can about them."

"Yes, my lord."

card.name: Yasuki Aitoko
card.text:
Courtier • Merchant • Destined
Invest [PAY 3], or [PAY 2] if another player is Dragon Clan: Permanently give your target Holding the ability, "Economic Open, [BOW]: A target player loses 1 Honor."
card.flavor: "I have great respect for the Brotherhood. However, if they choose to continue to ally with the Spider, then there will be difficulties."

card.name: Yasuki Shairei
card.text:
Courtier • Merchant
Economic Open, [BOW]: Target a Personality with lower Personal Honor than printed. His controller may pay Gold equal to the difference plus 1. If he does not, he loses Honor equal to the difference.
card.flavor: "Lord Renyu intends to tax the monasteries to hurt the Spider. Carry word to this monastery in particular. Tell no one else."

card.name: Daidoji Ryushi
card.text:
Samurai • Scout • Reserve
(You may Recruit a Reserve Personality, if they would be opposed, as an Absent Battle action.)
Absent Interrupt: After you Recruit Ryushi, give him +2F.
card.flavor: The conflict between Iweko Seiken and the Imperial Governor continued to complicate matters in the Second City, and as a result, the Crane began to conspire to move the Colonial Court to their city at Twin Forks.

card.name: Daidoji Sutebo
card.text:
Samurai • Scout
Battle: Give a target Personality that has moved or entered play this battle +2F or -2F.
card.flavor: "You can see the Lion encampment here, and the Scorpion here. They will converge sometime tomorrow, unless we take steps to stop it."

card.name: Doji Natsuyo
card.text:
Courtier
Natsuyo enters play for 1 less Gold if another player is Scorpion Clan.
Favor Political Open, [BOW]: Discard the Imperial Favor to gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "Dainagon's apprentice is beautiful and clever, and has many allies. And she never capitalizes on their secrets. For some reason." - Shosuro Makiko

card.name: Kakita Burei
card.text:
Artisan • Braggart • Samurai • Duelist
Interrupt: If the action creates a duel involving Burei, ignore Items' Chi Modifiers in the duel's resolution.
Iaijutsu Battle: Give a target enemy Personality -3F.
card.flavor: "You would be honored to join me for dinner, you say? Well of course you would!"

card.name: Kakita Jikeru
card.text:
Artisan • Courtier • Jester
Political Open, [BOW]: Target a Personality. After the next time he assigns to attack a Province with a Fortification, target a player who gains or loses 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "Oh brave warriors, kicking over shrines and gardens. Truly it is a most dangerous duty!"

card.name: Mirumoto Reiji
card.text:
Samurai • Cavalry • Kensai
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to this battle. Kensai may attach two Weapons, as long as neither is Two-Handed.)
card.flavor: While not known for their cavalry, the Dragon do boast the most sure-footed mounts in the Empire.

card.name: Togashi Yayoi
card.text:
Monk • Tattooed
Battle, [BOW]: Destroy a target enemy attachment with Force less than or equal to Yayoi's Chi.
card.flavor: "Do not attribute to mystical arts what could instead be attributed to discipline and indomitable will." - Shosuro Tosaku

card.name: Kitsuki Kira
card.text:
Courtier • Magistrate
Political Battle, [BOW]: Dishonor a target enemy Personality and give him -2F. If this targeted a Crab Clan Personality, you may target another Personality and give him -2F.
card.flavor: "The Spider are under our purview. Your interference is not required."

card.name: Mirumoto Takanori
card.text:
Samurai • Kensai
Takanori has +1C while he has a Weapon.
Battle: Fear equal to Takanori's Chi.
card.flavor: "There are those who believe a single strike solves the duel. This is not so. What solves the duel comes before the strike." - Mirumoto's "Niten"

card.name: Tamori Junya
card.text:
Earth • Shugenja
(Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
Your Provinces with one or more Fortifications attached have +1 strength.
card.flavor: "So the Crab believe only they comprehend the way of earth." The Tamori frowned. "What folly."

card.name: Tamori Touya
card.text:
Blessed by Benten • Earth • Shugenja
(Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
Battle: Bow or destroy Touya's target Spell to reduce a target enemy Follower or Personality's Force by the Spell's Focus Value. If the Spell was Earth, gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "Emina's granddaughter received three marriage proposals. But she is too useful to give away just yet."

card.name: Ikoma Shungo
card.text:
Samurai • Scout • Cavalry • Reserve
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to the battle. You may Recruit a Reserve Personality, if they would be opposed, as an Absent Battle action.)
Shungo has +1F, or +2F if the Defender is Spider Clan, while attacking.
card.flavor: "They are up to something," the Ikoma swore. "They are biding their time. I care not what others say. I will uncover the truth."

card.name: Ikoma Keisuke
card.text:
Samurai • Scout
Keisuke's printed ability has Tireless while you control a Terrain or Crab Clan Personality at his battlefield.
Battle: Straighten a target attachment.
card.flavor: Not all were pleased to see the two mightiest armies in the Empire set aside their differences for common goals.

card.name: Kitsu Leiko
card.text:
Water • Shugenja
(Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
Open, [BOW]: Create a 2F/2C/3PH Lion Clan • Ancestor • Samurai • Spirit Personality.
card.flavor: "To use the Sodan-Senzo arts for war is distasteful." The Kitsu gestured to the spirit. "But our honored ancestor, Matsu Seijuro, convinced me to make an exception."

card.name: Kitsu Asato
card.text:
Water • Shugenja
(Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
Scorpion Clan players ignore Asato's Honor Requirement.
Home Water Battle, [BOW]: Give a target enemy Personality or Follower -2F.
card.flavor: "Sometimes one's honor must be set aside..."

card.name: Matsu Marii
card.text:
Beastmaster • Commander • Samurai
Battle, [PAY 3]: Create a 1F Cat • Nonhuman Follower and attach it to your target Personality.
card.flavor: "These beasts respect cunning and power. They are not unlike humans."

card.name: Akodo Iketsu
card.text:
Commander • Samurai • Tactician
Battle: Target one or two of your unbowed Personalities at another battlefield. If they would be opposed, move them to this battlefield.
card.flavor: "To think I once worried that an Empire at peace meant there would be no chance for war."

card.name: Kitsune Beiko
card.text:
Earth • Shugenja
(Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
Interrupt: After you Recruit Beiko, create a 5F/2C/3PH Mantis Clan • Bear • Nonhuman • Spirit Personality with the trait "Has -2F while attacking" and the ability, "Battle: Fear 4."
card.flavor: "I find your response disappointing. My friend, even more so!"

card.name: Moshi Raiko
card.text:
Lady of the Sun • Thunder • Naval • Shugenja
(Once a turn, the Attacker gets the first Battle action, if it's from a Naval Personlity's unit.)
Raiko has +1F/+1C while she has an Air, Fire, or Thunder Spell.
card.flavor: "She is a formidable force in the Second City. Were she not so accursedly inflexible, I might actually like her." - Bayushi Shibata

card.name: Tsuruchi Hikari
card.text:
Samurai • Scout • Reserve
(You may Recruit a Reserve Personality, if they would be opposed, as an Absent Battle action.)
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 2 Attack.
card.flavor: "My family worked very hard to find a safe route to the north, Phoenix. Why should I allow you to benefit in our stead?"

card.name: Tsuruchi Yashiro, Defender of the Obsidian Blades
card.text:
Jade • Samurai • Scout • Experienced • Unique
Jade Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 4 Attack. Straighten Yashiro if the target was Shadowlands.
card.flavor: "Let them come as often as they like, Ayumu-sensei. Each one that tries to take the blades is one that will never threaten the Empire again."

card.name: Yoritomo Shotsuo
card.text:
Samurai • Scout • Naval
Invest [PAY 2], or [PAY 0] if another player is Phoenix Clan: Permanently give Shotsuo Conqueror. (After this card enters play, you may also pay the Invest cost to get the effect, once. A Conqueror's unit doesn't bow after battle.)
card.flavor: "A good kill, eh? Too bad this is one of the smallest ones..."

card.name: Yoritomo Yusuke
card.text:
Kolat • Magistrate • Samurai
Tireless Open: Dishonor Yusuke to straighten him.
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
card.flavor: "My duty is to enforce the law. However, there are so many laws that quite a few contradict one another, leaving me with ... leeway."

card.name: Isawa Genma
card.text:
Air • Cavalry • Shugenja
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to this battle.)
Air Tireless Open: Straighten Genma.
card.flavor: She does her best to pay her respects to the elements. She does not know if the voices in her mind are signs of insanity, or the messages of the kami.

card.name: Isawa Kaname, Advisor the the Ruby Champion
card.text:
Fire • Magistrate • Yojimbo • Experienced • Shugenja • Unique
Fire Battle: Melee 2 Attack or Ranged 2 Attack.
Fire Engage: Give your target Shugenja +1F.
card.flavor: "I have proven worthy of this position a hundred times over. I can show you again, if you prefer."

card.name: Isawa Muira
card.text:
Fire • Conqueror • Shugenja
(A Conqueror's unit doesn't bow after battle. Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
card.flavor: He has given himself to the burning excess of Fire.

card.name: Isawa Kido
card.text:
Air • Shugenja
(Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
Air Battle: Fear equal to Kido's Chi. (Bow a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with Force equal to or lower than the Fear's strength).
card.flavor: "There are ways to avoid conflict. Display an unreasonable amount of force, and any bandit will lose his nerve."

card.name: Shiba Kakei
card.text:
Samurai • Yojimbo • Cavalry
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to the battle.)
Battle: Fear equal to 1 plus the number of actions resolved from your Kiho and Spells this battle.
card.flavor: He has the unenviable task of keeping the Isawa disciples of Water alive. He must do his best to keep up.

card.name: Shiba Yuuchi
card.text:
Samurai • Yojimbo
Battle: Target your Shugenja at any location. Give Yuuchi a Force bonus equal to the target's Chi.
Battle, [BOW]: Melee 2 Attack. (Destroy a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with 2 or lower Force).
card.flavor: "Shh! Do you hear that?"

card.name: Bayushi Fuyuko
card.text:
Courtier
After another player's Personality Lobbies, give him -1PH, or -2PH if he is Crane Clan.
Political Open, [BOW]: Target a Personality whose current Personal Honor is lower than printed. His controller loses 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "Makiko's apprentice is a master rhetorician. She can make her opponents question their own purpose. Be wary of her." - Doji Dainagon

card.name: Bayushi Kotomuri
card.text:
Junshin • Samurai • Yojimbo • Expendable
(Draw a card after your Expendable card dies.)
Invest [PAY2]: Dishonor one or two target Personalities with lower Personal Honor. (After this card enters play, you may also pay the Invest cost to get the effect, once.)
card.flavor: "He is brilliant, if troubled. It is my place to keep him alive, not ask questions."

card.name: Bayushi Jinn-Ja
card.text:
Courtier • Mastermind • Sake Addict
Interrupt: After you Recruit Jinn-Ja, put a target non-Unique Political Strategy in your discard pile into your hand.
card.flavor: "Haha! The Crane never anticipated it, and the Imperials are too busy to care. I tell you, Kotomuri-san, I don't know which part of that makes me happier."

card.name: Bayushi Akagi
card.text:
Bitter Lies • Samurai • Kensai
(Kensai may attach two Weapons, as long as neither is Two-Handed.)
Battle: Give a target enemy Personality a Force penalty equal to Akagi's Force.
card.flavor: "Hello, my Mantis friends. Perhaps after I have killed ten or so of you, you can teach me some sonderful sea songs to sing over your graves!"

card.name: Shosuro Kayo
card.text:
Samurai • Yojimbo
Battle, [BOW]: Melee 2 Attack, or Melee 3 Attack if the target is dishonorable. (Destroy a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with Force equal to or lower than the Melee Attack's strength).
card.flavor: "The Goju have come for you, mistress," she hissed. "Run, and I will give you the time you need to let the others know!"

card.name: Shosuro Sadao
card.text:
Ninja • Samurai • Spy
Ninja Battle: Give a target enemy Personality a -1F/-1C Poison token. You may move Sadao home if the target was Lion Clan.
card.flavor: "The Lion, for all their skill, seemed to think the war began only when soldiers gathered on the field."

card.name: Nao
card.text:
Monk • Kensai
(Kensai may attach two Weapons, as long as neither is Two-Handed.)
After a Fear effect from a card in Nao's unit, or from your action that targeted Nao, bows a Follower, destroy it.
card.flavor: "I sought perfection without the restraint of mercy. There was only one place for me to go."

card.name: Daigotsu Atsushi
card.text:
Samurai • Duelist • Expendable
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists. Draw a card after your Expendable card dies.)
Battle: Fear 2.
card.flavor: He looked at the corpse on the ground. "Talentless," he said with a sigh. When he turned his eyes to us, though, there was not disappointment - only death.

card.name: Susumu Mizuki
card.text:
Courtier • Reserve
(You may Recruit a Reserve Personality, if they would be opposed, as an Absent Battle action.)
Mizuki's Reserve may be used as an Absent Battle/Engage.
Invest [PAY 1]: Take the Imperial Favor.
card.flavor: "If you were not intrigued," she said with a smile, "you would have sent me away by now."

card.name: Susumu Takuan
card.text:
Courtier • Imperial
After your Spider Clan Personality is destroyed, gain 1 Honor.
Home Political Battle, [BOW]: Destroy your target Spider Clan Personality to destroy a target enemy card without attachments.
card.flavor: "Kuroko's husband is an odd one," Makoto mused. "That's the problem with that family. You know you should dislike them but they make it so difficult."

card.name: Daigotsu Teruo
card.text:
Samurai • Shadowlands • Expendable
(Draw a card after your Expendable card dies.)
Open, [BOW]: Look at the top five cards of your Fate deck. You may rearrange them. Draw a card. Destroy Teruo.
card.flavor: "The visions drove him to our master, who has given him the strength to suffer through them. In turn, he shares his knowledge with the Spider." - Daigotsu Kanpeki

card.name: Sora
card.text:
Monk • Kensai
Before one of Sora's Weapons is destroyed, draw a card.
Battle, [BOW]: Melee 2 Attack. You may bow Sora's Weapon to straighten him.
card.flavor: "The Togashi, pah! Too wrapped up in mysticism to know when to pick up something sharp instead of talk."

card.name: Aikiren
card.text:
Ronin
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 2 Attack. (Destroy a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with 2 or lower Force)
card.flavor: "Such a fantastic shot deserves a little reward, don't you think? A snack fit for a master archer."

card.name: Patairaku no Oni
card.text:
Nonhuman • Oni • Shadowlands
After Patairaku enters play, lose 3 Honor.
Battle, [PAY 2]: Create a 1F Goblin • Nonhuman • Pet • Shadowlands Follower and attach it to Patairaku.
card.flavor: "Humans speak of honor, then crush those weaker than themselves. Little ones, you have nothing to fear so long as I am here."

card.name: Zenathaar
card.text:
Naga • Nonhuman • Savior • Scout • Warrior of the Bright Eye
Zenathaar will not join you if you control any Shadowlands Personalities. Your other Naga Personalities have +1PH.
Home Battle: Move your target Naga Personality home.
card.flavor: "The humans have fought for us long enough. All that remains of the Dark Naga must fall."

card.name: Ide Kosaka
card.text:
Courtier • Merchant
Invest [PAY 2]: Create a (bowed) Holding with the trait, "[BOW]: Produce 1 Gold."
Economic Home Battle/Open, [PAY 1]: Straighten your target Courtier, Unicorn Clan, or Spider Clan Personality.
card.flavor: She is always willing to help a friend, should they offer her a favor in return.

card.name: Ide Aragaki
card.text:
Courtier • Merchant
[BOW]: Produce Gold equal to Aragaki's Personal Honor, which may only pay for one Invest cost.
card.flavor: "The Ide have a reputation for a reason, friends. I wish to increase our influence in this region. You wish to be able to fund your new venture. I think we can come to an understanding..."

card.name: Moto Erdene
card.text:
Death Priest • Water • Expendable • Shugenja
(Draw a card after your Expendable card dies.)
Tireless Battle: Erdene commits Seppuku. Bow a target enemy card. (Rehonor, then destroy, a Personality who commits Seppuku; these effects cannot be negated.)
card.flavor: She followed in the footsteps of her parents. It is her greatest wish that duty one day return her to her family.

card.name: Moto Qorin
card.text:
Death Priest • Water • Cavalry • Shugenja
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to this battle. Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
Qorin has Naval while he has a Water Spell.
card.flavor: "He has many who would fill the void in his heart. He needs only to turn to those by his side." - Moto Erdene

card.name: Shinjo Ajasu, Topaz Champion
card.text:
Samurai • Cavalry
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to the battle.)
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 2 Attack. If Ajasu has moved this battle, straighten him.
card.flavor: "My father took the Topaz Championship in his day. It is my honor to follow in his footsteps."

card.name: Utaku Saiken
card.text:
Samurai • Stable Master
Saiken cannot gain Cavalry.
Home Engage, [BOW]: Give Reserve to your target non-Unique Cavalry Personality in a Province.
card.flavor: "Some believe they are more important than Saiken-san because they march into combat, and he does not. They are fools." - Shinjo Ajasu

card.name: Battle Attendants
card.text:
Can only attach to a Samurai.
Engage, [BOW]: Create and attach a +2F/+0C Armor Item to this Personality. Remove it from the game after this battle ends.
card.flavor: A samurai requires many servants to attend to his or her needs, and war provides no exceptions.

card.name: Personal Guard
card.text:
Guard
This Follower has a Force bonus equal to this Personality's Personal Honor.
card.flavor: "My personal guard insists that I should take your life." Hachiro smiled at Karachu. "But that would be too merciful, I think."

card.name: Cavalry Escort
card.text:
Cavalry
Battle, [PAY *]: If this Follower is in your hand, Recruit your target Personality (paying all costs) for 5 more Gold and attach this Follower (ignoring all costs) to him.
card.flavor: "There are still dangers on the roads, my lord. I will keep you safe."

card.name: Jiramu's Wakizashi
card.text:
One-Handed • Sword • Weapon
Battle, [BOW]: Melee 2 Attack. (Destroy a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with 2 or lower Force).
card.flavor: Jiramu and Emoto had known it might come to this. The Seppun had been caught, and now there was only one way for him to convince the Kolat of his loyalty so that he might infiltrate them.

card.name: Mobile Troops
card.text:
Scout • Cavalry
Invest [PAY 3]: Give this Follower two +1F tokens. (After this card enters play, you may also pay the Invest cost to get the effects, once.)
After this unit moves, give this Follower +1F.
card.flavor: "This thing couldn't possibly be human. The Crab should answer for this... monstrosity!"

card.name: Samurai Lancers
card.text:
Cavalry
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to the battle.)
Battle: Discard a card to make a Fear effect with strength equal to its Focus Value.
card.flavor: Shinjo Sarang met the unwavering gaze of the fallen Crane. "So this is Doji Moro. What an enexpected pleasure."

card.name: Yomanri Archers
card.text:
Cavalry
Repeatable Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 3 Attack. (Repeatable actions may be taken any number of times per turn.)
card.flavor: Sung-Ki paused her horse by Yoritomo Doho's body. "Tell your ancestors, Yabusame is not only for practice."

card.name: Assault Unit
card.text:
Reserve
(You may Equip a Reserve attachment, if it would be opposed, as a Battle action.)
Interrupt: After the action Equips this Follower at a battlefield, Fear 3.
card.flavor: There is no shortage of samurai willing to lead an ill-fated charge.

card.name: Defensive Miko
card.text:
Expendable
(Draw a card after your Expendable card dies.))
This Personality cannot attack.
card.flavor:
"I am defeated," Shunsuko said. "Claim your victory, Crab."

Esumi lowered his guard. "Kill a priestess? Shame my ancestors? I think not."

card.name: Profiteer
card.text:
Merchant
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold, which may only pay for one Economic action's cost.
card.flavor: "You need not confess your crimes to me, Makoto-san. You'll soon be face-to-face with one far more worthy of that honor!"

card.name: Traveling Ronin - exp
card.text:
Ronin • Experienced
Tireless Battle: Transfer this Follower to another of your target Personalities. After it transfers, straighten it. (Tireless actions may be taken even while bowed.)
card.flavor: "Otokodate are often useful in our armies, granddaughter. Just don't let their numbers grow to large." - Matsu Kenji

card.name: Zlkyt's Family
card.text:
Nonhuman • Zokujin
Battle: If this Follower is attacking, Fear 4 that may target a Personality with Followers. (Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality with 4 or lower Force.).
card.flavor: "Foolish intruders! This is our mine!"

card.name: Aramasu's Mask
card.text:
Mempo
Cannot attach to a Scorpion Clan Personality. Equips to a Mantis Clan Personality for 1 less Gold. This Personality has Tactician.
Interrupt, [BOW]: Negate an action from a Fate card with the same Focus Value as a card discarded by this Personality's Tactical Advantage action this turn.

card.name: Awakened Naginata
card.text:
Polearm • Two-Handed • Destined • Weapon
(Draw a card after you Equip a Destined card.)
card.flavor: "There are many secrets for awakening powerful spirits within the weapons of war. However, there are few that can be trusted to use such power wisely. Even a fraction of such might in the hands of the unworthy can cause immeasurable tragedy." - Asako Chukage

card.name: Osano-Wo's Bow
card.text:
Bow • Jade • Two-Handed • Weapon
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 3 Attack, or Ranged 4 Attack if the target is Shadowlands. (Destroy a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with Force equal to or lower than the Ranged Attack's strength).
card.flavor: "I think on that moment every time I close my eyes. If there are Fortunes, it is certain they mock me." - Yoritomo Tansen

card.name: Kaiu Axe
card.text:
Heavy Weapon • One-Handed • Weapon
Battle, [BOW]: Give a target enemy Follower or Personality -2F.
card.flavor: "Some of the smiths find themselves inspired, taking the time to make elaborate patterns on the weapons. So long as it doesn't slow production or keep it from killing something, I leave them to their choices." - Hida Kisada

card.name: Kikko
card.text:
Armor
This Personality has +1PH.
Battle: Fear 2. (Bow a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with 2 or lower Force).
card.flavor: "Some secrets, some places are not even for you, Dragon," Sung-Ki said quietly as they rode away.

card.name: Tested Blade
card.text:
One-Handed • Sword • Weapon
Battle, [BOW]: Fear equal to this Personality's Chi that may target a Personality with Followers (Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality with Force equal to or lower than the Fear's strength).
card.flavor: "Look at that," the Scorpion said. "Lion blood matches my kimono perfectly."

card.name: Merciless Assault
card.text: Battle: Bow your target unbowed Follower. Melee Attack equal to its Force (Destroy a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with Force equal to or lower than the Melee Attack's strength).
card.flavor: "You think because you are an officer and I am a mere soldier that you are my superior in single combat? Your blood will serve as a warning to all others!"

card.name: Sohei's Ono
card.text:
Heavy Weapon • Two-Handed • Weapon
Battle, [BOW]: Melee 4 Attack. (Destroy a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with 4 or lower Force).
card.flavor: "How terrible is the Spider's wrath," Takuan noted casually, "if our mere monks can thwart beings from other Spirit Realms?"

card.name: Bo of Ritual Blessings
card.text:
Staff • Two-Handed • Weapon
Battle, [BOW]: Bow a target enemy card.
card.flavor: "It's interesting, is it not?" Jekku said casually. "I found it in the gaijin lands. It seems quite useful, even if you are not a priest. What do you think of that, Jikaro-san?"

card.name: Untested Blade
card.text:

Samurai • Scout

Battle: Target a Personality at any location; if Natsuki has no Training tokens, the target must have assigned to this battlefield. Move the target here. Straighten him if you do not control him.
card.flavor: "Why seek, when you can draw him in?"

card.name: Daidoji Hirota
card.text:
Courtier • Merchant
Invest [PAY 2]: You may target a Port, and you may target a different Market. Give each target a +1GP Wealth token.
card.flavor: "Trade is a profession that is beneath every Crane family. Except for the Daidoji, who seem to actually enjoy it." - Yasuki Jiro

card.name: Kakita Shinichi
card.text:
Samurai • Yojimbo • Duelist • Resilient
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists. Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution.)
Shinichi has +1F while you control Kakita Daitsu.
Battle: Fear 3.
card.flavor:
"Only two duels this season, Daitsu?" Shinichi chuckled. "I think you are losing a step, brother."

"The season isn't over," Daitsu smiled.

card.name: Kakita Ariyoshi
card.text:
Artisan • Courtier
Ariyoshi enters play for 1 less Gold if your Allegience is Progressive.
Political Battle: Show the top card of your Fate deck. Target an enemy Personality with Chi less than or equal to the card's Focus Value. His controller may choose to move him home. If he doesn't choose this, draw the top card and take an additional action.

card.name: Kakita Mariko
card.text:
Samurai • Duelist
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists.)
Interrupt: After you Recruit Mariko, look at the top card of your Dynasty deck. You may put it at the bottom.
card.flavor: "The duel is a river, and we are stones in its current. We are shaped by the duel as we determine its course. Death changes a person, don't you think?"

card.name: Mirumoto Futoro
card.text:
Samurai • Cavalry • Duelist
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to the battle.)
Iaijutsu Battle, [BOW]: Destroy a target enemy attachment with Force less than or equal to Futoro's Chi (Spells have zero Force).
card.flavor: The rice bowl clattered to the table. "Fighting?" he demanded. "In the Ivory Court? Are you absolutely certain?"

card.name: Mirumoto Jaikei
card.text:
Samurai • Kensai • Reserve • Resilient
(Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution.)
Jaikei does not gain Addiction tokens.
Invest [PAY 10], [PAY *]: Equip up to three Weapons to your Personalities, paying 4 less Gold each. You may target and bow a Shugenja. This Invest cost cannot be reduced.
card.flavor: "You... ah... you have a little something... right there." - Tamori Wataru

card.name: Mirumoto Saiko
card.text:
Samurai • Kensai
(Kensai may attach two Weapons, as long as neither is Two-Handed.) Battle, [BOW]: Melee Attack equal to Saiko's Force.
card.flavor: She bowed sharply. "The Dragon Champion wishes you to know that he supports the Crane in their mediation efforts. His aid is yours to call upon."

card.name: Tamori Ginrao
card.text:
Earth • Magistrate • Shugenja
Ginrao enters play for 1 less Gold if your Allegience is Progressive or you are a Crane Clan player. Ginrao also enters play for 2 less Gold if you do not control another Ginrao or you took a Kharmic action this turn.
card.flavor: Shikei nodded. "The Crane seek peace, and we should foster that. Perhaps we can mend what we once had with the Scorpion in the process."

card.name: Tamori Wataru
card.text:
Alchemist • Earth • Shugenja
Open, [BOW]: Create a Potion Item with the ability, "Engage: Destroy this Item to give this Personality +2F, the ability, 'Battle: Fear 3', and a -1C Addiction token" and attach it to your target Personality without a Potion Item.
card.flavor: "I wonder what would happen if I changed the mixture slightly... hmm, yes. Yes, I think so."

card.name: Togashi Shao
card.text:
Monk • Tattooed • Void • Resilient
Void Engage: You may give Shao +1F, or you may target an enemy Personality with higher printed Force and give him a Force penalty, and Shao a bonus, equal to the difference between their printed force.
card.flavor: "If the foolishness of the court could drive even our lord to strike out, what hope is there for it?"

card.name: Akodo Niito
card.text:
Samurai • Resilient
Niito enters play for 1 less Gold if your Allegiance is Traditionalist.
Battle, [BOW]: Target an enemy Personality with lower Personal Honor. Bow a number of target cards in his unit up to the difference in Personal Honor.
card.flavor: "Was there ever any doubt of our loyalty, Seiken-sama?"

card.name: Ikoma Genichi
card.text:
Samurai • Scout
Genichi has Resilient while he opposes a Scorpion Clan Personality or you control a Terrain. (Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution.)
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 3 Attack.
card.flavor: "They think they are faster. Smarter. This one was too stupid to stay out of harm's way, and too slow to save himself."

card.name: Ikoma Akinari
card.text:
Samurai • Scout
Invest [PAY 10]: Search your discard pile and Dynasty deck for one or two copies of Akinari. Recruit them, ignoring costs. This Invest cost cannot be reduced.
card.flavor: "The Imperial bureaucracy has approved our petition," Dairuko said to the fresh scouts. "Your training begins in earnest now. No more skirmishes - we war with Bayushi's clan, and they will pay for their pride."

card.name: Kitsu Junsuke
card.text:
Water • Shugenja
Increase your Honor gain from Proclaiming Junsuke to equal the number of Ancestors, up to 5, you control.
Home Battle, [BOW]: Give your target defending Ancestor +2F.
card.flavor: "Gunjin-sama, the priest said in a whisper. "Your presence is strong. What message do you bear?"

card.name: Kitsu Watanabe
card.text:
Water • Shugenja
Water Dynasty/Open, [BOW]: Straighten your target Fortification.
card.flavor: "Unthinkable," the Kitsu's voice shook with rage. "The Scorpion dare assault the sacred Tombs? The spirits of this world and those beyond will not suffer such blasphemy!" The water seemed to swell and roll with the shugenja's words, reaching for the enemy.

card.name: Matsu Rishou
card.text:
Deathseeker • Samurai
Rishou cannot defend.
card.flavor: "What tricks do you have now, Scorpion?" the Matsu laughed. "Did you think striking the Kitsu Tombs would enrage us? As if the Matsu do not draw strength from their rage!"

card.name: Kitsune Nakumi
card.text:
Earth • Nonhuman • Shugenja
Interrupt: After you Recruit Nakumi, create a 1F/2C/3PH Mantis Clan • Fox • Nonhuman • Spirit • Resilient Personality. (Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution.)
card.flavor: "They say fox spirits have difficulty hiding their tails, even in the guise of humans." - Kitsune Yamazaru

card.name: Kitsune Satoko
card.text:
Earth • Shugenja
Satoko enters play for 1 less Gold if your Allegience is Progressive.
Home Battle, [BOW]: Move your target Spirit Personality home. You may rehonor it.
card.flavor: "Satoko and her daughter Nakumi are among our finest spirit-tamers. She never speaks of Nakumi's father. They say he vanished, but I have my suspicions." - Kitsune Yamazaru

card.name: Tsuruchi Kaitaru
card.text:
Samurai • Scout • Naval • Resilient
(Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution.)
Invest [PAY 10]: Produce 15 Gold. This Invest cost cannot be reduced.
card.flavor: "It is just as much a scout's duty to uncover resources as it is to uncover enemies." - Yoritomo Hiromi

card.name: Yoritomo Haruna
card.text:
Courtier • Merchant
Economic Open, [BOW]: Target a Market or Port card in your Province. You may either use one of its abilities ignoring costs, produce 2 Gold, or target your Personality and give him +2F, or +3F if he is Spider Clan. Discard the card and refill the Province face-up.
card.flavor: "She works long hours for Yashinko-sama's convenience, affording no time for herself." - Yoritomo Dairu

card.name: Yoritomo Dairu
card.text:
Artisan • Samurai • Yojimbo • Kensai • Naval
(Kensai may attach two Weapons, as long as neither is Two-Handed.)
Battle: Bow a target enemy attachment with lower Force. You may bow one of Dairu's Weapons or one of your Ports to destroy the target.
card.flavor: "He looks over our sister where I cannot. At least she welcomes the runt's company." - Yoritomo Hiromi

card.name: Agasha Beiru
card.text:
Earth • Shugenja
Earth Open, [BOW], [PAY *]: Recruit a target Fortification in your discard pile (attach it to any of your Provinces). Give its Province a +1 strength Wall token.
card.flavor: At his command, the earth tore free from its bindings. "Stand down," he ordered the enemy. "I will not say it again."

card.name: Isawa Orinoko
card.text:
Fire • Shugenja
Orinoko enters play for 1 less Gold if your Allegiance is Traditionalist.
Invest [PAY 10]: Give Orinoko three +1F/+1C tokens, then permanently give her Conqueror and the ability "Fire Battle: Fear 5." This Invest cost cannot be reduced.
card.flavor: Those students instructed by Isawa Koiso find the secret to incredible power, but nagging questions haunt their conscience.

card.name: Isawa Kaisei
card.text:
Air • Cavalry • Destined • Shugenja
Air Open, [BOW]: If it is not your turn, target one of your Provinces. It is consecrated. Before the turn ends, if it hasn't been destroyed, gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: The court was in an uproar. "It is a simple matter," he insisted. "There is ample research to corroborate the fact. Gaijin blood renders one susceptible to spiritual corruption."

card.name: Isawa Waiko
card.text:
Fire • Resilient • Shugenja
(Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution.)
Fire Battle: If Waiko has a Fire Spell, Ranged 2 Attack.
card.flavor: "Still your rage, friend Moto!" she cried, but her assailant would not hear her. Hoping for forgiveness, she drew upon the power of fire to defend herself.

card.name: Shiba Tuoko
card.text:
Samurai • Yojimbo • Resilient
(Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution.)
Interrupt: After you Recruit Tuoko, create a 0F/2C/2PH Phoenix Clan • Void • Shugenja Personality.
card.flavor: "My lady Ontaiko, give me leave to respond to these insults. The Unicorn must pay for their offense."

card.name: Shiba Yinfuo
card.text:
Samurai • Yojimbo
Battle, [BOW]: Melee 2 Attack, or 3 if you took a Kharmic action this turn.
card.flavor: "You would strike down my charge now that she is weakened by defeating twenty of your men, sparing their lives? You are unworthy of the title of samurai."

card.name: Soshi Kitaiko
card.text:
Air • Courtier • Shugenja
Interrupt, [BOW]: After the action Equips your Spell to Kitaiko, draw a card.
Air Tireless Open: If Kitaiko has an Air Spell, straighten her.
card.flavor: "A kistune? Do not be silly. However, if they wish to think me one, so much the better."

card.name: Bayushi Yasunari
card.text:
Samurai • Yojimbo
Home Battle: If he would be opposed, move Yasunari to the current battlefield.
card.flavor: Yasunari watched the Dragon approach. "We know why you are here," he said irritably. "My mistress will not submit to your questioning. Ask again, and you will not like the answer you get."

card.name: Bayushi Atsuto
card.text:
Courtier • Samurai • Yojimbo • Conqueror
Atsuto has Resilient while opposing a dishonorable Personality. (Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution.)
card.flavor: "My lady," Atsuto said quietly. "I believe the Crane's attempt to prevent war was sincere. How... bizarre."

card.name: Shosuro Kiyofumi
card.text:
Ninja • Scout • Resilient
(Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution.)
Kiyofumi has Destined while you control a Geisha (Geisha Houses are not Geisha; Draw a card after you Recruit a Destined card).
card.flavor: "The Lion are notoriously disciplined. They hate drink, they hate gambling... but the honorable entertainer in their home is distraction enough, I suppose."

card.name: Shosuro Yasumasa
card.text:
Courtier
Interrupt: Increase each Honor loss from the Battle action by 1.
card.flavor: "It was no easy task, lord Nitoshi, but we were able to locate the man you sought in the Colonites. I present to you the war fan of Akodo Uehara. I believe he will not have the chance to return from the jungles to assist his clan in this war."

card.name: Yogo Gingo
card.text:
Samurai • Cavalry • Reserve
Gingo enters play for 1 less Gold if your Allegiance is Traditionalist.
Invest [PAY 10]: Give Gingo two +1F/+1C tokens, and permanently give him Conqueror and the ability, "Battle: Move a target Personality home." This Invest cost cannot be reduced.
card.flavor: "I will prove our worth to you, Lord Seiken."

card.name: Yasi
card.text:
Monk • Kensai • Resilient
(Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution.)
Battle: Bow one or two of Yasi's target unbowed Weapons. Make a Ranged Attack equal to their total Force Modifiers.
card.flavor: His blade struck an unseen assassin. His companion gasped. "Never drop your guard," he warned.

card.name: Goju Saido
card.text:
Assassin • Ninja • Shadowlands
Invest [PAY 10]: Melee 5 Attack (this cannot be Interrupted) that may target a card in a player's home (if otherwise legal). This Invest cost cannot be reduced. Lose 2 Honor.
After Saido enters play, lose 1 Honor.
card.flavor: It hissed in delight as the Crab twitched, his chest impaled with the blade of another...

card.name: Marimako
card.text:
Monk • Conqueror • Kensai • Naval
(A Conqueror's unit doesn't bow after battle. Kensai may attach two Weapons, as long as neither is Two-Handed. Once a turn, the Attacker gets the first Battle action, if it's from a Naval Personality's unit.)
card.flavor: She is both beautiful and deadly. Marimako's skills with weapons are unrivaled within the Clan.

card.name: Daigotsu Jemaru
card.text:
Samurai • Shadowlands • Reserve • Resilient
(You may Recruit a Reserve Personality, if they would be opposed, as an Absent Battle action. Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution.)
Absent Interrupt: After you Recruit Jemaru, take an additional action.
Battle: Fear 2.
card.flavor: "The Daigotsu will destroy everything that stands against us!"

card.name: Susumu Jaru
card.text:
Courtier
Increase your Honor gain from Proclaiming Jaru to equal the number of Clout tokens, up to 6, in play.
Political Open, [BOW]: Discard one or more Clout tokens on other players' cards. Bow a target Personality with Chi equal to the number discarded, and gain that amount of Honor. Give the target a Clout token if he is Crab Clan.
card.flavor: No one likes the old man, but his powerful words can bring a Court to a crashing stop. None can ignore him.

card.name: Susumu Tanjin
card.text:
Courtier
Tanjin enters play for 1 less Gold if your Allegiance is Progressive.
Invest [PAY 2]: Give another player's target card a Clout token.
Home Interrupt, [BOW]: Increase the strength of the action's Fear effects by the number of Clout tokens in play.
card.flavor: "It is truly a shame," he tutted.

card.name: Akenohoshi, the Dancer
card.text:
Artisan • Geisha • Mai Master
Open, [BOW]: Give a target Human Personality +1F and Conqueror. (A Conqueror's unit doesn't bow after battle.)
card.flavor: "After an evening spent in her company, I feel as though I could fight to the setting sun." - Hida Kurima

card.name: Momiji, the Madam
card.text:
Artisan • Geisha • Merchant
Interrupt, [BOW]: After the action Recruits a Geisha (including Momiji) or a Geisha House from a Province, refill it face-up.
card.flavor: "Sachina-sama, all is in readiness for the grand opening of the House of Floating Petals this evening."

card.name: Oboro, the Liar
card.text:
Artisan • Geisha • Kolat • Silken Sect
Invest [PAY 3]: Shuffle all your other copies of Oboro in play and in your discard pile into your Dynasty Deck. Gain a Conspiracy token for each Oboro shuffled.
card.flavor: "Take the dignitaries to the House of Loose Silk this evening. Keep them occupied for as long as possible." - Master Roc

card.name: Suzune, the Coy
card.text:
Artisan • Geisha
Invest [PAY 4]: Create a 3F/2C/1PH Ronin • Samurai • Scout • Yojimbo • Resilient Personality (Once per game per Personality, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution).
Open, [BOW]: Straighten your target Human Scout or Yojimbo.
card.flavor: "She is relatively plain, not impressive, and cannot play well. Why can I not keep my men away from her?" - Tamahime

card.name: Natsumi, the Socialite
card.text:
Artisan • Courtier • Geisha
Interrupt, [BOW]: After the action shows a Battle Strategy in another player's hand, he may discard it. If he chooses not to, a target player gains or loses 1 Honor (you must use this ability before the card is shown).
card.flavor: "She is so popular that one must ay a fortune and wait three months just to have tea. No wonder the Crane favor her so."

card.name: Harukaze, the Confidant
card.text:
Artisan • Geisha
Invest [PAY 6]: Show one or two non-Unique cards from your hand and/or Fate discard pile. Put them face-down under Harukaze and bow her.
Open, [BOW], [PAY 2]: Put a card under Harukaze into your hand.
card.flavor: "One look into that journal would be quite a treasure indeed." - Rokkaku

card.name: Ide Ryou
card.text:
Courtier • Merchant
Interrupt: After you Recruit Ryou, give a target Holding a +1GP Wealth token.
Invest [PAY 10]: Give (in total) three +1GP Wealth tokens to one to three target Holdings. This Invest cost cannot be reduced.
card.flavor: "Trade is the basis for all diplomacy. Those who claim it is 'peace' or 'politics' are simply fooling themselves."

card.name: Iuchi Kalsang
card.text:
Death Priest • Water • Cavalry • Shugenja
Water Battle: Discard a card from your hand to create Fear equal to the card's Focus Value, +1 if its target is Phoenix Clan.
card.flavor: "Forgive the Phoenix? After what they cost my father? I would sooner forgive the Dragon Champion than forget the Phoenix's slight to my family!"

card.name: Moto Alani
card.text:
Death Priest • Water • Destined • Resilient • Shugenja
(Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution.)
Water Interrupt: The action's Fear effects have +1 strength, may target Items, and destroy attachments after they bow.
card.flavor: "Those who say they do not fear death are either lying, or do not know death."

card.name: Moto Kyouaku-Inu
card.text:
Samurai • Cavalry • Kensai
(Kensai may attach two Weapons, as long as neither is Two-Handed.)
Cannot attach Followers.
Battle: Move your target Infantry Personality at any location to Kyouaku-Inu's battlefield.
card.flavor: "Every child her parents had before her died of illness. They named her 'vicious dog' to keep bad spirits away." - Moto Maleesh

card.name: Shinjo Shimikoto
card.text:
Bully • Samurai • Resilient
(Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution.)
Battle: Melee 2 Attack. If this destroyed a card, you may make a Fear 3 targeting a (legal) card in the same unit.
card.flavor: "They say her father spoiled her, and it made her headstrong. What of it? She wishes to see the Empire and I think she should be permitted." - Shinjo Min-Hee

card.name: Utaku Kimiono
card.text:
Courtier • Samurai
Kimiono enters play for 1 less Gold if your Allegiance is Progressive.
Political Battle: Fear equal to Kimiono's Personal Honor. If this bowed a card in a unit whose Personality has lower Personal Honor, gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "I only wanted peace. But not like this."

card.name: Colonial Conscripts
card.text:
You may destroy any player's Farm to ignore the Gold cost of Equipping this Follower.
Battle: Give a target enemy Samurai -3F.
card.flavor: Those in the Colonies have endured much, and their anger in battle shows it.

card.name: Dark Naga Ambusher
card.text:
Naga • Nonhuman • Scout • Reserve
(You may Equip a Reserve attachment, if it would be opposed, as a Battle action.)
Interrupt: After you Equip this Follower, take an additional action.
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 2 Attack.
card.flavor: They retreated, but punished their pursuers for each step.

card.name: Talented Maiko
card.text:
Geisha • Maiko
Open, [BOW]: A target player shows a random card in his hand.
Open, [BOW]: Turn a target card in another player's Province face-up.
card.flavor: Peasants gifted in the arts rarely find their talents appreciated. They are fiercely loyal to who - or what - changes that.

card.name: Spider Elite Sohei
card.text:
Monk • Reserve
Invest [PAY 1]: Search your deck for a Spider Elite Sohei, show it, and put it in your hand.
Battle: Fear 3.
card.flavor: As the fighting in the streets intensified, a wave of black and white clan monks began to form. Ruthlessly, mercilessly, those who broke the peace were put down.

card.name: Legion of the Khan
card.text:
Cavalry • Destined
Fear effects, Melee Attacks, and Ranged Attacks targeting this Follower have -2 strength.
Battle: Ranged 3 Attack.
card.flavor: "Fearless as the Matsu, tenacious as the Hida. Their advance is a serious problem." - Isawa Norimichi

card.name: Dragon Elite Inkyo
card.text:
Jade • Monk
This Follower contributes Force even while bowed and it is considered to have 3 Chi when a Kiho checks a card's Chi.
card.flavor: The Dragon and Spider worked together to contain the fighting. Though it was not as destructive and chaotic as the riots or the siege, Noburo and his monks had reached the limit of their patience with the squabbles of the other clans.

card.name: Ichigo's Guard
card.text:
Courage
(Repeatable Interrupt: Discard a Courage card to give a Fear effect +2 or -2 strength.)
Fear effects, Melee Attacks, and Ranged Attacks targeting cards in this unit have -1 strength.
card.flavor: Neither Ichigo nor his men were moved by Irezu's insanity.

card.name: Mounted Skirmishers
card.text:
Cavalry
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to the battle.)
Battle: Give a target enemy Follower or Personality -2F, or -3F if this Personality has moved this turn.
card.flavor: "Your devotion to your ally is honorable," Sung-ki said quietly, "so I will spare you. However, your meddling in this is over. Where is the thing called 'Kaiji'?"

card.name: Pursuit Riders
card.text:
Cavalry • Courage • Reserve
(Repeatable Interrupt: Discard a Courage card to give a Fear Effect +2 or -2 strength.)
Battle: Move home this unit and a target enemy unit with equal or lower total Force.
card.flavor: Yoritomo Hama looked up at Tae-hyun and his men. Their purpose there was unspoken but clear.

card.name: Front Line Fodder
card.text:
Ashigaru • Expendable
(Draw a card after your Expendable card dies.)
After a Fear effect bows this Follower, destroy it.
card.flavor: "The preferred solution when you have more koku than bushi. The Lion will be too busy cutting through them to see the true threat." - Bayushi Makubesu

card.name: Mercenary Guard
card.text:
Mercenary • Ronin • Expendable
This Personality has Resilient. (Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution.)
card.flavor: "Raise an army of peasants and ronin. While the Lion are busy watching us do that, unleash our advance riders and scouts near the Kitsu Tombs." - Bayushi Nitoshi

card.name: Aranai's Armor
card.text:
Armor • Destined
This Personality has Resilient.
Interrupt: After you Equip this Item, rehonor this Personality, and you may target and rehonor another Personality.
card.flavor:
Yogo Katsuta stared as his blood-streaked hand. "I don't... don't understand."
"Perhaps in the next life," Aranai said softly.

card.name: Aranai's Kama
card.text:
One-Handed • Peasant • Courage • Weapon
(Repeatable Interrupt: Discard a Courage card to give a Fear Effect +2 or -2 strength.)
card.flavor:
"Your life is mine now, little beast," Aranai said to the cowering goblin.

"Yes, yes!" Keppo sobbed. "Keppo do whatever warlord asks!"

card.name: Ensorcelled Longsword
card.text:
Gaijin • One-Handed • Sword • Destined • Weapon
(Draw a card after you Equip a Destined card.)
After this Weapon enters your discard pile from play, put it back into your hand.
card.flavor: "Of course I would never consider actually using a gaijin weapon, even if it was one that I could make appear whenever I wished. However, contemplating the possible applications of such a thing is ... interesting." - Bayushi Makubesu

card.name: Crude Dai-kyu
card.text:
Bow • Two-Handed • Expendable • Weapon
(Draw a card after your Expendable card is destroyed.)
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 3 Attack.
card.flavor: "True craftsmen are in rare supply in the Colonies. However, the archer's skill is enough to compensate for poor work in some cases." - Tsuruchi Taito

card.name: Opportune Weapon
card.text:
One-Handed • Courage • Weapon
(Repeatable Interrupt: Discard a Courage card to give a Fear effect +2 or -2 strength.)
Battle, [BOW]: Melee 2 Attack. Lose 1 Honor.
card.flavor: True geisha do not consort with such low company that they would have to worry about defending themselves. Of course, that doesn't stop all of them from learning how.

card.name: Heirloom Tanto
card.text:
Knife • One-Handed • Kharmic • Weapon
(Repeatable Limited, [PAY 2]: Discard a Kharmic card to draw a card.)
In a duel, you may focus this Item from your discard pile and remove it from the game after the focused cards are discarded.
card.flavor: "My ancestors have passed this weapon down since before the Ki-Rin Clan left the Empire. And you dare call us gaijin, Phoenix?" - Utaku Izimi

card.name: Official Sanction
card.text:
Political Open, [BOW]: Give this Item a number of Favor tokens equal to this Personality's Personal Honor.
Political Open, [BOW]: Target a Personality. Discard two Favor tokens from this Item to negate his next straightening this game or five Favor tokens from it to bow him.
card.flavor: Masatsuko signed the writ with a heavy hand. There were times when even the Miya knew war was inevitable.

card.name: Toshigoku's Blade
card.text:
Cursed • Sword • Two-Handed • Weapon
On your turn, you must declare an Attack Phase and assign this Personality to attack, if able.
Battle, [BOW]: Destroy a target enemy card with Force less than or equal to this Item's, and no attachments. Give this Item a +1F token.
card.flavor: It steals the souls of those it touches. Even, eventually, the wielder.

card.name: Shikomizue
card.text:
One-Handed • Staff • Sword • Weapon
You may Equip this Item as an Engage action.
Battle: Fear 1, or Fear 2 if you Equipped this Item during this battle.
card.flavor: The area around the Kitsu Tombs saw a surprisingly large amount of pilgrims as the Imperial bureaucracy debated the Lion's petition for war. When it was granted, the Lion realized too late just what those visitors truly were.

card.name: Shinai
card.text:
Sword • Two-Handed • Courage • Weapon
(Repeatable Interrupt: Discard a Courage card to give a Fear effect +2 or -2 strength.)

Abomination • Naga • Nonhuman • Pearl • Experienced • Shugenja • Unique

Pearl Battle: If The Sleepless One is opposed, each Rokugani player discards a random card and you may target and bow your Warrior to take [RANK-2] additional actions.

card.name: The Teskath
card.text:
Asp • Naga • Nonhuman

Your Stronghold creates an additional Warrior after you Recruit Teskath.

Battle: Bow your target unbowed Warrior. Ranged Attack equal to its Force plus one.

card.name: Corrupted Wildlife
card.text:
Expendable • Naga • Nonhuman • Reserve

Will only attach to a Naga.

Battle: Melee 3 Attack.

card.name: Asp Spear
card.text:
Naga • Spear • Two-Handed • Reserve • Weapon

Will only attach to a Naga. This Personality uses his Force as his duel stat.

Battle, [BOW]: Melee 3 Attack.

Tireless Battle: Ranged 3 Attack. Discard this Item. Put it into your hand before the turn ends.

card.name: The Akasha
card.text:
Corrupted • Naga • Unique

Play after a card enters your Fate discard pile if it now has more cards than your hand, then draw a card.

Your Fear effects, Melee Attacks, and Ranged Attacks have +1 strength.

card.name: Baseless Rage
card.text:
Battle: Target a Personality. He flees in terror. Move him home.

Battle: Melee [RANK] Attack.

card.name: Brutal Strike
card.text:
Battle: Melee [RANK] Attack.

Unstoppable Battle: Destroy your target Warrior. One or two Melee 3 Attacks.

Interrupt: Give each Melee or Ranged Attack +3 or -3 strength.

card.name: Cursed Resolve
card.text:
Interrupt: Destroy your target unbowed Warrior. Negate the action's effects.

Unstoppable Battle: Bow one or more of your target unbowed Warriors. Destroy a target enemy unit with a number of cards in it equal to the number of Warriors you bowed. If you now have two or less cards in your hand, you may destroy the targeted Warriors.

card.name: Gathering
card.text:
Engage: You have the first opportunity to take a Battle action. Create a 2F/2C/0PH Naga • Nonhuman • Warrior Personality.

Unstoppable Battle: Destroy your target Warrior. Create two 2F/2C/0PH Naga • Nonhuman • Warrior Personalities.

card.name: Inevitability
card.text:
Interrupt: Negate an Event's effects. Draw a card.

Unstoppable Battle: Destroy your target Warrior. Give [RANK] target enemy Personalities or Followers -3F.

card.name: Malevolence
card.text:
Battle: Fear [RANK+1].

Unstoppable Battle: Destroy your target Warrior. One or two Fear 4 effects.

Interrupt: Give each Fear effect +4 or -4 strength.

card.name: Serpent Tunnels
card.text:
Terrain

Unstoppable Battle: Destroy a Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play. Target your Personality at any location; you may destroy a Warrior at this battlefield to target two Personalities at any location instead. Move the targets to this battlefield. Straighten their units as they move.

card.name: Warlord's Command
card.text:
Battle: Give [RANK] target Naga Followers or Personalities +2F each.

Unstoppable Battle: Destroy your target Warrior. Straighten one or two target units at any location. You may move them to the current battlefield.

card.name: Knot of Serpents
card.text:
Your Province Strength cannot be reduced. After you Recruit a Naga Personality, create [RANK-2], or [RANK-1] if if he is Unique, 2F/2C/0PH Naga • Nonhuman • Warrior Personalities. After your card destroys your Warrior, draw a card. Your Unstoppable effects cannot be prevented.

Dynasty, [PAY]: Recruit a Forest for 2 less Gold and refill its Province face-up.

card.name: Devastating Betrayal
card.text: Interrupt: You may choose a different one of your (legal) Personalities for the action to target instead of the one chosen by another player, now or after he chooses the target.
card.flavor: The military force of the traditionalists was vastly larger than their opponent's, and a swift victory was anticipated. They reckoned without the duplicity of the Scorpion, however.

card.name: Seclusion
card.text: Open: Remove your target Personality from the game. Search your Dynasty deck for a Personality with equal or lower Gold Cost and refill this Province with him face-up.
card.flavor: Throughout Rokugan's history, there have been occasions when Emperors have retired to their personal chambers for an extensive period of time in order to contemplate matters of great importance.

card.name: The Toil of Zokujin
card.text:
Mine
[BOW]: Produce 1 Gold.
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold, which can only pay for a single Armor, Mine, or Weapon.
card.flavor: "When will we be seen as equals, brother?" one hissed. "Only when man is long dead and their cities ground to dust," the other answered.

card.name: Developed Quarry
card.text:
Mine
After this Holding enters play, give it three +1F Masterwork tokens.
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Open, [BOW]: Transfer a Masterwork token from this Holding to a target Armor or Weapon without a Masterwork token.
card.flavor: "We must find another, soon."

card.name: Earthborn Temple
card.text:
Temple
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Battle/Open: Give your target Monk or Shugenja +1F if he shares an elemental keyword with one of this Spells or your Rings.
card.flavor: It is a favorite destination for shugenja, for the kami swirl around the shrine in a swarm of undeniable power.

card.name: Protected Temple
card.text:
Temple • Fortification • Kharmic
(Fortifications attach to the Province from which they entered play.)
This Holding enters play bowed and, if your Sensei is Brotherhood Sensei, for 2 less Gold.
[BOW]: Produce 4 Gold.
card.flavor: "No one would dare attack this holy land."

card.name: Rich Vein
card.text:
Mine
[BOW]: Produce 3 Gold.
Interrupt: After you Recruit this Holding from a Province, look at the top three cards of your Dynasty deck. If one of them is a Mine, you may refill the Province with it, face-up.
card.flavor: The men swarmed to the mine as soon as word spread. Within hours, the villagers were busy ripping out the valuable metal from the land.

card.name: House of No Tomorrow
card.text:
Geisha House • Fortification
This Fortification enters play bowed. Add 1 to the Honor required for an Honor Victory and -1 to the Honor required for a Dishonor Victory (while this Holding is in play), or 2 and -2 respectively if you have Courtesy.
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
card.flavor: "Choose your sin, my lord," she whispered. "We have all that you might desire."

card.name: Jade Bazaar
card.text:
Jade • Market
Courtesy: After you Recruit this card from a Province, refill the Province face-up. (Courtesy traits do not take effect if you went first)
[BOW]: Produce 4 Gold.
card.flavor: "Come in, come in! We have the most beautiful statues of jade, and jade replicas!"

card.name: Plain Library
card.text:
Expendable • Fortification
This Fortification enters play bowed.
[BOW]: Produce 3 Gold.
Interrupt: After you Recruit this Holding, look at the top three cards of your Fate deck. Place zero to two of them at the bottom of your deck.
card.flavor: "Pathetic! Is this truly all that you have?"

card.name: Weapon Artist
card.text:
Mine • Retainer
[BOW]: Produce 6 Gold.
Open, [BOW]: Create a +2F/+1C One-Handed • Sword • Weapon Item and attach it to your target Personality.
card.flavor: "Artistry? Bah! I have no time for artistry. I shall give you the weapons of murder that you desire, and you shall be grateful for it!"

card.name: Missing Caravan
card.text:
This Holding (in and out of play) has every non-boldface keyword on your face-up Holdings.
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
card.flavor: The Unicorn had once held dominance over the trade routes outside the borders of the Emerald Empire. Others now attempt their own, though many fail with disastrous results.

card.name: Delicate Forge
card.text:
Mine
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Open, [BOW]: Put a target Armor or Weapon in your discard pile into your hand. Destroy this Holding.
card.flavor: "Some dismiss the artistry of the Crab. Do not be fooled. Our works can elate as much as they can endure."

card.name: Otomo Bureaucrat
card.text:
Imperial • Retainer
[BOW]: Produce 5 Gold.
Political Tireless Interrupt: Choose an Honor gain or loss from another player's action and reduce it to 2.
card.flavor: Though the conflict between the heirs brewed, the Otomo refused to note it in any of their scrolls. This struggle would never exist in Rokugani history,

card.name: Lane of Immorality
card.text:
Shadowlands
After you Recruit this Holding, lose 1 Honor.
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold and lose 1 Honor.
card.flavor: The stench of despair never leaves this place. Men walk quickly to leave it behind, yet the temptations lay their hooks deeply within any passersby.

card.name: Remote Temple
card.text:
Temple
[BOW]: Produce 1 Gold.
Open, [BOW]: Search your Fate deck for a Ring. Show it. Put it into your hand. Discard a card. Destroy this Holding.
card.flavor: Only the devout ever visit this building. Some say the spirits are pleased by and reward the extra effort given by the visitors. Others say that is a rumor started by the head priest...

card.name: Shrine of the Colonies
card.text:
Temple
Reduce all Honor losses from your cards by 1, to a minimum of 1.
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
card.flavor: The Colonies once hosted hundreds of temples to foreign gods. Ones to the Kami were built shortly after the arrival of the samurai, and some of those shrines now rivaled their counterparts on the mainland.

card.name: Contemplative Shrine
card.text:
Temple
[BOW]: Produce 3 Gold.
Tireless Open: Discard a Kiho or a Spell to straighten this Holding. (Tireless actions may be taken even while bowed.)
card.flavor: The fiercest struggles of the Emerald Empire seem small when one stands within the serenity of the temple grounds.

card.name: Hida Ayameko
card.text:
Samurai • Tactician
(Battle: Discard a card to give this Tactician a Force bonus equal to the card's Focus value.)
Courtesy: Ayameko has Resilient. (Courtesy traits do not take effect if you went first. Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution.)
card.flavor: "The eye? No matter. I only need one to see my enemies."

card.name: Hida O-Win
card.text:
Samurai
While O-Win is opposing a Shadowlands or Spider Clan Personality, his printed ability is Unstoppable and its Fear has +1 strength.
Battle: Fear 3.
card.flavor: "The Spider think they are the only ones who use ruthless terror. He aims to show them their mistake." - Kuni Renyu

card.name: Hiruma Toshi
card.text:
Ninja • Samurai • Scout • The Masked Crab
Toshi enters play for 1 less Gold if you are a Scorpion Clan player.
card.flavor: The Crab-Scorpion alliance against the Second Pit has even extended to tentative cooperation between Hiruma and Shosuro.

card.name: Kaiu Akemi, the Diplomat
card.text:
Courtier • Love Letter • Samurai • Siege
Battle: If Akemi is opposed, show a random card in the enemy leader's hand. You may discard a card with a higher Focus Value (from your hand) to discard the shown card.
card.flavor: "She can be ill-mannered at times, but it is dangerous to understimate a sumai wrestler's influence." - Shosuro Yamazaki

card.name: Hida Kenjiro
card.text:
Lord of Blades • Samurai • Scout • Kensai
Battle, [BOW]: Melee 2 Attack. You may bow one of Kenjiro's Followers or Weapons to straighten him.
card.flavor: "I read Mirumoto's Niten in the dojo. It is not without merit."

card.name: Yasuki Makoto, Imperial Advisor
card.text:
Courtier • Imperial • Kolat • Merchant • Experienced • Unique
Economic Kolat Open, [BOW], [PAY 5]: Draw a card.
card.flavor: "We have labored long and hard to recover from the disasters of my predecessor's reign. Makoto's appointment is our greatest victory yet." - Master Tiger

card.name: Daidoji Tomomi
card.text:
Samurai • Scout • Conqueror
Tomomi enters play for 1 less Gold if you are a Mantis Clan player.
card.flavor: "Two factions, once in total conflict and clawing at each-other's throats... now allies, working towards the same goal. Can you still say this is not a valid strategy towards winning a war?" - Doji Makoto

card.name: Daidoji Nozomi
card.text:
Samurai • Scout • Cavalry
Engage: If Nozomi moved this battle, give her Naval.
Battle: Fear equal to Nozomi's Force, or 2 if she is Naval.
card.flavor: "I will make use of any weapon at my disposal. If fear is the better weapon, then so be it."

card.name: Doji Takato, the Manipulator
card.text:
Courtier • Love Letter • Orator
Courtesy: After you Recruit Takato, gain 1 Honor. (Courtesy traits do not take effect if you went first)
Interrupt: After you Recruit Takato, discard a card to make a target player discard a random card. Each of you may put the other's card in your hand.
card.flavor: The Nakodo always knows best.

card.name: Kakita Daitsu
card.text:
Samurai • Duelist • Kensai
Daitsu has +1C while you control Kakita Shinichi. Daitsu will only attach one Weapon.
Unstoppable Battle, [BOW]: Melee 2 Attack. (Other players cannot Interrupt Unstoppable actions.)
card.flavor: "Still standing in my way! There is a man who wants to die!"

card.name: Daidoji Yurei
card.text:
Samurai • Scourge of Darkness • Duelist
Yurei will not enter play if you control a Fallen or Shadowlands Personality. Yurei has +1F for each Personality with 0 Personal Honor opposing him.
Battle: Fear equal to Yurei's Force.
card.flavor: "He took the name of his ancestor upon his gempukku, a man who was known as a living ghost of vengeance. From the anger in his eyes, I did not doubt they were of the same blood." - Daidoji Akeha

card.name: Mirumoto Yoritama
card.text:
Samurai • Kensai
Iaijutsu Battle: Yoritama challenges a target enemy Personality. Give the loser -3F. You may take an additional action if Yoritama has two Weapons.
card.flavor: "Two seasons of denouncements and conflicts, and now Noboru-sama stands on the same side as the Crab! For all the division that Seiken has caused, he has created interesting unities as well."

card.name: Mirumoto Touya
card.text:
Samurai • Duelist
