Iaijutsu Battle: Touya challenges a target enemy Personality. The winner creates Fear 4 targeting a (legal) card in the loser's unit (there is no effect in a tie).
card.flavor: "I do not claim to know my lord's motivations. My understanding is not required. I have more orders, and faith in my lord. I know they may bring me before him in battle. So be it."

card.name: Tamori Chikyu
card.text:
Courtier • Earth • Shugenja
Political Open: If it is another player's turn, target his unbowed Personality. Gain 1 Honor before the turn ends if the target did not attack you this turn.
card.flavor: "The Daughter of Heaven is of the same blood as my clan. Whatever occurs, I cannot allow shame to befall the Iweko name."

card.name: Tamori Daiishu
card.text:
Commander • Earth • Shugenja
Courtesy: After you Recruit Daiishu, gain 2 Honor and permanently give him Naval. (Courtesy traits do not take effect if you went first. Once a turn, the Attacker gets the first Battle action, if it's from a Naval Personality's unit.)
card.flavor: "The Asahina would do well to remember their debts to us."

card.name: Togashi Gozato, the Wise Monk
card.text:
Love Letter • Monk • Samurai • Tattooed • Void
After you Recruit Doji Takato or Matsu Misato, bow Gozato.
Void Tireless Battle: Bow your target unbowed Ring. Straighten Gozato or move him home.
card.flavor: "He is a prestigious man," Miaka said, "he would be a good husband." "And what does your heart say?" Gozato asked.

card.name: Mirumoto Tsukino
card.text:
Samurai • Destined • Kensai
(Draw a card after you Recruit a Destined card. Kensai may attach two Weapons, as long as neither is Two-Handed.)
Unless you are Spider Clan, discard a card after you Recruit Tsukino.
card.flavor: The Spider and Dragon now leaned on one another more and more. But neither side forgot the circumstances that had brought them together.

card.name: Akodo Raikitsu
card.text:
Samurai • Duelist • Tactician
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists.)
Battle: Straighten a target enemy unit in the Defender's home. Its controller may choose to move it to this battlefield. If he does not choose this, give this Province -2 strength.
card.flavor: "Never doubt the Lion Clan. Even if the odds rush against us, victory is inevitable."

card.name: Ikoma Ayumi - exp
card.text:
Hero • Magistrate • Samurai • Cavalry • Experienced • Naval
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to the battle.)
Open: Give Ayumi's target Follower Cavalry.
card.flavor: "The legacy of the Lion Clan is bigger than us all. We must be worthy of that title."

card.name: Kitsu Suzaki
card.text:
Child of Prophecy • Water • Shugenja
Open, [PAY 3]: If Suzaki is in your Province and you are Lion Clan, you may shuffle her into your deck to gain 1 Honor and create a 2F/2C/3PH Lion Clan • Ancestor • Samurai • Spirit Personality in your home.
card.flavor: "The kami do not obey the will of man, but they will give aid where there is need."

card.name: Akodo Yuyama
card.text:
Ancestor • Samurai • Scout • Spirit • The Masked Lion • Destined
(Draw a card after you Recruit a Destined card.)
Yuyama has +1F if you are Phoenix Clan.
card.flavor: "I will watch over you, sister, until you have raised our family name to the greatness it deserves."

card.name: Matsu Hachiro - exp
card.text:
Commander • Paragon • Samurai • Scout • Cavalry • Experienced
Hachiro has +2F while attacking.
Unstoppable Battle: Melee 2 Attack, or Melee 3 Attack if the target is Scorpion Clan. (Other players cannot Interrupt Unstoppable actions.)
card.flavor: With the restraints unleashed, the Lion Clan raged across the Colonies. The name "Seiken" echoed from a thousand throats.

card.name: Matsu Misato, the Hatamoto
card.text:
Love Letter • Samurai
Battle: If Misato is opposed, target a player. He discards a card at random to draw a card. Give Misato +1F.
card.flavor: While she is grateful for her current honor, she wishes to be on the battlefield alongside her sisters. The shameful thought presses her to perfection.

card.name: Kitsune Yoshioka
card.text:
Earth • Shugenja
Interrupt: After you Recruit Yoshioka, create a 4F/2C/3PH Elephant • Nonhuman • Spirit • Cavalry Personality with the ability "Battle: Fear 3, or Fear 4 if the target is Cavalry."
card.flavor: "Where are you going? Do you not want to meet my new friend? You're being rude!"

card.name: Kitsune Gorikki
card.text:
Earth • Expendable • Shugenja
After you Recruit Gorikki, if you are Crane Clan, take the Imperial Favor.
card.flavor: The Kitsue and Moshi families are very different in most ways, but in certain ways they are strikingly similar. Reverence for the natural order of things is chief among them.

card.name: Yoritomo Nishigori
card.text:
Magistrate • Samurai • Naval
Courtesy: Nishigori enters play for 1 less Gold.
Once per turn, if Nishigori is unbowed, produce 3 Gold which can only pay for a single Strategy's action.
card.flavor: "Carry this message for me, captain. 'We have established a perimeter around the Sea of Shadows; but all remains quiet for now. Orders?'"

card.name: Isawa Nomura
card.text:
Fire • Scion of Flame • Shugenja
Fire Interrupt: After the action resolves, if it was Fire and bowed or destroyed any enemy cards, give your target Shugenja +2F.
card.flavor: "I will not see the future marred by the dangerous philosophies of Iweko Shibatsu! Iweko Seiken will sit upon the throne, or I will die in the attempt!"

card.name: Isawa Tenkawa, the Scholar
card.text:
Air • Love Letter • Shugenja
Air Open, [BOW]: After the next time this phase another player's action targets one of your cards, negate its (remaining) effects.
card.flavor: "You may no longer be an Imperial princess, Miaka-sama, but you are a daughter of Iweko and will always have my service if you wish it."

card.name: Isawa Fujigawa
card.text:
Fire • Shugenja
Ranged Attacks targeting Fujigawa have -1 strength if another player is Mantis Clan.
Courtesy: Abilities on Fujigawa's Spells have Unstoppable. (Courtesy traits do not take effect if you went first. Other players cannot Interrupt Unstoppable actions.)
card.flavor: "I find the sea quite calming. Strange, I know."

card.name: Kyuji
card.text:
Nonhuman • Orochi • Scion of the Sea • Water • Cavalry • Naval • Shugenja
Kyuji may only move to a battlefield if any enemy units are there. (Assigning isn't moving.)
Water Battle: If Kyuji has not moved to a battlefield this turn, give it +2F/-2C.
card.flavor: "The Empire is concerned about monstrosities born of the Sea of Shadows. There are allies to be had in such a battle." - Asako Miyabi

card.name: Shiba Koshiba
card.text:
Samurai • Yojimbo
Unstoppable Battle: Give a target enemy Follower or Personality -1F, or -3F if you control a Lion Clan Personality or your Stronghold's Gold Production is 3. (Other players cannot Interrupt Unstoppable actions.)
card.flavor: "Keep your back to me, my lady," Koshiba cautioned. "These Unicorn are devious foes."

card.name: Shiba Kintaro, the Remembered
card.text:
Samurai • Yojimbo • Destined • Duelist
(Draw a card after you Recruit a Destined card. Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists.)
card.flavor: "Regardless of what happens to me, I shall live forever through my actions."

card.name: Bayushi Aggushi & Bayushi Janqu
card.text:
Courtier • Samurai
This counts as two cards when destroyed during battle resolution.
Tireless Open: If you have targeted Aggushi & Janqu with a Political action this turn, straighten them.
Battle, [BOW]: Melee 3 Attack.
card.flavor: Sometimes love and duty coincide.

card.name: Bayushi Irezu - exp
card.text:
Bitter Lies • Commander • Martyr • Experienced • Kensai
Irezu has +1C if another player is Lion Clan.
Battle: Move home a target unit whose total Force is less than or equal to Irezu's Chi.
card.flavor: "If Sihung couldn't kill me, no Lion will!"

card.name: Bayushi Iyashi, Lady Sorrow
card.text:
Magistrate • Musician • Paragon • Samurai • Yojimbo • Loyal
Iyashi has Courtier while you control The Sorrow.
Battle, [BOW]: Melee 2 Attack, or Melee 4 Attack if you control The Sorrow or the target is Shadowlands.
card.flavor: Despite her lord's reservations, Tenzan's wife was allowed to join him on his seemingly hopeless quest.

card.name: Shosuro Yamazaki, the Master Courtier
card.text:
Courtier • Love Letter
Interrupt: After you Recruit Yamazaki, show a random card in another player's hand.
Political Open, [BOW]: Rehonor and bow a target dishonorable Personality.
card.flavor: "His mask is imposing, but the man himself seems meek. It's all very confusing. What is he really?" - Kaiu Akemi

card.name: Yogo Chijin
card.text:
Air • Bloodspeaker • Shugenja
After a dishonorable Personality is destroyed, his controller loses 1 Honor.
[BOW]: Produce Gold equal to Chijin's Chi which can only pay for a single Air or Maho Spell.
card.flavor: "The Scorpion need power, regardless of the source. And we know how to handle such things."

card.name: Yogo Gorobei
card.text:
Magistrate • Samurai • The Masked Monkey • Yojimbo
Courtesy: Gorobei has Conqueror (Courtesy traits do not take effect if you went first.)
Gorobei has +1F while in an army with a Crab Clan Personality.
card.flavor: "The Hiruma have learned many things from us. I wonder what we will learn from the Hida?" - Bayushi Nitoshi

card.name: Daigotsu Takahide
card.text:
Magistrate • Samurai • Duelist
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists.)
Unstoppable Battle: Fear 3, or Fear 4 if Takahide has won a duel this turn. (Other players cannot Interrupt Unstoppable actions.)
card.flavor: "Oh, to the contrary, I am very interested in maintaining order, Hida-san. You might even say I am willing to go to great lengths for it."

card.name: Gyushi Kageto
card.text:
Artisan • Fire • Smith • Shugenja
Fire Open, [PAY 3]: Create a +2F/+1C One Handed • Sword • Weapon Item and attach it to your target Personality.
card.flavor: "I have enjoyed far more freedom as a Gyushi than I ever did among the Chuda!"

card.name: Kokujin Dairu, Student of the Dark Lotus
card.text:
Monk • Shadowlands • Destined • Kensai
(Draw a card after you Recruit a Destined card. Kensai may attach two Weapons, as long as neither is Two-Handed.)
card.flavor: "The Empire has forgotten us, master. They will be reminded soon enough."

card.name: Kokujin Kuchika, Blood of the Dark Lotus
card.text:
Monk • Shadowlands • Kensai
Tireless Battle: Bow your target unbowed Dragon Clan or Monk Personality to straighten Kuchika. You may destroy the target to give Kuchika +2F and permanently give her Tattooed.
card.flavor: "It is done," whispered Dairu. Fire danced in his eyes.

card.name: Susumu Issei
card.text:
Courtier
Courtesy: You have a +5 Lobby Bonus. (Courtesy traits do not take effect if you went first.)
Interrupt: After you Recruit Issei, put a Political Battle Strategy from your discard pile into your hand.
card.flavor: "Perhaps your school is older, my friend, but I've danced the courtly dance while you were still crawling."

card.name: Susumu Kengo
card.text:
Courtier • Expendable
(Draw a card after your Expendable card dies.)
Kengo has +1PH (in and out of play) if another player is Crab Clan.
card.flavor: "It seems these coins are counterfeit. How unfortunate for the Crab." Kengo grinned.

card.name: Banished
card.text:
Ishiken • Ronin • Void • Resilient • Shugenja
(Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution. Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
Will not gain the "Phoenix Clan" Clan Alignment.
card.flavor: "My name? It no longer matters. Only the Void matters. Only the secrets."

card.name: Br'nn - exp
card.text:
Nonhuman • One Tribe • Ratling • Scavenger • Scout • Experienced
Br'nn has +1F while he has an attachment. Br'nn has +1F while an attachment is in another player's discard pile. Br'nn has +1F while another player controls an Ashalan card.
card.flavor: "Still run-running, manling, and young-young now, if Tomorrow try to catch again."

card.name: Iweko Miaka, The Princess
card.text:
Heir • Imperial • Love Letter • Unique
Will not gain a Clan Alignment. After your turn begins, if you control six other Love Letter cards with different titles and six Affection tokens, you win the game.
Favor Political Open, [BOW]: Discard the Imperial Favor to draw a card.
card.flavor: Imperial heirs marry for duty, but she dares hope she might also marry for love.

card.name: Masajiro
card.text:
Nonhuman • Ogre • Shadowlands • Sinner • Yojimbo
After Masajiro enters play, lose 2 Honor.
Home Battle: If he would be opposed, move Masajiro to the current battlefield. After he moves, straighten his attachments if there is another Nonhuman or Unique Personality in his army.
card.flavor: "Serve Spider? No. That father, not me."

card.name: Keppo - exp
card.text:
Gobin • Nonhuman • Scout • Shadowlands • Experienced
After Keppo enters play, lose 3 Honor.
Interrupt, [PAY *]: If the action Recruits Keppo or is his printed Battle action, after it resolves, Equip a target attachment from another player's discard pile to him.
Battle: Destroy a target enemy attachment with 4 Gold Cost or less.

card.name: The Abbot
card.text:
Monk • Courtier • Kolat • Master Coin • Merchant • Experienced 3 Yasuki Jinn-Kuen • Unique
Other player's actions targeting The Abbot cost 2 more Gold (even actions without Gold costs).
Invest [PAY 1]: Gain a Conspiracy token. You may give a target card you do not control a Clout token.
Kolat Political Open: Straighten a Holding.
card.flavor: "Retired? Hardly. Just a new market to work for recruits."

card.name: Ide Hideshi, Topaz Champion
card.text:
Courtier • Merchant • Cavalry
Hideshi's Invest is [PAY 0] if another player is Phoenix Clan.
Invest [PAY 2]: Permanently give another player's target Holding the trait, "After this Holding bows, each player gains 1 Honor."
card.flavor: "Some consider my victory unusual, but then these are unusual times."

card.name: Ide Igo
card.text:
Courtier • Merchant
Courtesy: Igo has Destined. (Courtesy traits do not take effect if you went first. Draw a card after you Recruit a Destined card.)
card.flavor: "If only you could hear my words from the lips of Lady Naleesh. She believes strongly in the cause, as I do."

card.name: Moto Nurgui
card.text:
Death Priest • Scion of the Void • Void • Water • Cavalry • Shugenja
Interrupt, [BOW]: After the action resolves, if its Fear effects bowed any cards without attachments, destroy them.
card.flavor: She walked through the battlefield, her footsteps falling just shy of the ground. She whispered the names of the fallen and felt the echoes in her soul.

card.name: Moto Tadasu
card.text:
Commander • Samurai • Zealot • Cavalry
Tadasu has +1F while you control a Death Priest.
Unstoppable Battle: Fear 3 that may target Spells. Destroy any Spells this bowed. (Spells have 0 Force.)
card.flavor: "Death holds no power when you give it no hold within your soul."

card.name: Moto Chizura
card.text:
Death Priest • Hatamoto • Water • Conqueror • Shugenja
(A Conqueror's unit doesn't bow after battle. Shugenja may attach and cast Spells.)
card.flavor: "You may not want to hear my words, Tadasu-san, but you must heed them if you wish to bring victory to our clan."

card.name: Shinjo Saeki
card.text:
Magistrate • Samurai • Cavalry
Saeki has +1F while in an army with any Ronin.
Battle: Give a target enemy Personality -2F. If he has lower Personal Honor, give Saeki +1F.
card.flavor: "Haha!" she shouted in pure glee. She knew death lurked inches from her in every direction, but in her heart of hearts she knew she would not die this day.

card.name: Boyoh Spearmen
card.text:
Ronin • Mercenary
Battle, [BOW]: Melee 2 Attack. (Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 2 or lower Force).
card.flavor: Men who fight for honor will gladly die for it, but men who fight for koku will fight to live to spend it.

card.name: Shinjo Archers
card.text:
Cavalry
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 2 Attack. Straighten this Follower if this unit moved this turn.
card.flavor: The Tsuruchi are the Empire's greatest archers, but from horseback, no bow is as accurate as a Shinjo's.

card.name: Hachiro's Legion
card.flavor: Among the forces loyal to Iweko Seiken, none saw more fighting than the Lion. And among the Lion, none were as decorated and as often victorious as the men and women of Hachiro's Legion.

card.name: Anonymous Monk
card.text:
Monk • Cavalry
While you control one or more Rings, this Follower has Expendable. While you control two or more Rings, this Personality has Cavalry. While you control three or more Rings, this Follower has +1F.
card.flavor: Some among the Brotherhood find that anonymity is a boon in the hunt for enlightenment.

card.name: Victorious Wave Men
card.text:
Mercenary • Ronin • Reserve
(You may Equip a Reserve attachment, if it would be opposed, as a Battle action.)
After this Follower is destroyed by another player's action or by battle resolution, put it in your hand.
card.flavor: To a ronin, the only thing sweeter than victory is the enjoyment of the spoils in its wake.

card.name: Nezumi Remnants
card.text:
Nonhuman • Ratling • Cavalry
Battle: Fear 2. If this fails to bow a card because the card is already bowed, destroy that card.
card.flavor: "Few Nezumi remain in the mortal realm, and those that do so are... different." - Kitsune Gorikki

card.name: Jovial Ronin
card.text:
Mercenary • Ronin • Cavalry
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to the battle.)
Unstoppable Battle: Fear equal to this Personality's Personal Honor. (Other players cannot Interrupt Unstoppable actions.)
card.flavor: "Oh ho! It looks like we have a bit of a ride ahead, my friend. Do you know any good travel poems?"

card.name: Trained Horsemen
card.text:
Cavalry
Fear effects, Melee Attacks, and Ranged Attacks targeting this Follower have -1 strength.
Battle: Ranged 3 Attack.
card.flavor: "The recent history of the Empire will record few conflicts as tragic as that between the Phoenix and the Unicorn. The former wished only to protect the Empire from corruption, and the latter only to defend the honor of their ancestors." - Miya Saikitsu

card.name: Trained Swordsmen
card.text:
Fear effects, Melee Attacks, and Ranged Attacks targeting this Follower have -1 strength.
Battle: Melee 3 Attack.
card.flavor: "A conflict between the Phoenix and Unicorn? Well of course. What else would you expect? The Phoenix are hopeless philosophers and the Unicorn little better than savages." - Otomo Demiyah

card.name: Bound Spirit
card.text:
Earth • Nonhuman • Spirit • Shugenja
(Followers cannot attach Spells.)
Unstoppable Battle: Fear 2, or Fear 3 if this Follower is attached to an Earth Shugenja. (Other players cannot Interrupt Unstoppable actions.)
card.flavor: "Come, great one. Let us find more playthings for you." - Tamori Daiishu

card.name: Gifted Officer
card.text: Fear effects, Melee Attacks, and Ranged Attacks targeting this Follower have -2 strength.
card.flavor: The wisest decision any commander can make is to select skilled and independent officers to serve beneath him.

card.name: Unliving Legion
card.text:
Nonhuman • Shadowlands • Undead
After you Equip this Follower, lose 3 Honor.
After the first time each battle a Personality or Follower is destroyed at this card's battlefield, create a 1F Nonhuman • Shadowlands • Undead Follower and attach it to this Personality.
Battle: Fear equal to the number of Undead cards in this unit.

card.name: Taketori
card.text:
One-Handed • Sword • Weapon
Equips to Kakita Daitsu for 1 less Gold.
Battle, [BOW]: If your card bowed this Personality this battle, straighten him.
card.flavor: "But why name the blade after something so mundane?" Daitsu did not reply. He only smiled.

card.name: Demolisher
card.text:
Siege
This Item has -3F while it is bowed.
Seige Battle, [BOW]: Melee 5 Attack.
Siege Battle, [BOW]: Destroy a target Fortification at this battlefield.
card.flavor: The Otomo watched on in horror. The Kaiu cast him a glance. "You did say you wanted it done quickly."

card.name: Takatsume
card.text:
Polearm • Two-Handed • Weapon
Equips to Matsu Hachiro for 1 less Gold.
Battle: Fear 2, or Fear 4 if the target is a Follower.
card.flavor: "They say the talented hawk hides its claws." Hachiro brandished hi Mai-Chong. "But then, I rarely argue with results."

card.name: Uguisu
card.text:
One-Handed • Sword • Weapon
Equips to Kakita Shinichi for 1 less Gold.
Interrupt, [BOW]: If the action is from this Personality, its Fear effects destroy attachments after bowing them.
card.flavor: "My younger brother Daitsu has a fine blade, certainly, but only a true artist can wield Uguisu." - Kakita Shinichi

card.name: Iron Armor
card.text:
Armor
Card effects will not move this Personality. Melee and Ranged Attacks targeting this Personality have -2 strength.
card.flavor: "I have seen it turn aside arrows and crumple blades. But by Amaterasu's memory, is it worth it?" - Iuchi Chiwa

card.name: Forge Hammer
card.text:
Heavy Weapon • Two-Handed • Expendable • Weapon
(Draw a card after your Expendable card is destroyed.)
card.flavor: "When in defense of my lord, I do not get picky!" - Kaiu Nakagawa

card.name: Raiden O-Tsuchi
card.text:
Heavy Weapon • Thunder • Two-Handed • Courage • Weapon
Home Battle: If this Personality would be opposed, move him to the current battlefield.
Thunder Battle, [BOW]: Melee 3 Attack.
card.flavor: "I told you, it fell from the heavens! Who am I to questions the Fortunes?" - Hiruma Maiko

card.name: Saikatsu
card.text:
Two-Handed • Sword • Weapon
Melee and Ranged Attacks targeting cards in this unit have -1 strength.
card.flavor:
"That cannot be the sword Saikatsu! It was lost when Otosan Uchi fell!"

The Shiba held the sword high above her head. "Then allow me to prove it to you."

card.name: Tsuruchi Hankyu
card.text:
Bow • Two-Handed • Weapon
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 2 Attack. (Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 2 or lower Force).
card.flavor: "It is much better suited for archery in close quarters, and will serve you well in the swamps. But you'll have to get very close." The scouts eyes narrowed. "Not a problem," he said.

card.name: Akumato
card.text:
One-Handed • Sword • Expendable • Weapon
This Weapon's Force Modifier is equal to the number of dishonorable Personalities you control, to a maximum of +3F.
Battle, [BOW]: Dishonor your target honorable Personality. Straighten a target Personality.
card.flavor: "What does it matter? I was victorious! Isn't victory all that counts?"

card.name: Tessen of the Tsunami Legion
card.text:
One-Handed • Tessen • Water • Weapon
Equips to a Phoenix Clan Personality for 1 less Gold. This Personality has Cavalry and Tactician.
Water Battle, [BOW]: Move this Personality home. Straighten his unit as he moves.
card.flavor: "How are they able to follow his signals in so much rain?"

card.name: Token of Affection
card.text:
Imperial • Love Letter
(This is not an Affection token for Iweko Miaka.)
Open, [BOW]: Search your discard pile, then Dynasty deck for Iweko Miaka. If she is not dead, discard a card in one of your Provinces and refill it with her, face-up. Discard this Item.
card.flavor: "Ah, such a painful sting, and yet they seek it so reverently." - Doji Takato

card.name: Unfinished Blade
card.text:
One-Handed • Sword • Weapon
Invest [PAY 1]: Gain 1 Honor. (Increase the Gold Cost by the Invest cost to get then effect, once.)
card.flavor: It is not enough to hammer mindlessly upon the metal. A true forger folds his very soul into the blade.

card.name: Shika Sensei
card.text:
Crab • Crane • Lion • Mantis • Scorpion
Interrupt, [BOW]: After the action Recruits a Ninja or Scout from a Province, refill it face-up.

(-1 Province Strength, -1 Starting Honor)
card.flavor: "Keep your weapons close at hand. Be mindful of your surroundings. Never lower your guard and you will not fall."

card.name: Seppun Tasuke
card.text:
All Clans
Your Love Letter Personalities in and out of play have your Clan Alignment and you ignore their Honor Requirement. After your Iweko Miaka is destroyed, you lose the game.
Open, [BOW]: Name a number and target another player. After each time his (non-Focused) card with that Focus Value is discarded, gain an Affection token.

(-1 Gold Production)
card.flavor: "Cloak yourself in honor and no blade can touch you."

card.name: Brotherhood Sensei
card.text:
Dragon • Phoenix • Spider • Unicorn
Your maximum hand size is equal to 6 plus the number of Temples you control, to a maximum of 10.
Battle/Open, [BOW]: Straighten your target Monk or Shugenja.

(-1 Gold Production)
card.flavor: The wisdom of Shinsei is eternal.

card.name: Fire Kami's Greed
card.text:
While this Shugenja is Fire, he has +1F.
Fire Battle, [BOW]: You may target your Samurai. Give a target enemy Follower or Personality a Force penalty equal to the Chi of this Shugenja or the Samurai.
card.flavor: The Fire kami are always desperately eager to burn something new. Skilled shugenja find ways to accommodate them.

card.name: Fierce Blood of the Earth
card.text:
This Shugenja has Shadowlands.
Maho Battle,[BOW]: Bow or destroy your target Personality to give this Personality a Force bonus equal to the target's Force or Chi (you choose). Lose 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "The process is painful, I suppose. The screaming can be rather tiresome, but I must maintain my appearances." - Hida Ruri

card.name: Final Ruin
card.text: Fire Battle, [BOW]: You may target your Samurai. Destroy a target enemy card without attachments and with Force less than this Shugenja's or the Samurai's Chi.
card.flavor: "A spell which only the cruelest shugenja will use. Such a death I would not wish on the most dishonorable foe." - Naka Mahatsu

card.name: Purification of the Heart
card.text:
After your Equip this Spell to an Air Shugenja, you may discard a card from your Province and refill it face-up.
Air Open, [BOW]: Rehonor this Shugenja.
Air Open, [BOW]: Transfer this Spell to another Shugenja.
card.flavor: "Let these gentle spirits carry away your sorrow."

card.name: Bushido's Scourge
card.text:
After this card enters play, gain 1 Honor if this Shugenja is Air.
Air Battle, [BOW]: You may target your Samurai. Fear equal to this Shugenja's or the Samurai's Chi. (Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with Force equal to or lower than the Fear's strength).
card.flavor: Those whose Honor is weak can be undone by an Air spirit whispering of their flaws.

card.name: Strength of the Fifth Ring
card.text: Void Open, [BOW]: If this Shugenja has 4 or higher Chi, or is Void, bow him to draw a card.
card.flavor: "The most admirable battle magic evokes the strength of the warriors themselves." - Naka Mahatsu

card.name: Fearsome Visage of the Earth
card.text:
Courage
(Repeatable Interrupt: Discard a Courage card to give a Fear effect +2 or -2 strength.)
Unstoppable Earth Battle, [BOW]: Fear 2. (Other players cannot Interrupt Unstoppable actions.)
card.flavor: "The anger of the Earth is terrifying... to others." - Kuni Tomozaku

card.name: Touch of Lightning
card.text:
Thunder Interrupt, [BOW]: Give a Ranged Attack +1 strength.
Unstoppable Thunder Battle: Ranged 1 Attack. (Other players cannot Interrupt Unstoppable actions.)
card.flavor: "That was a small taste of the power I wield. Need I show more?"

card.name: Grasp the Mind
card.text:
Equips to a Void Shugenja for 1 less Gold.
Void Open, [BOW]: Target a face-up card in a Province. Put it at the bottom of its owner's Dynasty deck, refilling face-up. Destroy this Spell if you do not own the target.
card.flavor: "This sort of madness is why the Phoenix cannot allow Void magic to go unsupervised." - Isawa Shunryu

card.name: A Desperate Struggle
card.text: Unstoppable Battle, [PAY 1]: Move home a target defending Personality. (Other player's cannot Interrupt Unstoppable actions.)
card.flavor: He fell from his steed with an awful crunch. He looked up and saw his death as the Unicorn thundered closer and closer...

card.name: Serenity
card.text:
Courtesy: This Strategy's Ranged Attack has +1 strength. (Courtesy traits do not take effect if you went first)
Unstoppable Battle, [PAY 1]: Target your unbowed Samurai. Ranged Attack equal to his Personal Honor.
card.flavor: Her heart pounded in her ears and her breath hitched. THe world faded away for one glorious moment as the arrow loosed, and it rushed back in a flood of blood.

card.name: A Good Death
card.text:
As a Focus Effect, both the winner and loser of this duel gain 1 Honor.
Interrupt: If the action is another player's, after it destroys your defending Follower or Personality, give your target Personality +2F and Resilient, and gain 2 Honor. (Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution.)
card.flavor: It is all a samurai desires.

card.name: Emerald Ascension
card.text: Open, [PAY 2]: Target your unbowed Personality and bow him unless he is Dragon Clan or a Magistrate. Look at a number of Fate cards on top of your deck equal to his Chi. Put one in your hand. Put the rest at the bottom of the deck in any order.
card.flavor: Tsuda bore the armor of the Emerald Champion for the first time. He saw his reflection and did not recognize the Champion staring back at him. Perhaps one day he would feel worthy of the honor, but not today.

card.name: Obsidian Ascension
card.text:
Courage • Kharmic
All players have, "Open: Bow your target unbowed Personalities and Follower with 5 or more total Force to discard an Obsidian Ascension, putting any cards under it into their owner's hand."
Open: Put this Strategy into play and put a target Weapon (in play) under it. Gain 1 Honor if you are Lion Clan.
card.flavor: Clawed hands grasped the Obsidian blades...

card.name: Jade Ascension
card.text:
Courage
Open: Until he leaves play, give your target Human Shugenja the ability, "Home Battle: Straighten one of this Shugenja's Spells. You may use its abilities again this turn. If you are a Phoenix Clan player, you may take an additional action."
card.flavor: "The mantle returns to the Phoenix as it should be," Kaname whispered to herself.

card.name: The Soul of Man
card.text: Kolat Open: Permanently set your target Human Personality's Personal Honor to 0, give him Courtier • Kolat, and give him the ability, "Kolat Political Open, [BOW]: Target a Personality controlled by the active player. His controller may pay 4 Gold. If he does not, bow the target." Lose 1 Honor unless you are Dragon Clan.
card.flavor: "Man will endure," Kyoshiro wrote, "but only if man controls his own destiny."

card.name: A New Alliance
card.text:
Invest [PAY 2]: Draw a card. (Increase the Gold Cost by the Invest cost to get the effect, once.)
Political Open: The abilities on two target Dynasty or Fate cards (in play) cannot be used.
card.flavor: "We are all in agreement then," Makoto said. Nitoshi nodded. For the benefit of Scorpion and Crane, it seemed a temporary alliance was in order." - Petals and Pincer, IV

card.name: The Thrill of Daring
card.text:
Courtesy: Discipline [PAY 1]. (Courtesy traits do not take effect if you went first. Pay 1 Gold to play, then remove from the game, this Discipline in your discard.)
Absent Battle: Target your Personality at home who assigned to the current battlefield (this turn). Move him there.
card.flavor: Did she dare? She asked herself, then leapt from the parapets.

card.name: Battle of Wits
card.text: Political Open: Bow your target unbowed Personality and target another player's Personality; Courtiers have +1C during this action. Target and show the top two cards of each Fate deck. The one player whose targeted cards have the highest total Focus Value and Chi, or you if tied, puts his two Fate cards into his hand.
card.flavor: He realized mid-sentence that he had already lost but it was too late to gracefully withdraw. He continued.

card.name: Scouting Amid the Snow
card.text:
This Strategy's ability is Battle/Engage if you control a Scout at this battlefield.
Battle: Search your Fate deck for a Terrain, show it, and put it in your hand.
card.flavor: While the winter snows cloak the land, the armies wait... and the Ikoma scouts watch for opportunities.

card.name: Sulphurous Swamps
card.text:
Terrain
Discipline [PAY 2].
Players discard a card after each time one of their own actions moves a Personality home. After a player's action destroys this Terrain, he discards a card.
Battle/Engage: Destroy a target Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play.

card.name: Bring Them Forward
card.text:
Kata • Courage
Your Followers out of play have Reserve. (You may Equip a Reserve attachment, if it would be opposed, as a Battle action.)
Open: Put this Kata into play. Discard your other Kata in play.
card.flavor: "Reserves should exercise and maintain alertness until they are needed. Idleness breeds fear." - The Book of Sun Tao

card.name: Undone by the Enlightened
card.text: Battle: Put your target Ring into your hand. Destroy a target enemy card without attachments.
card.flavor: "Mystics who have progressed far on the Path can unleash the wrath of the five Elements on others." - Naka Makatsu

card.name: We Are Not Yet Beaten
card.text:
Kharmic
As a Focus Effect, exchange the Focus Values of this Strategy and one of the other player's focused cards. Interrupt: Give a Melee or Ranged Attack -2 strength.
card.flavor: "Stand up, men! I am an Akodo, and we have never known defeat!"

card.name: Springing the Ambush
card.text: Unstoppable Battle: Give a target enemy Follower or Personality -2F. You may target your Scout to take an additional action. (Other players cannot Interrupt Unstoppable actions.)
card.flavor: "Surprise makes ten men worth a hundred." - Akodo's Leadership

card.name: Stay Behind Me
card.text: Battle: Target your unbowed Personality. Bow him or, if he is a Yojimbo, bow your unbowed Courtier or Shugenja at any location instead, to make a Melee Attack equal to your target Personality's Chi.
card.flavor: "Wait here, my lord. I will deal with these cowards."

card.name: Drawing First Blood
card.text:
As a Focus Effect, remove Duelist from the Personality facing yours in this duel.
Battle: Target your unbowed Personality, and bow him if he's defending. Move hom a target enemy Personality with lower Chi. Gain 1 Honor if your Personality is a Duelist.
card.flavor: "One does not always need to kill in order to be victorious." - Kakita, The Sword

card.name: Priestly Feud
card.text: Open: If you control one or no Rings, your target unbowed Personality challenges another player's target Personality. Spells and Kihos have +1FV during the duel. The loser must declare an attack this turn (if legal) and must assign his Personality from the duel opposing an army (if possible).
card.flavor: On occasion, taryu-jiai duels can lead to bitter accusations and blood feuds.

card.name: Zazen Meditation
card.text:
Invest [PAY 1]: Draw a card. (Increase the Gold Cost by the Invest cost to get the effect, once.)
Battle/Open: Give your target Personality +1F/+2C.
card.flavor: There are rumors that sustained meditation can bestow increased longevity upon the practicioner.

card.name: New Factors
card.text:
Courage
After you discard this Strategy from a Courage action, gain 1 Honor.
Favor Political Open: If this Strategy is in your discard pile, discard the Imperial Favor and remove this Strategy from the game to draw a card.
card.flavor: "So," mused the Otomo, "the Crane openly undermine us. At last, it has come to this."

card.name: No One of Consequence
card.text:
Courage (Repeatable Interrupt: Discard a Courage card to give a Fear effect +2 or -2 strength.)
Battle: Give your target Personality Conqueror. If you control a Courtier or Shugenja, you may target and give your Yojimbo Personality Conqueror.
card.flavor: She grew more distressed, her orders more frantic. He nodded. "Of course, my lady."

card.name: Dirty Tricks
card.text: Battle: Straighten your target Personality. Dishonor him. Lose 2 Honor. You may take an additional action.
card.flavor: The Spider whispered in the dead man's ear. "I guess my way is better."

card.name: Unforeseen Cost
card.text:
Courage • Kharmic
Open: Choose another player. Before each Honor gain or loss from his cards in play, he may bow one of his unbowed Holdings; if he does not bow a Holding, negate the gain or loss. These effects will not be prevented.
card.flavor: "I am not sure your kin will pay for one so easily caught. But then, I will take my chances."

card.name: Open Ground
card.text:
Terrain
Before this battle resolves, you may target a Personality (at any location) who assigned to this battlefield, and move him here.
Battle: Destroy a Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play.
card.flavor: On such open ground, both sides had plenty of time to see the other coming.

card.name: Return to Your Feet
card.text:
Courage
Courtesy: This Strategy's ability is Battle/Open. (Courtesy traits do not take effect if you went first.)
Battle: Straighten your target Personality, and straighten his Weapons if he is a Kensai.
card.flavor: "Zanshin is more than returning to your battle-ready stance. It is finding no separation in one stance or the other." - Hojatsu Sensei

card.name: Brazen Disregard
card.text:
Discipline [PAY 2] (Pay 2 Gold to play, then remove from the game, this Discipline in your discard.)
Absent Interrupt: If the action is from a Strategy, negate any movement from its effects.
card.flavor: "You think I care what some moldy papers have to say about it?!"

card.name: Self and No Self
card.text:
Kharmic
After you discard this card from a Kharmic action, you may straighten or bow a Ring or Void card.
Kiho Void Open: Bow your target unbowed Monk or Shugenja. Look at the top three cards of your Fate deck. Put one of them into your hand. Put this Strategy into your deck where that card was.
card.flavor: "What troubled this pond?"

card.name: In Defense
card.text: Unstoppable Battle: Fear 3. (Other players cannot Interrupt Unstoppable actions. Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 3 or lower Force.)
card.flavor: "You will leave them alone!" Ikoma Ayumi put herself between the frightened villagers and the bandit. "This village will suffer your terror no more!"

card.name: Besieged Fortifications
card.text:
Terrain
Fortifications at this Province give no bonuses and their abilities may not be used. Defending Personalities have -1F.
Battle/Engage: Destroy a Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play.
card.flavor: The Unicorn were quick to express their displeasure with the Phoenix's new policies.

card.name: Valiant Defense
card.text:
Terrain
Courtesy: You may take an additional action after resolving this Strategy's action. (Courtesy traits do not take effect if you went first.)
Your Personalities have Resilient.
Battle: Destroy a Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play.
card.flavor: "Brace for the Unicorn charge!" the Shiba shouted.

card.name: Overwhelming Offense
card.text:
Battle: Destroy a target Fortification at this battlefield.
Battle: Give a target Follower or Personality -5F. Lose Honor equal to half your starting honor, rounded down.
card.flavor: The speed of the Utaku, the tactical acumen of the Shinjo, the ruthlessness of the Moto... it was all too much for the Phoenix defenses. The outcome was never in question.

card.name: Ongoing Division
card.text: After you discard (not focus) this Strategy during a battle, draw a card.
card.flavor: Despite the voiced wishes of the two Imperial heirs, their supporters in the Colonies rarely found common ground, and violence was increasingly common.

card.name: Honed to a Razor's Edge
card.text:
Discipline [PAY 2] (Pay 2 Gold to play, then remove from the game, this Discipline in your discard.)
Kiho Absent Battle: If he would be opposed, move to the current battlefield your target Monk or Shugenja at home. Straighten him as he moves.
card.flavor: "Do not train to be victorious. Train to put yourself beyond the possibility of defeat." - Togashi Gozato

card.name: Two Swords, One Cut
card.text: Battle: Bow your target unbowed Weapon to reduce a target enemy Follower's or Personality's Force by the Weapon's positive Force Modifier. You may remove one of the enemy card's abilities (this turn) if your Weapon is attached to a Kensai.
card.flavor: The conflict within the Colonies drove the Dragon into battle with enemies they had never faced before. Most found it unfortunate, but a small few found it a wondrous challenge for their vaunted style.

card.name: Unexpected Attack
card.text:
Terrain
Battle: Destroy a Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play. If this destroyed a Terrain, draw a card.
card.flavor: The Scorpion's information proved correct, and the reserves of the traditionalist forces were only the first to fall beneath the ruthless onslaught of the forces loyal to Shibatsu.

card.name: Cautious Contemplation
card.text:
Kharmic
After you discard this Strategy from a Kharmic action, you may target and discard a Kata.
Open, [PAY *]: Straighten your target bowed Personality. If his last bowing was from another player's card effect and you paid two Gold for this action, draw a card, and you may target and discard a Kata.
card.flavor: "Interesting," Jinn-Ja said. "Very interesting indeed."

card.name: Courage Beyond Question
card.text:
Discipline [PAY 1]
Interrupt: Negate all Force bonuses and penalties from the action.
Battle: Give your target Samurai Conqueror. Straighten his unit after this battle resolves. (A Conqueror's unit doesn't bow after battle.)
card.flavor: "A bottle of Friendly Traveler says I take more, Shinichi." He laughed. "You give away your wealth so recklessly, little Daitsu."

card.name: Undermining the Otomo
card.text:
Kharmic
After you discard this Strategy for a Kharmic action, you may take the Imperial Favor if you have higher Family Honor than any other player.
Political Open: Even if this Strategy is in your discard pile, put your target discarded (not dead) Personality into one of your Provinces, discarding any card there. Remove this Strategy from the game.
card.flavor: "It seems the Crane have a new hobby," the Scorpion noted.

card.name: Escalating Violence
card.text:
You may only play one Escalating Violence per battle.
Interrupt: If the action is another player's and Battle, after the first time it destroys one of your cards, target an enemy Personality. Your Personalities have +1F/+1C while opposing the target (this turn).
card.flavor: The Lion gasped in pain, then collapsed dead on the ground. "Did your Leadership help you stop me?" the Yoritomo sneered. "I didn't think so."

card.name: Sinister Deception
card.text: Unstoppable Battle: Give a target attacking Personality -4F. (Other players cannot Interrupt Unstoppable action).
card.flavor: "Oh," he said. "I'm sorry, I thought you were someone else. I could have sworn..." She only laughed. "I hear it all the time," she said with a wave.

card.name: Keigo Sensei
card.text:
All Clans
Your Starting Family Honor is 0.
Limited: Bow your Stronghold to search your discard pile and Fate deck for a Fudo Ring, show it, and put it in your hand. Discard a card.
Open: If you control five Fudo Rings, destroy a target Province.

(-1 Province Strength, -1 Gold Production)

card.name: Abundant Farmlands
card.text:
Farm
After each player's turn begins, straighten this Holding.
[BOW]: Produce 1 Gold.
card.flavor: The plains of the Lion provinces are both vast and fertile. They must be in order to feed the many legions of that clan's armies.

card.name: General's Hatamoto
card.text:
Retainer
Battle, [BOW]: Give a target Personality or Follower +2F (this turn).
card.flavor: "A proper samurai retires to a monastery at the age of forty years. However, some retired samurai may yet serve their lord." - Akodo's Leadership

card.name: Temple of Tengen
card.text:
Temple • Unique
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Limited, [BOW]: Draw a card. Discard a card.
card.flavor: There are temples to the ten thousand Fortunes throughout the Emerald Empire. Some, like those devoted to the Fortune of Writing, are less frequented.

card.name: The Breeding Ground
card.text:
Stables
Limited, [BOW]: Give your target Personality Conqueror (this turn) (Battle resolution does not bow cards in a Conqueror's unit).
card.flavor: "This demon crawled from some foul pit, and we are honor bound to find that pit and destroy it. No unclean beast bloodies the Lion and survives." - Akodo Daiken

card.name: Well-Defended Farm
card.text:
Farm
Your Ashigaru Personalities and Followers have +1F while opposed.
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
card.flavor: "My neighbors and I have stood against bandits. We will stand against a demon as well, if we must."

card.name: Akodo Daiken
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Conqueror
(Battle resolution does not bow cards in a Conqueror's unit.)
card.flavor: The Lion charged with a roar of fury and the passion of men who have trained for war but never tasted it. The Crab resigned themselves to receive the charge with the resilience of men who have tasted it far too often.

card.name: Ikoma Jeiku
card.text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Scout
Invest [PAY 1]: Refill the Province Jeiku entered play from face-up. (After this card enters play, you may also pay the Invest cost to get the effect, once.)
card.flavor: "I bring dire news, my lord! A village has fallen to a ravenous beast, a demon from the pit! We must ride at once!"

card.name: Ikoma Takakura
card.text: Lion Clan • Samurai • Scout
card.flavor: The Akodo are known for their brilliance, the Matsu for their ferocity, and the Kitsu for their purity. But the Ikoma are known for their cunning, their practicality, and their willingness to do whatever they must to achieve victory.

card.name: Armed Rice Farmer
card.text:
Ashigaru • Expendable
(Draw a card after your Expendable card is destroyed.)
card.flavor: "Take up this spear, peasant. Your lords have need of you on the fields of battle."

card.name: Boyoh Mercenary
card.text:
Mercenary
After Boyoh Mercenary enters play, discard a card.
After Boyoh Mercenary's army destroys a Province, draw a card.
card.flavor: "The Crab may employ such disgraceful men, for they have no honor. The Lion will never stoop so low." - Akodo Dairuko

card.name: The Lost Colossus
card.text:
Earth • Golem • Nonhuman
After The Lost Colossus enters play, bow it.
Will not attach cards. Will not challenge. You may not target The Lost Colossus with Political actions.
card.flavor: In the distant Colonies, the Crab had assets at their disposal that would render the war a moot point. Fortunately for the Lion, these were too far to bring to bear.

card.name: Frontier Farmer
card.text:
Ashigaru
You may Equip this Follower from your discard pile.
card.flavor: There was a sound on the wind, like that of distant thunder, but no clouds marred the skies. The peasants grimaced at the thought, for they knew all too well the sound of armies on the march.

card.name: Naga Remnants
card.text:
Naga • Nonhuman
Battle: Bow a target enemy attachment.
card.flavor: "The serpent men were once allies," Kisada said, rubbing his chin. "They have been untrustworthy of late, due to the influence of that accursed sorcerer of theirs, but if these wish to fight alongside us, we shall permit them."

card.name: Rice Farmer
card.text:
Ashigaru • Kharmic
(Repeatable Limited, [PAY 2]: Discard a Kharmic card from your hand to draw a card.)
card.flavor: Only in the most desperate need will samurai press a farmer into war. On the whole, a man raising crops is of much greater value than a man with a spear.

card.name: Defensive Formation
card.text: Battle: Give one to three of your target defending Personalities +2F (this turn).
card.flavor: "Stand at ease, friend Lion. We only wish to offer the Dragon Clan's aid in this time of strife."

card.name: Marshal Your Strength
card.text: Battle: Give your target Personality Force and Chi bonuses (this turn) equal to his Personal Honor, minus 1 if he is unopposed.
card.flavor: "Focus is the key to victory. Know your strengths and weaknesses, focus on them, and you can achieve victory in the face of any hardship." - Akodo's Leadership

card.name: Outnumbered
card.text: Battle: Give all your opposed Personalities with Followers at the current battlefield +1F (this turn). Give all enemy Personalities there without Followers -1F (this turn).
card.flavor: The only concern for a samurai is that he might perish before enacting his lord's will. Death is a meaningless triviality compared to that.

card.name: Suffer the Consequences
card.text:
Kharmic
(Repeatable Limited, [PAY 2]: Discard a Kharmic card to draw a card.)
Battle, [PAY *]: Destroy a target enemy Follower or Weapon with Force less than or equal to the amount of Gold paid plus 2.
card.flavor: "I probably should have thought that through..."

card.name: Tactical Setback
card.text: Absent Battle: Give a target enemy Personality -2F (this turn). (You may take Absent actions without presence.)
card.flavor: "I am not entirely sure. Did... did you see a dragon come through here, or...?"

card.name: The Impregnable Fortress of the Crab (1)
card.text: Your Crab Clan Personalities have +1F while opposed.
card.flavor: A soldier of the Crab Clan is trained upon the Carpenter Wall, where he lives every waking moment in vigilance against the terrible beasts of the south. For the Crab, battle is the reality of every sunrise.

card.name: The Impregnable Fortress of the Crab (2)
card.text: Your Crab Clan Personalities have +1F while opposed.
card.flavor: "The Lion think that they understand war. They read their scrolls and study their maps and practice their kata. They have no understanding of what true war is. We shall show them." - Hida Kisada

card.name: The Honorable Garrison of the Lion (1)
card.text: Battle: Give your target opposed Lion Clan Samurai a Force bonus equal to his Personal Honor (this turn).
card.flavor: A soldier of the Lion clan is trained in the dojo, where his every waking moment is prepared for the inevitable moment of battle. To the Lion, there is no greater honor.

card.name: The Honorable Garrison of the Lion (2)
card.text: Battle: Give your target opposed Lion Clan Samurai a Force bonus equal to his Personal Honor (this turn).
card.flavor: "The Crab stand on a wall and slay stupid beasts and twisted demons every day. They practice brutal, relentless violence, and think that they understand war. They are brutes playing at a civilized art. They have no notion of what they face." - Akodo Dairuko

card.name: Contested Market
card.text:
Port
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Economic Open, [PAY 2]: Choose a player with three or more Holdings in play. Give his target Holding -2 Gold Production (this turn).
card.flavor: "Good day, fishmonger. Oh, I'm sorry, I meant 'Mantis.' I get the two confused quite often."

card.name: Counting House
card.text:
You may only have one copy of Counting House in play.
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Limited, [BOW]: If you have fewer Provinces than each other player, draw a card.
card.flavor: The fact that economics are looked upon with such disdain seems ironic when one considers how important money is to the Empire's function.

card.name: Family Library
card.text:
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Limited: Discard a face-up card from one of your Provinces. Refill the Province with your target discarded (not dead) Personality. Destroy this Holding.
card.flavor: Every samurai family maintains at least one library to preserve their most important lore, heraldry chief among them.

card.name: Farmer's Market
card.text:
Farm • Market
You have +1 maximum hand size.
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
card.flavor: No matter how heated the conflict, no matter how righteous the cause, a samurai will never thoughtlessly endanger a farmer. They are too important.

card.name: House of Exotic Goods
card.text:
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Limited: Put one or more face-up cards in your Provinces at the bottom of your deck (and refill the Provinces). Turn all cards in your Provinces face-up. Destroy this Holding.
card.flavor: "What do you need, my friend? Silk from the Colonies? Spices from the Burning Sands? We have it all!"

card.name: Kabuki Theater Troupe
card.text:
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Limited, [BOW]: Gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: The system of artisans and patronage is essential to the function of the Crane, and a keystone of their dominance in the courts.

card.name: Marketplace
card.text:
Market
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold, or 3 Gold if you are a Crane Clan player.
card.flavor:
"And what goods do you hope to acquire today, friend Mantis?"
"The exact same things you do, friend Crane. As always."

card.name: Second City Harbor
card.text:
Port
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
You may use this Holding's printed (Economic Battle) ability one additional time per turn for each of your Markets in play.
Economic Battle, [PAY 2]: Give a target enemy Personality -1F (this turn).
card.flavor: The Second City exists far from the Empire, in its Colonies.

card.name: Daidoji Kinta
card.text:
Samurai
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 4 Attack (Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 4 or lower Force).
card.flavor: "We meet again, wave man. Did you not learn to avoid your betters the first time? I will gladly repeat the lesson for you."

card.name: Daidoji Tametaka
card.text:
Commander • Iron Crane • Samurai • Scout
Battle: Give a target enemy Follower or Personality -4F (this turn). You may target your Personality and move him home.
card.flavor:
"They claim that when the Mantis Champion heard you were involved, my lord, he set course for the mainland immediately."
Tametaka grunted. "That sounds like him."

card.name: Daidoji Tanshi
card.text: Samurai • Scout
card.flavor: The Daidoji are one of the most respected of all bushi families. They often choose to serve duty atop the Great Carpenter Wall with the Crab Clan, protecting the Empire from the demonic oni that desire to overrun it.

card.name: Doji Shimada
card.text: Magistrate • Samurai
card.flavor: "Go forth to war, my kinsmen. Know that you have my support and, through my art, you shall have the support of the other Great Clans as well. This I can gladly do for you."

card.name: Kakita Ibara
card.text:
Samurai • Duelist
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists.)
Battle: Fear 1, with +1 strength if Ibara has challenged a Personality this turn. (Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with Force equal to or lower than the Fear's strength)
card.flavor: "I enjoyed burning your village, Tsuruchi. Perhaps I'll burn a few more."

card.name: Kakita Mitohime
card.text:
Imperial • Magistrate • Samurai • Destined • Duelist
(Draw a card after you Recruit a Destined card. Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists.)
card.flavor: "I was born without my honor because of my parents' mistakes. I have regained it, and I will not see it lost due to the insults of the Mantis."

card.name: Tsuruchi Satou
card.text:
Samurai • Scout • The Masked Wasp
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 4 Attack (Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 4 or lower Force).
card.flavor: "I haven't killed a Crane before. What a delightful opportunity this will be."

card.name: Tsuruchi Taito
card.text:
Samurai • Scout • Naval
(Once a turn, the Attacker gets the first Battle action, if it's from a Naval Persoanlity's unit.)
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 3 Attack (Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 3 or lower Force). If the Defender has not had an opportunity to take a Battle action or pass, discard a card.
card.flavor: He watched the village burning to ash. "Ibara," he said through clenched teeth. "We will meet again."

card.name: Yoritomo Raiden
card.text:
Kolat • Pirate • Naval
Unstoppable Battle: Fear 3, or Fear 4 if the target is Phoenix Clan (Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with Force equal to or lower than the Fear's strength. Unstoppable has no relevance in this set.)
card.flavor: "Sail up a river during monsoon season so that you can help in the fight against the Crane? Of course, my lord Champion. I thought you wanted something difficult."

card.name: Yoritomo Teihiko
card.text:
Samurai • Naval
(Once a turn, the Attacker gets the first Battle action, if it's from a Naval Personality's unit.)
card.flavor:
"You have no blade," the Crane laughed, "just that ridiculous thing on your arm."
Teihiko smiled. "Come closer and say that."

card.name: Yoritomo Yakuwa
card.text:
Samurai • Scout • Naval
(Once a turn, the Attacker gets the first Battle action, if it's from a Naval Personality's unit.)
card.flavor: He watched the Crane scouts fade in and out of the wilderness like wraiths. "This may be more of a problem than we anticipated," he muttered.

card.name: Medium Infantry
card.flavor: The samurai forces in any army consist of light, medium, and heavy infantry. The largest portion of the force is made up of medium infantry, the rank and file of samurai trained by their dojo to wage war in the name of their family and clan.

card.name: Sons of Gusai
card.text:
Mercenary • Pirate
This Follower has +1F while you control a Port.
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 2 Attack (Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 2 or lower Force).
card.flavor: Gusai was a former Mantis Champion, revered by the clan but reviled by the Empire.

card.name: Sparrow Clan Aide
card.text:
After you Equip this Follower, gain 1 Honor.
Political Battle: Bow or straighten a target Personality with lower Personal Honor than this Personality.
card.flavor: The Sparrow are one of the Empire's Minor Clans, renowned for their artistry and oratory skills. An aide from the Sparrow Clan is a mark of prestige among the elite.

card.name: Akodo Kaiken
card.text:
Knife • One-Handed • Weapon
(A Personality may only have one Weapon.)
Battle, [BOW]: Reduce the Force of a target enemy Follower or Personality by this Personality's Chi (this turn).
card.flavor: The five sacred daggers of the Lion Clan are among the most famous artifacts in Rokugan.

card.name: Reinforced Parangu
card.text:
One-Handed • Sword • Weapon
(A Personality may only have one Weapon.)
Battle: Fear 2 (Bow a target enemy Follower, or Personality without Followers, with 2 or lower Force).
card.flavor: A crude, simple blade used by the Mantis for mundane affairs.

card.name: Singing Blade
card.text:
One-Handed • Sword • Weapon
(A Personality may only have one Weapon.)
After this Personality wins a duel, give this Item a +1F token.
card.flavor: Drawing it from its scabbard creates a single, perfect note, like the sweetest of music.

card.name: Advance Warning
card.text: Battle: Move your target Personality home. If he is a Scout, straighten his unit. Raise or lower the current Province's strength by his Force (this turn).
card.flavor: Deception is unacceptable according to the Code of Bushido, but the successful scouting and reconnaissance is simple proper warfare.

card.name: Allied Efforts
card.text: Battle: Give a target enemy Follower or Personality -3F (this turn).
card.flavor: The Mantis control considerable holdings in the distant Colonies, and as such have allies upon which they can call that the Crane have never seen.

card.name: Back to the Front
card.text: Absent Battle: Target your Personality at any location who assigned to this battlefield (this turn). Move him there and straighten his unit as he moves. (You may take Absent actions without presence.)
card.flavor: "The commander offers these orders for the reserves! I have no time for healing, my kinsmen need me at the front!"

card.name: Block Supply Lines
card.text: Battle: Move home a target attacking Personality. Bow his unit as he moves.
card.flavor: The seaways are under the unquestionable control of the Mantis, but the Crane need no supply lines that cover the sea. The conflict would be resolved exclusively by land forces.

card.name: Destiny Has No Secrets
card.text: Battle: Give you target Personality +2F/+2C. Show your hand to all players.
card.flavor: On the field of battle, whatever secrets a man hides deep in his heart have no bearing. Death comes for all, regardless of their shortcomings.

card.name: Discretionary Valor
card.text:
As a Focus Effect, bow the other Personality.
Battle: Move your target opposed Personality home. Gain 1 Honor. Draw a card.
card.flavor:
"Please accept the mediation of the Dragon Clan, my friend. We wish only to help."
The Mantis Champion smiled. "We do not want or need your help, monk."

card.name: Fall Back!
card.text: Battle: Move home your target Personality. As he moves, straighten his unit and you may straighten one of your other units (at any location).
card.flavor: "Curse the Mantis and curse their archers!" Tametaka exploded. "Fall back until we can discern their location!"

card.name: Incapacitated
card.text: Battle: Move home a target defending Personality.
card.flavor: "Our Champion gave orders that Daidoji Tametaka was not to be killed," the officer said. "However, there is no reason that we cannot remove him from the battlefield through other means."

card.name: Planned Departure
card.text: Battle: Move your target Personality home and straighten his unit as he moves. You may target a Personality and give him +2F or -2F (this turn).
card.flavor: He took one last look around. "It seems a pity that tomorrow, all this will be trod into a mud-soaked battlefield. Such is destiny, however."

card.name: Ritual Preparation
card.text: Battle: Straighten your target card in a unit.
card.flavor: "Before battle, sharpen your blade, by your own hand. Attune yourself to its edge. During battle, trust that your preparations were sufficient." - Daidoji Tametaka

card.name: Ruthless Determination
card.text:
Determination
Dark Virtue Battle: Target your unbowed Samurai Personality. Fear equal to his Force minus 1 (Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with Force equal to or lower than the Fear's strength).
card.flavor: The last enemy fell before her, his blood glinting on her blade. She sighed. "How wonderful an evening stroll can prove to be."

card.name: Startling Lessons
card.text: Iaijutsu Battle: Your target unbowed Personality challenges a target enemy Personality. Give the loser -3F (this turn). If the winner is a Duelist, give him a +1F token.
card.flavor: "No. Your blade position is perfect but you do not feel it in your spirit. Steel yourself and try again. Now!"

card.name: Strength of My Father
card.text: Battle: Give your target opposed Personality a Force bonus equal to his Personal Honor (this turn).
card.flavor: "Begone, spirit! You will not defeat me any more than you were able to defeat my father, who banished you to the realm of the dead twenty years ago!"

card.name: The Eternal Chase
card.text: Iaijutsu Battle: Your target unbowed Personality challenges a target enemy Personality. Bow the loser. Destroy him if the last Battle action his owner took this battle destroyed one of your Personalities.
card.flavor: "I yield," he said through clenched teeth. "I cannot defeat your technique. Not today. But soon."

card.name: The Mountain's Feet
card.text: Earth Battle: Bow this Shugenja to bow a target enemy unbowed card. Raise or lower the current battlefield's Province's strength by the Force of the target.
card.flavor: The strong use their strength wisely. The wise use the strength of their enemy.

card.name: Mastery of Chikujo
card.text:
Kata • Kharmic
Open: Put this Kata into play. Discard your other Kata in play.
Absent Battle, [BOW]: If the current enemy army has any units, transfer your target Fortification at its battlefield to another Province.
card.flavor: "Quickly erected and quickly removed to be relocated. They are the most alluring defenses, but quite effective for all that." - Kaiu Watsuki

card.name: Building Contract
card.text: Dynasty, [PAY *]: Search your Dynasty deck for a non-Unigue Holding and Recruit it, paying 1 more Gold unless it is a Fortification. (You may only take Dynasty actions during your Dynasty Phase.)
card.flavor: The Clans seek to outdo each other in numerous ways, especially in times of relative peace. A wise architect can live quite comfortable in such a climate.

card.name: Coastal Pearl Bed
card.text:
Pearl • Pearl Bed
Open, [BOW]: A target Holding's abilities may not be used.
card.flavor: Hiruma Daizan plunged beneath the waves. "As beautiful as the first day they were found," he thought. "More so, because now they serve the Crab."

card.name: Questionable Market
card.text:
Market • Port
Invest [PAY 2]: Give this Holding two +1GP Wealth tokens. (Entering play, permanently increase the Gold Cost by the Invest cost to get the effect.)
card.flavor:
"It is a beauty, yes? Caught on the day of the Empress's proclamation! They were jumping into the boat!"
"My profits have been down at the inn lately. How much for the ones that stopped jumping longer ago?"

card.name: Breaking the Rhythm
card.text:
As a Focus Effect, after you win this duel, gain 1 Honor and give the winner +1F.
Absent Battle: Negate a target Personality's current Force bonuses or penalties (you choose). (Absent actions may be taken without presence.)
card.flavor: "Understanding chaos is the key to victory." - Akodo's Leadership

card.name: Beautiful Host
card.text:
Retainer
Political Open: If another player's action has caused you an Honor loss this turn, give your target Personality a +1F Revenge token.
card.flavor: "Oh, you simply must attend, I insist! I assure you, you will not want to miss it. It will be the talk of the season."

card.name: A New Year
card.text:
Festival
Open: Discard zero to two cards; each other player in turn order may discard a card. Each player then draws as many cards as he discarded.
card.flavor: With each new year come new challenges and celebrations, but few years see the ascension of a new Emperor. When it occurs, a series of twenty festivals is held to commemorate the occasion.

card.name: Return of Myth
card.text: Open: Give each Nonhuman Personality +1F/+1C and give each Nonhuman Follower +1F.
card.flavor: "Tales of spirits, wondrous events, even sightings of the elemental dragons." The Phoenix shugenja's eyes were alight. "The Heavens are clear in their blessings of the Iweko Dynasty."

card.name: Short Season
card.text:
Each player may take only one Limited or Open action per turn (after this Event enters play).
Open: If you have not taken an action this phase, put this Event into play. Discard it after the current active player's next Action Phase begins..
card.flavor: The winter season was short and quite mild, beginning with the Empress's announcement and ending with a coronation.

card.name: Into the Wastes
card.text: Engage: You have the first opportunity in this battle to pass or take a Battle action, which must come from a card in a unit.
card.flavor: "It matters not what the others think," Yoritomo Hiromi said indignantly. "The Colonies are Mantis territory and I wish to know what lies beyond our borders. If there is a threat, we must know."

card.name: The Heavens Are Watching
card.text: Open: Turn all cards in other Provinces face-up (including other players' Provinces).
card.flavor: Throughout the Empire, the shugenja of Rokugan were unanimous in their finding that the Celestial Heavens were greatly pleased with the selection of the new Emperor.

card.name: The New Order
card.text:
Unique
This Event may not be discarded from play (though its Open action may be negated normally). Players need 10 more Honor to win an Honor Victory.
Political Open: Destroy your rightmost Province. Put this Event into play.
card.flavor: Whenever power changes hands, there are those who seek opportunity.

card.name: Blessed Dojo
card.text:
Dojo
Open, [BOW]: Target your Monk or Shugenja Personality. After the next time (this turn) you announce an action on his Spell or your Kiho targets him, give him +2C until that action ends.
card.flavor: "Seek truth in all things. The universe longs to share it with us. We must but be prepared to accept it."

card.name: Elemental Library
card.text:
Library
Battle, [BOW], [PAY *]: Equip a target Spell to your target opposed, unbowed Shugenja, paying 2 less Gold. If he and the Spell share an element or Thunder keyword, you may take an additional action from the Spell.
card.flavor: Most temples established by shugenja are aligned to one element over the other, purely due to the priests' preferences.

card.name: Forgotten Legacy
card.text:
Legacy
(Once per turn as a Dynasty, remove a card in your hand from the game to search your deck and Provinces for a Legacy Holding and Recruit it.)
You must have at least 16 Holdings in your deck construction.
card.flavor: The mapmaker gaped as he cleared the pass. "How long has this been here?" he wondered.

card.name: Fortified Docks
card.text:
Port
Open: Give your target Personality Naval. Destroy this Holding. (Once a turn, the Attacker gets the first Battle action, if it's from a Naval Personality's unit.)
card.flavor: The captain chuckled as he felt the eyes of dozens of archers on him. "No one sneaks in here, eh?"

card.name: Fudoist Temple
card.text:
Fudo • Temple
Open, [BOW]: Give a target Personality and each of his Followers Cavalry.
card.flavor: The Fudoist sect had been put to the torch by the Ivory Champion, but the Colonies were a vast, unexplored land.

card.name: Distracted Sentries
card.text:
Fortification • Kharmic
(Fortifications attach, bowed, to the Province from which they entered play.)
Before this Province is destroyed, transfer this Holding to an adjacent province.
Tireless Open: Straighten this Holding. It will not produce Gold until your next turn begins.
card.flavor: "No, I didn't hear anything! Stop trying to distract me! I am on a lucky streak!"

card.name: Honored Sensei
card.text:
Retainer
This Holding has +1GP, but only when it pays for a single non-Shadowlands Naga or Human Personality without your Clan Alignment; gain 1 Honor after he enters play.
card.flavor:
"Like... oof... this, sensei?"
"Your technique is flawed, but adequate for now."

card.name: Jade Mine
card.text:
Jade • Mine
When this Holding produces Gold, you may give it +1GP (this turn); if you do, it will not straighten until after your next Action Phase.
card.flavor: The shugenja nodded appreciatively. "This will enable the Phoenix to trade with the Crab quite sufficiently, I think."

card.name: Miryoku no Shima
card.text: Open: Target two of your Personalities. A lesson is taught. One copies Commander, Duelist, Kensai, Magistrate, Paragon, Scout, or Yojimbo from the other.
card.flavor: Few places in the Colonies are as untouched by war.

card.name: Puppet Theater Troupe
card.text: Political Open, [BOW]: If the active player has 11 or more Family Honor, he loses 1 Honor.
card.flavor: One of the most commonly requested performances of the season was a rather scandalous account of Kuni Renyu's rivalry with Togashi Noboru.

card.name: Secret Dojo
card.text:
Dojo
Interrupt, [BOW]: Bow the winner of any duel created by the action if he was the Challenger. Destroy this Holding.
card.flavor: "I always thought this was a tax warehouse," she commented. Behind the blindfold, he smiled. "Let us begin."

card.name: Slave Pits
card.text:
Mine
Courtesy: When this Holding produces Gold, you may give it +1GP (this turn) and lose 2 Honor. (Courtesy traits do not take effect if you went first.)
card.flavor: There are dark places in the Empire, far from the Jade Sun's light, where unsavory practices remain in place.

card.name: Throes of Madness
card.text:
Kharmic
Open, [BOW]: Straighten your target Personality. Destroy this Holding.
Open, [BOW]: Straighten this Holding if you have not given any Madness tokens this turn. Give a target Personality a Madness token.
card.flavor: "The Mad Dragon will return one day!" He laughed. "The faithful will be ready!"

card.name: Blessed Herbalist
card.text:
Expendable • Fortification
(Draw a card after your Expendable card is destroyed. Fortifications attach, bowed, to the Province from which they entered play.)
Tireless Interrupt: Negate all the action's Melee and Ranged Attacks (at this battlefield).
card.flavor: "Try to remain still, brother. The kami will heal you, if you let them."

card.name: Mystic Dojo
card.text:
Dojo
This Holding has +2GP when it pays for a single Shugenja only.
card.flavor: The term dojo most often applies to schools for samurai to learn the ways of war. Most often, but not always.

card.name: Personal Dojo
card.text:
Dojo
Tireless Interrupt: If you have won a duel this turn, each of the action's Fear effects have +1 strength and may target Items and Spells. (Tireless actions may be taken even while bowed.)
card.flavor: "Oh, I see you brought a no-dachi. That is so quaint. No, I certainly never have seen that before."

card.name: Nexus of Lies
card.text: Before another, non-Spider Clan player loses Honor from a card he owns, increase the loss by an amount equal to half his Starting Family Honor, rounded down (this doesn't allow them to ignore Honor Requirements).
card.flavor: To outsiders, it appears as a simple tower. To the Scorpion, it is the greatest repository of blackmail secrets in the world.

card.name: The Obsidian Dojo
card.text:
Dojo
Interrupt, [BOW]: If the action creates a duel, then after your Personality wins it permanently give him the ability, "Battle: Fear 4 (Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 4 or lower Force)." Destroy this Holding.
card.flavor: "If the other clans think us only what we appear to be, they are fools." - Daigotsu Kanpeki

card.name: Platinum Mine
card.text:
Mine
This Holding has +1GP when it pays for a single attachment only.
card.flavor: Incredibly rare and found mostly in the Colonies, platinum is valuable enough to tempt even the most virtuous soul.

card.name: Forward Encampment
card.text:
Barracks
Battle, [BOW], [PAY *]: Equip a target Follower or Spell in your discard pile if another player's action destroyed it or its Personality this battle.
card.flavor: "We may only be here a month," the commander said, "but I won't have our horses wandering. Fences, men. Defensive and containment."

card.name: Agasha Tameko
card.text:
Commander • Water • Shugenja • Soul of Agasha Tomioko
Water Interrupt: After the action Equips a Spell to Tameko, take an additional action.
card.flavor: "Are the Unicorn truly surprised that their repulsive ancestry may have stained their souls? If so, they are more naive than I imagined."

card.name: Walking with the Fire
card.text:
Kharmic
Battle/Open: Straighten your target Ring.
Fire Interrupt: Bow your target unbowed Ring. After revealing focused cards in a duel created by the action, give the first card you focused in the duel +2FV.
card.flavor: "The designs of the kami are majestic, of that there is no doubt. It can be difficult to endure their beauty, though."

card.name: Small Library
card.text:
Library
After this card enters play from a Province, refill the Province face-up.
card.flavor: "We have but a fraction of the records of a larger library, sama, but you will find all our scrolls in perfect condition. We all do what we must."

card.name: Kaiu-Built Defenses
card.text:
Fortification
This Holding enters play unbowed.
Interrupt, [BOW]: Negate an Engage action.
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 3 Attack.
card.flavor: "If there is ever a chance it will be attacked, do yourself a favor and commission a Kaiu." - Common saying among governors

card.name: Chaldera
card.text:
Constrictor • Naga • Nonhuman
Battle: Bow a target enemy Personality with lower Force and with either no unbowed Followers or Shadowlands.
card.flavor: "This world belongs to the humans now. The fate that has befallen my people is tragic, but who are we to questions fate? It is what it is."

card.name: Suana Dojo
card.text:
Dojo
This Holding has -1GP while your Stronghold's Gold Production is 4 or greater.
card.flavor: Few heroes of the Brotherhood have such a reputation as Suana. A man of peace and introspection, once he was moved to battle, he wan an unstoppable juggernaut.

card.name: Doji Masachika
card.text:
Magistrate • Samurai • Expendable
(Draw a card after your Expendable card dies.)
Interrupt: After Masachika enters play, dishonor a target Personality with equal or lower Personal Honor.
card.flavor: "Perhaps it is an unlucky name," he admitted. He smiled. "Unlucky for you."

card.name: Iuchi Daitoru
card.text: Magistrate • Shugenja • Water
card.flavor: Many underestimate the Unicorn magistrates because of their compassionate nature. It is due to this compassion that they are so driven to find and punish the guilty and the wicked, however.

card.name: Temple of Destiny
card.text:
Temple • Destined
(Draw a card after you Recruit a Destined card.)
card.flavor: Destiny is an idea that everyone accepts, but which few truly understand. Those few who dedicate themselves to unraveling its mysteries are often lost to others.

card.name: Trading Grounds
card.text:
Market
This Holding has +3GP when it pays for a single Holding only.
card.flavor: Nothing in the mortal realm can compare to the chaos of the trading grounds during a coronation festival season.

card.name: Traveling Market
card.text: Market • Kharmic
card.flavor: Many merchants believe that their customers will come to them. Others are not so patient, and are willing to go to the customer if the promise of coin is sufficient.

card.name: Labor Crew
card.text:
Fortification
(Fortifications attach, bowed, to the Province from which they entered play.)
Interrupt, [BOW]: Negate a target Personality's movement into an attacking army.
card.flavor: "Celebration or not, this trench must be dug. Do you relish the thought of cavalry overrunning the village? No? Then dig!"

card.name: Yukihime's Hot Springs
card.text: Open, [BOW]: A target Holding's abilities may not be used.
card.flavor: "I do not know about you, friends, but all this talk of coronation has me in need of a long, soothing soak in the springs."

card.name: Hida Taisho
card.text:
Samurai
Battle, [BOW]: Reduce a target enemy Follower or Personality's Force by Taisho's Force.
card.flavor: "As for myself, I care little who sits on the throne. I am but a soldier, and I will never be in his presence. I wage war on the Shadowlands, and that is all."

card.name: Hida Zaiburo
card.text:
Berserker • Conqueror
(A Conqueror's unit doesn't bow after battle.)
Battle: Fear equal to Zaiburo's Force minus 1.
card.flavor: "You have served well despite your curse, brother. I swear to you, and to our parents in the next world, I will find a way to end your life. Trust me, Kaiji."

card.name: Toritaka Iabuchi
card.text:
Samurai • Scout • Destined
(Draw a card after you Recruit a Destined card.)
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 2 Attack (Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 2 or lower Force).
card.flavor: "My power is not for myself, great Fortunes, but for our new Emperor. Give them your wisdom and your insight, that he may reign with justice."

card.name: Hida Iguchi
card.text:
Samurai • Cavalry
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to the battle.)
card.flavor: Iguchi shook the dust of the trail from his thick beard. "Will I be going to the Imperial City?" he asked. "What kind of question is that?"

card.name: Hida Kurabi
card.text:
Berserker • Hero • Imperial • Destined • Reserve
(Draw a card after you Recruit a Destined card. You may Recruit a Reserve Personality, if they would be opposed, as an Absent Battle action.)
card.flavor: "All Imperials are reqruired in the capital for the coronation." He crumpled up the scroll. "Wonderful."

card.name: Hiruma Raikohime
card.text:
Magistrate • Samurai • Resilient
