(Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution.)
Engage: If Raikohime is opposed, discard a card to make the enemy leader either discard a Battle Strategy, or show you his hand if it does not have one.
card.flavor: "The Kokujin monks have returned, Shara-sensei. I swear to you, I will end them."

card.name: Kaiu Burei
card.text:
Samurai • Siege
Before you Proclaim Burei, increase the Honor gain to equal the number of your Fortifications in play, up to 5.
card.flavor: He inspected every single seam, spending hours upon hours supervising the work. The Kaiu were not known for their expertise without just cause.

card.name: Kaiu Daikohime
card.text:
Samurai • Siege
Battle, [BOW]: If Daikohime is defending, Ranged 3 Attack. After this destroys a card, gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "What simpleton drew up these plans? Look at these oversights. I could capture this fortification with a dozen men. No, this will not do at all."

card.name: Kaiu Gorobei
card.text:
Samurai • Siege
Battle: Discard a card to bow a target enemy card with Force equal to or lower than the discarded card's Focus Value.
card.flavor: "Last night I was struck by inspiration! We will add an additional tower here, and link it with a second, internal wall. This shall be my most impregnable fortress yet."

card.name: Kaiu Watsuki - exp
card.text:
Daimyo • Samurai • Siege • Experienced • Loyal • Tactician • Unique
Interrupt: After the action Recruits a Fortification from a Province, refill it face-up.
Battle: Ranged 3 Attack with +1 strength for each Fortification at this battlefield.
card.flavor: "The construction seems to be ahead of schedule. I think the new Emperor will be very pleased."

card.name: Kuni Chutsu
card.text: Earth • Shugenja
card.flavor: He felt the spirits of the earth stirring all around him, taking notice of his deference and patience. Like the Crab, the Earth despised weakness and impatience. The priest smiled. "Thank you, my friends," he said softly.

card.name: Kuni Harakibi
card.text:
Earth • Shugenja • Witch Hunter
Earth Battle, [BOW]: Melee 3 Attack, or Melee 4 Attack if the target is Shadowlands (Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with Force equal to or lower than the Melee Attack's Strength).
card.flavor: The witch-hunter's make-up gleamed in the moonlight. "Tell me, friend Phoenix... where did you find these scrolls?"

card.name: Kuni Yairao
card.text:
Commander • Earth • Shugenja • Soul of Kuni Iyedo
Earth Battle, [PAY *]: Equip a target Follower in your hand to your target Personality.
card.flavor: "Celebration is never an excuse to allow your vigilance to waver. We must be strong because so many others are weak."

card.name: Kuni Renyu - exp3
card.text:
Daimyo • Earth • Jade • Magistrate • Shugenja • Witch Hunter • Experienced 3 • Loyal • Unique
Earth Interrupt: If the action is Earth, negate the next straightening (this turn) of each card it bows.
Earth Unstoppable Battle: Bow a target enemy card that is Dragon Clan, Gaijin, Shadowlands, or has no attachments.
card.flavor: Since his return from the Colonies, many have noted that Renyu's temper has only worsened.

card.name: Asahina Hirakane
card.text:
Air • Shugenja • Soul of Asahina Minori
Open: Target another player's Personality. After the next time this turn he is destroyed during a battle, gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: Whispering a prayer, the priest took the paper from the dead soldier's hand. "The Empire must hear this death poem," he whispered.

card.name: Kakita Mitsumichi
card.text:
Samurai • Soul of Kakita Yariga • Duelist
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists.)
Mitsumichi will not refuse challenges. If Mitsumichi is honorable, the first card another player focuses in each duel against him is focused face-up.
card.flavor: "A man whose sword is always drawn is never approached. He has no allies. Yet a man who never draws his sword will find it rusting in its sheath. Seek balance in all things." - The Tao of Shinsei

card.name: Doji Senkiku
card.text:
Samurai • Magistrate • Soul of Doji Hitomaro
Political Engage: If Senkiku opposes a dishonorable Personality, gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "A wise lord would never risk fielding a disgraced man, even if that man was a master swordsman. It makes his enemy look virtuous. The battle is but a moment in time; the aftermath is an eternity. How easily victory sours, like spoiled milk."

card.name: Kakita Akitomo
card.text:
Artisan • Courtier • Jester
Political Interrupt, [BOW]: If the action is yours, before you gain Honor from it, negate the gain to make a target player lose 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "A man to be admired! Truly, this is the most glorious celebration Susumu-sama could have conceived without opening his coffers!"

card.name: Daidoji Taenaru
card.text:
Samurai • Soul of Daidoji Tae
After Taenaru is destroyed, gain 2 Honor.
Battle: Once per battle, move home a target enemy Personality with lower current Force than his own printed Force. Bow him as he moves.
card.flavor: The sensei asked, "Is it better to live well, or to die well?" Taenaru did not flinch. "Both," she replied.

card.name: Doji Tashihime
card.text:
Artisan • Poet • Soul of Doji Nukada
Political Interrupt: Before another player loses Honor from the action, Tashihime's poems immortalize the shame; increase the loss by 1 and gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "Who wrote this!?" the man demanded, the scroll clenched in his fist. His eyes raked the court. "Who is this 'Waratte?'" The daimyo looked away, and too late the man realized he'd been made a fool.

card.name: Fearless Heavy Cavalry
card.text:
Cavalry
Negate Fear effects targeting this Follower.
Interrupt: If the action is yours, straighten this Follower after it resolves.
card.flavor: "A commander is fortunate who has such a force in his army." - Moto Taigo

card.name: Shune
card.text:
Kenku • Nonhuman • Duelist
Iaijutsu Battle: Target your unbowed Personality and bow him unless he has won a duel this turn. Bow a target enemy Personality with equal or lower Chi than your Personality.
card.flavor: Kenku sightings in Crane lands are more common of late. Many take this is as sign of favor, of good fortune for the Crane. The Champion ponders before the shrine of Doji Yasuyo. He is not so certain.

card.name: Daidoji Hiroteru
card.text:
Iron Crane • Samurai
Hiroteru has +1F for each bowed card in the enemy army.
Battle: Fear 3.
card.flavor: "To kill the spirit is the swiftest victory of all."

card.name: Doji Norime
card.text:
Magistrate • Samurai
Absent Home Battle: Move Norime into your defending army. After this moves her, you may target and bow an enemy dishonorable Personality. (Absent actions may be taken without presence. Home actions may be taken from home.)
card.flavor: "You harbor a criminal in your army, Matsu-san. Were you aware of this?"

card.name: Kakita Ikura
card.text:
Artisan • Courtier • Cursed • Daimyo • Loyal • Unique
Ikura will not attack or issue challenges, and cannot be challenged from Iaijutsu actions.
Favor Political Open: Discard the Imperial Favor to make a target player lose 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "Such a charming, peaceful soul. But his music is so anguished..." - Doji Makoto

card.name: Kakita Hikai
card.text:
Artisan • Courtier • Jester • Expendable
(Draw a card after your Expendable card dies.)
After you Proclaim Hikai or he is destroyed, a target player loses 1 Honor.
card.flavor: The Kakita Jester is a master entertainer. The ideal jester can dance, sing, compose spontaneous poetry, and amuse an audience without appearing like a buffoon. However, with all these talents, they are best known for their barbed wit.

card.name: Kakita Izumiko
card.text:
Samurai • Duelist
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists.)
After Izumiko wins a duel, gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "One day, you are born. The next, you die. If you are lucky, sometime in-between you will glimpse the moon."

card.name: Kakita Ujirou - exp
card.text:
Magistrate • Samurai • Duelist • Experienced • Reserve • Unique
After Ujirou enters play, you may take an additional action. While you are the Defender, you Recruit Ujirou for 5 less Gold.
Battle: Fear 4 that destroys attachments and dishonorable Personalities after it bows them.
card.flavor: "The door was open," the dying Bayushi remarked. Ujirou shrugged and wiped blood from his blade.

card.name: Mirumoto Akifumi
card.text:
Samurai • Void
Tireless Battle: Target your Ring. You may bow it to straighten Akifumi or you may bow Akifumi to straighten it. (Tireless actions may be taken even while bowed.)
card.flavor: "The first child or the second? An interesting, but useless question. It was never for us to choose who might be Emperor, only to wait until the great cycle reveals itself."

card.name: Togashi Kasuru
card.text:
Monk • Tattooed • Void • Tactician
(Battle: Discard a card to give this Tactician a Force bonus equal to the card's Focus Value.)
Battle, [BOW]: If Kasuru is attacking, draw a card. You may discard a card to straighten Kasuru.
card.flavor: "Come, my friend. Let us share in the secrets of the universe together."

card.name: Kitsuki Goichi
card.text:
Magistrate • Samurai • Soul of Kitsuki Berii
Battle: Move home a target Human Personality with the lowest Personal Honor at this battlefield (you choose in case of a tie).
card.flavor: "We were once allies with your kind, Scorpion," he said. "But that time has passed. Why would we support your foolish war?"

card.name: Kitsuki Einosuke
card.text:
Courtier • Magistrate • Expendable
(Draw a card after your Expendable card dies.)
Courtesy: Einosuke has Destined. (Courtesy traits do not take effect if you went first. Draw a card after you Recruit a Destined card.)
card.flavor: "Here, master," the student remarked. "This mark was placed to confuse us."

card.name: Mirumoto Eisuke
card.text: Samurai • Soul of Mirumoto Daini
card.flavor: "Matters with the Spider grow even more strained than before with the appointment of this new Emperor. They are an interesting people, and I would be saddened to cut them down. Saddened, but not worried."

card.name: Kitsuki Masamitsu
card.text:
Air • Courtier • Magistrate • Shugenja
Air Tireless Open: If Masamitsu has cast an Air Spell this turn, straighten him. (Tireless action may be taken even while bowed.)
card.flavor: Masamitsu's talents help train the next generation as well as lead to testimony that traps the guilty.

card.name: Mirumoto Tsuda, Emerald Champion
card.text:
Imperial • Magistrate • Samurai • Cavalry • Duelist • Experienced • Unique
Iaijutsu Battle: Challenge a target enemy Personality. If the target is honorable, his controller may dishonor him and move him home to refuse the duel. Destroy the loser.
card.flavor: "The mad ones. The Fudoists. Bandits. Criminals. Many faces of the same foe, undone by the same weapon - justice."

card.name: Mirumoto Rikiya
card.text:
Samurai • Soul of Mirumoto Washizuka • Duelist
Iaijutsu Battle, [BOW]: Move home a target enemy defending Personality with equal or lower Chi. Straighten Rikiya if he won a duel this turn.
card.flavor: "Peace in the Colonies, my friend. The Dragon will brook no more of this pointless conflict."

card.name: Togashi Taiki
card.text:
Monk • Tattooed
Taiki has the element keywords of any Rings you control. While you control a Ring of Air, he has Cavalry; Ring of Earth, he has +2F/+1C; Ring of Fire, he has, "Battle: Melee 2 Attack."; Ring of Water, he has Conqueror; Ring of Void, he has Destined • Expendable.
card.flavor: The ise zumi in the Colonies have taken great strides to bring harmony to the region.

card.name: Tamori Tsunemi
card.text:
Commander • Earth • Shugenja • Conqueror
(A Conqueror's unit doesn't bow after battle.)
card.flavor: "A new Emperor sits on the Throne, and yet I know there will be little true rejoicing. Times like these make opportunists out of many souls."

card.name: Tamori Jinai
card.text:
Alchemist • Earth • Shugenja
Earth Battle: Bow a target enemy card without attachments.
card.flavor: "The element of earth is common in all living things. While my temple may have no great wall of stone, it is guarded all the same."

card.name: Tamori Seiken - exp
card.text:
Commander • Earth • Mountaineer • Shugenja • Cavalry • Experienced • Unique
Seiken's Nonhuman Followers have Cavalry.
Earth Battle: Fear equal to the Focus Value of Seiken's target Follower or Spell.
card.flavor: Seiken burst from the ground itself, propelled by his steed of stone. The Scorpion ambush was scattered, and the Dragon made their presence known.

card.name: Tamori Shoko
card.text:
Commander • Earth • Shugenja
Earth Battle: Give a target enemy Follower or Personality -2F.
card.flavor: "Hello, my enemies. I have a gift for you. Where shall I place it?"

card.name: Togashi Tsukagi
card.text: Monk • Soul of Togashi Akagi • Tattooed • Void
card.flavor: "The pattern holds. A fall, a rise. A man learns the cost of his bargain. There will be a break from within, and a storm will rip apart our very hearts. Pain and rage await us all, and I can unleash myself. Pain and rage. For myself and for my enemies."

card.name: Akodo Kenaro - exp
card.text:
Samurai • Duelist • Experienced • Tactician • Unique
After your Personality wins a duel at a battlefield, give him +1F.
Iaijutsu Battle: Kenaro challenges a target enemy Personality. Bow the loser.
card.flavor: "You served the Empress with honor, father. I shall serve her son in the same fashion."

card.name: Akodo Hio
card.text:
Beastmaster • Samurai • Soul of Akodo Michio
Battle, [PAY 2]: Discard a card to create a 2F Cat • Nonhuman Follower and attach it to your target Beastmaster.
card.flavor: The insults suffered due to the offenses of the Scorpion would not be borne lightly by the Lion. The sons of Akodo and daughters of Matsu were not those who endured such things without answer.

card.name: Matsu Iairimi
card.text:
Hero • Samurai • Soul of Matsu Mari
Interrupt: Negate Iairimi's movement from the action.
card.flavor: "She carries an unconventional weapon, but it is one that the Scorpion have learned to fear. Many of their kinsmen's blood is upon it." - Ikoma Sairei

card.name: Akodo Shaido
card.text:
Samurai • Duelist
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists.)
Shaido has +1F and +1PH while attacking.
card.flavor: There are few families in Rokugan who place as great an emphasis on education as the Akodo. The overwhelming emphasis is on warfare, of course, but other subjects are covered as well.

card.name: Ikoma Sairei
card.text: Paragon • Samurai • Soul of Ikoma Sido
card.flavor: As the Lion pushed farther into Scorpion territory, many strange things were discovered. "What are you doing here, cousin?" he asked the large cat, but of course it did not answer.

card.name: Matsu Ataruko
card.text:
Beastmaster • Commander • Samurai
Battle: Fear 2, or Fear 4 if Ataruko has a Nonhuman, non-Shadowlands Follower.
card.flavor: "It is said her mother is Matsu Benika, bearer of the Jade Hand. I do not know if this is true, but she possesses insight such as no warrior I have ever known." - Akodo Kano

card.name: Ikoma Noritsu
card.text:
Samurai • Soul of Ikoma Tatsunori • Tactician
(Battle: Discard a card to give this Tactician a Force bonus equal to the card's Focus Value.)
Political Interrupt: Before you gain Honor from a Battle action, negate the gain to draw a card.
card.flavor: His uncle bore the blessings of Bishamon himself, the Fortune of Strength. Some say he possesses it as well.

card.name: Matsu Keiasu
card.text:
Beastmaster • Commander • Samurai • Cavalry
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to the battle.)
Keiasu's Nonhuman, non-Shadowlands Followers have Cavalry.
card.flavor: "By the Fortunes, he's a fast one! How does he keep up with the beasts?" - Ikoma Noritsu

card.name: Akodo Eirasu
card.text:
Deathseeker • Hero • Samurai • Soul of Akodo Ebiro
Battle: Fear equal to Eirasu's Force that bows any Undead card it targets. (Target an enemy Follower or Personality without Followers; bow it if its Force is less than or equal to the Fear's strength.)
card.flavor: Second generation Deathseekers are virtually unheard of, but then again, the unheard grows increasingly common.

card.name: Akodo Naikiru
card.text:
Governor • Samurai • Soul of Akodo Nakama • Tactician
Your Bushido Virtue Strategies in and out of play have +1FV, to a maximum of 4.
card.flavor: "Not all of us are called to serve in the same manner. I would gladly carry a blade into battle for my lord, but my duty is to govern, and I will do it with all that I have."

card.name: Matsu Chizuki
card.text:
Beastmaster • Commander • Daimyo • Samurai • Conqueror • Loyal • Unique
Melee Attacks and Fear effects from Cat Followers in this army have +1 strength.
Interrupt: After Chizuki enters play, search your Fate deck for Zaiko, show it, and put it in your hand.
card.flavor: "She speaks to cats in a manner I cannot understand. Never ask after her father." - Akodo Dairuko

card.name: Matsu Seijuko
card.text:
Samurai • Duelist
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists.)
After Seijuko wins a duel, give her +1PH.
Battle: Fear equal to Seijuko's Personal Honor.
card.flavor: "My ancestor was called the Golden Crane for his skill in dueling. I venerate his memory, but call me a Crane and we shall cross steel."

card.name: Akodo Taiketsu
card.text:
Samurai • Duelist
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists.)
Invest [PAY 2]: Put an Iaijutsu Strategy in your discard pile into your hand. (Entering play, permanently increase the Gold Cost by the Invest cost to get the effect.)
card.flavor: His face registered disappointment as he sheathed his blade. Yet another opponent had failed to give him challenge.

card.name: Matsu Karoko
card.text:
Samurai
Battle, [BOW]: Melee 3 Attack. Straighten Karoko if she is attacking.
card.flavor: "You will be my chief implement of vengeance upon these filthy Scorpion," Chizuki said with a smile. "Teach them what it means to cross the Matsu."

card.name: Moshi Karuiko
card.text: Shugenja • Thunder • Soul of Moshi Kamiya
card.flavor: "My mother earned great glory for the Mantis in battle against the Destroyers. I seek only to serve in a similar manner. How can a simple priestess cause an Empire to take note?"

card.name: Sarassa
card.text:
Ningyo • Nonhuman • Shugenja • Thunder • Naval
(Once a turn, the Attacker gets the first Battle action, if it's from a Naval Personality's unit.)
Thunder Battle, [PAY *]: Equip a target Spell to Sarassa. You may take an additional action to use one of the Spell's Battle abilities.
card.flavor: "Your actions, human... they have effect far beyond that which you can see."

card.name: Moshi Yokohime
card.text:
Shugenja • Soul of Moshi Yuriko • Thunder • Naval
(Once a turn, the Attacker gets the first Battle action, if it's from a Naval Personality's unit.)
Thunder Battle: Bow a target enemy card without attachments.
card.flavor: "I witnessed the death of a Phoenix through his own eyes. Lady Ikako, I need to understand."

card.name: Moshi Ikako - exp
card.text:
Air • Fire • Daimyo • Shugenja • Experienced • Naval • Reserve • Unique
Your other Moshi Personalities in Ikako's army have +1F. After Ikako enters play, you may take an additional action.
Fire Battle: Ranged Attack equal to 2 plus the number of other Personalities in this army.
card.flavor: "Regardless of the new Emperor's preferences, I will not see the Moshi lose their way."

card.name: Tsuruchi Arayo
card.text:
Samurai • Soul of Tsuruchi Amaya
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 4 Attack. Bow the target if it is still in play.
card.flavor: It is said that her grandmother was born of the Daidoji, and it is in her memory that she wears such an odd helm.

card.name: Tsuruchi Jinrai
card.text:
Magistrate • Samurai • Soul of Tsuruchi Jougo
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 3 Attack. You may target a Mantis Clan Personality in one of your Provinces and reduce his Gold Cost by 2 (this turn), to a minimum of 3.
card.flavor: "I enjoyed killing the Crane, but I think I would like to try a different prey."

card.name: Yoritomo Kuniken
card.text:
Samurai • Naval
(Once a turn, the Attacker gets the first Battle action, if it's from a Naval Personality's unit.)
While opposed, Kuniken has +1F for each of your Port Holdings, up to three Ports.
card.flavor: "Is it not glorious? For every man I slay, I take a single coin and add its metal to my armor. Gaze upon my kills."

card.name: Yoritomo Tsuhime
card.text:
Magistrate • Samurai • Soul of Yoritomo Eriko • Naval
(Once a turn, the Attacker gets the first Battle action, if it's from a Naval Personality's unit.)
card.flavor: "A new Emperor means a new age, and this shall be an age in which the Mantis shall forever be remembered!"

card.name: Yoritomo Nintai
card.text:
Samurai • Kensai • Naval
(Kensai may attach two One-Handed Weapons.)
Battle: Fear 2, with +2 strength if Nintai has a Gaijin or Peasant Weapon attached, and with +1 strength if her army has fewer units than the enemy army.
card.flavor: The students of the half-Naga Yoritomo Minori are a strange and private group.

card.name: Yoritomo Matsuo - exp
card.text:
Samurai • Experienced • Kensai • Naval • Unique
Equipping Weapons is Battle/Open for you.
Battle: Bow your target unbowed Weapon, then straighten it if it is Gaijin or Peasant. Destroy a target enemy attachment.
card.flavor: "In any other clan he would have been discarded, cast out. Only in the Mantis has he found his true strength." - Yoritomo Hiromi

card.name: Yoritomo Minoro
card.text:
Magistrate • Samurai
Economic Home Interrupt, [PAY 2]: Give the action's Ranged Attacks +2 or -2 strength.
card.flavor: Throughout Rokugan, no other clan looks forward to the changes a new Emperor brings to the tax structure of the Empire. Perhaps because, as so many say, no clan loves coin as do the Mantis.

card.name: Yoritomo Juriken
card.text:
Samurai • Kensai • Naval
(Kensai may attach two One-Handed Weapons. Once a turn, the Attacker gets the first Battle action, if it's from a Naval Personality's unit.)
Battle: Give a target enemy Personality -2F, or -3F if Juriken has a Gaijin or Peasant Weapon attached.
card.flavor: "Brother, no one wants to hear about your armor. Fight and be done with it!"

card.name: Yoritomo Waito
card.text:
Commander • Samurai • Soul of Yoritomo Iwata
Interrupt: If the action is a Ranged Attack action, after it resolves, give your target Personality +2F.
card.flavor: The merchant placed the coins in the samurai's hand, but to his dismay, the Mantis only smiled and held his hand out for more.

card.name: Yoritomo Saitsuko
card.text:
Samurai • Kensai • Naval
(Kensai may attach two One-Handed Weapons. Once a turn, the Attacker gets the first Battle action, if it's from a Naval Personality's unit.)
card.flavor: "The name of the man who sits upon the throne is of little concern to me, so long as I many remain upon the sea."

card.name: Isawa Akime
card.text:
Air • Artisan • Shugenja
Air Open, [BOW]: Target a Phoenix Clan Personality in your discard pile. The rebirth begins. He becomes honorably dead.
card.flavor: The mourning at funerals must remain silent and still, lest the spirit remain in the realm of the living. Only the dancing shugenja may show emotion.

card.name: Agasha Shikeno
card.text: Air • Alchemist • Fire • Shugenja • Soul of Asako Hoshimi
card.flavor: "Only once has an Agasha sat upon the Council of Fire. If it takes me a hundred reincarnations, I will be the next!"

card.name: Asako Misora
card.text:
Earth • Inquisitor • Magistrate • Shugenja • Expendable
(Draw a card after your Expendable card dies.)
card.flavor: "I am sometimes surprised at those who would turn to darkness. For some, it is a desperate act. But not for all... not for all."

card.name: Isawa Ikariya
card.text:
Fire • Shugenja • Reserve
(You may Recruit a Reserve Personality, if they would be opposed, as an Absent Battle action.)
Fire Battle: Ranged Attack equal to the number of Spells in this unit.
card.flavor: "He is so eager to use the blessings of the kami in battle. Such anger in one so gifted is an ill tiding." - Isawa Akime

card.name: Isawa Kageharu
card.text:
Shugenja • Soul of Isawa Mizuhiko • Water • Loyal • Naval
(Loyal Personalities will not join other Clans. Once a turn, the Attacker gets the first Battle action, if it's from a Naval Personality's unit.)
card.flavor: "If a prophecy is unavoidable, what does that imply about our ability to choose our actions?"

card.name: Isawa Haruge
card.text:
Earth • Shugenja • Soul of Isawa Itsuoko
Earth Battle, [BOW]: You may bow one of Haruge's Spells to straighten her. Bow a target enemy Personality. If it is an Oni, it will not straighten until the next turn begins.
card.flavor: "If I never have to use my gifts, I will consider both myself and the Empire very lucky."

card.name: Isawa Nairuko
card.text:
Earth • Shugenja • Soul of Isawa Mariko
Nairuko has +2F while she has a Spell.
card.flavor: "The blessings of the kami are meant for joy, not harm. Even so, I will do what I must.

card.name: Isawa Mochiko
card.text:
Shugenja • Water • Soul of Isawa Tanaka • Cavalry
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to the battle.)
Water Battle: If he would be opposed, move your target Personality at any location to a battlefield (not necessarily this one).
card.flavor: "Water that remains still for too long soon stagnates."

card.name: Haikitsu
card.text:
Magistrate • Samurai
Open, [BOW]: Target a dishonorable Personality. After the next time this turn he attacks you or an action on his card resolves, gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "I have lived an honorable life. I will not undo all I have accomplished in the twilight of my years."

card.name: Isawa Uzuyumi - exp
card.text:
Commander • Shugenja • Water • Experienced • Naval • Unique
Water Battle: If he would be opposed, move to this battlefield a target Personality at any location. Straighten his unit as he moves.
card.flavor: "Even war is sacred, if it is conducted as such."

card.name: Asako Tsunefusa - exp
card.text:
Daimyo • Earth • Inquisitor • Magistrate • Shugenja • Experienced • Loyal • Unique
Earth Battle: Bow a target enemy Personality. If he is Shadowlands, give each Shugenja in this army +1F.
card.flavor: The elder Asako Daimyo leads the family with militant sternness, quite unlike the many Asako Henshin daimyo before her.

card.name: Asako Hiribe
card.text:
Earth • Interrogator • Magistrate • Shugenja
Earth Open: Target a Personality. You suspect him of the taint. If he has Shadowlands, give him -2F. He has Shadowlands while you are taking actions (this turn).
card.flavor: "To accept the taint in this age is to reject the protection of the Divine Emperor. Before, I might have felt pity. Not anymore."

card.name: Shiba Danjiro
card.text:
Samurai • Soul of Shiba Morihiko • Yojimbo
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged Attack equal to Danjiro's Force.
card.flavor: "To live for others is the most sacred duty, second only to dying for others."

card.name: Shiba Kiyomichi
card.text:
Samurai • Soul of Shiba Sakishi • Yojimbo • Duelist
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists.)
After the first time each turn Kiyomichi assigns to an army with a Shugenja, gain 1 Honor.
Battle: Move your target Shugenja at any location to Kiyomichi's battlefield.
card.flavor: "Stay close to me, and I will carve us a path to the general's heart!"

card.name: Bayushi Aibako
card.text:
Samurai • Bitter Lies • Conqueror
(A Conqueror's unit doesn't bow after battle.)
card.flavor: "These problems in the Colonies are trivial. For all their bluster, no one has the strength or resources to stop us."

card.name: Bayushi Sunetsu
card.text:
Samurai • Soul of Bayushi Sunetra
Sunetsu's Items must be Armor or Weapons.
Battle: If Sunetsu has one or no Followers, move her to an unresolved battlefield.
card.flavor: "The Lion are coming. I am ready to greet them."

card.name: Soshi Kodanshi
card.text:
Ninja
After Kodanshi enters play from a Province, create a 0F/2C/0PH Ninja • Scorpion Clan Personality.
card.flavor: "We cannot be stopped because we are everywhere. Behind me is another. And another. And another."

card.name: Bayushi Katsue
card.text:
Courtier • Samurai • Soul of Bayushi Shigeru
Political Interrupt: After Katsue enters play, a target player loses 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "Yes, yes, the Lion. They continue to think that they can wage war on the Scorpion without repercussions. I continue to think otherwise."

card.name: Bayushi Toshimo - exp
card.text:
Bitter Lies • Samurai • Yojimbo • Experienced • Kensai • Unique
Battle: Fear equal to the Force of your target unbowed Kensai. You may destroy a Madness token on Toshimo to have this destroy cards after it bows them.
card.flavor: "I remember when the Crab were enemies, but now we fight back-to-back. If I am mad, it is because the world is mad."

card.name: Bayushi Saikaku
card.text:
Bitter Lies • Samurai • Kensai
(Kensai may attach two One-Handed Weapons.)
Battle, [BOW]: Fear 4. You may bow Saikaku's Weapon or destroy a Madness token on him to straighten him.
card.flavor: "It is not enough to have one sword. I would carry swords with my feet if I could still walk."

card.name: Bayushi Manora
card.text:
Bitter Lies • Samurai • Kensai
(Kensai may attach two One-Handed Weapons.)
card.flavor: "Sages say that there is a time under the Heavens to pick up a sword and a time to put down a sword. I say there is also a time to pick up two swords."

card.name: Shosuro Longji
card.text:
Ninja • Soul of Shosuro Aroru • Duelist
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists.(
Longji's Followers must be Ninja. Personalities cannot refuse a challenge from Longji unless they bow first. Your actions targeting Longji that create challenges are Unstoppable. (Other players cannot Interrupt Unstoppable actions.)
card.flavor: "Face me."

card.name: Shosuro Saigyo
card.text:
Ninja • Duelist
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists.)
After Saigyo enters play, lose 2 Honor.
Ninja Battle: A target enemy Personality challenges Saigyo. Give the winner +2F.
card.flavor: "A Lion samurai clings to Bushido. That is his strength. It is also his weakness."

card.name: Bayushi Junko
card.text:
Courtier • Intimidator • Soul of Bayushi Jou
Political Interrupt: If the action targets Junko and is another player's, he may choose to lose 2 Honor. If he did not choose this, negate the action.
Tireless Battle: Move Junko home.
card.flavor: "My friend... do you really want to do that?"

card.name: Shosuro Sakura
card.text:
Alchemist • Ninja • Poison Master • Seductress • Duelist • Loyal • Unique
Ninja Open, [BOW]: Your other target unbowed Ninja Personality challenges another player's target Personality. He may refuse; if he does, give him a -1F/-1C Poison token. Bow the loser.
card.flavor: "And it had been such a lovely party."

card.name: Bayushi Mifuyu
card.text:
Magistrate • Samurai
Battle: Give a target enemy Personality -3F.
card.flavor: "Our plan has risks," Nitoshi said, "but all things have risks. In the end, our magistrates will give the answer we most want to hear, and that will be that."

card.name: Soshi Rei
card.text:
Air • Shugenja
After an action from Rei's unit dishonors another player's Personality, his controller loses 1 Honor. After the first time each turn her own Spell bows Rei, straighten her.
card.flavor: "Well. Is that not interesting?"

card.name: Shosuro Orikasa
card.text:
Courtier • Samurai
Tireless Interrupt: If the action is yours and Political, straighten Orikasa after it resolves.
card.flavor: "It is like staging a play, really. Everyone sees the actors behind the characters, and a few see the playwrights behind the actors. Who sees the carpenters and seamstresses?

card.name: Daigotsu Atsushi - exp
card.text:
Samurai • Duelist • Experienced • Unique
After Atsushi enters play, lose 2 Honor. After Atsushi wins a duel, give him a +1F Infamy token.
Battle: Fear 3 with +1 strength for each of Atsushi's Infamy tokens.
card.flavor: "No, no... keep your blade drawn. It seems a good way to make things fair between us."

card.name: Daigotsu Hachiko
card.text:
Samurai • Duelist • Reserve
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists. You may Recruit a Reserve Personality, if they would be opposed, an an Absent Battle action.)
After Hachiko enters play, lose 1 Honor.
card.flavor: Not all those who serve the Spider Clan are soulless monsters. However, one would be hard pressed to find someone of another clan who cares to make the distinction.

card.name: Daigotsu Kendo
card.text:
Commander • Samurai • Shadowlands • Conqueror
(A Conqueror's unit doesn't bow after battle.)
card.flavor: "Promises were made to us, brothers, and to our lord Kanpeki. If the new Emperor does not adhere to these promises... there will be consequences."

card.name: Daigotsu Zenshi
card.text:
Nonhuman • Samurai • Shadowlands • Undead
After Zenshi enters play, lose 4 Honor.
Battle: Give each Undead card in Zenshi's army +1F.
card.flavor: His voice rumbled from his chest like thunder. "Not even death could stop me. What chance do you have, little man?"

card.name: Daigotsu Ryuko
card.text:
Fallen • Paragon • Samurai • Shadowlands • Destined
(Draw a card after you Recruit a Destined card.)
After Ryuko enters play, lose 1 Honor.
Battle, [BOW]: Melee 2 Attack.
card.flavor: She gazed at the mask and wondered if it was her destiny to become as inhuman as the visage she wore.

card.name: Daigotsu Hayigi
card.text:
Bog Hag • Infiltrator • Nonhuman • Shadowlands • Shugenja
Battle: Give a target enemy Personality a Force penalty equal to his own Personal Honor. If his Force is now zero, you may give him a -1F/-1C Poison token and lose 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "Even in these times, creatures like her have their uses."

card.name: Daigotsu Shaoru
card.text:
Samurai • Duelist
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists.)
Battle: Shaoru challenges a target enemy Personality. Each player must focus at least once in the duel. Give the winner +1F.
card.flavor:
"You, samurai... why do you carry three blades?"
"That which is perfected balanced for the duel is not ideal for war, my lord."

card.name: Goju Mitsuru
card.text:
Ninja • Shadowlands • Reserve
(You may Recruit a Reserve Personality, if they would be opposed, as an Absent Battle action.)
Mitsuru has +2F while opposing a Personality with no abilities.
card.flavor: "Some ask why I never trusted the Shadow Dragon and its ilk," Kanpeki grunted. "Look upon that thing and ask me that question."

card.name: The Twisted One
card.text:
Ninja • Shadowlands
After The Twisted One enters play, lose 1 Honor.
Ninja Battle: Copy a Battle ability that does not copy abilities on a target enemy Personality. Remove the ability from the target.
card.flavor: "What need have I of a life of my own? I can have anyone's like I wish."

card.name: Goju Kumoru
card.text:
Ninja • Shadowlands
Kumoru's Followers must be Ninja.
Ninja Open: Create a battlefield (not at any Province). Assign Kumoru to attack there and another player's target unbowed Personality to defend there. Fight a battle there. Battle resolution there will not destroy Personalities. Lose 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "His name is what? Is that a joke?" - Lao-she

card.name: Goju Yurishi - exp2
card.text:
Daimyo • Dragon Child • Ninja • Shadowlands • Experienced 2 • Unique
Ninja Battle: Bow a target unbowed enemy Personality. If he has 0 Force or no abilities, create a 2F/2C/0PH Ninja • Shadowlands Spider Clan Personality. Lose 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "Thank you for your gift, friend," he whispered. "Your identity helps remind me of my own."

card.name: Kokujin Gunjao
card.text:
Monk • Shadowlands • Duelist
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists.)
After Gunjao enters play, lose 2 Honor.
Battle: Fear 4. (Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 4 or lower Force).
card.flavor: "The great master's body is dead, but his spirit? Nothing save the death of the universe can end Kokujin's spirit."

card.name: Lao-she
card.text:
Monk • Kensai
(Kensai may attach two One-Handed Weapons.)
Home Battle: If Lao-she would be opposed, move him to the current battlefield. (Home actions may be taken from home.)
card.flavor: Regardless of what action the new Emperor takes with regard to the Spider, the fate of the monks that serve that clan is far less clear.

card.name: Naibu
card.text:
Commander • Goblin • Nonhuman • Shadowlands • Expendable
(Draw a card after your Expendable card dies.)
After Naibu enters play, lose 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "Tribe serve Chuda. Father's tribe serve Chuda. Chuda no power but magic. Time to serve new master, maybe?"

card.name: Air Dragon - exp3
card.text:
Air • Dragon • Nonhuman • Shugenja • Cavalry • Experienced 3 • Unique
Cannot attach Followers or Items. Cannot gain a Clan Alignment. Has -2HR while you control the Ring of Air. After a phase begins, straighten Air Dragon.
Air Battle: Negate Air Dragon's current Force penalties.
card.flavor: The essence of air is inconstant, ever-present, like a half-remembered whisper in the wind.

card.name: Ratling Raider
card.text:
Nonhuman • Ratling
After Ratling Raider enters play, create two 2F/2C/2PH Nonhuman • Ratling Personalities (at his location).
card.flavor: The nezumi race is virtually extinct, with only a few dozen here and there remaining in the mortal realm. Those few left behind often fall into unsavory practices to survive.

card.name: Earth Dragon - exp2
card.text:
Dragon • Earth • Nonhuman • Shugenja • Cavalry • Experienced 2 • Unique
Cannot attach Followers or Items. Cannot gain a Clan Alignment. Has -2HR while you control the Ring of Earth. Before the first time each turn another player's action moves or bows the Earth Dragon, negate it.
card.flavor: The essence of earth is resolute, inflexible, changing only by minute increments during mortal lifespans.

card.name: Enomoto
card.text:
Ronin • Shugenja • Void
Enomoto has +1F/+2C while he has a Spell.
card.flavor: "I am aged, yes, but communion with the Void has maintained my vitality. The universe embraces those who seek its truths."

card.name: Fire Dragon - exp3
card.text:
Dragon • Fire • Nonhuman • Shugenja • Cavalry • Experienced 3 • Unique
Cannot attach Followers or Items. Cannot gain a Clan Alignment except Phoenix Clan. Has -2HR while you control the Ring of Fire.
Fire Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 7 Attack.
card.flavor: The essence of fire is passion and anger, always consuming but ever-hungry.

card.name: Fushiki no Oni
card.text:
Fire • Nonhuman • Oni • Shadowlands
After Fushiki enters play, lose 4 Honor.
Fire Battle: Destroy a target Fortification at this battlefield with Gold Cost lower than Fushiki's Force. Give Fushiki a +1F token.
card.flavor: The corruption of the Shadowlands Taint is so pervasive that the elements themselves can be subverted, becoming a host for demons.

card.name: Seasoned Ronin
card.text:
Ronin • Samurai
Battle: Give each Ronin Follower and Ronin Personality in Seasoned Ronin's army +1F.
card.flavor: "I have been involved in three battles and four duels. I have served six different lords, and all will speak well of me if you choose to ask them. I am a man without a master, but I am not a man without pride or honor. If you choose to have me serve you, my lord, you will not regret it."

card.name: Tonbo Jairyu
card.text:
Dragonfly Clan • Shugenja • Water • Naval
(This Personality is Unaligned.)
Invest [PAY 5]: Give Jairyu a +1F/+1C token and the permanent ability, "Water Battle: Move home a target defending Personality."
card.flavor: The Dragonfly are one of the smaller Minor Clans in Rokugan. They serve the Dragon, often acting as intermediaries with other clans.

card.name: Kung-an
card.text:
Shugenja • Void
Open, [PAY 3]: Put a Ring from your hand into play; while it remains in play, it does not count towards an Enlightenment Victory. After your next turn begins, put it into your hand.
card.flavor: "The elements speak to me more purely than any clan shugenja. I hear their words without the bias of oaths or loyalties."

card.name: Moto Daigoro
card.text:
Nonhuman • Samurai • Shadowlands • Undead • Cavalry
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to the battle.)
After Daigoro enters play, lose 4 Honor.
Battle: Fear 4.
card.flavor: Legions of the Moto once rode within the Shadowlands. Their shame has been purged, but there are some remnants.

card.name: Ninja Shapeshifter
card.text:
Ninja
Ninja Shapeshifter's Followers must be Ninja.
Ninja Battle/Open: Ninja Shapeshifter copies a target Personality's Force, Chi, Personal Honor, or ability that does not copy abilities.
card.flavor: There are those whose souls have been lost to the Nothing, but who serve neither Goju nor Ninube.

card.name: Moto Aikenro
card.text:
Samurai
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 3 Attack. Straighten Aikenro if you have moved your Cavalry Personality into Aikenro's battlefield this turn.
card.flavor: "The Tsuruchi think themselves master of the bow. I would like to try my hand against one of them one day."

card.name: Otomo Terumoto
card.text:
Courtier • Samurai • Soul of Otomo Taneji
After Terumoto enters play, gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: Few families have the great honor of serving the Emperor directly, with no oath of fealty to any clan. First among them are the Otomo, stewards of the political power or the Emerald Throne. Terumoto leads in his brother's place, for his elder brother's scandal was to marry into the Susumu family.

card.name: Young Battlecat
card.text:
Cat • Nonhuman • Expendable
(Draw a card after your Expendable card dies.)
card.flavor: "Those with potential must be found early, so they may be trained in using their gifts." - Matsu Chizuki

card.name: Tarui
card.text:
Ronin • Samurai • Duelist
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists.)
card.flavor: "It matters little how old you are, how unpleasant you are. If you are skilled enough with a blade, then someone will pay you to use it. You just have to decide if it is worth it to do what they ask."

card.name: Void Dragon - exp3
card.text:
Dragon • Nonhuman • Shugenja • Void • Cavalry • Experienced 3 • Unique
Cannot attach Followers or Items. Cannot gain a Clan Alignment. Has -2HR while you control the Ring of the Void. After the Void Dragon's army destroys any units or Province in a battle resolution, the enemy leader discards two cards from his hand.
card.flavor: The essence of the Void is everything but nothing.

card.name: Voitagi
card.text:
Samurai • Shadowlands • Soul of Uragirimono • Undead
After Voitagi enters play, lose 3 Honor.
Battle: Fear 3 (Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 3 or lower Force).
card.flavor: "Why have I wakened again? What purpose am I meant to fulfill before I can embrace oblivion forever?"

card.name: Water Dragon - exp3
card.text:
Dragon • Nonhuman • Shugenja • Water • Cavalry • Experienced 3 • Unique
Cannot attach Followers or Items. Cannot gain a Clan Alignment. Has -2HR while you control the Ring of Water.
Water Tireless Open: Water Dragon copies another target Personality's keyword, trait, or ability that does not copy abilities.
card.flavor: The essence of water is tumult, ever-changing. It is the calmed sea that rages and is calmed again.

card.name: Zaiko
card.text:
Cat • Nonhuman • Cavalry
Interrupt: After this Follower enters play, search your discard pile, then deck, for a Young Battlecat, show it, and put it in your hand.
Battle, [BOW]: Melee 2 Attack, with +1 strength if the target is an Infantry Follower.
card.flavor: "Well done, my friend." - Matsu Chizuki

card.name: Moto Taigo, Shogun
card.text:
Commander • Imperial • Samurai • Cavalry • Conqueror • Experienced 2 • Tactician • Unique
Battle: Fear equal to your target Follower's Force, with +1 strength if the Fear targets an enemy Infantry card.
card.flavor: In all places the Shogun traveled, he spoke reverently of his father's deeds and actions. In his wake, others began to think differently of the name Chagatai.

card.name: Moto Zaitsuta
card.text:
Chieftain • Samurai • Soul of Moto Zhijuan • Cavalry
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to the battle.)
card.flavor: "My grandmother protected the Empire from threats from the west. Now I protect the west from threats. Fate is strange."

card.name: Shinjo Jalendu
card.text:
Samurai • Scout • Soul of Shinjo Jalair • Cavalry
Interrupt: After your Battle action Recruits your Personality, take an additional action.
card.flavor: "I am not a gaijin. I am a true samurai, like every other follower of Shinjo-kami."

card.name: Moto Yao-tsu
card.text:
Commander • Samurai • Soul of Moto Qu Yuan • Cavalry
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to the battle.)
After an action resolves, straighten each unit it moved into Yao-tsu's army.
card.flavor: "Explain it to me again, Phoenix. Explain how my grandfather's blood makes me corrupted."

card.name: Moto Paikao
card.text: Commander • Samurai Battle: Discard a card to give a target enemy Follower or Personality a Force penalty equal to the card's Focus Value.
card.flavor: "There is nothing so wondrous as the look in an enemy's eyes when he realizes that your lack of a horse will not save him."

card.name: Shinjo Hamura
card.text:
Magistrate • Samurai
Battle: Fear 3 that may target a dishonorable Personality with Followers. If this bowed a dishonorable Personality, you may rehonor him to gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "Dishonor is a weakness, and a dishonorable leader infects his entire unit."

card.name: Shinjo Jao-shen
card.text:
Magistrate • Samurai • Cavalry • Loyal
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to the battle. Loyal Personalities will not join other Clans.)
Political Open, [BOW]: Target a Personality. After the next time this turn he attacks you, dishonor him.
card.flavor: "Tselu-sama, here is another one. The brothers may not want bloodshed, but sooner or later some brash fool will draw steel."

card.name: Shinjo Tae-hyun - exp
card.text:
Magistrate • Samurai • Cavalry • Experienced • Unique
Other players' effects will not move dishonorable Personalities to oppose your Magistrates.
Battle: Dishonor a target enemy Personality. You may take an additional action printed on your Magistrate or a card in his unit.
card.flavor: "Your blade is your second weapon. Your mind must be your first."

card.name: Utaku Kazue
card.text:
Battle Maiden • Samurai • Cavalry
Battle: Give a target enemy Follower or Personality a Force penalty equal to Kazue's Personal Honor. Gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "I do not wish to quarrel with priests, but I have a reminder for the leaders of the Phoenix; death and rebirth come to all, warrior and priest alike."

card.name: Fearless Medium Infantry
card.text:
Negate Fear effects targeting this Follower.
Interrupt: If the action is yours, straighten this Follower after it resolves.
card.flavor: "Bushido creates heroes out of even the sorriest of men." - Akodo Kenaro

card.name: Shinjo Zhi-tae
card.text:
Commander • Samurai • Soul of Shinjo Ji-tae • Cavalry
Battle: Move home your target Personality.
card.flavor: "He is a splendid warrior from a clan of splendid warriors. I am sure his aunt is very proud of him." - Moto Naleesh

card.name: Shinjo Nobunaga
card.text:
Soul of Shinjo Xushen • Cavalry
During an Attack Phase, if Nobunaga has not moved that phase, he has +1F and his printed Ranged Attack has +1 strength.
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 3 Attack.
card.flavor: "I can only hope that on the battlefield, he causes the same amount of horror in the Empire's enemies as he inspires in me." - Doji Dainagon

card.name: Utaku Sakiko
card.text:
Battle Maiden • Samurai • Cavalry • Destined • Reserve
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to the battle. Draw a card after you Recruit a Destined card. You may Recruit a Reserve Personality, if they would be opposed, as an Absent Battle action.)
card.flavor: "We fight together, my friend, as always. But I fear the fighting will grow worse instead of better. Dark times are ahead."

card.name: Ratling Archers
card.text:
Nonhuman • Pack • Ratling
This Follower has +2F while attached to a Ratling.
Battle: Ranged 2 Attack.
card.flavor: "Yes, but they work quite cheaply." - Yoritomo Yusuke

card.name: Elite Spearmen
card.text: Battle: Ranged 2 Attack (Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 2 or lower Force).
card.flavor: "Personally, I appreciate being able to keep my enemy at arm's length as I kill them." - Bayushi Nieko

card.name: Ashigaru Archers
card.text:
Ashigaru
After this Follower enters play from your hand, you may draw an additional card when this turn ends.
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 2 Attack.
card.flavor: "Semi-skilled, but they certainly have their uses." - Tsuruchi Jinrai

card.name: Fearless Heavy Infantry
card.text:
Negate Fear effects targeting this Follower.
Interrupt: If the action is yours, straighten this Follower after it resolves.
card.flavor: "Fortresses of stone are wonderful things, but on the battlefield you need warriors with fortress-hearts." - Kaiu Watsuki

card.name: Band of Brothers
card.text:
Ronin
After this Follower enters play, target one or two of your Personalities. Create and attach a 1F Ronin Follower to each of them.
card.flavor: "Some ronin form bonds of loyalty to each other; I find them superior in quality to those loyal only to themselves." - Akodo Dairuko

card.name: Camel Mounts
card.text:
Camel • Nonhuman • Cavalry
Will only attach to a Human. This Personality has Cavalry.
Home Battle: Move this unit to the current battlefield if it would be opposed there.
card.flavor: "You must be joking." - Utaku Sakiko

card.name: Tselu Sensei
card.text:
Unicorn Clan
Open, [BOW]: Bow your target unbowed Magistrate. Rehonor and bow another player's target dishonorable Personality. Gain Honor equal to the second target's Personal Honor if his controller has more Honor than you.

(-1 Province Strength)
card.flavor: "The Unicorn have few heroes greater than the first Ivory Champion, the savior of the Colonies." - Seppun Ritisharu

card.name: The Unquiet Moto
card.text:
Nonhuman • Shadowlands • Undead • Cavalry
After this Follower enters play, lose 4 Honor.
Battle: Ranged 3 Attack.
card.flavor: "We cannot use them where our friends in the Unicorn can see them, but they are too good not to use." - Daigotsu Ryuko

card.name: Diplomatic Apprentice
card.text: Crane Clan and Scorpion Clan players Equip this Follower for 2 less Gold. Before your Political action bows this Personality, you may bow this Follower instead, which fulfills the action's cost and conditions of bowing.
card.flavor: "It is the duty of every courtier to help train the next generation of courtiers." - Kakita Ikura

card.name: Fearless Light Cavalry
card.text:
Cavalry
Negate Fear effects targeting this Follower.
Interrupt: If the action is yours, straighten this Follower after it resolves.
card.flavor: "Discipline and training create legendary warriors." - Moto Paiko

card.name: Goblin Chuckers
card.text:
Goblin • Nonhuman • Shadowlands
After this Follower enters play, lose 2 Honor.
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 2 Attack (Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 2 or lower Force).
card.flavor: "Yeeeaaaaaah!"

card.name: Amoral Wave Man
card.text:
Mercenary • Ronin
Battle, [BOW]: Melee 3 Attack.
Tireless Battle, [PAY 3]: Straighten this Follower.
card.flavor: "They are unfortunate souls. It is true we need money to live, but our price should not define us." - Enomoto

card.name: Gunso
card.text:
Gunso
All other Followers in this unit have +1F. After this Follower is destroyed, give -1F to all Followers in its former unit.
card.flavor: "We are stretched thin in the Colonies, but it's the lack of good leaders that hurts us the most." - Yoritomo Hiromi

card.name: Hidden Reserves
card.text:
Scout
Battle, [PAY *]: If this Follower is in your hand, target your Personality at any location. If he would be opposed, move him to the current battlefield and Equip this Follower to him.
card.flavor: "The Lion think they know the value of reinforcements. We shall see if they know enough." - Bayushi Nitoshi

card.name: Iron Defenders
card.text: If this Personality is ever attacking, destroy this Follower.
card.flavor: "With the ascension of Iweko II, officers of the Imperial Legions sought to heal the rifts within their ranks. Divisions of ideologies remained, but most set these differences aside in favor of renewed unity."

card.name: Karo
card.text: Battle, [BOW], [PAY *]: Destroy this Follower. Search your Fate deck for a non-Unique Follower not named Karo. Equip it for 3 less Gold.
card.flavor: "Our opposition to the Spider is relentless. In the past we were content to ignore court life. Now we must use the resources developed for war in support of our courtiers." - Hida Kisada

card.name: Lookout
card.text:
Ninja
Will only attach to a Ninja.
Ninja Interrupt: A single Ranged Attack from the action may target an otherwise legal card in the Defender's home. Destroy this Follower.
card.flavor: "I hate trusting in others, but sometimes it must be done." - Shosuro Longii

card.name: Mounted Support
card.text:
Cavalry
This Personality has Conqueror (A Conqueror's unit doesn't bow after battle.)
card.flavor: "This conflict with the Phoenix is maddening. Why can't they stay in their temples and leave running the Empire to those of us who really live in it?" - Shinjo Sujikaro

card.name: Shugenja Aide
card.text:
Shugenja
This Personality, if he is a Shugenja, has +1C while actions on your Kihos and Spells are resolving.
card.flavor: "So much activity, so many reports. It is a relief to know that my sacred writings, at least, are being well cared for." - Isawa Tsumaro

card.name: A Test of Courage
card.text: Interrupt: The action will not move your target Personality (at this battlefield). You may not use his abilities or target him with actions (this turn).
card.flavor: "Sunrise to sunset, keep death foremost in your mind at all times." - Akodo's Leadership

card.name: An Act of Disdain
card.text: Political Open: Destroy your target unbowed Courtier Personality with 3 or more Personal Honor. After each time (this turn) another player's target Personality assigns or an action on a card in his unit resolves, dishonor him and gain 3 Honor.
card.flavor: The Rokugani do not forget grudges, not even after generations.

card.name: Ninja Guards
card.text:
Guard • Ninja
Will only attach to a Ninja.
This Follower has a Force bonus equal to its Personality's printed Force.
card.flavor: "Our orders are clear. Allow none of the Lion to escape."

card.name: Test of Sincerity
card.text: Political Open: Target another player's Human Personality. His controller may have him commit seppuku (rehonor, then destroy him). If he chose this, he gains 4 Honor. If he did not choose this, dishonor the Personality, and his controller loses 2 Honor.
card.flavor: There is an ancient story of the Scorpion, when one commanded his yojimbo to kill him to show the clan's sincerity. The yojimbo did so without hesitation, then took his own life.

card.name: Fearless Light Infantry
card.text:
Negate Fear effects targeting this Follower.
Interrupt: If the action is yours, straighten this Follower after it resolves.
card.flavor: "The best infantry units money can buy." - Yoritomo Matsuo

card.name: Fearless Medium Cavalry
card.text:
Cavalry
Negate Fear effects targeting this Follower.
Interrupt: If the action is yours, straighten this Follower after it resolves.
card.flavor: "Discipline, mobility, power. So treasured in your army, and so annoying in your enemy's" - Akodo Dairuko

card.name: Enslaved Djinn
card.text:
Djinn • Fire • Nonhuman • Spirit
After this Follower enters play, search your discard pile, then deck, for another Enslaved Djinn. Show it. Put it into your hand.
card.flavor: "No good can come from trafficking with gaijin spirits." - Asako Tsunefusa

card.name: A Samurai's Soul
card.text:
One-Handed • Sword • Weapon
(A Personality can only have one Weapon.)
card.flavor: "The katana is sacred to a samurai. It is believed that his soul is contained within the blade. As the sword is passed from generation to generation, imagine how many souls it must accumulate." - Tsi Soshu, Daimyo of the Oriole

card.name: Ouma-Jirushi
card.text:
Standard
Fear effects targeting cards in this unit have -1 strength. Ranged Attacks targeting cards in this unit have +1 strength. While opposed, this Personality has +1PH and his Followers have +1F.
card.flavor: The samurai carrying the army's own standard has the most dangerous position on the battlefield. For many, it is a death sentence, yet so many still dream of the honor.

card.name: Eternal Armor
card.text:
Armor
(A Personality can only have one Armor.)
After the first time each turn another player's Battle action targets this Personality, that player may discard a card; if he does not, negate the action.
card.flavor: "He couldn't have fought in that battle! His armor is spotless!"

card.name: Polvara Cache
card.text:
Gaijin
Open: Destroy a target Holding controlled by a player with four or more Holdings in play. Lose 2 Honor. Remove this Item from the game.
card.flavor: What the Rokugani call "Gaijin Pepper" is strictly forbidden, since the time of Hantei the 8th.

card.name: Fubatsu Blade
card.text:
One-Handed • Sword • Weapon
(A Personality can only have one Weapon.)
card.flavor: "It is true that the katana houses its wielder's soul. But do not forget, the swordsmith has offered a piece of himself to the blade as well." - Hida Fubatsu

card.name: Ichiro's Yumi
card.text:
Bow • Two-Handed • Weapon
May only attach to a Samurai.
Battle, [BOW]: Give a target enemy Follower or Personality -3F. You may then make a Ranged 0 Attack against that card if it is a legal target.
card.flavor: The Yumi of the last true Wasp stings just as sure as now as it did then.

card.name: Red Hunger's Fang
card.text:
Ninja • One-Handed • Weapon
After this Item enters play, lose 3 Honor.
Ninja Battle, [BOW]: Give a target enemy Personality a -1F/-1C Poison token.
card.flavor: "It came from the largest snake I'd ever seen. It was big enough to eat a tower. How many more of those hide in the western wastes?" - Tsuruchi Kosoko

card.name: Lacquered Armor
card.text:
Armor
Ranged Attacks targeting cards in this unit have -2 strength.
Tireless Battle: Move this Personality home. (Tireless action may be taken even while bowed.)
card.flavor: Unlike the sword, armor is rarely passed down through the generations. Instead, new armor is forged for every samurai.

card.name: Lost Blade of the Maharaja
card.text:
Gaijin • Sword • Two-Handed • Weapon
Battle, [BOW]: Bow a target Personality with Force equal to or lower than this Personality's.
card.flavor: "You know... sometimes I wonder whatever happened to this Mah... Marah... Mararanajad anyway." - Hiruma Maiko

card.name: Wooden Nunchaku
card.text:
One-Handed • Peasant • Courage • Weapon
After this Item attaches, dishonor this Personality.
Battle, [BOW]: Give a target enemy Follower or Personality -2F.
card.flavor: Inspired by the rice thresher used by farmers, nunchaku are considered by samurai to be good only for training reflexes, hand movements, and standing balance. Most would never lower themselves by using a training weapon in a true fight.

card.name: Ominous Armor
card.text:
Armor
(A Personality can only have one Armor.)
Before another player's card destroys this Personality, destroy this Item instead.
card.flavor: "Yes, it is a shame. It was a truly glorious, intimidating suit of armor. Even so, better it than me." - Yogo Nobukai

card.name: Farmer's Kama
card.text:
One-Handed • Peasant • Expendable • Weapon
(Draw a card after your Expendable card is destroyed.)
This Item has +1F while this Personality is a Kensai.
Battle: Negate this Personality's current Force penalties.
card.flavor: Designed for farming, not fighting... although it is adequate for either purpose.

card.name: Bisento
card.text:
Polearm • Two-Handed • Weapon
Battle, [BOW]: Bow a target enemy card. Destroy it if it is a One-Handed Weapon.
card.flavor: "Such unevenly-weighted, disgraceful, ghastly weapons. They suit the Spider monks nicely." - Doji Dainagon

card.name: Tachi
card.text:
Sword • Two-Handed • Weapon
Negate this Personality's Force and Chi bonuses (Modifiers from Items are not bonuses.)
card.flavor: A sword is not a katana unless it is made with folded steel, "tamahagane." Lesser two-handed swords are called "tachi." Of course, "lesser sword" is a relative term.

card.name: Throwing Knives
card.text:
Knife • One-Handed • Weapon
(A Personality can only have one Weapon.)
Battle: Ranged Attack equal to this Personality's Force. Destroy this Item.
card.flavor:
"What use are these against an armored man?"
The sensei replied: "Even helmets have openings for the eyes, my student."

card.name: Tiger Claw
card.text:
Ninja • One-Handed • Weapon
Ninja Battle, [BOW]: Melee 3 Attack (Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 3 or lower Force).
card.flavor: "That samurai do not seek natural advantages, even going so far as to eschew them, is why their Empire is doomed to fall." - Kokujin Dairu

card.name: Summon Water Kami
card.text: Water Battle: You may bow this Shugenja. If he bowed or if he is Water, negate other players' effects that move units to or from this battlefield. Destroy this Spell.
card.flavor: Some who had raised their banner for one heir or the other began to lose sight of the Empire they were serving.

card.name: Versatile Blade
card.text:
One-Handed • Sword • Weapon
Battle: Discard a card to straighten this Personality.
Home Battle: If this Personality would be opposed, discard a card to move him to the current battlefield.
card.flavor: "The spear, the bow, the staff. Each offers something the others don't. But the sword is eternal." - Mirumoto's Niten

card.name: Ring of Air
card.text:
Air • Unique
Play after you resolve two or more Favor actions in one turn. You may discard this Ring from your hand to use its ability without cost.
Air Repeatable Battle/Open, [BOW]: Straighten your target Personality or attachment.
card.flavor: Ephemeral.

card.name: Ring of Earth
card.text:
Earth • Unique
Play after a battle resolves at your Province, if it was not destroyed and any enemy units were ever at its battlefield. You may discard this Ring from your hand to use its ability without cost.
Earth Repeatable Interrupt, [BOW]: The Battle action cannot move Personalities.
card.flavor: Resolute.

card.name: Ring of Fire
card.text:
Fire • Unique
Play after you win a duel during a battle, if your Personality did not enter the duel with higher Chi than the other. You may discard this Ring from your hand to use its ability without cost.
Fire Battle, [BOW]: Target an enemy card without attachments. After this battle resolves, if you lost the battle, destroy the target.
card.flavor: Inspirational.

card.name: Ring of the Void
card.text:
Void • Unique
You may discard this Ring from your hand to use its Void ability without cost.
Limited: Play if you have two or fewer Rings in play. Discard your hand.
Void Limited, [BOW]: Draw a card. If you now have more cards in your hand than any other player, discard a card.
card.flavor: Contradictory.

card.name: Ring of Water
card.text:
Water • Unique
Play after a battle resolves in which you played a Terrain, destroyed a Terrain, and destroyed any cards or Provinces during resolution. You may discard this Ring from your hand to use its ability without cost.
Water Absent Repeatable Battle, [BOW]: Move your target Personality home or, if he would be opposed, move your target Personality at any location to the current battlefield.
card.flavor: Tempestuous.

card.name: Aroru Sensei
card.text:
Scorpion Clan
Iaijutsu actions you take are Ninja instead. Reduce your Honor losses from your Ninja cards by 2.
Interrupt, [BOW]: After another player refuses a challenge or loses a duel from an action that targeted his Personality and your Ninja, give a -1F/-1C Poison token to his Personality.

(-1 Gold Production, -1 Family Honor)
card.flavor: "Nature provides all that we require."

card.name: Taitaken Sensei
card.text:
Crab • Lion • Mantis • Spider • Unicorn
Battle, [BOW]: Bow your target unbowed Follower or Weapon. Melee Attack with strength equal to its Force (An Item's Force is its Force Modifier).

(-1 Province Strength, -1 Family Honor)
card.flavor: "Seppun Taitaken is a great man, descended from a hero of the Clan War. His line has served the Hantei, the Toturi, and now the Iweko. To be his student is a great honor." - Iweko Setai

card.name: Chuuna Sensei
card.text:
Mantis Clan
Your Stronghold has no abilities.
Limited, [BOW]: Target your unbowed Thunder Personality. Bow a target card in a unit; the card's attachments, if any, must be bowed. If this bowed a Personality, bow your Thunder Personality.
card.flavor: "The Thunder Dragon is our link to the power of the Heavens and the mortal realm. Give it your reverence, and receive power undreamt of."

card.name: Hakuseki Sensei
card.text:
Crane Clan
Your Stronghold has no abilities. Your Magistrates have +1F while opposing any dishonorable Personalities. After each time your Battle action bows or destroys a dishonorable Personality, gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "Hakuseki-sama is lost to us, but we honor her by remembering her teachings in the dojo that now bears her name." - Kakita Ujirou

card.name: Daigo Sensei
card.text:
Crab Clan
You may not bring Shadowlands cards into play.
Interrupt, [BOW]: If the action targeted your Shugenja with an attached Earth Spell, the action's player discards a card after it resolves.

(-1 Province Strength, -1 Family Honor)
card.flavor: "Any student of mine who ever embraces the darkness, for any reason, I will hunt and kill myself."

card.name: Dijuro Sensei
card.text:
Crane • Dragon • Phoenix • Scorpion
Your non-Fortification Holdings enter play for 1 more Gold. Each Province you assigned a Personality to defend or with a Cavalry unit attacking it has +1 strength for each Fortification attached to it, and has a maximum strength equal to its printed strength +4.
card.flavor: "Act in haste and you will fail. Patience wins the day. Patience is strength."

card.name: Kiyoteru Sensei
card.text:
All Clans
Your Stronghold has no abilities. When Recruiting Dragons, you may Proclaim them, and may compare their Honor Requirement to the total Force of your non-Shadowlands Personalities instead of to your Honor.
card.flavor: "You wish to learn more of the great dragons, that is true. The reasons you give are lies. But lies will not matter. I will teach you."

card.name: Sahara Sensei
card.text:
Spider Clan
Reduce your Honor losses from your Duelists by 2.
Interrupt, [BOW]: If the action creates a duel, after your Personality wins, give him "Battle: Fear equal to this Personality's Force."

(-1 Province Strength)
card.flavor: "The banner you fly, the burdens you bear... all that matters is what actions you take. Defend yourself."

card.name: Seijuro Sensei
card.text:
Lion Clan
Interrupt, [BOW]: If the action is Battle and creates a duel, after your Personality wins it, give him a Force bonus equal to his Personal Honor.

(-1 Province Strength)
card.flavor: "The great Matsu Seijuro was lost to us years ago, but we are fortunate that his son continues to teach his brilliant methods to a new generation." - Akodo Dairuko

card.name: Mahatsu Sensei
card.text:
All Clans
Limited, [BOW]: Bow your Stronghold to search your discard pile and Fate deck for a Ring, show it, and put it in your hand. Discard a card.

(-1 Gold Production)
card.flavor: "Balance is the essence of all that is. All success, all knowledge, all victory... it comes from balance."

card.name: Chukage Sensei
card.text:
Phoenix Clan
You Equip non-Water Spells for 1 more Gold. After your Water card moves a Personality, give your target Water Shugenja +1F. You may Equip Water Spells to your unbowed opposed Shugenja as a Battle action.
card.flavor: "I met a challenge that I could not overcome because I was not prepared. Let me help you avoid such a fate."

card.name: Yodo Sensei
card.text:
Dragon Clan
Your Stronghold has no abilities.
After your action dishonors another player's Personality, gain 1 Honor.

(+2 Province Strength)
card.flavor: "Long has my family served the Dragon, and many are our secrets. For my lord, I will teach these secrets to you. Do not disappoint me."

card.name: Seppun's Blessed Blade
card.text:
Sword • Two-Handed • Weapon
(A Personality can only have one Weapon.)
This Item's Force modifier equals this Personality's Personal Honor.
card.flavor: "It is not enough that a samurai's honor be his guide, his armor, his greatest protector. It must also be these things for his lord." - Seppun Teshan

card.name: Conflagration
card.text:
If this Shugenja is Fire, Ranged Attacks from actions in this unit have +1 strength.
Fire Battle, [BOW]: Give this Shugenja +3F.
card.flavor: "If the Isawa can produce this manner of magic as a celebratory display for our new Emperor," Kisada mused, "think of what a useful application might bring."

card.name: Divide Into Ash
card.text:
This Shugenja has +2F.
Earth Jade Battle, [BOW]: Melee Attack equal to this Shugenja's Chi, +1 if he is Earth, +1 if the target is Shadowlands.
card.flavor: "The blood of a gaijin does not just make one weak to dark magic," Misora said darkly, "but your very essence is more fragile. I will show you."

card.name: Earth's Embrace
card.text:
Attaches to an Earth Shugenja for 2 less Gold.
Earth Battle, [BOW]: Give each of your Shugenja in this army +1F.
card.flavor: "Their damnable priests!" the Moto commander said, slamming his fist down. "For pacifists, they are certainly efficient at causing me losses without calling down death and fire."

card.name: Reach Across the World
card.text: Air Battle/Open: Target two of your Shugenja. Transfer one or more attachments from one to the other. If the caster is Air, you may take an additional action.
card.flavor: "Yoritomo Harumi!" the Phoenix exclaimed. "What is the meaning of this?"

card.name: Mark of Heaven's Favor
card.text:
A Holding may only be targeted by one Mark of Heaven's Favor per game.
Air Open, [BOW]: Permanently increase a positive numeral on a target Holding by one (2 is a numeral, two is not). Remove this Spell from the game.
card.flavor: True priests of the kami understand that every prayer is a sacred pact, whether it blesses crops or destroys armies. Nothing can be taken for granted.

card.name: Frozen Tomb
card.text:
This Shugenja has +1F, or +2F if he is Water.
Water Engage, [BOW]: Negate a target Personality's next movement. After each time his controller resolves an action that targeted him or came from a card in his unit, give him -2F.
card.flavor: "Struggle against the cold," Nergui said. "Struggle against it as uselessly as you might struggle against your own demise."

card.name: Walking with the Earth
card.text:
Courage
Earth Open: If you don't have a Ring in play, target three Personalities controlled by the active player. He must declare an attack this turn and assign at least one of them, if able.
Earth Open: Give your Provinces +2 strength for each Ring you control (this turn).
card.flavor: "It seems the monk was not jesting when he said we cannot pass."

card.name: Favor of the Air Spirits
card.text: Air Interrupt, [BOW]: You may choose new targets of any of the action's Melee or Ranged Attacks, and if this Shugenja is Air, those targets may be in the army of the player taking the action.
card.flavor: To a Crane, all is art - prayers to the spirits of air are little more than sacred steps and movement for their amusement.

card.name: Hitomi's Devotion
card.text:
Earth
Battle resolution will not destroy cards in this unit while defending and, if this Shugenja is Earth, while attacking.
card.flavor: "Many shrink from the blessings of Lady Hitomi," Seiken said. "Some wonder if it is blasphemy. I suppose there's little sense dealing with such fools."

card.name: Kiyoshi's Wrath
card.text: Earth Battle, [BOW]: Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality with 4 or lower Force.
card.flavor: The alliance between the Crab and Scorpion has benefited both clans. For their part, some younger Yogo students have embraced the power and restrained anger of their Kuni peers.

card.name: See the Many Faces
card.text:
Expendable
You may Equip this Spell from your discard pile to a Void or Magistrate Shugenja.
Open, [BOW]: Target a Personality. You suspect him of the taint. He has Shadowlands while you are taking actions (this turn).
card.flavor: To see beyond what is, what might be, and what was: the curse and gift of those who can commune with the endless Void.

card.name: Thunderer's Embrace
card.text: Thunder Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 3 Attack. Bow the target if it is still in play and this Shugenja is Thunder. Destroy this Spell.
card.flavor: Some think the devastation of lightning is the streak of fire from the sky. Those who survive and endure the crack of thunder against their body know better.

card.name: Pull of the Tides
card.text: Water Battle, [BOW]: Target your Personality, and another of your Personalities at a different location. Switch their locations. Straighten their units as they move.
card.flavor: "I never got many chances to commune with the water spirits in the Dragon mountains," the Tamori said, smiling. "But I should probably let this man go on his way."

card.name: The Thunder Resounds
card.text: Thunder Battle: Target a Spell at this battlefield or a Thunder Spell at any location. This Spell copies an ability from the target that does not itself copy abilities (this turn).
card.flavor: "Can you feel it?" Chuuna whispered to her students. "Can you feel the power of two realms leaping to your fingertips?"

card.name: Sailor's Warning
card.text: Thunder Battle, [BOW]: Target your Personality. Ranged Attack with strength equal to his Chi. Destroy this Spell.
card.flavor: "There are holdouts, of course," Hiromi said. "Some will not accept the new order, and I find it may be my duty in the Colonies to bring such things to an end."

card.name: Steal the Candle's Flame
card.text:
Fire Interrupt, [BOW]: Give a Melee or Ranged Attack +2 strength.
Fire Battle: Ranged 0 Attack.
card.flavor: The minds shattered by P'an Ku were not all put to rest by the Ivory Champion and the Imperial Legion. Some still wander, fomenting chaos and pain for their own ends.

card.name: Armor of the Emperor
card.text:
Earth • Armor • Courage
(A Personality can only have one Armor.)
Before this Spell is destroyed, give it Expendable if this Shugenja is Earth.
This Shugenja has +3F during the Combat Segment (before battle resolution).
card.flavor: The Kuni raised his hand and spoke a single word: "No."

card.name: Thunder Dragon's Child
card.text:
Attaches to a Thunder Shugenja for 1 less Gold.
Thunder Open, [BOW]: Give this Shugenja +2F and Conqueror.
card.flavor: "If you are just and the fire of the hero burns in your heart, the great Thunder Dragon will usher you forward and through any foe."

card.name: Heart Thunder
card.text: Thunder Battle, [BOW]: Fear 2 (Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 2 or lower Force). After this bows the target, give this Personality +1F, or +2F if he is Thunder.
card.flavor: "Enough!" Ikako screamed, bringing her hands together. Her essence and the power of the holy place thundered outward, stunning and awing the offenders.

card.name: Typhoon Surge
card.text: Water Battle: Move a target Personality at any location to the current battlefield. Straighten his unit if you do not control him. Destroy this Spell.
card.flavor: "Iuchi water magic is interesting but primitive," the Phoenix said sadly. "You will, perhaps, learn from this."

card.name: A Warrior's Brutality
card.text: Battle: Give your target opposed Personality +3F.
card.flavor: No matter how noble, or graceful, or honorable, in the end a samurai is just a killer. He is a slayer of men. Every thought, every breath, every waking moment is devoted to the cause of killing and dying. The duty of a samurai is not only to attend to the needs of his lord... it is to make of himself a blade for the hands of his master.

card.name: Accessible Terrain
card.text:
Terrain
The Attacker and Defender each have the abiity "Absent Repeatable Battle: Move your target Personality at any location to this battlefield."
Absent Battle: Destroy a Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play.
card.flavor: "No army has ever benefitted from prolonged warfare." - Sun Tao

card.name: Alliance Threatened
card.text:
This ability has Absent if it targets a Cavalry card or if you ever had presence at this battlefield. (Absent actions may be taken without presence.)
Battle: Give a target enemy Follower or Personality -3F.
card.flavor: "You assured me your scouts cleared that field! Are you incompetent, or are they?"

card.name: Spinning the Web
card.text: Ninja Battle: Give a target enemy Personality a -1F/-1C Poison token. Straighten your Sensei; you may use its abilities again this turn. You may target and bow your unbowed Ninja to give the Personalty an additional -1F/-1C Poison token after each time your Ninja action resolves that targeted him, not including this one. Lose 2 Honor.
card.flavor: Every choice he made was already made for him. From the moment the ambush began, his fate was predetermined.

card.name: A Lion's Roar
card.text: Battle: Bow your target unbowed Personality with 3 or more Personal Honor. Ranged Attack with strength equal to his Personal Honor, plus 2 if he is a Tactician.
card.flavor: The Lion believe that honorable men will succeed where dishonorable men stumble.

card.name: Assassin's Strike
card.text: Assassin Dark Virtue Battle: Target your unbowed Samurai. Destroy a target enemy bowed card.
card.flavor: "Every moment you are not within your estate, you are in danger. And sometimes even this is not a certainty." - Mirumoto's Niten

card.name: Absolution
card.text:
Kharmic
Interrupt: Negate an Event's effects.
card.flavor: The judgement of the heavens is often harsh and unrelenting. Yet for the truly willing, absolution can be easily attained.

card.name: Directing the Battle
card.text: Battle, [PAY 4]: If there are any enemy units at this battlefield, search your Fate deck for a non-Unique Battle Strategy. Show it and put it in your hand.
card.flavor: "I soon found that I became a much better general the moment I abandoned all planning." - Akodo Kano

card.name: Awed Witness
card.text: Iaijutsu Battle: Your target unbowed Personality challenges a target enemy Personality. Bow the lower. The winning player may create a 2F/2C/2PH Samurai Personality with his Clan Alignment.
card.flavor: As the Kakita sheathed her blades, the ronin approached and fell to her knees. "Teach me!" she begged. "Only teach me and I will serve you forever!"

card.name: Balance in Nothingness
card.text: Interrupt: After the action targets your bowed Personality, negate its remaining effects.
card.flavor: "True harmony comes from the understanding that all forms lack an intrinsic meaning. By clinging to definitions, one creates one's own delusions. This is what is meant by saying, 'the world is empty.' Quiet your mind and simply observe what arises." - Naka Mahatsu

card.name: Public Arrest
card.text:
Battle: Fear 2.
Battle: Fear equal to your target unbowed Magistrate's Chi plus Personal Honor that must target a dishonorable or Shadowlands Personality, who may have Followers.
card.flavor: "Even if innocent, most samurai would rather die." - Kitsuki Yodo

card.name: Bridging the Gap
card.text:
Castle • Terrain
This Province has +4 strength.
