Battle: Destroy a Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play.
card.flavor: "Bridges are built to be crossed, yes... but also to be broken as needed." - Kaiu Watsuki

card.name: Brush the Arrow Aside
card.text:
Kata • Courage
Open: Put this Kata into play. Discard your other Kata in play.
Interrupt, [BOW]: The action's Ranged Attacks bow, instead of destroying, Personalities with Spells.
card.flavor: It is said that a kami can become so fond of a shugenja, that it will actively protect him from harm, even without invocation.

card.name: Civil Discussion
card.text: Political Open: Target your unbowed Courtier. After each time any player assigns, he loses 1 Honor for each unit he assigned, up to three units.
card.flavor: "What is the point of negotiating with these uncultured brutes?!"

card.name: Clash of Blades
card.text: Iaijutsu Open: Your target unbowed Personality challenges a target Personality. Dishonor and permanently remove all abilities from the loser. The winner gains 1 Honor.
card.flavor:
"You better have the strength to finish what you start here!" Ayahi roared.
Akifumi's eyes narrowed. "No, I think you should live with this mistake."

card.name: Grasp the Swords
card.text: Battle: Give your target Personality with a Weapon +2F/+2C. If he is a Kensai, you may take an additional action.
card.flavor: "Arm yourself however you can. If one carries oneself with honor, there is no shame in defending one's lord." - Mirumoto's Niten

card.name: Conservation
card.text:
Courage
Interrupt: Each of the action's Melee and Ranged Attacks has -1 strength, or -3 strength if its target has Armor attached.
Open: Show one or two target attachments in your hand. Shuffle them into your Fate deck. Draw cards equal to the number you showed plus one.
card.flavor: The warrior sat down to catch his breath during the lull. He knew it would not last very long.

card.name: Lookout Post
card.text:
Kharmic
Absent Interrupt: Negate the action if it is Engage.
Battle: Move home your target Personality. Straighten his unit as he moves.
card.flavor: "Oh yes, sticking me up here has clearly made a world of difference."

card.name: Control
card.text:
Control
Dark Virtue Open, [PAY 3]: Target your unbowed Samurai and target a Personality. While your Samurai remains unbowed and in play, negate the Personality's straightening.
card.flavor: "Everything begins and ends with control. In the grand scheme, nothing else matters." - Bayushi Nitoshi

card.name: Death of the Winds
card.text: Battle, [PAY 2]: Target your unbowed Tactician. Search your Fate deck for a non-Unique Battle Strategy and take an additional action to play it.
card.flavor: The course of a samurai's life, no matter how long, is determined only by a handful of choices.

card.name: Knife in the Darkness
card.text: Ninja Battle: Move home your target Ninja Personality and a target enemy Personality; these movements will not be negated. Bow them.
card.flavor: "Oh, such a shame," he whispered with a laugh. "And such an unseasonable time for wildfires in the Lion lands."

card.name: Defend Your Honor
card.text: Political Interrupt: Target your unbowed Samurai. Before the other player's action causes you an Honor loss, negate it, and your Samurai may then issue a challenge. The player may either target his unbowed Personality to accept the challenge or refuse. If the player refuses or loses the duel, he loses Honor equal to the amount you negated. Destroy the loser.
card.flavor: A man may yet live having lost his life, but never after losing his honor.

card.name: Pure Intent
card.text: Battle: Give your target opposed Personality a Force bonus equal to his Personal Honor. Gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "I know not if you are demon, spirit, or man, but I will not shrink from your blade. Face me and we shall see who wins the day!"

card.name: Banzai!
card.text:
Discipline [PAY 2]. (Pay 2 Gold to play, then remove from the game, this Discipline in your discard.)
Battle: Give your target opposed Personality +2F.
card.flavor: "Hold nothing back. There are no half-steps toward victory." - Seijuro-Sensei

card.name: Desperate Sacrifice
card.text: Political Battle: Destroy your target Courtier. Bow a target enemy Personality. Move him home. This movement will not be negated.
card.flavor: A samurai is always prepared for death... either his own, or someone else's.

card.name: Hidden Strength
card.text:
Invest [PAY 1]: If your Personality is a Duelist, draw a card.
Interrupt: After the action starts a duel, if your Personality in it has a lower duel stat than the other (at that time), then each player must focus at least once in the duel, and give the first card you focused in the duel +2FV after it is revealed.
card.flavor:
"Such... such a minor cut," the Dragon spat, struggling to rise. "Do not understand... burns so much."
"Yes," Jai replied. "Funny, is it not?"

card.name: Diligent Care
card.text:
Kata • Kharmic
Open: Put this Kata into play. Discard your other Kata in play.
Interrupt, [BOW]: If the action is another player's, attachments return to your hand instead of being destroyed for its effects (including when a Personality is destroyed).
card.flavor: Every one samurai relies upon the competence of a hundred servants.

card.name: Smoke and Mirrors
card.text: You may focus this Strategy face-up to discard the last card the other player focused (if any), then draw a card. Each player may focus one additional time this duel.
card.flavor: The power that a priest of the kami can bring to bear is great indeed, but if he cannot see or breathe, the effect is largely lost.

card.name: Interference
card.text: Political Open: A target Stronghold's abilities may not be used. If it is your turn, bow it.
card.flavor: "I have heard some very disconcerting rumors about events at the Castle of the Swift Sword in Akodo lands, my lord. Perhaps it bears investigation?"

card.name: Explored Territory
card.text:
Terrain
Before the first time (while this card is in play) another player's action destroys one of your cards at this battlefield, other than this Terrain, negate the destruction and draw a card.
Battle: Destroy a Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play.
card.flavor: In spite of its age, there are still places in Rokugan yet to be explored.

card.name: Standing Fast
card.text: Battle: Target your unbowed Samurai or Berserker Personality. Bow one or two target enemy units with a total Gold Cost less than your Personality's unit's total Gold Cost. Destroy any cards in the enemy units with 0 Gold Cost.
card.flavor: When faced with insurmountable odds, a samurai will often retreat, so as not to die needlessly and cost his lord a servant. There are times, however, when a stand must be made.

card.name: False Trail
card.text:
As a Focus Effect, if the last Battle Strategy you played this game is in your discard pile, put it into your hand.
Battle, [PAY 2]: Move a target enemy Personality at any battlefield to another unresolved battlefield.
card.flavor: "These prints were places here on purpose." The Tsuruchi frowned. "How long have I been chasing foxes?"

card.name: Fist of the Earth
card.text: Earth Kiho Battle: Bow your target unbowed Monk or Shugenja. Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers.
card.flavor:
"He is unarmed," the bandit said, "he cannot even reach us!"
"You are a fool!" his leader scorned.

card.name: Reserve Commander
card.text:
Retainer
Interrupt, [BOW]: If the action is another player's, before it destroys one of your Personalities at the current battlefield, create a 0F/1C/1PH Personality and transfer your first Personality's Followers to him. Destroy this Holding.
card.flavor: "Be ready in case the general has need of us. Keep the men in position."

card.name: Gaining an Edge
card.text: Absent Battle: If he would be opposed, move your target Personality at home to the current battlefield. If he is a Duelist, straighten him as he moves. (Absent actions may be taken without presence.)
card.flavor: The Scorpion sputtered. "You... weren't supposed to be here!"

card.name: Concealed Archers
card.text: Battle: Take an additional Ranged Attack action from your target card in a unit not at this battlefield. Each of the action's Ranged Attacks has +1 strength if the unit's Personality is Naga. Lose 2 Honor.
card.flavor: Even Akodo the One-Eyed condoned the use of deception in battle.

card.name: Startling Kiai
card.text:
Battle Give a target enemy Personality -2F.
Battle: Give a target enemy Personality with 6 or more Force -4F. You may take an additional action.
card.flavor: "There are many ways of disrupting the opponent's balance. First, attack his spirit with your voice. The blade follows shortly after." - Akodo's Leadership

card.name: Warranted Search
card.text: Political Open: Give another player's target Personality -2F. You may target and bow your unbowed Magistrate to dishonor the Personality.
card.flavor: To be subjected to a search is utter humiliation. It implies that one's word, one's honor, is not good enough.

card.name: Hidden Storehouse of House Rafiq
card.text: Battle, [PAY 3]: If you (after playing this Strategy) have fewer cards in your hand than each other player, draw two cards.
card.flavor: "So what if these are my enemy's supplies? I will take any advantage I can get."

card.name: Feign Death
card.text: Interrupt: Target your Personality. After the action resolves, if it destroyed him, bring him into play in your home, ignoring costs and Honor Requirement, then bow him, dishonor him, and lose 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "The man who does not keep death foremost in his mind will not be prepared when the moment comes. It is disgraceful to allow the moment when one should die to pass by." - Akodo's Leadership

card.name: Holding Cells
card.text: Kolat Battle, [PAY 4]: Target a Personality. Before this battle resolves, bow him. Lose 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "Our guests will not be discovered here," the Abbot said sagely. "When we are finished with them, we will take their memory and return them. Or, if necessary, ensure that they will never be missed."

card.name: Defensive Technique
card.text:
Interrupt: Bow your target unbowed Weapon to negate the action's Melee or Ranged Attacks.
Battle: Give your target opposed Kensai with a Weapon +2F.
card.flavor: When a Scorpion learns the Niten style from a Dragon, the result is somewhat difficult to anticipate, even for the most skilled opponent.

card.name: The Path of Wisdom
card.text: Before your turn ends, if this Strategy is in your discard pile, put it in your hand.
card.flavor: The monks of the Brotherhood of Shinsei spend their lives in contemplation of the universe, uncovering great wisdom and, occasionally, great mystical power as a result. They are delighted to share their wisdom with whomever wished to hear it.

card.name: The Blessed Herd
card.text: Battle, [BOW]: Give each of your Cavalry Followers at the current battlefield +1F.
card.flavor: The Unicorn Clan believes that the children of Shinjo, the true unicorns, will return one day to aid them when they need it most.

card.name: Purity of Spirit
card.text: Kiho Battle: Target your unbowed Monk or Shugenja and an enemy Personality with lower Chi. Bow the enemy Personality, and bow your Personality unless the enemy is Shadowlands.
card.flavor: The unclean cannot stand against those who are truly pure.

card.name: Ivory Magistrate Outpost
card.text:
Open: Straighten your target Magistrate.
Battle: Straighten your target Personality.
card.flavor: Throughout the whole of the Colonies, the small organization of Ivory Magistrates works tirelessly to keep the peace. No festival stays their sacred duty.

card.name: Lost in Transit
card.text:
Discipline [PAY 1]. (Pay 1 Gold to play, then remove from the game, this Discipline in your discard.)
Battle/Open: Bow a target attachment.
card.flavor: Even the words of a sacred Emperor can be lost, if they are exposed to the elements improperly.

card.name: Lakeside Retreat
card.text:
Terrain
Before this battle resolves, straighten a Follower or Personality.
Battle: Destroy a Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play.
card.flavor: "I come each year at the same time to remember you, father," she said softly. "Your memory will live on as long as I do."

card.name: Needed at the Wall
card.text: Battle: Bow your target unbowed Fortification at this battlefield. Move home a target enemy Personality. Bow his unit as it moves.
card.flavor: The Crab commander at the Second Pit called for reinforcements, and twenty times the number her requested appeared.

card.name: Outmaneuvered by Force
card.text: Political Interrupt: Negate the action if it is Political and taken by a player whose total Force of all units at home is now less than your total Force of all units at home (bowed cards count).
card.flavor: "That order would have been most unfortunate, had you lived to complete it. Fortunately, the draft they will find with your body will be much different."

card.name: Feinting Maneuver
card.text:
Absent Battle: If he would be opposed, move your target Tactician at home to the current battlefield. (Absent actions may be taken without presence.)
Battle, [PAY 3]: Put a Battle Strategy in your discard pile into your hand.
card.flavor: "Ride, brothers! Crush them before they have the chance to remaneuver!"

card.name: Mercantile Conflict
card.text:
Discipline [PAY 1]. (Pay 1 Gold to play, then remove from the game, this Discipline in your discard.)
Political Open: Bow your target unbowed Courtier. The next two Honor losses from your cards (this turn) are increased by 1 each.
card.flavor: "Yes, I did hear about the fire at the inn across town. It's a tragedy, and I hope his family can survive the loss. In the meantime, you are fortunate, because we do have rooms available."

card.name: Pacify
card.text: Battle: Target your unbowed Samurai. Target an enemy Personality with lower Chi. Bow him or all his attachments.
card.flavor: "Sit down and be quiet, you oafish lout. The adults are talking."

card.name: Poison Sake
card.text: Open, [PAY 2]: Bow your target unbowed Courtier or Ninja. Target another player's Personality. After the next time (this turn) his controller assigns him, targets him, or an action from a card in his unit resolves, give him two -1F/-1C Poison tokens.
card.flavor: "I have a new blend for you, my lord. I think it will be very much to your liking."

card.name: Rewards of Experience
card.text: Battle: Target your unbowed Samurai Personality. Bow a target enemy unit with lower total Force than your Samurai's Force. While your Samurai remains unbowed and at the current battlefield, negate the straightening of any cards in the enemy unit.
card.flavor: "The beast thought itself fearsome. I have been killing its ilk since I was a boy."

card.name: Preserving Forces
card.text:
As a Focus Effect, before your Personality in this duel is destroyed for losing it, you may destroy one of his Followers to negate his destruction.
Open: Put one or two target Followers in your discard pile into your hand.
card.flavor: "Haha! That was thrilling, was it not! Fortunately it was not one of the big ones."

card.name: Art of the Iai
card.text: Battle/Engage, [PAY *]: Equip a target Weapon from your hand to your target opposed Personality. If he is a Kensai, draw a card after it attaches.
card.flavor: "You die with your blade still in its saya. How humiliating for you. Your ancestors will not be welcoming, I imagine."

card.name: Powerful Motivation
card.text:
Courage
Battle: Straighten one or two target Followers.
Open: Put your target discarded (not dead) Commander into one of your Provinces, discarding any other cards there.
card.flavor: The Lion have many detractors, but no one has ever accused them of failing to make their intentions perfectly clear.

card.name: Rank Hath Privilege
card.text: Political Open: Bow your target unbowed Magistrate Personality. Bow a target Human Personality with lower Personal Honor.
card.flavor: "Stand aside, you brutish thugs. I am a member of the Imperial families, an Otomo noble by birth. Nothing you have to say is of any interest to me."

card.name: Hold the Walls
card.text:
Terrain
Attacking Personalities and Followers have -1F.
Battle: Destroy a Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play.
card.flavor: It has been said that few can overcome many.

card.name: Sake House Brawl
card.text: Open: Bow one or more of your target unbowed Personalities. Bow one or more target Personalities, each controlled by a different player, with total Force less than the total Force of your Personalities this bowed.
card.flavor: "This is not Friendly Traveller Sake! What manner of charltans are you? I cannot drink this swill!"

card.name: Selfless Politics
card.text: Political Open: After the next time a target Personality attacks you (this turn), gain 2 Honor and dishonor him.
card.flavor: "It would be foolish of you to try something like that again," she said calmly. "Our clans are allies, and thus I am forgiving, but cross me again and you will see how words are stronger than steel, even Kaiu steel."

card.name: Show Me Your Stance
card.text: Iaijutsu Battle: Your target unbowed Human Personality challenges a target enemy Human Personality to a duel of Personal Honor. The winner gains 2 Honor. Dishonor the loser. Move him home. Bow him as he moves.
card.flavor: "I see you favor the Descending Star style. Impressive, but I think you will find it disappointing today nonetheless."

card.name: Wedge
card.text: Battle: Target your Personality. You may not use abilities on cards in his unit or target them with actions. Before this battle resolves, double his unit's Force. Destroy him after the battle ends.
card.flavor: "Forward, brothers! Shatter their line and claim victory for our lord!"

card.name: Gempukku
card.text: Political Open: Target your Human Personality with neither Samurai nor Shugenja, even if he is in a Province. Permanently give him +1PH and either Samurai or Shugenja.
card.flavor: The coming-of-age ceremony is where a young boy or girl casts aside their childhood name and embraces their Nanori, the name and duty of an adult.

card.name: Test of Character
card.text: Political Open: Target a Human Personality. He must undergo a test of character. Discard the top card of his controller's Fate Deck. If the Focus Value is greater than or equal to the target's Personal Honor, dishonor him and draw a card.
card.flavor: Maintaining a kneeling position for hours, despite the physical discomfort, is often used as a test of character by whimsical lords.

card.name: Scour the Unworthy
card.text:
Battle: Fear 3 (Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 3 or lower Force).
Battle: Bow one to four target enemy Personalities, each with a 4 or lower Gold Cost and with a total combined Gold Cost of 8 or less.
card.flavor: "Bah! War dogs, lions, kenku... are there not samurai worthy to fight me?"

card.name: Superior Tactics
card.text: Battle: Target your unbowed Personality with 3 or more Chi. Either move him to another unresolved battlefield or destroy a Terrain in play at the current battlefield.
card.flavor: It is said that no army lead by an Akodo general has ever lost a battle. This is of course hyperbole... but only by a slim margin.

card.name: The Call of Battle
card.text: Thunder Open: Your target Personality may assign even if he is bowed (this turn). After the next time this turn he assigns, straighten his unit.
card.flavor: "I put aside my blade years ago, to serve as a courtier for my clan. But the siren song of war... it never leaves the soul."

card.name: The Code of Bushido
card.text: Interrupt: If the action is from or targets a Samurai and it has any effects, other than consequences of losing a duel, that may dishonor him or causes his player Honor losses, negate the action.
card.flavor: "When an act will bring dishonor, the rule of the samurai is simple. He must not do whatever he was about to do." - Akodo's Leadership

card.name: The Emperor's Road
card.text: Kiho Water Battle: Move your target unbowed Monk or Shugenja to another location.
card.flavor: The Emperor's Road is a physical thing, upon which the Emperor travels when leaving the Imperial City. The name is shared by a number of magical effects that allow for travel to take place instantaneously over long distances.

card.name: Colonial Temple
card.text:
Temple
This Holding has +2GP when it pays for a single attachment only.
card.flavor: The perspective afforded by the Colonies has, ironically, given rise to tremendously successful shugenja temples.

card.name: Unexpected Testimony
card.text:
Political Interrupt: If the action is another player's, negate its effects that dishonor or give Shadowlands to your target Personality.
Political Battle/Open: Give a target Personality -1F, or -3F if you control a Magistrate.
card.flavor: "Good evening, Ide-san. I understand you have some... unexpected things to say to contribute to the conversation."

card.name: Unexplained Illness
card.text: Ninja Battle/Open: Bow a target Personality with a Poison token.
card.flavor: "Urg... I think... there may have been... something wrong with the fish."

card.name: Unholy Strike
card.text:
Battle: Melee 2 Attack.
Interrupt: Give a Melee or Ranged Attack +2 strength.
card.flavor: "This kata is magnificent. I eagerly await the opportunity to try it on a target more worthy of my ire."

card.name: Unrequited Love
card.text: Political Open: Target one of the active player's unbowed Human Personalities. That player may choose to bow the Personality and gain 1 Honor. If he does not choose this, dishonor the Personality, and the player loses Honor equal to the Personality's printed Personal Honor.
card.flavor: A samurai rarely has the opportunity to marry for love, much to the dismay of many a romantic soul.

card.name: Unsafe Passage
card.text:
Interrupt: Negate your target Commander's movement from the action's effects.
Battle: Take an additional action to use a printed ability on your target Follower, even if it is bowed or the ability has been used the maximum number of times this turn.
card.flavor: The route between the Empire and the Colonies is well-traveled, but it is not truly safe. Many dangers await the unwary traveller.

card.name: You Walk With Evil
card.text: Battle: If a target Samurai's army contains any Shadowlands cards, bow and dishonor him, and permanently give him Shadowlands.
card.flavor: "My shame in becoming Tainted cannot be overcome. But I will assuage my conscience by dying bathed in the blood of my clan's enemies."

card.name: Superior Defense
card.text: Battle: Give a target enemy Follower or Personality a Force penalty equal to your target unbowed Follower's Force. If that Follower is attached to a Commander, you may bow it to draw a card and take an additional action.
card.flavor: "Break this line? No, I do not think you shall."

card.name: Brazen Challenge
card.text: Iaijutsu Battle: Your target unbowed Personality challenges a target enemy Personality. Bow the loser. If your Personality is a Duelist and you won the duel by three or more, you may take an additional action.
card.flavor: "If you thought my actions dishonorable, you shouldn't have accepted. Now who will tell your story?" - Kakita Ibara

card.name: The Unassailable Fortress of the Crab (1)
card.text: Battle: Straighten your target opposed Personality. Straighten his attachments if your army has fewer units than the opposing army.
card.flavor: What was once merely a watchtower has grown in size and scope. Now it truly stands watch over the Crab lands, like a sentry that never falters.

card.name: The Esteemed Palace of the Crane (1)
card.text: Political Open, [BOW]: If you control a Personality, gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: The Crane excel at many things. One among them is the gift of finding beauty and exploiting it for political advantage.

card.name: The Fortified Monastery of the Dragon (1)
card.text: After all players reveal Strongholds, search your Fate deck for a non-Void Ring, and put it into play; Sensei effects that remove abilities also remove this trait.
card.flavor: Many think of the Dragon as being cold and impassive, like the mountains. But both have warmth and beauty undreamt of.

card.name: The Grand Halls of the Lion (1)
card.text: Battle: Give your target opposed Samurai a Force bonus equal to his Personal Honor.
card.flavor: The samurai of the Lion Clan do not press the issue that theirs is the greatest and most glorious army in the Empire. They assume that all others know and accept this. Only when it is called into question is the wrath of the Lion unleashed.

card.name: The Fruitful Port of the Mantis (1)
card.text:
Port
Limited, [PAY 3]: Draw a card.
card.flavor: "My brother's temperament notwithstanding, the best way to ensure that we are not crossed is to ensure that no clan can afford to alienate our mercantile interests." - Yoritomo Harumi

card.name: The Majestic Temple of the Phoenix (1)
card.text:
Temple
Dynasty, [PAY *]: Recruit your target dead (not discarded) Phoenix Clan Personality; you may Proclaim him. Gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "There is no death or life in this world. We are but spirits who pass from one realm to the next before finding our ultimate home." - Phoenix teaching

card.name: The Shadowed Estate of the Scorpion (1)
card.text: Tireless Open: Name a Fate card, or name a Dynasty card in play. Negate the effects of the next action from a card with that title.
card.flavor: "Welcome our guests. Provide all that they need. Learn everything you can. They will be ours." - Bayushi Nitoshi

card.name: The Hidden Bastion of the Spider (1)
card.text: Tireless Battle: Fear 3 (Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality without Follower with 3 or lower Force)
card.flavor: "A new Emperor will soon sit upon the throne, and we shall see what promises are kept and what promises are broken. The Empire should remember that they are not the only ones with promises to keep, however." - Daigotsu Kanpeki

card.name: The Endless Plains of the Unicorn (1)
card.text:
This Stronghold produces 4 Gold on your first turn.
Battle/Engage: If he would be opposed, move your target unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit at any location to the current battlefield.
card.flavor: "No one who threatens this place can be allowed to live. We stand to lose too much." - Shinjo Min-hee

card.name: Temple Fortress
card.text:
Castle • Temple
After the first time each turn you bow this Holding, gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: The tale of the Dark Naga's assault upon the Second City was one that would forever chill the blood of all who heard it.

card.name: Front Rank Troops
card.text:
Expendable
(Draw a card after your Expendable card dies.)
card.flavor: "Choose the units in front with care. Their deaths need to bring more grief to your enemy than to you." - Moto Taigo

card.name: Fudoshi
card.text:
Nonhuman • Oni • Shadowlands
After this Follower enters play, lose 3 Honor.
If this Follower has 7 Force or less, after a Follower or Personality is destroyed at this battlefield, give this Follower a +1F token.
card.flavor: "Horrible, and horribly effective." - Daigotsu

card.name: Enlistment
card.text:
Unique
Each player may draw an additional card before his turn ends if he Equipped any Followers from his hand since his last turn ended.
Open: Put this Event into play.
card.flavor: Even among the loyal people of Rokugan, there are some who do not wish to serve unless forced.

card.name: Steal an Advantage
card.text:
This Strategy's ability is Battle/Engage if you control a Scout at this battlefield.
Battle: A target enemy card may not use one of its abilities (you choose).
card.flavor: "Any more words about us 'foolish mammals' without your sword, serpent?"

card.name: Strategic Withdrawal
card.text:
As a Focus Effect, if you win this duel, draw a card.
Battle: Move your target Personality home. You may target an enemy Personality and give him -3F.
card.flavor: Cowardice is a common accusation, but even Akodo's Leadership teaches that discretion is often the path to victory.

card.name: Mutual Support
card.text: Battle: Give two or more target opposed Personalities, each with a different Clan alignment, +2F (each).
card.flavor: "The Scorpion are nothing!" the Lion officer barked. "The Crab... are another matter."

card.name: Usurpation
card.text: Battle: Target your unbowed defending Personality. Move home a target enemy Personality with lower Personal Honor. Gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "My brother has achieved his position through great effort, that is true. As his elder brother, it is my right to assume this role."

card.name: The Unassailable Fortress of the Crab (2)
card.text: Tireless Battle: Straighten your target opposed Personality. Straighten his attachments if your army has fewer units than the opposing army. (Tireless actions may be taken even while bowed.)
card.flavor: The sons of Hida are never exactly what is expected of them. Their strengths are more varied than most realize.

card.name: The Esteemed Palace of the Crane (2)
card.text:
You have a +5 Lobby Bonus.
Political Open, [BOW]: If you control a Personality, gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "Still the hearts of your enemies with the tranquility of a calm sea, and victory is assured." - Crane proverb

card.name: The Fortified Monastery of the Dragon (2)
card.text:
After all players reveal Strongholds, search your Fate deck for a non-Void Ring, and put it into play; Sensei effects that remove abilities also remove this trait.
You start with 1 additional card in hand and have +1 maximum hand size.
card.flavor: Few clans benefit from monastic insight in the same way as the Dragon.

card.name: The Grand Halls of the Lion (2)
card.text: Tireless Battle: Give your target opposed Samurai a Force bonus equal to his Personal Honor. (Tireless actions may be taken even while bowed.)
card.flavor: "My Champion, if you wish victory over the Scorpion, it is a simple matter. Release me to do what I must, and you shall have it." - Matsu Chizuki

card.name: The Fruitful Port of the Mantis (2)
card.text:
Port
Once per game, produce 2 Gold.
Limited, [PAY 3]: Draw a card.
card.flavor: Every day, dozens or hundres of ships pass through the harbor, all laden with goods and coins that ultimately benefit the Mantis Clan.

card.name: The Majestic Temple of the Phoenix (2)
card.text:
Temple
Personalities you Proclaim enter play for two less Gold.
Dynasty, [PAY *]: Recruit your target dead (not discarded) Phoenix Clan Personality; you may Proclaim him. Gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "True power lies in harmony with the universe, in understanding one's place, and in the fulfillment of wisdom." - Phoenix teaching

card.name: The Shadowed Estate of the Scorpion (2)
card.text:
Other players have -1 maximum hand size.
Tireless Open: Name a Fate card, or name a Dynasty card in play. Negate the effects of the next action from a card with that title.
card.flavor: Guests of the Scorpion Clan will find their every want or need taken care of. The price for such things comes only much later.

card.name: The Hidden Bastion of the Spider (2)
card.text:
If any of your Provinces have been destroyed this game, refill the first Province during your Dynasty Phase face-up.
Tireless Battle: Fear 4 (Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 4 or lower Force).
card.flavor: "We shall be ready, my lord," Kendo said with a smile. "We shall march in an instant upon your order."

card.name: The Endless Plains of the Unicorn (2)
card.text:
This Stronghold produces 4 Gold on your first turn. You may Cycle one additional time per game on any turn.
Battle/Engage: If he would be opposed, move your target unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit at any location to the current battlefield.
card.flavor: "This is why we fight with such ferocity. Because we protect so beautiful a home." - Moto Naleesh

card.name: The Eternal Rainbows
card.text:
Terrain
The Personality this ability targeted has +2F.
Battle: Target your opposed Personality. Destroy a Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play.
card.flavor: The name, while strange, was given to it by grateful Unicorn scouts who were on the brink of death before they found its bountiful oasis.

card.name: Personal Instructor
card.text: After a battle resolution in which this Follower was in an army that destroyed any enemy units or a Province, gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "Elbows. Elbows! Do you think the eagle soars by letting his wings flap any which way? No? Then do not let your elbows flap around."

card.name: Legendary Victory
card.text:
You can only play one Legendary Victory per battle.
Political Battle: If you are the Attacker or Defender in this battle and your army is currently opposed by an army with greater total Force, double your Honor gains during the Resolution Segment after all other bonuses are applied.
card.flavor: Even during times of celebration, or especially during times of celebration, some victories are spoken of with great reverence and solemnity.

card.name: Coronation Festival
card.text:
Festival • Kharmic
You have the ability, "Open: If you have fewer Provinces than one other player, then a number of times per turn equal to the difference (now), you may refill one of your Provinces face-up."
Open: If you have not resolved a Coronation Festival this game, put this Event into play.
card.flavor: The season of festivals ended finally in a week of merriment before the coronation of Iweko II.

card.name: Exodus of the Spider
card.text:
You have the ability, "Battle: If your current army is opposed, discard a card to draw a card."
Open: Put this Event into play.
card.flavor: Kanpeki looked at the burning banner, then back to his men. "We have kept our oaths, and they have broken theirs. You know, as I know, what this means. I will not have my father's name slandered. The Empire must burn."

card.name: A Vision Imparted
card.text:
You have the ability, "Open: Give a target face-up card in your Province Kharmic."
Open: Put this Event into play.
card.flavor: The certainty of the Heavens rained down upon the mortal mind of a man named Enomoto, and he was shattered by it. Far away, the aged monk Hira felt something stir within him. "What... what is this I see?" he wondered idly. "What is happening?"

card.name: Rhetorician
card.text:
Retainer
After this Holding enters play, a target player gains or loses 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "A violation of Imperial law, you say? An interesting position with interesting implications, Akodo-san. Let us examine your argument more closely."

card.name: Borderless Fields
card.text:
Farm
Interrupt, [BOW]: After the action Recruits an Ashigaru Personality, create a 0F/1C/0PH Ashigaru • Conscript Personality. Destroy this Holding.
card.flavor: "Conscripting farmers requires a light hand. Too many, and the harvests suffer. Too few, and they will talk of overthrowing their masters." - Bayushi Nitoshi

card.name: Veteran's Farmland
card.text:
Farm
Battle/Open: Straighten your target Ashigaru Follower.
card.flavor: Ashigaru who return to their farmlands are changed by the wars they've fought. They are wiser, stronger, more willful, and, most importantly, respected. They can protect their own lands. It is often better for samurai that such farmers die in battle.

card.name: Isolated Farmlands
card.text:
Farm
After this Holding enters play, create a 0F/1C/0PH Ashigaru • Conscript Personality and straighten your Sensei.
card.flavor: Some isolated villages are actually many smaller farms working in tandem. They often govern themselves, unconcerned with the conflicts of samurai and the world outside. As long as taxes are paid and the occaisional Ashigaru conscripted, most samurai are content to leave them be.

card.name: Heisha
card.text:
Barracks
Open, [BOW]: Put a target Follower in your discard pile into your hand.
card.flavor: The Heisha, meaning "soldier lodge," is the living quarters that a lord provides his garrison. It is always strategically placed, close enough to his quarters that they can protect him, but far enough away that they do not disturb him.

card.name: Officer's Lodge
card.text:
Barracks • Winter
Tireless Interrupt, [PAY *]: If you bowed this Holding to produce Gold while Recruiting a Commander, Equip a target Follower to him from your hand for 1 less Gold after he enters play.
card.flavor: The lodging of officers is often better than that of lesser soldiers. But not by much.

card.name: Garrison Hub
card.text:
Barracks
Battle: Transfer your target Follower from your target Personality to your other target Personality.
card.flavor: Ji-Samurai willingly serve many masters, so many that they cannot tell them apart. They want only to be noticed, to prove their worth, that they might earn full-fledged retainer status and an estate of their own.

card.name: Architect
card.text:
Retainer • Fortification
(Fortifications attach to the Province from which they entered play.)
If you use this Holding's Gold Production to Recruit a single Fortification only, you choose which of your Provinces the Fortification attaches to.
card.flavor:
"The tower will look better there."
"Overlooking... the woods?"

card.name: Combat Drill Field
card.text:
Barracks
Battle, [BOW]: Give your target opposed Follower +1F, or +2F if it is attached to a Commander.
card.flavor: "Fates and Fortunes may have their say, but ultimately it is preparation that wins battles." - Akodo Dairuko

card.name: Bamboo Irrigation
card.text:
Farm
This Holding has +1GP when it pays to Recruit a single Farm only, or when it pays for a single Sensei action only.
card.flavor: When the elements are all in balance, present in equal measure, the land prospers.

card.name: Padis Dojo
card.text:
Dojo
Open, [BOW]: Draw a card. If you now have more cards in your hand than each other player, discard a card. Destroy this Holding.
card.flavor: It is the largest dojo for many provinces, and one well known for its martial tournaments. Competitors travel from far and wide to compete with honor for the glory of their family and clan.

card.name: Peaceful Retreat
card.text:
Fortification
(Fortifications attach to the Province from which they entered play.)
After this Holding is destroyed, gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "Let them come, then. If they dare to destroy this place, they will only serve to shame themselves and to exalt us in the eyes of their enemies."

card.name: Daikura
card.text: You have +1 maximum hand size.
card.flavor: Besieged castles are rarely assaulted, since, due to their layout, a direct assault is a dangerous affair. Instead, armies will surround a besieged castle and gradually starve the inhabitants. In this cases, a large storehouse can be the difference between victory and defeat.

card.name: Hasty Defenses
card.text: Courtesy: Your Provinces have +1 strength. (Courtesy traits do not take effect if you went first.)
card.flavor: Without adequate warning, castle defenders are often forced to improvise.

card.name: Mess Hall
card.text:
Barracks
This Holding has +1GP for each different title among your Barracks Holdings, other than Mess Hall, maximum +2GP.
card.flavor: "Feed our troops well, but for the sake of the Fortunes, don't spoil them! They must be fit to spill Scorpion blood soon." - Akodo Kano

card.name: Ashigaru Farmland
card.text:
Farm
Courtesy: This Holding also straightens at the start of other player's turns, but has -1GP on those turns. (Courtesy traits do not take effect if you went first.)
card.flavor: Sometimes, isolated farming communities start to prefer self-governance to the leadership of samurai. That they do not understand the ways of their lords does not help matters.

card.name: Hida Toranosuke - exp
card.text:
Jade • Samurai • Experienced • Resilient
(Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution.)
Jade Battle, [BOW]: Melee 3 Attack. Straighten Toranosuke if he has a Heavy Weapon or if the target is Shadowlands.
card.flavor: "Many of my brothers in arms seem to have forgotten the danger our eternal enemy presents. As for myself, I have no time for celebrations. There is work to be done."

card.name: Kaiu Otogou
card.text:
Samurai • Siege
Invest [PAY 1]: Create a Fortification Holding with the trait "This Province has +1 strength" and attach it to your target Province.
Open: If it is not your turn, target your Fortification. Before this turn ends, if it is still in play, gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "From this port we shall set forth to destroy the Spider once and for all!"

card.name: Kaiu Gizen
card.text:
Samurai • Siege • Destined
(Draw a card after you Recruit a Destined card.)
Compassion: Gizen has +1F for each Fortification at his battlefield, to a maximum of 3 Fortifications. (Compassion takes effect while you have fewer Provinces than anyone else)
card.flavor: "The Voice has said that we must fortify this coastline. There are many better uses we could make of this stone... but it is not our place to question an Imperial command."

card.name: Kuni Igarasu
card.text:
Earth • Shugenja
Invest [PAY 5], or [PAY 3] if any other player is Crane Clan: Give Igarasu two +1F/+1C tokens.
card.flavor: "The Earth spirits whisper to me, whisper of unease, even of fear. I wonder, does anyone else hear them? Or are all too busy with these petty festivals?"

card.name: Kuni Soseki
card.text:
Earth • Shugenja • Resilient
Earth Battle: Melee 3 Attack (Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 3 or lower Force).
card.flavor: The Kuni are known to rival the Isawa as masters of Earth's protective powers. Of course, the Kuni put those powers to far more aggressive use as well.

card.name: Toritaka Suppon
card.text:
Samurai • The Masked Tortoise
Battle, [BOW]: Fear 4. Straighten Suppon if you are Scorpion Clan or if your army has fewer units than the enemy army.
card.flavor: "When the Scorpion asked him what sort of mask he wanted, he remembered a story about an angry kappa. Now they call him the Masked Tortoise." - Toritaka Chokichi

card.name: Doji Hoshihana
card.text:
Artisan • Courtier • Poet • Storyteller
Compassion: Hoshihana has Destined. (Compassion takes effect while you have fewer Provinces than anyone else.)
Tireless Open: If you have resolved an action from a Political Strategy this turn, straighten Hoshihana.
card.flavor: She smiled as she told her story, all the while listening to every word the nearby Otomo said.

card.name: Doji Buredo
card.text:
Magistrate • Samurai
Compassion: Buredo has +1F/+1C/+1PH. (Compassion takes effect while you have fewer Provinces than anyone else.)
Phoenix Clan players may Proclaim Buredo.
card.flavor: "The weapons of the lawless are many, but none so dangerous as knowledge of the law."

card.name: Doji Moro
card.text:
Magistrate • Samurai • Resilient
(Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution.)
Iaijutsu Battle: Fear 2. If this bowed a Personality with lower Personal Honor, give Moro +1F.
card.flavor: "I have long come to terms with the wolf inside. You might even say we each look after one another."

card.name: Kakita Iwari
card.text:
Artisan • Courtier • Spy • Expendable
Political Open: Target another player's Personality. After the first time (this turn) the target assigns or moves to a battlefield, move Iwari there, and if the target is attacking, his player loses 1 Honor, or 2 Honor if the target is Crab Clan.
card.flavor: "Shh! Don't tell anyone. It will be our secret, my little friend..."

card.name: Kakita Shinichi - exp
card.text:
Samurai • Yojimbo • Duelist • Experienced • Resilient
Shinichi's focused cards have +1FV while you control, or he is dueling, Kakita Daitsu.
Iaijutsu Unstoppable Battle: Shinichi challenges a target enemy Personality, who may move home to refuse. Bow the loser.
card.flavor: "Oh look. Here come more fools. Another round, brother? A chance to win your money back?"

card.name: Daidoji Kuraou
card.text:
Iron Crane • Samurai
Kuraou has +1F/+1C while he has a Spear or opposes a Crab Clan Personality.
Battle: Give a target enemy Personality -3F.
card.flavor: "Wise generals say, 'few can overcome many,' but I have found that the honorable are rarely willing to dwell upon how that is possible."

card.name: Tamori Mabasu
card.text:
Commander • Earth • Shugenja • Tactician
Courtesy: Mabasu and his Spirit Followers have Cavalry. (Courtesy traits do not take effect if you went first.)
card.flavor: "Very well! If you refuse to listen to my words, then perhaps I shall let the kami speak for themselves!"

card.name: Kitsuki Mizukabe
card.text:
Courtier • Magistrate • Resilient
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 3 Attack, or Ranged 4 Attack if the target is dishonorable.
card.flavor:
"The Dragon were stewards of the Spider. You are no better than them!"
Mizukabe's hand touched his bow. "Would you are to repeat that?" he whispered.

card.name: Kitsuki Akito
card.text:
Courtier • Magistrate • Expendable
(Draw a card after your Expendable card dies.)
Compassion, or if you are Unicorn Clan: Akito has +2F/+2C. (Compassion takes effect while you have fewer Provinces than anyone else.)
card.flavor: He bowed beneath the eyes of the hesitant Ide. "Haven't our clans feuded for long enough?"

card.name: Mirumoto Higaru - exp
card.text:
Samurai • Duelist • Experienced • Kensai
Battle, [BOW]: Straighten your target Ring. You may bow one of Higaru's Swords to straighten him.
card.flavor: "The past cannot be changed and should not be dwelled upon. We must occupy our minds with the present, but never forget the future which we shape with our every action."

card.name: Tamori Hirakura
card.text:
Commander • Earth • Shugenja • Resilient
(Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution.)
Battle: Melee Attack equal to the number of Hirakura's Spirit Followers (this is a Melee 0 Attack if he has no Spirit Followers).
card.flavor: "I hope the earth opens up! I hope it swallows you all!"

card.name: Togashi Tameko
card.text:
Fire • Monk • Tattooed
After Tameko enters play, give her three +1F Fire tokens.
Fire Battle: Ranged Attack equal to the number of Tameko's Fire tokens, plus 1 if the target is Mantis Clan. Remove one of Tameko's Fire tokens.
card.flavor: "Sensei once told me, the purpose of the monk is to 'illuminate the path.'"

card.name: Akodo Kano, Master Tactician
card.text:
Samurai • Experienced 2 • Tactician • Unique
Increase Kano's Force bonuses from the rulebook Tactical Advantage action by 2 if he has a Tessen.
Battle: Give a target Battle Strategy without Discipline in your discard pile Discipline [PAY 2].
card.flavor: Kano had returned to serve his sister and the Lion, but the whispers of Matsu Hitomi troubled him. "What you describe... it cannot be," he said softly.

card.name: Akodo Toshigure
card.text:
Samurai • Duelist
Toshigure has -1C while dueling Doji Moro. Toshigure has +1PH if he won a duel this turn or you are Mantis Clan.
card.flavor: "Loyalty is not learned, neither is it inherited. Unlike Imperial positions filled by right of blood, loyalty must be earned. Forget this, and you have done your enemy's work for him." - Akodo's Leadership

card.name: Akodo Naotaka
card.text:
Samurai • Duelist
Iaijutsu Battle: Naotaka challenges a target enemy Personality. Give the winner +2F.
card.flavor: "Draw your sword, Bayushi. Give me exactly what I want."

card.name: Ikoma Kiyomako
card.text:
Magistrate • Samurai • Resilient
(Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution.)
Battle: Give a target enemy Personality -2F. If he is Scorpion Clan, give Kiyomako +1F.
card.flavor: "This man was seen in the vicinity of the Kitsu Tombs shortly before the Scorpion attack. If he knows anything, I must know it as well. If he was involved, then even the Heavens cannot save him from my wrath."

card.name: Matsu Hideyuki
card.text:
Beastmaster • Commander • Samurai • Reserve
Compassion: Equipping Nonhuman Followers to Hideyuki is a Battle/Open for you, for 1 less gold if Hideyuki entered play this battle. (Compassion takes effect while you have fewer Provinces than anyone else.)
card.flavor: "I enjoy my duty, but I wish the older ones wouldn't stare."

card.name: Matsu Kaori
card.text:
Beastmaster • Commander • Samurai • Scion of Stone
You may destroy one of Kaori's unbowed Nonhuman Followers to refuse a challenge targeting her and negate all effects of refusing.
Earth Battle: Fear 2.
card.flavor: "They can stare until their eyes fall out, for all I care! I will take my allies as they appear."

card.name: Moshi Kyan
card.text:
Shugenja • Thunder • Resilient
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 2 Attack. Straighten Kyan if you have Compassion or the target was Dragon Clan. (Compassion takes effect while you have fewer Provinces than anyone else.)
card.flavor: There are some among the Moshi who have truly embraced their Mantis identity, rather to their sister's chagrin.

card.name: Yoritomo Minoko
card.text:
Naga • Samurai • Kensai
Minoko has Naval while she has a Peasant Weapon.
Battle, [BOW]: Melee 3 Attack. If this does not destroy a Personality, straighten Minoko.
card.flavor: "I survived the Dark Naga's onslaught. Do you think I fear a few ruins beneath the sea?"

card.name: Yoritomo Kinshikirai
card.text:
Magistrate • Samurai • Yojimbo • Naval
Compassion: Kinshikirai's printed ability has no Gold Cost. (Compassion takes effect while you have fewer Provinces than anyone else.)
Interrupt, [PAY 2]: If the action is yours or you are Lion clan, after it resolves, straighten Kinshikirai.
card.flavor: "Danjuro's training has aided me in many things... but this?"

card.name: Tsuruchi Akira
card.text:
Samurai
Positive numerals in the text box of Akira's Bow Items have +1. (2 is a numeral, two is not)
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 4 Attack. If this is not increased or combined, it can target a Province and reduce its strength by the Ranged Attack's strength.
card.flavor: The Tsuruchi are no longer the wandering bounty-hunters of their past, but they are still the Empire's finest archers.

card.name: Yoritomo Kyunan
card.text:
Artisan • Samurai • Kensai • Reserve
(You may Recruit a Reserve Personality, if they would be opposed, as an Absent Battle action.)
After Kyunan enters play, you may take one or two additional actions to Equip Peasant Weapons to him.
card.flavor: "I much prefer a simple weapon, due to the risks of sea travel. There are times, though, when a man must draw steel."

card.name: Kitsune Narako
card.text:
Earth • Prophetess • Shugenja • Destined
After a card enters another player's hand from his or her own card's effect, target your Personality with fewer Omen tokens than his Personal Honor, and give him a +1F/+1C Omen token.
card.flavor: "Another has been vouchsafed this vision, and I catch only the edges of it. Yet even that glimpse terrifies me. Have the Heavens forsaken us?"

card.name: Asako Nashimoto
card.text:
Earth • Inquisitor • Magistrate • Shugenja • Resilient
(Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution.)
card.flavor: The Unicorn waystation shattered, and samurai scattered in all directions. A lone Phoenix emerged, the earth swirling about him in a maelstrom.

card.name: Asako Kazuki
card.text:
Earth • Inquisitor • Magistrate • Shugenja • Resilient
Melee and Ranged Attacks may not target Kazuki.
Battle, [BOW]: Fear 4, with +1 strength if the target is Shadowlands, and +1 strength if you have Compassion.
card.flavor: "I want to know where the Spider have gone, wave man. You know, and you are going to tell me."

card.name: Isawa Nobuo
card.text:
Shugenja • Water • Expendable
(Draw a card after your Expendable card dies.)
Compassion, or if any other player is Unicorn Clan: Nobuo has +1F/+1C. (Compassion takes effect while you have fewer Provinces than anyone else.)
card.flavor: "You are a fool to challenge one who commands the power of the tides, Moto."

card.name: Isawa Hibana - exp
card.text:
Fire • Shugenja • Experienced
Ranged Attacks from Hibana's Spells have +1 strength. Hibana has Conqueror while she has a Fire Spell. Hibana Equips Fire Spells for 2 less Gold.
card.flavor: "The situation with the Unicorn is unacceptable. The Masters will either choose to apologize, or unleash the Phoenix's true power. Either way, it will be momentous."

card.name: Isawa Fujisawa
card.text:
Scholar • Water • Shugenja • Reserve
(You may Recruit a Reserve Personality, if they would be opposed, as an Absent Battle action.)
Interrupt, [PAY *]: After Fujisawa enters play, Equip a target Spell to him from your hand or discard pile.
card.flavor: "Hmm," he pondered. "Yes, I think I know where the Spider might be. I must inform my lord at... what was that sound?"

card.name: Shiba Hano
card.text:
Samurai • Yojimbo
After Hano enters the discard pile, he becomes Honorably Dead. Hano Equips Polearms for 1 less Gold.
Battle: Melee 2 Attack. Gain 1 Honor if this destroyed a card or you are Crane Clan.
card.flavor: Sitting up, he inhaled sharply, sudddenly. "What happened? Where am I?" The naginata at his side did not reveal its secrets.

card.name: Bayushi Fuyuko - exp
card.text:
Courtier • Experienced
You Recruit Doji Natsuyo for 1 less Gold.
Political Open: Target two Personalities controlled by the same player. Fuyuko sows seeds of distrust. After the next time this turn they are attacking in the same army together, their controller loses 1 Honor, or 2 Honor if each of them has 3 or more printed Personal Honor.
card.flavor: "These words go to you exactly as they came to me."

card.name: Bayushi Chizuken
card.text:
Samurai • Resilient • Tactician
(Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution. Battle: Discard a card to give this Tactician a Force bonus equal to the card's Focus Value.)
Battle: Give a target Personality -2F. Bow him if he is Lion Clan.
card.flavor: The rout of the Lion from Shamate Pass after their defeat at the Second Pit was an offense no Lion would ever forgive, and no Scorpion would ever forget.

card.name: Bayushi Tenburo
card.text:
Bitter Lies • Samurai • Kensai
Open: Remove a Madness token from Tenburo to give him Cavalry, Conqueror, or Naval.
card.flavor: The fire exploded behind him, hurling him forward, singeing the plates of his armor. He only laughed, the sound terrifying those who survived the destruction.

card.name: Shosuro Wayari
card.text:
Bitter Lies • Samurai • Kensai
(Kensai may attach two One-Handed Weapons.)
After Wayari enters play, give a target Personality a Madness token.
card.flavor: "Send more Matsu to the Pass, Lion! My blade still thirsts for your blood!"

card.name: Shosuro Kanako
card.text:
Ninja • Duelist • Resilient
After Kanako enters play, lose 2 Honor.
Compassion, or if you are Crab Clan: Kanako has Destined. (Compassion takes effect while you have fewer Provinces than anyone else.)
card.flavor: "I think it well past time that the Lion became acquainted with some of our more... clandestine assets. Don't you agree?" - Bayushi Nitoshi

card.name: Soshi Mumoshi
card.text:
Air • Ninja • Shugenja
After Mumoshi enters play, lose 2 Honor.
Ninja Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 2 Attack. Straighten Mumoshi if he has a Ninja Weapon or the target has a Poison token.
card.flavor: "The Matsu are a hardy folk, even for the Lion. Many of our subtler poisons do not work. They need a very special blend..."

card.name: Daigotsu Tomiyama
card.text:
Samurai • Shadowlands • Yojimbo • Duelist • Expendable
Compassion: If Spider Clan is your only Clan Alignment, you may Recruit Tomiyama as an Open. (Compassion takes effect while you have fewer Provinces than anyone else.)
card.flavor: "We could have been their allies. Now they will regret every slur, every insult. They will pay in blood and bone."

card.name: Daigotsu Kanpeki, Unleashed
card.text:
Clan Champion • Monk • Paragon • Samurai • Shadowlands • Conqueror • Experienced 4 • Kensai • Loyal • Unique
After Kanpeki enters play, lose 3 Honor.
Your Fear effects may target Items and Spells. Your Shadowlands Personalities without a printed Fear ability have the ability, "Battle: Fear 2".
Battle: Fear 5.
card.flavor: "Give me your blessing, father. Let me bring ruin."

card.name: Daigotsu Onita
card.text:
Samurai • Shadowlands • Duelist
Onita has +1F/+1C while she has a Sword.
Open: Give Onita +2F/-2C. Duels in which she is the challenger are duels of Force (this turn).
card.flavor: "A moth! How delightful. So delicate. So fragile. So innocent. You remind me of myself in so many ways, little one."

card.name: Goju Kenteiru
card.text:
Ninja • Shadowlands • Shugenja • Cavalry
After Kenteiru enters play, lose 3 Honor.
Compassion: Kenteiru has Naval. (Compassion takes effect while you have fewer Provinces than anyone else.)
card.flavor: Kenteiru's blade descended. The guard would never report what he had seen. Kenteiru's features shifted. The guard would not be missed.

card.name: Ninube Aitso
card.text:
Ninja • Shadowlands
Battle, [BOW]: Bow a target enemy Personality with lower Chi. If he has no abilities, create a 2F/2C/0PH Ninja • Shadowlands Personality.
card.flavor: "The dragon is not with us any longer," Aitso whispered. "And so my kin and I need... certain things. Things you can supply."

card.name: Chuda Teraiko
card.text:
Shadowlands • Shugenja
Maho Battle: Fear equal to the Force of your target Personality; destroy him if he is bowed, and bow him if he is unbowed.
card.flavor: "Kanpeki-sama has welcomed us back into the fold, my pets. It is time that we repaid the favor and hunt those who hunt him."

card.name: Ashigaru Gunso
card.text:
Ashigaru • Commander
After Ashigaru Gunso enters play, if your Sensei is Hikahime, create a 0F/1C/0PH Ashigaru • Conscript Personality.
Battle: Bow one or more of your target unbowed Ashigaru Conscripts. Ranged Attack equal to the number this bowed.
card.flavor: "Of low birth I may be, but I am a warrior born just the same."

card.name: Banished - exp
card.text:
Ishiken • Ronin • Shugenja • Void • Experienced • Resilient
After Banished enters play, lose 2 Honor. Will not join a Phoenix Clan player.
Void Battle: Ranged 3 Attack. If this destroys a Phoenix Clan Personality, you may move Banished home.
card.flavor: "You cast me out unjustly, then dare lay claim to what is mine? I will see you all burn!"

card.name: Venerable Spirit
card.text:
Ashigaru • Spirit
Battle: Straighten one or two of your target Conscripts.
Battle: Bow one or more of your target unbowed Ashigaru Conscripts. Fear equal to the number this bowed.
card.flavor: It is not a fact that most shugenja dwell upon, but there are spirits who watch over the lower castes, not merely samurai. It causes some to question certain truths that ought not be questioned...

card.name: Seppun Omihiru
card.text: Imperial • Magistrate • Shugenja
card.flavor: The ascendance of a new Emperor is always a matter of great concern for the Imperial families. The shugenja tradition of the Seppun, in particular, must acclimate to their new charge and ensure his habits are taken into consideration.

card.name: Kenturo
card.text:
Ashigaru • Scout
After Kenturo enters play, if your Sensei is Hikahime, create a 0F/1C/0PH Ashigaru • Conscript Personality.
Battle: Bow one or more of your target unbowed Ashigaru Conscripts. Give a target enemy Follower or Personality a Force penalty equal to the number this bowed.
card.flavor: "Of course, my lord. My weapon is yours to do as you please."

card.name: Moto Baatar
card.text:
Scout • Samurai • Cavalry • Reserve
(You may Recruit a Reserve Personality, if they would be opposed, as an Absent Battle action.)
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 2 Attack. Straighten Baatar if he has a Spear, the Ranged Attack targeted a Phoenix Clan Personality, or he entered play this battle.
card.flavor: "Fool. You insult my blood, you insult my ancestors. Would any samurai respond differently?"

card.name: Shinjo Chairei
card.text:
Magistrate • Samurai
Chairei has +1F if you are Dragon Clan.
Courtesy: Chairei has Cavalry. (Courtesy traits do not take effect if you went first.)
card.flavor: "The Empire is a vast and wondrous place, and at any given time there are a multitude of fascinating events transpiring. None of this has caused me to forget Shikei's insult."

card.name: Utaku Sakiko - exp
card.text:
Battle Maiden • Magistrate • Samurai • Cavalry • Destined • Experienced • Reserve
Battle, [BOW]: Melee 3 Attack that may bow the target instead of destroying it; if this bows the target, gain 2 Honor. If Sakiko has entered play or moved this turn, straighten her.
card.flavor: The Unicorn spent centuries wandering the lands beyond the Empire. During this time, samurai and peasant alike were united in the cause of survival. The Unicorn have not forgotten those roots.

card.name: Shinjo Tsung-min
card.text:
Commander • Samurai • Cavalry • Reserve
(You may Recruit a Reserve Personality, if they would be opposed, as an Absent Battle action.)
Battle: Give a target enemy Personality a Force penalty equal to your target unbowed Personality's Personal Honor.
card.flavor: "My words may not inspire, nor my deeds inflame the soul. But I can harness the fervor in my troops' hearts. Our honor is why we shall never be broken."

card.name: Utaku Masako
card.text:
Battle Maiden • Commander • Samurai • Cavalry
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to the battle.)
Masako has +1F/+1C for each of your Provinces that have been destroyed this game.
card.flavor: "I will not allow you to sully these plains. Death awaits those who would threaten my home."

card.name: Utaku Zo Sia
card.text:
Cavalry
Compassion: Zo Sia has the ability, "Open, [PAY 2]: If Zo Sia is honorably dead, put her face-up in your target Province, discarding any card there." (Compassion takes effect while you have fewer Provinces than anyone else.)
card.flavor: "Since the return of Lady Shinjo, stories have surfaced of a child who neither ages or dies. There are rumors that she is... immortal."

card.name: Fresh Recruits
card.text:
Ashigaru
This Follower has +1F for each other Ashigaru in this unit.
card.flavor: The bulk of all Rokugan's armies are made up of ashigaru levies, organized legions of warriors from the lower castes, given a modicum of training and the right to fight for their lords.

card.name: Intimidation Tactic
card.text: Open: Bow your target unbowed Follower. Make a Fear effect equal to its Force. If your Follower's Personality is a Commander, the Fear destroys any Followers after it bows them.
card.flavor: "I will use my smaller axe, just out of respect for your obviously inferior weaponry."

card.name: The Thundering Death
card.text:
Cavalry
Battle: Fear 3 that, if this unit is Cavalry, destroys Infantry cards after it bows them (Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 3 or lower Force).
card.flavor: On the battlefield, the sound of thunder under a clear sky is the sound of impending death.

card.name: Caravan Guards
card.text:
Expendable
(Draw a card after your Expendable card dies.)
This Personality cannot attack. After this Follower is destroyed, gain 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "On the honor of my ancestors, you have lost your last caravan to gaijin raiders while I live."

card.name: Razorfang
card.text:
Cat • Nonhuman
Compassion: This Follower's printed ability has no bow cost. (Compassion takes effect while you have fewer Provinces than anyone else.)
Battle, [BOW]: Melee 3 Attack.
card.flavor: The warcats of the Lion posses a hierarchy, just as do the samurai they serve.

card.name: Legion of the Ninth Kami
card.text:
Nonhuman • Shadowlands • Undead
After this Follower enters play, lose 2 Honor.
Interrupt: If the action is from an Undead card, its Fear effects may target Items and Spells, and destroy attachments after they bow them.
card.flavor: They have foresworn their lord's name until his spirit is returned to the Realm of Evil.

card.name: Junghar Regulars
card.text:
Cavalry
Engage: Give a target Follower or Personality +2F or -2F.
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 3 Attack.
card.flavor: The Three Armies of the Khan are no longer what they once were, but they remain nonetheless.

card.name: Hirakura's Attendant
card.text:
Earth • Nonhuman • Spirit
Earth Battle, [BOW]: Melee 3 Attack. Straighten this Follower if it is attached to an Earth Personality.
card.flavor: "Bandits?" Hirakura laughed. "How entertaining. Please deal with them, my friend."

card.name: Conscription Officer
card.text:
Ashigaru
Open, [BOW]: Create a 1F Ashigaru Follower and attach it to your target Personality.
card.flavor: Who will join me? Who will stand beside the great samurai who protect us? Who will take up arms to defend his home and family?

card.name: Shiotome Patrol
card.text:
Battle Maiden • Cavalry
Battle: Give a target enemy defending Personality -3F. Gain 1 Honor if his Force is now 0.
card.flavor: "Should we retreat?" the Shiba asked. His commander shook his head. "There would be no point at all."

card.name: Master Bowman's Yumi
card.text:
Bow • Two-Handed • Weapon
(A Personality may only have one Weapon.)
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 3 Attack (Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 3 or lower Force.)
card.flavor: The Tsuruchi sensei allow their students to view it, reverently informing them of the enemies it has thwarted and the lives it has claimed.

card.name: Village Defenders
card.text:
Ashigaru • Conscript
Battle: Straighten your target Ashigaru.
card.flavor: "You are not one of us! You are not one of the samurai! Begone from our home or die!"

card.name: Shield of the Honored Soul
card.text:
Armor
(A Personality can only have one Armor.)
Interrupt: Negate the action's Force penalties on all cards in this unit.
card.flavor: "When one commits fully to a course of action, with no doubt or remorse in one's heart, defeat cannot be the outcome." - Akodo's Leadership

card.name: Box of Secrets
card.text: Your Personalities with this Personality's Family Name enter play for 1 less Gold.
card.flavor: "To all scions of the Phoenix Clan, be aware that the Forgotten wave man calling himself the Banished has taken objects of incredible importance. He is to be found at all costs, and the items recovered. As the Banished has not seen the errors of his ways, his survival is not desired." - The Elemental Masters

card.name: Fang of Vengeance
card.text:
One-Handed • Sword • Reserve • Weapon
(You may Equip a Reserve attachment, if it would be opposed, as a Battle action.)
After this Item enters play, if the last action another player took destroyed one of your cards, you may take an additional action.
Battle, [BOW]: Melee 2 Attack.
card.flavor: If revenge is a beast, then surely this is its fang.

card.name: Kano's Tessen
card.text:
One-Handed • Tessen • Weapon
Equips to Akodo Kano for 1 less Gold. You may use this Personality's Tactical Advantage ability as an Engage.
card.flavor: The Lion Champion stared at her older brother. "I wish only to serve you, sister," he said, smiling. "This conflict with the Scorpion... it bears ill omens for the Empire, and I need to do my part to see it ended swiftly and victoriously."

card.name: Flawless Naginata
card.text:
Polearm • Two-Handed • Courage • Weapon
(Repeatable Interrupt: Discard a Courage card to give a Fear effect +2 or -2 strength.)
Battle, [BOW]: Melee 2 Attack (Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 2 or lower Force).
card.flavor: Sometimes a mere reputation is enough to make a weapon terrible.

card.name: Swordcatcher
card.text:
One-Handed • Peasant • Weapon
Your deck may include four copies of this Item. After it attaches, dishonor its Personality.
Battle, [BOW]: Fear 2 that may target Items and Spells, and may not be increased or combined except with other Swordcatchers. Return any attachments this Fear bowed to their owner's hand.
card.flavor: "What now, Spider?"

card.name: Poisoned Shuriken
card.text:
Ninja • One-Handed • Weapon
After this Item enters play, lose 3 Honor.
Ninja Battle, [BOW]: Bow a target enemy Personality with a Poison token or without abilities.
card.flavor: "They are completely ineffective as weapons on their own, but of course the shuriken itself is not the weapon, is it?" - Bayushi Fuyuko

card.name: Inevitable Victory
card.text:
Heavy Weapon • Jade • Two-Handed • Destined • Weapon
Will not attach to a Shadowlands Personality. This Personality has +1PH. After your turn begins, give this Weapon a +1F/+1C token.
card.flavor: "I created it for the war against the Spider. No, I don't think the name is presumptuous. Why do you ask?" - Kaiu Watsuki

card.name: Matched Daisho
card.text:
One-Handed • Sword • Weapon
As a Focus Effect, after a player wins the duel, they may discard a card to draw a card.
This Item has +1F/+1C while this Personality has another Matched Daisho or you have Compassion. (Compassion takes effect while you have fewer Provinces than anyone else.)
card.flavor: Born of the same forge, brothers of life and death.

card.name: Reinforced Yari
card.text:
Spear • Two-Handed • Weapon
Will only attach to an Infantry Personality. This Personality cannot gain Cavalry. Cavalry Personalities may not move to oppose this Personality in the Engage segment.
card.flavor: "They are too heavy for a rider to carry, and awkward even for infantry. Their reinforced haft and specially built tips are more than sufficient to pierce both a horse and its rider. We will put them to good use." - Isawa Nobuo

card.name: Fangs of the Heavens
card.text:
This Shugenja loses and cannot gain Naval.
Thunder Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 2 Attack. If this Shugenja is Thunder, you may bow this Shugenja and destroy this Spell to make a second consecutive Ranged 2 Attack. These Ranged Attacks cannot be combined (with any Ranged Attacks).
card.flavor: To seek the blessings of Osano-wo is to seek death itself.

card.name: On Storm-Borne Wings
card.text: Thunder Engage, [BOW]: A great storm surrounds your army. Give your target Personality +1F. The next time the enemy leader targets one of your cards in this battle with a Battle action, they must target that Personality, if legal.
card.flavor: "All of the elements are equally balanced in a ranging storm. But balance does not always mean peace." - Moshi Madohime

card.name: Terrible Revelations
card.text:
While this Shugenja is Void, he has Expendable.
Void Battle/Open, [BOW]: Raise this Shugenja's Force to equal his Chi.
card.flavor: Enomoto's Prophecy, like many before, heralded things that none wished to consider. However, as it became better understood, many found they could not tear their thoughts away.

card.name: Stepping Behind the Tapestry
card.text:
This Personality cannot be targeted. His abilities, and the abilities on his other attachmnets, cannot be used. Cards in this unit do not contribute Force during battle resolution unless they are Air.
Air Battle/Open: Destroy this Spell.
card.flavor:
"Wasn't there one more? A woman, I think."
"No. We searched the temple. There was no one else."

card.name: Tracing with the Mountain's Finger
card.text: Earth Battle, [BOW]: Melee 1 Attack, plus 1 if this Shugenja is Earth, plus 1 if the current Province's strength has been increased or reduced this turn (Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with Force equal to or lower than the Melee Attack's strength).
card.flavor: No matter how he ran, the boulder turned in tandem. Every glance, it was closer. His heart raced as the Kuni laughed in the distance. "This is how you crush a spider!"

card.name: Trick of Moon's Light
card.text:
Destroy this Spell after it straightens unless this Shugenja is Air.
Air Open, [BOW]: Create a 0F/3C/0PH Air • Illusion • Nonhuman • Shugenja Personality. This Spell may remain bowed. Remove the Illusion from the game after the next time this Spell straightens or leaves play.
card.flavor: "All of that dedication, years of dojo training, the lessons of their sensei... and still they trust their eyes. Now to figure out why he was here..."

card.name: Numinous Mantra
card.text: Battle, [BOW]: Take two additional actions to cast Spells. You cannot target other players or their cards this battle until after their next opportunity to take a Battle action.
card.flavor: Spells are scrolls containing incantations. They are prayers, sacred utterances meant to invoke the kami who aid the caster. Memorizing these complex prayers is difficult and tedious. Of course, there are also spells to help with that.

card.name: Seeking Answers
card.text: Open, [BOW]: Show the top three cards of your Fate deck. Another player chooses and discards one. Put one of the two remaining cards in your hand and discard the other. Destroy this Spell.
card.flavor: "I must find the answer. Only... only I dare not ask the question."

card.name: The Spaces In-Between
card.text:
This action has Absent while this Shugenja is Water.
Water Home Battle: Move this Personality home or to a battlefield where he would be opposed.
card.flavor: "Water flows through any gap, no matter how slight or small." - Iuchi Wattu

card.name: Nourished by Fallen Leaves
card.text:
Earth
This Shugenja has Conqueror while he is Earth.
After your action resolves, if it bowed an enemy card, give this Shugenja +1F.
card.flavor: "Dead leaves nourish the seedlings. It is the way of the world." - Tamori Mabasu

card.name: Veil of Water
card.text: Water Interrupt, [BOW]: If this Shugenja is unbowed and is targeted by the Battle action, bow him, negate the action, and you may move him home if he is Water.
card.flavor: "There is no place more peaceful that the center of a typhoon." - The Book of Water

card.name: Warning Flame
card.text: Fire Battle, [BOW]: Give a target opposed Personality either +1F or -1F for each card in his unit, up to 3.
card.flavor: "Of all the elemental kami, it is those of flame who are most eager to take shape in the world. Only the smallest of offerings... a cand;e's flame, a slight spark... and they manifest in full force, albeit briefly." - Isawa Koiso

card.name: Darkness Inside
card.text: Ninja Battle: Give a target enemy Personality -1F for each Ninja Personality in your army. If the target now has 0 Force or no abilities, you may take an additional action.
card.flavor: Power flooded through Kanpeki's form, filling him with a strength he had never dreamt of. "Father!" he shouted. "I will strike them down in your name, father!"

card.name: Immaterial Weapons
card.text: Battle: Give a target enemy Personality -2F, or -4F if his controller had more cards in hand than you before you played this card.
card.flavor: "Have you sometimes suspected that your own thoughts are the enemy?" - Togashi Shao

card.name: An Honored Guest
card.text:
Kharmic
Interrupt: Permanently give +1PH to a target Personality the action is Recruiting. You may Proclaim him even if he does not have your Clan Alignment.
card.flavor: The home is a sacred place in Rokugan. It is a samurai's sanctuary, a place of introspection and harmony. To invite a guest is a gesture of trust. So is honoring the invitation.

card.name: Leave It Abandoned
card.text: Siege Absent Battle: Give your target Fortification Expendable. Straighten it if your current army is opposed. Gain 1 Honor after it is destroyed during battle resolution. You may take an additional action. (Absent action may be taken without presence.)
card.flavor: Sometimes it is better to sacrifice the cart in order to save the ox.

card.name: The Indignity of Arrest
card.text: Battle: Target your unbowed Personality. Give a target enemy Personality a Force penalty equal to your Personality's Chi or the number of your Magistrates in his army, whichever is higher.
card.flavor: "The nature of this man's crmes justifies the manner of his arrest, Kitsuki-sama. He does not deserve the courtesy afforded to others of his rank."

card.name: Caught Among Thieves
card.text:
Courage
Open: Bow your target unbowed Personality. Target another player's Personality. Gain 1 Honor. If your Personality is a Magistrate, draw a card if the other target has lower Personal Honor, and straighten your Personality if the other target is dishonorable.
card.flavor: "I can only imagine why you might seek the company of such scum, Shosuro-san."

card.name: Walls of Death
card.text:
Siege Interrupt: If you have a Fortification at the current battlefield, negate an Engage action.
Siege Battle: Bow your target unbowed Fortification. Ranged Attack equal to half its Gold Cost, rounded up, plus 1.
card.flavor: An army protecting lands that have been prepared for war is difficult to assail.

card.name: Secret Alliances
card.text:
Invest [PAY 3]: Before you draw cards at the end of the turn, put this card into your hand from the discard pile.
Political Open: Permanently give your target Courtier Expendable and the trait, "After another player's action targets this card, gain 1 Honor."
card.flavor: "Our sensei have pitted us against one another. I believe it may be some manner of wager." - Petals and Pincer, V

card.name: Unforgivable
card.text: Battle: Take two additional actions. Strategies discarded by any of these additional actions that is Tactical Advantage permanently gain Discipline [PAY 1]. You may not target other players or their cards until after their next opportunity to take a Battle action.
card.flavor: "That is it! That overgrown cockroach has crossed the final line! Kyuden Bayushi will burn for what he's done! I will anoint my blade with his arterial spray and drown his family in his blood!"

card.name: The Looming Darkness
card.text:
You may only play one The Looming Darkness per turn.
Open: Either give all Shadowlands Personalities +1F/+1C or give all non-Shadowlands Personalities a minimum of 1 Chi and -1F/-1C. Lose 2 Honor.
card.flavor: "Those beasts have never been seen this far into our borders. How did they get here?" - Hida Kisada

card.name: Dense Jungle
card.text:
Terrain • Kharmic
After this Terrain leaves play, straighten the Personalities it bowed.
Battle: Destroy a Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play. Starting with you, each player targets and bows one of his unbowed Personalities at this battlefield.
card.flavor: The expansion of the Empire exposed its people to new forms of life.

card.name: Terrorizing Ambush
card.text:
Terrain
Your Melee Attacks have +1 strength. Other players' Melee Attacks have -1 strength.
Battle/Engage: Destroy a Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play.
card.flavor: "The ashigaru broke the moment the Spider reserves appeared. The Imperials should have known not to rely on peasant levies." - Akodo Dairuko

card.name: Accepting the Choice
card.text: Open, [PAY 2]: Discard a card to search your Fate deck for a card and put it in your hand.
card.flavor:
"You will make a fine Emperor, my brother."
"You would have as well."

card.name: Unseemly Brawl
card.text: Battle: Target your Personality and an enemy Personality with lower Force. Give your Personality a Force bonus equal to the difference, to a maximum of +5F.
card.flavor: "And I say the Taint has returned! You think you can call a Crab a liar?" - Hida Zaiberu

card.name: Swifter than Sight
card.text: Interrupt: Bow your target unbowed Weapon to negate its Personality's destruction from the action and, if he is a Kensai and has two Weapons, to negate his movement and bowing from it. Destroy the Weapon.
card.flavor: Before the first word could leave the Spider's mouth, Kinshikirai's blade pinned his scroll-hand to the wall. "Now, Spider, let us discuss the punishment for treason."

card.name: Distracting Paranoia
card.text: Ninja Battle: Bow a target enemy card with a Poison token or without abilities.
card.flavor: "Sometimes a target's very alertness can be turned against hime." - Unknown Shosuro sensei

card.name: The Dark Sword's Lunacy
card.text:
Courage
