As a Focus Effect, after this duel resolves, put this card into your hand if you lost.
Battle: Bow your target unbowed Personality. Move home a target enemy unit with fewer attachments or with lower Force than your Personality. Straighten your Personality if he has two Weapons attached.
card.flavor: "Sanity? Tactics? Who needs those? Bwahahahaha!!!"

card.name: Strike of the Obsidian Blade
card.text: Iaijutsu Battle: Your target unbowed Personality challenges a target enemy Personality. Give the loser -2F and dishonor him. If you won, you may take an additional action which may not target enemy cards other than the loser.
card.flavor: Their treachery exposed, the Spider rampaged through the Colonies and the Empire. Some tried to stop them, but their brutal techniques too often proved superior. - Otomo Hiroshi, The Final Days, third scroll

card.name: Battlefield Challenge
card.text: Iaijutsu Battle: Your target unbowed Personality challenges a target enemy Personality. Bow the loser. The winner gains 2 Honor.
card.flavor: Samurai are always eager to test their skills in single combat, and on the field of war there is no need for the niceties of dueling protocol.

card.name: Dissension in Command
card.text:
Terrain
Battle/Engage: Give a target attacking Personality -3F. Destroy a Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play.
card.flavor: The struggle to defeat the treacherous Spider was made more difficult by disputes of precedence between the clan forces. Kanpeki's followers took full advantage. - Otomo HIroshi, The Final Days, fourth scroll.

card.name: Kharma's First Form
card.text:
Kata • Kharmic
Open: Put this Kata into play. Discard your other Kata in play.
Open, [BOW]: Put a target Kharmic card in your Fate discard pile into your hand. Discard a card.
card.flavor: "As the bonsai must be pruned to flourish, so too must the Empire be managed. The time has come for the Spider to be sheared away. It is simply the way of things."

card.name: Narrow Passage
card.text:
Terrain
While there is only one Personality in the defending army, he has Force and Chi bonuses equal to the number of units in the attacking army and has Resilient.
Battle: Destroy a Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play.
card.flavor: "You could number a thousand, but if only two of you can face me at a time, you will never pass."

card.name: Amethyst Adjunct
card.text: Economic Open: Target your unbowed Personality. Straighten a target Holding that has not produced Gold this turn. If you targeted a Courtier or Phoenix Clan Personality, give the Holding +1GP (this turn).
card.flavor: Kodo bowed, touching her head to the floor. "I will serve you well, Minori-sama. This is my vow." Kneeling, her smile was concealed.

card.name: Ivory Ascendance
card.text:
Invest [PAY 2]: If you are Scorpion Clan, draw a card.
Battle/Open: Dishonor a target Personality. You may take an additional action.
card.flavor: "My dearest Tselu has done all that I could ask and more as my Ivory Champion. Will you be equal to his example, Shizuka?" The Scorpion's eyes twinkled. "You will be amazed, my lady."

card.name: Onyx Ascendance
card.text: Maho Battle: Destroy your target unbowed Follower or Personality. Destroy a target enemy card without attachments and lower or equal Gold Cost. Create a 2F/2C/0PH Nonhuman • Shadowlands • Undead Personality at the current battlefield. Lose 2 Honor unless you are Scorpion Clan.
card.flavor: Kichi's eyes stared upward, sightless. "Power consumes those who cannot wield it properly," Yogo Ameiko said, smirking. "Innocent little fox, you never had a chance."

card.name: Ruby Ascendance
card.text:
Courage
These actions have Absent if they target a Cavalry card or you ever had presence at the current battlefield.
Battle: Negate a target card's current Force bonuses or penalties (your choice).
Battle: Negate the current Province's current strength bonuses or penalties (your choice).
card.flavor: Tamahime regarded her new station with bemusement. "This will do."

card.name: Turquoise Adjunct
card.text:
Invest [PAY 2]: If the target is Crane Clan or an Artisan, draw a card.
Open: Permanently give your target Personality the ability "Dynasty/Open, [BOW]: Discard a card to produce Gold equal to its Focus Value."
card.flavor: "I am privileged to serve in this capacity. My efforts shall restore prosperity to the Empire and Colonies alike." - Doji Dainagon

card.name: Ominous Rumors
card.text:
Kharmic
Political Open: Target a non-Shadowlands Personality whose player also controls a Shadowlands card. You accuse the target of consorting with the enemy. The Personality's controller may bow him. If he does not bow, dishonor him and draw a card.
card.flavor: The merest hint of Taint is sufficient to end careers. But what happens when gossip is based on truth?

card.name: Unwanted Tutelage
card.text:
Battle: Straighten a target card with a Melee or Ranged Attack ability. Lose 2 Honor.
Interrupt: If the action has a Melee or Ranged Attack, give it +2 strength. Lose 2 Honor.
card.flavor: He frowned and shook his head, trying to clear his mind. The shot seemed perfect, but at the same time something seemed terribly wrong.

card.name: Walking with the Water
card.text:
Terrain
Water Absent Battle: Destroy a Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play. If he would be opposed, move your target Personality at any location to this battlefield. You may straighten the Ring of Water.
card.flavor: "There are riddles of the world so much greater than the piddling nonsense most men concern themselves with." - Togashi Noburo

card.name: The Price of Shame
card.text: Battle: Give a target enemy Personality -3F. Dishonor him if he now has 0 Force.
card.flavor: Saeki swept Oneiyara's legs out from under him, sending him spiraling into the dirt. "Do you think you are better than the peasants? That you mean any more than they do? They know the honor of service! You are nothing more than a bandit!"

card.name: Strength of the Torrent
card.text: Kiho Water Battle: Target your unbowed Monk or Shugenja and give one or two target enemy Followers or Personalities -2F. Bow each enemy target that now has 0 Force.
card.flavor: A sudden torrent of water knocked the soldiers down before they could draw their blades. "There will be no need for steel today," she said with a laugh.

card.name: Confounding Departure
card.text:
Courtesy: This card's ability has no Gold Cost. (Courtesy traits do not take effect if you went first.)
Battle, [PAY 1]: Bow a target enemy card; if the target has any attachments, they must be bowed.
card.flavor: "Not today, vile enemies." She laughed as they coughed and cursed. The tricks of the Scorpion Clan were not completely without merit.

card.name: A Breed Apart
card.text: Kiho Battle: Straighten your target Monk or Shugenja, or negate his current Force penalties. You may target and bow an enemy Shadowlands card without attachments.
card.flavor: "Accept Daigotsu's blessing if you require it, lackey," Tetsuo sneered at the Kokujin monk. "I need not his strength to perform his will. My strength is sufficient."

card.name: Inexorable Advance
card.text: Battle: Target your Personality. Fear equal to the Force of his target Follower. If your Personality is a Commander, negate the next straightening of any card bowed by this Fear effect.
card.flavor: In the end, it was only proper for the Spider to have disappeared in advance. The charge of their enemies, had they remained, would have devastated them.

card.name: Not the End
card.text:
Kharmic
Battle: Ranged 1 Attack (Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 1 or lower Force). After this destroys a card, draw a card.
card.flavor: "An arrow like this killed me once," Endo sneered. "As you can see, it did not stop me then. It will not stop me now."

card.name: Sundered Blade
card.text: Iaijutsu Battle: Target your unbowed Personality. Bow a target enemy attachment. Destroy it if your Personality is a Duelist and his Chi is greater than or equal to the attachment's Force.
card.flavor: The snap of breaking metal was like a bell's chime. "Your weapons, like you, is inadequate," Toshigure said. "Speak to me of my clan's shortcomings again and see yourself broken as well."

card.name: Hira Sensei
card.text:
Crane • Mantis • Phoenix
You may not take more than six actions from Events per game.
Open, [BOW]: If you have taken an action from an Event in your Province this turn, turn a card in your Provinces face-up.

(-1 Province Strength)
card.flavor: "I set aside worldly concerns to find peace within the Tao. I can find no peace with this mystery. I must have answers."

card.name: Unexpected Valor
card.text:
Discipline [Pay 0]. (Pay 0 Gold to play, then remove from the game, this Discipline in your discard.)
Battle: Straighten your target card that was bowed by another player's card effect this battle.
card.flavor: "I may die, but I will not be a coward. In the next life, my soul will find better means."

card.name: Virtuous Victory
card.text: Battle: Give your target opposed Personality +2F. You may target an enemy Personality with lower Personal Honor; if you do, give him -2F gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: Honor transcends the waxing and waning of politics. The Crane remain dedicated to ensuring that improper conduct is met with appropriate consequence.

card.name: Be Silent!
card.text:
Courtesy: Discipline [PAY 2]. (Courtesy traits do not take effect if you went first.)
Political Interrupt: If the action is a Favor action, negate Personalities' movement home from its effects.
card.flavor: "Speak to me again, cur, and it will cost you your tongue, if not your life."

card.name: Ichigo Sensei
card.text:
Crab • Dragon • Lion • Scorpion • Unicorn
After an enemy card is destroyed during a battle, if the destruction was not from another player's card effect, gain 1 Honor.

(-1 Province Strength)
card.flavor: "My Emperor, I am the master sensei of the Seppun Tactical Dojo. It will be my great honor to advise you in any matter you require. Call upon me at any time, for any reason."

card.name: Hikahime Sensei
card.text:
All Clans
You may include four copies of each non-Unique Ashigaru Personality in your deck. Your non-Ashigaru Personalities in and out of play have +1 Gold Cost. You can not play Oath of Fealty.
Open, [BOW], [PAY 2]: If you control an Ashigaru Personality, create a 0F/1C/0PH Ashigaru • Conscript Personality.

(-1 Gold Production, -2 Starting Honor)
card.flavor: "Forward! Show them the steel of our souls!"

card.name: Yajinden Sensei
card.text:
Spider Clan
You may only Recruit Shadowlands Personalities. You do not lose Honor from your Shadowlands Followers and Human Shadowlands Personalities. Fear actions from your Spider Clan Personalities and Stronghold destroy attachments after bowing them.

(-1 Province Strength, -2 Family Honor)
card.flavor: "The Empire has forgotten me. Unacceptable."

card.name: War of the Spirit Realms
card.text: Ninja Open, [PAY 2]: You may target and bow a Spell. Search your Fate deck for a Ninja Strategy, show it, and put it in your hand. Lose 2 Honor.
card.flavor: As the ancestral guardians shimmered into existence, the samurai-ko licked her lips anxiously. "This was not in the intelligence," she whispered. Then the air shimmered again, and the hungry dead spilled forth. "The Kwanchai's daughter will not be harmed!" they hissed.

card.name: Ominous Revelation
card.text:
Invest [PAY 2]: The Event may be Unique.
Political Open: Search your Dynasty deck for a non-Unique Event not named Ominous Revelation and refill this Province with it, face-up.
card.flavor: The crowd fell silent as Kozan continued. "The Dark Lord has chosen to renege on his agreement with the Empress. The Taint endures... it has only remained hidden."

card.name: Battle of the First Seal
card.text: Open: Dark times are coming. Personalities with 3 or more Personal Honor have -1F. Personalities with 0 Personal Honor have +1F.
card.flavor: The Spider's unholy army outnumbered the temple's defenders more than fifty to one. The samurai fought with honor, but they could not hold back the dark tide. Renyu and Norimichi's magic tore the world asunder, but when Norimichi fell, their defeat was inevitable.

card.name: Master of Clear Water Dojo
card.text:
Dojo • Retainer
This Holding enters play for 1 less Gold if another of your Dojos entered play this turn.
card.flavor: The dojo at Sunda Mizu Mura is the largest in Crab lands, and the finest veterans of the Crab armies go there to teach the next generation.

card.name: Shadowless Strike Dojo
card.text:
Dojo
Battle/Open, [BOW]: Target your Duelist who has not been targeted by a Shadowless Strike Dojo this turn. Your Duelist has +1F while opposed. After he or she enters a duel facing a Personality with higher Chi, give your Duelist +1C in the duel's resolution.
card.flavor: "Crane poets like to say their bushi's blades strike so swiftly they cast no shadow. A typical exaggeration." - Ikoma Asa

card.name: The Iron Mountain School
card.text:
Dojo
Open: Once per game, create and attach a +2F/+1C One-Handed • Sword • Weapon Item to your target Duelist.
card.flavor: "The Dragon are fond of strange gempukku customs. What does a poem show about one's martial skills?" - Ikoma Kiyomako

card.name: Libraries of Kyuden Isawa
card.text:
Library
Interrupt, [BOW]: After the action Equips a Spell from your hand, draw a card. You may not use abilities on any Libraries of Kyuden Isawa again this turn.
card.flavor: The visions and prophecy offered by the Heavens warned that a terrible fate would come to pass, but a small group swore they would stop it at any cost.

card.name: Ki-Rin's Shrine - exp2
card.text:
Temple • Experienced 2 • Kharmic
After a Kharmic action puts this Holding into a discard pile, draw a card and remove this Holding from the game.
This Holding has +1GP when it pays for a single Kharmic action only.
card.flavor: "There are places," the Dragon whispered, "where this realm is bound to the Heavens. If we can find them, we can stop the prophecy."

card.name: The Ikoma Halls
card.text:
Library • Destined
(Draw a card after you Recruit a Destined card.)
After you draw a card for bringing this Holding into play, if you then have four or more cards in your hand, discard a card.
card.flavor: "A strange incident took place in the halls of the Ikoma last month. As a historian myself, I can only hope to someday chronicle the truth of it." - Otomo Hiroshi

card.name: The Miya Records
card.text:
Library
Open, [BOW]: Transfer your target Spell (in play) to your target Shugenja.
card.flavor: The theft of a few obscure scrolls from Kyuden Miya was never explained. Few even noticed their absence.

card.name: Retired Scholar
card.text:
Library • Retainer • Kharmic
This Holding has +1GP when it pays to Recruit or Equip a single Library or Spell only.
card.flavor: Just as some samurai choose to serve the clan as advisors in their old age, some aged shugenja continue to work as librarians and scholars.

card.name: Defensive Fortification
card.text:
Fortification
You may take this Holding's actions during a battle at any battlefield where you control a Siege Personality.
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 2 Attack.
Interrupt, [BOW]: Give the action's Ranged Attacks +2 strength.
card.flavor: "I do not care what it was! If it rears its head again, blast it off!"

card.name: Spirit's Essence Dojo
card.text:
Dojo
After this Holding enters play from a Province, refill the Province face-up.
card.flavor: Generations ago, the War of Spirits nearly tore the Empire apart. Some secrets of that time remain hidden within Rokugan.

card.name: Dojo of the Dauntless
card.text:
Dojo
You may Recruit this Holding as an Open. After you Recruit this Holding, you may target and straighten a Duelist.
card.flavor: "You are weary, you say? How fortunate for you that the enemies of the Scorpion are also weary. Do it again! Ten more times!" - Bayushi Hisako

card.name: Temple of the First Seal
card.text:
Temple
Interrupt, [BOW]: Give one of the action's Fear effects +1 strength.
card.flavor: Nestled deeply in a hidden ravine far inside the Shinomen Mori, the temple waited. It was a memory of a time before man, before even the Naga, and no one had disturbed it for untold thousands of years... until now.

card.name: City of Night - exp
card.text:
Library • Experienced
Battle, [BOW]: Straighten your target Spell. You may use its abilities a second time this turn, but they do not give Force bonuses to unopposed Personalities.
card.flavor: Hidden away in the recesses of the Spine of the World Mountains, the impossibly ancient library at the City of Night waited for the Dragon.

card.name: The Feeding Hills
card.text:
Nonhuman • Oni • Shadowlands
After this Holding enters play, lose 3 Honor. This Holding enters play for 1 less Gold for each Shadowlands Follower and Personality you control. After you bow this Holding, lose 1 Honor.
Open, [BOW]: Straighten your target Oni.
card.flavor: "What a pleasant place to rest! I wonder where these stairs go... Oh Fortunes, no! Aaaaagh!"

card.name: Erected Watchtower
card.text:
Expendable • Fortification
This Holding enters play unbowed if you control any Siege Personalities.
Open, [BOW]: If you control any Personalities, gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: In times of great conflict, defenses built in haste are vastly superior to no defenses at all.

card.name: Shinsei's Last Hope - exp
card.text:
Experienced
Battle, [BOW]: Give a target enemy Follower or Personality -2F. If the target is Shadowlands and attacking, give it -4F instead and bow it if its Force is now 0.
card.flavor: Deep within the boundaries of the Shadowlands, there once stood a pure village immune to the Taint. Its history has been one of secrets and tragedy, but now it may play a role of great importance once again.

card.name: Hida Genda
card.text:
Commander • Samurai • Tactician
Battle: Melee 1 Attack, with +2 strength if Genda has a Heavy Weapon or has used his rulebook Tactical Advantage ability this turn.
card.flavor:
"Come, sister! Let us crush these Spider with the might of the first Crab Thunder's bloodline!"
"I think I heard one of them say we only had a single samurai's worth of eyes between us," Ayameko replied, smiling with a vengeful relish.

card.name: Kaiu O-Taro
card.text:
Samurai • Seige • Reserve
O-Taro enters play for 1 less Gold during battle for each Fortification attached to the current Province. After you discard a card for an Honor action, give O-Taro +1F. You may Proclaim O-Taro even if it is not your turn.
card.flavor: "The nickname's a joke, but it isn't wise to laugh about it." - Kaiu Gorobei

card.name: Kaiu Eichi
card.text:
Samurai • Seige • Resilient
Other players' Melee and Ranged attacks targeting cards in Eichi's unit have a strength penalty equal to the number of your Fortifications at his battlefield. Battle: Take an additional action from your Fortification, even if it is at an adjacent battlefield.
card.flavor: "All according to plan."

card.name: Kuni Tenba
card.text:
Earth • Shugenja
Tenba has Cavalry while you are the Defender and he has an Earth Spell.
Battle: Give a target enemy Follower or Personality -3F.
card.flavor: "I want to show you something Tamori Seiken-sama taught me," was the last thing the goblins heard, other than the sound of their own bones snapping beneath stone hooves.

card.name: Kuni Renyu - exp4
card.text:
Daimyo • Earth • Jade • Magistrate • Shugenja • Witch Hunter • Experienced 4 • Loyal • Unique
Your Provinces have +1 strength. Your Earth Personalities (including Renyu) have Resilient.
Earth Jade Tireless Battle: Straighten your target Earth Personality. You may target and bow an enemy card with Shadowlands or lower Force than Renyu.
card.flavor: "At last, the Spider will perish."

card.name: Kuni Hokinsha
card.text:
Earth • Shugenja
Hokinsha has +1C if you are Mantis Clan or have Courtesy. (Courtesy does not take effect if you went first.)
Battle: Straighten your Sensei. You may use its abilities a second time this turn. Take an additional action.
card.flavor: The revelations about the Taint forced the Kuni to spread themselves thin, seeking all who might be corrupted.

card.name: Doji Natsuyo - exp
card.text:
Courtier • Experienced
Ignore Natsuyo's Honor Requirement while you control Bayushi Fuyuko.
Political Home Interrupt, [BOW]: When taking Honor Interrupts to the action, you may remove Political Honor cards in your discard pile from the game instead of discarding them from your hand.
card.flavor: "Politics never ends."

card.name: Doji Soeka - exp
card.text:
Courtier • Magistrate • Experienced
Political Open: Remove an ability from a target Holding or attachment.
Tireless Battle: Move Soeka home. (Tireless actions may be taken even while bowed.)
card.flavor: "Sins are useful tools. I cannot believe we have made so little use of them before."

card.name: Doji Ikei
card.text:
Magistrate • Samurai • Resilient
After the first time each turn you resolve an Honor action, give Ikei a +1F Respect token if he has two or fewer Respect tokens.
card.flavor: He struck with blinding speed, but his expression never changed. "Your incompetence bores me, criminal."

card.name: Kakita Daitsu - exp
card.text:
Samurai • Duelist • Experienced • Kensai
Cards focused by Daitsu's opponent in duels have -1FV while you control, or the opponent is, Kakita Shinichi. Daitsu will only attach one Weapon.
Iaijutsu Battle, [BOW]: Melee 3 Attack. You may bow a Sword attached to Daitsu to straighten him.
card.flavor: "Those old sparring sessions saved my life that day, Shinishi-san. I owe you much."

card.name: Kakita Inaka
card.text:
Artisan • Courtier • Jester
Political Battle, [BOW]: Move home a target enemy dishonorable Personality.
card.flavor: The Kakita Jesters are often sneered at by other samurai - until a moment of mockery steals their On before all the court.

card.name: Kakita Oshaberi
card.text:
Artisan • Courtier • Jester • The Masked Crane • Expendable
Melee and Ranged Attacks targeting Oshaberi have -3 strength.
Political Engage: Other players do not gain Honor for destroying your cards in this battle's resolution.
Political Open, [BOW]: Straighten your Sensei.
card.flavor: "How could my silly faces offend a fine warrior such as yourself?"

card.name: Sannin
card.text:
Monk • Tattooed
After Sannin enters play, permanently give them one of the following abilities (and its elemental keyword) not already on your Sannin in play: "Void Dynasty, [BOW]: Recruit a Sannin from your discard pile or Dynasty deck."; "Fire Battle, [BOW]: Melee 3 Attack."; or "Air Battle: Straighten a target Sannin."
card.flavor: They serve as the clan requires.

card.name: Kitsuki Goto
card.text:
Courtier • Magistrate • Resilient
(Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution.)
Political Interrupt, [BOW]: If you took an Honor Interrupt to the action, return the Honor card you discarded for it to your hand. You may not take Honor actions this turn.
card.flavor: "Do not place your trust in words or people. Trust your senses and reason." - Agasha Kitsuki

card.name: Kitsuki Goshi
card.text:
Courtier • Magistrate • Destined
(Draw a card after you Recruit a Destined card.)
Interrupt: After the action destroys a dishonorable Personality, gain 1 Honor.
Engage: Dishonor a target enemy Personality with lower Chi.
card.flavor: "You have no reason to be here today, samurai. Your lord shall hear of this transgression."

card.name: Mirumoto Konoe
card.text:
Samurai • Duelist
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists.)
Battle: If Konoe is opposed, look at the top three cards of your Fate deck. You may discard a card to put one of them into your hand; if it is Iaijutsu, you may take an additional action to play it. Put the other cards back in any order.
card.flavor: "Forget honor, pretty words, and loyalty. I have my skill and my blade. I will prevail in every battle."

card.name: Tamori Gaitsuru
card.text:
Commander • Earth • Shugenja • Destined • Resilient
(Draw a card after you Recruit a Destined card. Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution.)
Gaitsuru's Earth attachments have Resilient.
card.flavor: The Tamori force themselves to be strong, to be rigid, to endure. In doing so, they hope never again to repeat the terrible corruption from the start of their line.

card.name: Tamori Daiishu - exp
card.text:
Commander • Earth • Shugenja • Experienced
Invest [PAY 2], or [PAY 0] if you have Courtesy: Search your deck for The Mountainborn or Unbound Spirit, show it, and put it in your hand. (Courtesy does not take effect if you went first.)
Earth Battle, [BOW]: Melee 3 Attack. You may bow one of Daiishu's Followers to straighten him.
card.flavor: "Crush them, my friend."

card.name: Akodo Misaka
card.text:
Samurai • Duelist
Iaijutsu Battle: Misaka challenges a target enemy Personality. The winner may target and give Reserve to a Personality in a Province, and if the winner was the challenged in the duel and defending, give that Reserve Personality -5GC.
card.flavor: "I could see you dead on the battlefield, Scorpion, but I wish to kill you myself."

card.name: Ikoma Morita
card.text:
Samurai • Scout
Battle: Fear equal to the number of attacking units in Morita's army, which may target a Personality with Followers if you control a Terrain.
card.flavor: The lands around Kyuden Ikoma were as familiar to him as his own flesh. He frowned at what he saw. "Someone has been here," he whispered.

card.name: Matsu Yamamura
card.text:
Beastmaster • Commander • Samurai • Scion of the Wind
Battle, [BOW]: Give Yamamura's target Nonhuman Follower a Force bonus equal to Yamamura's Force or the Force of any bowed enemy Follower or Personality.
card.flavor: "They are not so different from men. They crave both war and peace. They know love and violence. Perhaps they are more human than we are."

card.name: Matsu Takeuchi
card.text:
Beastmaster • Commander • Samurai • Cavalry
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to the battle.)
Battle: Straighten Takeuchi's target Follower. If it is a Cat with higher Force than an opposing bowed Follower or Personality, the Cat may use its abilities an additional time this turn.
card.flavor: "Come, brothers. War is the most glorious thing. There is always more prey."

card.name: Matsu Akio
card.text:
Samurai • Duelist • Tactician
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists. Battle: Discard a card to give this Tactcian a Force bonus equal to the card's Focus Value.)
After Akio uses her rulebook Tactical Advantage ability, give her a Chi bonus equal to half the Focus Value of the card discarded for it, rounded up.
card.flavor: "I will be with you in a moment. Make your peace now."

card.name: Matsu Tayuko - exp
card.text:
Samurai • Paragon • Experienced
While attacking, Tayuko has +2F plus +1F for each Honor action you have resolved (this turn).
Battle: Move home a target enemy defending Personality with lower Personal Honor. If the target has fewer attachments, gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: The Scorpion had grossly underestimated Akodo Dairuko, perhaps thinking her moderate nature made her weak. But the strength of her forces showed she was Lion to her core.

card.name: Moshi Chiyoko
card.text:
Fire • Shugenja • Thunder
Thunder Battle: Fear 2, plus 1 for each Fire or Thunder action you have resolved from a Spell at this battlefield (Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with Force equal to or lower than the Fear's strength).
card.flavor: "I see it, sister," Chiyoko replied. "Let us show it the sun."

card.name: Moshi Nariko
card.text:
Air • Shugenja • Thunder • Naval
(Once a turn, the Attacker gets the first Battle action, if it's from a Naval Personality's unit.)
After Nariko Equips a Spell, give her +1F, and give her +1C if the Spell is Air or Thunder or you are Phoenix Clan.
card.flavor: "Sister, that thing," Nariko said, "it is from the abyssal depths. It knows only night."

card.name: Tsuruchi Kinuyo
card.text:
Samurai • Scout • Destined
Compassion: Instead of drawing a card for bringing Kinuyo into play, you may put a card in your Fate discard pile into your hand. (Compassion takes effect while you have fewer Provinces than anyone else.)
card.flavor: They called her "Kigakikubachi," for she was always the last to release her arrow.

card.name: Tsuruchi Taito - exp
card.text:
Bounty Hunter • Magistrate • Samurai • Scout • Experienced • Naval
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 3 Attack. If this destroyed an enemy Personality, move Taito home; this movement is optional if the Defender has taken an action this battle.
card.flavor: "'What if they look up?' she asked me. Ha! They never look up."

card.name: Yoritomo Tamiya
card.text:
Mercenary • Samurai • Shadowlands • Kensai • Naval
After Tamiya enters play, lose 2 Honor. Your Peasant Weapons out of play have Courage. (Repeatable Interrupt: Discard a Courage card to give a Fear effect +2 or -2 strength.)
card.flavor: "This isn't supposed to happen," Tamiya whispered. "I didn't choose this! I never accepted anything!"

card.name: Yoritomo Honjo
card.text:
Samurai • Kensai
Your Peasant Weapons out of play have Honor. (Repeatable Interrupt: Discard an Honor card to give an Honor gain or loss +1 or -1.)
Battle: Target Honjo's Weapon. Bow it, or if it is a Peasant Weapon you may destroy it, to make a Melee 2 Attack.
card.flavor: "There's no reasoning with umikaiju."

card.name: Agasha Dorai
card.text:
Air • Alchemist • Shugenja • Void
After you Recruit Dorai from a Province, refill it face-up.
Void Open: Give Kharmic to a face-up Library or Temple in your Province.
card.flavor: "We sought only to aid the Empire with the gift of knowledge. We received only violence as thanks."

card.name: Asako Misai
card.text:
Earth • Inquisitor • Magistrate • Shugenja • The Masked Phoenix
Your Earth and Jade Spells out of play have Honor and Kharmic while another player controls any Shadowlands Personalities. After an action from an Earth or Jade card in this unit bows or destroys an enemy Shadowlands card, gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "I will save you, my friend. From yourself, if need be."

card.name: Isawa Bikaru
card.text:
Shugenja • Water • Resilient
Enters play for 2 less Gold if you are Crab Clan or have Compassion or Courtesy. (Compassion takes effect while you have fewer Provinces than anyone else. Courtesy does not take effect if you went first.)
card.flavor: Many Phoenix felt anger at the Unicorn's offense. The crisis of the Seals demanded they set it aside, but Bikaru neither forgave nor forgot.

card.name: Isawa Hokaiko
card.text:
Water • Shugenja
Battle: Fear equal to Hokaiko's Force that may target Items and Spells. If Hokaiko has moved this turn, this Fear destroys attachments after it bows them.
card.flavor: "The site of this tomb is distant, yes, but to suggest the Phoenix cannot make it in time?" She could not continue for laughing.

card.name: Isawa Norimichi, Elemental Master
card.text:
Earth • Jade • Shugenja • Experienced 2 • Loyal • Unique
Your other Earth Shugenja have +1F.
Earth Jade Battle: Melee 3 Attack, or Melee 5 Attack if the target is Shadowlands.
card.flavor: Wave after wave of undead were crushed in the merciless embrace of earth, but they continued coming in seemingly endless numbers.

card.name: Shiba Kakei - exp
card.text:
Samurai • Void • Yojimbo • Cavalry • Experienced
Void Battle: Ranged Attack equal to the number of Kiho and Spell actions you have resolved this battle, or 2, whichever is greater. You may target and move your Shugenja at any location home or, if he or she would be opposed, to this battlefield.
card.flavor: All around him, shugenja fell to the ground, crippled by pain and nausea. "What is this?" Kakei demanded, his sword ready but no enemy in sight.

card.name: Bayushi Shen-lao
card.text:
Bitter Lies • Samurai • Kensai • Resilient
Battle: Target an enemy Follower or Personality. Either give it -2F, or Fear 2 targeting it (if legal). You may discard one of Shen-lao's Madness tokens to apply the effect you did not choose.
card.flavor: "His family proudly traces their heritage back to the days of our exile in the Burning Sands. Perhaps too proudly." - Sensei Hisako

card.name: Bayushi Chiyoda
card.text:
Bitter Lies • Samurai • Shadowlands • Kensai
(Kensai may attach two One-Handed Weapons.) Open, [PAY *]: Target a Weapon in your discard pile. Destroy one of Chiyoda's Madness tokens to Equip the Weapon to him.
card.flavor:
"I didn't do anything!" Chiyoda wailed. "It's not my fault!"
"Kill enough Lion," she smirked, "and perhaps I won't care."

card.name: Bayushi Kanihime
card.text:
Ninja • Duelist • Resilient
After Kanihime enters play, lose 1 Honor.
Ninja Open: Kanihime has +1F/+1C while opposing another player's target Personality in a battle or duel. You may bow one of the target's attachments if he or she has a Poison token.
card.flavor: "The Lion must never know," Nitoshi said. "Send Kwanchai's daughter."

card.name: Shosuro Kayo - exp
card.text:
Ninja • Samurai • Yojimbo • Experienced
Ninja Battle, [BOW]: Melee 3 Attack. This will not be increased or combined, but may target a Personality with attached Followers and a Poison token.
card.flavor: The nightmarish apparition before her had ended the lives of dozens, but she only sneered. "You are unworthy of fear," she mocked, wrapping the chain around its throat. "Soon, you will elicit nothing but laughter."

card.name: Shosuro Ozu
card.text:
Ninja • Spy • Duelist • Expendable
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists. Draw a card after your Expendable card dies.)
After Ozu enters play, lose 4 Honor, or 2 Honor if you are Mantis Clan.
card.flavor: Ozu smiled at the Lion's disdain for her Mantis attire. They feared Scorpion venom so much that they had clutched a serpent to their breast instead...

card.name: Yogo Mizogushi
card.text:
Air • Courtier • Kuroiban • Magistrate • Shugenja
Battle: Fear 2. If you have resolved an Honor action this turn, this Fear has +2 strength and may target a dishonorable Personality with Followers.
card.flavor: "To suggest that we would allow a breach is beyond insulting. It was the Lion thirst for blood that incensed the creatures. You brought this upon yourselves with your war-mongering!"

card.name: Daigotsu Aimaro
card.text:
Samurai • Shadowlands • Duelist
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists.)
Battle: Give a target enemy Follower or Personality -3F. If it now has lower Force than Aimaro, give Aimaro +1C (this turn).
card.flavor:
"You choose to stand against us," he hissed.
"You threw your lives away for nothing. The will of the Spider will not be denied."

card.name: Daigotsu Endo - exp
card.text:
Nonhuman • Samurai • Shadowlands • Undead • Destined • Experienced
You may Recruit Endo even if he is dead. Endo is not destroyed for having 0 Chi. Your Honor cards out of play have Courage.
Battle: Fear 2, or Fear 4 if the target is Shadowlands.
card.flavor: The Phoenix magic tore through his form, seemingly without effect. "Not good enough," he whispered.

card.name: Hikayo
card.text:
Nonhuman • Ogre • Shadowlands • Resilient
Hikayo's Weapons must be Heavy Weapons. Shadowlands Personalities may not refuse challenges from Hikayo.
Interrupt: Hikayo's duel stat in duels from the action is his printed Force.
card.flavor: "Hmph," Kanpeki grunted. "I missed watching them work. It is good to have all my father's allies back with us."

card.name: Daigotsu Yuhmi - exp2
card.text:
Shadowlands • Infiltrator • Nonhuman • Samurai • Experienced 2 • Unique
After Yundha enters play, lose 4 Honor.
Battle: Fear 4 that destroys Shugenja after it bows them.
card.flavor: Norimichi screamed as his hand was severed. Silent as always, Yuhmi had returned to the ranks of the Spider Clan.

card.name: Goju Iaitsu
card.text:
Ninja • Shadowlands
After Iaitsu enters play, lose 2 Honor.
Ninja Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 3 Attack. Straighten Iaitsu if this destroyed a card without abilities (Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 3 or lower Force).
card.flavor: "The less the clans know of the prophecy, the easier our task will be. See to it." - Daigotsu Kanpeki

card.name: Goju Toriken
card.text:
Ninja • Shadowlands • Conqueror
(A Conqueror's unit doesn't bow after battle.)
After Toriken enters play, lose 1 Honor.
Ninja Open: Remove an ability from a target non-Unique Follower or Personality.
card.flavor: "You are terrified, of course. It's only natural. But I feel wonderful! Identity agrees with me, I think."

card.name: Keisho
card.text:
Ashigaru • Shugenja • Resilient
(Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution.)
Keisho will not attach Spells with Focus Value greater than her Chi.
card.flavor: A peasant shugenja is unheard of. Any commoner born with the gift is sought and fostered by the Phoenix. It is dangerous to leave such rare incidents as they are. Dangerous in many ways...

card.name: The Crimson Mountain Oni
card.text:
Nonhuman • Oni • Shadowlands • Resilient
After The Crimson Mountain Oni enters play, lose 7 Honor. Will not attach cards or issue challenges.
Interrupt: Negate The Crimson Mountain Oni's movement from the action.
Battle: Melee 6 Attack. If this destroys an attachment on a Crab Clan Personality, you may make a Melee 6 Attack.
card.flavor: "Where are you, Little Bear?" the monstrosity roared. "You took my fingers, now I will take your life!"

card.name: Tetsuo - exp2
card.text:
Monk • Conqueror • Experienced 2 • Kensai • Unique
Will not join a Spider Clan player.
Battle, [BOW]: Melee 4 Attack. You may bow Tetsuo's Polearm to straighten him.
card.flavor: "The Spider have betrayed the very ideals they claimed to venerate. It was always about petty revenge. They are not worthy of my fealty. They are not worthy of their lives."

card.name: Akuma no Obake
card.text:
Nonhuman • Oni • Shadowlands
After Akuma enters play, lose 4 Honor. Will not attach cards.
Battle: Destroy a target enemy attachment with equal or lower Force.
card.flavor: "Our hatred is one and the same," Ikikashi whispered into the churning sea. "Your master is dead, but I can offer you more than he ever did..."

card.name: Umikaiju
card.text:
Nonhuman • Oni • Shadowlands • Water • Naval
(Once a turn, the Attacker gets the first Battle action, if it's from a Naval Personality's unit.)
After Umikaiju enters play, lose 2 Honor. Will not attach cards.
Battle, [BOW]: Fear 5.
card.flavor: Massive beasts rose from the abyssal seas, horrifying and unstoppable.

card.name: Moto Chinua - exp
card.text:
Samurai • Cavalry • Experienced
Your Honor cards out of play have Courage.
Battle: Target an enemy card. If it has higher Force, is Nonhuman, is Phoenix Clan, or has no attachments, bow it.
card.flavor: Word of the battle began to reach the clans, bringing even the most heated conflicts to a halt. The fire in Chinua's heart could not be quenched so easily. "There will be a reckoning," he promised.

card.name: Moto Dai-ketsu
card.text:
Death Priest • Shugenja • Water • Cavalry • Naval
(Once a turn, the Attacker gets the first Battle action, if it's from a Naval Personality's unit.)
Battle, [BOW]: Fear equal to Dai-ketsu's Force plus the number of Spells he has. If there is a dead Personality in any discard pile or you are Mantis Clan, straighten Dai-ketsu.
card.flavor: "Not even the kami can protect you from my blessings."

card.name: Moto Jengzan
card.text:
Commander • Samurai • Resilient
(Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution.)
Jengzan's Cavalry Followers have Resilient. Your Cavalry Followers out of play have Honor. (Repeatable Interrupt: Discard an Honor card to give an Honor gain or loss +1 or -1.)
card.flavor: Politics and war ride together. Men fall to the needs of both.

card.name: Shinjo Megura
card.text:
Magistrate • Samurai • Cavalry • Destined
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to the battle. Draw a card after you Recruit a Destined card.)
card.flavor: "I will be merciful if you confess. Do so quickly, or freeze. I care little which you choose."

card.name: Shinjo Dogenda
card.text:
Magistrate • Samurai
Home Interrupt: After a Personality is rehonored for the action's effects (including Honor gain), gain 1 Honor.
Battle: Give a target enemy Personality -2F. Dishonor the target if he or she has lower Personal Honor than Dogenda.
card.flavor: "I may not carry Benten's blessings, but I am righteous, and that is enough."

card.name: Utaku Yabusame
card.text:
Battle Maiden • Commander • Samurai • Cavalry
Tireless Battle: Straighten Yabusame if she is attacking and your Family Honor is higher than any other player's.
Repeatable Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 3 Attack. Gain 1 Honor.
card.flavor: "Honor guides my steed, and my arrows."

card.name: Shiotome Troupe
card.text:
Battle Maiden • Cavalry • Honor
After this Follower enters play, gain 1 Honor. This Personality has +1PH. After this unit moves to oppose a defender, gain 1 Honor.
Battle, [BOW]: Fear equal to this Personality's Personal Honor.
card.flavor: Few military forces are as respected.

card.name: Courageous Ashigaru
card.text:
Ashigaru • Conscript
After this Follower enters play from your hand, draw an additional card before your turn ends.
card.flavor: "The majesty of bushido is that it can minifest itself even in the least of souls. Courage can rise from humbleness and honor any lord with its service." - Akodo's Leadership

card.name: Brotherhood Sohei
card.text:
Monk
Battle: Give one or two target enemy Personalities, each with a different Clan alignment, -2F each.
card.flavor: Fools occasionally mistook them for Spider monks. It was a mistake no one ever repeated, for the monks where very... educationally minded.

card.name: The Mountainborn
card.text:
Earth • Nonhuman • Shugenja • Spirit • Experienced Bound Spirit
After this Personality straightens, straighten this Follower.
Earth Battle, [BOW]: Fear equal to twice this Follower's Force.
card.flavor: The Oni's roar was matched with the pure, powerful growl of earth and fire, forged together to stop it.

card.name: Emerald Guard
card.text:
Honor
Reduce the Gold cost to Equip this Follower by the Personality's Personal Honor.
Interrupt: Negate this Personality's movement from the action.
card.flavor: "Wait a moment, my lady. Something here seems amiss."

card.name: Master Infiltrator
card.text:
Ninja • Scout
After this Follower enters play, lose 2 Honor.
Ninja Open: Look at a face-down card in another player's Province.
card.flavor: "No one need know anything about this," she whispered with a smile. "It is best to leave such secrets to the Scorpion."

card.name: Warcats-in-Training
card.text:
Cat • Nonhuman • Cavalry
Negate Fear effects targeting this Follower while it is opposing a bowed Follower or Personality.
Battle: Fear 2 or give a target enemy Follower or Personality -2F.
card.flavor: "They seem cute and playful... until one of them 'playfully' removes a man's finger."

card.name: Oni Familiar
card.text:
Nonhuman • Oni • Shadowlands • Cavalry
After this Follower enters play, lose 4 Honor.
Battle: Fear 2 that destroys Followers after it bows them.
card.flavor: The Spider forces advanced upon the temple, skeletal nightmares riding at the front of their battle lines.

card.name: Legendary Warcat
card.text:
Cat • Nonhuman • Courage
This Follower has +1F for each bowed Follower and bowed Personality opposing it.
After you discard this Follower from your hand for a Courage Interrupt, you may take an additional action to Equip it (after the origial action resolves).
card.flavor: "His name is Rage. Fear him as you fear death."

card.name: Defensive Archers
card.text:
Interrupt: Negate the action's challenges to this Personality if the challenger has no Followers.
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 3 Attack.
card.flavor: "Fire immediately behind the front line as soon as the charge begins!"

card.name: Questionable Vassal
card.text:
Mercenary • Ninja • Ronin
After this Follower enters play, lose 1 Honor.
Ninja Battle, [PAY 2]: Ranged 3 Attack (Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 3 or lower Force).
card.flavor: "I purchased his loyalty, yes, but I worry I may not have paid enough."

card.name: Sons of Gusai - exp
card.text:
Mercenary • Pirate • Courage • Experienced
(Repeatable Interrupt: Discard a Courage card to give a Fear effect +2 or -2 strength.)
Battle, [PAY 2]: Give another target opposed Mercenary +2F.
card.flavor: "To the Sea of Shadows!" Akukiho ordered. His mean reacted no differently than when ordered to pursue human quarry.

card.name: Spiritual Sentries
card.text:
Nonhuman • Spirit • Honor
(Repeatable Interrupt: Discard an Honor card to give an Honor gain or loss +1 or -1.)
Absent Home Battle: Move this Personality to the current battlefield if any enemy attacking units are there. Straighten the Personality as he or she moves.
card.flavor: "The scouts said nothing about this!" the Scorpion hissed as the ancient ancestors of the Lion shimmered into existence, barring their path.

card.name: Clan Mon
card.text:
Standard • Courage
Invest [PAY 2]: Draw a card.
You may include any number of copies of this card in your deck. Can only attach to a Samurai without a Standard. Followers in this unit have +1F.
Battle: Fear equal to the number of Standards in this army.
card.flavor: "It is not a burden to carry your clan's banner into battle. It is an honor... one that endures long after the ringing of steel fades."

card.name: Bakuhatsugama
card.text:
Chain • Ninja • Two-Handed • Weapon
After this Item enters play, lose 1 Honor.
Ninja Battle, [BOW]: Bow a target enemy card. If this bowed a Personality with attachments, destroy this Item.
card.flavor: Outlandish, exotic, dishonorable, and dangerous for the untrained to use; weapons such as these are scorned by most samurai. Thus, most samurai are wholly unprepared to face them. The irony isn't lost upon their wielders.

card.name: Ritual Armor
card.text:
Armor • Honor
(Repeatable Interrupt: Discard an Honor card to give an Honor gain or loss +1 or -1.)
This Personality has +1PH. Increase by 1 the first of your Honor gains each turn from actions from or targeting this Personality.
card.flavor: For formal functions, where the crude necessities of war make way for finer craftsmanship and aesthetic concerns.

card.name: Weathered Armor
card.text:
Armor
Actions cannot move this Personality.
Tireless Battle: Put this Item into your hand. (Tireless actions may be taken even while bowed.)
card.flavor: Every suit of armor is a litany of battles won and trials endured. Some suits develop their own legends, legacies that their wearers seek to be worthy of. They live, they fight, and they pass these suits on, so the suits, like their wearers, can continue to serve their clans.

card.name: Purity's Fist
card.text:
Heavy Weapon • Jade • Two-Handed • Weapon
Jade Battle, [BOW]: Melee 3 Attack with -1 strength if the target has a Two-Handed Weapon and +1 strength if the target is Shadowlands.
card.flavor: Inspired by Hida Genda's preferred weapon, these hammers epitomize the Crab approach to battle. Smaller weapons cannot turn a Fist aside, and those who bear the Taint cannot bear its touch. Simple, pragmatic, and effective.

card.name: Revered Blade
card.text:
One-Handed • Sword • Honor • Weapon
(Repeatable Interrupt: Discard an Honor card to give an Honor gain or loss +1 or -1.)
After you Equip this Item, gain 1 Honor for each Province you have destroyed this game. This Personality has +1PH.
card.flavor: A blade, like a name, is received from one's ancestors and is to be safeguarded for the benefit of the generations to come after.

card.name: Tetsuo's Nagamaki
card.text:
Polearm • Two-Handed • Weapon
Equips to Tetsuo for 2 less Gold. After the first time each turn this Weapon bows, straighten it.
Battle, [BOW]: Melee 3 Attack (Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 3 or lower Force).
card.flavor: "They cut out my heart. This will cut out theirs..."

card.name: Threshing Flail
card.text:
One-Handed • Peasant • Destined • Weapon
(Draw a card after you Equip a Destined card.)
After this Weapon attaches, dishonor its Personality.
Battle, [BOW]: Fear 3.
card.flavor: What many call a nunchaku is a weapon derived from a simple agricultural tool. Using such weapons is frowned upon in samurai culture. However, few can deny their effectiveness in battle.

card.name: Light Tetsubo
card.text:
Heavy Weapon • One-Handed • Reserve • Weapon
(You may Equip a Reserve attachment, if it would be opposed, as a Battle action.)
After this Item enters play, straighten it Personality.
Open, [BOW]: If this Personality does not have a Madness token, give him or her one.
card.flavor: They are smaller and somewhat lighter than their kin, but can be wielded in both hands for added damage.

card.name: Box of Mysteries
card.text:
Invest [PAY 2]: Draw a card. (Upon being played, permanently increase the Gold Cost by the Invest cost to get the effect.)
This Personality cannot issue challenges.
Battle, [BOW]: Draw a card. Discard a card.
card.flavor: Scholars and philosophers alike often keep their greatest insights on simple scrolls, and contain them in simple boxes.

card.name: Calling on the Sun
card.text: Fire Battle, [BOW]: You may target your Samurai. Ranged Attack equal to this Shugenja's Chi or the Samurai's Chi, +2 if this Shugenja is Fire (Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with Force equal to or lower than the Ranged Attack's strength.
card.flavor: Scorpion shugenja are known for versatility and deception, not sheer power. The Scorpion prefer it this way.

card.name: Compassion's Invocation
card.text:
Honor
(Repeatable Interrupt: Discard an Honor card to give an Honor gain or loss +1 or -1.)
Air Open, [BOW]: Bow this Shugenja to give a target Personality a Force penalty equal to this Shugenja's Chi. Gain 1 Honor if this Shugenja is Air.
card.flavor: "This shrine is sacred ground, my friend," she whispered. "You will not attack."

card.name: The Tapestry's Flowing Pattern
card.text: Void Battle/Engage, [BOW]: Give your target Personality +3F. If this Shugenja is Void, abilities on the target may be used a second time this turn.
card.flavor: "Nature's pattern is imperfect, yet flawless. Encouraging repetition in the pattern can be useful, or endlessly confusing."

card.name: Wrath of Suitengu
card.text:
This action has Home while this Shugenja is Water. (Home actions may be taken from home.)
Water Battle, [BOW]: Move a target Personality to an adjacent, unresolved battlefield.
card.flavor: At the priest's command, the river leapt to life and struck down his enemies. The Fortune of the Sea's reach was significant, well beyond the coastal waters.

card.name: The Wind's Clarity
card.text:
Honor
You may Equip this Spell from your discard pile, bowed, to an Air Shugenja if you control a Library or Temple Holding.
Air Open, [BOW]: Bow this Shugenja to gain 1 Honor. Destroy this Spell.
card.flavor: The whispers of the air kami can enhance even the most scholarly mind.

card.name: Ritual of Naming
card.text: Maho Repeatable Open, [PAY *]: Bow this Shugenja and destroy your target Human Personality to search your Dynasty discard pile, then deck, for an Oni Personality and Recruit it. Lose 3 Honor. (Repeatable actions may be taken any number of times per turn.)
card.flavor: "Your names are weak, mewling things. I require all three of you to summon but a single oni of note."

card.name: Primal Tempest
card.text: Thunder Battle, [BOW]: Fear 4 that may, if this Shugenja is Thunder, target a Personality with Followers (Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 4 or lower Force).
card.flavor: The fall of the First Seal caused a surge of massive beasts from the Sea of Shadows. All at once, the Mantis were placed on the defensive.

card.name: Thunder's Resplendent Gift
card.text:
Courage
(Repeatable Interrupt: Discard a Courage card to give a Fear effect +2 or -2 strength.)
Thunder Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 2 Attack. Then, if this Shugenja is Thunder, Fear 2. Neither of these effects may be combined.
card.flavor: The Spider charged. The Mantis and the Phoenix struggled to do their part, fighting alongside the Crab with great fervor.

card.name: The World's Essence
card.text: Open, [BOW]: Give your target Personality Expendable. (Draw a card after your Expendable card dies.)
card.flavor: The lanterns in the room flickered as the shugenja's prayer was completed. "You will have all you need to complete your final task," the priest said sadly.

card.name: Eternally Unyielding
card.text:
Honor
(Repeatable Interrupt: Discard an Honor card to give an Honor gain or loss +1 or -1.)
Earth Battle, [BOW]: Raise or lower the current Province's strength by the number of Earth Followers or Spells (your choice) in this unit, plus 2 if this Shugenja is Earth and opposed.
card.flavor: The mountains rumbled, their promise of thunder greater than any storm.

card.name: Earth's Inevitability
card.text:
Earth Interrupt, [BOW]: If the action is another player's, negate this Shugenja's movement from it.
Earth Battle, [BOW]: If this Shugenja is Earth and opposed, give him or her +1F for each Earth card in this unit.
